internal sealed class SR
{
	private static global::SR loader;

	[ThreadStatic]
	private static Dictionary<DynamicResourceString.ID, DynamicResourceString> _dynamicResourceStrings;

	private ResourceManager[] resources;

	private SR()
	{
		string[] array = "Infragistics.Documents.RichText.strings".Split(';');
		int num = 0;
		string[] array2 = array;
		foreach (string text in array2)
		{
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
		}
		resources = new ResourceManager[num];
		Assembly assembly = GetType().Assembly;
		int num2 = 0;
		array2 = array;
		foreach (string text2 in array2)
		{
			if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
			{
				resources[num2++] = new ResourceManager(text2, assembly);
			}
		}
	}

	public static DynamicResourceString GetDynamicResourceString(string name, object[] args, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		lock (typeof(global::SR))
		{
			DynamicResourceString.ID key = new DynamicResourceString.ID(culture, name, args);
			DynamicResourceString value = null;
			if (_dynamicResourceStrings == null)
			{
				_dynamicResourceStrings = new Dictionary<DynamicResourceString.ID, DynamicResourceString>();
			}
			else
			{
				_dynamicResourceStrings.TryGetValue(key, out value);
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				value = new InternalDynamicResourceString(ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer, culture, name, args);
				_dynamicResourceStrings.Add(key, value);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	private static global::SR GetLoader()
	{
		if (loader == null)
		{
			lock (typeof(global::SR))
			{
				if (loader == null)
				{
					loader = new global::SR();
				}
			}
		}
		return loader;
	}

	public static string GetString(string name)
	{
		return GetString(null, name);
	}

	public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetString(null, name, args);
	}

	public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
	{
		return GetString(culture, name, null);
	}

	public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: true, culture, name, args);
	}

	private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		string text = null;
		if (allowCustomizedStrings)
		{
			text = ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
		}
		if (text == null)
		{
			global::SR sR = GetLoader();
			if (sR == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			text = sR.GetString(name, culture);
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
		}
		if (args != null && args.Length != 0 && text.Length > 2)
		{
			try
			{
				text = string.Format(null, text, args);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		ResourceManager[] array = resources;
		for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
		{
			string text = array[i].GetString(name, culture);
			if (text != null)
			{
				return text;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)

	}

	private object GetObject(string name, CultureInfo culture)

		ResourceManager[] array = resources;

		{
			object obj = array[i].GetObject(name, culture);
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return obj;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
internal sealed class LocalizedDescriptionAttribute : DescriptionAttribute
{
	private bool loaded;

	public override string Description
	{
		get
		{
			if (!loaded)
			{
				loaded = true;
				base.DescriptionValue = global::SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, base.Description);
			}
			return base.Description;
		}
	}

	public LocalizedDescriptionAttribute(string description)
		: base(description)
	{
	}
}

	internal interface ISupportValueChangeNotifications<TItem>
	{
		void AddListener(IValueChangeListener<TItem> listener);

		void RemoveListener(IValueChangeListener<TItem> listener);
	}
	internal class SupportValueChangeNotificationsImpl<TItem> : ISupportValueChangeNotifications<TItem>
	{
		private ValueChangeListenerList<TItem> _listeners;

		protected ValueChangeListenerList<TItem> Listeners
		{
			get
			{
				if (_listeners == null)
				{
					_listeners = new ValueChangeListenerList<TItem>();
				}
				return _listeners;
			}
		}

		internal SupportValueChangeNotificationsImpl()
		{
			_listeners = new ValueChangeListenerList<TItem>();
		}

		public void AddListener(IValueChangeListener<TItem> listener)
		{
			Listeners.AddListener(listener);
		}

		public void RemoveListener(IValueChangeListener<TItem> listener)
		{
			if (_listeners != null)
			{
				_listeners.RemoveListener(listener);
			}
		}

		protected void NotifyPropertyChangeListeners(TItem item)
		{
			if (_listeners != null)
			{
				ListenerList.RaiseValueChanged(_listeners, item);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ValueChangeListenerList<TItem> : IValueChangeListener<TItem>
	{
		private object _listeners;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(_listeners is IList list))
				{
					if (_listeners == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				return list.Count;
			}
		}

		internal ValueChangeListenerList()
		{
		}

		public void AddListener(IValueChangeListener<TItem> listener)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(listener);
			_listeners = ListenerList.Add(_listeners, listener, useWeakReference: false);
		}

		public void RemoveListener(IValueChangeListener<TItem> listener)
		{
			_listeners = ListenerList.Remove(_listeners, listener);
		}

		public void OnValueChanged(TItem item)
		{
			if (_listeners != null)
			{
				ListenerList.RaiseValueChanged(_listeners, item);
			}
		}

		internal static IValueChangeListener<TItem> Add(IValueChangeListener<TItem> listeners, IValueChangeListener<TItem> listener)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(listener);
			if (listeners == null)
			{
				return listener;
			}
			ValueChangeListenerList<TItem> valueChangeListenerList = listeners as ValueChangeListenerList<TItem>;
			if (valueChangeListenerList == null)
			{
				valueChangeListenerList = new ValueChangeListenerList<TItem>();
				valueChangeListenerList.AddListener(listeners);
			}
			valueChangeListenerList.AddListener(listener);
			return valueChangeListenerList;
		}
	}
	internal interface IMap<TKey, TValue> : IEnumerable<TKey>, IEnumerable
	{
		TValue this[TKey key] { get; set; }
	}
	internal abstract class IntKeyArrayMapBase<TKey, TValue> : IMap<TKey, TValue>, IEnumerable<TKey>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected class Enumerator : IEnumerator<TKey>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private IntKeyArrayMapBase<TKey, TValue> _map;

			protected int _index;

			public virtual TKey Current => _map.GetKeyValue(_index);

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			internal Enumerator(IntKeyArrayMapBase<TKey, TValue> map)
			{
				_map = map;
				Reset();
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				TValue[] array = _map._array;
				int maxIndex = _map._maxIndex;
				while (++_index <= maxIndex)
				{
					if (!EqualityComparer<TValue>.Default.Equals(default(TValue), array[_index]))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_index = -1;
			}
		}

		protected TValue[] _array;

		protected int _maxIndex;

		public virtual TValue this[TKey key]
		{
			get
			{
				int intValue = GetIntValue(key);
				if (intValue >= _array.Length)
				{
					return default(TValue);
				}
				return _array[intValue];
			}
			set
			{
				int intValue = GetIntValue(key);
				if (intValue > _maxIndex)
				{
					_maxIndex = intValue;
					if (intValue >= _array.Length)
					{
						TValue[] array = new TValue[Math.Max(1 + intValue, 2 * _array.Length)];
						_array.CopyTo(array, 0);
						_array = array;
					}
				}
				_array[intValue] = value;
			}
		}

		protected IntKeyArrayMapBase()
		{
			_array = new TValue[4];
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_maxIndex = 0;
			_array.Initialize();
		}

		public abstract int GetIntValue(TKey key);

		public abstract TKey GetKeyValue(int val);

		public virtual IEnumerator<TKey> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new Enumerator(this);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

		private class IntEnumerator : Enumerator

		public override TValue this[int key]

				if (key > _maxIndex)

					return default(TValue);

				base[key] = value;

		{

					return value;

		internal class DelegateEqualityComparer<T> : IEqualityComparer<T>, IEqualityComparer
		{
			private Func<T, T, bool> _equalsComparer;

			private Func<T, int> _hashCodeProvider;

			internal DelegateEqualityComparer(Func<T, T, bool> equalsComparer, Func<T, int> hashCodeProvider)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(equalsComparer);
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(hashCodeProvider);
				_equalsComparer = equalsComparer;
				_hashCodeProvider = hashCodeProvider;
			}

			public bool Equals(T x, T y)
			{
				return _equalsComparer(x, y);
			}

			public int GetHashCode(T obj)
			{
				return _hashCodeProvider(obj);
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer.Equals(object x, object y)
			{
				return Equals((T)x, (T)y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer.GetHashCode(object obj)
			{
				return GetHashCode((T)obj);
			}
		}

		internal class PropInfo
		{
			internal readonly int _key;

			internal readonly string _name;

			internal readonly Type _type;

			internal readonly object _mappedFields;

			internal readonly IValueConverter _converter;

			internal readonly bool _isReadOnly;

			internal readonly CopyMethod _copyMethod;

			internal readonly IDefaultValueFactory _defaultValueFactory;

			private readonly IEqualityComparer _equalityComparer;

			internal readonly object _defaultValue;

			internal readonly bool _updateDataItemAsynchronously;

			internal readonly bool _cacheDataItemConvertedValue;

			internal PropInfo(int key, string name, Type type, object mappedFields = null, bool isReadOnly = false, IValueConverter converter = null, CopyMethod copyMethod = CopyMethod.CopyValue, object defaultValue = null, IDefaultValueFactory defaultValueFactory = null, IEqualityComparer equalityComparer = null, bool updateDataItemAsynchronously = false, bool cacheDataItemConvertedValue = false)
			{
				_key = key;
				_name = name;
				_type = type;
				_mappedFields = mappedFields;
				_isReadOnly = isReadOnly;
				_converter = converter;
				_copyMethod = copyMethod;
				_defaultValue = defaultValue;
				_defaultValueFactory = defaultValueFactory;
				_equalityComparer = equalityComparer;
				_updateDataItemAsynchronously = updateDataItemAsynchronously;
				_cacheDataItemConvertedValue = cacheDataItemConvertedValue;
			}

			internal virtual bool AreValuesEqual<T>(T x, IPropertyStorage<T, int> xStorage, T y, IPropertyStorage<T, int> yStorage)
			{
				object value = xStorage.GetValue<object>(x, _key);
				object value2 = yStorage.GetValue<object>(y, _key);
				if (_equalityComparer == null)
				{
					return object.Equals(value, value2);
				}
				return _equalityComparer.Equals(value, value2);
			}

			internal bool GetMappedField<T>(out T mappedField)
			{
				object mappedFields = _mappedFields;
				if (mappedFields is T)
				{
					mappedField = (T)mappedFields;
					return true;
				}
				if (mappedFields is IEnumerable enumerable)
				{
					foreach (object item in enumerable)
					{
						if (item is T)
						{
							mappedField = (T)item;
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				mappedField = default(T);
				return false;
			}

			internal virtual bool CopyCollectionOfPropertyType(ICollection source, ICollection dest)
			{
				if (dest is IList list)
				{
					list.Clear();
					foreach (object item in source)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal virtual void CopyValue<T>(T sourceItem, IPropertyStorage<T, int> source, T destItem, IPropertyStorage<T, int> dest)
			{
				object value = source.GetValue<object>(sourceItem, _key);
				dest.SetValue(destItem, _key, value);
			}

			internal virtual IPropertyStore CreateStore()
			{
				return new DictionaryPropertyStore<object, object>(_defaultValueFactory, _defaultValue);
			}

			internal virtual object GetValue<T>(T x, IPropertyStorage<T, int> xStorage)
			{
				return xStorage.GetValue<object>(x, _key);
			}

			internal virtual bool IsDefaultValue<T>(T item, IPropertyStorage<T, int> storage)
			{
				object value = storage.GetValue<object>(item, _key);
				if (_equalityComparer == null)
				{
					return object.Equals(value, _defaultValue);
				}
				return _equalityComparer.Equals(value, _defaultValue);
			}
		}

		internal class TypedPropInfo<TItem, TValue> : PropInfo, IFieldValueAccessor<TValue>, IFieldValueAccessor
		{
			private readonly Func<TItem, IPropertyStorage<TItem, int>> _storageRetriever;

			private readonly IEqualityComparer<TValue> _equalityComparer;

			internal new readonly TValue _defaultValue;

			internal TypedPropInfo(int key, string name, Func<TItem, IPropertyStorage<TItem, int>> storageRetriever, object mappedFields = null, bool isReadOnly = false, IValueConverter converter = null, CopyMethod copyMethod = CopyMethod.CopyValue, TValue defaultValue = default(TValue), Func<TItem, TValue> defaultValueFactoryFunc = null, IEqualityComparer<TValue> equalityComparer = null, bool updateDataItemAsynchronously = false, bool cacheDataItemConvertedValue = false)
				: base(key, name, typeof(TValue), mappedFields, isReadOnly, converter, copyMethod, defaultValue, ResolveDefaultValueFactory(defaultValue, defaultValueFactoryFunc), (IEqualityComparer)equalityComparer, updateDataItemAsynchronously, cacheDataItemConvertedValue)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(storageRetriever);
				_storageRetriever = storageRetriever;
				_equalityComparer = equalityComparer;
				_defaultValue = defaultValue;
			}

			internal override bool AreValuesEqual<T>(T x, IPropertyStorage<T, int> xStorage, T y, IPropertyStorage<T, int> yStorage)
			{
				TValue value = xStorage.GetValue<TValue>(x, _key);
				TValue value2 = yStorage.GetValue<TValue>(y, _key);
				if (_equalityComparer == null)
				{
					return EqualityComparer<TValue>.Default.Equals(value, value2);
				}
				return _equalityComparer.Equals(value, value2);
			}

			internal override bool CopyCollectionOfPropertyType(ICollection source, ICollection dest)
			{
				if (source is ObservableCollectionExtended<TValue> observableCollectionExtended && dest is IEnumerable<TValue>)
				{
					observableCollectionExtended.ReInitialize((IEnumerable<TValue>)dest);
					return true;
				}
				if (dest is ICollection<TValue> collection)
				{
					collection.Clear();
					foreach (TValue item in source)
					{
						collection.Add(item);
					}
					return true;
				}
				return base.CopyCollectionOfPropertyType(source, dest);
			}

			internal override void CopyValue<T>(T sourceItem, IPropertyStorage<T, int> source, T destItem, IPropertyStorage<T, int> dest)
			{
				TValue value = source.GetValue<TValue>(sourceItem, _key);
				dest.SetValue(destItem, _key, value);
			}

			internal override IPropertyStore CreateStore()
			{
				return new DictionaryPropertyStore<TItem, TValue>(_defaultValueFactory, _defaultValue);
			}

			public virtual TValue GetValue(object dataItem)
			{
				TItem val = (TItem)dataItem;
				return _storageRetriever(val).GetValue<TValue>(val, _key);
			}

			internal override object GetValue<T>(T x, IPropertyStorage<T, int> xStorage)
			{
				return xStorage.GetValue<TValue>(x, _key);
			}

			internal override bool IsDefaultValue<T>(T item, IPropertyStorage<T, int> storage)
			{
				TValue value = storage.GetValue<TValue>(item, _key);
				if (_equalityComparer == null)
				{
					return EqualityComparer<TValue>.Default.Equals(value, _defaultValue);
				}
				return _equalityComparer.Equals(value, _defaultValue);
			}

			private static IDefaultValueFactory<TItem, TValue> ResolveDefaultValueFactory(TValue defaultValue, Func<TItem, TValue> defaultValueFactoryFunc)
			{
				if (defaultValueFactoryFunc == null && !EqualityComparer<TValue>.Default.Equals(default(TValue), defaultValue))
				{
					defaultValueFactoryFunc = (TItem i) => defaultValue;
				}
				if (defaultValueFactoryFunc == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new DefaultValueFactory<TItem, TValue>(defaultValueFactoryFunc);
			}

			public virtual void SetValue(object dataItem, TValue newValue)
			{
				TItem val = (TItem)dataItem;
				_storageRetriever(val).SetValue(val, _key, newValue);
			}

			object IFieldValueAccessor.GetValue(object dataItem)
			{
				return GetValue(dataItem);
			}

			void IFieldValueAccessor.SetValue(object dataItem, object newValue)
			{
				SetValue(dataItem, (newValue != null) ? ((TValue)newValue) : default(TValue));
			}
		}

		private IMap<int, PropInfo> _props;

		internal readonly IMap<int, bool> _unmappedPropertiesStoreCandidates = new IntMap<bool>();

		private IMap<int, IDefaultValueFactory> _cachedDefaultValueFactories;

		internal IMap<int, PropInfo> Props => _props;

		internal virtual string DataItemIdPropName
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetPropInfoFromName("Id") == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return "Id";
			}
		}

		protected StoragePropsInfo()
		{
			_props = new IntMap<PropInfo>();
			Initialize(_props);
		}

		protected virtual bool CopyCloneOverride(PropInfo propInfo, object sourceVal, ref object destVal)
		{
			if (sourceVal != null)
			{
				IValueConverter converter = propInfo._converter;
				if (converter != null)
				{
					CultureInfo invariantCulture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
					string value = converter.ConvertBack(sourceVal, typeof(string), null, invariantCulture) as string;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
					{
						destVal = converter.Convert(value, sourceVal.GetType(), null, invariantCulture);
						if (destVal != null)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool CopyContentsOverride(PropInfo propInfo, object sourceVal, object destVal, MergeMethod mergeMethod)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> props);

		internal void CopyValues<T>(T sourceItem, IPropertyStorage<T, int> source, T destItem, IPropertyStorage<T, int> dest, int[] propsToCopy = null, IMap<int, bool> skipProperties = null)
		{
			Merge(sourceItem, source, destItem, dest, MergeMethod.CopyAll, initializingNewStore: false, propsToCopy, skipProperties);
		}

		internal static T CreateHelper<TItem, T>(TItem item) where T : new()
		{
			return new T();
		}

		internal static void FillMap(PropInfo[] infos, IMap<int, PropInfo> map)
		{
			foreach (PropInfo propInfo in infos)
			{
				map[propInfo._key] = propInfo;
			}
		}

		internal IEnumerable<TMappedField> GetAllMappedFields<TMappedField>()
		{
			List<TMappedField> list = new List<TMappedField>();
			foreach (int prop in Props)
			{
				if (Props[prop].GetMappedField<TMappedField>(out var mappedField))
				{
					list.Add(mappedField);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal IMap<int, IDefaultValueFactory> GetDefaultValueFactories()
		{
			if (_cachedDefaultValueFactories == null)
			{
				IntMap<IDefaultValueFactory> intMap = new IntMap<IDefaultValueFactory>();
				foreach (int prop in Props)
				{
					IDefaultValueFactory defaultValueFactory = Props[prop]._defaultValueFactory;
					if (defaultValueFactory != null)
					{
						intMap[prop] = defaultValueFactory;
					}
				}
				_cachedDefaultValueFactories = intMap;
			}
			return _cachedDefaultValueFactories;
		}

		internal PropInfo GetMappedPropInfo<TMappedField>(TMappedField mappedField)
		{
			IEqualityComparer<TMappedField> equalityComparer = EqualityComparer<TMappedField>.Default;
			foreach (int prop in Props)
			{
				PropInfo propInfo = Props[prop];
				if (propInfo.GetMappedField<TMappedField>(out var mappedField2) && equalityComparer.Equals(mappedField2, mappedField))
				{
					return propInfo;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal IMap<int, PropInfo> GetMatchingProps(Predicate<PropInfo> predicate)
		{
			IMap<int, PropInfo> map = new IntMap<PropInfo>();
			IMap<int, PropInfo> props = Props;
			foreach (int item in props)
			{
				PropInfo propInfo = props[item];
				if (predicate(propInfo))
				{
					map[item] = propInfo;
				}
			}
			return map;
		}

		internal void InitializeNewStore<T>(T item, ref IPropertyStorage<T, int> storage, IPropertyStorage<T, int> newStorage, IPropertyStorage<T, int> variableStorage = null)
		{
			if (storage != newStorage)
			{
				if (storage != null)
				{
					Merge(item, storage, item, newStorage, MergeMethod.CopyNonEmptyValuesOnlyIfDestIsEmpty, initializingNewStore: true);
				}
				storage = newStorage;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDataDifferent<T>(T x, IPropertyStorage<T, int> xStorage, T y, IPropertyStorage<T, int> yStorage, IMap<int, bool> propertiesToCheck, IMap<int, bool> propsWithDifferentValues = null)
		{
			return IsDataDifferent(x, xStorage, y, yStorage, (propertiesToCheck != null) ? ((Predicate<PropInfo>)((PropInfo ii) => propertiesToCheck[ii._key])) : null, propsWithDifferentValues);
		}

		internal bool IsDataDifferent<T>(T x, IPropertyStorage<T, int> xStorage, T y, IPropertyStorage<T, int> yStorage, Predicate<PropInfo> propertiesToCheck, IMap<int, bool> propsWithDifferentValues = null)
		{
			bool result = false;
			IMap<int, PropInfo> props = Props;
			foreach (int item in props)
			{
				PropInfo propInfo = props[item];
				if ((propertiesToCheck == null || propertiesToCheck(propInfo)) && !propInfo.AreValuesEqual(x, xStorage, y, yStorage))
				{
					result = true;
					if (propsWithDifferentValues == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					propsWithDifferentValues[item] = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal PropInfo GetPropInfoFromName(string name)
		{
			IMap<int, PropInfo> props = Props;
			foreach (int item in props)
			{
				PropInfo propInfo = props[item];
				if (propInfo._name == name)
				{
					return propInfo;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int GetPropFromName(string name)
		{
			return GetPropInfoFromName(name)?._key ?? (-1);
		}

		internal void Merge<T>(T item, IPropertyStorage<T, int> source, IPropertyStorage<T, int> dest, MergeMethod mergeMethod)
		{
			Merge(item, source, item, dest, mergeMethod);
		}

		internal void Merge<T>(T sourceItem, IPropertyStorage<T, int> source, T destItem, IPropertyStorage<T, int> dest, MergeMethod mergeMethod, bool initializingNewStore = false, int[] propsToCopy = null, IMap<int, bool> skipProperties = null)
		{
			if (source == null || dest == null || (source == dest && (object)sourceItem == (object)destItem))
			{
				return;
			}
			IMap<int, PropInfo> props = Props;
			foreach (int item in (IEnumerable<int>)(((object)propsToCopy) ?? ((object)props)))
			{
				PropInfo propInfo = props[item];
				CopyMethod copyMethod = ((!initializingNewStore) ? propInfo._copyMethod : ((!propInfo._isReadOnly) ? CopyMethod.CopyValue : propInfo._copyMethod));
				if (copyMethod == CopyMethod.None || (skipProperties != null && skipProperties[item]))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (CopyMethod.CopyValue == copyMethod && mergeMethod == MergeMethod.CopyAll)
				{
					propInfo.CopyValue(sourceItem, source, destItem, dest);
					continue;
				}
				object obj = (source.HasValue(sourceItem, item) ? source.GetValue<object>(sourceItem, item) : propInfo._defaultValue);
				bool flag = mergeMethod switch
				{
					MergeMethod.CopyNonEmptyValues => !IsValueEmpty(obj), 
					MergeMethod.CopyNonEmptyValuesOnlyIfDestIsEmpty => !IsValueEmpty(obj) && (!dest.HasValue(destItem, item) || IsValueEmpty(dest.GetValue<object>(destItem, item))), 
					_ => true, 
				};
				if (CopyMethod.CopyContents == copyMethod)
				{
					flag = false;
					object value = dest.GetValue<object>(destItem, item);
					if (value != obj)
					{
						CopyContentsOverride(propInfo, obj, value, mergeMethod);
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (CopyMethod.CopyClone == copyMethod)
				{
					object destVal = obj;
					if (CopyCloneOverride(propInfo, obj, ref destVal))
					{
						obj = destVal;
					}
				}
				dest.SetValue(destItem, item, obj);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsValueEmpty(object val)
		{
			if (CoreUtilities.IsValueEmpty(val))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (val is DateTime { Ticks: 0L })
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class DictionaryPropertyStore<TItem, TValue> : SupportValueChangeNotificationsImpl<TItem>, IPropertyStore<TItem, TValue>, IPropertyStore
	{
		private readonly WeakDictionary<TItem, TValue> _values;

		private readonly IEqualityComparer<TValue> _equalityComparer;

		private readonly IDefaultValueFactory _defaultValueFactory;

		private readonly TValue _defaultValue;

		private readonly bool _hasDefaultValue;

		public DictionaryPropertyStore(IDefaultValueFactory defaultValueFactory = null, TValue defaultValue = default(TValue))
		{
			_values = new WeakDictionary<TItem, TValue>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: true, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: false);
			_defaultValueFactory = defaultValueFactory;
			_equalityComparer = EqualityComparer<TValue>.Default;
			_defaultValue = defaultValue;
			_hasDefaultValue = !_equalityComparer.Equals(default(TValue), defaultValue);
		}

		public virtual TValue GetValue(TItem item)
		{
			if (!_values.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
			{
				if (_hasDefaultValue)
				{
					value = _defaultValue;
				}
				else if (_defaultValueFactory != null)
				{
					value = (_values[item] = (TValue)_defaultValueFactory.CreateDefaultValue(item));
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public virtual void SetValue(TItem item, TValue newValue)
		{
			_values.TryGetValue(item, out var value);
			bool num = !_equalityComparer.Equals(value, newValue);
			if (_equalityComparer.Equals(newValue, _defaultValue))
			{
				_values.Remove(item);
			}
			else
			{
				_values[item] = newValue;
			}
			if (num)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChangeListeners(item);
			}
		}

		public virtual bool HasValue(TItem item)
		{
			return _values.ContainsKey(item);
		}

		public void Compact()
		{
			if (_values != null)
			{
				_values.Compact(removeEntriesWithNullValues: true);
			}
		}

		object IPropertyStore.GetValue(object item)
		{
			return GetValue((TItem)item);
		}

		void IPropertyStore.SetValue(object item, object newValue)
		{
			SetValue((TItem)item, (newValue != null) ? ((TValue)newValue) : default(TValue));
		}

		bool IPropertyStore.HasValue(object item)
		{
			return HasValue((TItem)item);
		}
	}
	internal interface IDefaultValueFactory
	{
		object CreateDefaultValue(object item);
	}
	internal interface IDefaultValueFactory<TItem, TValue> : IDefaultValueFactory
	{
		TValue CreateDefaultValue(TItem item);
	}
	internal interface IListInternal
	{
		int Count { get; }

		object this[int index] { get; set; }

		int IndexOf(object item);
	}

	internal class BitmapImageLoader : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private BitmapImage _image;

		private BitmapImageLoader _placeholderImageLoader;

		private BitmapImageLoadStatus _status;

		private Exception _exception;

		public BitmapImage ImageToDisplay
		{
			get
			{
				if (_status == BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded && _image != null)
				{
					return _image;
				}
				if (_placeholderImageLoader != null)
				{
					return _placeholderImageLoader.ImageToDisplay;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public Exception Exception => _exception;

		public BitmapImageLoader PlaceholderImageLoader
		{
			get
			{
				return _placeholderImageLoader;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_placeholderImageLoader != value)
				{
					if (_placeholderImageLoader != null)
					{
						_placeholderImageLoader.PropertyChanged -= OnPlaceholderImageLoader_PropertyChanged;
					}
					_placeholderImageLoader = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("PlaceholderImageLoader");
					if (_placeholderImageLoader != null && _placeholderImageLoader.Status != BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded)
					{
						_placeholderImageLoader.PropertyChanged += OnPlaceholderImageLoader_PropertyChanged;
					}
					if (_status != BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded)
					{
						RaisePropertyChanged("ImageToDisplay");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public BitmapImageLoadStatus Status
		{
			get
			{
				return _status;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (_status != value)
				{
					_status = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("Status");
					if (_status == BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded && _image.CanFreeze)
					{
						_image.Freeze();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		internal BitmapImageLoader(BitmapImage image)
		{
			_status = BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded;
			_image = image;
		}

		internal BitmapImageLoader(string uriString, BitmapCreateOptions options = BitmapCreateOptions.None)
		{
			Uri uri = new Uri(uriString, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
			LoadFromUri(uri, options);
		}

		internal BitmapImageLoader(Uri uri, BitmapCreateOptions options = BitmapCreateOptions.None)
		{
			LoadFromUri(uri, options);
		}

		internal BitmapImageLoader(Stream stream, BitmapCreateOptions options = BitmapCreateOptions.None, RichTextImageFormat? format = null)
		{
			try
			{
				_status = BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loading;
				_image = new BitmapImage();
				if (!format.HasValue || (format.Value != RichTextImageFormat.Wmf && format.Value != RichTextImageFormat.Emf) || !LoadUsingGdiPlus(stream))
				{
					_image.BeginInit();
					_image.CreateOptions = options;
					_image.StreamSource = stream;
					_image.EndInit();
				}
				if (!_image.IsDownloading && _image.PixelHeight > 0 && _image.PixelWidth > 0)
				{
					if (_image.CanFreeze)
					{
						_image.Freeze();
					}
					_status = BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded;
				}
				else
				{
					WireEvents();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				_exception = exception;
				_status = BitmapImageLoadStatus.LoadFailed;
				UnwireEvents();
			}
		}

		private void OnDecodeFailed(object sender, ExceptionEventArgs e)
		{
			UnwireEvents();
			_exception = e.ErrorException;
			Status = BitmapImageLoadStatus.LoadFailed;
		}

		private void OnDownloadCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UnwireEvents();
			Status = BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded;
		}

		private void OnDownloadFailed(object sender, ExceptionEventArgs e)
		{
			UnwireEvents();
			_exception = e.ErrorException;
			Status = BitmapImageLoadStatus.LoadFailed;
		}

		private void OnPlaceholderImageLoader_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "Status")
			{
				_placeholderImageLoader.PropertyChanged -= OnPlaceholderImageLoader_PropertyChanged;
				if (_status != BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded && _placeholderImageLoader.Status == BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("ImageToDisplay");
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ClearException()
		{
			_exception = null;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private bool LoadUsingGdiPlus(Stream stream)
		{
			try
			{
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(stream);
				ImageFormat imageFormat = bitmap.RawFormat;
				if (ImageFormat.MemoryBmp.Guid == imageFormat.Guid)
				{
					imageFormat = ImageFormat.Bmp;
				}
				bitmap.Save(memoryStream, imageFormat);
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				_image.BeginInit();
				_image.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
				_image.StreamSource = memoryStream;
				_image.EndInit();
				_image.Freeze();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void LoadFromUri(Uri uri, BitmapCreateOptions options)
		{
			try
			{
				_status = BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loading;
				_image = new BitmapImage();
				_image.CreateOptions = options;
				_image.BeginInit();
				_image.UriSource = uri;
				_image.EndInit();
				if (!_image.IsDownloading && _image.PixelHeight > 0 && _image.PixelWidth > 0)
				{
					if (_image.CanFreeze)
					{
						_image.Freeze();
					}
					_status = BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded;
				}
				else
				{
					WireEvents();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				_exception = exception;
				_status = BitmapImageLoadStatus.LoadFailed;
				UnwireEvents();
			}
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string prop)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(prop));
			}
		}

		private void UnwireEvents()
		{
			_image.DecodeFailed -= OnDecodeFailed;
			_image.DownloadFailed -= OnDownloadFailed;
			_image.DownloadCompleted -= OnDownloadCompleted;
		}

		private void WireEvents()
		{
			_image.DecodeFailed += OnDecodeFailed;
			_image.DownloadFailed += OnDownloadFailed;
			_image.DownloadCompleted += OnDownloadCompleted;
		}
	}
	internal enum BitmapImageLoadStatus : byte
	{
		Loading,
		Loaded,
		LoadFailed
	}
}

	public class RichTextDocument : INotifyPropertyChanged

		private class AtomicOperationInfo
		{
			internal readonly RichTextDocument _document;

			internal int _counter;

			internal bool _documentChanged;

			internal UndoTransaction _undoTransaction;

			internal readonly DocumentOffsetChange _startingOffsetChange;

			internal readonly bool _updatingTableGridColumns;

			private object _operationEndListeners;

			internal AtomicOperationInfo(RichTextDocument document, bool startUndoTransaction = true, string undoTitle = null, string undoDescription = null, bool updatingTableGridColumns = false)
			{
				_document = document;
				_updatingTableGridColumns = updatingTableGridColumns;
				if (startUndoTransaction && !updatingTableGridColumns)
				{
					_undoTransaction = document.StartUndoHelper(undoTitle, undoDescription);
				}
				_startingOffsetChange = _document._lastOffsetChange;
			}

			internal void ListenForOperationEnd(IPropertyChangeListener listener)
			{
				_operationEndListeners = ListenerListEx.Add(_operationEndListeners, listener);
			}

			internal void NotifyListenersOfOperationEnd()
			{
				ListenerListEx.RaisePropertyChanged(_operationEndListeners, this, "IsInAtomicOperation", KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
			}
		}

		private struct AvailableStyleKey<T> : IComparable<AvailableStyleKey<T>> where T : RichTextStyleBase
		{
			internal T _style;

			internal bool _isUsed;

			internal AvailableStyleKey(T style, bool isUsed)
			{
				_style = style;
				_isUsed = isUsed;
			}

			public int CompareTo(AvailableStyleKey<T> other)
			{
				if (other._style == _style)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				int sortPriority = _style.SortPriority;
				int sortPriority2 = other._style.SortPriority;
				if (sortPriority < sortPriority2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (sortPriority > sortPriority2)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				bool isPrimary = _style.IsPrimary;
				bool isPrimary2 = other._style.IsPrimary;
				if (isPrimary != isPrimary2)
				{
					if (!isPrimary)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				return string.Compare(_style.Id, other._style.Id, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase);
			}
		}

		}

		}

		public void Delete(DocumentSpan[] spans)
		{
			if (spans == null || spans.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginAtomicOperationSR("Op_DeleteText_Title", "Op_DeleteText_Description", Utilities.TruncateString(GetTextInSpan(spans[0], new PlainTextFormatOptions
			{
				NewLineText = " "
			}), 20));
			try
			{
				List<DocumentSpan> list = Utilities.CompactAndSortSpans(spans);
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					DeleteHelper(list[num]);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		public void DeleteTableRow(TableRowNode row, out string error)
		{
			error = null;
			BeginAtomicOperationSR("Op_DeleteTableRow_Title", "Op_DeleteTableRow_Description");
			try
			{
				DocumentSpan nodeSpan = GetNodeSpan(row);
				if (nodeSpan.Length > 0)
				{
					DeleteHelper(nodeSpan);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		public FindResult FindAll(DocumentSpan span, string textToFind, out string error, FindCriteria findCriteria = null, bool allowOverlappingMatches = false, int maximumMatches = 10000)
		{
			return FindAll(new DocumentSpan[1] { span }, textToFind, out error, findCriteria, allowOverlappingMatches, maximumMatches);
		}

		public FindResult FindAll(DocumentSpan[] spans, string textToFind, out string error, FindCriteria findCriteria = null, bool allowOverlappingMatches = false, int maximumMatches = 10000)
		{
			error = null;
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(maximumMatches, "maximumMatches");
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(textToFind))
			{
				return new FindResult(new CoreUtilities.EmptyEnumerable<FindMatch>());
			}
			if (findCriteria == null)
			{
				findCriteria = new FindCriteria();
			}
			DocumentBodyNode owner = ((_rootNode != null) ? _rootNode.Body : null);
			FindOperator findOperator = findCriteria.Operator;
			string regex;
			RegexOptions options;
			if (findOperator == FindOperator.Wildcard)
			{
				CoreUtilities.WildcardToRegexConverter.Convert(textToFind, out regex, out options, out var error2, matchWholeText: false);
				if (error2 != null)
				{
					error = error2.Message;
					return null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				options = RegexOptions.None;
				regex = Regex.Escape(textToFind);
			}
			Regex regex2 = new Regex(options: (!findCriteria.CaseSensitive) ? (options | RegexOptions.IgnoreCase) : (options & ~RegexOptions.IgnoreCase), pattern: regex);
			List<FindMatch> matches = new List<FindMatch>();
			FindTextConsumer tc = null;
			bool done = false;
			Action<DocumentSpan, string> matchCallback = delegate(DocumentSpan span, string value)
			{
				if (matches.Count < maximumMatches)
				{
					matches.Add(new FindMatch(new VersionedDocumentSpan(CurrentVersion, span), value));
				}
				else
				{
					tc.Stop();
					done = true;
				}
			};
			for (int num = 0; num < spans.Length; num++)
			{
				tc = new FindTextConsumer(regex2, matchCallback, allowOverlappingMatches);
				tc.InitializeSpan(this, spans[num]);
				NodeUtils.GetBlockOwnerText(owner, tc);
				if (done)
				{
					break;
				}
				tc.ProcessPendingText();
			}
			error = null;
			return new FindResult(matches);
		}

		public CharacterSettings GetCommonCharacterSettings(DocumentSpan span, bool ignoreLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace = false)
		{
			span = GetResolvedSpanForSettingsRetrieval(span, ignoreLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace);
			NodeSpanCache nodeSpanCache;
			List<RunNode> list = NodeUtils.GetRunNodesIntersectingSpan(this, span, out nodeSpanCache).ToList();
			GetCommonSettingsHelper getCommonSettingsHelper = new GetCommonSettingsHelper(new CharacterSettings());
			foreach (RunNode item in list)
			{
				if ((nodeSpanCache.GetCachedSpan(item).Intersection(span) ?? DocumentSpan.Empty).Length > 0)
				{
					getCommonSettingsHelper.Process(item.SettingsResolved);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				IEnumerable<ParagraphNode> paragraphsIntersectingSpan = NodeUtils.GetParagraphsIntersectingSpan(this, span);
				foreach (ParagraphNode item2 in paragraphsIntersectingSpan)
				{
					DocumentSpan nodePostfixDocumentSpan = NodeUtils.GetNodePostfixDocumentSpan(item2);
					if (nodePostfixDocumentSpan.Length > 0 && span.Contains(nodePostfixDocumentSpan))
					{
						getCommonSettingsHelper.Process(item2.ParagraphMarkSettingsResolved);
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					ParagraphNode paragraphNode = paragraphsIntersectingSpan.FirstOrDefault();
					if (paragraphNode != null)
					{
						if (paragraphNode.IsListItemResolved && span == NodeUtils.GetNodePrefixDocumentSpan(paragraphNode))
						{
							getCommonSettingsHelper.Process(paragraphNode.ListItemInfoResolved.IndicatorSettingsResolved);
						}
						else
						{
							getCommonSettingsHelper.Process(paragraphNode.RunSettingsResolved);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return (CharacterSettings)getCommonSettingsHelper._dest;
		}

		public string GetCommonParagraphListStyle(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			string[] array = (from i in GetParagraphs(span)
				select (!i.IsListItemResolved) ? null : i.ListItemInfoResolved.Owner.ListStyleId).Distinct().ToArray();
			if (1 != array.Length)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return array[0];
		}

		public ParagraphSettings GetCommonParagraphSettings(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			span = GetResolvedSpanForSettingsRetrieval(span);
			IEnumerable<ParagraphNode> paragraphsIntersectingSpan = NodeUtils.GetParagraphsIntersectingSpan(this, span);
			GetCommonSettingsHelper getCommonSettingsHelper = new GetCommonSettingsHelper(new ParagraphSettings());
			Utilities.PerformOnAll(paragraphsIntersectingSpan, delegate(ParagraphNode p)
			{
				getCommonSettingsHelper.Process(p.SettingsResolved);
			});
			return (ParagraphSettings)getCommonSettingsHelper._dest;
		}

		public HyperlinkNode InsertHyperlink(int documentOffset, string targetUri, out string error, string displayText = null, string tooltip = null)
		{
			Utilities.ValidateUri(targetUri);
			if (displayText == null)
			{
				displayText = targetUri;
			}
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotEmpty(displayText, "displayText");
			BeginAtomicOperationSR("Op_RemoveHyperlink_Title", "Op_RemoveHyperlink_Description", targetUri);
			try
			{
				MoveFromAvailableToStylesHelper<CharacterStyle>("Hyperlink", out var _);
				HyperlinkNode hyperlinkNode = new HyperlinkNode();
				hyperlinkNode.SetText(displayText);
				hyperlinkNode.Uri = targetUri;
				hyperlinkNode.Tooltip = tooltip;
				if (targetUri.StartsWith("www.") && targetUri.Length > 4)
				{
					hyperlinkNode.Uri = "http://" + targetUri;
				}
				InsertContent(documentOffset, hyperlinkNode, out error);
				return (error == null) ? hyperlinkNode : null;
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		public ParagraphNode InsertParagraph(int offset, out string error, bool emulateUI = false)
		{
			if (!ValidateDocumentOffset(offset, out error))
			{
				return null;
			}
			BeginAtomicOperationSR("Op_InsertParagraph_Title", "Op_InsertParagraph_Description");
			try
			{
				NodeBase nodeAtDocumentOffset = GetNodeAtDocumentOffset(offset);
				if (emulateUI && nodeAtDocumentOffset is TableRowNode)
				{
					TableRowNode tableRowNode = InsertTableRow(offset, before: false, out error);
					return (tableRowNode != null) ? NodeUtils.GetDescendantParagraphs(tableRowNode).FirstOrDefault() : null;
				}
				InsertNodeRetrievalInfo info = new InsertNodeRetrievalInfo(offset, emulateUI, addEmptyParagraphIfOffsetAfterDoc: false);
				nodeAtDocumentOffset = GetInsertTextNodeHelper(ref info, out error);
				bool flag = false;
				ParagraphNode paragraphNode = nodeAtDocumentOffset?.GetAncestorNode<ParagraphNode>();
				ParagraphNode right = null;
				bool before = false;
				if (paragraphNode != null)
				{
					if (emulateUI && offset <= paragraphNode.PrefixOffsetCount && (paragraphNode.IsListItemResolved || paragraphNode.GetAncestorNode<TableCellNode>() != null))
					{
						right = new ParagraphNode();
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						int relativeOffset = NodeUtils.GetRelativeOffset(this, paragraphNode, offset);
						if (relativeOffset == 0)
						{
							before = true;
						}
						else
						{
							NodeUtils.Split(paragraphNode, relativeOffset, out right);
						}
					}
				}
				if (right == null)
				{
					if (paragraphNode != null && NodeUtils.IsDocumentOffsetAtNodeEnd(this, paragraphNode, offset))
					{
						ParagraphStyle styleResolvedHelper = RichTextStyleCollection.GetStyleResolvedHelper<ParagraphStyle>(paragraphNode, paragraphNode.StyleId);
						string text = styleResolvedHelper?.NextParagraphStyleId;
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && !Utilities.AreIdsEqual(styleResolvedHelper.Id, text) && MoveFromAvailableToStylesHelper<ParagraphStyle>(text, out var _) != null)
						{
							right = new ParagraphNode
							{
								StyleId = text
							};
						}
					}
					if (right == null)
					{
						right = ((paragraphNode != null) ? ((ParagraphNode)paragraphNode.Clone(copyId: false, copyChildNodes: false)) : new ParagraphNode());
					}
				}
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (right != null)
				{
					if (flag || nodeAtDocumentOffset is DocumentBodyNode || nodeAtDocumentOffset is DocumentRootNode)
					{
						EnsureBodyNode();
						RootNode.Body.ChildNodes.Insert(right, flag);
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else if (paragraphNode != null && paragraphNode.ParentCollection != null)
					{
						flag2 = paragraphNode.ParentCollection.InsertBeforeAfter(paragraphNode, right, before);
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					int nodeOffsetCount = right.NodeOffsetCount;
					ProcessDocumentOffsetChange(new DocumentOffsetChange(AggregateOffsetCount - nodeOffsetCount, new DocumentSpan(info._adjustedDocumentOffset, 0), new DocumentSpan(info._adjustedDocumentOffset, nodeOffsetCount)));
					return right;
				}
				error = "Paragraph cannot be inserted at this location.";
				return null;
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		public TableNode InsertTable(int documentOffset, int columns, int rows, out string error, TableExtentBehavior extentBehavior = TableExtentBehavior.FixedWidthColumns, Extent? pageExtent = null, Extent? fixedColumnWidth = null, string tableStyleId = null)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsPositive(columns, "columns");
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsPositive(rows, "rows");

			}
			if (fixedColumnWidth.HasValue)

				CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(fixedColumnWidth.Value.Twips, "fixedColumnWidth");
			}
			if (!ValidateDocumentOffset(documentOffset, out error))
			{
				return null;
			}
			BeginAtomicOperationSR("Op_InsertTable_Title", "Op_InsertTable_Description");
			try
			{
				EnsureBodyNode();

				{
					tableStyleId = "TableGrid";
				}
				ParagraphNode nodeAtDocumentOffset = NodeUtils.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset<ParagraphNode>(this, documentOffset);
				MoveFromAvailableToStylesHelper<TableStyle>(tableStyleId, out error);
				if (error == null)
				{

					tableNode.StyleId = tableStyleId;
					InsertContent(documentOffset, tableNode, out error);
					if (error == null)
					{
						return tableNode;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		public void MakeHyperlink(DocumentSpan span, string targetUri, out string error, string tooltip)
		{
			Utilities.ValidateUri(targetUri);
			error = null;
			BeginAtomicOperationSR("Op_MakeHyperlink_Title", "Op_MakeHyperlink_Description", targetUri);
			try
			{
				NodeUtils.SplitParagraphContentAtBoundaries(this, span);
				HyperlinkNode[] array = GetHyperlinks(span).ToArray();
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					HyperlinkNode hyperlinkNode;
					if (1 == array.Length && (hyperlinkNode = array[0]).GetDocumentSpan() == span)
					{
						hyperlinkNode.Uri = targetUri;
						hyperlinkNode.Tooltip = tooltip;
						return;
					}
					RemoveHyperlinks(span, out error);
					if (error != null)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				string text = "Hyperlink";
				MoveFromAvailableToStylesHelper<CharacterStyle>(text, out var _);
				ParagraphNode[] array2 = GetParagraphs(span).ToArray();
				foreach (ParagraphNode paragraphNode in array2)
				{
					if (paragraphNode.GetChildNodesDocumentSpan().OverlapsWith(span))
					{
						HyperlinkNode hyperlinkNode = new HyperlinkNode
						{
							Uri = targetUri,
							Tooltip = tooltip
						};
						if (NodeUtils.AddLayerOverChildNodesContainedInSpan(this, paragraphNode, hyperlinkNode, span))
						{
							hyperlinkNode.SetStyleIdOnRuns(text);
						}
						else if (error == null)
						{
							error = "Unknown error!";
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		}

		}

		public ReplaceResult ReplaceAll(DocumentSpan[] spans, string textToFind, NodeBase replacementContent, out string error, FindCriteria findCriteria = null)
		{
			return ReplaceAllHelper(spans, textToFind, replacementContent, null, out error, findCriteria);
		}

		private ReplaceResult ReplaceAllHelper(DocumentSpan[] spans, string textToFind, NodeBase replacementContent, string replacementText, out string error, FindCriteria findCriteria = null)
		{
			Utilities.ValidateNotEmpty(textToFind, "TextToFind");
			error = null;
			BeginAtomicOperation("Replace", "Replace text");
			try
			{
				List<Replacement> list = new List<Replacement>();
				FindResult findResult = FindAll(spans, textToFind, out error, findCriteria, allowOverlappingMatches: false, int.MaxValue);
				if (error != null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (findResult.HasMatch)
				{
					FindMatch[] array = findResult.Matches.Reverse().ToArray();
					foreach (FindMatch findMatch in array)
					{
						DocumentSpan span = findMatch.Span.Span;
						ReplaceContentsHelper(span, replacementContent, replacementText, out error);
						if (error != null)
						{
							break;
						}
						list.Add(Replacement.CreateHelper(findMatch, replacementContent, replacementText));
					}
				}
				return new ReplaceResult(new ReadOnlyCollection<Replacement>(list));
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		public void ToggleCharacterFormatting(DocumentSpan span, CharacterFormatType formatType)
		{
			if (span.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			CharacterSettings commonCharacterSettings = GetCommonCharacterSettings(span);
			int num = -1;
			switch (formatType)
			{
			case CharacterFormatType.Bold:
				num = 1;
				break;
			case CharacterFormatType.Italics:
				num = 17;
				break;
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			RichTextStorageProps<RichTextObjectBase>.DefaultStorage defaultStorage = commonCharacterSettings.PropsInfo._defaultStorage;
			bool flag = !(defaultStorage.GetValue<bool?>(commonCharacterSettings, num) ?? true);
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = new CharacterSettings();
			defaultStorage.SetValue(characterSettings, num, flag);
			string arg = (flag ? "Apply" : "Remove");
			string arg2 = num.ToString();
			BeginAtomicOperationSR($"Op_{arg}{arg2}_Title", $"Op_{arg}{arg2}_Description");
			try
			{
				ApplyCharacterSettings(span, characterSettings, out var _);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyCharacterSettingsHelper(DocumentSpan span, ApplySettingsHelper applySettingsHelper, out string error)
		{
			ApplyCharacterSettingsHelper(new DocumentSpan[1] { span }, applySettingsHelper, out error);
		}

		internal void ApplyCharacterSettingsHelper(DocumentSpan[] spans, ApplySettingsHelper applySettingsHelper, out string error)
		{
			BeginAtomicOperationSR("Op_ApplyCharacterSettings_Title", "Op_ApplyCharacterSettings_Description");
			try
			{
				error = null;
				if (NodeUtils.DoSpansCorrespondToListIndicatorsAtSameLevel(this, spans, out var matchingList, out var matchingLevel))
				{
					matchingList.PrepareListTemplateForModifications();
					ListLevelDefinition levelDefinitionSafe = Utilities.GetLevelDefinitionSafe(matchingList, matchingLevel);
					if (levelDefinitionSafe != null)
					{
						CharacterSettings characterSettings = levelDefinitionSafe.NumberSettings ?? new CharacterSettings();
						applySettingsHelper.ApplyTo(characterSettings);
						levelDefinitionSafe.NumberSettings = characterSettings;
					}
					return;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < spans.Length; i++)
				{
					DocumentSpan span = spans[i];
					ModifyParagraphsAndRunsHelper(span, delegate(RunNode r)
					{
						r.ApplySettings(applySettingsHelper);
					}, delegate(ParagraphNode p, DocumentSpan pSpan)
					{
						if (span.Contains(pSpan.End - 1))
						{
							applySettingsHelper.ApplyTo(p.MarkSettingsAllocated);
						}
					});
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyParagraphSettingsHelper(DocumentSpan span, ApplySettingsHelper applySettingsHelper, out string error)
		{
			BeginAtomicOperationSR("Op_ApplyParagraphSettings_Title", "Op_ApplyParagraphSettings_Description");
			try
			{
				error = null;
				Utilities.PerformOnAll(GetParagraphs(span), delegate(ParagraphNode p)
				{
					p.ApplySettings(applySettingsHelper);
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		internal void BeginAtomicOperationSR(string undoTitleSR = null, string undoDescriptionSR = null, params string[] undoDescriptionSRArgs)
		{
			BeginAtomicOperation(Utilities.GetString(undoTitleSR), Utilities.GetString(undoDescriptionSR, undoDescriptionSRArgs));
		}

		internal void BeginAtomicOperation(string undoTitle = null, string undoDescription = null, bool updatingTableGridColumns = false)
		{
			if (_atomicOperation == null)
			{
				_atomicOperation = new AtomicOperationInfo(this, startUndoTransaction: true, undoTitle, undoDescription ?? undoTitle, updatingTableGridColumns);
			}
			_atomicOperation._counter++;
		}

		internal void ClearImageDownloadQueues(bool cancelDownloadsInProgress)
		{
			if (_imageDownloadQueue == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_imageDownloadQueue.Clear();
			_imageDownloadPriorityStack.Clear();
			if (cancelDownloadsInProgress)
			{
				ImageDownloadData[] array = _imageDownloadsInProgress.ToArray();
				_imageDownloadsInProgress.Clear();
				_imageDownloadCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
				_imageDownloadCancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
				ImageDownloadData[] array2 = array;
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					array2[i]._status = RichTextImageStatus.DownloadNotStarted;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CommitUndoHelper(UndoTransaction transaction)
		{
			transaction?.Commit();
		}

		internal void EndAtomicOperation()
		{
			if (_atomicOperation == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_atomicOperation._counter--;
			if (_atomicOperation._counter != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			AtomicOperationInfo atomicOperation = _atomicOperation;
			_atomicOperation = null;
			if (atomicOperation._undoTransaction != null)
			{
				atomicOperation._undoTransaction.Commit();
			}
			atomicOperation.NotifyListenersOfOperationEnd();
			if (atomicOperation._documentChanged && !atomicOperation._updatingTableGridColumns)
			{
				DocumentChangeType changeType = DocumentChangeType.Content;
				if (atomicOperation._startingOffsetChange != null && atomicOperation._startingOffsetChange.NextChange == null)
				{
					changeType = DocumentChangeType.Settings;
				}
				OnDocumentChanged(changeType);
			}
		}

		internal ImageNode[] GetAffectedNodes(ImageDownloadData loadData)
		{
			List<ImageNode> list = new List<ImageNode>();
			if (_imageDownloadAffectedNodeMap.TryGetValue(loadData, out var value))
			{
				DocumentRootNode rootNode = RootNode;
				int count = value.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					ImageNode imageNode = value[i];
					if (imageNode.ImageUri == loadData._uriString && imageNode.RootNode == rootNode)
					{
						list.Add(imageNode);
						continue;
					}
					value.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
				if (list.Count == 0)
				{
					RemoveDownloadData(loadData);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal bool GetIsDocumentOffsetListNumber(int documentOffset)
		{
			ParagraphNode paragraphNode = GetNodeAtDocumentOffset(documentOffset) as ParagraphNode;
			int num = paragraphNode?.PrefixOffsetCount ?? 0;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return num + paragraphNode.GetDocumentOffset() >= documentOffset;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal Extent GetMinMaxFontSize(DocumentSpan span, bool minimum)
		{
			span = GetResolvedSpanForSettingsRetrieval(span);
			NodeSpanCache nodeSpanCache;
			IEnumerable<RunNode> runNodesIntersectingSpan = NodeUtils.GetRunNodesIntersectingSpan(this, span, out nodeSpanCache);
			Extent? extent = null;
			foreach (RunNode item in runNodesIntersectingSpan)
			{
				Extent? fontSizeHelper = NodeUtils.GetFontSizeHelper(item);
				if (!fontSizeHelper.HasValue)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (extent.HasValue)
				{
					bool num;
					if (!minimum)
					{
						Extent? extent2 = extent;
						Extent value = fontSizeHelper.Value;
						if (!extent2.HasValue)
						{
							continue;
						}
						num = extent2.GetValueOrDefault() < value;
					}
					else
					{
						Extent? extent2 = extent;
						Extent value = fontSizeHelper.Value;
						if (!extent2.HasValue)
						{
							continue;
						}
						num = extent2.GetValueOrDefault() > value;
					}
					if (!num)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				extent = fontSizeHelper;
			}
			if (!extent.HasValue)
			{
				ParagraphNode paragraphNode = NodeUtils.GetParagraphsIntersectingSpan(this, span).FirstOrDefault();
				if (paragraphNode != null)
				{
					extent = NodeUtils.GetFontSizeHelper(paragraphNode);
				}
			}
			if (extent.HasValue)
			{
				return extent.Value;
			}
			if (RootNode != null && RootNode.Settings != null)
			{
				CharacterSettings defaultCharacterSettings = RootNode.Settings.DefaultCharacterSettings;
				if (defaultCharacterSettings != null && defaultCharacterSettings.FontSize.HasValue)
				{
					return defaultCharacterSettings.FontSize.Value;
				}
			}
			return DefaultCharacterSettings.FontSize.Value;
		}

		internal NodeBase GetNodeAtAggregateIndex(int nodeAggregateIndex)
		{
			if (_rootNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _rootNode.GetNodeAtAggregateIndex(nodeAggregateIndex);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<TNode> GetNodesInSpan<TNode>(DocumentSpan intersectSpan, bool fullyContainedNodesOnly = false) where TNode : NodeBase
		{
			if (!fullyContainedNodesOnly)
			{
				Utilities.EnsureNonEmpty(ref intersectSpan);
			}
			return NodeUtils.GetNodesIntersectingSpan<TNode>(this, intersectSpan, fullyContainedNodesOnly);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<ParagraphNode> GetParagraphsInListAtOffset(int offset, int? level = null)
		{
			ParagraphNode nodeAtDocumentOffset = NodeUtils.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset<ParagraphNode>(this, offset);
			if (nodeAtDocumentOffset != null && nodeAtDocumentOffset.IsListItemResolved)
			{
				List<ParagraphNode> list = nodeAtDocumentOffset.ListItemInfoResolved.Owner.Paragraphs;
				if (level.HasValue)
				{
					list = list.Where((ParagraphNode p) => level.Value == p.ListLevel).ToList();
				}
				return new ReadOnlyCollection<ParagraphNode>(list);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal DocumentSpan? GetRelativeIntersection(DocumentSpan span, NodeBase n, NodeSpanCache spanCache = null)
		{
			DocumentSpan span2 = spanCache?.GetCachedSpan(n) ?? GetNodeSpan(n);
			DocumentSpan? result = span.Intersection(span2);
			if (result.HasValue)
			{
				result = result.Value.OffsetBy(-span2.Offset);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal DocumentSpan GetResolvedSpanForSettingsRetrieval(DocumentSpan span, bool ignoreLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace = false)
		{
			if (span.Length == 0)
			{
				int num = span.Offset;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					ParagraphNode nodeAtDocumentOffset = NodeUtils.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset<ParagraphNode>(this, num);
					if (NodeUtils.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset<ParagraphNode>(this, num - 1) == nodeAtDocumentOffset)
					{
						num--;
					}
				}
				return new DocumentSpan(num, 1);
			}
			if (ignoreLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace)
			{
				span = IgnoreLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace(span);
			}
			return span;
		}

		internal void GrowShrinkFontSize(DocumentSpan span, bool grow, Extent? delta = null)
		{
			string arg = (grow ? "Grow" : "Shrink");
			BeginAtomicOperationSR($"Op_{arg}FontSize_Title", $"Op_{arg}FontSize_Description");
			try
			{
				Dictionary<Extent, ApplySettingsHelper> map = new Dictionary<Extent, ApplySettingsHelper>();
				Func<CharacterSettings, ApplySettingsHelper> getApplySettingsHelper = delegate(CharacterSettings settings)
				{
					Extent? fontSizeHelper = NodeUtils.GetFontSizeHelper(settings);
					if (fontSizeHelper.HasValue)
					{
						Extent nextFontSize = NodeUtils.GetNextFontSize(fontSizeHelper.Value, grow, delta);
						if (fontSizeHelper.Value != nextFontSize)
						{
							if (!map.TryGetValue(nextFontSize, out var value))
							{
								value = (map[nextFontSize] = new ApplySettingsHelper(new CharacterSettings
								{
									FontSize = nextFontSize
								}, null, cloneSourceObject: false));
							}
							return value;
						}
					}
					return (ApplySettingsHelper)null;
				};
				ModifyParagraphsAndRunsHelper(span, delegate(RunNode r)
				{
					ApplySettingsHelper applySettingsHelper = getApplySettingsHelper(r.SettingsResolved);
					if (applySettingsHelper != null)
					{
						r.ApplySettings(applySettingsHelper);
					}
				}, delegate(ParagraphNode p, DocumentSpan pSpan)
				{
					if (span.Contains(pSpan.End - 1))
					{
						ApplySettingsHelper applySettingsHelper = getApplySettingsHelper(p.ParagraphMarkSettingsResolved);
						if (applySettingsHelper != null)
						{
							p.ApplyParagraphMarkSettings(applySettingsHelper);
						}
					}
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		internal bool IsUndoLoggingActive(bool clearUndoHistoryIfInactive)
		{
			if (IsInAtomicOperation && _atomicOperation._updatingTableGridColumns)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool num = !_isUndoLoggingStopped && (_undoManager == null || !_undoManager.IsSuspended);
			if (!num && clearUndoHistoryIfInactive && !_isUndoLoggingStopped)
			{
				ClearUndoRedoHistory();
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal bool ListenForAtomicOperationEnd(IPropertyChangeListener listener)
		{
			if (IsInAtomicOperation)
			{
				_atomicOperation.ListenForOperationEnd(listener);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void MakeDownloadAPriority(ImageDownloadData loadData)
		{
			if (loadData._status != RichTextImageStatus.DownloadFailed && loadData._status != RichTextImageStatus.DownloadComplete && !_imageDownloadsInProgress.Contains(loadData))
			{
				_imageDownloadPriorityStack.Push(loadData);
			}
		}

		private void MergeListInfosHelper(IEnumerable<RichTextList> source)
		{
			EnsureBodyNode();
			RichTextListCollection lists = _rootNode.Lists;
			foreach (RichTextList item in source)
			{
				if (!lists.Contains(item.Id))
				{
					lists.Add((RichTextList)item.Clone());
				}
			}
		}

		private void MergeStylesHelper(IEnumerable<RichTextStyleBase> source)
		{
			EnsureBodyNode();
			RichTextStyleCollection styles = _rootNode.Styles;
			foreach (RichTextStyleBase item in source)
			{
				if (!styles.Contains(item.Id) || !IsStyleBeingUsedByContent(item.Id))
				{
					styles[item.Id] = (RichTextStyleBase)item.Clone();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ModifyParagraphsAndRunsHelper(DocumentSpan span, Action<RunNode> modifyRunAction, Action<ParagraphNode, DocumentSpan> modifyParagraphAction = null, bool breakPartiallySpanningRuns = true)
		{
			NodeSpanCache nodeSpanCache;
			foreach (NodeBase item in NodeUtils.GetParagraphsAndRunsIntersectingSpan(this, span, out nodeSpanCache).ToList())
			{
				if (modifyRunAction != null && item is RunNode runNode)
				{
					DocumentSpan cachedSpan = nodeSpanCache.GetCachedSpan(runNode);
					DocumentSpan documentSpan = cachedSpan.Intersection(span) ?? DocumentSpan.Empty;
					if (documentSpan.Length > 0)
					{
						RunNode runNode2 = ((breakPartiallySpanningRuns && !documentSpan.Contains(cachedSpan)) ? NodeUtils.SplitHelper(runNode, documentSpan.OffsetBy(-cachedSpan.Offset)) : runNode);
						if (runNode2 != null)
						{
							modifyRunAction(runNode2);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (modifyParagraphAction != null && item is ParagraphNode paragraphNode)
				{
					modifyParagraphAction(paragraphNode, nodeSpanCache.GetCachedSpan(paragraphNode));
				}
			}
		}

		internal TStyle MoveFromAvailableToStylesHelper<TStyle>(string styleId, out string error) where TStyle : RichTextStyleBase
		{
			error = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(styleId))
			{
				error = string.Format("Null or empty style id specified.", styleId);
			}
			RichTextStyleBase richTextStyleBase = null;
			if (error == null)
			{
				DocumentRootNode rootNode = RootNode;
				richTextStyleBase = rootNode.Styles[styleId];
				if (richTextStyleBase == null)
				{
					richTextStyleBase = AvailableStyles[styleId];
					if (richTextStyleBase is TStyle)
					{
						rootNode.Styles.Add(richTextStyleBase = (RichTextStyleBase)richTextStyleBase.Clone());
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(richTextStyleBase.BasedOn))
						{
							MoveFromAvailableToStylesHelper<TStyle>(richTextStyleBase.BasedOn, out error);
							if (error != null)
							{
								error = $"A style in the BasedOn chain of {styleId} style is not found.";
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (richTextStyleBase == null)
				{
					error = $"Style with the id of {styleId} does not exist.";
				}
				else
				{
					if (richTextStyleBase is TStyle)
					{
						return (TStyle)richTextStyleBase;
					}
					error = $"Style with the id of {styleId} is not a {typeof(TStyle).Name}.";
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void OnDocumentVersionCompatibilityChanged()
		{
			_compatibilityVersionCounter++;
			ClearUndoRedoHistory();
			ClearImageDownloadQueues(cancelDownloadsInProgress: true);
		}

		internal void OnLayoutManagerDisposed(LayoutManagerBase lm)
		{
			if (_layoutManagers != null)
			{
				_layoutManagers.Remove(lm);
				_layoutManagers.Compact();
			}
		}

		internal void OnLayoutManagerInstantiated(LayoutManagerBase lm)
		{
			if (_layoutManagers == null)
			{
				_layoutManagers = new WeakList<LayoutManagerBase>();
			}
			_layoutManagers.Add(lm);
			_layoutManagers.Compact();
		}

		internal void ProcessDocumentChange(RichTextDocumentChange change)
		{
			if (_lastChange != null)
			{
				_lastChange.InitializeNextChange(change);
			}
			_lastChange = change;
			OnDocumentChanged();
			if (_lastCreatedVersionObject != null && _lastCreatedVersionObject.FutureChanges == null)
			{
				_lastCreatedVersionObject.Initialize(change);
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessDocumentOffsetChange(DocumentOffsetChange change)
		{
			if (_lastOffsetChange != null)
			{
				_lastOffsetChange.InitializeNextChange(change);
			}
			_lastOffsetChange = change;
			OnDocumentChanged();
			if (_lastCreatedVersionObject != null && _lastCreatedVersionObject.FutureOffsetChanges == null)
			{
				_lastCreatedVersionObject.InitializeOffsetChange(change);
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessDocumentOffsetChange_SpanInserted(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			ProcessDocumentOffsetChange_SpanInserted(span.Start, span.Length);
		}

		internal void ProcessDocumentOffsetChange_SpanInserted(int documentOffset, int insertLength)
		{
			ProcessDocumentOffsetChange(DocumentOffsetChange.CreateHelper(this, documentOffset, 0, insertLength));
		}

		internal void ProcessPropertyChange(PropertyChangeChainContextBase context)
		{
			if (context.Leaf.CompletionCallback == null)
			{
				context.Leaf.CompletionCallback = OnChangeCompleted;
			}
			lock (_syncRoot)
			{
				_pendingChanges.Add(context);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveDownloadData(ImageDownloadData loadData)
		{
			if (_imageDownloadAffectedNodeMap.ContainsKey(loadData))
			{
				_imageDownloadAffectedNodeMap.Remove(loadData);
			}
			if (_imageDownloadCache.ContainsKey(loadData._uriString))
			{
				_imageDownloadCache.Remove(loadData._uriString);
			}
		}

		internal ImageDownloadData QueueImageDownload(ImageNode node, bool isPriorityDownload)
		{
			string imageUri = node.ImageUri;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(imageUri))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_imageDownloadCache == null)
			{
				_imageDownloadCache = new WeakDictionary<string, ImageDownloadData>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: false, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: true);
				_imageDownloadAffectedNodeMap = new WeakDictionary<ImageDownloadData, List<ImageNode>>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: true, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: false);
				_imageDownloadQueue = new Queue<ImageDownloadData>();
				_imageDownloadPriorityStack = new Stack<ImageDownloadData>();
				_imageDownloadsInProgress = new HashSet<ImageDownloadData>();
			}
			_imageDownloadCache.TryGetValue(imageUri, out var value);
			if (value != null)
			{
				_imageDownloadAffectedNodeMap[value].Add(node);
				if (isPriorityDownload)
				{
					MakeDownloadAPriority(value);
				}
				return value;
			}
			value = new ImageDownloadData(imageUri);
			_imageDownloadCache.Add(imageUri, value);
			if (isPriorityDownload)
			{
				_imageDownloadPriorityStack.Push(value);
			}
			else
			{
				_imageDownloadQueue.Enqueue(value);
			}
			List<ImageNode> list = new List<ImageNode>();
			list.Add(node);
			_imageDownloadAffectedNodeMap.Add(value, list);
			ProcessImageDownloadQueues();
			return value;
		}

		internal void RegisterDocumentAdapter(RichTextDocumentAdapterBase documentAdapter)
		{
			_documentAdapters.Compact();
			_documentAdapters.Add(documentAdapter);
		}

		public void ReplaceContents(DocumentSpan span, string newText, out string error, bool breakParagraphBeforeContent = false, bool breakParagraphAfterContent = false)
		{
			if (newText == null)

				newText = string.Empty;
			}
			InsertContentOptions value = new InsertContentOptions
			{
				_breakParagraphBeforeContent = breakParagraphBeforeContent,
				_breakParagraphAfterContent = breakParagraphAfterContent
			};
			ReplaceContentsHelper(span, null, newText, out error, value, emulateTyping: true);
		}

		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(contentNode, "contentNode");
			InsertContentOptions value = new InsertContentOptions
			{
				_breakParagraphBeforeContent = breakParagraphBeforeContent,
				_breakParagraphAfterContent = breakParagraphAfterContent
			};
			ReplaceContentsHelper(span, contentNode, null, out error, value);
		}

		internal void ResumeImageDownloads()
		{
			if (_imageDownloadSuspendCount > 0)
			{
				_imageDownloadSuspendCount--;
				if (_imageDownloadSuspendCount == 0)
				{
					ProcessImageDownloadQueues();
				}
			}
		}

		internal UndoTransaction StartUndoHelper(string description, string detailedDescription)
		{
			if (!IsUndoLoggingActive(clearUndoHistoryIfInactive: true))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return UndoManager.StartTransaction(description, detailedDescription);
		}

		internal void SuspendImageDownloads()
		{
			_imageDownloadSuspendCount++;
		}

		internal void UnregisterDocumentAdapter(RichTextDocumentAdapterBase documentAdapter)
