			_documentAdapters.Compact();
			_documentAdapters.Remove(documentAdapter);
		}

		internal bool ValidateDocumentOffset(int documentOffset, out string error)
		{
			if (documentOffset < 0 || documentOffset > AggregateOffsetCount)
			{
				error = $"Invalid document offset of {documentOffset}.";
				return false;
			}
			error = null;
			return true;
		}

		internal void VerifyLayoutMetrics()
		{
			LayoutManagerBase layoutManagerBase = null;
			if (_layoutManagers != null)
			{
				_layoutManagers.Compact();
				int count = _layoutManagers.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (_layoutManagers[i].Status == LayoutManagerProcessStatus.Complete)
					{
						layoutManagerBase = _layoutManagers[i];
						break;
					}
				}
				if (layoutManagerBase == null && count > 0)
				{
					layoutManagerBase = _layoutManagers[0];
				}
			}
			if (layoutManagerBase == null)
			{
				layoutManagerBase = new WebLayoutManager(new MetricsProvider(), this, new Extent(12240.0).LogicalPixels);
				layoutManagerBase.ValidateStructure();
			}
			layoutManagerBase.EnsureStatusIsComplete();
		}

		private void AddOffsetChangesHelper_Delete(int startingDocumentLength, List<DocumentSpan> deletedSpans)
		{
			deletedSpans = Utilities.MergeSpans(deletedSpans);
			int num = startingDocumentLength;
			foreach (DocumentSpan deletedSpan in deletedSpans)
			{
				ProcessDocumentOffsetChange(new DocumentOffsetChange(num, deletedSpan, new DocumentSpan(deletedSpan.Start, 0)));
				num -= deletedSpan.Length;
			}
		}

		private void ApplyOrClearCharacterStyleHelper(bool apply, DocumentSpan span, string styleId, out string error, bool clearExistingCharacterSettings)
		{
			string arg = (apply ? "Apply" : "Clear");
			BeginAtomicOperationSR($"Op_{arg}CharacterStyle_Title", $"Op_{arg}CharacterStyle_Description");
			try
			{
				error = null;
				if (apply)
				{
					MoveFromAvailableToStylesHelper<CharacterStyle>(styleId, out error);
				}
				if (error != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				ModifyParagraphsAndRunsHelper(span, delegate(RunNode r)
				{
					r.StyleId = (apply ? styleId : null);
					if (clearExistingCharacterSettings)
					{
						r.Settings = null;
					}
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		private void ApplyOrClearParagraphStyleHelper(bool apply, DocumentSpan span, string styleId, out string error)
		{
			string arg = (apply ? "Apply" : "Clear");
			BeginAtomicOperationSR($"Op_{arg}ParagraphStyle_Title", $"Op_{arg}ParagraphStyle_Description");
			try
			{
				error = null;
				if (apply)
				{
					MoveFromAvailableToStylesHelper<ParagraphStyle>(styleId, out error);
				}
				if (error == null)
				{
					ModifyParagraphsAndRunsHelper(span, null, delegate(ParagraphNode p, DocumentSpan intersection)
					{
						p.StyleId = styleId;
					});
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		private void ApplyOrClearParagraphListStyle(bool apply, DocumentSpan span, string listStyleId, out string error)
		{
			error = null;
			string arg = (apply ? "Apply" : "Clear");
			BeginAtomicOperationSR($"Op_{arg}ListStyle_Title", $"Op_{arg}ListStyle_Description");
			try
			{
				DocumentRootNode rootNode = RootNode;
				if (apply)
				{
					AddParagraphIfDocumentEmpty();
					MoveFromAvailableToStylesHelper<ListStyle>(listStyleId, out error);
					if (error != null)
					{
						return;
					}
					MoveFromAvailableToStylesHelper<ParagraphStyle>("ListParagraph", out error);
					if (error != null)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				ParagraphNode[] array = GetParagraphs(span).ToArray();
				if (array.Length == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				RichTextList listToUse = null;
				if (apply && (span.Length == 0 || (1 == array.Length && span == NodeUtils.GetNodePrefixDocumentSpan(array[0]))) && 1 == array.Length)
				{
					RichTextListItemInfo listItemInfoResolved = array[0].ListItemInfoResolved;
					if (listItemInfoResolved != null)
					{
						listToUse = listItemInfoResolved.Owner;
					}
				}
				if (listToUse == null)
				{
					IEnumerable<string> source = array.Select((ParagraphNode p) => p.ListId).Distinct();
					if (1 == source.Count())
					{
						string text = source.First();
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
						{
							RichTextList richTextList = _rootNode.Lists[text];
							if (richTextList != null && Utilities.HasSameItems(array, richTextList.Paragraphs, orderIsSignificant: false))
							{
								listToUse = richTextList;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (listToUse != null)
				{
					if (apply)
					{
						listToUse.ListStyleId = listStyleId;
						listToUse.Template = null;
						listToUse.LevelOverrides = null;
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
				else if (apply)
				{
					listToUse = new RichTextList
					{
						Id = rootNode.Lists.CreateNewId(),
						ListStyleId = listStyleId
					};
					rootNode.Lists.Add(listToUse);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return;
				}
				Utilities.PerformOnAll(array, delegate(ParagraphNode p)
				{
					int aggregateOffsetCount = AggregateOffsetCount;
					int documentOffset = p.GetDocumentOffset();
					int prefixOffsetCount = p.PrefixOffsetCount;
					if (apply)
					{
						p.ListId = listToUse.Id;
						p.StyleId = "ListParagraph";
					}
					else
					{
						p.ListId = null;
						if ("ListParagraph" == p.StyleId)
						{
							p.StyleId = null;
						}
					}
					int prefixOffsetCount2 = p.PrefixOffsetCount;
					if (prefixOffsetCount != prefixOffsetCount2)
					{
						ProcessDocumentOffsetChange(new DocumentOffsetChange(aggregateOffsetCount, new DocumentSpan(documentOffset, prefixOffsetCount), new DocumentSpan(documentOffset, prefixOffsetCount2)));
					}
				});
				if (flag2 && !CoreUtilities.HasItems(listToUse.Paragraphs))
				{
					rootNode.Lists.Remove(listToUse);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		private static RichTextStyleCollection CreateAvailableStyles()
		{
			RichTextStyleCollection richTextStyleCollection = new RichTextStyleCollection();
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(DefaultNormalStyle.Clone() as RichTextStyleBase);
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(DefaultListStyle.Clone() as RichTextStyleBase);
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(DefaultTableNormalStyle.Clone() as RichTextStyleBase);
			ListLevelDefinition[] repeatLevels = Utilities.CreateBulletRepetitions();
			int num = 2;
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(Utilities.CreateListStyle("BulletCircle", "Circle", num++, new ListLevelDefinition[1] { Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForBullet('o', "Courier New") }, repeatLevels));
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(Utilities.CreateListStyle("BulletArrow", "Arrow", num++, new ListLevelDefinition[1] { Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForBullet('Ø', "Wingdings") }, repeatLevels));
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(Utilities.CreateListStyle("Bullet_Check", "Check", num++, new ListLevelDefinition[1] { Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForBullet('ü', "Wingdings") }, repeatLevels));
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(Utilities.CreateListStyle("BulletSquare", "Square", num++, new ListLevelDefinition[1] { Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForBullet('§', "Wingdings") }, repeatLevels));
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(Utilities.CreateListStyle("BulletDiamond", "Diamond", num++, new ListLevelDefinition[1] { Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForBullet('v', "Wingdings") }, repeatLevels));
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(Utilities.CreateListStyle("BulletDiamondArrow", "Diamond Arrow", num++, new ListLevelDefinition[1] { Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForBullet('v', "Wingdings") }, new ListLevelDefinition[4]
			{
				Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForBullet('Ø', "Wingdings"),
				Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForBullet('§', "Wingdings"),
				Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForBullet('·', "Symbol"),
				Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForBullet('\u00a8', "Symbol")
			}, concatenateLevelText: false, indentFirstLevel: false));
			ListLevelDefinition[] repeatLevels2 = Utilities.CreateNumberRepetitions();
			num = 2;
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(Utilities.CreateListStyle("Decimal", "Decimal", num++, new ListLevelDefinition[1] { Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForNumber(NumberFormat.Decimal, "%{0}.", NumberAlignment.Start) }, repeatLevels2));
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(Utilities.CreateListStyle("DecimalConcatenated", "Decimal Concatenated", num++, null, new ListLevelDefinition[1] { Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForNumber(NumberFormat.Decimal, "%{0}.", NumberAlignment.Start) }, concatenateLevelText: true, indentFirstLevel: false));
			richTextStyleCollection.Add(Utilities.CreateListStyle("DecimalParenthesis", "Decimal Parenthesis", num++, new ListLevelDefinition[1] { Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForNumber(NumberFormat.Decimal, "%{0})", NumberAlignment.Start) }, repeatLevels2));

		private static void CreateHeadingStyle(int headingLevel, RichTextStyleCollection styles, ParagraphSettings psettings, Extent? fontSize, ColorInfo color, bool? bold = null, bool? italic = null)
		{
			ParagraphStyle paragraphStyle = new ParagraphStyle();
			paragraphStyle.Id = "Heading" + headingLevel;
			paragraphStyle.Name = "Heading " + headingLevel;
			paragraphStyle.BasedOn = "Normal";
			paragraphStyle.NextParagraphStyleId = "Normal";
			paragraphStyle.SortPriority = 9;
			paragraphStyle.IsPrimary = true;
			paragraphStyle.ParagraphSettings = psettings;
			if (headingLevel == 1)
			{
				paragraphStyle.DisplayMode = StyleDisplayMode.Show;
			}
			else
			{
				paragraphStyle.DisplayMode = StyleDisplayMode.HideFromMainUI;
				paragraphStyle.UnhideWhenUsed = true;
			}
			CharacterStyle characterStyle = new CharacterStyle();
			characterStyle.Id = paragraphStyle.Id + "Char";
			characterStyle.Name = paragraphStyle.Name + " Char";
			characterStyle.BasedOn = "DefaultParagraphFont";
			characterStyle.SortPriority = 9;
			characterStyle.DisplayMode = StyleDisplayMode.HideFromMainUI;
			characterStyle.LinkedStyle = paragraphStyle.Id;
			paragraphStyle.LinkedStyle = characterStyle.Id;
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = new CharacterSettings();
			characterSettings.Color = color;
			characterSettings.Bold = bold;
			characterSettings.ComplexScriptBold = bold;
			characterSettings.Italics = italic;
			characterSettings.ComplexScriptItalics = italic;
			characterSettings.FontSize = fontSize;
			characterSettings.ComplexScriptFontSize = fontSize;
			characterStyle.CharacterSettings = characterSettings;
			paragraphStyle.CharacterSettings = characterSettings.Clone() as CharacterSettings;
			styles.Add(characterStyle);
			styles.Add(paragraphStyle);
		}

		private RichTextDocumentVersion CreateCurrentVersion()
		{
			_versionCounter++;
			return new RichTextDocumentVersion(this);
		}

		private static RichTextBorder CreateDefaultCellBorder()
		{
			return new RichTextBorder
			{
				Size = new Extent(0.5, ExtentUnitType.Points),
				BorderType = RichTextBorderType.Single,
				Spacing = new Extent(0.0),
				Color = ColorInfo.Automatic
			};
		}

		private static ListStyle CreateDefaultListStyle()
		{
			ListLevelDefinition[] repeatLevels = Utilities.CreateBulletRepetitions();
			ListStyle listStyle = Utilities.CreateListStyle("Bullet", "Bullet", 1, new ListLevelDefinition[1] { Utilities.CreateListLevelDefinitionForBullet('·', "Symbol") }, repeatLevels);
			listStyle.SortPriority = 1;
			listStyle.Seal();
			return listStyle;
		}

		private static ParagraphStyle CreateDefaultNormalStyle()

			paragraphStyle.Name = "Normal";
			paragraphStyle.IsPrimary = true;
			paragraphStyle.IsDefault = true;
			paragraphStyle.Seal();
			return paragraphStyle;
		}

		private static TableStyle CreateDefaultTableNormalStyle()
		{
			TableStyle tableStyle = new TableStyle();
			tableStyle.Id = "TableNormal";
			tableStyle.Name = "Normal Table";
			tableStyle.IsDefault = true;
			tableStyle.SortPriority = 99;
			tableStyle.UnhideWhenUsed = true;
			tableStyle.DisplayMode = StyleDisplayMode.HideFromMainUI;
			TableAreaTableSettings tableSettings = new TableAreaTableSettings
			{
				TableIndent = default(Extent),
				CellMargins = new TableCellMargins
				{
					Top = new Extent(0.0),
					Bottom = new Extent(0.0),
					Start = new Extent(108.0),
					End = new Extent(108.0)
				}
			};
			tableStyle.AreaSpecificSettings = new AreaSpecificSettings();
			tableStyle.AreaSpecificSettings.SetAreaSettings(TableArea.WholeTable, new TableAreaSettings
			{
				TableSettings = tableSettings
			});
			tableStyle.Seal();
			return tableStyle;
		}

		private void DeleteHelper(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			if (span.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int aggregateOffsetCount = AggregateOffsetCount;
			List<DocumentSpan> list = new List<DocumentSpan>();
			NodeSpanCache nodeSpanCache;
			List<NodeBase> list2 = NodeUtils.GetNodesIntersectingSpan(this, span, skipDescendantsOfFullyContainedNodes: true, out nodeSpanCache).ToList();
			ParagraphNode mergeParagraph = null;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = list2.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				NodeBase nodeBase = list2[i];
				DocumentSpan nodeSpan = nodeSpanCache.GetCachedSpan(nodeBase);
				if (span.Contains(nodeSpan))
				{
					if (NodeUtils.IsRootOrBodyNode(nodeBase))
					{
						DocumentBodyNode documentBodyNode = ((_rootNode != null) ? _rootNode.Body : null);
						if (documentBodyNode != null && documentBodyNode.ChildNodes != null)
						{
							documentBodyNode.ChildNodes.Clear();
							documentBodyNode.ChildNodes.Add(new ParagraphNode());
							list.Clear();
							list.Add(new DocumentSpan(0, aggregateOffsetCount - AggregateOffsetCount));
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (nodeBase is TableCellNode)
					{
						NodeUtils.ClearCellContent((TableCellNode)nodeBase);
						if (nodeBase.AggregateOffsetCount < nodeSpan.Length)
						{
							DocumentSpan item = new DocumentSpan(nodeSpan.Start, nodeSpan.Length - nodeBase.AggregateOffsetCount);
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
					else if (nodeBase is ParagraphNode)
					{
						bool flag = true;
						if (nodeBase.Parent is TableCellNode { ChildNodes: var childNodes })
						{
							int count2 = childNodes.Count;
							flag = count2 > 1;
							if (flag)
							{
								int num = childNodes.IndexOf(nodeBase);
								if (num == count2 - 1 && childNodes[num - 1] is TableNode)
								{
									flag = false;
								}
							}
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							NodeUtils.RemoveNodeHelper(nodeBase);
							list.Add(nodeSpan);
						}
						else
						{
							DocumentSpan intersection = nodeBase.GetChildNodesDocumentSpan().Intersection(span) ?? DocumentSpan.Empty;
							DeleteParagraphContentsOnlyHelper(list, ref mergeParagraph, ref nodeSpan, ref intersection, nodeBase as ParagraphNode);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						NodeUtils.RemoveNodeHelper(nodeBase);
						list.Add(nodeSpan);
					}
					continue;
				}
				DocumentSpan intersection2 = nodeSpan.Intersection(span) ?? DocumentSpan.Empty;
				if (nodeBase is TextNode textNode)
				{
					_ = textNode.Text;
					if (intersection2.Length > 0)
					{
						int start = intersection2.Offset - nodeSpan.Offset;
						if (textNode.DeleteText(start, intersection2.Length))
						{
							list.Add(intersection2);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (nodeBase is ParagraphNode paragraph)
				{
					DeleteParagraphContentsOnlyHelper(list, ref mergeParagraph, ref nodeSpan, ref intersection2, paragraph);
				}
			}
			if (mergeParagraph != null)
			{
				MergeSiblingParagraph(mergeParagraph);
			}
			AddOffsetChangesHelper_Delete(aggregateOffsetCount, list);
		}

		private static void DeleteParagraphContentsOnlyHelper(List<DocumentSpan> deletedSpans, ref ParagraphNode mergeParagraph, ref DocumentSpan nodeSpan, ref DocumentSpan intersection, ParagraphNode paragraph)
		{
			if (intersection.Contains(nodeSpan.End - 1))
			{
				mergeParagraph = paragraph;
				deletedSpans.Add(new DocumentSpan(nodeSpan.End - 1, 1));
			}
			else if (paragraph.IsListItemResolved && 1 == paragraph.PrefixOffsetCount && intersection.Contains(nodeSpan.Start))
			{
				paragraph.ListId = null;
				if ("ListParagraph" == paragraph.StyleId)
				{
					paragraph.StyleId = null;
					paragraph.ListLevel = -1;
				}
				deletedSpans.Add(new DocumentSpan(nodeSpan.Start, 1));
			}
		}

		private DocumentBodyNode EnsureBodyNode()
		{
			if (_rootNode == null)
			{
				RootNode = new DocumentRootNode();
			}
			DocumentBodyNode body = _rootNode.Body;
			if (body == null)
			{
				if (_rootNode.ChildNodes == null)
				{
					_rootNode.ChildNodes = new NodeCollection();
				}
				_rootNode.ChildNodes.Add(new DocumentBodyNode());
				body = _rootNode.Body;
			}
			return body;
		}

		internal void EnsureTrailingParagraph()
		{
			DocumentBodyNode documentBodyNode = EnsureBodyNode();
			if (documentBodyNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ParagraphNode paragraphNode = documentBodyNode.LastChild as ParagraphNode;
			if (paragraphNode == null && !IsInAtomicOperation)
			{
				UndoManager undoManager = UndoManager;
				if (!undoManager.IsPerformingRedo && !undoManager.IsPerformingRollback && !undoManager.IsPerformingUndo)
				{
					documentBodyNode.ChildNodes.Add(new ParagraphNode());
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<T> GetAvailableStyles<T>(bool includeHiddenStyles, Func<T, bool, bool> filter = null) where T : RichTextStyleBase
		{
			List<AvailableStyleKey<T>> list = new List<AvailableStyleKey<T>>();
			Dictionary<string, T> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, T>();
			if (_rootNode != null)
			{
				foreach (RichTextStyleBase style in _rootNode.Styles)
				{
					if (style is T val)
					{
						dictionary.Add(val.Id, val);
						if (includeHiddenStyles || val.DisplayMode != StyleDisplayMode.Hide)
						{
							list.Add(new AvailableStyleKey<T>(val, isUsed: true));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (RichTextStyleBase availableStyle in _availableStyles)
			{
				if (availableStyle is T val2 && !dictionary.ContainsKey(val2.Id) && (includeHiddenStyles || val2.DisplayMode != StyleDisplayMode.Hide))
				{
					list.Add(new AvailableStyleKey<T>(val2, isUsed: true));
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 1)
			{
				list.Sort();
			}
			foreach (AvailableStyleKey<T> item in list)
			{
				if ((includeHiddenStyles || item._style.DisplayMode == StyleDisplayMode.Show || (item._isUsed && item._style.UnhideWhenUsed)) && (filter == null || filter(item._style, item._isUsed)))
				{
					yield return item._style;
				}
			}
		}

		private char GetCharAtOffset(int offset)
		{
			string textInSpan = GetTextInSpan(new DocumentSpan(offset, 1), NodeUtils.DEFAULT_FORMAT);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(textInSpan))
			{
				return '\0';
			}
			return textInSpan[0];
		}

		private DocumentSpan IgnoreLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			int i = span.Start;
			int num = span.Start + span.Length - 1;
			while (i < num && IsWhitespace(num))
			{
				num--;
			}
			for (; i < num && IsWhitespace(i); i++)
			{
			}
			return new DocumentSpan(i, 1 + num - i);
		}

		private bool IsWhitespace(int offset)
		{
			char charAtOffset = GetCharAtOffset(offset);
			if (charAtOffset != 0)
			{
				return char.IsWhiteSpace(charAtOffset);
			}
			return true;
		}

						}
					}
				}

		private bool IndentOutdentParagraphHelper(ParagraphNode p, bool indent, Extent? amount = null, bool? firstLineOnly = null, DocumentSpan? selection = null)
		{

				if (nextListLevelForIndentation != p.ListLevel)
				{
					p.ListLevel = nextListLevelForIndentation;
					return true;
				}
				return false;

		}

		private void MergeParagraphs(ParagraphNode dest, ParagraphNode p, bool insertAtBeginning)
		{
			List<NodeBase> items = p.ChildNodes.ToList();
			p.ChildNodes.Clear();
			dest.ChildNodes.InsertRange(items, insertAtBeginning);
			NodeUtils.RemoveNodeHelper(p);
		}

		private void MergeSiblingParagraph(ParagraphNode paragraph, bool retainSettingsOfSecondParagraph = false)
		{
			if (paragraph.GetNextSibling() is ParagraphNode paragraphNode)
			{
				if (retainSettingsOfSecondParagraph)
				{
					MergeParagraphs(paragraphNode, paragraph, insertAtBeginning: true);
				}
				else
				{
					MergeParagraphs(paragraph, paragraphNode, insertAtBeginning: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnChangeCompleted(PropertyChangeChainContextBase context)
		{
			PropertyChangeChainContextBase[] array;
			lock (_syncRoot)
			{
				array = _pendingChanges.ToArray();
				_pendingChanges.Clear();
			}
			int num = array.Length;
			if (num < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			UndoManager undoManager = UndoManager;
			if (IsUndoLoggingActive(clearUndoHistoryIfInactive: true))
			{
				UndoTransaction undoTransaction = null;
				if (num > 1)
				{
					undoTransaction = undoManager.StartTransaction(null, null);
				}
				try
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
					{
						undoManager.AddChange(array[i].CreateUndoUnit(this));
					}
					undoTransaction?.Commit();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					undoTransaction?.Rollback();
					throw ex;
				}
			}
			ProcessDocumentChange(new RichTextDocumentChange(RichTextDocumentChange.RichTextDocumentChangeType.Settings));
		}

		private void OnDocumentChanged(DocumentChangeType changeType = DocumentChangeType.Content)
		{
			if (!IsInAtomicOperation)
			{
				_ = _currentVersion;
				if (_currentVersion != null)
				{
					_currentVersion = null;
					RaisePropertyChanged("CurrentVersion");
				}
				RaiseContentChangedEvent(new DocumentContentChangedEventArgs(changeType));
			}
			else
			{
				_atomicOperation._documentChanged = true;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessImageDownloadQueues()
		{
			if (_imageDownloadsInProgress == null || _imageDownloadSuspendCount > 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (_imageDownloadsInProgress.Count < 8)
			{
				ImageDownloadData imageDownloadData = null;
				if (_imageDownloadPriorityStack.Count > 0)
				{
					imageDownloadData = _imageDownloadPriorityStack.Pop();
				}
				else
				{
					if (_imageDownloadQueue.Count <= 0 || _imageDownloadsInProgress.Count >= 4)
					{
						break;
					}
					imageDownloadData = _imageDownloadQueue.Dequeue();
				}
				if (imageDownloadData != null)
				{
					ProcessImageDownloadHelper(imageDownloadData);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessImageDownloadHelper(ImageDownloadData loadData)
		{
			if (loadData._status == RichTextImageStatus.DownloadFailed || loadData._status == RichTextImageStatus.DownloadComplete || !_imageDownloadCache.ContainsKey(loadData._uriString) || GetAffectedNodes(loadData).Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_imageDownloadCache.Compact(removeEntriesWithNullValues: true);
			_imageDownloadAffectedNodeMap.Compact(removeEntriesWithNullValues: true);
			if (!_imageDownloadsInProgress.Contains(loadData))
			{
				_imageDownloadsInProgress.Add(loadData);
			}
			loadData._status = RichTextImageStatus.Downloading;
			FileDownloader downloader = new FileDownloader(loadData._uriString, _imageDownloadCancellationTokenSource);
			downloader.DownloadDataAsync(delegate
			{
				if (_imageDownloadsInProgress.Contains(loadData))
				{
					_imageDownloadsInProgress.Remove(loadData);
					loadData._error = downloader.Error;
					switch (downloader.Status)
					{
					case FileDownloadStatus.Canceled:
						loadData._status = RichTextImageStatus.DownloadCanceled;
						break;
					case FileDownloadStatus.Complete:
						loadData._status = RichTextImageStatus.DownloadComplete;
						break;
					case FileDownloadStatus.Downloading:
						loadData._status = RichTextImageStatus.Downloading;
						break;
					case FileDownloadStatus.Failed:
						loadData._status = RichTextImageStatus.DownloadFailed;
						break;
					case FileDownloadStatus.NotStarted:
						loadData._status = RichTextImageStatus.DownloadNotStarted;
						break;
					case FileDownloadStatus.TimedOut:
						loadData._status = RichTextImageStatus.DownloadTimedOut;
						break;
					}
					if (loadData._status == RichTextImageStatus.DownloadComplete)
					{
						string error;
						RichTextImageFormat? richTextImageFormat = RichTextImage.DeduceFormat(loadData._uriString, downloader.DownloadedData, out error);
						if (richTextImageFormat.HasValue)
						{
							loadData._buffer = downloader.DownloadedData;
							loadData._downlaodedImage = new RichTextImage(loadData._buffer, richTextImageFormat.Value);
						}
						else
						{
							loadData._status = RichTextImageStatus.UnknownImageFormat;
							loadData._error = new NotSupportedException(error);
						}
					}
					ImageNode[] affectedNodes = GetAffectedNodes(loadData);
					if (affectedNodes != null)
					{
						int num = affectedNodes.Length;
						for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
						{
							affectedNodes[i].OnImageDownloadCompleted();
						}
					}
					ProcessImageDownloadQueues();
				}
			}, 60000);
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propname)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propname));
			}
		}

		private InsertTextOptions ReplaceContentsHelper_GetInsertRunSettings(DocumentSpan span, bool emulateTyping = false)
		{
			InsertTextOptions result = null;
			if (emulateTyping)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				HyperlinkNode nodeAtDocumentOffset = NodeUtils.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset<HyperlinkNode>(this, span.Start);
				if (nodeAtDocumentOffset != null)
				{
					HyperlinkNode nodeAtDocumentOffset2 = NodeUtils.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset<HyperlinkNode>(this, span.End);
					if (nodeAtDocumentOffset != nodeAtDocumentOffset2)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return new InsertTextOptions
					{
						_mergeWithExistingSettings = false
					};
				}
			}
			span = IgnoreLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace(span);
			RunNode nodeAtDocumentOffset3 = NodeUtils.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset<RunNode>(this, span.Start);
			if (nodeAtDocumentOffset3 != null)
			{
				result = new InsertTextOptions
				{
					_styleId = nodeAtDocumentOffset3.StyleId,
					_settings = nodeAtDocumentOffset3.Settings,
					_mergeWithExistingSettings = false
				};
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void ReplaceContentsHelper(DocumentSpan span, NodeBase newContentNode, string newText, out string error, InsertContentOptions? newContentNodeInsertOptions = null, bool emulateTyping = false)
		{
			bool flag = span.Length > 0;
			if (flag)
			{
				BeginAtomicOperationSR("Op_ReplaceContent_Title", "Op_ReplaceContent_Description", Utilities.TruncateString(GetTextInSpan(span, new PlainTextFormatOptions
				{
					NewLineText = " "
				}), 20), Utilities.TruncateString(newText ?? string.Empty, 20));
			}
			try
			{
				InsertTextOptions insertTextOptions = null;
				if (flag)
				{
					insertTextOptions = ReplaceContentsHelper_GetInsertRunSettings(span, emulateTyping);
					DeleteHelper(span);
				}
				if (newContentNode != null)
				{
					InsertContent(span.Start, newContentNode, out error, newContentNodeInsertOptions);
				}
				else
				{
					InsertText(span.Start, newText, out error, insertTextOptions);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					EndAtomicOperation();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class ColorUtilities
	{
		private const int HLSMAX = 240;

		private const int RGBMAX = 255;

		private const int UNDEFINED = 160;

		private static readonly Dictionary<ColorInfo, HighlightColor> _highlightColorMap = CreateHighlightColorMap();

		private static Dictionary<ColorInfo, HighlightColor> CreateHighlightColorMap()
		{
			Dictionary<ColorInfo, HighlightColor> dictionary = new Dictionary<ColorInfo, HighlightColor>();
			foreach (HighlightColor enumValue in SerializationUtilities.GetEnumValues<HighlightColor>())
			{
				if (enumValue != HighlightColor.None)
				{
					System.Windows.Media.Color? color = ResolveHighlightColor(enumValue);
					if (color.HasValue)
					{
						System.Windows.Media.Color? color2 = color;
						dictionary.Add(color2.HasValue ? ((ColorInfo)color2.GetValueOrDefault()) : null, enumValue);
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color ApplyTint(System.Windows.Media.Color baseColor, double tint)
		{
			if (tint == 0.0)
			{
				return baseColor;
			}
			ConvertRGBToHLS(baseColor, out var h, out var l, out var s);
			int l2 = l;
			if (tint < 0.0)
			{
				l2 = (int)Truncate((double)l * (1.0 + tint));
			}
			else if (tint > 0.0)
			{
				l2 = (int)Truncate((double)l * (1.0 - tint)) + (240 - (int)Truncate(240.0 * (1.0 - tint)));
			}
			return ConvertHLSToRGB(h, l2, s);
		}

		public static bool AreClose(System.Windows.Media.Color color1, System.Windows.Media.Color color2)
		{
			if (color1.A != color2.A)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (2 < Math.Abs(color1.R - color2.R))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (2 < Math.Abs(color1.G - color2.G))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (2 < Math.Abs(color1.B - color2.B))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static double CalculateYiqYValue(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			double num = (double)(int)color.R / 255.0;
			double num2 = (double)(int)color.G / 255.0;
			double num3 = (double)(int)color.B / 255.0;
			return num * 0.299 + num2 * 0.587 + num3 * 0.114;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color ColorFromSystemColorType(SystemColorType systemColorType)
		{
			return systemColorType switch
			{
				SystemColorType.ActiveBorder => System.Windows.SystemColors.ActiveBorderColor, 
				SystemColorType.ActiveCaption => System.Windows.SystemColors.ActiveCaptionColor,

				SystemColorType.Control => System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlColor, 
				SystemColorType.ControlDark => System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlDarkColor, 
				SystemColorType.ControlDarkDark => System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlDarkDarkColor, 
				SystemColorType.ControlLight => System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlLightColor, 
				SystemColorType.ControlLightLight => System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlLightLightColor, 
				SystemColorType.ControlText => System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlTextColor, 
				SystemColorType.Desktop => System.Windows.SystemColors.DesktopColor, 
				SystemColorType.GrayText => System.Windows.SystemColors.GrayTextColor, 
				SystemColorType.Highlight => System.Windows.SystemColors.HighlightColor, 
				SystemColorType.HighlightText => System.Windows.SystemColors.HighlightTextColor, 
				SystemColorType.InactiveBorder => System.Windows.SystemColors.InactiveBorderColor, 
				SystemColorType.InactiveCaption => System.Windows.SystemColors.InactiveCaptionColor, 
				SystemColorType.InactiveCaptionText => System.Windows.SystemColors.InactiveCaptionTextColor, 
				SystemColorType.Info => System.Windows.SystemColors.InfoColor, 
				SystemColorType.InfoText => System.Windows.SystemColors.InfoTextColor, 
				SystemColorType.Menu => System.Windows.SystemColors.MenuColor, 
				SystemColorType.MenuText => System.Windows.SystemColors.MenuTextColor, 
				SystemColorType.ScrollBar => System.Windows.SystemColors.ScrollBarColor, 
				SystemColorType.Window => System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowColor, 
				SystemColorType.WindowFrame => System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowFrameColor, 
				SystemColorType.WindowText => System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowTextColor, 
				SystemColorType.GradientActiveCaption => System.Windows.SystemColors.GradientActiveCaptionColor, 
				SystemColorType.GradientInactiveCaption => System.Windows.SystemColors.GradientInactiveCaptionColor, 
				SystemColorType.HotTrack => System.Windows.SystemColors.HotTrackColor, 
				SystemColorType.MenuBar => System.Windows.SystemColors.MenuBarColor, 
				SystemColorType.MenuHighlight => System.Windows.SystemColors.MenuHighlightColor, 
				_ => System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowTextColor, 
			};
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Color ConvertHLSToRGB(int h, int l, int s)
		{
			int num;
			int num2;
			int num3;
			if (s == 0)
			{
				num = (num2 = (num3 = l * 255 / 240));
			}
			else
			{
				int num4 = ((l > 120) ? (l + s - (l * s + 120) / 240) : ((l * (240 + s) + 120) / 240));
				int n = 2 * l - num4;
				num = (HueToRGB(n, num4, h + 80) * 255 + 120) / 240;
				num2 = (HueToRGB(n, num4, h) * 255 + 120) / 240;
				num3 = (HueToRGB(n, num4, h - 80) * 255 + 120) / 240;
			}
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, (byte)num, (byte)num2, (byte)num3);
		}

		private static void ConvertRGBToHLS(System.Windows.Media.Color rgb, out int h, out int l, out int s)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(Math.Max(rgb.R, rgb.G), rgb.B);
			int num2 = Math.Min(Math.Min(rgb.R, rgb.G), rgb.B);
			l = ((num + num2) * 240 + 255) / 510;
			if (num == num2)
			{
				s = 0;
				h = 160;
				return;
			}
			if (l <= 120)
			{
				s = ((num - num2) * 240 + (num + num2) / 2) / (num + num2);
			}
			else
			{
				s = ((num - num2) * 240 + (510 - num - num2) / 2) / (510 - num - num2);
			}
			int num3 = ((num - rgb.R) * 40 + (num - num2) / 2) / (num - num2);
			int num4 = ((num - rgb.G) * 40 + (num - num2) / 2) / (num - num2);
			int num5 = ((num - rgb.B) * 40 + (num - num2) / 2) / (num - num2);
			if (rgb.R == num)
			{
				h = num5 - num4;
			}
			else if (rgb.G == num)
			{
				h = 80 + num3 - num5;
			}
			else
			{
				h = 160 + num4 - num3;
			}
			if (h < 0)
			{
				h += 240;
			}
			if (h > 240)
			{
				h -= 240;
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		private static void DebugFail(string message)
		{
		}

		public static HighlightColor? GetHighlightColor(ColorInfo colorInfo)
		{
			if (colorInfo == null || !_highlightColorMap.TryGetValue(colorInfo, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static int HueToRGB(int n1, int n2, int hue)
		{
			if (hue < 0)
			{
				hue += 240;
			}
			if (hue > 240)
			{
				hue -= 240;
			}
			if (hue < 40)
			{
				return n1 + ((n2 - n1) * hue + 20) / 40;
			}
			if (hue < 120)
			{
				return n2;
			}
			if (hue < 160)
			{
				return n1 + ((n2 - n1) * (160 - hue) + 20) / 40;
			}
			return n1;
		}

		internal static bool IsColorDark(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return !IsColorLight(color);
		}

		internal static bool IsColorLight(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			ConvertRGBToHLS(color, out var _, out var l, out var _);
			return l >= 120;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color? ResolveHighlightColor(HighlightColor? highlightColor)
		{
			if (!highlightColor.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return highlightColor.Value switch
			{
				HighlightColor.None => null, 
				HighlightColor.Black => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 0, 0, 0), 
				HighlightColor.Blue => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 0, 0, byte.MaxValue), 
				HighlightColor.Cyan => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 0, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue), 
				HighlightColor.Green => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 0, byte.MaxValue, 0), 
				HighlightColor.Magenta => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, 0, byte.MaxValue), 
				HighlightColor.Red => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, 0, 0), 
				HighlightColor.Yellow => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, 0), 
				HighlightColor.White => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue), 
				HighlightColor.DarkBlue => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 0, 0, 128), 
				HighlightColor.DarkCyan => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 0, 128, 128), 
				HighlightColor.DarkGreen => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 0, 128, 0), 
				HighlightColor.DarkMagenta => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 128, 0, 128), 
				HighlightColor.DarkRed => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 128, 0, 0), 
				HighlightColor.DarkYellow => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 128, 128, 0), 
				HighlightColor.DarkGray => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 128, 128, 128), 
				HighlightColor.LightGray => System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 192, 192, 192), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static double Truncate(double value)
		{
			return Math.Truncate(value);
		}

	internal class ChangeManagerBase
	{
		internal abstract class ChangeBase
		{
			internal abstract bool Perform(ChangeManagerBase changeManager);

			internal virtual bool CanMerge(ChangeBase newChange)
			{
				return false;
			}

			internal virtual ChangeBase Merge(ChangeBase newChange)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		internal class ChangeManagerUndoUnit : UndoUnit
		{
			private ChangeManagerBase _changeManager;

			private ChangeBase _change;

			private bool _isSealed;

			[ThreadStatic]
			private static ChangeManagerUndoUnit _LastActiveChangeUnit;

			[ThreadStatic]
			private static bool _SealChangeUnitPending;

			public override object Target => _changeManager._doc;

			internal ChangeManagerUndoUnit(ChangeManagerBase changeManager, ChangeBase change)
			{
				_changeManager = changeManager;
				_change = change;
				_LastActiveChangeUnit = this;
				if (!_SealChangeUnitPending)
				{
					_SealChangeUnitPending = true;
					Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(SealPendingChanges), DispatcherPriority.Send);
				}
			}

			protected override UndoMergeAction Merge(UndoMergeContext mergeInfo)
			{
				if (!_isSealed)
				{
					if (mergeInfo.UnitBeingAdded is ChangeManagerUndoUnit changeManagerUndoUnit && changeManagerUndoUnit.Target == Target && _change.CanMerge(changeManagerUndoUnit._change))
					{
						_change = _change.Merge(changeManagerUndoUnit._change);
						_LastActiveChangeUnit = this;
						return UndoMergeAction.Merged;
					}
					_isSealed = true;
				}
				return base.Merge(mergeInfo);
			}

			protected override bool Execute(UndoExecuteContext executeInfo)
			{
				return _change.Perform(_changeManager);
			}

			public override string GetDescription(UndoHistoryItemType itemType, bool detailed)
			{
				return null;
			}

			private void SealPendingChanges()
			{
				_SealChangeUnitPending = false;
				if (_LastActiveChangeUnit != null)
				{
					_LastActiveChangeUnit._isSealed = true;
					_LastActiveChangeUnit = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal readonly RichTextDocument _doc;

		internal ChangeManagerBase(RichTextDocument doc)
		{
			_doc = doc;
		}

		internal void ProcessChangeHelper(ChangeBase change, RichTextDocumentChange docChange)
		{
			if (_doc.IsUndoLoggingActive(clearUndoHistoryIfInactive: true))
			{
				_doc.UndoManager.AddChange(new ChangeManagerUndoUnit(this, change));
			}
			if (docChange != null)
			{
				_doc.ProcessDocumentChange(docChange);
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class KeyedCollectionChangeManager<TCollection, TItem> : ChangeManagerBase where TCollection : RichTextObjectKeyedCollectionBase<TItem> where TItem : RichTextObjectBase
	{
		protected abstract class ChangeEx : ChangeBase
		{
			internal override bool Perform(ChangeManagerBase changeManager)
			{
				TCollection collection = ((KeyedCollectionChangeManager<TCollection, TItem>)changeManager).GetCollection();
				if (collection != null)
				{
					return PerformOverride(collection);
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal abstract bool PerformOverride(TCollection collection);

			internal virtual RichTextDocumentChange CreateDocumentChange()
			{
				return new RichTextDocumentChange(RichTextDocumentChange.RichTextDocumentChangeType.Settings);
			}
		}

		protected class Change_Add : ChangeEx
		{
			internal string _itemId;

			internal override bool PerformOverride(TCollection collection)
			{
				return collection.Remove(_itemId);
			}
		}

		protected class Change_Remove : ChangeEx
		{
			internal TItem _item;

			internal override bool PerformOverride(TCollection collection)
			{
				if (!collection.Contains(collection.GetItemId(_item)))
				{
					collection.Add((TItem)_item.Clone());
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected class PropertyChange<TValue> : ChangeEx
		{
			internal string _itemId;

			internal int _property;

			internal TValue _value;

			internal override bool PerformOverride(TCollection collection)
			{
				TItem val = collection[_itemId];
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.ApplyUndo(_property, _value);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal KeyedCollectionChangeManager(RichTextDocument doc)
			: base(doc)
		{
		}

		internal abstract TCollection GetCollection();

		internal static void OnItemAdded(TCollection collection, TItem item)
		{
			ProcessHelper(collection, () => new Change_Add
			{
				_itemId = collection.GetItemId(item)
			});
		}

		internal static void OnItemRemoved(TCollection collection, TItem item)
		{
			ProcessHelper(collection, () => new Change_Remove
			{
				_item = (TItem)item.Clone()
			});
		}

		private static void ProcessHelper(TCollection collection, Func<ChangeEx> changeCreator)
		{
			ChangeManagerBase changeManager = collection.GetChangeManager();
			if (changeManager != null)
			{
				ChangeEx changeEx = changeCreator();
				changeManager.ProcessChangeHelper(changeEx, changeEx.CreateDocumentChange());
			}
		}
	}
	internal class NodesChangeManager : ChangeManagerBase
	{
		internal abstract class NodeChangeBase : ChangeBase
		{
			private int _nodeAggregateIndex;

			internal int NodeAggregateIndex => _nodeAggregateIndex;

			internal void InitializeNodeAggregateIndex(int nodeAggregateIndex)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(nodeAggregateIndex);
				_nodeAggregateIndex = nodeAggregateIndex;
			}

			internal NodeBase GetNode(RichTextDocument doc)
			{
				_ = doc.RootNode;
				return doc.GetNodeAtAggregateIndex(_nodeAggregateIndex);
			}

			internal override bool Perform(ChangeManagerBase changeManager)
			{
				RichTextDocument doc = changeManager._doc;
				NodeBase node = GetNode(doc);
				if (node != null)
				{
					try
					{
						PerformOverride(doc, node);
						return true;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal abstract void PerformOverride(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n);

			internal abstract RichTextDocumentChange CreateDocumentChange(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n);
		}

		internal class PropertyChange<TValue> : NodeChangeBase
		{
			internal readonly int _property;

			internal readonly TValue _value;

			internal PropertyChange(int property, TValue oldValue)
			{
				_property = property;
				_value = oldValue;
			}

			internal override void PerformOverride(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n)
			{
				n.ApplyUndo(_property, _value);
			}

			internal override RichTextDocumentChange CreateDocumentChange(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n)
			{
				if (1 == _property)
				{
					NodeCollection nc = (NodeCollection)(object)_value;
					return RichTextDocumentChange.CreateHelper(doc, RichTextDocumentChange.RichTextDocumentChangeType.NodesCollectionChanged, n.GetChildNodesDocumentOffset(), Utilities.GetOffsetCount(nc), Utilities.GetOffsetCount(n.ChildNodesIfAllocated));
				}
				if (3 == _property && n is TextNode)
				{
					string text = (string)(object)_value;
					return RichTextDocumentChange.CreateHelper(doc, RichTextDocumentChange.RichTextDocumentChangeType.NodeContentChanged, n.GetDocumentOffset(), text?.Length ?? 0, n.AggregateOffsetCount);
				}
				return new RichTextDocumentChange(RichTextDocumentChange.RichTextDocumentChangeType.Settings);
			}
		}

		internal abstract class Nodes_Insert_Remove_Base : NodeChangeBase
		{
			internal readonly NodeData _parentNodeData;

			internal abstract int StartIndex { get; }

			internal abstract int NodeCount { get; }

			internal abstract bool IsInsert { get; }

			protected Nodes_Insert_Remove_Base(NodeData parentNode)
			{
				_parentNodeData = parentNode;
			}

			internal override bool CanMerge(ChangeBase newChange)
			{
				if (!(newChange is Nodes_Insert_Remove_Base nodes_Insert_Remove_Base))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (nodes_Insert_Remove_Base._parentNodeData != _parentNodeData)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (nodes_Insert_Remove_Base.IsInsert != IsInsert)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal abstract class Nodes_Insert_Base : Nodes_Insert_Remove_Base
		{
			internal override bool IsInsert => true;

			protected Nodes_Insert_Base(NodeData parentNodeData)
				: base(parentNodeData)
			{
			}

			internal override bool CanMerge(ChangeBase newChange)
			{
				if (!base.CanMerge(newChange))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!(newChange is Nodes_Insert_Base nodes_Insert_Base))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (nodes_Insert_Base.StartIndex != StartIndex + NodeCount)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class Nodes_Insert : Nodes_Insert_Base
		{
			private int _index;

			internal override int NodeCount => 1;

			internal override int StartIndex => _index;

			public Nodes_Insert(int index, NodeData parentNodeData)
				: base(parentNodeData)
			{
				_index = index;
			}

			internal override ChangeBase Merge(ChangeBase newChange)
			{
				Nodes_Insert_Base nodes_Insert_Base = newChange as Nodes_Insert_Base;
				Nodes_InsertMulti nodes_InsertMulti = new Nodes_InsertMulti(_index, 1 + nodes_Insert_Base.NodeCount, _parentNodeData);
				nodes_InsertMulti.InitializeNodeAggregateIndex(base.NodeAggregateIndex);
				return nodes_InsertMulti;
			}

			internal override void PerformOverride(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n)
			{
				n.ChildNodes.RemoveAt(_index);
			}

			internal override RichTextDocumentChange CreateDocumentChange(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n)
			{
				DocumentSpan documentSpan = n.ChildNodes.GetDocumentSpan(_index, 1);
				return RichTextDocumentChange.CreateHelper(doc, RichTextDocumentChange.RichTextDocumentChangeType.NodesAdded, documentSpan.Start, 0, documentSpan.Length);
			}
		}

		internal class Nodes_InsertMulti : Nodes_Insert_Base
		{
			private int _index;

			private int _count;

			internal override int NodeCount => _count;

			internal override int StartIndex => _index;

			public Nodes_InsertMulti(int index, int count, NodeData parentNodeData)
				: base(parentNodeData)
			{
				_index = index;
				_count = count;
			}

			internal override ChangeBase Merge(ChangeBase newChange)
			{
				Nodes_Insert_Base nodes_Insert_Base = newChange as Nodes_Insert_Base;
				_count += nodes_Insert_Base.NodeCount;
				return this;
			}

			internal override void PerformOverride(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n)
			{
				n.ChildNodes.RemoveRange(_index, _count);
			}

			internal override RichTextDocumentChange CreateDocumentChange(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n)
			{
				DocumentSpan documentSpan = n.ChildNodes.GetDocumentSpan(_index, _count);
				return RichTextDocumentChange.CreateHelper(doc, RichTextDocumentChange.RichTextDocumentChangeType.NodesAdded, documentSpan.Start, 0, documentSpan.Length);
			}
		}

		internal abstract class Nodes_Remove_Base : Nodes_Insert_Remove_Base
		{
			internal override bool IsInsert => false;

			protected Nodes_Remove_Base(NodeData parentNode)
				: base(parentNode)
			{
			}

			internal override bool CanMerge(ChangeBase newChange)
			{
				if (!base.CanMerge(newChange))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!(newChange is Nodes_Remove_Base nodes_Remove_Base))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (nodes_Remove_Base.StartIndex != StartIndex)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class Nodes_Remove : Nodes_Remove_Base
		{
			private int _index;

			internal readonly NodeData _removedNode;

			internal override int NodeCount => 1;

			internal override int StartIndex => _index;

			public Nodes_Remove(int index, NodeBase removedNode, NodeData parentNodeData)
				: base(parentNodeData)
			{
				_index = index;
				_removedNode = NodeUtils.ToNodeDataTree(removedNode);
			}

			internal override void PerformOverride(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n)
			{
				NodeBase item = NodeUtils.ToNodeTree(_removedNode);
				n.ChildNodes.Insert(_index, item);
			}

			internal override RichTextDocumentChange CreateDocumentChange(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n)
			{
				int startOffset = ((_index < n.ChildNodes.Count) ? n.ChildNodes[_index].GetDocumentOffset() : (n.GetChildNodesDocumentOffset() + Utilities.GetOffsetCount(n.ChildNodes)));
				return RichTextDocumentChange.CreateHelper(doc, RichTextDocumentChange.RichTextDocumentChangeType.NodesRemoved, startOffset, _removedNode.AggregateOffsetCount, 0);
			}

			internal override ChangeBase Merge(ChangeBase newChange)
			{
				List<NodeData> list = new List<NodeData>();
				list.Add(_removedNode);
				if (newChange is Nodes_Remove nodes_Remove)
				{
					list.Add(nodes_Remove._removedNode);
				}
				else
				{
					Nodes_RemoveMulti nodes_RemoveMulti = newChange as Nodes_RemoveMulti;
					list.AddRange(nodes_RemoveMulti.RemovedNodes);
				}
				Nodes_RemoveMulti nodes_RemoveMulti2 = new Nodes_RemoveMulti(_index, list, _parentNodeData);
				nodes_RemoveMulti2.InitializeNodeAggregateIndex(base.NodeAggregateIndex);
				return nodes_RemoveMulti2;
			}
		}

		internal class Nodes_RemoveMulti : Nodes_Remove_Base
		{
			internal readonly int _index;

			private NodeData[] _removedNodes;

			internal NodeData[] RemovedNodes => _removedNodes;

			internal override int NodeCount => _removedNodes.Length;

			internal override int StartIndex => _index;

			public Nodes_RemoveMulti(int index, IEnumerable<NodeBase> removedNodes, NodeData parentNodeData)
				: base(parentNodeData)
			{
				_index = index;
				_removedNodes = removedNodes.Select(NodeUtils.ToNodeDataTree).ToArray();
			}

			public Nodes_RemoveMulti(int index, IEnumerable<NodeData> removedNodes, NodeData parentNodeData)
				: base(parentNodeData)
			{
				_index = index;
				_removedNodes = removedNodes.ToArray();
			}

			internal override ChangeBase Merge(ChangeBase newChange)
			{
				Nodes_Remove_Base nodes_Remove_Base = newChange as Nodes_Remove_Base;
				new List<NodeData>();
				NodeData[] array = new NodeData[_removedNodes.Length + nodes_Remove_Base.NodeCount];
				_removedNodes.CopyTo(array, 0);
				if (nodes_Remove_Base is Nodes_Remove nodes_Remove)
				{
					array[_removedNodes.Length] = nodes_Remove._removedNode;
				}
				else
				{
					(newChange as Nodes_RemoveMulti)._removedNodes.CopyTo(array, _removedNodes.Length);
				}
				_removedNodes = array;
				return this;
			}

			internal override void PerformOverride(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n)
			{
				IEnumerable<NodeBase> items = _removedNodes.Select(NodeUtils.ToNodeTree);
				n.ChildNodes.InsertRange(_index, items);
			}

			internal override RichTextDocumentChange CreateDocumentChange(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n)
			{
				int startOffset = ((_index < n.ChildNodes.Count) ? n.ChildNodes[_index].GetDocumentOffset() : (n.GetChildNodesDocumentOffset() + Utilities.GetOffsetCount(n.ChildNodes)));
				int oldOffsetCount = _removedNodes.Aggregate(0, (int c, NodeData i) => c + i.AggregateOffsetCount);
				return RichTextDocumentChange.CreateHelper(doc, RichTextDocumentChange.RichTextDocumentChangeType.NodesRemoved, startOffset, oldOffsetCount, 0);
			}
		}

		internal class Nodes_ReplaceMulti : NodeChangeBase
		{
			private int _index;

			private NodeData[] _replacedNodes;

			public Nodes_ReplaceMulti(int index, IEnumerable<NodeBase> replacedNodes)

			}
		}

		internal class Nodes_Reset : NodeChangeBase

			}
		}

		}

		internal static void OnChildCollection_AddRemoveReplaceHelper(NodeBase parent, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs arg)
		{
			NotifyCollectionChangedAction action = arg.Action;
			if (action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add && NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove != action && NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace != action)
			{
				return;
			}
			NodesChangeManager changeManager = GetChangeManager(parent);
			if (changeManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			NodeData parentNodeData = parent?._data;
			int aggregateIndex = parent.GetAggregateIndex();
			if (aggregateIndex >= 0)
			{
				NodeChangeBase nodeChangeBase = null;
				switch (arg.Action)
				{
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				{
					int newStartingIndex2 = arg.NewStartingIndex;
					IList newItems = arg.NewItems;
					nodeChangeBase = ((1 != newItems.Count) ? ((Nodes_Insert_Base)new Nodes_InsertMulti(newStartingIndex2, newItems.Count, parentNodeData)) : ((Nodes_Insert_Base)new Nodes_Insert(newStartingIndex2, parentNodeData)));
					break;
				}
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				{
					int oldStartingIndex = arg.OldStartingIndex;
					IList oldItems2 = arg.OldItems;
					nodeChangeBase = ((1 != oldItems2.Count) ? ((Nodes_Remove_Base)new Nodes_RemoveMulti(oldStartingIndex, oldItems2.Cast<NodeBase>(), parentNodeData)) : ((Nodes_Remove_Base)new Nodes_Remove(oldStartingIndex, (NodeBase)oldItems2[0], parentNodeData)));
					break;
				}
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				{
					int newStartingIndex = arg.NewStartingIndex;
					IList oldItems = arg.OldItems;
					nodeChangeBase = ((1 != oldItems.Count) ? ((NodeChangeBase)new Nodes_ReplaceMulti(newStartingIndex, oldItems.Cast<NodeBase>())) : ((NodeChangeBase)new Nodes_Replace(newStartingIndex, (NodeBase)oldItems[0])));
					break;
				}
				}
				if (nodeChangeBase != null)
				{
					nodeChangeBase.InitializeNodeAggregateIndex(aggregateIndex);
					changeManager.ProcessChange(parent, nodeChangeBase);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnChildCollectionReset(NodeBase parent, IEnumerable<NodeBase> oldItems)
		{
			int aggregateIndex = parent.GetAggregateIndex();
			if (aggregateIndex >= 0)
			{
				Nodes_Reset nodes_Reset = new Nodes_Reset(oldItems);
				nodes_Reset.InitializeNodeAggregateIndex(aggregateIndex);
				ProcessChange(parent, nodes_Reset);
			}
		}

		internal static void OnNodePropertyChanged<TValue>(NodeBase n, int prop, TValue oldValue)
		{
			NodesChangeManager changeManager = GetChangeManager(n);
			if (changeManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int aggregateIndex = n.GetAggregateIndex();
			if (aggregateIndex >= 0)
			{
				if (oldValue is RichTextObjectBase { IsSealed: false } richTextObjectBase)
				{
					oldValue = (TValue)(object)richTextObjectBase.Clone();
				}
				PropertyChange<TValue> propertyChange = new PropertyChange<TValue>(prop, oldValue);
				propertyChange.InitializeNodeAggregateIndex(aggregateIndex);
				changeManager.ProcessChange(n, propertyChange);
			}
		}
	}

	internal static class ClipboardManager
	{
		public const string EmbedSourceFormat = "Embed Source";

		public const string RichTextFormat = "Rich Text Format";

		public const string StringFormat = "System.String";

		public const string TextFormat = "Text";

		public const string UnicodeTextFormat = "UnicodeText";

		public const string DibFormat = "DeviceIndependentBitmap";

		public const string HtmlFormat = "HTML Format";

		private static bool _exceptionThrownWhenAccessingClipboard;

		private static IDataObject _privateClipboardData;

		private static readonly object _syncLock = new object();

		private static WeakReference _privateClipboardDataOnWpfClipboard;

		public static bool IsUsingInternalClipboard => _exceptionThrownWhenAccessingClipboard;

		public static IDataObject GetDataObject()
		{
			lock (_syncLock)
			{
				if (IsUsingInternalClipboard)
				{
					return _privateClipboardData;
				}
				try
				{
					if (_privateClipboardData != null && !IsCurrent(_privateClipboardData))
					{
						_privateClipboardData = null;
						_privateClipboardDataOnWpfClipboard = null;
					}
					return Clipboard.GetDataObject();
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_exceptionThrownWhenAccessingClipboard = true;
					return _privateClipboardData;
				}
				catch (ExternalException)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool IsCurrent(IDataObject dataObject)
		{
			lock (_syncLock)
			{
				if (CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_privateClipboardDataOnWpfClipboard) is DataObject dataObject2 && (dataObject == _privateClipboardData || dataObject == dataObject2))
				{
					if (Clipboard.IsCurrent(dataObject2))
					{
						return true;
					}
					_privateClipboardData = null;
					_privateClipboardDataOnWpfClipboard = null;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool RetainCurrentClipboardData()
		{
			lock (_syncLock)
			{
				if (CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_privateClipboardDataOnWpfClipboard) is DataObject dataObject && IsCurrent(dataObject))
				{
					Clipboard.SetDataObject(dataObject, copy: true);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void SetDataObject(IDataObject dataObject)
		{
			lock (_syncLock)
			{
				_privateClipboardData = dataObject;
				_privateClipboardDataOnWpfClipboard = null;
				if (IsUsingInternalClipboard)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					DataObject dataObject2 = dataObject as DataObject;
					if (_privateClipboardDataOnWpfClipboard == null)
					{
						dataObject2 = new DataObject();
						string[] formats = dataObject.GetFormats();
						foreach (string format in formats)
						{
							dataObject2.SetData(format, dataObject.GetData(format));
						}
					}
					Clipboard.SetDataObject(dataObject2);
					_privateClipboardDataOnWpfClipboard = new WeakReference(dataObject2);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_exceptionThrownWhenAccessingClipboard = true;
				}
				catch (ExternalException)
				{
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CustomDataObject : IDataObject
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, object> _data = new Dictionary<string, object>();

		private bool _shouldSynchronize = true;

		object IDataObject.GetData(string format, bool autoConvert)
		{
			return GetData(format);
		}

		bool IDataObject.GetDataPresent(string format, bool autoConvert)
		{
			return GetDataPresent(format);
		}

		string[] IDataObject.GetFormats(bool autoConvert)
		{
			return GetFormats();
		}

		void IDataObject.SetData(string format, object data, bool autoConvert)
		{
			SetData(format, data);
		}

		private static string ConvertToTextValue(string value, out bool wasConverted)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				wasConverted = false;
				return null;
			}
			Encoding defaultEncoding = SerializationUtilities.DefaultEncoding;
			byte[] bytes = defaultEncoding.GetBytes(value);
			string text = defaultEncoding.GetString(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
			wasConverted = value != text;
			return text;
		}

		public object GetData(string format)
		{
			_data.TryGetValue(format, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public object GetData(Type format)
		{
			object data = GetData(format.FullName);
			if (data != null && format.IsAssignableFrom(data.GetType()))
			{
				return data;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool GetDataPresent(string format)
		{
			return _data.ContainsKey(format);
		}

		public bool GetDataPresent(Type format)
		{
			return GetDataPresent(format.FullName);
		}

		public string[] GetFormats()
		{
			return _data.Keys.ToArray();
		}

		public void ResumeSynchronizations()
		{
			if (!_shouldSynchronize)
			{
				_shouldSynchronize = true;
				SynchronizeFormatsAfterResume();
			}
		}

		public void SetData(object data)
		{
			SetData(data.GetType(), data);
		}

		public void SetData(Type format, object data)
		{
			SetData(format.FullName, data);
		}

		public void SetData(string format, object data)
		{
			_data[format] = data;
			if (_shouldSynchronize)
			{
				switch (format)
				{
				case "System.String":
				case "Text":
				case "UnicodeText":
					SynchronizeStringFormats(data as string, format);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void SuspendSynchronizations()
		{
			_shouldSynchronize = false;
		}

		private void SynchronizeFormatsAfterResume()
		{
			bool wasConverted;
			if (_data.ContainsKey("UnicodeText"))
			{
				string value = ConvertToTextValue(_data["UnicodeText"] as string, out wasConverted);
				_data["System.String"] = value;
				_data["Text"] = value;
			}
			else if (_data.ContainsKey("System.String"))
			{
				string value2 = _data["System.String"] as string;
				string value = ConvertToTextValue(value2, out wasConverted);
				_data["UnicodeText"] = value2;
				if (wasConverted)
				{
					_data["System.String"] = value;
				}
				_data["Text"] = value;
			}
			else if (_data.ContainsKey("Text"))
			{
				string value3 = _data["Text"] as string;
				string value = ConvertToTextValue(value3, out wasConverted);
				_data["UnicodeText"] = value3;
				_data["System.String"] = value;
				if (wasConverted)
				{
					_data["Text"] = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeStringFormats(string value, string appliedFormat)
		{
			bool wasConverted;
			string value2 = ConvertToTextValue(value, out wasConverted);
			if (appliedFormat != "System.String" || wasConverted)
			{
				_data["System.String"] = value2;
			}
			if (appliedFormat != "Text" || wasConverted)
			{
				_data["Text"] = value2;
			}
			if (appliedFormat != "UnicodeText")
			{
				_data["UnicodeText"] = value;
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class LayoutNodeCollection : IList<LayoutNodeBase>, ICollection<LayoutNodeBase>, IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase>, IEnumerable
	{
		internal abstract Extent Height { get; }

		protected abstract IList<LayoutNodeBase> UnderlyingList { get; }

		public LayoutNodeBase this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return UnderlyingList[index];
			}
			set
			{
				UnderlyingList[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public int Count => UnderlyingList.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => UnderlyingList.IsReadOnly;

		internal abstract Extent GetOffsetY(LayoutNodeBase layoutNode);

		internal LayoutNodeBase GetSibling(LayoutNodeBase item, bool next)
		{
			return GetSibling(IndexOf(item), next);
		}

		internal LayoutNodeBase GetSibling(int index, bool next)
		{
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				index += (next ? 1 : (-1));
				if (index >= 0 && index < Count)
				{
					return this[index];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public abstract void InsertRange(int index, IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> nodes);

		protected void OnRangeInserted(int index, IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> nodes)
		{
			LayoutNodeBase afterNode = ((index > 0) ? this[index - 1] : null);
			LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = null;
			foreach (LayoutNodeBase node in nodes)
			{
				layoutNodeBase?.OnAddedToTree(afterNode, node);
				afterNode = layoutNodeBase;
				layoutNodeBase = node;
				index++;
			}
			if (layoutNodeBase != null)
			{
				LayoutNodeBase beforeNode = ((index < Count) ? this[index] : null);
				layoutNodeBase.OnAddedToTree(afterNode, beforeNode);
			}
		}

		public abstract void RemoveRange(int index, int count);

		public int IndexOf(LayoutNodeBase item)
		{
			return UnderlyingList.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, LayoutNodeBase item)
		{
			UnderlyingList.Insert(index, item);
			LayoutNodeBase afterNode = null;
			LayoutNodeBase beforeNode = null;
			if (item.ParentLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded)
			{
				afterNode = ((index > 0) ? this[index - 1] : null);
				beforeNode = ((index + 1 < Count) ? this[index + 1] : null);
			}
			item.OnAddedToTree(afterNode, beforeNode);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			UnderlyingList.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Add(LayoutNodeBase item)
		{
			UnderlyingList.Add(item);
			LayoutNodeBase afterNode = null;
			if (item.ParentLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded)
			{
				afterNode = ((Count > 1) ? this[Count - 2] : null);
			}
			item.OnAddedToTree(afterNode, null);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			UnderlyingList.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(LayoutNodeBase item)
		{
			return UnderlyingList.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(LayoutNodeBase[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			UnderlyingList.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool Remove(LayoutNodeBase item)
		{
			return UnderlyingList.Remove(item);
		}

		public IEnumerator<LayoutNodeBase> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return UnderlyingList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return UnderlyingList.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

	internal class AggregatingLayoutNodeTreeList : TreeList<AggregatingLayoutNodeTreeList.NodeEx, LayoutNodeBase>
	{
		internal class NodeEx : Node
		{
			internal NodeEx _parent;

			internal Extent _itemHeight;

			internal Extent _totalHeight;

			internal Extent LeftHeight
			{
				get
				{
					if (_left == null)
					{
						return new Extent(0.0);
					}
					return _left._totalHeight;
				}
			}

			internal Extent RightHeight
			{
				get
				{
					if (_right == null)
					{
						return new Extent(0.0);
					}
					return _right._totalHeight;
				}
			}

			internal override NodeEx Parent
			{
				get
				{
					return _parent;
				}
				set
				{
					_parent = value;
				}
			}

			internal override void Aggregate_Insert(NodeEx n)
			{
				base.Aggregate_Insert(n);
				_totalHeight += n._totalHeight;
			}

			internal override void Aggregate_Remove(NodeEx n)
			{
				base.Aggregate_Remove(n);
				_totalHeight -= n._totalHeight;
			}

			internal override void InitializeAggregateInfo()
			{
				base.InitializeAggregateInfo();
				_itemHeight = ((_item != null) ? _item.HeightToAggregate : new Extent(0.0));
				_totalHeight = _itemHeight + LeftHeight + RightHeight;
			}
		}

		protected override bool NodeHasParentOverride => true;

		protected override bool TrackNodesOnItemsOverride => true;

		internal Extent Height
		{
			get
			{
				if (_root == null)
				{
					return new Extent(0.0);
				}
				return _root._totalHeight;
			}
		}

		protected override NodeEx GetItemNode(LayoutNodeBase item)
		{
			return item.ParentTreeNode;
		}

		protected override void SetItemNode(LayoutNodeBase item, NodeEx node)
		{
			item.ParentTreeNode = node;
		}

		internal Extent GetOffsetY(LayoutNodeBase layoutNode)
		{
			NodeEx parentTreeNode = layoutNode.ParentTreeNode;
			return GetOffsetYHelper(parentTreeNode);
		}

		private Extent GetOffsetYHelper(NodeEx n)
		{
			if (n == null)
			{
				return new Extent(0.0);
			}
			Extent leftHeight = n.LeftHeight;
			do
			{
				NodeEx parent = n._parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					if (n == parent._right)
					{
						leftHeight += parent.LeftHeight + parent._itemHeight;
					}
					else if (n != parent._left)
					{
						return new Extent(0.0);
					}
				}
				else if (_root != n)
				{
					return new Extent(0.0);
				}
				n = parent;
			}
			while (n != null);
			return leftHeight;
		}

		internal LayoutNodeBase GetNodeContainingOffsetY(Extent offsetY)
		{
			NodeEx nodeEx = _root;
			while (nodeEx != null)
			{
				Extent leftHeight = nodeEx.LeftHeight;
				if (leftHeight.Twips > 0.0)
				{
					if (offsetY < leftHeight)
					{
						nodeEx = nodeEx._left;
						continue;
					}
					offsetY -= leftHeight;
				}
				if (offsetY < nodeEx._itemHeight)
				{
					return nodeEx._item;
				}
				offsetY -= nodeEx._itemHeight;
				if (!(offsetY <= nodeEx.RightHeight))
				{
					break;
				}
				nodeEx = nodeEx._right;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class ListLevelDefinitionCollection : RichTextObjectBase, ICollection<ListLevelDefinition>, IEnumerable<ListLevelDefinition>, IEnumerable, IListInternal
	{
		internal new static class StorageProps
		{
			internal class Info : RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info
			{
				internal static readonly Info Instance = new Info();

				internal override RichTextObjectBase CreateNew()
				{
					return new ListLevelDefinitionCollection();
				}

				internal override PropertyResolverBase CreateResolver(object target)
				{
					return null;
				}

				protected override void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> map)
				{
					base.Initialize(map);
					StoragePropsInfo.FillMap(new PropInfo[1] { CreateProp(0, "CollectionChange", (ListLevelDefinitionCollection i) => default(UndoCollectionChangeInfo<ListLevelDefinition>), delegate(ListLevelDefinitionCollection i, UndoCollectionChangeInfo<ListLevelDefinition> v)
					{
						i.ProcessCollectionChangeUndo(v);
						return true;
					}) }, map);
				}

				internal override bool AreObjectsEqualOverride(RichTextObjectBase x, RichTextObjectBase y)
				{
					return Utilities.AreCollectionEqual(((ListLevelDefinitionCollection)x)._levels, ((ListLevelDefinitionCollection)y)._levels, (ListLevelDefinition a, ListLevelDefinition b) => RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info.AreObjectsEqual(a, b));
				}

				internal override int GetObjectHashCodeOverride(RichTextObjectBase o)
				{
					return Utilities.GetCollectionHashCode(((ListLevelDefinitionCollection)o)._levels, (ListLevelDefinition i) => RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info.GetObjectHashCode(i));
				}
			}

			internal const int CollectionChange = 0;
		}

		private List<ListLevelDefinition> _levels;

		internal override RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info PropsInfo => StorageProps.Info.Instance;

		public int Count => _levels.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => base.IsSealed;

		public ListLevelDefinition this[int index] => _levels[index];

		object IListInternal.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _levels[index];
			}
			set
			{
				Add(value as ListLevelDefinition);
			}
		}

		public ListLevelDefinitionCollection()
		{
			_levels = new List<ListLevelDefinition>();
		}

		internal override void CopyFrom(RichTextObjectBase source)
		{
			ListLevelDefinitionCollection listLevelDefinitionCollection = source as ListLevelDefinitionCollection;
			ClearHelper();
			int count = listLevelDefinitionCollection.Count;
			ListLevelDefinition[] array = new ListLevelDefinition[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = listLevelDefinitionCollection._levels[i].Clone() as ListLevelDefinition;
			}
			AddRangeHelper(array);
		}

		public void Add(ListLevelDefinition levelDefintion)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(levelDefintion, "levelDefintion");
			if (levelDefintion.Level < 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_LevelOutOfRange"));
			}
			ProcessAdd(levelDefintion);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			if (_levels.Count > 0)
			{
				ListLevelDefinition[] oldDefinitions = _levels.ToArray();
				ClearHelper();
				OnReset(oldDefinitions);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(ListLevelDefinition item)
		{
			return _levels.Contains(item);
		}

		public bool Contains(int levelNumber)
		{
			return IndexOfLevel(levelNumber) >= 0;
		}

		public void CopyTo(ListLevelDefinition[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_levels.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public int IndexOfLevel(int levelNumber)
		{
			int count = _levels.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (_levels[i].Level == levelNumber)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public bool RemoveLevel(int levelNumber)
		{
			ListLevelDefinition levelDefinition = null;
			if (!TryGetDefinition(levelNumber, out levelDefinition))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((ICollection<ListLevelDefinition>)this).Remove(levelDefinition);
		}

		public bool TryGetDefinition(int levelNumber, out ListLevelDefinition levelDefinition)
		{
			int num = IndexOfLevel(levelNumber);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				levelDefinition = _levels[num];
				return true;
			}
			levelDefinition = null;
			return false;
		}

		private void AddRangeHelper(ListLevelDefinition[] newLevels)
		{
			_levels.AddRange(newLevels);
			int num = newLevels.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				newLevels[i].AddListener(this, useWeakReference: false);
			}
		}

		private void ClearHelper()
		{
			int count = _levels.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				_levels[i].RemoveListener(this);
			}
			_levels.Clear();
		}

		private void OnReset(ListLevelDefinition[] oldDefinitions)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(0, new UndoCollectionChangeInfo<ListLevelDefinition>(UndoCollectionChangeAction.Reset, oldDefinitions));
		}

		private void ProcessAdd(ListLevelDefinition levelDef)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			if (TryGetDefinition(levelDef.Level, out var levelDefinition) && levelDef == levelDefinition)
			{
				return;
			}
			UndoCollectionChangeAction action;
			int index;
			if (levelDefinition != null)
			{
				levelDefinition.RemoveListener(this);
				action = UndoCollectionChangeAction.Replace;
				index = _levels.IndexOf(levelDefinition);
				_levels[index] = levelDef;
			}
			else
			{
				action = UndoCollectionChangeAction.Insert;
				index = 0;
				int count = _levels.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count && _levels[i].Level <= levelDef.Level; i++)
				{
					index = i + 1;
				}
				_levels.Insert(index, levelDef);
			}
			levelDef.AddListener(this, useWeakReference: false);
			OnPropertyChanged(0, new UndoCollectionChangeInfo<ListLevelDefinition>(action, index, levelDefinition));
		}

		private void ProcessCollectionChangeUndo(UndoCollectionChangeInfo<ListLevelDefinition> collectionChange)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			switch (collectionChange.Action)
			{
			case UndoCollectionChangeAction.Reset:
			{
				ListLevelDefinition[] oldDefinitions = _levels.ToArray();
				SetLevelDefinitions(collectionChange.OldValues);
				OnReset(oldDefinitions);
				break;
			}
			case UndoCollectionChangeAction.Insert:
				((ICollection<ListLevelDefinition>)this).Remove(this[collectionChange.Index]);
				break;
			case UndoCollectionChangeAction.Remove:
			case UndoCollectionChangeAction.Replace:
				Add(collectionChange.OldValue);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetLevelDefinitions(ListLevelDefinition[] newDefinitions)
		{
			ClearHelper();
			AddRangeHelper(newDefinitions);
		}

		public IEnumerator<ListLevelDefinition> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<ListLevelDefinition>)_levels).GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable)_levels).GetEnumerator();
		}

		void ICollection<ListLevelDefinition>.Add(ListLevelDefinition item)
		{
			ProcessAdd(item);
		}

		bool ICollection<ListLevelDefinition>.Remove(ListLevelDefinition item)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			int num = _levels.IndexOf(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			_levels.RemoveAt(num);
			item.RemoveListener(this);
			OnPropertyChanged(0, new UndoCollectionChangeInfo<ListLevelDefinition>(UndoCollectionChangeAction.Remove, num, item));
			return true;
		}

		int IListInternal.IndexOf(object item)
		{
			return _levels.IndexOf(item as ListLevelDefinition);
		}
	}

			int num = ((1 == count) ? documentOffset : nodeBase2.GetDocumentOffset()) + nodeBase2.AggregateOffsetCount;
			return new DocumentSpan(documentOffset, num - documentOffset);
		}
