		internal NodeBase GetSibling(NodeBase item, bool next)
		{
			return GetSibling(IndexOf(item), next);
		}

		internal NodeBase GetSibling(int index, bool next)
		{
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				index += (next ? 1 : (-1));
				if (index >= 0 && index < Count)
				{
					return this[index];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void InitializeParent(NodeBase parent)
		{
			if (_parent == parent)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_parent != null && parent != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Same NodeCollection instance cannot be associated with multiple nodes.");
			}
			VerifyIsMutable();
			if (Count > 0)
			{
				if (parent != null)
				{
					using IEnumerator<NodeBase> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						NodeBase current = enumerator.Current;
						ValidateItem(current, parent);
					}
				}
				using IEnumerator<NodeBase> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					enumerator.Current.InitializeParent(parent);
				}
			}
			_parent = parent;
			ListAsNodeList?.InvalidateAggregateInfoOnAllNodes();
		}

		internal void Insert(NodeBase item, bool atBeginning)
		{
			int index = ((!atBeginning) ? Count : 0);
			Insert(index, item);
		}

		internal bool InsertAfter(NodeBase afterItem, NodeBase itemToInsert)
		{
			return InsertBeforeAfter(afterItem, itemToInsert, before: false);
		}

		internal bool InsertAfter(NodeBase afterItem, IEnumerable<NodeBase> itemsToInsert)
		{
			return InsertBeforeAfter(afterItem, itemsToInsert, before: false);
		}

		internal bool InsertBefore(NodeBase beforeItem, NodeBase itemToInsert)
		{
			return InsertBeforeAfter(beforeItem, itemToInsert, before: true);
		}

		internal bool InsertBefore(NodeBase beforeItem, IEnumerable<NodeBase> itemsToInsert)
		{
			return InsertBeforeAfter(beforeItem, itemsToInsert, before: true);
		}

		internal bool InsertBeforeAfter(NodeBase relativeToItem, NodeBase itemToInsert, bool before)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(relativeToItem);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (!before)
				{
					num++;
				}
				Insert(num, itemToInsert);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool InsertBeforeAfter(NodeBase relativeToItem, IEnumerable<NodeBase> itemsToInsert, bool before)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(relativeToItem);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (!before)
				{
					num++;
				}
				InsertRange(num, itemsToInsert);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InsertRange(IEnumerable<NodeBase> items, bool atBeginning)
		{
			int num = ((!atBeginning) ? Count : 0);
			foreach (NodeBase item in items)
			{
				Insert(num++, item);
			}
		}

		internal void OnItem_AggregateOffsetCountChanged(NodeBase item)
		{
			ListAsNodeList?.OnItem_AggregateOffsetCountChanged(item);
		}

		internal void OnItem_AggregateNodeCountChanged(NodeBase item)
		{
			ListAsNodeList?.OnItem_AggregateNodeCountChanged(item);
		}

		internal void ReplaceContents(IEnumerable<NodeBase> items)
		{
			Clear();
			InsertRange(0, items);
		}

		internal bool Split(NodeBase n, out NodeCollection right)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(n);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				NodeBase[] items = GetItemsStartingAt(num).ToArray();
				RemoveRange(num, Count - num);
				right = new NodeCollection();
				right.AddRange(items);
				return true;
			}
			right = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ValidateItem(NodeBase node, NodeBase newParent = null)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(node);
			if (node.Parent != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("A Node cannot exist in more than one collection or multiple times in the same collection.", "node");
			}
			NodeBase nodeBase = newParent ?? _parent;
			if (nodeBase != null)
			{
				SchemaValidator.ValidateChildNode(nodeBase, node);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Add(NodeBase item)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			ValidateItem(item);
			_list.Add(item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (Count > 0)
			{
				VerifyIsMutable();
				NodesChangeManager changeManager = NodesChangeManager.GetChangeManager(_parent);
				NodeBase[] oldItems = ((changeManager != null) ? this.ToArray() : null);
				int num = changeManager?._doc.CompatibilityVersionId ?? (-1);
				_list.Clear();
				if (changeManager != null && num == changeManager._doc.CompatibilityVersionId)
				{
					changeManager.OnChildCollectionReset(_parent, oldItems);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(NodeBase item)
		{
			return _list.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(NodeBase[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_list.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public IEnumerator<NodeBase> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _list.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public int IndexOf(NodeBase item)
		{
			return _list.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, NodeBase item)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			ValidateItem(item);
			_list.Insert(index, item);
		}

		public void InsertRange(int index, IEnumerable<NodeBase> items)
		{
			NodeList listAsNodeList = ListAsNodeList;
			if (listAsNodeList != null)
			{
				listAsNodeList.InsertRange(index, items);
				return;
			}
			foreach (NodeBase item in items)
			{
				_list.Insert(index++, item);
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(NodeBase item)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			_list.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void RemoveRange(int index, int count)
		{
			NodeList listAsNodeList = ListAsNodeList;
			if (listAsNodeList != null)
			{
				listAsNodeList.RemoveRange(index, count);
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				_list.RemoveAt(index);
			}
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			Add((NodeBase)value);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains((NodeBase)value);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf((NodeBase)value);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Insert(index, (NodeBase)value);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			Remove((NodeBase)value);
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			CoreUtilities.CopyTo(this, array, index);
		}
	}

	internal class NodeListBase<TNode, TItem> : TreeList<TNode, TItem> where TNode : NodeListBase<TNode, TItem>.NodeEx, new() where TItem : class
	{
		internal class NodeEx : Node
		{
			internal int _itemOffsetCount;

			internal int _totalOffsetCount;

			internal int _itemIndexCount;

			internal int _totalIndexCount;

			internal int LeftOffsetCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (_left == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return _left._totalOffsetCount;
				}
			}

			internal int RightOffsetCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (_right == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return _right._totalOffsetCount;
				}
			}

			internal int LeftIndexCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (_left == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return _left._totalIndexCount;
				}
			}

			internal int RightIndexCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (_right == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return _right._totalIndexCount;
				}
			}

			protected virtual int GetItemOffsetCount()
			{
				return 0;
			}

			protected virtual int GetItemTotalIndexCount()
			{
				return 1;
			}

			internal int InternalGetItemIndexCount()
			{
				return GetItemTotalIndexCount();
			}

			internal int InternalGetItemOffsetCount()
			{
				return GetItemOffsetCount();
			}

			internal override void InitializeAggregateInfo()
			{
				base.InitializeAggregateInfo();
				_itemOffsetCount = GetItemOffsetCount();
				_totalOffsetCount = _itemOffsetCount + LeftOffsetCount + RightOffsetCount;
				_itemIndexCount = GetItemTotalIndexCount();
				_totalIndexCount = _itemIndexCount + LeftIndexCount + RightIndexCount;
			}

			internal override void Aggregate_Insert(TNode n)
			{
				base.Aggregate_Insert(n);
				_totalOffsetCount += n._totalOffsetCount;
				_totalIndexCount += n._totalIndexCount;
			}

			internal override void Aggregate_Remove(TNode n)
			{
				base.Aggregate_Remove(n);
				_totalOffsetCount -= n._totalOffsetCount;
				_totalIndexCount -= n._totalIndexCount;
			}
		}

		public int AggregateOffsetCount => _root._totalOffsetCount;

		public int AggregateNodeCount => _root._totalIndexCount;

		public TItem GetItemContainingAggregateIndex(ref int aggregateIndex)
		{
			if (aggregateIndex < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int aggregateNodeCount = AggregateNodeCount;
			if (aggregateIndex >= aggregateNodeCount)
			{
				aggregateIndex -= aggregateNodeCount;
				return null;
			}
			TNode itemContainingAggregateIndexHelper = GetItemContainingAggregateIndexHelper(_root, ref aggregateIndex);
			TItem val = ((itemContainingAggregateIndexHelper != null) ? itemContainingAggregateIndexHelper._item : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				aggregateIndex = -1;
			}
			return val;
		}

		private TNode GetItemContainingAggregateIndexHelper(TNode n, ref int aggregateIndex)
		{
			int leftIndexCount = n.LeftIndexCount;
			if (aggregateIndex < leftIndexCount)
			{
				return GetItemContainingAggregateIndexHelper(n._left, ref aggregateIndex);
			}
			aggregateIndex -= leftIndexCount;
			if (aggregateIndex < n._itemIndexCount)
			{
				return n;
			}
			aggregateIndex -= n._itemIndexCount;
			if (n._right == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetItemContainingAggregateIndexHelper(n._right, ref aggregateIndex);
		}

		public TItem GetItemContainingOffset(ref int offset)
		{
			if (offset < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int aggregateOffsetCount = AggregateOffsetCount;
			if (offset >= aggregateOffsetCount)
			{
				offset -= aggregateOffsetCount;
				return null;
			}
			TNode itemContainingOffsetPosHelper = GetItemContainingOffsetPosHelper(_root, ref offset);
			TItem val = ((itemContainingOffsetPosHelper != null) ? itemContainingOffsetPosHelper._item : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				offset = -1;
			}
			return val;
		}

		private TNode GetItemContainingOffsetPosHelper(TNode n, ref int offset)
		{
			int leftOffsetCount = n.LeftOffsetCount;
			if (offset < leftOffsetCount)
			{
				return GetItemContainingOffsetPosHelper(n._left, ref offset);
			}
			offset -= leftOffsetCount;
			if (offset < n._itemOffsetCount)
			{
				return n;
			}
			offset -= n._itemOffsetCount;
			if (n._right == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetItemContainingOffsetPosHelper(n._right, ref offset);
		}
	}
	internal class NodeDataList : NodeListBase<NodeDataList.NodeEx, NodeData>, INodeCollectionInfo<NodeData>
	{
		internal new class NodeEx : NodeListBase<NodeEx, NodeData>.NodeEx
		{
			protected override int GetItemOffsetCount()
			{
				if (_item == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _item.AggregateOffsetCount;
			}

			protected override int GetItemTotalIndexCount()
			{
				if (_item == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _item.AggregateNodeCount;
			}
		}

		public int GetItemAggregateIndex(NodeData item)
		{
			int num = 0;
			using (IEnumerator<NodeData> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current == item)
					{
						return num;
					}
					num += item.AggregateNodeCount;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public int GetItemOffset(NodeData item)
		{
			int num = 0;
			using (IEnumerator<NodeData> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current == item)
					{
						return num;
					}
					num += item.AggregateOffsetCount;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	internal class NodeList : NodeListBase<NodeList.NodeEx, NodeBase>, INodeCollectionInfo<NodeBase>
	{
		internal new class NodeEx : NodeListBase<NodeEx, NodeBase>.NodeEx
		{
			internal NodeEx _parent;

			internal override NodeEx Parent
			{
				get
				{
					return _parent;
				}
				set
				{
					_parent = value;
				}
			}

			protected override int GetItemOffsetCount()
			{
				if (_item == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _item.AggregateOffsetCount;
			}

			protected override int GetItemTotalIndexCount()
			{
				if (_item == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _item.AggregateNodeCount;
			}
		}

		private readonly NodeCollection _owner;

		protected override bool NodeHasParentOverride => true;

		protected override bool NotifyChangesOverride
		{
			get
			{
				if (_owner != null)
				{
					return _owner.HasListeners;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override bool TrackNodesOnItemsOverride => true;

		internal NodeList(NodeCollection owner)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(owner);
			_owner = owner;
			RefreshNotifyChanges();
		}

		protected override NodeEx GetItemNode(NodeBase item)
		{
			return (NodeEx)item.ChildNodesToken;
		}

		protected override void OnItemAdded(NodeBase item)
		{
			_owner.OnItemAdded(item);
		}

		protected override void OnItemRemoved(NodeBase item)
		{
			_owner.OnItemRemoved(item);
		}

		protected override void SetItemNode(NodeBase item, NodeEx node)
		{
			item.ChildNodesToken = node;
		}

		protected override void NotifyCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs nccArgs)
		{
			NotifyCollectionChangedAction action = nccArgs.Action;
			if (NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace != action)
			{
				Notify("AggregateNodeCount");
			}
			Notify("AggregateOffsetCount");
			Notify(Utilities.g_nccActionNames[(int)action], nccArgs);
		}

		private NodeEx GetTreeNode(NodeBase item)
		{
			return item.ChildNodesToken as NodeEx;
		}

		internal void OnItem_AggregateOffsetCountChanged(NodeBase childNode)
		{
			NodeEx treeNode = GetTreeNode(childNode);
			if (treeNode != null && treeNode._item == childNode)
			{
				int itemOffsetCount = treeNode._itemOffsetCount;
				treeNode._itemOffsetCount = treeNode._item.AggregateOffsetCount;
				int num = treeNode._itemOffsetCount - itemOffsetCount;
				NodeEx nodeEx = treeNode;
				do
				{
					nodeEx._totalOffsetCount += num;
					nodeEx = nodeEx._parent;
				}
				while (nodeEx != null);
				Notify("AggregateOffsetCount");
			}
		}

		internal void OnItem_AggregateNodeCountChanged(NodeBase childNode)
		{
			NodeEx treeNode = GetTreeNode(childNode);
			if (treeNode != null && treeNode._item == childNode)
			{
				int itemIndexCount = treeNode._itemIndexCount;
				treeNode._itemIndexCount = treeNode._item.AggregateNodeCount;
				int num = treeNode._itemIndexCount - itemIndexCount;
				NodeEx nodeEx = treeNode;
				do
				{
					nodeEx._totalIndexCount += num;
					nodeEx = nodeEx._parent;
				}
				while (nodeEx != null);
				Notify("AggregateNodeCount");
			}
		}

		internal void OnHasListenersChanged()
		{
			RefreshNotifyChanges();
		}

		private void Notify(string propertyName, object extraInfo = null)
		{
			_owner.NotifyListeners(_owner, propertyName, extraInfo);
		}

		public int GetItemAggregateIndex(NodeBase item)
		{
			NodeEx treeNode = GetTreeNode(item);
			return GetItemAggregateIndexHelper(treeNode);
		}

		private int GetItemAggregateIndexHelper(NodeEx n)
		{
			if (n == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = n.LeftIndexCount;
			do
			{
				NodeEx parent = n._parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					if (n == parent._right)
					{
						num += parent.LeftIndexCount + parent._itemIndexCount;
					}
					else if (n != parent._left)
					{
						return -1;
					}
				}
				else if (_root != n)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				n = parent;
			}
			while (n != null);
			return num;
		}

		public int GetItemOffset(NodeBase item)
		{
			NodeEx treeNode = GetTreeNode(item);
			return GetItemOffsetHelper(treeNode);
		}

		private int GetItemOffsetHelper(NodeEx n)
		{
			if (n == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = n.LeftOffsetCount;
			do
			{
				NodeEx parent = n._parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					if (n == parent._right)
					{
						num += parent.LeftOffsetCount + parent._itemOffsetCount;
					}
					else if (n != parent._left)
					{
						return -1;
					}
				}
				else if (_root != n)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				n = parent;
			}
			while (n != null);
			return num;
		}
	}

	internal class ParagraphLineTreeList : TreeList<ParagraphLineTreeList.NodeEx, RichTextLine>
	{
		internal class NodeEx : Node
		{
			internal NodeEx _parent;

			internal Extent _itemHeight;

			internal Extent _totalHeight;

			internal Extent LeftHeight
			{
				get
				{
					if (_left == null)
					{
						return new Extent(0.0);
					}
					return _left._totalHeight;
				}
			}

			internal Extent RightHeight
			{
				get
				{
					if (_right == null)
					{
						return new Extent(0.0);
					}
					return _right._totalHeight;
				}
			}

			internal override NodeEx Parent
			{
				get
				{
					return _parent;
				}
				set
				{
					_parent = value;
				}
			}

			internal override void Aggregate_Insert(NodeEx n)
			{
				base.Aggregate_Insert(n);
				_totalHeight += n._totalHeight;
			}

			internal override void Aggregate_Remove(NodeEx n)
			{
				base.Aggregate_Remove(n);
				_totalHeight -= n._totalHeight;
			}

			internal override void InitializeAggregateInfo()
			{
				base.InitializeAggregateInfo();
				_itemHeight = ((_item != null) ? _item.OverallHeight : new Extent(0.0));
				_totalHeight = _itemHeight + LeftHeight + RightHeight;
			}
		}

		protected override bool NodeHasParentOverride => true;

		protected override bool TrackNodesOnItemsOverride => true;

		internal Extent Height
		{
			get
			{
				if (_root == null)
				{
					return new Extent(0.0);
				}
				return _root._totalHeight;
			}
		}

		protected override NodeEx GetItemNode(RichTextLine item)
		{
			return item._treeNode;
		}

		protected override void SetItemNode(RichTextLine item, NodeEx node)
		{
			item._treeNode = node;
		}

		internal static Extent GetOffsetY(RichTextLine lineInfo)
		{
			return GetOffsetYHelper(lineInfo._treeNode);
		}

		private static Extent GetOffsetYHelper(NodeEx n)
		{
			if (n == null)
			{
				return new Extent(0.0);
			}
			Extent leftHeight = n.LeftHeight;
			do
			{
				NodeEx parent = n._parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					if (n == parent._right)
					{
						leftHeight += parent.LeftHeight + parent._itemHeight;
					}
					else if (n != parent._left)
					{
						return new Extent(0.0);
					}
				}
				n = parent;
			}
			while (n != null);
			return leftHeight;
		}

		internal RichTextLine GetLineContainingOffsetY(Extent offsetY)
		{
			NodeEx nodeEx = _root;
			while (nodeEx != null)
			{
				Extent leftHeight = nodeEx.LeftHeight;
				if (leftHeight.Twips > 0.0)
				{
					if (offsetY < leftHeight)
					{
						nodeEx = nodeEx._left;
						continue;
					}
					offsetY -= leftHeight;
				}
				if (offsetY < nodeEx._itemHeight)
				{
					return nodeEx._item;
				}
				offsetY -= nodeEx._itemHeight;
				if (!(offsetY <= nodeEx.RightHeight))
				{
					break;
				}
				nodeEx = nodeEx._right;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public abstract class RichTextObjectCollectionBase<T> : RichTextObjectBase, IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable where T : RichTextObjectBase
	{
		internal new static class StorageProps
		{
			internal abstract class Info : RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info
			{
			}
		}

		private List<T> _list = new List<T>();

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _list[index];
			}
			set
			{
				VerifyIsMutable();
				T oldItem = _list[index];
				_list[index] = value;
				NotifyListeners(this, "Replace", new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, value, oldItem, index));
			}
		}

		public int Count => _list.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => base.IsSealed;

		public int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			return _list.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			_list.Insert(index, item);
			NotifyListeners(this, "Add", new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, item, index));
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			T changedItem = _list[index];
			_list.RemoveAt(index);
			NotifyListeners(this, "Remove", new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, changedItem, index));
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			Insert(Count, item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			_list.Clear();
			NotifyListeners(this, "Reset", new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return _list.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			CoreUtilities.CopyTo(this, array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _list.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public abstract class RichTextObjectKeyedCollectionBase<T> : RichTextObjectBase, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable where T : RichTextObjectBase
	{
		private RichTextObjectKeyedTreeList<T> _list;

		private DocumentRootNode _rootNode;

		private int _changingItemId;

		internal override bool ShouldCreateChangeChainContext => false;

		public T this[string id]
		{
			get
			{
				if (_list.TryGetValue(id, out var item))
				{
					return item;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public int Count => _list.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => base.IsSealed;

		internal DocumentRootNode Owner => _rootNode;

		public RichTextObjectKeyedCollectionBase()
		{
			_list = new RichTextObjectKeyedTreeList<T>(this, (T ii) => GetItemId(ii));
		}

		internal override void CopyFrom(RichTextObjectBase source)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(source);
			Clear();
			foreach (T item in (RichTextObjectKeyedCollectionBase<T>)source)
			{
				Add((T)item.Clone());
			}
		}

		internal override void OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (sender is T item)
			{
				RaiseItemNotification(GetItemId(item), sender, property, extraInfo);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
			}
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(item, "item");
			string itemId = GetItemId(item);
			ValidateId(itemId, checkForConflict: false, item);
			if (_list.TryGetValue(itemId, out var item2))
			{
				if (item2 == item)
				{
					return;
				}
				ValidateId(itemId, checkForConflict: true, item);
			}
			InitializeItemOwner(item, this);
			_list.InsertSorted(item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_list.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return _list.Contains(item);
		}

		public bool Contains(string id)
		{
			return _list.ContainsKey(id);
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_list.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _list.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public bool Remove(string listInfoId)
		{
			return _list.Remove(listInfoId);
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			return _list.Remove(item);
		}

		internal string CreateNewId()
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (Count > 0)
			{
				num = this.Select((T ii) => Utilities.TryParseInt(GetItemId(ii))).Max();
			}
			return Math.Max(1, 1 + num).ToString();
		}

		internal ChangeManagerBase GetChangeManager()
		{
			if (_rootNode != null)
			{
				RichTextDocument document = _rootNode.Document;
				if (document != null)
				{
					return GetChangeManager(document);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal abstract ChangeManagerBase GetChangeManager(RichTextDocument doc);

		internal abstract string GetItemId(T item);

		internal void Initialize(DocumentRootNode rootNode)
		{
			if (_rootNode != rootNode)
			{
				if (_rootNode != null && rootNode != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException($"A {GetType().Name} instance cannot be assigned to multiple DocumentRootNodes.");
				}
				_rootNode = rootNode;
				Utilities.PerformOnAll(this, ReinitializeItemRootNode);
			}
		}

		internal abstract void InitializeItemOwner(T item, RichTextObjectKeyedCollectionBase<T> owner);

		internal abstract void NotifyChangeManager_AddRemove(T item, bool add);

		internal void OnItemAdded(T item)
		{
			if (_changingItemId == 0)
			{
				item.AddListener(this, useWeakReference: false);
				RaiseItemNotification(GetItemId(item), this, "Add", null);
				NotifyChangeManager_AddRemove(item, add: true);
			}
		}

		internal void OnItemIdChanged(T item, string oldId)
		{
			_changingItemId++;
			try
			{
				_list.OnKeyChanged(item, oldId);
				RaiseItemNotification(oldId, this, "Remove", null);
				RaiseItemNotification(GetItemId(item), this, "Add", null);
			}
			finally
			{
				_changingItemId--;
			}
		}

		internal void OnItemIdChanging(T item, string proposedId)
		{
			ValidateId(proposedId, checkForConflict: true, item);
		}

		internal void OnItemRemoved(T item)
		{
			if (_changingItemId == 0)
			{
				item.RemoveListener(this);
				InitializeItemOwner(item, null);
				RaiseItemNotification(GetItemId(item), this, "Remove", null);
				NotifyChangeManager_AddRemove(item, add: false);
			}
		}

		internal abstract void RaiseItemNotification(string itemId, object sender, string property, object extraInfo);

		internal abstract void ReinitializeItemRootNode(T item);

		internal virtual void ValidateId(string id, bool checkForConflict, T item)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Id of the {typeof(T).Name} must be a non-empty string.", "Id");
			}
			if (checkForConflict && _list.TryGetValue(id, out var item2) && item2 != item)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"A {typeof(T).Name} with the id {id} already exists in the {GetType().Name}.", "Id");
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RichTextObjectKeyedTreeList<T> : SortedTreeList<string, T> where T : RichTextObjectBase
	{
		private readonly RichTextObjectKeyedCollectionBase<T> _owner;

		protected override bool NotifyChangesOverride => true;

		internal RichTextObjectKeyedTreeList(RichTextObjectKeyedCollectionBase<T> owner, Func<T, string> keyGetter)
			: base((IComparer<string>)StringComparer.InvariantCulture, keyGetter)
		{
			_owner = owner;
		}

		protected override void OnItemAdded(T item)
		{
			_owner.OnItemAdded(item);
		}

		protected override void OnItemRemoved(T item)
		{
			_owner.OnItemRemoved(item);
		}

		protected override void NotifyCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs nccArgs)
		{
		}
	}
	public class RichTextStyleCollection : RichTextObjectKeyedCollectionBase<RichTextStyleBase>
	{
		internal class DefaultStyleTracker<TStyle> where TStyle : RichTextStyleBase
		{
			internal static readonly Func<RichTextStyleCollection, TStyle> _defaultStyleGetter;

			internal static readonly Func<RichTextStyleCollection, DefaultStyleTracker<TStyle>> _defaultStyleTrackerGetter;

			private readonly RichTextStyleCollection _owner;

			internal TStyle _defaultStyle;

			private bool _isDefaultStyleDirty = true;

			static DefaultStyleTracker()
			{
				if (typeof(CharacterStyle) == typeof(TStyle))
				{
					_defaultStyleGetter = (RichTextStyleCollection styles) => styles._runDefaultStyle.GetDefaultStyle() as TStyle;
					_defaultStyleTrackerGetter = (RichTextStyleCollection styles) => styles._runDefaultStyle as DefaultStyleTracker<TStyle>;
				}
				else if (typeof(ParagraphStyle) == typeof(TStyle))
				{
					_defaultStyleGetter = (RichTextStyleCollection styles) => styles._paragraphDefaultStyle.GetDefaultStyle() as TStyle;
					_defaultStyleTrackerGetter = (RichTextStyleCollection styles) => styles._paragraphDefaultStyle as DefaultStyleTracker<TStyle>;
				}
				else if (typeof(TableStyle) == typeof(TStyle))
				{
					_defaultStyleGetter = (RichTextStyleCollection styles) => styles._tableDefaultStyle.GetDefaultStyle() as TStyle;
					_defaultStyleTrackerGetter = (RichTextStyleCollection styles) => styles._tableDefaultStyle as DefaultStyleTracker<TStyle>;
				}
				else
				{
					_defaultStyleGetter = (RichTextStyleCollection styles) => (TStyle)null;
				}
			}

			internal DefaultStyleTracker(RichTextStyleCollection owner)
			{
				_owner = owner;
			}

			internal TStyle GetDefaultStyle()
			{
				if (_isDefaultStyleDirty)
				{
					_defaultStyle = FindDefaultStyle();
					_isDefaultStyleDirty = false;
				}
				return _defaultStyle;
			}

			private TStyle FindDefaultStyle()
			{
				return _owner.OfType<TStyle>().FirstOrDefault((TStyle i) => i.IsDefault);
			}

			internal static void DirtyIsDefault(RichTextStyleBase changedStyle)
			{
				RichTextStyleCollection owner = changedStyle.Owner;
				if (owner != null)
				{
					DefaultStyleTracker<TStyle> defaultStyleTracker = _defaultStyleTrackerGetter(owner);
					if (defaultStyleTracker != null && !defaultStyleTracker._isDefaultStyleDirty)
					{
						defaultStyleTracker._isDefaultStyleDirty = true;
						defaultStyleTracker._defaultStyle = null;
						owner.Owner?._styleListeners.NotifyDefaultStyleManagers(owner, "DefaultStyle", null);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal new static class StorageProps
		{
			internal class Info : RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info
			{
				internal static readonly Info Instance = new Info();

				internal override RichTextObjectBase CreateNew()
				{
					return new RichTextStyleCollection();
				}

				internal override PropertyResolverBase CreateResolver(object target)
				{
					return null;
				}

				protected override void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> map)
				{
					base.Initialize(map);
					StoragePropsInfo.FillMap(new PropInfo[0], map);
				}
			}
		}

		internal readonly StyleListenersManager _styleListeners = new StyleListenersManager();

		internal readonly DefaultStyleTracker<CharacterStyle> _runDefaultStyle;

		internal readonly DefaultStyleTracker<ParagraphStyle> _paragraphDefaultStyle;

		internal readonly DefaultStyleTracker<TableStyle> _tableDefaultStyle;

		internal override RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info PropsInfo => StorageProps.Info.Instance;

		public new RichTextStyleBase this[string id]
		{
			get
			{
				return base[id];
			}
			set
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(value, "value");
				if (id != value.Id)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Id must match the id of the style being set.", "Id");
				}
				RichTextStyleBase richTextStyleBase = this[id];
				if (richTextStyleBase != null)
				{
					if (richTextStyleBase == value)
					{
						return;
					}
					Remove(richTextStyleBase);
				}
				Add(value);
			}
		}

		public RichTextStyleCollection()
		{
			_runDefaultStyle = new DefaultStyleTracker<CharacterStyle>(this);
			_paragraphDefaultStyle = new DefaultStyleTracker<ParagraphStyle>(this);
			_tableDefaultStyle = new DefaultStyleTracker<TableStyle>(this);
		}

		internal override ChangeManagerBase GetChangeManager(RichTextDocument doc)
		{
			return doc.StylesChangeManager;
		}

		internal override string GetItemId(RichTextStyleBase item)
		{
			return item.Id;
		}

		internal override void InitializeItemOwner(RichTextStyleBase item, RichTextObjectKeyedCollectionBase<RichTextStyleBase> owner)
		{
			item.InitializeOwner((RichTextStyleCollection)owner);
		}

		internal static void DirtyDefaultStyleHelper(RichTextStyleBase style)
		{
			if (style is ParagraphStyle)
			{
				DefaultStyleTracker<ParagraphStyle>.DirtyIsDefault(style as ParagraphStyle);
			}
			else if (style is CharacterStyle)
			{
				DefaultStyleTracker<CharacterStyle>.DirtyIsDefault(style as CharacterStyle);
			}
			else if (style is TableStyle)
			{
				DefaultStyleTracker<CharacterStyle>.DirtyIsDefault(style as TableStyle);
			}
			else
			{
				_ = style is ListStyle;
			}
		}

		internal override void NotifyChangeManager_AddRemove(RichTextStyleBase item, bool add)
		{
			if (item.IsDefault)
			{
				DirtyDefaultStyleHelper(item);
			}
			if (add)
			{
				KeyedCollectionChangeManager<RichTextStyleCollection, RichTextStyleBase>.OnItemAdded(this, item);
			}
			else
			{
				KeyedCollectionChangeManager<RichTextStyleCollection, RichTextStyleBase>.OnItemRemoved(this, item);
			}
		}

		internal override void RaiseItemNotification(string itemId, object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (_styleListeners != null)
			{
				_styleListeners.Notify(itemId, sender, property, extraInfo);
			}
			if (base.Owner != null)
			{
				base.Owner._styleListeners.Notify(itemId, sender, property, extraInfo);
			}
		}

		internal override void ReinitializeItemRootNode(RichTextStyleBase item)
		{
		}

		public new void Add(RichTextStyleBase style)
		{
			base.Add(style);
		}

		internal static void AddStyleListenerHelper(RichTextStyleCollection collection, string styleId, IPropertyChangeListener listener, bool useWeakReference = false)
		{
			collection?._styleListeners.AddListener(styleId, listener, useWeakReference);
		}

		internal static TStyle GetStyleHelper<TStyle>(NodeBase n, string styleId, bool returnDefaultIfIdNull = false) where TStyle : RichTextStyleBase
		{
			TStyle val = null;
			bool flag = string.IsNullOrEmpty(styleId);
			if (!flag || returnDefaultIfIdNull)
			{
				RichTextStyleCollection styleCollection = Utilities.GetStyleCollection(n);
				if (styleCollection != null)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						RichTextStyleBase richTextStyleBase = styleCollection[styleId];
						val = richTextStyleBase as TStyle;
						if (richTextStyleBase != null && val == null)
						{
							Utilities.OnError("{0} style expected to be of type {1}. It's of {2} type.", styleId, typeof(TStyle).Name, richTextStyleBase.GetType().Name);
						}
					}
					else if (returnDefaultIfIdNull)
					{
						val = DefaultStyleTracker<TStyle>._defaultStyleGetter(styleCollection);
					}
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal static TStyle GetStyleResolvedHelper<TStyle>(NodeBase n, string styleId, bool returnDefaultIfIdNull = false) where TStyle : RichTextStyleBase
		{
			TStyle styleHelper = GetStyleHelper<TStyle>(n, styleId, returnDefaultIfIdNull);
			if (styleHelper == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (TStyle)styleHelper.Resolved;
		}

		internal static void RemoveStyleListenerHelper(RichTextStyleCollection collection, string styleId, IPropertyChangeListener listener)
		{
			collection?._styleListeners.RemoveListener(styleId, listener);
		}
	}
