	public class TabStopCollection : RichTextObjectBase, ICollection<TabStop>, IEnumerable<TabStop>, IEnumerable, IListInternal
	{
		internal new static class StorageProps
		{
			internal class Info : RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info
			{
				internal static readonly Info Instance = new Info();

				internal override RichTextObjectBase CreateNew()
				{
					return new TabStopCollection();
				}

				internal override PropertyResolverBase CreateResolver(object target)
				{
					return null;
				}

				protected override void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> map)
				{
					base.Initialize(map);
					StoragePropsInfo.FillMap(new PropInfo[1] { CreateProp(0, "CollectionChange", (TabStopCollection i) => default(UndoCollectionChangeInfo<TabStop>), delegate(TabStopCollection i, UndoCollectionChangeInfo<TabStop> v)
					{
						i.ProcessCollectionChangeUndo(v);
						return true;
					}, default(UndoCollectionChangeInfo<TabStop>), CopyMethod.None) }, map);
				}

				internal override bool AreObjectsEqualOverride(RichTextObjectBase x, RichTextObjectBase y)
				{
					return Utilities.AreCollectionEqual(((TabStopCollection)x)._tabs, ((TabStopCollection)y)._tabs, (TabStop a, TabStop b) => a == b);
				}

				internal override int GetObjectHashCodeOverride(RichTextObjectBase o)
				{
					return Utilities.GetCollectionHashCode(((TabStopCollection)o)._tabs, (TabStop i) => i.GetHashCode());
				}
			}

			internal const int CollectionChange = 0;
		}

		private List<TabStop> _tabs;

		internal override RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info PropsInfo => StorageProps.Info.Instance;

		public int Count => _tabs.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => base.IsSealed;

		public TabStop this[int index] => _tabs[index];

		object IListInternal.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _tabs[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value is TabStop tabStop))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("value is not a tab stop");
				}
				AddTab(tabStop.Position, tabStop.Alignment);
			}
		}

		public TabStopCollection()
		{
			_tabs = new List<TabStop>();
		}

		internal override void CopyFrom(RichTextObjectBase source)
		{
			TabStopCollection tabStopCollection = source as TabStopCollection;
			_tabs.Clear();
			_tabs.AddRange(tabStopCollection._tabs.ToArray());
		}

		public void AddTab(Extent position, TabStopAlignment alignment = TabStopAlignment.Start, TabStopLeader leader = TabStopLeader.None)
		{
			ProcessAdd(new TabStop(position, alignment, leader));
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			if (_tabs.Count > 0)
			{
				TabStop[] oldTabStops = _tabs.ToArray();
				_tabs.Clear();
				OnReset(oldTabStops);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(TabStop item)
		{
			return _tabs.Contains(item);
		}

		public bool Contains(Extent position)
		{
			return IndexOfTabPosition(position) >= 0;
		}

		public void CopyTo(TabStop[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_tabs.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public int IndexOfTabPosition(Extent position)
		{
			int count = _tabs.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (_tabs[i].Position == position)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public bool RemoveTab(Extent position)
		{
			if (!TryGetTab(position, out var tabstop))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((ICollection<TabStop>)this).Remove(tabstop.Value);
		}

		public bool TryGetTab(Extent position, out TabStop? tabstop)
		{
			int num = IndexOfTabPosition(position);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				tabstop = _tabs[num];
				return true;
			}
			tabstop = null;
			return false;
		}

		private void OnReset(TabStop[] oldTabStops)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(0, new UndoCollectionChangeInfo<TabStop>(UndoCollectionChangeAction.Reset, oldTabStops));
		}

		private void ProcessAdd(TabStop stop)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			if (TryGetTab(stop.Position, out var tabstop))
			{
				TabStop value = stop;
				TabStop? tabStop = tabstop;
				if (value == tabStop)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			UndoCollectionChangeAction action;
			int index;
			if (tabstop.HasValue)
			{
				action = UndoCollectionChangeAction.Replace;
				index = _tabs.IndexOf(tabstop.Value);
				_tabs[index] = stop;
			}
			else
			{
				action = UndoCollectionChangeAction.Insert;
				index = 0;
				int count = _tabs.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count && !(_tabs[i].Position > stop.Position); i++)
				{
					index = i + 1;
				}
				_tabs.Insert(index, stop);
			}
			OnPropertyChanged(0, new UndoCollectionChangeInfo<TabStop>(action, index, tabstop.HasValue ? tabstop.Value : stop));
		}

		private void ProcessCollectionChangeUndo(UndoCollectionChangeInfo<TabStop> collectionChange)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			switch (collectionChange.Action)
			{
			case UndoCollectionChangeAction.Reset:
			{
				TabStop[] oldTabStops = _tabs.ToArray();
				SetTabStops(collectionChange.OldValues);
				OnReset(oldTabStops);
				break;
			}
			case UndoCollectionChangeAction.Insert:
				RemoveTab(collectionChange.OldValue.Position);
				break;
			case UndoCollectionChangeAction.Remove:
			case UndoCollectionChangeAction.Replace:
			{
				TabStop oldValue = collectionChange.OldValue;
				AddTab(oldValue.Position, oldValue.Alignment);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void SetTabStops(TabStop[] newStops)
		{
			_tabs.Clear();
			_tabs.AddRange(newStops);
		}

		public IEnumerator<TabStop> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<TabStop>)_tabs).GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable)_tabs).GetEnumerator();
		}

		void ICollection<TabStop>.Add(TabStop item)
		{
			ProcessAdd(item);
		}

		bool ICollection<TabStop>.Remove(TabStop item)
		{
			VerifyIsMutable();
			int num = _tabs.IndexOf(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			_tabs.ToArray();
			_tabs.RemoveAt(num);
			OnPropertyChanged(0, new UndoCollectionChangeInfo<TabStop>(UndoCollectionChangeAction.Remove, num, item));
			return true;
		}

		int IListInternal.IndexOf(object item)
		{
			if (item is TabStop)
			{
				return _tabs.IndexOf((TabStop)item);
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	internal class TreeList<TNode, TItem> : IList<TItem>, ICollection<TItem>, IEnumerable<TItem>, IEnumerable where TNode : TreeList<TNode, TItem>.Node, new() where TItem : class
	{
		private class Enumerable : IEnumerable<TItem>, IEnumerable
		{
			private TreeList<TNode, TItem> _tree;

			private TNode _startAtNode;

			internal Enumerable(TreeList<TNode, TItem> tree, TNode startAtNode = null)
			{
				_tree = tree;
				_startAtNode = startAtNode;
			}

			public IEnumerator<TItem> GetEnumerator()
			{
				Enumerator enumerator = new Enumerator(_tree);
				if (_startAtNode != null)
				{
					enumerator.Reset(_startAtNode);
				}
				return enumerator;
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		protected class Enumerator : IEnumerator<TItem>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private TreeList<TNode, TItem> _tree;

			private TNode _root;

			private Stack<TNode> _ancestors;

			private TNode _current;

			private int _version;

			public TItem Current => _current._item;

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			public Enumerator(TreeList<TNode, TItem> tree, TNode root = null)
			{
				_tree = tree;
				_root = root ?? tree._root;
				_ancestors = new Stack<TNode>();
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				Reset();
			}

			private TNode PushLeftNodesHelper(TNode n)
			{
				while (n._left != null)
				{
					_ancestors.Push(n);
					n = n._left;
				}
				return n;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (_current == null)
				{
					if (_root._totalCount == 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					_current = PushLeftNodesHelper(_root);
					_version = _tree._version;
				}
				else
				{
					if (_version != _tree._version)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Source collection was modified while traversing enumerator.");
					}
					TNode val = _current;
					if (val._right != null)
					{
						_current = PushLeftNodesHelper(val._right);
					}
					else if (_ancestors.Count > 0)
					{
						TNode val2 = _ancestors.Pop();
						while (val2 != null && val == val2._right)
						{
							val = val2;
							val2 = ((_ancestors.Count > 0) ? _ancestors.Pop() : null);
						}
						_current = val2;
					}
					else
					{
						_current = null;
					}
				}
				return _current != null;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_current = null;
				_ancestors.Clear();
			}

			internal void Reset(TNode n)
			{
				Reset();
				if (n != null)
				{
					n = _tree.GetPredecessor(n);
					if (n != null)
					{
						PushAncestorsHelper(n, includeN: false);
						_current = n;
						_version = _tree._version;
					}
				}
			}

			private void PushAncestorsHelper(TNode n, bool includeN)
			{
				TNode parent = n.Parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					PushAncestorsHelper(parent, n == parent._left);
				}
				if (includeN)
				{
					_ancestors.Push(n);
				}
			}
		}

		internal class Node
		{
			internal int _totalCount;

			internal TItem _item;

			internal TNode _left;

			internal TNode _right;

			internal bool _isDirty;

			internal int TotalCount => _totalCount;

			internal int LeftCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (_left == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return _left._totalCount;
				}
			}

			internal int RightCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (_right == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return _right._totalCount;
				}
			}

			internal virtual TNode Parent
			{
				get
				{
					return null;
				}
				set
				{
				}
			}

			internal virtual void InitializeAggregateInfo()
			{
				_totalCount = LeftCount + RightCount;
				if (_item != null)
				{
					_totalCount++;
				}
			}

			internal virtual void Aggregate_Insert(TNode n)
			{
				_totalCount++;
			}

			internal virtual void Aggregate_Remove(TNode n)
			{
				_totalCount--;
			}

			internal void MarkDirty()
			{
				_isDirty = true;
			}

			internal void SetItem(TItem item)
			{
				_item = item;
				MarkDirty();
				InitializeAggregateInfo();
			}
		}

		protected TNode _root;

		private int _version;

		private bool _nodeHasParent;

		private bool _notifyChanges;

		private bool _trackNodesOnItems;

		public int Count => _root._totalCount;

		public TItem this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return GetItem(index)._item;
			}
			set
			{
				TNode item = GetItem(index);
				TItem item2 = item._item;
				SetNodeItemHelper(item, value);
				if (_notifyChanges)
				{
					OnItemRemoved(item2);
					OnItemAdded(value);
					NotifyCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, value, item2, index));
				}
				BumpVersion();
			}
		}

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		protected virtual bool NodeHasParentOverride => false;

		protected virtual bool NotifyChangesOverride => false;

		protected virtual bool TrackNodesOnItemsOverride => false;

		public int Version => _version;

		public TreeList()
		{
			_nodeHasParent = NodeHasParentOverride;
			_notifyChanges = NotifyChangesOverride;
			_trackNodesOnItems = TrackNodesOnItemsOverride;
			_root = new TNode();
		}

		private void BalanceHelper(TNode parent, TNode n)
		{
			int num = CalcRotateDirection(n);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				RotateHelper(parent, n, num < 0);
			}
		}

		private void BumpVersion()
		{
			_version++;
		}

		internal int CalcDepth()
		{
			return CalcDepth(_root);
		}

		internal int CalcDepth(TNode n)
		{
			if (n != null)
			{
				return 1 + Math.Max(CalcDepth(n._left), CalcDepth(n._right));
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private int CalcRotateDirection(TNode n)
		{
			int leftCount = n.LeftCount;
			int rightCount = n.RightCount;
			if (rightCount > leftCount * 2 && rightCount > 2 && n._right != null)
			{
				int num = 1 + leftCount + n._right.LeftCount;
				int rightCount2 = n._right.RightCount;
				if (Math.Abs(num - rightCount2) < rightCount - leftCount)
				{
					return -1;
				}
			}
			if (leftCount > rightCount * 2 && leftCount > 2 && n._left != null)
			{
				int leftCount2 = n._left.LeftCount;
				int num2 = 1 + rightCount + n._left.RightCount;
				if (Math.Abs(leftCount2 - num2) < leftCount - rightCount)
				{
					return 1;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private TNode GetItem(int index)
		{
			ValidateIndex(index);
			return GetItemHelper(_root, index);
		}

		private TNode GetItemHelper(TNode n, int index)
		{
			int leftCount = n.LeftCount;
			if (index == leftCount)
			{
				return n;
			}
			if (index < leftCount)
			{
				return GetItemHelper(n._left, index);
			}
			return GetItemHelper(n._right, index - leftCount - 1);
		}

		private TNode GetMaximum(TNode n)
		{
			while (n._right != null)
			{
				n = n._right;
			}
			return n;
		}

		private TNode GetMinimum(TNode n)
		{
			while (n._left != null)
			{
				n = n._left;
			}
			return n;
		}

		private TNode GetPredecessor(TNode n)
		{
			if (n._left != null)
			{
				return GetMaximum(n._left);
			}
			if (_nodeHasParent)
			{
				TNode parent;
				while ((parent = n.Parent) != null)
				{
					if (n == parent._right)
					{
						return parent;
					}
					n = parent;
				}
				return null;
			}
			int num = IndexOf(n._item) - 1;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetItem(num);
		}

		private TNode GetSuccessor(TNode n)
		{
			if (n._right != null)
			{
				return GetMinimum(n._right);
			}
			if (_nodeHasParent)
			{
				TNode parent = n.Parent;
				if (parent == null || n != parent._left)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return parent;
			}
			int num = IndexOf(n._item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			num++;
			if (num >= Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetItem(num);
		}

		private int IndexOfHelper_UsingParent(TNode n)
		{
			int num = n.LeftCount;
			do
			{
				TNode parent = n.Parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					if (n == parent._right)
					{
						num += parent.LeftCount + 1;
					}
					else if (n != parent._left)
					{
						return -1;
					}
				}
				else if (_root != n)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				n = parent;
			}
			while (n != null);
			return num;
		}

		private int IndexOfHelper(TNode n, TItem item)
		{
			if (n._item == item)
			{
				return n.LeftCount;
			}
			if (n._left != null)
			{
				int num = IndexOfHelper(n._left, item);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			if (n._right != null)
			{
				int num2 = IndexOfHelper(n._right, item);
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					return num2 + n.LeftCount + 1;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void InsertHelper(int index, TItem item, bool calledFromInsertRange = false)
		{
			TNode root = _root;
			if (root._totalCount == 0)
			{
				SetNodeItemHelper(root, item);
			}
			else
			{
				TNode val = new TNode();
				SetNodeItemHelper(val, item);
				InsertHelper(root, index, val);
				BalanceHelper(null, root);
			}
			BumpVersion();
			if (_notifyChanges)
			{
				OnItemAdded(item);
				if (!calledFromInsertRange)
				{
					NotifyCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, item, index));
				}
			}
		}

		private void InsertHelper(TNode n, int i, TNode newItemNode)
		{
			int leftCount = n.LeftCount;
			if (i <= leftCount)
			{
				if (n._left == null)
				{
					n._left = newItemNode;
					if (_nodeHasParent)
					{
						newItemNode.Parent = n;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					InsertHelper(n._left, i, newItemNode);
					BalanceHelper(n, n._left);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				i -= leftCount;
				i--;
				if (n._right == null)
				{
					n._right = newItemNode;
					if (_nodeHasParent)
					{
						newItemNode.Parent = n;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					InsertHelper(n._right, i, newItemNode);
					BalanceHelper(n, n._right);
				}
			}
			n.Aggregate_Insert(newItemNode);
			n.MarkDirty();
		}

		private TNode RemoveHelper(TNode parent, TNode n, int i)
		{
			int leftCount = n.LeftCount;
			TNode val;
			if (i == leftCount)
			{
				if (n._left == null && n._right == null)
				{
					if (parent != null)
					{
						RemoveMin(parent, n);
						val = n;
					}
					else
					{
						val = new TNode
						{
							_item = n._item
						};
						SetNodeItemHelper(n, null);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					val = ((leftCount <= n.RightCount) ? RemoveMin(n, n._right) : RemoveMax(n, n._left));
					TItem item = n._item;
					SetNodeItemHelper(n, val._item);
					val._left = null;
					val._right = null;
					SetNodeItemHelper(val, item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				val = ((i < leftCount) ? RemoveHelper(n, n._left, i) : RemoveHelper(n, n._right, i - leftCount - 1));
				n.Aggregate_Remove(val);
				n.MarkDirty();
			}
			return val;
		}

		private TNode RemoveMax(TNode parent, TNode n)
		{
			if (n._right != null)
			{
				TNode val = RemoveMax(n, n._right);
				n.Aggregate_Remove(val);
				BalanceHelper(parent, n);
				return val;
			}
			if (parent != null)
			{
				TNode left = n._left;
				if (n == parent._right)
				{
					parent._right = left;
				}
				else if (n == parent._left)
				{
					parent._left = left;
				}
				if (left != null)
				{
					if (_nodeHasParent)
					{
						left.Parent = parent;
					}
					n._left = null;
					n.Aggregate_Remove(left);
				}
				return n;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private TNode RemoveMin(TNode parent, TNode n)
		{
			if (n._left != null)
			{
				TNode val = RemoveMin(n, n._left);
				n.Aggregate_Remove(val);
				BalanceHelper(parent, n);
				return val;
			}
			if (parent != null)
			{
				TNode right = n._right;
				if (n == parent._left)
				{
					parent._left = right;
				}
				else if (n == parent._right)
				{
					parent._right = right;
				}
				if (right != null)
				{
					if (_nodeHasParent)
					{
						right.Parent = parent;
					}
					n._right = null;
					n.Aggregate_Remove(right);
				}
				return n;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ReplaceChildNodeHelper(TNode parent, TNode childNode, TNode newChildNode)
		{
			if (childNode == parent._left)
			{
				parent._left = newChildNode;
			}
			else if (childNode == parent._right)
			{
				parent._right = newChildNode;
			}
		}

		private void RotateHelper(TNode parent, TNode n, bool left)
		{
			TNode val;
			if (left)
			{
				val = n._right;
				n._right = val._left;
				val._left = n;
				if (_nodeHasParent && n._right != null)
				{
					n._right.Parent = n;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				val = n._left;
				n._left = val._right;
				val._right = n;
				if (_nodeHasParent && n._left != null)
				{
					n._left.Parent = n;
				}
			}
			if (_nodeHasParent)
			{
				val.Parent = parent;
				n.Parent = val;
			}
			if (parent != null)
			{
				ReplaceChildNodeHelper(parent, n, val);
			}
			else
			{
				_root = val;
			}
			n.InitializeAggregateInfo();
			val.InitializeAggregateInfo();
		}

		private void SetNodeItemHelper(TNode n, TItem item)
		{
			n.SetItem(item);
			if (_trackNodesOnItems && item != null)
			{
				SetItemNode(item, n);
			}
		}

		private void ValidateIndex(int index, bool allowCount = false)
		{
			int count = Count;
			if ((index < 0 || index >= count) && (!allowCount || index != count))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
		}

		protected virtual TNode GetItemNode(TItem item)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemAdded(TItem item)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemRemoved(TItem item)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void NotifyCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs nccArgs)
		{
		}

		protected void RaiseNodesRequireParentsHelper()
		{
			if (!_nodeHasParent)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("This overload is only applicable when nodes have parents.");
			}
		}

		protected void RefreshNotifyChanges()
		{
			_notifyChanges = NotifyChangesOverride;
		}

		protected virtual void SetItemNode(TItem item, TNode node)
		{
		}

		internal IEnumerator<TItem> GetEnumeratorStartingAt(int index)
		{
			TNode item = GetItem(index);
			Enumerator enumerator = new Enumerator(this);
			enumerator.Reset(item);
			return enumerator;
		}

		internal IEnumerator<TItem> GetEnumeratorStartingAt(TItem item)
		{
			int index = IndexOf(item);
			return GetEnumeratorStartingAt(index);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<TItem> GetItems(TNode startAtNode)
		{
			return new Enumerable(this, startAtNode);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<TItem> GetItems(int startAtIndex)
		{
			TNode item = GetItem(startAtIndex);
			return GetItems(item);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<TItem> GetItems(TItem startAtItem)
		{
			int startAtIndex = IndexOf(startAtItem);
			return GetItems(startAtIndex);
		}

		internal void InvalidateAggregateInfo(TNode node)
		{
			RaiseNodesRequireParentsHelper();
			do
			{
				node.InitializeAggregateInfo();
				node = node.Parent;
			}
			while (node != null);
		}

		internal void InvalidateAggregateInfoOnAllNodes()
		{
			ReinitializeAggregateInfoOnAllNodes_Helper(_root);
		}

		private void ReinitializeAggregateInfoOnAllNodes_Helper(TNode n)
		{
			if (n._left != null)
			{
				ReinitializeAggregateInfoOnAllNodes_Helper(n._left);
			}
			if (n._right != null)
			{
				ReinitializeAggregateInfoOnAllNodes_Helper(n._right);
			}
			n.InitializeAggregateInfo();
		}

		public void Add(TItem item)
		{
			InsertHelper(Count, item);
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			TItem[] array = ((_notifyChanges && Count > 0) ? this.ToArray() : null);
			_root._left = null;
			_root._right = null;
			SetNodeItemHelper(_root, null);
			BumpVersion();
			if (!_notifyChanges)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (array != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					OnItemRemoved(array[i]);
				}
			}
			NotifyCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		public bool Contains(TItem item)
		{
			return IndexOf(item) >= 0;
		}

		public void CopyTo(TItem[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			using IEnumerator<TItem> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				TItem current = enumerator.Current;
				array[arrayIndex++] = current;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator<TItem> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new Enumerator(this);
		}

		public int IndexOf(TItem item)
		{
			if (_trackNodesOnItems && _nodeHasParent && item != null)
			{
				TNode itemNode = GetItemNode(item);
				if (itemNode == null || itemNode._item != item)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return IndexOfHelper_UsingParent(itemNode);
			}
			return IndexOfHelper(_root, item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, TItem item)
		{
			ValidateIndex(index, allowCount: true);
			InsertHelper(index, item);
		}

		public void InsertRange(int index, IEnumerable<TItem> items)
		{
			ValidateIndex(index, allowCount: true);
			int num = index;
			TItem val = null;
			IList list = null;
			foreach (TItem item in items)
			{
				InsertHelper(index++, item, calledFromInsertRange: true);
				if (val == null)
				{
					val = item;
					continue;
				}
				if (list == null)
				{
					list = new List<TItem>();
					list.Add(val);
				}
				list.Add(item);
			}
			if (_notifyChanges)
			{
				if (list != null)
				{
					NotifyCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, list, num));
				}
				else
				{
					NotifyCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, val, num));
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(TItem item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveAt_Impl(index, calledFromRemoveRange: false);
		}

		private void RemoveAt_Impl(int index, bool calledFromRemoveRange)
		{
			if (!calledFromRemoveRange)
			{
				ValidateIndex(index);
			}
			TNode val = RemoveHelper(null, _root, index);
			BumpVersion();
			if (_notifyChanges)
			{
				OnItemRemoved(val._item);
				if (!calledFromRemoveRange)
				{
					NotifyCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, val._item, index));
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveRange(int index, int count)
		{
			ValidateIndex(index);
			if (count > 0)
			{
				List<TItem> list = (_notifyChanges ? new List<TItem>(count) : null);
				ValidateIndex(index + count - 1);
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (_notifyChanges)
					{
						list.Add(this[index]);
					}
					RemoveAt_Impl(index, calledFromRemoveRange: true);
				}
				if (_notifyChanges)
				{
					NotifyCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, list, index));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(count, "count");
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	internal class TreeList<TItem> : TreeList<TreeList<TItem>.NodeEx, TItem> where TItem : class
	{
		internal class NodeEx : Node
		{
		}
	}
	internal class SortedTreeList<TKey, TItem> : TreeList<TItem> where TItem : class
	{
		private IComparer<TKey> _comparer;

		private Func<TItem, TKey> _keyGetter;

		public SortedTreeList(IComparer<TKey> comparer, Func<TItem, TKey> keyGetter)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(comparer);
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(keyGetter);
			_comparer = comparer;
			_keyGetter = keyGetter;
		}

		public bool ContainsKey(TKey key)
		{
			TItem item;
			return TryGetValue(key, out item);
		}

		public void InsertSorted(TItem item)
		{
			Node match;
			int index = Find(_keyGetter(item), out match);
			if (match != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Item already exists in the collection.");
			}
			Insert(index, item);
		}

		public bool Remove(TKey key)
		{
			Node match;
			int index = Find(key, out match);
			if (match != null)
			{
				RemoveAt(index);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void OnKeyChanged(TItem item, TKey oldKey)
		{
			if (Remove(oldKey))
			{
				InsertSorted(item);
			}
		}

		public bool TryGetValue(TKey key, out TItem item)
		{
			Find(key, out var match);
			if (match != null)
			{
				item = match._item;
				return true;
			}
			item = null;
			return false;
		}

		private int Find(TKey itemKey, out Node match)
		{
			match = null;
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return FindHelper(_root, itemKey, ref match);
		}

		private int FindHelper(Node n, TKey itemKey, ref Node match)
		{
			int num = _comparer.Compare(itemKey, _keyGetter(n._item));
			if (num < 0)
			{
				if (n._left == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return FindHelper(n._left, itemKey, ref match);
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return 1 + n.LeftCount + ((n._right != null) ? FindHelper(n._right, itemKey, ref match) : 0);
			}
			match = n;
			return n.LeftCount;
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ColorInfoConverter))]
	public sealed class ColorInfo
	{
		private enum ColorInfoState : byte
		{
			IsAutomatic = 1,
			IsRGB = 2,
			IsThemeColor = 4,
			IsTintValid = 8
		}

		private static readonly ColorInfo _automatic = new ColorInfo();

		private readonly System.Windows.Media.Color _color;

		private readonly ColorInfoState _state;

		private readonly ThemeColorType _themeColorType;

		private readonly double _tint;

		public static ColorInfo Automatic => _automatic;

		public System.Windows.Media.Color? Color
		{
			get
			{
				if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsAutomatic))
				{
					return Utilities.WindowTextColor;
				}
				if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsRGB))
				{
					return _color;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public bool IsAutomatic => TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsAutomatic);

		public ThemeColorType? ThemeColorType
		{
			get
			{
				if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsThemeColor))
				{
					return _themeColorType;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public double? Tint
		{
			get
			{
				if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsTintValid))
				{
					return _tint;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsResolved => _state == ColorInfoState.IsRGB;

		internal bool IsSystemColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsAutomatic)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private ColorInfo()
		{
			_state = ColorInfoState.IsAutomatic;
		}

		public ColorInfo(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
			: this(color, null, null, isLoading: false)
		{
		}

		public ColorInfo(System.Windows.Media.Color color, double tint)
			: this(color, null, tint, isLoading: false)
		{
		}

		public ColorInfo(ThemeColorType themeColorType)
			: this(null, themeColorType, null, isLoading: false)
		{
		}

		public ColorInfo(ThemeColorType themeColorType, double tint)
			: this(null, themeColorType, tint, isLoading: false)
		{
		}

		internal ColorInfo(System.Windows.Media.Color? color, ThemeColorType? themeColorType, double? tint, bool isLoading)
		{
			if (color.HasValue)
			{
				_state = ColorInfoState.IsRGB;
				_color = color.Value;
				ValidateColor(_color);
			}
			if (themeColorType.HasValue)
			{
				_state = ColorInfoState.IsThemeColor;
				ValidateThemeColor(themeColorType.Value);
				_themeColorType = themeColorType.Value;
			}
			if (tint.HasValue)
			{
				_state |= ColorInfoState.IsTintValid;
				_tint = tint.Value;
				ValidateTint(ref _tint, isLoading);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ColorInfo colorInfo = obj as ColorInfo;
			if (colorInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == colorInfo;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0 ^ _state.GetHashCode() ^ _color.GetHashCode() ^ _themeColorType.GetHashCode() ^ _tint.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (IsAutomatic)
			{
				return Utilities.GetString("ColorInfo_Description", Utilities.GetString("ColorInfo_Automatic_Description"));
			}
			string text;
			if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsRGB))
			{
				text = _color.ToString();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsThemeColor))
				{
					return base.ToString();
				}
				text = _themeColorType.ToString();
			}
			if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsTintValid))
			{
				return Utilities.GetString("ColorInfo_WithTint_Description", text, _tint);
			}
			return Utilities.GetString("ColorInfo_Description", text);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ColorInfo a, ColorInfo b)
		{
			if ((object)a == b)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((object)a == null || (object)b == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (a._state != b._state)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (a._themeColorType != b._themeColorType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (a._tint != b._tint)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return a._color == b._color;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ColorInfo a, ColorInfo b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public static implicit operator ColorInfo(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return new ColorInfo(color);
		}

		public static implicit operator ColorInfo(ThemeColorType themeColorType)
		{
			return new ColorInfo(themeColorType);
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color GetResolvedColor()
		{
			return GetResolvedColor((DocumentRootNode)null, AutomaticColorUsageType.Foreground);
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color GetResolvedColor(RichTextDocument document, AutomaticColorUsageType automaticColorUsageType)
		{
			DocumentRootNode documentRootNode = null;
			if (document != null)
			{
				documentRootNode = document.RootNode;
			}
			return GetResolvedColor(documentRootNode, automaticColorUsageType);
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color GetResolvedColor(DocumentRootNode documentRootNode, AutomaticColorUsageType automaticColorUsageType)
		{
			if (IsAutomatic)
			{
				return automaticColorUsageType switch
				{
					AutomaticColorUsageType.Background => Colors.Transparent, 
					_ => System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowTextColor, 
				};
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color color;
			if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsRGB))
			{
				color = _color;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsThemeColor))
				{
					return default(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				}
				if (documentRootNode == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("documentRootNode", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_DocOrRootNodeNull"));
				}
				ThemeColorDefinition colorDefinition = documentRootNode.ThemeInfoResolved.ColorScheme.GetColorDefinition(_themeColorType);
				if (colorDefinition == null)
				{
					return default(System.Windows.Media.Color);
				}
				color = colorDefinition.GetResolvedColor();
			}
			if (TestFlag(_state, ColorInfoState.IsTintValid))
			{
				return ColorUtilities.ApplyTint(color, _tint);
			}
			return color;
		}

		internal System.Windows.Media.Color GetResolvedColor(DocumentRootNode documentRootNode, AutomaticColorUsageType automaticColorUsageType, Shading? backgroundShading)
		{
			if (IsAutomatic && automaticColorUsageType == AutomaticColorUsageType.Foreground && backgroundShading.HasValue && AutomaticForegroundColorUtilities.ShouldUseLightColor(documentRootNode, backgroundShading.GetValueOrDefault()))
			{
				return Colors.White;
			}
			return GetResolvedColor(documentRootNode, automaticColorUsageType);
		}

		internal static ColorInfo FromWordShade(System.Windows.Media.Color color, ThemeColorType? themeColorType, byte wordShadeValue, bool isloading)
		{
			return new ColorInfo(color, themeColorType, TintFromWordShade(wordShadeValue), isloading);
		}

		internal static ColorInfo FromWordTint(System.Windows.Media.Color color, ThemeColorType? themeColorType, byte wordTintValue, bool isloading)
		{
			return new ColorInfo(color, themeColorType, TintFromWordTint(wordTintValue), isloading);
		}

		internal string Serialize(CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (IsAutomatic)
			{
				return "Automatic";
			}
			string text = "";
			if (Tint.HasValue)
			{
				text = "," + Tint.Value.ToString("R", culture ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
			if (ThemeColorType.HasValue)
			{
				return ThemeColorType.Value.ToString() + text;
			}
			return Color.Value.ToString() + text;
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string stringValue, CultureInfo culture, out ColorInfo result)
		{
			result = new ColorInfo();
			if (culture.CompareInfo.Compare(stringValue, "Automatic", CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				result = Automatic;
				return true;
			}
			int num = stringValue.IndexOf(',');
			string value;
			string text;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				value = stringValue;
				text = null;
			}
			else
			{
				value = stringValue.Substring(0, num);
				text = stringValue.Substring(num + 1);
			}
			double? num2 = null;
			if (text != null && double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Integer | NumberStyles.AllowTrailingSign | NumberStyles.AllowParentheses | NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint, culture ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out var result2))
			{
				num2 = result2;
			}
			if (Enum.TryParse<ThemeColorType>(value, ignoreCase: true, out var result3))
			{
				if (!num2.HasValue)
				{
					result = new ColorInfo(result3);
				}
				else
				{
					result = new ColorInfo(result3, num2.Value);
				}
				return true;
			}
			object obj = System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(value);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = (System.Windows.Media.Color)obj;
			if (!num2.HasValue)
			{
				result = new ColorInfo(color);
			}
			else
			{
				result = new ColorInfo(color, num2.Value);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static double TintFromWordShade(byte wordShadeValue)
		{
			return -1.0 - (double)(int)wordShadeValue / -255.0;
		}

		internal static double TintFromWordTint(byte wordTintValue)
		{
			return 1.0 - (double)(int)wordTintValue / 255.0;
		}

		private static bool TestFlag(ColorInfoState value, ColorInfoState flag)
		{
			return (value & flag) == flag;
		}

		private static void ValidateColor(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			if (color.A != byte.MaxValue)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CannotCreateNonOpaqueColorInfo"), "color");
			}
		}

		private static void ValidateThemeColor(ThemeColorType themeColor)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(themeColor, "themeColor");
		}

		private static void ValidateTint(ref double tint, bool isLoading)
		{
			if (tint < -1.0 || 1.0 < tint)
			{
				if (!isLoading)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("tint", Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_InvalidColorInfoTint"));
				}
				tint %= 2.0;
				if (tint < -1.0)
				{
					tint += 2.0;
				}
				else if (1.0 < tint)
				{
					tint -= 2.0;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class ColorInfoConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		internal const string AutomaticColorName = "Automatic";

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string stringValue && ColorInfo.TryParse(stringValue, culture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is ColorInfo && destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return ((ColorInfo)value).Serialize(culture);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	internal class DocumentOffsetChange
	{
		private DocumentOffsetChange _nextChange;

		private int _oldDocumentLength;

		private DocumentSpan _oldSpan;

		private DocumentSpan _newSpan;

		public DocumentSpan OldSpan => _oldSpan;

		public DocumentSpan NewSpan => _newSpan;

		public int LengthDelta => _newSpan.Length - _oldSpan.Length;

		public int OldLength => _oldDocumentLength;

		public int NewLength => _oldDocumentLength + LengthDelta;

		internal DocumentOffsetChange NextChange => _nextChange;

		internal DocumentOffsetChange(int oldDocumentLength, DocumentSpan oldSpan, DocumentSpan newSpan)
		{
			_oldDocumentLength = oldDocumentLength;
			_oldSpan = oldSpan;
			_newSpan = newSpan;
		}

		internal static DocumentOffsetChange CreateHelper(RichTextDocument doc, int startOffset, int oldOffsetCount, int newOffsetCount)
		{
			int num = newOffsetCount - oldOffsetCount;
			return new DocumentOffsetChange(doc.AggregateOffsetCount - num, new DocumentSpan(startOffset, oldOffsetCount), new DocumentSpan(startOffset, newOffsetCount));
		}

		internal void InitializeNextChange(DocumentOffsetChange nextChange)
		{
			if (_nextChange != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			_nextChange = nextChange;
		}
	}
	public struct DocumentSpan : IEquatable<DocumentSpan>, IComparable<DocumentSpan>
	{
		public static readonly DocumentSpan All = new DocumentSpan(0, int.MaxValue);

		internal static DocumentSpan Empty = default(DocumentSpan);

		internal static DocumentSpan Invalid = new DocumentSpan(int.MinValue, 0, allowNegativeOffset: true);

		private readonly int _offset;

		private readonly int _length;

		public int End
		{
			get
			{
				if (_length < 0)
				{
					return _offset;
				}
				return _offset + _length;
			}
		}

		public int Length => _length;

		public int Offset => _offset;

		public int Start
		{
			get
			{
				if (_length < 0)
				{
					return _offset + _length;
				}
				return _offset;
			}
		}

		public DocumentSpan(int offset, int length)
			: this(offset, length, allowNegativeOffset: false)
		{
		}

		internal DocumentSpan(int offset, int length, bool allowNegativeOffset)
		{
			if (!allowNegativeOffset)
			{
				if (offset < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset");
				}
				if (offset + length < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("length");
				}
			}
			_offset = offset;
			_length = length;
		}

		public bool Equals(DocumentSpan other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}

		int IComparable<DocumentSpan>.CompareTo(DocumentSpan other)
		{
			if (_offset < other._offset)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_offset > other._offset)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (_length < other._length)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_length > other._length)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _length.GetHashCode() ^ _offset.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DocumentSpan)
			{
				return this == (DocumentSpan)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator >(DocumentSpan span, DocumentSpan other)
		{
			return ((IComparable<DocumentSpan>)span).CompareTo(other) > 0;
		}

		public static bool operator <(DocumentSpan span, DocumentSpan other)
		{
			return ((IComparable<DocumentSpan>)span).CompareTo(other) < 0;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(DocumentSpan span1, DocumentSpan span2)
		{
			if (span1._offset == span2._offset)
			{
				return span1._length == span2._length;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DocumentSpan span1, DocumentSpan span2)
		{
			return !(span1 == span2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"DocumentSpan Offset = {Offset}; Length = {Length}; Start = {Start}, End = {End}";
		}

		public bool Contains(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			if (span.Start >= Start)
			{
				return span.End <= End;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(int offset)
		{
			if (offset >= Start)
			{
				return offset < End;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DocumentSpan? Intersection(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(_offset, span._offset);
			int num2 = Math.Min(End, span.End);
			if (num > num2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new DocumentSpan(num, num2 - num);
		}

		public bool IntersectsWith(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(_offset, span._offset);
			int num2 = Math.Min(End, span.End);
			return num <= num2;
		}

		public DocumentSpan OffsetBy(int delta)
		{
			return new DocumentSpan(_offset + delta, _length);
		}

		public DocumentSpan? Overlap(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(_offset, span._offset);
			int num2 = Math.Min(End, span.End);
			if (num >= num2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new DocumentSpan(num, num2 - num);
		}

		public bool OverlapsWith(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(_offset, span._offset);
			int num2 = Math.Min(End, span.End);
			return num < num2;
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(ExtentConverter))]
	[DebuggerDisplay("{Twips} twips, {LogicalPixels} pixels, {Points} pts, {Inches} inches, {Millimeters} millimeters")]
	public struct Extent : IEquatable<Extent>, IComparable<Extent>
	{
		internal class ExtentConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}

			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (value is string value2 && TryParse(value2, culture, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (value is Extent && destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return ((Extent)value).Serialize(culture);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		internal const double EmusPerTwip = 635.0;

		internal const double EmusPerInch = 914400.0;

		internal const double EmusPerCentimeter = 360000.0;

		internal const double EmusPerMillimeter = 36000.0;

		internal const double EmusPerPoint = 12700.0;

		internal const double EmusPerPixel = 9525.0;

		internal const string UnitsTwips = "twip";

		internal const string UnitsTwips2 = "twips";

		internal const string UnitsTwips3 = "tw";

		internal const string UnitsInches = "in";

		internal const string UnitsCentimeters = "cm";

		internal const string UnitsMillimeters = "mm";

		internal const string UnitsPoints = "pt";

		internal const string UnitsPoints2 = "pts";

		internal const string UnitsPicas = "pc";

		internal const string UnitsPixels = "px";

		internal const string UnitsEmus = "emu";

		internal const string UnitsEmus2 = "emus";

		private static double _LogicalToDevicePixelFactor;

		private static double _HalfLogicalToDevicePixelFactor;

		private static Extent _LayoutPaddingX;

		private static Extent _LayoutPaddingY;

		private long _extentInEmus;

		public double Centimeters => (double)_extentInEmus / 360000.0;

		public double Inches => (double)_extentInEmus / 914400.0;

		public double Emus => _extentInEmus;

		public double LogicalPixels => (double)_extentInEmus / 9525.0;

		public double Millimeters => (double)_extentInEmus / 36000.0;

		public double Points => (double)_extentInEmus / 12700.0;

		public double Twips => (double)_extentInEmus / 635.0;

		internal static double HalfLogicalToDevicePixelFactor => _HalfLogicalToDevicePixelFactor;

		internal double IntegralDevicePixels => RoundToIntegralDevicePixel(LogicalPixels);

		internal static Extent LayoutPaddingX => _LayoutPaddingX;

		internal static Extent LayoutPaddingY => _LayoutPaddingY;

		internal static double LogicalToDevicePixelFactor
		{
			get
			{
				return _LogicalToDevicePixelFactor;
			}
			set
			{
				lock (typeof(IEquatable<Extent>))
				{
					_LogicalToDevicePixelFactor = value;
					_HalfLogicalToDevicePixelFactor = value / 2.0;
					InitializeLayoutPadding();
				}
			}
		}

		static Extent()
		{
			_LogicalToDevicePixelFactor = 1.0;
			_HalfLogicalToDevicePixelFactor = 0.5;
			InitializeLayoutPadding();
		}

		private Extent(long extentInEmus)
		{
			_extentInEmus = extentInEmus;
		}

		public Extent(double value, ExtentUnitType unitType = ExtentUnitType.Twips)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotInfinity(value);
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNan(value);
			_extentInEmus = (long)Utilities.MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(unitType switch
			{
				ExtentUnitType.Centimeters => value * 360000.0, 
				ExtentUnitType.Emus => value, 
				ExtentUnitType.Inches => value * 914400.0, 
				ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels => value * 9525.0, 
				ExtentUnitType.Millimeters => value * 36000.0, 
				ExtentUnitType.Points => value * 12700.0, 
				ExtentUnitType.Twips => value * 635.0, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("unitType"), 
			});
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _extentInEmus.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is Extent)
			{
				return this == (Extent)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static Extent operator +(Extent extent1, Extent extent2)
		{
			return new Extent(extent1._extentInEmus + extent2._extentInEmus, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
		}

		public static Extent operator +(Extent extent)
		{
			return extent;
		}

		public static Extent operator -(Extent extent, Extent other)
		{
			return new Extent(extent._extentInEmus - other._extentInEmus, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
		}

		public static Extent operator -(Extent extent)
		{
			return new Extent(-extent._extentInEmus, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
		}

		public static bool operator >(Extent extent, Extent other)
		{
			return extent.CompareTo(other) > 0;
		}

		public static bool operator <(Extent extent, Extent other)
		{
			return extent.CompareTo(other) < 0;
		}

		public static bool operator <=(Extent extent, Extent other)
		{
			return extent.CompareTo(other) <= 0;
		}

		public static bool operator >=(Extent extent, Extent other)
		{
			return extent.CompareTo(other) >= 0;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(Extent extent1, Extent extent2)
		{
			return extent1._extentInEmus == extent2._extentInEmus;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(Extent extent1, Extent extent2)
		{
			return !(extent1 == extent2);
		}

		public static Extent operator *(Extent extent, double value)
		{
			return new Extent((double)extent._extentInEmus * value, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
		}

		public static Extent operator *(double value, Extent extent)
		{
			return new Extent(value * (double)extent._extentInEmus, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
		}

		public static Extent operator /(Extent extent, double value)
		{
			return new Extent((double)extent._extentInEmus / value, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
		}

		public static Extent operator /(double value, Extent extent)
		{
			return new Extent(value / (double)extent._extentInEmus, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{Twips} twips, {LogicalPixels} pixels";
		}

		public int CompareTo(Extent other)
		{
			return _extentInEmus.CompareTo(other._extentInEmus);
		}

		public static Extent Max(Extent value1, Extent value2)
		{
			return new Extent(Math.Max(value1._extentInEmus, value2._extentInEmus));
		}

		public static Extent Min(Extent value1, Extent value2)
		{
			return new Extent(Math.Min(value1._extentInEmus, value2._extentInEmus));
		}

		internal static Rect AlignRectToDevicePixelBoundaries(Rect rect, System.Windows.Point dpiOffset)
		{
			double num = RoundToIntegralDevicePixel(rect.X) + dpiOffset.X;
			double num2 = RoundToIntegralDevicePixel(rect.Y) + dpiOffset.Y;
			double num3 = num - rect.X;
			double num4 = num2 - rect.Y;
			return new Rect(num, num2, RoundToIntegralDevicePixel(rect.Width - 2.0 * num3), RoundToIntegralDevicePixel(rect.Height - 2.0 * num4));
		}

		internal static Rect? AlignRectToDevicePixelBoundaries(Rect? rect, System.Windows.Point dpiOffset)
		{
			if (!rect.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return AlignRectToDevicePixelBoundaries(rect.Value, dpiOffset);
		}

		internal static double CalculateDpiOffsetAdjustment(double value, bool alwaysRoundUp = false)
		{
			double num = value % _LogicalToDevicePixelFactor;
			if (CoreUtilities.AreClose(num, 0.0))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (CoreUtilities.AreClose(Math.Abs(num), _LogicalToDevicePixelFactor))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (!alwaysRoundUp)
			{
				if (Math.Abs(num) < _HalfLogicalToDevicePixelFactor)
				{
					return 0.0 - num;
				}
				return (double)Math.Sign(num) * _LogicalToDevicePixelFactor - num;
			}
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0 - num;
			}
			return _LogicalToDevicePixelFactor - num;
		}

		internal static Extent Max(Extent extent1, Extent? extent2)
		{
			if (!extent2.HasValue)
			{
				return extent1;
			}
			Extent? extent3 = extent2;
			if (extent1 > extent3)
			{
				return extent1;
			}
			return extent2.Value;
		}

		internal static Extent Min(Extent extent1, Extent? extent2)
		{
			if (extent2.HasValue)
			{
				Extent? extent3 = extent2;
				if (!(extent1 < extent3))
				{
					return extent2.Value;
				}
			}
			return extent1;
		}

		internal static Extent RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(Extent value, int? minValue = null)
		{
			return RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(value.LogicalPixels, minValue);
		}

		internal static Extent RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(double value, int? minValue = null)
		{
			return new Extent(RoundToIntegralDevicePixel(value, minValue), ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
		}

		internal static double RoundToIntegralDevicePixel(double value, int? minValue = null)
		{
			if (minValue.HasValue)
			{
				return RoundToIntegralDevicePixel(Math.Max(value, minValue.Value));
			}
			return RoundToIntegralDevicePixel(value);
		}

		internal static double RoundToIntegralDevicePixel(double value)
		{
			return value + CalculateDpiOffsetAdjustment(value);
		}

		internal string Serialize(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			return string.Format("{0}{1}", Points.ToString(formatProvider), "pt");
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string value, IFormatProvider formatProvider, out Extent result)
		{
			result = new Extent(0L);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = value.Trim();
			NumberStyles style = NumberStyles.AllowLeadingSign | NumberStyles.AllowTrailingSign | NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint | NumberStyles.AllowThousands;
			if (double.TryParse(value, style, formatProvider, out var result2))
			{
				result = new Extent(result2, ExtentUnitType.Points);
				return true;
			}
			value = value.ToLowerInvariant();
			double num = 1.0;
			string text = null;
			ExtentUnitType unitType = ExtentUnitType.Points;
			if (value.Contains("pts"))
			{
				text = "pts";
			}
			else if (value.Contains("pt"))
			{
				text = "pt";
			}
			else if (value.Contains("pc"))
			{
				text = "pc";
				num = 12.0;
			}
			else if (value.Contains("twips"))
			{
				text = "twips";
				unitType = ExtentUnitType.Twips;
			}
			else if (value.Contains("twip"))
			{
				text = "twip";
				unitType = ExtentUnitType.Twips;
			}
			else if (value.Contains("tw"))
			{
				text = "tw";
				unitType = ExtentUnitType.Twips;
			}
			else if (value.Contains("in"))
			{
				text = "in";
				unitType = ExtentUnitType.Inches;
			}
			else if (value.Contains("cm"))
			{
				text = "cm";
				unitType = ExtentUnitType.Centimeters;
			}
			else if (value.Contains("mm"))
			{
				text = "mm";
				unitType = ExtentUnitType.Millimeters;
			}
			else if (value.Contains("px"))
			{
				text = "px";
				unitType = ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels;
			}
			else if (value.Contains("emus"))
			{
				text = "emus";
				unitType = ExtentUnitType.Emus;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!value.Contains("emu"))
				{
					return false;
				}
				text = "emu";
				unitType = ExtentUnitType.Emus;
			}
			string[] array = value.Split(new string[1] { text }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (array.Length == 1 && double.TryParse(array[0], style, formatProvider, out result2))
			{
				result = new Extent(result2 * num, unitType);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void InitializeLayoutPadding()
		{
			_LayoutPaddingY = (_LayoutPaddingX = RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(new Extent(6.0, ExtentUnitType.Points)));
		}

		public bool Equals(Extent other)
		{
			return other == this;
		}

		int IComparable<Extent>.CompareTo(Extent other)
		{
			return ((IComparable)_extentInEmus).CompareTo((object)other._extentInEmus);
		}
	}

	internal class KeyedListenersManger
	{
		private Dictionary<string, object> _listeners = new Dictionary<string, object>();

		internal void AddListener(string key, IPropertyChangeListener listener, bool useWeakReference)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
			{
				_listeners.TryGetValue(key, out var value);
				_listeners[key] = ListenerListEx.Add(value, listener);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void NotifyAll(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			object[] array = _listeners.Values.ToArray();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				ListenerListEx.RaisePropertyChanged(array[i], this, property, extraInfo);
			}
		}

		internal void Notify(string key, object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (_listeners.TryGetValue(key, out var value) && value != null)
			{
				ListenerListEx.RaisePropertyChanged(value, this, property, extraInfo);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveListener(string key, IPropertyChangeListener listener)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) && _listeners.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				object obj = ListenerListEx.Remove(value, listener);
				if (obj == null)
				{
					_listeners.Remove(key);
				}
				else if (value != obj)
				{
					_listeners[key] = obj;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	}

		internal void AddDefaultStyleListener(IPropertyChangeListener listener, bool useWeakReference)
		{

		}

		internal void RemoveDefaultStyleListener(IPropertyChangeListener listener)
		{
			_defaultStyleListeners = ListenerListEx.Remove(_defaultStyleListeners, listener);
		}

		internal void NotifyDefaultStyleManagers(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (_defaultStyleListeners != null)
			{
				ListenerListEx.RaisePropertyChanged(_defaultStyleListeners, this, property, extraInfo);
			}
		}

	internal struct CaretLayoutInfo
	{
		private BlockLayoutNode _pNode;

		private RichTextLine _line;

		private int _documentOffset;

		private int _lineIndex;

		private int _lineContentIndex;

		private System.Windows.Point _overallTopLeftCaretPoint;

		private double _caretHeight;

		private double _contentHeight;

		private FontSpecification _font;

		private HighlightColor? _highlightColor;

		internal double CaretHeight => _caretHeight;

		internal double ContentHeight => _contentHeight;

		internal HighlightColor? HighlightColor => _highlightColor;

		internal int DocumentOffset => _documentOffset;

		internal FontSpecification Font => _font;

		internal IRichTextLine Line => _line;

		internal int LineIndex => _lineIndex;

		internal int LineContentIndex => _lineContentIndex;

		internal System.Windows.Point OverallTopLeftCaretPoint => _overallTopLeftCaretPoint;

		internal BlockLayoutNode LayoutNode => _pNode;

		internal CaretLayoutInfo(BlockLayoutNode pNode, int lineIndex, int lineContentIndex, int documentOffset, int documentOffsetRemaining, CharacterSettings settingsOverride, LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext context)
		{
			_pNode = pNode;
			_documentOffset = documentOffset;
			bool flag = false;
			if (lineIndex < 0 || _pNode.LineCount == 0)
			{
				_lineIndex = 0;
				_line = ((_pNode.LineCount > 0) ? (_pNode.GetLineAtIndex(0) as RichTextLine) : null);
				_lineContentIndex = 0;
			}
			else if (lineIndex >= _pNode.LineCount)
			{
				flag = true;
				_lineIndex = _pNode.LineCount - 1;
				_line = _pNode.GetLineAtIndex(_lineIndex) as RichTextLine;
				_lineContentIndex = _line._contentItems.Count - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				_lineIndex = lineIndex;
				_line = _pNode.GetLineAtIndex(lineIndex) as RichTextLine;
				_lineContentIndex = lineContentIndex;
			}
			RichTextLineContent? richTextLineContent = null;
			if (_line != null && (context == LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext.EndOfLine || context == LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext.StartOfLine))
			{
				if (_lineIndex > 0 && documentOffsetRemaining == 0 && _lineContentIndex <= _line.FirstNonListNumberIndex)
				{
					if (_lineContentIndex > 0)
					{
						documentOffset -= _line.GetDocumentOffsetCount(includeListNumber: true, includeNewLine: false, _lineContentIndex);
					}
					_lineIndex--;
					_line = _pNode.GetLineAtIndex(_lineIndex) as RichTextLine;
					_lineContentIndex = _line.FirstNonListNumberIndex;
					documentOffset -= _line.GetDocumentOffsetCount(includeListNumber: true, includeNewLine: false);
				}
				int num = _line.Count - 1;
				if (context == LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext.EndOfLine && _line != null && _line[num].IsNewLineOrParagraphMark)
				{
					num--;
				}
				if (num >= 0 && _line != null)
				{
					documentOffset -= documentOffsetRemaining + _line.GetDocumentOffsetCount(includeListNumber: false, includeNewLine: false, _lineContentIndex);
					if (context == LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext.EndOfLine)
					{
						richTextLineContent = _line[num];
						documentOffset += _line.GetDocumentOffsetCount(includeListNumber: false, includeNewLine: false) - richTextLineContent.Value.TrailingSpaces;
						_lineContentIndex = num;
						documentOffsetRemaining = richTextLineContent.Value.ContentOffsetCount;
					}
					else
					{
						_lineContentIndex = _line.FirstNonListNumberIndex;
						documentOffsetRemaining = 0;
					}
					_documentOffset = documentOffset;
				}
			}
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = null;
			RichTextDocument document = _pNode.Document;
			bool flag2 = context == LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext.EndOfSelection && documentOffsetRemaining > 0 && _line != null && _line[_lineContentIndex].IsNewLineOrParagraphMark;
			if (document != null)
			{
				int num2 = _documentOffset;
				if (flag2 && num2 > 0)
				{
					num2--;
				}
				characterSettings = document.GetCommonCharacterSettings(new DocumentSpan(num2, 0));
			}
			FontSpecification fontSpecification = null;
			RichTextLineContent? richTextLineContent2 = null;
			char sampleCharacterFromGroup = 'a';
			if (_line != null && _lineContentIndex >= 0 && _lineContentIndex < _line._contentItems.Count)
			{
				richTextLineContent2 = _line[_lineContentIndex];
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(richTextLineContent2.Value.TextForNavigation))
				{
					sampleCharacterFromGroup = richTextLineContent2.Value.TextForNavigation[0];
				}
				fontSpecification = FontSpecificationCache.Instance.GetFont(_pNode.Document, _pNode.LayoutManager.MetricsProvider, richTextLineContent2.Value.CharacterSettings, sampleCharacterFromGroup);
				if (characterSettings == null)
				{
					characterSettings = richTextLineContent2.Value.CharacterSettings;
				}
			}
			if (characterSettings == null)
			{
				characterSettings = (_pNode.DocumentNode as ParagraphNode).RunSettingsResolved;
			}
			if (settingsOverride != null)
			{
				CharacterSettings characterSettings2 = new CharacterSettings();
				RichTextObjectBase.PropertyResolver<CharacterSettings> propertyResolver = new RichTextObjectBase.PropertyResolver<CharacterSettings>(characterSettings2);
				propertyResolver.MergeProperties(settingsOverride);
				propertyResolver.MergeProperties(characterSettings);
				characterSettings = characterSettings2;
			}
			_font = FontSpecificationCache.Instance.GetFont(_pNode.Document, _pNode.LayoutManager.MetricsProvider, characterSettings, sampleCharacterFromGroup);
			double num3 = _pNode.ContentOverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
			double num4 = _pNode.ContentOverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
			_caretHeight = (_pNode.IsDropCap ? _font.DropCapHeight.LogicalPixels : _font.Height.LogicalPixels);
			if (_line != null)
			{
				num4 += _line.RelativeOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
				if (_lineContentIndex >= 0 && _line.Count > 0)
				{
					_contentHeight = _line[Math.Min(_lineContentIndex, _line.Count - 1)].Height.LogicalPixels;
				}
				else
				{
					_contentHeight = _caretHeight;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_contentHeight = _caretHeight;
			}
			if (richTextLineContent2.HasValue)
			{
				num3 += richTextLineContent2.Value.RelativeOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
				RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent3 = ((_lineContentIndex <= 0 || _line == null || _font == fontSpecification) ? richTextLineContent2.Value : _line[_lineContentIndex - 1]);
				if (richTextLineContent2.HasValue && settingsOverride != null && settingsOverride.VerticalAlignment.HasValue)
				{
					if (settingsOverride.VerticalAlignment.Value == RunVerticalAlignment.Subscript)
					{
						num4 += new Extent(_font.Height.LogicalPixels * 0.55, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels).LogicalPixels;
					}
				}
				else if (richTextLineContent3.RelativeOffsetY.Emus > 0.0)
				{
					num4 += richTextLineContent3.RelativeOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
				}
				if (richTextLineContent3.Group is OtherContentGroup)
				{
					num4 += richTextLineContent3.Height.LogicalPixels - _font.Height.LogicalPixels;
				}
			}
			if (richTextLineContent2.HasValue)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					if (!richTextLineContent2.Value.IsNewLineOrParagraphMark)
					{
						num3 += richTextLineContent2.Value.OverallWidth.LogicalPixels;
					}
				}
				else if (documentOffsetRemaining > 0)
				{
					string textForNavigation = richTextLineContent2.Value.TextForNavigation;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(textForNavigation))
					{
						if (textForNavigation.Length <= documentOffsetRemaining)
						{
							documentOffsetRemaining -= textForNavigation.Length;
							num3 += richTextLineContent2.Value.ContentWidth.LogicalPixels;
						}
						else
						{
							IRichTextMetricsProvider metricsProvider = _pNode.LayoutManager.MetricsProvider;
							num3 += metricsProvider.GetOffsetFromCharacterIndex(textForNavigation, _font, documentOffsetRemaining);
							documentOffsetRemaining = 0;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num3 += richTextLineContent2.Value.ContentWidth.LogicalPixels;
						documentOffsetRemaining -= richTextLineContent2.Value.ContentOffsetCount;
					}
				}
				if (documentOffsetRemaining > 0)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						num3 += _font.WidthOfSpace.LogicalPixels * (double)documentOffsetRemaining;
					}
					else if (richTextLineContent2.Value.TrailingSpaces > 0)
					{
						num3 += _font.WidthOfSpace.LogicalPixels * (double)Math.Min(richTextLineContent2.Value.TrailingSpaces, documentOffsetRemaining);
					}
				}
				if (richTextLineContent.HasValue)
				{
					num3 += richTextLineContent.Value.TrailingSpaceWidth.LogicalPixels;
					_documentOffset = documentOffset + richTextLineContent.Value.TrailingSpaces;
				}
			}
			TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode = ((_pNode is ParagraphLayoutNode) ? ((ParagraphLayoutNode)_pNode).ParentCell : null);
			if (tableCellLayoutNode != null && tableCellLayoutNode.IsContentClipped)
			{
				num3 = Math.Min(num3, tableCellLayoutNode.OverallRect.Value.Right);
			}
			_overallTopLeftCaretPoint = new System.Windows.Point(num3, Math.Max(num4, 0.0));
			_highlightColor = characterSettings.HighlightColor;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Caret info, OverallTopLeft: {_overallTopLeftCaretPoint}, DocOffset: {_documentOffset}, Height: {_caretHeight}";
		}

		internal override BlockLayoutNode AnchorNode

						return CalculateAggregatedHeight();
					}
					Extent? extent = textFrameHeight.Value.Extent;
					if (!extent.HasValue)
					{
						return CalculateAggregatedHeight();
					}

					{
					case ExtentRule.Exact:

					{
						Extent extent2 = CalculateAggregatedHeight();
						if (extent2 > extent.Value)
						{
							return extent2;
						}
						return extent.Value;
					}
					}
				}

			}
		}

		protected override Extent CalculateYOffset()

		internal static void FloatParagraphNode(ParagraphLayoutNode paraNode, TextFrameSettings frameSettings)
		{
			TextFrameSettings textFrameSettings = paraNode.GetSiblingParagraph(next: false)?.FrameSettings;
			if (textFrameSettings != null && RichTextObjectEqualityComparer<TextFrameSettings>.Instance.Equals(frameSettings, textFrameSettings))

				if (siblingParagraphLayoutInfo != null)

					siblingParagraphLayoutInfo.SlotNewParagraph(paraNode);
					return;
				}
			}
			TextFrameSettings textFrameSettings2 = paraNode.GetSiblingParagraph(next: true)?.FrameSettings;
			if (textFrameSettings2 != null && RichTextObjectEqualityComparer<TextFrameSettings>.Instance.Equals(frameSettings, textFrameSettings2))
			{
				FloatingParagraphGroupInfo siblingParagraphLayoutInfo2 = paraNode.GetSiblingParagraphLayoutInfo(next: true);

					paraNode.InitializeLayoutInfo(siblingParagraphLayoutInfo2);
					return;

		}

		internal static void OnParagraphNodeAdded(ParagraphLayoutNode paraNode)
		{

		}

		internal static void OnParagraphNodeDisposed(ParagraphLayoutNode paraNode)
		{

				UnfloatParagraphNode(paraNode, isBeingDisposed: true);

			FloatingParagraphGroupInfo siblingParagraphLayoutInfo2 = paraNode.GetSiblingParagraphLayoutInfo(next: true);
			if (siblingParagraphLayoutInfo != null && siblingParagraphLayoutInfo != siblingParagraphLayoutInfo2)
			{
				TextFrameSettings textFrameSettings = paraNode.GetSiblingParagraph(next: false)?.FrameSettings;
				TextFrameSettings y = paraNode.GetSiblingParagraph(next: true)?.FrameSettings;
				if (textFrameSettings != null && RichTextObjectEqualityComparer<TextFrameSettings>.Instance.Equals(textFrameSettings, y))

		}

		private static void UnfloatParagraphNode(ParagraphLayoutNode paraNode, bool isBeingDisposed)
		{
			if (!(paraNode.FloatingBlockInfo is FloatingParagraphGroupInfo { Paragraphs: var paragraphs } floatingParagraphGroupInfo))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = paragraphs.IndexOf(paraNode);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				int count = paragraphs.Count;
				floatingParagraphGroupInfo.RemoveParagraph(paraNode);
				if (num != 0 && num != count - 1 && !isBeingDisposed)
				{
					floatingParagraphGroupInfo.SplitAtParagraph(floatingParagraphGroupInfo.Paragraphs[num]);
					paraNode.InitializeLayoutInfo(null);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void VerifyParagraphNodeFloatingGroup(ParagraphLayoutNode paraNode, TextFrameSettings frameSettings)
		{
			FloatingParagraphGroupInfo floatingParagraphGroupInfo = paraNode.FloatingBlockInfo as FloatingParagraphGroupInfo;
			if (floatingParagraphGroupInfo != null)

				floatingParagraphGroupInfo._frameSettings = null;

			ParagraphLayoutNode siblingParagraph = paraNode.GetSiblingParagraph(next: false);
			TextFrameSettings y = siblingParagraph?.FrameSettings;
			FloatingParagraphGroupInfo floatingParagraphGroupInfo2 = ((siblingParagraph != null) ? (siblingParagraph.FloatingBlockInfo as FloatingParagraphGroupInfo) : null);
			ParagraphLayoutNode siblingParagraph2 = paraNode.GetSiblingParagraph(next: true);
			TextFrameSettings y2 = siblingParagraph2?.FrameSettings;
			FloatingParagraphGroupInfo floatingParagraphGroupInfo3 = ((siblingParagraph2 != null) ? (siblingParagraph2.FloatingBlockInfo as FloatingParagraphGroupInfo) : null);
			bool num = RichTextObjectEqualityComparer<TextFrameSettings>.Instance.Equals(frameSettings, y);
			bool flag = RichTextObjectEqualityComparer<TextFrameSettings>.Instance.Equals(frameSettings, y2);
			if (num)
			{
				if (floatingParagraphGroupInfo == floatingParagraphGroupInfo2)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (floatingParagraphGroupInfo2 != null)
				{
					floatingParagraphGroupInfo?.RemoveParagraph(paraNode);
					floatingParagraphGroupInfo2.SlotNewParagraph(paraNode);
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (!flag)
			{
				bool flag2 = floatingParagraphGroupInfo == null;
				if (floatingParagraphGroupInfo != null)
				{
					FloatingParagraphGroupInfo floatingParagraphGroupInfo4 = null;
					floatingParagraphGroupInfo4 = ((floatingParagraphGroupInfo != floatingParagraphGroupInfo2) ? ((floatingParagraphGroupInfo == floatingParagraphGroupInfo3) ? floatingParagraphGroupInfo3 : null) : floatingParagraphGroupInfo2);
					if (floatingParagraphGroupInfo4 != null)
					{
						floatingParagraphGroupInfo4.RemoveParagraph(paraNode);
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					Create(paraNode);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (flag && floatingParagraphGroupInfo != floatingParagraphGroupInfo3 && floatingParagraphGroupInfo3 != null)
			{
				floatingParagraphGroupInfo?.RemoveParagraph(paraNode);
				floatingParagraphGroupInfo3.Paragraphs.Insert(0, paraNode);

		private void AppendFloatingInfo(FloatingParagraphGroupInfo infoToAppend)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = infoToAppend._paraNodes.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphLayoutNode = infoToAppend._paraNodes[i];
				_paraNodes.Add(paragraphLayoutNode);
				paragraphLayoutNode.InitializeLayoutInfo(this);
			}
			infoToAppend.RemoveFromLayoutManagerCache();
		}

		private Extent CalculateAggregatedHeight()
		{
			Extent result = default(Extent);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _paraNodes.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphLayoutNode = _paraNodes[i];
				result += paragraphLayoutNode.Height;
				if (i == count - 1)
				{
					RichTextLine lastLine = paragraphLayoutNode.LastLine;
					if (lastLine != null)
					{
						result -= lastLine.OverallHeight - lastLine.ContentHeight;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void RemoveParagraph(ParagraphLayoutNode paraNode)
		{
			int num = _paraNodes.IndexOf(paraNode);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				_paraNodes.RemoveAt(num);
				if (paraNode.FloatingBlockInfo == this)
				{
					paraNode.InitializeLayoutInfo(null);
				}
				if (_paraNodes.Count < 1)
				{
					RemoveFromLayoutManagerCache();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SlotNewParagraph(ParagraphLayoutNode paraNode)
		{
			LayoutNodeBase parentLayoutNode = paraNode.ParentLayoutNode;
			if (parentLayoutNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = parentLayoutNode.ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = childNodes.IndexOf(paraNode);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num2 = _paraNodes.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				int num3 = childNodes.IndexOf(_paraNodes[num2]);
				if (num3 >= 0 && num > num3)
				{
					_paraNodes.Insert(num2 + 1, paraNode);
					paraNode.InitializeLayoutInfo(this);
					return;
				}
			}
			_paraNodes.Insert(0, paraNode);
			paraNode.InitializeLayoutInfo(this);
		}

		private void SplitAtParagraph(ParagraphLayoutNode paraNode)
		{
			int num = _paraNodes.IndexOf(paraNode);
			if (num >= 1 && num < _paraNodes.Count)
			{
				FloatingParagraphGroupInfo floatingParagraphGroupInfo = new FloatingParagraphGroupInfo(base.LayoutManager);
				while (num < _paraNodes.Count)
				{
					ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphLayoutNode = _paraNodes[num];
					floatingParagraphGroupInfo.Paragraphs.Add(paragraphLayoutNode);
					_paraNodes.RemoveAt(num);
					paragraphLayoutNode.InitializeLayoutInfo(floatingParagraphGroupInfo);
				}
				floatingParagraphGroupInfo.AddToLayoutManagerCache();
			}
		}

		IEnumerable<ILayoutBlock> ILayoutBlock.GetChildBlocksInViewPort(Rect viewport)
		{
			if (_paraNodes.Count <= 0)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (ParagraphLayoutNode paraNode in _paraNodes)
			{
				double logicalPixels = paraNode.OverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
				double logicalPixels2 = paraNode.OverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
				if (logicalPixels > viewport.Right || logicalPixels2 > viewport.Bottom)
				{
					break;
				}
				double logicalPixels3 = paraNode.Height.LogicalPixels;
				double logicalPixels4 = paraNode.Width.LogicalPixels;
				if (!(logicalPixels + logicalPixels4 < viewport.Left) && !(logicalPixels2 + logicalPixels3 < viewport.Top))
				{
					yield return paraNode;
				}
			}
		}

	internal class FloatingTableInfo : FloatingBlockInfoBase
	{
		private TableLayoutNode _tableLayoutNode;

		internal override BlockLayoutNode AnchorNode => _tableLayoutNode.GetSiblingBlock(next: true, nonFloatingOnly: true);

		internal override ILayoutBlock Block => _tableLayoutNode;

		internal override FrameSettingsBase FrameSettings => _tableLayoutNode.FloatingSettings;

		public override Extent Height => _tableLayoutNode.Height;

		internal override LayoutPlane Plane => LayoutPlane.Foreground;

		public override Rect? OverallRect
		{
			get
			{
				Rect? contentRect = ContentRect;
				if (!contentRect.HasValue)
				{
					return null;
				}
				FloatingTableSettings floatingTableSettings = FrameSettings as FloatingTableSettings;
				Extent? extent = floatingTableSettings?.BottomFromText;
				Extent? extent2 = floatingTableSettings?.LeftFromText;
				Extent? extent3 = floatingTableSettings?.RightFromText;
				Extent? extent4 = floatingTableSettings?.TopFromText;
				if (!extent.HasValue && !extent2.HasValue && !extent3.HasValue && !extent4.HasValue)
				{
					return contentRect;
				}
				double num = (extent.HasValue ? extent.Value.LogicalPixels : 0.0);
				double num2 = (extent2.HasValue ? extent2.Value.LogicalPixels : 0.0);
				double num3 = (extent3.HasValue ? extent3.Value.LogicalPixels : 0.0);
				double num4 = (extent4.HasValue ? extent4.Value.LogicalPixels : 0.0);
				return new Rect(contentRect.Value.X - num2, contentRect.Value.Y - num4, contentRect.Value.Width + num2 + num3, contentRect.Value.Height + num4 + num);
			}
		}

		public override Extent Width => _tableLayoutNode.Width;

		public override TextFrameWrap Wrap
		{
			get
			{
				TextFrameVerticalAlignment? textFrameVerticalAlignment = FrameSettings?.VerticalAlignment;
				if (!textFrameVerticalAlignment.HasValue)
				{
					return TextFrameWrap.None;
				}
				return textFrameVerticalAlignment.Value switch
				{
					TextFrameVerticalAlignment.Inline => TextFrameWrap.None, 
					_ => TextFrameWrap.Around, 
				};
			}
		}

		}

		}
