			return visitor.VisitImageLayoutNode(this, argument);
		}

		protected override void OnDisposed()
		{
			if (_imageNode != null && !_imageNode.IsSealed)
			{
				PropertyChangeListenerList.ManageListenerHelper(ref _imageNode, null, this, useWeakReference: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
			if (!_isSizeInfoDirty)
			{
				_isSizeInfoDirty = true;
				Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action<bool, bool>(ValidateSize), false, false);
				if (property == "ImageResolved")
				{
					ErrorText = ((_imageNode.Error != null) ? _imageNode.Error.Message : null);
					RaisePropertyChanged("ImageSource");
				}
			}
		}

		private void CacheNewLoader(BitmapImageLoader imageLoader)
		{
			switch (imageLoader.Status)
			{
			case BitmapImageLoadStatus.LoadFailed:
				ProcessImageLoadFailure(imageLoader);
				break;
			case BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loading:
				imageLoader.PlaceholderImageLoader = LoadingImage;
				if (LoadingImage.Status == BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loading)
				{
					LoadingImage.PropertyChanged += OnBitmapLoaderPropertyChanged;
				}
				WireImageIfLoading(imageLoader);
				break;
			case BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded:
				imageLoader.PlaceholderImageLoader = null;
				break;
			}
			RichTextImage imageResolved = _imageNode.ImageResolved;
			if (imageResolved != null)
			{
				CachedImages[imageResolved] = imageLoader;
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_imageNode.ImageUri))
			{
				CachedImagesFromUri[_imageNode.ImageUri] = imageLoader;
			}
		}

		private BitmapImageLoader GetCachedImageLoader()
		{
			BitmapImageLoader value = null;
			if (_imageNode != null)
			{
				RichTextImage imageResolved = _imageNode.ImageResolved;
				if (imageResolved != null)
				{
					lock (_SyncRoot)
					{
						CachedImages.TryGetValue(imageResolved, out value);
					}
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_imageNode.ImageUri))
				{
					lock (_SyncRoot)
					{
						CachedImagesFromUri.TryGetValue(_imageNode.ImageUri, out value);
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private BitmapImageLoader GetDefaultImageLoader()
		{
			switch (_imageNode.ImageStatus)
			{
			case RichTextImageStatus.DecodeFailed:
			case RichTextImageStatus.DownloadCanceled:
			case RichTextImageStatus.DownloadFailed:
			case RichTextImageStatus.DownloadTimedOut:
			case RichTextImageStatus.UnknownImageFormat:
				return LoadingErrorImage;
			default:
				return LoadingImage;
			}
		}

		private static BitmapImageLoader LoadImageResource(string resourcePath)
		{
			return new BitmapImageLoader(Utilities.GetImageUri(resourcePath));
		}

		private void OnBitmapLoaderPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.PropertyName == "Status"))
			{
				return;
			}
			BitmapImageLoader bitmapImageLoader = sender as BitmapImageLoader;
			bitmapImageLoader.PropertyChanged -= OnBitmapLoaderPropertyChanged;
			bool flag = bitmapImageLoader == LoadingErrorImage || bitmapImageLoader == LoadingImage;
			if (!flag)
			{
				_isImageLoadWired = false;
			}
			switch (bitmapImageLoader.Status)
			{
			case BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded:
				if (!flag)
				{
					bitmapImageLoader.PlaceholderImageLoader = null;
				}
				RaisePropertyChanged("ImageSource");
				break;
			case BitmapImageLoadStatus.LoadFailed:
				if (!flag)
				{
					ProcessImageLoadFailure(bitmapImageLoader);
				}
				RaisePropertyChanged("ImageSource");
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessImageLoadFailure(BitmapImageLoader imageLoader)
		{
			imageLoader.PlaceholderImageLoader = LoadingErrorImage;
			if (LoadingErrorImage.Status == BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loading)
			{
				LoadingErrorImage.PropertyChanged += OnBitmapLoaderPropertyChanged;
			}
			if (Debugger.IsAttached && Debugger.IsLogging())
			{
				Utilities.LogDebuggerError($"ImageLoadFailed - exception: {imageLoader.Exception}");
			}
			if (imageLoader.Exception != null)
			{
				ErrorText = imageLoader.Exception.Message;
				if (_imageNode != null && imageLoader != LoadingImage && imageLoader != LoadingErrorImage)
				{
					_imageNode.OnImageDecodeFailed(imageLoader.Exception);
				}
				imageLoader.ClearException();
			}
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propName)
		{
			if (_handler != null)
			{
				_handler(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propName));
			}
		}

		private void ValidateSize(bool calledFromCtor = false, bool calledFromImageSourceGet = false)
		{
			if (_imageNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double imageCropAreaHeight = ImageCropAreaHeight;
			double imageCropAreaWidth = ImageCropAreaWidth;
			double imageOuterAreaHeight = ImageOuterAreaHeight;
			double imageOuterAreaWidth = ImageOuterAreaWidth;
			Transform imageCropAreaRenderTransform = ImageCropAreaRenderTransform;
			double imageHeight = ImageHeight;
			double imageWidth = ImageWidth;
			Transform renderTransform = RenderTransform;
			_isSizeInfoDirty = false;
			_imageHeight = 0.0;
			_imageWidth = 0.0;
			RichTextSize? renderSizeResolved = _imageNode.GetRenderSizeResolved();
			RichTextMargin? renderEffectsMargin = _imageNode.RenderEffectsMargin;
			BitmapImageLoader bitmapImageLoader = GetCachedImageLoader();
			bool flag = bitmapImageLoader != null && bitmapImageLoader.Status == BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loaded;
			if (bitmapImageLoader == null)
			{
				bitmapImageLoader = GetDefaultImageLoader();
			}
			WireImageIfLoading(bitmapImageLoader);
			BitmapImage imageToDisplay = bitmapImageLoader.ImageToDisplay;
			_imageHeight = (_imageCropAreaHeight = imageToDisplay?.Height ?? 29.0);
			_imageWidth = (_imageCropAreaWidth = imageToDisplay?.Width ?? 35.0);
			Extent extent;
			Extent extent2;
			if (renderSizeResolved.HasValue)
			{
				extent = renderSizeResolved.Value.Width;
				extent2 = renderSizeResolved.Value.Height;
				_imageCropAreaHeight = extent2.LogicalPixels;
				_imageCropAreaWidth = extent.LogicalPixels;
				if (!flag)
				{
					System.Windows.Size imageCropAreaSize = Utilities.CreateImageLayoutInfo(new System.Windows.Size(100.0, 100.0), _imageNode.Cropping, _imageNode.Transform, calculateSizeOnly: false)._imageCropAreaSize;
					_imageHeight = _imageCropAreaHeight * 100.0 / Math.Max(imageCropAreaSize.Height, 1.0);
					_imageWidth = _imageCropAreaWidth * 100.0 / Math.Max(imageCropAreaSize.Width, 1.0);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				extent = new Extent(_imageWidth, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
				extent2 = new Extent(_imageHeight, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (renderEffectsMargin.HasValue)
			{
				num = renderEffectsMargin.Value.Left.LogicalPixels;
				num2 = renderEffectsMargin.Value.Right.LogicalPixels;
				num3 = renderEffectsMargin.Value.Top.LogicalPixels;
				num4 = renderEffectsMargin.Value.Bottom.LogicalPixels;
			}
			_imageCropAreaHeight = extent2.LogicalPixels + (num + num2);
			_imageCropAreaWidth = extent.LogicalPixels + (num3 + num4);
			_ = _height;
			_ = _width;
			_imageOuterAreaHeight = _imageCropAreaHeight;
			_imageOuterAreaWidth = _imageCropAreaWidth;
			_height = new Extent(_imageOuterAreaHeight, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			_width = new Extent(_imageOuterAreaWidth, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			if (calledFromCtor)
			{
				_imageNode.ValidatedRenderSize = null;
				return;
			}
			_imageCropAreaRenderTransform = null;
			_renderTransform = null;
			if (flag)
			{
				RichTextImageTransform richTextImageTransform = _imageNode.Transform;
				if (renderSizeResolved.HasValue && (richTextImageTransform == null || !richTextImageTransform.StretchSize.HasValue))
				{
					richTextImageTransform = ((richTextImageTransform == null) ? new RichTextImageTransform() : ((RichTextImageTransform)richTextImageTransform.Clone()));
					richTextImageTransform.StretchSize = renderSizeResolved;
				}
				ImageLayoutInfo imageLayoutInfo = Utilities.CreateImageLayoutInfo(new System.Windows.Size(_imageWidth, _imageHeight), _imageNode.Cropping, richTextImageTransform, calculateSizeOnly: false);
				_imageCropAreaHeight = imageLayoutInfo._imageCropAreaSize.Height;
				_imageCropAreaWidth = imageLayoutInfo._imageCropAreaSize.Width;
				_imageOuterAreaHeight = imageLayoutInfo._imageOuterAreaSize.Height;
				_imageOuterAreaWidth = imageLayoutInfo._imageOuterAreaSize.Width;
				_height = new Extent(_imageOuterAreaHeight, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
				_width = new Extent(_imageOuterAreaWidth, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
				double num5 = _imageOuterAreaHeight - imageLayoutInfo._stretchSizeResolved.Height;
				double num6 = _imageOuterAreaWidth - imageLayoutInfo._stretchSizeResolved.Width;
				double num7 = num6 / 2.0;
				double num8 = num5 / 2.0;
				double num9 = num6 / 2.0;
				double num10 = num5 / 2.0;
				if (!renderEffectsMargin.HasValue)
				{
					num = num7;
					num3 = num8;
					num2 = num9;
					num4 = num10;
				}
				if (num3 != num8 || num != num7)
				{
					if (imageLayoutInfo._imageCropAreaTransform == null)
					{
						imageLayoutInfo._imageCropAreaTransform = new TransformGroup();
					}
					imageLayoutInfo._imageCropAreaTransform.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
					{
						X = num - num7,
						Y = num3 - num8
					});
				}
				if (num3 != num8 || num4 != num10)
				{
					_height = new Extent(_height.LogicalPixels + (num3 - num8) + (num4 - num10), ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
				}
				if (num != num7 || num2 != num9)
				{
					_width = new Extent(_width.LogicalPixels + (num - num7) + (num2 - num9), ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
				}
				_renderTransform = imageLayoutInfo._imageTransform;
				_imageCropAreaRenderTransform = imageLayoutInfo._imageCropAreaTransform;
				_imageNode.ValidatedRenderSize = new RichTextSize(imageLayoutInfo._imageCropAreaSize);
			}
			else
			{
				_imageNode.ValidatedRenderSize = null;
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (calledFromImageSourceGet)
			{
				if (ImageOuterAreaHeight != imageOuterAreaHeight)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					RaisePropertyChanged("ImageOuterAreaHeight");
				}
				if (ImageOuterAreaWidth != imageOuterAreaWidth)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					RaisePropertyChanged("ImageOuterAreaWidth");
				}
				if (ImageCropAreaHeight != imageCropAreaHeight)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					RaisePropertyChanged("ImageCropAreaHeight");
				}
				if (ImageCropAreaWidth != imageCropAreaWidth)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					RaisePropertyChanged("ImageCropAreaWidth");
				}
				if (!Utilities.AreEquivalent(ImageCropAreaRenderTransform, imageCropAreaRenderTransform))
				{
					flag2 = true;
					RaisePropertyChanged("ImageCropAreaRenderTransform");
				}
				if (ImageHeight != imageHeight)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					RaisePropertyChanged("ImageHeight");
				}
				if (ImageWidth != imageWidth)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					RaisePropertyChanged("ImageWidth");
				}
				if (!Utilities.AreEquivalent(RenderTransform, renderTransform))
				{
					flag2 = true;
					RaisePropertyChanged("RenderTransform");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged(null);
			}
			if (_firstGroup is OtherContentGroup otherContentGroup)
			{
				if (Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(otherContentGroup._height) != Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(_height))
				{
					flag2 = true;
					otherContentGroup._height = _height;
				}
				if (otherContentGroup._contentItems.Count > 0 && otherContentGroup._contentItems.Array[0].UnderlyngContent == this && Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(otherContentGroup._contentItems.Array[0]._width) != Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(_width))
				{
					flag2 = true;
					otherContentGroup._contentItems.Array[0]._width = _width;
				}
			}
			if (flag2 && flag)
			{
				DirtySettings();
				ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
			}
			else if (!calledFromImageSourceGet)
			{
				LayoutManager?.InvalidateLayout();
			}
		}

		private void WireImageIfLoading(BitmapImageLoader loader)
		{
			if (loader.Status == BitmapImageLoadStatus.Loading && !_isImageLoadWired)
			{
				if (loader != LoadingErrorImage && loader != LoadingImage)
				{
					_isImageLoadWired = true;
				}
				loader.PropertyChanged += OnBitmapLoaderPropertyChanged;
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class LayoutNodeBase : IPropertyChangeListener, ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string>
	{
		private enum InternalFlags : byte
		{
			AreSettingsDirty = 1,
			AreDescendantSettingsDirty = 2,
			HasCollectionChangedAfterLoadBegan = 4,
			IsSubTreeBeingLoaded = 8,
			IsSubTreeLoaded = 0x10,
			IsNewlyAdded = 0x20
		}

		internal abstract class ControllerBase
		{
			private class ViewportInfo
			{
				internal readonly BlockLayoutNode _firstNodeInViewport;

				internal readonly int _firstNodeIndex;

				internal readonly Rect _viewPort;

				internal int _currentIndex;

				internal ViewportInfo(ControllerBase controller, Rect viewport)
				{
					_viewPort = viewport;
					_firstNodeInViewport = null;
					_firstNodeIndex = (_currentIndex = -1);
					LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = controller._layoutManager;
					int? documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint = layoutManager.GetDocumentOffsetFromLayoutPoint(new System.Windows.Point(_viewPort.Left, _viewPort.Top), includeListNumbers: true, includeParagraphMarks: true);
					if (!documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint.HasValue)
					{
						return;
					}
					NodeBase nodeBase = layoutManager.Document.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset(documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint.Value);
					if (nodeBase == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					DocumentBodyNode body = layoutManager.Document.RootNode.Body;
					while (nodeBase.Parent != body)
					{
						nodeBase = nodeBase.Parent;
					}
					BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode = layoutManager.GetLayoutNode<BlockLayoutNode>(nodeBase);
					if (blockLayoutNode == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (blockLayoutNode.Plane != LayoutPlane.Middle)
					{
						blockLayoutNode = blockLayoutNode.GetSiblingBlock(next: false, nonFloatingOnly: true);
						while (blockLayoutNode != null && blockLayoutNode.OverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels > viewport.Top)
						{
							blockLayoutNode = blockLayoutNode.GetSiblingBlock(next: false, nonFloatingOnly: true);
						}
					}
					LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = controller._rootNode.ChildNodes;
					if (blockLayoutNode == null && childNodes != null && childNodes.Count > 0)
					{
						blockLayoutNode = childNodes[0] as BlockLayoutNode;
					}
					if (blockLayoutNode != null)
					{
						_firstNodeInViewport = blockLayoutNode;
						_firstNodeIndex = (_currentIndex = childNodes.IndexOf(blockLayoutNode));
					}
				}
			}

			internal readonly LayoutManagerBase _layoutManager;

			internal Extent _widthConstraint;

			internal object _currentProcessStatusInfo;

			private RootLayoutNode _rootNode;

			private int _currentIndex;

			private Extent _widthSoFar;

			private HashSet<LayoutNodeBase> _priorityNodesProcessed;

			private BlockLayoutNode _currentNode;

			private ViewportInfo _currentViewport;

			private int _currentViewportIndex;

			private Dictionary<BlockLayoutNode, ViewportInfo> _viewportsProcessedMap;

			internal BlockLayoutNode CurrentNode => _currentNode;

			protected virtual bool PrioritizeViewPorts => false;

			protected ControllerBase(RootLayoutNode rootNode)
			{
				_rootNode = rootNode;
				_widthConstraint = _rootNode.WidthConstraint;
				_layoutManager = rootNode.LayoutManager;
				_currentIndex = 0;
				_widthSoFar = default(Extent);
			}

			internal virtual bool Process(TimeSpan? maxTimeAllowed)
			{
				if (PrioritizeViewPorts && _layoutManager.Editor != null)
				{
					return ProcessViewportsFirst(maxTimeAllowed);
				}
				TimeKeeper timeKeeper = new TimeKeeper(maxTimeAllowed);
				return ProcessFromFirstNodeToLast(timeKeeper);
			}

			protected virtual void OnProcessingComplete()
			{
			}

			protected virtual bool ProcessNode(BlockLayoutNode node, ref object processStatusInfo, TimeKeeper timeKeeper, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
			{
				return true;
			}

			private void InitializeCurrentViewportInfo(Rect[] viewPorts, ref int startIndex)
			{
				if (viewPorts == null || viewPorts.Length < startIndex + 1)
				{
					_currentViewport = null;
					return;
				}
				if (_priorityNodesProcessed == null)
				{
					_priorityNodesProcessed = new HashSet<LayoutNodeBase>();
					_viewportsProcessedMap = new Dictionary<BlockLayoutNode, ViewportInfo>();
				}
				for (int i = startIndex; i < viewPorts.Length; i++)
				{
					startIndex = i;
					Rect viewport = viewPorts[i];
					ViewportInfo viewportInfo = new ViewportInfo(this, viewport);
					if (viewportInfo._firstNodeInViewport != null && (!_viewportsProcessedMap.TryGetValue(viewportInfo._firstNodeInViewport, out var value) || !(value._viewPort.Bottom >= viewport.Bottom)))
					{
						_currentViewport = viewportInfo;
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			private bool ProcessFromFirstNodeToLast(TimeKeeper timeKeeper)
			{
				LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = _rootNode.ChildNodes;
				int num = childNodes?.Count ?? 0;
				while (_currentIndex < num)
				{
					BlockLayoutNode child = childNodes[_currentIndex] as BlockLayoutNode;
					if (!ProcessNodeHelper(timeKeeper, child, ref _currentIndex))
					{
						return false;
					}
					_currentIndex++;
				}
				if (_currentIndex == num)
				{
					_rootNode.SetWidth(_widthSoFar);
					OnProcessingComplete();
				}
				return _currentIndex == num;
			}

			private bool ProcessNodeHelper(TimeKeeper timeKeeper, BlockLayoutNode child, ref int currentIndex, bool oneNodeOnly = false)
			{
				if (child == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (child.ProcessesLayout)
				{
					if (_priorityNodesProcessed != null && _priorityNodesProcessed.Contains(child))
					{
						return true;
					}
					_currentNode = child;
					if (!ProcessNode(child, ref _currentProcessStatusInfo, timeKeeper, _widthConstraint, null))
					{
						if (_widthSoFar > _rootNode.Width)
						{
							_rootNode.SetWidth(_widthSoFar);
						}
						return false;
					}
					Extent extent = child.InlineLayoutWidth + child.OverallOffsetX;
					if (extent > _widthSoFar)
					{
						_widthSoFar = extent;
					}
					_currentProcessStatusInfo = null;
					if (oneNodeOnly || timeKeeper.IsTimedOut)
					{
						if (_widthSoFar > _rootNode.Width)
						{
							_rootNode.SetWidth(_widthSoFar);
						}
						currentIndex++;
						return oneNodeOnly;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			private bool ProcessViewportsFirst(TimeSpan? maxTimeAllowed)
			{
				TimeKeeper timeKeeper = new TimeKeeper(maxTimeAllowed);
				if (_currentNode != null && _currentProcessStatusInfo != null)
				{
					if (!((_currentViewport == null) ? ProcessNodeHelper(timeKeeper, _currentNode, ref _currentIndex, oneNodeOnly: true) : ProcessNodeHelper(timeKeeper, _currentNode, ref _currentViewport._currentIndex, oneNodeOnly: true)))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (_priorityNodesProcessed != null && !_priorityNodesProcessed.Contains(_currentNode))
					{
						_priorityNodesProcessed.Add(_currentNode);
					}
					_currentNode = null;
				}
				LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = _rootNode.ChildNodes;
				int num = childNodes?.Count ?? 0;
				if (_currentViewport == null)
				{
					InitializeCurrentViewportInfo(_layoutManager.Editor.ViewPorts, ref _currentViewportIndex);
				}
				while (_currentViewport != null && _currentViewport._currentIndex < num)
				{
					BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode = childNodes[_currentViewport._currentIndex] as BlockLayoutNode;
					if (!ProcessNodeHelper(timeKeeper, blockLayoutNode, ref _currentViewport._currentIndex))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!_priorityNodesProcessed.Contains(blockLayoutNode))
					{
						_priorityNodesProcessed.Add(blockLayoutNode);
					}
					if (blockLayoutNode.Plane == LayoutPlane.Middle && (blockLayoutNode.OverallOffsetY + blockLayoutNode.Height).LogicalPixels > _currentViewport._viewPort.Bottom)
					{
						break;
					}
					_currentViewport._currentIndex++;
					_viewportsProcessedMap[_currentViewport._firstNodeInViewport] = _currentViewport;
					_currentViewport = null;
					_currentViewportIndex++;
					InitializeCurrentViewportInfo(_layoutManager.Editor.ViewPorts, ref _currentViewportIndex);
				}
				return ProcessFromFirstNodeToLast(new TimeKeeper(maxTimeAllowed));
			}
		}

		internal class ContentChangedController : ControllerBase
		{
			private LayoutNodeBase _node;

			private object _changeInfo;

			internal ContentChangedController(LayoutNodeBase node, object changeInfo)
				: base(node.Root)
			{
				_node = node;
				_changeInfo = changeInfo;
			}

			internal override bool Process(TimeSpan? maxTimeAllowed)
			{
				TimeKeeper timeKeeper = new TimeKeeper(maxTimeAllowed);
				return Process(timeKeeper);
			}

			internal bool Process(TimeKeeper timeKeeper)
			{
				return _node.ProcessContentChanged(ref _currentProcessStatusInfo, _changeInfo, timeKeeper, _widthConstraint, null);
			}
		}

		internal class LayoutController : ControllerBase
		{
			internal readonly bool _newlyAddedNodeOnly;

			internal readonly BlockLayoutNode _firstNode;

			private bool _prioritizeViewPorts;

			private Extent _overallWidth;

			protected override bool PrioritizeViewPorts => _prioritizeViewPorts;

			internal LayoutController(RootLayoutNode rootNode, bool newlyAddedNodesOnly = false, bool prioritizeViewPorts = false, BlockLayoutNode firstNode = null)
				: base(rootNode)
			{
				_newlyAddedNodeOnly = newlyAddedNodesOnly;
				_prioritizeViewPorts = prioritizeViewPorts;
				_firstNode = firstNode;
				if (_prioritizeViewPorts)
				{
					LayoutManagerProcessStatus status = _layoutManager.Status;
					if (status == LayoutManagerProcessStatus.BuildingStructureNotStarted || status == LayoutManagerProcessStatus.BuildingStructure)
					{
						_prioritizeViewPorts = false;
					}
				}
			}

			protected override void OnProcessingComplete()
			{
				base.OnProcessingComplete();
				Extent extent = _overallWidth;
				Extent overallWidthOfFloatingContent = _layoutManager.OverallWidthOfFloatingContent;
				if (overallWidthOfFloatingContent > extent)
				{
					extent = overallWidthOfFloatingContent;
				}
				if (!_newlyAddedNodeOnly || extent.LogicalPixels > _layoutManager.LayoutWidth)
				{
					_layoutManager.SetLayoutWidth(extent.LogicalPixels);
				}
			}

			protected override bool ProcessNode(BlockLayoutNode node, ref object processStatusInfo, TimeKeeper timeKeeper, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
			{
				if (_newlyAddedNodeOnly && !node.IsNewlyAdded)
				{
					return true;
				}
				bool num = node.ProcessLayout(ref processStatusInfo, timeKeeper, constraintX, constraintY);
				if (num)
				{
					node.IsNewlyAdded = false;
					if (node.Plane == LayoutPlane.Middle)
					{
						Extent extent = node.OverallOffsetX + node.Width;
						if (extent > _overallWidth)
						{
							_overallWidth = extent;
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal class SettingsRefreshController : ControllerBase
		{
			private BlockLayoutNode _lastNodeProcessed;

			private object _lastNodeProcessStatusInfo;

			internal SettingsRefreshController(RootLayoutNode rootNode)
				: base(rootNode)
			{
			}

			protected override void OnProcessingComplete()
			{
				if (_layoutManager.Root != null)
				{
					_layoutManager.Root.ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
				}
			}

			protected override bool ProcessNode(BlockLayoutNode node, ref object processStatusInfo, TimeKeeper timeKeeper, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
			{
				bool num = node.ProcessSettingsChanged(ref processStatusInfo, timeKeeper, constraintX, constraintY);
				if (num)
				{
					node.ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
					_lastNodeProcessed = null;
					_lastNodeProcessStatusInfo = null;
					return num;
				}
				_lastNodeProcessed = node;
				_lastNodeProcessStatusInfo = processStatusInfo;
				return num;
			}

			internal void Abort()
			{
				if (_lastNodeProcessed != null)
				{
					_lastNodeProcessed.ProcessSettingsChangedAborted(_lastNodeProcessStatusInfo);
					_lastNodeProcessStatusInfo = null;
					_lastNodeProcessed = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal class TimeKeeper
		{
			private TimeSpan? _maxTimeAllowed;

			private int _startTickCount;

			private int _maxTicks;

			private bool _isTimedOut;

			internal static readonly TimeKeeper Perpetual = new TimeKeeper(null);

			internal bool IsTimedOut
			{
				get
				{
					if (!_maxTimeAllowed.HasValue)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (_isTimedOut)
					{
						return true;
					}
					_isTimedOut = Environment.TickCount - _startTickCount > _maxTicks;
					return _isTimedOut;
				}
			}

			internal TimeKeeper(TimeSpan? maxTimeAllowed)
			{
				_maxTimeAllowed = maxTimeAllowed;
				if (_maxTimeAllowed.HasValue)
				{
					_maxTicks = (int)_maxTimeAllowed.Value.TotalMilliseconds;
					_startTickCount = Environment.TickCount;
				}
			}
		}

		internal class SubTreeLoader
		{
			private class LevelInfo
			{
				internal NodeBase _node;

				internal LayoutNodeBase _layoutNode;

				internal LayoutNodeBase _childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed;

				internal IEnumerator<NodeBase> _childEnumerator;

				internal Dictionary<NodeBase, LayoutNodeBase> _reusableNodes;

				internal LevelInfo(NodeBase node, LayoutNodeBase layoutNode)
				{
					_node = node;
					_layoutNode = layoutNode;
				}

				internal void ReInitialize(NodeBase node, LayoutNodeBase layoutNode)
				{
					_node = node;
					_layoutNode = layoutNode;
					_childEnumerator = null;
					_childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed = null;
					_reusableNodes = null;
				}
			}

			private LayoutNodeBase _startLayoutNode;

			private List<LevelInfo> _levels;

			private LevelInfo[] _oldlevels;

			private LevelInfo _currentLevel;

			private int _currentLevelIndex;

			private TimeKeeper _timeKeeper;

			internal readonly LayoutManagerBase _layoutManager;

			internal bool IsTimedOut => _timeKeeper.IsTimedOut;

			internal SubTreeLoader(LayoutNodeBase layoutNode)
			{
				_startLayoutNode = layoutNode;
				_layoutManager = layoutNode.LayoutManager;
				_levels = new List<LevelInfo>();
			}

			internal bool LoadTree(TimeSpan? maxTimeAllowed)
			{
				if (_timeKeeper != null)
				{
					int num = -1;
					int num2 = _currentLevelIndex + 1;
					for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
					{
						if (_levels[i]._layoutNode.HasCollectionChangedAfterLoadBegan)
						{
							num = i;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						_currentLevelIndex = num;
						_currentLevel = _levels[num];
						if (num < num2 - 1)
						{
							LevelInfo[] oldlevels = _oldlevels;
							_oldlevels = new LevelInfo[Math.Max(num2, (oldlevels == null) ? 1 : oldlevels.Length)];
							for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
							{
								if (j <= num)
								{
									_oldlevels[j] = null;
								}
								else
								{
									_oldlevels[j] = _levels[j];
								}
							}
							if (oldlevels != null && oldlevels.Length > num2)
							{
								for (int k = num2; k < oldlevels.Length; k++)
								{
									_oldlevels[k] = oldlevels[k];
								}
							}
							_levels.RemoveRange(num + 1, num2 - (1 + num));
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_currentLevelIndex = -1;
					Push(_startLayoutNode.ParentLayoutNode, _startLayoutNode.DocumentNode, _startLayoutNode);
				}
				_timeKeeper = new TimeKeeper(maxTimeAllowed);
				ProcessDescendantNodes();
				return _currentLevelIndex < 0;
			}

			private LevelInfo Peek()
			{
				if (_currentLevelIndex >= 0)
				{
					return _levels[_currentLevelIndex];
				}
				return null;
			}

			private LevelInfo Pop()
			{
				if (_currentLevelIndex < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				LevelInfo levelInfo = _levels[_currentLevelIndex];
				levelInfo._layoutNode.IsSubTreeBeingLoaded = false;
				levelInfo._layoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
				levelInfo._childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed = null;
				levelInfo._reusableNodes = null;
				levelInfo._childEnumerator = null;
				_currentLevelIndex--;
				if (_currentLevelIndex >= 0)
				{
					_currentLevel = _levels[_currentLevelIndex];
				}
				return levelInfo;
			}

			private void ProcessDescendantNodes()
			{
				while (_currentLevelIndex >= 0)
				{
					LevelInfo currentLevel = _currentLevel;
					NodeBase node = currentLevel._node;
					LayoutNodeBase layoutNode = currentLevel._layoutNode;
					NodeCollection childNodes = node.ChildNodes;
					LayoutNodeCollection layoutNodeCollection = layoutNode.ChildNodes;
					if (childNodes == null || childNodes.Count == 0)
					{
						if (layoutNodeCollection != null && layoutNodeCollection.Count > 0)
						{
							layoutNodeCollection.Clear();
						}
						Pop();
						continue;
					}
					Dictionary<NodeBase, LayoutNodeBase> dictionary = currentLevel._reusableNodes;
					NodeBase nodeBase = null;
					LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = null;
					if (layoutNodeCollection == null)
					{
						if (!layoutNode.IsLeafNode)
						{
							layoutNodeCollection = (layoutNode.ChildNodes = ((!layoutNode.AggregatesChildNodeHeight) ? ((LayoutNodeCollection)new NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection()) : ((LayoutNodeCollection)new AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection())));
						}
					}
					else if (layoutNode.HasCollectionChangedAfterLoadBegan)
					{
						layoutNode.HasCollectionChangedAfterLoadBegan = false;
						if (dictionary == null)
						{
							dictionary = new Dictionary<NodeBase, LayoutNodeBase>();
						}
						foreach (LayoutNodeBase item in layoutNodeCollection)
						{
							dictionary[item.DocumentNode] = item;
						}
						if (currentLevel._childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed != null)
						{
							layoutNodeBase = currentLevel._childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed;
							nodeBase = layoutNodeBase.DocumentNode;
							currentLevel._childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed = null;
						}
						layoutNodeCollection.Clear();
						currentLevel._childEnumerator = null;
						currentLevel._reusableNodes = dictionary;
					}
					if (currentLevel._childEnumerator == null)
					{
						currentLevel._childEnumerator = childNodes.GetEnumerator();
					}
					else if (currentLevel._childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed != null && currentLevel._childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed.DocumentNode == currentLevel._childEnumerator.Current)
					{
						layoutNodeCollection.Add(currentLevel._childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed);
						currentLevel._childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed = null;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					IEnumerator<NodeBase> childEnumerator = currentLevel._childEnumerator;
					while (childEnumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						NodeBase current2 = childEnumerator.Current;
						LayoutNodeBase value = null;
						if (nodeBase == current2)
						{
							value = Push(layoutNode, current2, layoutNodeBase);
							flag = value != null;
						}
						else
						{
							dictionary?.TryGetValue(current2, out value);
						}
						if (value == null)
						{
							value = Push(layoutNode, current2);
							flag = value != null;
						}
						currentLevel._childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed = value;
						if (IsTimedOut)
						{
							return;
						}
						if (value != null)
						{
							layoutNodeCollection.Add(value);
							currentLevel._childLayoutNodeBeingProcessed = null;
							if (flag)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					_currentLevel._childEnumerator = null;
					if (!flag)
					{
						Pop();
					}
				}
			}

			private LayoutNodeBase Push(LayoutNodeBase parentLayoutNode, NodeBase node, LayoutNodeBase layoutNode = null)
			{
				_currentLevelIndex++;
				if (_oldlevels != null)
				{
					LevelInfo levelInfo = _oldlevels[_currentLevelIndex];
					if (levelInfo != null && levelInfo._node == node)
					{
						_currentLevel = levelInfo;
						_oldlevels[_currentLevelIndex] = null;
						bool flag = false;
						for (int i = 0; i < _oldlevels.Length; i++)
						{
							if (_oldlevels[i] != null)
							{
								flag = true;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							_oldlevels = null;
						}
						if (_levels.Count > _currentLevelIndex)
						{
							_levels[_currentLevelIndex] = levelInfo;
						}
						else
						{
							_levels.Add(levelInfo);
						}
						return _currentLevel._layoutNode;
					}
				}
				if (layoutNode == null)
				{
					layoutNode = Create(node, _layoutManager, parentLayoutNode);
				}
				if (layoutNode == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				layoutNode.IsSubTreeBeingLoaded = true;
				layoutNode.HasCollectionChangedAfterLoadBegan = false;
				if (_levels.Count <= _currentLevelIndex)
				{
					_currentLevel = new LevelInfo(node, layoutNode);
					_levels.Add(_currentLevel);
				}
				else
				{
					_currentLevel = _levels[_currentLevelIndex];
					_currentLevel.ReInitialize(node, layoutNode);
				}
				return layoutNode;
			}
		}

		internal class PendingOperationManager
		{
			private LayoutManagerBase _layoutManager;

			private DispatcherTimer _timer;

			private Queue<ContentChangedController> _contentChangedControllers;

			private Queue<SubTreeLoader> _subTreeLoaders;

			private Queue<LayoutController> _layoutControllers;

			private Queue<SettingsRefreshController> _settingsRefreshControllers;

			private SettingsRefreshController _currentSettingsRefreshController;

			internal PendingOperationManager(LayoutManagerBase layoutManager)
			{
				_layoutManager = layoutManager;
			}

			internal void OnRootNodeChanged(RootLayoutNode newRoot)
			{
				if (_contentChangedControllers != null)
				{
					_contentChangedControllers.Clear();
				}
				if (_layoutControllers != null)
				{
					_layoutControllers.Clear();
				}
				if (_settingsRefreshControllers != null)
				{
					_settingsRefreshControllers.Clear();
				}
				if (_subTreeLoaders != null)
				{
					_subTreeLoaders.Clear();
				}
				_currentSettingsRefreshController = null;
				VerifyTimerState(updateStatus: false);
			}

			internal void ProcessQueues(bool proccessAllEntriesSynchronously)
			{
				int num = (proccessAllEntriesSynchronously ? 200000000 : 80);
				int num2 = Environment.TickCount + num;
				if (_subTreeLoaders != null)
				{
					while (_subTreeLoaders.Count > 0)
					{
						_layoutManager.Status = LayoutManagerProcessStatus.BuildingStructure;
						SubTreeLoader subTreeLoader = _subTreeLoaders.Peek();
						VerifySettingsRefresh(subTreeLoader._layoutManager);
						if (!subTreeLoader.LoadTree(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(num)))
						{
							if (!proccessAllEntriesSynchronously)
							{
								return;
							}
							continue;
						}
						if (_subTreeLoaders.Count > 0)
						{
							_subTreeLoaders.Dequeue();
						}
						if (!proccessAllEntriesSynchronously)
						{
							int tickCount = Environment.TickCount;
							if (tickCount >= num2)
							{
								return;
							}
							num = num2 - tickCount;
						}
					}
				}
				if (_contentChangedControllers != null)
				{
					while (_contentChangedControllers.Count > 0)
					{
						_layoutManager.Status = LayoutManagerProcessStatus.BuildingStructure;
						if (!_contentChangedControllers.Peek().Process(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(num)))
						{
							if (!proccessAllEntriesSynchronously)
							{
								return;
							}
							continue;
						}
						if (_contentChangedControllers.Count > 0)
						{
							_contentChangedControllers.Dequeue();
						}
						if (!proccessAllEntriesSynchronously)
						{
							int tickCount2 = Environment.TickCount;
							if (tickCount2 >= num2)
							{
								return;
							}
							num = num2 - tickCount2;
						}
					}
				}
				if (_layoutControllers != null)
				{
					while (_layoutControllers.Count > 0)
					{
						_layoutManager.Status = LayoutManagerProcessStatus.ProcessingLayout;
						LayoutController layoutController = _layoutControllers.Peek();
						VerifySettingsRefresh(layoutController._layoutManager);
						if (!layoutController.Process(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(num)))
						{
							if (!proccessAllEntriesSynchronously)
							{
								return;
							}
							continue;
						}
						if (_layoutControllers.Count > 0)
						{
							_layoutControllers.Dequeue();
						}
						if (!proccessAllEntriesSynchronously)
						{
							int tickCount3 = Environment.TickCount;
							if (tickCount3 >= num2)
							{
								return;
							}
							num = num2 - tickCount3;
						}
					}
				}
				if (_settingsRefreshControllers != null)
				{
					while (_currentSettingsRefreshController != null || _settingsRefreshControllers.Count > 0)
					{
						_layoutManager.Status = LayoutManagerProcessStatus.RefreshingSettings;
						if (_currentSettingsRefreshController == null)
						{
							_currentSettingsRefreshController = _settingsRefreshControllers.Dequeue();
						}
						if (!_currentSettingsRefreshController.Process(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(num)))
						{
							if (!proccessAllEntriesSynchronously)
							{
								return;
							}
							continue;
						}
						_currentSettingsRefreshController = null;
						if (!proccessAllEntriesSynchronously)
						{
							int tickCount4 = Environment.TickCount;
							if (tickCount4 >= num2)
							{
								return;
							}
							num = num2 - tickCount4;
						}
					}
				}
				VerifyTimerState();
			}

			internal void QueueContentChangedController(ContentChangedController controller)
			{
				if (_contentChangedControllers == null)
				{
					_contentChangedControllers = new Queue<ContentChangedController>();
				}
				_contentChangedControllers.Enqueue(controller);
				VerifyTimerState();
			}

			internal void QueueLayoutController(LayoutController controller)
			{
				if (_layoutControllers == null)
				{
					_layoutControllers = new Queue<LayoutController>();
				}
				if (_layoutControllers.Count > 0)
				{
					HashSet<LayoutController> hashSet = new HashSet<LayoutController>();
					foreach (LayoutController layoutController in _layoutControllers)
					{
						if (layoutController._layoutManager == controller._layoutManager)
						{
							if (layoutController._widthConstraint == controller._widthConstraint && !layoutController._newlyAddedNodeOnly && !controller._newlyAddedNodeOnly)
							{
								return;
							}
							if (!controller._newlyAddedNodeOnly || layoutController._widthConstraint != controller._widthConstraint)
							{
								hashSet.Add(layoutController);
							}
						}
					}
					Queue<LayoutController> queue = new Queue<LayoutController>();
					queue.Enqueue(controller);
					while (_layoutControllers.Count > 0)
					{
						LayoutController item = _layoutControllers.Dequeue();
						if (!hashSet.Contains(item))
						{
							queue.Enqueue(item);
						}
					}
					_layoutControllers = queue;
				}
				else
				{
					_layoutControllers.Enqueue(controller);
				}
				VerifyTimerState();
			}

			internal void QueueSettingsRefreshController(SettingsRefreshController controller)
			{
				if (_settingsRefreshControllers == null)
				{
					_settingsRefreshControllers = new Queue<SettingsRefreshController>();
				}
				_settingsRefreshControllers.Enqueue(controller);
				VerifyTimerState();
			}

			internal void QueueSubTreeLoader(SubTreeLoader loader)
			{
				if (_subTreeLoaders == null)
				{
					_subTreeLoaders = new Queue<SubTreeLoader>();
				}
				_subTreeLoaders.Enqueue(loader);
				VerifyTimerState();
			}

			private void OnTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				_layoutManager.ClearCachedTimeKeepers();
				ProcessQueues(proccessAllEntriesSynchronously: false);
			}

			private void VerifySettingsRefresh(LayoutManagerBase layoutMgr)
			{
				if (_currentSettingsRefreshController != null && _currentSettingsRefreshController._layoutManager == layoutMgr)
				{
					_currentSettingsRefreshController.Abort();
					_settingsRefreshControllers.Enqueue(_currentSettingsRefreshController);
					_currentSettingsRefreshController = null;
				}
			}

			private void VerifyTimerState(bool updateStatus = true)
			{
				if (((_subTreeLoaders != null) ? _subTreeLoaders.Count : 0) + ((_contentChangedControllers != null) ? _contentChangedControllers.Count : 0) + ((_layoutControllers != null) ? _layoutControllers.Count : 0) + ((_settingsRefreshControllers != null) ? _settingsRefreshControllers.Count : 0) == 0 && _currentSettingsRefreshController == null)
				{
					if (updateStatus)
					{
						_layoutManager.Status = LayoutManagerProcessStatus.Complete;
					}
					if (_timer != null)
					{
						_timer.Stop();
						_timer = null;
					}
					return;
				}
				if (_timer == null)
				{
					_timer = new DispatcherTimer();
					_timer.Tick += OnTimerTick;
				}
				else if (_timer.IsEnabled)
				{
					return;
				}
				_timer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1.0);
				_timer.Start();
			}
		}

		internal BlockLayoutNode GetSiblingBlock(bool next, bool nonFloatingOnly = false)
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ParentLayoutNode.ChildNodes;
			int num = childNodes.IndexOf(this);
			int count = childNodes.Count;
			int num2 = (next ? 1 : (-1));
			while (true)
			{
				num += num2;
				if (next)
				{
					if (num >= count)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (num < 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (childNodes[num] is BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode && (!nonFloatingOnly || blockLayoutNode.Plane == LayoutPlane.Middle))
				{
					return blockLayoutNode;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void LoadSubTree(TimeSpan? maxTimeAllowed, bool performLayout = true, bool force = false)
		{
			if (!force && (IsSubTreeLoaded || IsSubTreeBeingLoaded || IsLeafNode))
			{
				return;
			}
			SubTreeLoader subTreeLoader = new SubTreeLoader(this);
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (maxTimeAllowed.HasValue)
			{
				num = Environment.TickCount;
				num2 = (double)num + maxTimeAllowed.Value.TotalMilliseconds;
			}
			bool flag = subTreeLoader.LoadTree(maxTimeAllowed);
			if (!performLayout)
			{
				return;
			}
			LayoutController layoutController = new LayoutController(Root);
			if (!flag)
			{
				LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
				layoutManager.QueueSubTreeLoader(subTreeLoader);
				layoutManager.QueueLayoutController(layoutController);
				return;
			}
			if (force)
			{
				layoutController.Process(null);
				return;
			}
			num = Environment.TickCount;
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (maxTimeAllowed.HasValue)
			{
				if (num2 > (double)num)
				{
					flag2 = !layoutController.Process(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(num2 - (double)num));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag2 = !layoutController.Process(null);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				LayoutManager.QueueLayoutController(layoutController);
			}
		}

		internal void LoadSubTreeAsync()
		{
			if (!IsSubTreeLoaded && !IsSubTreeBeingLoaded && !IsLeafNode)
			{
				SubTreeLoader loader = new SubTreeLoader(this);
				LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
				IsSubTreeBeingLoaded = true;
				layoutManager.QueueSubTreeLoader(loader);
				layoutManager.QueueLayoutController(new LayoutController(Root));
			}
		}

		}

		protected static LayoutNodeBase Create(NodeBase node, LayoutManagerBase layoutManager, LayoutNodeBase parentLayoutNode)
		{
			LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = InternalCreateHelper(node, layoutManager, parentLayoutNode);
			if (layoutNodeBase != null)
			{
				layoutManager.NodeMap[node] = layoutNodeBase;
			}
			return layoutNodeBase;
		}

		private static LayoutNodeBase InternalCreateHelper(NodeBase node, LayoutManagerBase layoutManager, LayoutNodeBase parentLayoutNode)
		{
			if (node is TextNode textNode)
			{
				return new TextLayoutNode(parentLayoutNode, textNode);
			}
			if (node is RunNode run)
			{
				return new RunLayoutNode(parentLayoutNode, run);
			}
			if (node is ParagraphNode paragraph)
			{
				return new ParagraphLayoutNode(parentLayoutNode, paragraph);
			}
			if (node is TableCellNode tableCell)
			{
				return new TableCellLayoutNode(parentLayoutNode, tableCell);
			}
			if (node is TableRowNode tableRow)
			{
				return new TableRowLayoutNode(parentLayoutNode, tableRow);
			}
			if (node is TableNode table)
			{
				return new TableLayoutNode(parentLayoutNode, table);
			}
			if (node is BreakNode breakNode)
			{
				return new BreakLayoutNode(parentLayoutNode, breakNode);
			}
			if (node is ImageNode imageNode)
			{
				return new ImageLayoutNode(parentLayoutNode, imageNode);
			}
			if (node is HyperlinkNode hyperlinkNode)
			{
				return new HyperlinkLayoutNode(parentLayoutNode, hyperlinkNode);
			}
			if (node is DocumentBodyNode bodyNode)
			{
				return new RootLayoutNode(layoutManager, bodyNode);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool GetFlag(InternalFlags flag)
		{
			return (_flags & flag) == flag;
		}

		private bool ProcessChildNodeAdded(int childIndex, NodeBase childDocNodeAdded)
		{
			LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = Create(childDocNodeAdded, LayoutManager, this);
			if (layoutNodeBase != null)
			{
				ChildNodes.Insert(childIndex, layoutNodeBase);
				OnChildrenAddedAndRemoved(new LayoutNodeBase[1] { layoutNodeBase }, null);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ProcessChildNodesAdded(int childIndex, IList docNodes)
		{
			if (docNodes == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			List<LayoutNodeBase> list = new List<LayoutNodeBase>(docNodes.Count);
			LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
			foreach (NodeBase docNode in docNodes)
			{
				if (docNode == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = Create(docNode, layoutManager, this);
				if (layoutNodeBase == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				list.Add(layoutNodeBase);
			}
			ChildNodes.InsertRange(childIndex, list);
			OnChildrenAddedAndRemoved(list, null);
			return true;
		}

		private void ProcessChildNodesChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			switch (args.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				if (childNodes == null || childNodes.Count < args.NewStartingIndex || args.NewItems == null || args.NewItems.Count == 0)
				{
					ProcessChildNodesReset();
					break;
				}
				NodeBase nodeBase = args.NewItems[0] as NodeBase;
				LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
				if ((layoutManager.Status != LayoutManagerProcessStatus.BuildingStructureNotStarted || !layoutManager.NodeMap.ContainsKey(nodeBase)) && !((args.NewItems.Count == 1) ? ProcessChildNodeAdded(args.NewStartingIndex, nodeBase) : ProcessChildNodesAdded(args.NewStartingIndex, args.NewItems)))
				{
					ProcessChildNodesReset();
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				if (childNodes == null || childNodes.Count <= args.OldStartingIndex || args.OldItems == null || args.OldItems.Count == 0)
				{
					ProcessChildNodesReset();
				}
				else if (!((args.OldItems.Count == 1) ? ProcessChildNodeRemoved(args.OldStartingIndex, args.OldItems[0] as NodeBase) : ProcessChildNodesRemoved(args.OldStartingIndex, args.OldItems)))
				{
					ProcessChildNodesReset();
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				ProcessChildNodesReset();
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				if (childNodes == null || childNodes.Count <= args.NewStartingIndex || args.OldItems == null || args.OldItems.Count != 1 || args.NewItems == null || args.NewItems.Count != 1 || args.OldItems[args.NewStartingIndex] != childNodes[args.NewStartingIndex])
				{
					ProcessChildNodesReset();
				}
				else if (!ProcessChildNodeRemoved(args.OldStartingIndex, args.OldItems[0] as NodeBase) || !ProcessChildNodeAdded(args.NewStartingIndex, args.NewItems[0] as NodeBase))
				{
					ProcessChildNodesReset();
				}
				break;
			default:
				ProcessChildNodesReset();
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessChildNodeRemoved(int oldChildIndex, NodeBase childDocNodeRemoved)
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = childNodes[oldChildIndex];
			if (childDocNodeRemoved == layoutNodeBase.DocumentNode)
			{
				if (childNodes.Count == 1)
				{
					OnChildrenCleared();
					childNodes.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					layoutNodeBase.OnPreDisposed();
					OnChildrenAddedAndRemoved(null, new LayoutNodeBase[1] { layoutNodeBase });
					childNodes.RemoveAt(oldChildIndex);
				}
				layoutNodeBase.DisposeNodeAndDescendants();
				OnDescendantsRemoved();
				LayoutManager?.ProcessRootParagraphRemovals();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ProcessChildNodesRemoved(int oldChildIndex, IList docNodes)
		{
			if (docNodes == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (oldChildIndex == 0 && childNodes.Count == docNodes.Count)
			{
				OnChildrenCleared();
				childNodes.Clear();
				return true;
			}
			List<LayoutNodeBase> list = new List<LayoutNodeBase>(docNodes.Count);
			LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
			int index = oldChildIndex;
			foreach (NodeBase docNode in docNodes)
			{
				if (docNode == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = childNodes[oldChildIndex++];
				if (docNode != layoutNodeBase.DocumentNode)
				{
					return false;
				}
				layoutNodeBase.OnPreDisposed();
				list.Add(layoutNodeBase);
			}
			OnChildrenAddedAndRemoved(null, list);
			childNodes.RemoveRange(index, list.Count);
			OnDescendantsRemoved();
			layoutManager?.ProcessRootParagraphRemovals();
			return true;
		}

		private void ProcessChildNodesReset()
		{
			if (LayoutManager == null || DocumentNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ChildNodes == null)
			{
				if (AggregatesChildNodeHeight)
				{
					ChildNodes = new AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection();
				}
				else
				{
					ChildNodes = new NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection();
				}
			}
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			List<NodeBase> list = new List<NodeBase>(childNodes.Count);
			Dictionary<NodeBase, LayoutNodeBase> dictionary = new Dictionary<NodeBase, LayoutNodeBase>(childNodes.Count);
			foreach (LayoutNodeBase item2 in childNodes)
			{
				NodeBase documentNode = item2.DocumentNode;
				if (documentNode != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add(documentNode, item2);
					list.Add(documentNode);
				}
			}
			NodeCollection childNodes2 = DocumentNode.ChildNodes;
			int num = 0;
			List<LayoutNodeBase> list2 = new List<LayoutNodeBase>();
			foreach (NodeBase item3 in childNodes2)
			{
				if (dictionary.TryGetValue(item3, out var value))
				{
					dictionary.Remove(item3);
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					value = Create(item3, LayoutManager, this);
					list2.Add(value);
				}
			}
			List<LayoutNodeBase> list3 = null;
			if (dictionary.Count > 0)
			{
				list3 = new List<LayoutNodeBase>();
				foreach (NodeBase item4 in list)
				{
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(item4, out var value2))
					{
						list3.Add(value2);
					}
				}
			}
			List<LayoutNodeBase> list4 = new List<LayoutNodeBase>();
			list4.Add(null);
			if (list3 != null && list3.Count == list.Count)
			{
				OnChildrenCleared();
				childNodes.Clear();
				foreach (LayoutNodeBase item5 in list3)
				{
					item5.DisposeNodeAndDescendants();
				}
			}
			else if (list3 != null)
			{
				using (List<LayoutNodeBase>.Enumerator enumerator4 = list3.GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator4.MoveNext())
					{
						LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = (list4[0] = enumerator4.Current);
						layoutNodeBase.OnPreDisposed();
						OnChildrenAddedAndRemoved(null, list4);
						childNodes.Remove(layoutNodeBase);
						layoutNodeBase.DisposeNodeAndDescendants();
					}
				}
				OnDescendantsRemoved();
			}
			using List<LayoutNodeBase>.Enumerator enumerator4 = list2.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator4.MoveNext())
			{
				LayoutNodeBase item = (list4[0] = enumerator4.Current);
				childNodes.Add(item);
				OnChildrenAddedAndRemoved(list4, null);
			}
		}

		private void SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_flags &= (InternalFlags)(byte)(~(int)flag);
			}
		}

		void ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string>.OnPropertyValueChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (IsSubTreeLoaded || IsSubTreeBeingLoaded)
			{
				NodeBase obj = sender as NodeBase;
				NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e = null;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					if (property == "ChildNodes")
					{
						e = new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset);
					}
				}
				else if (sender is NodeCollection)
				{
					e = extraInfo as NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs;
				}
				if (e != null)
				{
					if (IsSubTreeBeingLoaded)
					{
						HasCollectionChangedAfterLoadBegan = true;
					}
					else
					{
						ProcessChildNodesChanged(e);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			OnPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
		}
	}

	}

	internal class ParagraphLayoutNode : BlockLayoutNode, ILayoutNodeWithLines, ILeafLayoutNodeAncestor, IRunLayoutNodeContainer
	{
		private class ContentChangeHelperBase : LayoutHelperBase
		{
			protected List<RichTextContentGroupBase> _tempGroups;

			protected int _totalContentItemsAdded;

			protected Dictionary<FontTextKey, Extent> _oldItemMap;

			internal ContentChangeHelperBase(ParagraphLayoutNode pnode)
				: base(pnode)
			{
				_tempGroups = new List<RichTextContentGroupBase>();
			}

			protected override void AddGroup(RichTextContentGroupBase newGroup)
			{
				_tempGroups.Add(newGroup);
				_currentGroup = newGroup;
				_currentGroupContentIndex = 0;
			}

			protected override RichTextContentGroupBase AddGroupContent(RichTextGroupContentItem item, bool updateLeafInfo)
			{
				_totalContentItemsAdded++;
				return base.AddGroupContent(item, updateLeafInfo: false);
			}

			protected override Extent GetTextWidth(string subText, FontSpecification font)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(subText))
				{
					return default(Extent);
				}
				if (_oldItemMap != null && _oldItemMap.TryGetValue(new FontTextKey(subText, font), out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return base.GetTextWidth(subText, font);
			}
		}

		private abstract class LayoutHelperBase
		{
			protected struct AvailableLineContentArea
			{
				internal Extent _offsetX;

				internal Extent _width;

				internal AvailableLineContentArea(Extent offsetX, Extent width)
				{
					_offsetX = offsetX;
					_width = width;
				}
			}

			protected class FloatingBlockCache
			{
				private class FloatingBlockComparer : IComparer<FloatingBlockInfoBase>
				{
					public static FloatingBlockComparer Instance = new FloatingBlockComparer();

					public int Compare(FloatingBlockInfoBase x, FloatingBlockInfoBase y)
					{
						if (x == y)
						{
							return 0;
						}
						ILayoutBlock layoutBlock = x?.Block;
						ILayoutBlock layoutBlock2 = y?.Block;
						if (layoutBlock == null)
						{
							if (layoutBlock2 != null)
							{
								return 1;
							}
							return 0;
						}
						if (layoutBlock2 == null)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						Extent cachedOverallOffsetX = x.CachedOverallOffsetX;
						Extent cachedOverallOffsetX2 = y.CachedOverallOffsetX;
						if (cachedOverallOffsetX != cachedOverallOffsetX2)
						{
							return cachedOverallOffsetX.CompareTo(cachedOverallOffsetX2);
						}
						Extent width = x.Width;
						Extent width2 = y.Width;
						if (width != width2)
						{
							return width2.CompareTo(width);
						}
						BlockLayoutNode firstBlockNode = layoutBlock.FirstBlockNode;
						BlockLayoutNode firstBlockNode2 = layoutBlock2.FirstBlockNode;
						if (firstBlockNode == null)
						{
							if (firstBlockNode2 != null)
							{
								return 1;
							}
							return 0;
						}
						if (firstBlockNode2 == null)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						int documentOffset = firstBlockNode.DocumentNode.GetDocumentOffset();
						int documentOffset2 = firstBlockNode2.DocumentNode.GetDocumentOffset();
						return documentOffset.CompareTo(documentOffset2);
					}
				}

				private LayoutHelperBase _owner;

				private List<FloatingBlockInfoBase> _floatingBlocks;

				private List<FloatingBlockInfoBase> _lineIntersectingBlocks = new List<FloatingBlockInfoBase>();

				private double _floatingBlockCacheOffsetY;

				private double _floatingBlockCacheHeight;

				private double _overallOffsetX;

				private double _overallOffsetY;

				private double _widthConstraint;

				private double _lineListOffsetY;

				private RichTextLine _previousLine;

				private Extent? _nextAvailableOffsetY;

				private int _previousAreaIndex;

				private int _ownerDocOffset;

				private ElasticArray<AvailableLineContentArea> _lineAreas;

				private const double DefaultFloatingBlockCacheHeight = 200.0;

				private const double MinimumAvailableAreaWidth = 4.0;

				internal bool HasAdditionalAreas => _previousAreaIndex < _lineAreas.Count - 1;

				internal double LineListOffsetY
				{
					get
					{
						return _lineListOffsetY;
					}
					set
					{
						_lineListOffsetY = value;
					}
				}

				internal Extent? NextAvailableOffsetY => _nextAvailableOffsetY;

				internal FloatingBlockCache(LayoutHelperBase owner)
				{
					_owner = owner;
					_overallOffsetX = _owner._pnode.OverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
					_overallOffsetY = _owner._pnode.OverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
					_widthConstraint = _owner._constraintX.LogicalPixels;
					_ownerDocOffset = _owner._pnode.DocumentNode.GetDocumentOffset();
				}

				internal AvailableLineContentArea? GetNextAvailableContentArea(RichTextLine line, Extent lineHeight)
				{
					if (line != _previousLine)
					{
						CacheAvailableAreasForLine(line, lineHeight);
					}
					if (_previousAreaIndex >= _lineAreas.Count - 1)
					{
						return null;
					}
					_previousAreaIndex++;
					return _lineAreas.Array[_previousAreaIndex];
				}

				internal void ResetNextAvailable()
				{
					_previousLine = null;
					_lineAreas.ClearNoRelease();
				}

				private void CacheAvailableAreasForLine(RichTextLine line, Extent lineHeight)
				{
					_previousLine = line;
					_previousAreaIndex = -1;
					double num = _lineListOffsetY + line.RelativeOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
					double logicalPixels = lineHeight.LogicalPixels;
					VerifyFloatingBlockCacheForLine(num, logicalPixels);
					_lineAreas.ClearNoRelease();
					bool flag = false;
					_nextAvailableOffsetY = null;
					int count = _floatingBlocks.Count;
					double num2 = 0.0;
					_lineIntersectingBlocks.Clear();
					double num3 = Math.Max(_widthConstraint, line.Width.LogicalPixels);
					if (count > 0)
					{
						Rect rect = new Rect(_overallOffsetX, _overallOffsetY + num, num3, logicalPixels);
						for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
						{
							FloatingBlockInfoBase floatingBlockInfoBase = _floatingBlocks[i];
							Rect? overallRect = floatingBlockInfoBase.OverallRect;
							if (!overallRect.HasValue || !CoreUtilities.IntersectsWith(overallRect.Value, rect))
							{
								continue;
							}
							if (floatingBlockInfoBase is FloatingParagraphGroupInfo { IsDropCap: not false } floatingParagraphGroupInfo && floatingParagraphGroupInfo.Paragraphs.Count > 0)
							{
								NodeBase documentNode = floatingParagraphGroupInfo.Paragraphs[0].DocumentNode;
								if (documentNode == null || documentNode.GetDocumentOffset() > _ownerDocOffset)
								{
									continue;
								}
							}
							switch (floatingBlockInfoBase.Wrap)
							{
							case TextFrameWrap.Around:
							case TextFrameWrap.Auto:
							case TextFrameWrap.Through:
							case TextFrameWrap.Tight:
								_lineIntersectingBlocks.Add(floatingBlockInfoBase);
								break;
							case TextFrameWrap.None:
							case TextFrameWrap.NotBeside:
								flag = true;
								num2 = Math.Max(num2, overallRect.Value.Bottom);
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						_nextAvailableOffsetY = new Extent(num2 - _overallOffsetY, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
						_lineAreas.ClearNoRelease();
						_lineIntersectingBlocks.Clear();
						return;
					}
					if (_lineIntersectingBlocks.Count == 0)
					{
						_lineAreas.Add(new AvailableLineContentArea(default(Extent), new Extent(_widthConstraint * 10.0, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels)));
						return;
					}
					if (_lineIntersectingBlocks.Count > 1)
					{
						_lineIntersectingBlocks.Sort(FloatingBlockComparer.Instance);
					}
					double num4 = 0.0;
					double num5 = 0.0;
					int j = 0;
					for (int count2 = _lineIntersectingBlocks.Count; j < count2; j++)
					{
						FloatingBlockInfoBase floatingBlockInfoBase2 = _lineIntersectingBlocks[j];
						double num6 = floatingBlockInfoBase2.OverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels - _overallOffsetX;
						double num7 = num6 + floatingBlockInfoBase2.Width.LogicalPixels;
						if (num5 < num6 && num6 - num5 > 4.0)
						{
							_lineAreas.Add(new AvailableLineContentArea(new Extent(num5, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels), new Extent(num6 - num5, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels)));
						}
						num4 = num7;
						if (num4 > num5)
						{
							num5 = num4;
						}
					}
					if (num3 > num5 && num3 - num5 > 4.0)
					{
						_lineAreas.Add(new AvailableLineContentArea(new Extent(num5, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels), new Extent(num3 - num5, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels)));
					}
				}

				private void VerifyFloatingBlockCacheForLine(double lineOffsetY, double lineHeight)
				{
					if (_floatingBlocks == null || lineOffsetY < _floatingBlockCacheOffsetY || lineOffsetY + lineHeight > _floatingBlockCacheOffsetY + _floatingBlockCacheHeight)
					{
						_floatingBlockCacheOffsetY = lineOffsetY;
						_floatingBlockCacheHeight = Math.Max(200.0, lineHeight);
						Rect viewport = new Rect(_overallOffsetX, _overallOffsetY + _floatingBlockCacheOffsetY, _widthConstraint, _floatingBlockCacheHeight);
						if (_floatingBlocks == null)
						{
							_floatingBlocks = new List<FloatingBlockInfoBase>(_owner._layoutManager.GetFloatingBlockInfosInViewPort(viewport));
						}
						else
						{
							_floatingBlocks.Clear();
							_floatingBlocks.AddRange(_owner._layoutManager.GetFloatingBlockInfosInViewPort(viewport));
						}
						if (_floatingBlocks.Count > 0)
						{
							_owner._pnode.OverlapsFloatingContent = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private class RelayoutLinesContext
			{
				private LayoutHelperBase _owner;

				private bool _isPastLineChangeDeltaAdjustments;

				internal int _lineIndex;

				internal int _lineContentIndex;

				internal RichTextContentGroupBase _changeStartGroup;

				internal int _changeStartGroupIndex;

				internal int _changeStartGroupContentIndex;

				internal RichTextContentGroupBase _changeEndGroup;

				internal int _changeEndGroupIndex;

				internal int _changeEndGroupContentIndex;

				internal int _numberOfItemsAdded;

				internal int _numberOfItemsRemoved;

				internal int _firstChangeIndexOffset;

				internal int _changedItemsCount;

				internal int _lineReuseCandidateIndex;

				internal int _lineReuseCandidatesSkipped;

				internal RichTextLine _lineReuseCandidate;

				internal RichTextLine _lineToReuse;

				internal RelayoutLinesContext(LayoutHelperBase owner, int lineIndex, int lineContentIndex, RichTextContentGroupBase changeStartGroup, int changeStartGroupContentIndex, int numberOfItemsAdded, int numberOfItemsRemoved, int firstChangeIndexOffset, int changedItemsCount)
				{
					_owner = owner;
					_lineIndex = lineIndex;
					_lineContentIndex = lineContentIndex;
					_changeStartGroup = changeStartGroup;
					_changeStartGroupContentIndex = changeStartGroupContentIndex;
					_numberOfItemsAdded = numberOfItemsAdded;
					_numberOfItemsRemoved = numberOfItemsRemoved;
					_firstChangeIndexOffset = firstChangeIndexOffset;
					_changedItemsCount = changedItemsCount;
					if (_changeStartGroup == null)
					{
						if (_owner._pnode._groups.Count <= 0)
						{
							_changeStartGroupIndex = -1;
							_changeEndGroupIndex = -1;
							return;
						}
						_changeStartGroup = _owner._pnode._groups.Array[0];
						_changeStartGroupIndex = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						_changeStartGroupIndex = _owner._pnode.GetIndexOfGroup(_changeStartGroup);
					}
					_changeStartGroupContentIndex = _firstChangeIndexOffset + changeStartGroupContentIndex;
					while (_changeStartGroupContentIndex >= _changeStartGroup._contentItems.Count)
					{
						_changeStartGroupIndex++;
						if (_changeStartGroupIndex < _owner._pnode._groups.Count)
						{
							_changeStartGroupContentIndex -= _changeStartGroup._contentItems.Count;
							_changeStartGroup = _owner._pnode._groups.Array[_changeStartGroupIndex];
						}
						else
						{
							_changeStartGroupContentIndex = _changeStartGroup._contentItems.Count - 1;
						}
					}
					int num = _changedItemsCount + _numberOfItemsAdded + _numberOfItemsRemoved;
					_changeEndGroup = _changeStartGroup;
					_changeEndGroupIndex = _changeStartGroupIndex;
					_changeEndGroupContentIndex = _changeStartGroupContentIndex + num + 1 + Math.Min(numberOfItemsAdded, numberOfItemsRemoved);
					while (true)
					{
						int count = _changeEndGroup._contentItems.Count;
						if (_changeEndGroupContentIndex < count)
						{
							break;
						}

					_linePassLine.IsLastLineInParagraph = true;
					ArrangeContentWithinLine(_linePassLine, _linePassCurrentLineHeight, lines, rearrange: false, lineCompletedCallback);
					return true;
				}
				return true;
			}

			internal bool ProcessGroups(TimeKeeper timeKeeper)
			{
				LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = _pnode.ChildNodes;
				if (childNodes == null)
				{
					_pnode._lines.Clear();
					return true;
				}
				if (_currentRun == null)
				{
					InitializeGroups();
					_currentRun = _pnode.GetRelativeRunNode(next: true);
					_currentRunChildIndex = 0;
				}
				while (_currentRun != null)
				{
					CharacterSettings settingsResolved = _currentRun.SettingsResolved;
					if (_currentRun.IsVisible && !ProcessVisibleRun(timeKeeper, _currentRun, settingsResolved))
					{
						return false;
					}
					_currentRun = _pnode.GetRelativeRunNode(next: true, _currentRun);
					_currentRunChildIndex = 0;
				}
				CleanupGroups();
				ApplyKerningAdjustments();
				return true;
			}

			protected virtual RichTextContentGroupBase AddGroupContent(RichTextGroupContentItem item, bool updateLeafInfo = true)
			{
				if (_currentGroup._contentItems.Count >= LayoutManagerBase.MaxContentItemsPerGroup)
				{
					RichTextContentGroupBase richTextContentGroupBase = _currentGroup.CloneSettings();
					AddGroup(richTextContentGroupBase);
					if (updateLeafInfo && _currentLeafNode._totalContentItems == 0)
					{
						_currentLeafNode._firstGroup = richTextContentGroupBase;
						_currentLeafNode._firstContentIndexInGroup = 0;
					}
				}
				if (updateLeafInfo)
				{
					_currentLeafNode._totalContentItems++;
				}
				if (_currentGroup._characterSettings.AllCaps == true || _currentGroup._characterSettings.SmallCaps == true)
				{
					string text = item._content as string;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						string text2 = text.ToUpper();
						item._content = new ModifiedTextWithKerning(text2, text);
						item._width = new Extent(_metricsProvider.GetTextWidth(text2, _currentGroup.Font), ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
					}
				}
				_currentGroup._contentItems.Add(item);
				_currentGroupContentIndex++;
				return _currentGroup;
			}

			protected virtual void AddGroup(RichTextContentGroupBase newGroup)
			{
				_currentGroup = newGroup;
				newGroup._firstLeafNode = _currentLeafNode;
				_pnode._groups.Add(_currentGroup);
				_currentGroupIndex = _pnode._groups.Count - 1;
				_currentGroup._cachedIndexInGroupsList = _currentGroupIndex;
				_currentGroupContentIndex = -1;
			}

			protected void AnalyzeText(string text)
			{
				int firstNonSpaceIndex = -1;
				bool isFirstBreakInText = true;
				if (_currentGroup._characterSettings.SmallCaps == true)
				{
					_ = _currentGroup._characterSettings.AllCaps != true;
				}
				else
					_ = 0;
				int currentIndex = text.Length;
				int num = currentIndex;
				if (_currentGroup._font != null)
				{
					num = (int)Math.Max(MAX_TEXT_ITEM_WIDTH.LogicalPixels / _currentGroup._font.WidthOfAverageCharacter.LogicalPixels, 5.0);
				}
				if (currentIndex == 0)
				{
					firstNonSpaceIndex = 0;
					ProcessWordBreak(text, ref isFirstBreakInText, isNewLine: false, isWordBreak: false, '\0', ref currentIndex, ref firstNonSpaceIndex);
					return;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < currentIndex; i++)
				{
					char c = text[i];
					if (_currentGroup._sampleCharacter.HasValue && !Utilities.WillUseSameResolvedFont(_currentGroup._sampleCharacter.Value, c, _currentGroup.CharacterSettings))
					{
						ProcessWordBreak(text, ref isFirstBreakInText, isNewLine: false, isWordBreak: true, c, ref i, ref firstNonSpaceIndex);
						flag = false;
						RichTextContentGroupBase richTextContentGroupBase = _currentGroup.CloneSettings();
						AddGroup(richTextContentGroupBase);
						if (i == 0 && this is ParagraphLayoutHelper)
						{
							_currentLeafNode._firstGroup = richTextContentGroupBase;
							_currentLeafNode._firstContentIndexInGroup = 0;
						}
					}
					if (!_currentGroup._sampleCharacter.HasValue)
					{
						_currentGroup._font = _fontCache.GetFont(_document, _metricsProvider, _currentGroup.CharacterSettings, c);
						_currentGroup._sampleCharacter = c;
						num = (int)Math.Max(MAX_TEXT_ITEM_WIDTH.LogicalPixels / _currentGroup._font.WidthOfAverageCharacter.LogicalPixels, 5.0);
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						flag = false;
						ProcessWordBreak(text, ref isFirstBreakInText, isNewLine: false, isWordBreak: true, c, ref i, ref firstNonSpaceIndex);
					}
					switch (Utilities.GetChartype(c))
					{
					case Utilities.CharType.Space:
						if (firstNonSpaceIndex >= 0 || _leadingSpaceCount > 254)
						{
							ProcessWordBreak(text, ref isFirstBreakInText, isNewLine: false, isWordBreak: true, c, ref i, ref firstNonSpaceIndex);
						}
						_leadingSpaceCount++;
						break;
					case Utilities.CharType.Comma:
					case Utilities.CharType.DoubleQuote:
					case Utilities.CharType.Period:
					case Utilities.CharType.Punctuation:
					case Utilities.CharType.SingleQuote:
					case Utilities.CharType.Tab:
						if (firstNonSpaceIndex >= 0)
						{
							ProcessWordBreak(text, ref isFirstBreakInText, isNewLine: false, isWordBreak: true, c, ref i, ref firstNonSpaceIndex);
						}
						firstNonSpaceIndex = i;
						flag = true;
						break;
					case Utilities.CharType.NewLine:
						ProcessWordBreak(text, ref isFirstBreakInText, isNewLine: true, isWordBreak: true, c, ref i, ref firstNonSpaceIndex);
						break;
					case Utilities.CharType.Digit:
					case Utilities.CharType.Letter:
						if (_leadingSpaceCount > 0)
						{
							ProcessWordBreak(text, ref isFirstBreakInText, isNewLine: false, isWordBreak: true, c, ref i, ref firstNonSpaceIndex);
						}
						if (firstNonSpaceIndex < 0)
						{
							firstNonSpaceIndex = i;
						}
						break;
					default:
						if (firstNonSpaceIndex >= 0 || _leadingSpaceCount > 0)
						{
							ProcessWordBreak(text, ref isFirstBreakInText, isNewLine: false, isWordBreak: true, c, ref i, ref firstNonSpaceIndex);
						}
						firstNonSpaceIndex = i;
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					if (firstNonSpaceIndex >= 0 && i - firstNonSpaceIndex > num)
					{
						ProcessWordBreak(text, ref isFirstBreakInText, isNewLine: false, isWordBreak: true, c, ref i, ref firstNonSpaceIndex);
						i--;
					}
				}
				if (firstNonSpaceIndex >= 0 || _leadingSpaceCount > 0)
				{
					ProcessWordBreak(text, ref isFirstBreakInText, isNewLine: false, isWordBreak: false, '\0', ref currentIndex, ref firstNonSpaceIndex);
				}
			}

			protected void ApplyKerningAdjustments()
			{
				string leading = null;
				FontSpecification leadingFont = null;
				RichTextContentGroupBase richTextContentGroupBase = null;
				object obj = null;
				int num = 0;
				int count = _pnode._groups.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					RichTextContentGroupBase groupAtIndex = _pnode.GetGroupAtIndex(i);
					int count2 = groupAtIndex._contentItems.Count;
					for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
					{
						RichTextGroupContentItem richTextGroupContentItem = groupAtIndex._contentItems.Array[j];
						if (richTextGroupContentItem.IsTab || richTextGroupContentItem.IsNewLineOrParagraphMark)
						{
							leading = null;
							richTextContentGroupBase = null;
						}
						else
						{
							string text = richTextGroupContentItem.Text;
							if (richTextContentGroupBase != null)
							{
								double kerningAdjustment = _metricsProvider.GetKerningAdjustment(leading, leadingFont, text, groupAtIndex._font);
								if (obj is ModifiedTextWithKerning modifiedTextWithKerning)
								{
									modifiedTextWithKerning.SetAdjustmentX(new Extent(kerningAdjustment, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels));
								}
								else
								{
									TextWithKerning textWithKerning = obj as TextWithKerning;
									if (kerningAdjustment == 0.0)
									{
										if (textWithKerning != null)
										{
											richTextContentGroupBase._contentItems.Array[num]._content = textWithKerning.UnderlyngText;
										}
									}
									else if (textWithKerning != null)
									{
										textWithKerning.SetAdjustmentX(new Extent(kerningAdjustment, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels));
									}
									else if (obj is string text2)
									{
										richTextContentGroupBase._contentItems.Array[num]._content = new TextWithKerning(text2, new Extent(kerningAdjustment, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels));
									}
								}
							}
							if (richTextGroupContentItem._trailingSpaces > 0)
							{
								richTextContentGroupBase = null;
								leading = null;
							}
							else
							{
								richTextContentGroupBase = groupAtIndex;
								num = j;
								obj = richTextGroupContentItem._content;
								leading = text;
							}
						}
						leadingFont = groupAtIndex._font;
					}
				}
			}

			protected void FixupGroupIndicesOnFollowingLeafNodes(LeafLayoutNode leafNode, bool isLeafBeingRemoved = false)

						{

								break;

						}
					}
					if (isLeafBeingRemoved && richTextContentGroupBase != null && richTextContentGroupBase._firstLeafNode == leafNode)
					{

					}
				}
				if (nextVisibleLeafNode == null)
				{
					int num2 = leafNode._firstContentIndexInGroup + leafNode._totalContentItems;
					while (num2 > 0)
					{
						num2 -= richTextContentGroupBase._contentItems.Count;
						if (num2 > 0)
						{
							if (num + 1 >= _pnode._groups.Count)
							{
								return;
							}
							num++;
							richTextContentGroupBase = _pnode._groups.Array[num];
						}
					}
					if (_pnode._groups.Count > num + 1)
					{
						_pnode._groups.RemoveRange(num + 1, _pnode._groups.Count - (num + 1));
					}
					return;
				}
				int num3 = leafNode._firstContentIndexInGroup + leafNode._totalContentItems;
				bool flag = num3 == 0 && isLeafBeingRemoved;
				while (nextVisibleLeafNode != null)
				{
					while (num3 >= richTextContentGroupBase._contentItems.Count)
					{
						num++;
						if (num >= _pnode._groups.Count)
						{
							return;
						}
						num3 -= richTextContentGroupBase._contentItems.Count;
						richTextContentGroupBase = _pnode._groups.Array[num];
					}
					if (num3 == 0)
					{
						if (richTextContentGroupBase._firstLeafNode == null || richTextContentGroupBase._firstLeafNode == leafNode || flag)
						{

						}

					}

					{

					nextVisibleLeafNode._firstContentIndexInGroup = num3;
					num3 += nextVisibleLeafNode._totalContentItems;
					nextVisibleLeafNode = _pnode.GetNextVisibleLeafNode(nextVisibleLeafNode);
				}
			}

			protected void RemoveContentFromLeaf(LeafLayoutNode leafNode, RichTextContentGroupBase targetGroup, int indexInTargetGroup, int numberOfItemsToRemove)

			private Extent CalculateNextWordWidth(RichTextContentGroupBase group, int groupContentIndex, List<RichTextLineContentData> tempContentItems, out Extent wordHeight, out Extent widthBeforeDecimalSeparator, out Extent trailingSpacesWidth)
			{
				widthBeforeDecimalSeparator = default(Extent);
				if (group is OtherContentGroup)
				{
					tempContentItems.Add(new RichTextLineContentData
					{
						_group = group,
						_contentItemIndexInGroup = 0
					});

					trailingSpacesWidth = new Extent((double)(int)group._contentItems.Array[0]._trailingSpaces * group._font.WidthOfSpace.Emus, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
					return group._contentItems.Array[0]._width;
				}
				Extent extent = default(Extent);
				wordHeight = default(Extent);
				trailingSpacesWidth = default(Extent);
				int i = _pnode.GetIndexOfGroup(group);
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				for (int count = _pnode._groups.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					group = _pnode.GetGroupAtIndex(i);
					int count2 = group._contentItems.Count;
					while (groupContentIndex < count2)
					{
						RichTextLineContentData item = default(RichTextLineContentData);
						RichTextGroupContentItem richTextGroupContentItem = group._contentItems.Array[groupContentIndex];
						item._group = group;
						item._contentItemIndexInGroup = groupContentIndex;
						string underlyngText = richTextGroupContentItem.UnderlyngText;
						if (richTextGroupContentItem.UnderlyngContent == RichTextGroupContentItem.NewLineContentMarker || group is OtherContentGroup || richTextGroupContentItem.IsTab)
						{
