							break;
						}
						if (flag && richTextGroupContentItem.UnderlyngContent != null && extent + richTextGroupContentItem._width > _linePassMaxLineWidth)
						{
							flag2 = true;
							break;
						}
						tempContentItems.Add(item);
						if (richTextGroupContentItem.UnderlyngContent != null)
						{
							extent += richTextGroupContentItem._width;
							flag = true;
						}
						Extent height = group.GetHeight(_isDropCap, alignment: true);
						if (height > wordHeight)
						{
							wordHeight = height;
						}
						if (!_linePassWasDecimalSeparatorFound && _linePassLastTab.HasValue && _linePassLastTab.Value.Alignment == TabStopAlignment.Decimal)
						{
							widthBeforeDecimalSeparator = extent;
							_linePassWasDecimalSeparatorFound = _decimalSeparator == underlyngText;
						}

							if (font != null)
							{
								trailingSpacesWidth = new Extent((double)(int)richTextGroupContentItem._trailingSpaces * font.WidthOfSpace.LogicalPixels, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
							}

							}

								extent += trailingSpacesWidth;
							}
						}
						else

						}
						if (!flag2 && underlyngText != null && underlyngText.Length == 1 && Utilities.IsWordBreakingChar(underlyngText[0]))
						{
							flag2 = true;
							break;
						}
						groupContentIndex++;
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						break;
					}
					groupContentIndex = 0;
				}
				return extent;
			}

			private Extent GetNextTabPosition(Extent offsetX, FontSpecification font, out TabStopLeader leader, out TabStop? tabStop)

			private void ProcessGroupBreak(LeafLayoutNode leafNodeBeingProcessd, int leafContentItemCountRemaining)
			{
				if (_previousContentItemsProcessed > 0 && _previousOldGroup != null)

								{

								}
							}
						}

					}
				}

				_previousStartAtGroupContentIndex = _currentOldGroupContentIndex;

				{

				}

		private struct FontTextKey : IEquatable<FontTextKey>
		{
			private string _text;

			private FontSpecification _font;

			internal FontTextKey(string text, FontSpecification font)
			{
				_text = text;
				_font = font;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return _text.GetHashCode() ^ _font.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is FontTextKey)
				{
					return this == (FontTextKey)obj;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public static bool operator ==(FontTextKey item1, FontTextKey item2)
			{
				if (item1._text == item2._text)
				{
					return item1._font == item2._font;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public static bool operator !=(FontTextKey item1, FontTextKey item2)
			{
				return !(item1 == item2);
			}

			public bool Equals(FontTextKey other)
			{
				return this == other;
			}
		}

		public override Rect? BorderRect
		{

				}

				if (GetFlag(InternalFlags.MergesBordersWithNextSibling))
				{
					double num = logicalPixels2 + logicalPixels3 - value.Bottom;
					value.Height += num + Extent.HalfLogicalToDevicePixelFactor;

				{
					double num2 = value.Top - logicalPixels2;
					value.Y = logicalPixels2 - Extent.HalfLogicalToDevicePixelFactor;
					value.Height += num2 + Extent.LogicalToDevicePixelFactor;
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		internal override CaretLayoutInfo? GetCaretLayoutFromDocumentOffset(int documentOffset, CharacterSettings settingsOverride, LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext context)
		{
			int num = documentOffset - _paragraph.GetDocumentOffset();
			int prefixOffsetCount = _paragraph.PrefixOffsetCount;
			int postfixOffsetCount = _paragraph.PostfixOffsetCount;
			int num2 = _paragraph.AggregateOffsetCount - (prefixOffsetCount + postfixOffsetCount);
			int num3;
			int i;
			if (prefixOffsetCount > 0 && num <= prefixOffsetCount)
			{
				num3 = GetIndexOfFirstNonSpacerLine();
				i = ((num3 < 0) ? (-1) : 0);
				if (num > 0 && _lines.Count > 0)
				{
					num--;
					i++;
					RichTextLine richTextLine = _lines[num3];
					for (int count = richTextLine.Count; i < count && richTextLine._contentItems.Array[i]._group is ListNumberContentGroup; i++)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			else if (num2 == 0 && num == 0)
			{
				num3 = _lines.Count - 1;
				i = ((num3 < 0) ? (-1) : (_lines[num3]._contentItems.Count - 1));
			}
			else
			{
				num -= _paragraph.AggregateOffsetCount - postfixOffsetCount;
				if (_lines.Count > 0)
				{
					num3 = _lines.Count - 1;
					i = _lines[num3].Count - 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = -1;
					i = -1;
				}
			}
			return new CaretLayoutInfo(this, num3, i, documentOffset, num, settingsOverride, context);
		}

		public override IEnumerable<ILayoutBlock> GetChildBlocksInViewPort(Rect viewport)
		{
			if (_lines.Count <= 0)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			double parentOffsetX = OverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
			double parentOffsetY = OverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
			foreach (RichTextLine line in _lines)
			{
				if (parentOffsetY + line.RelativeOffsetY.LogicalPixels > viewport.Bottom)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (!line.HasBlockContent || viewport.Right <= parentOffsetX + line.Width.LogicalPixels)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (RichTextLineContent item in line.GetLineContent(parentOffsetX, viewport.Right - parentOffsetX))
				{
					if (item.Content is ILayoutBlock layoutBlock)
					{
						yield return layoutBlock;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override IRichTextLine GetLineAtDocumentOffset(int documentOffset)
		{
			LeafLayoutNode leafNodeAtDocumentOffset = GetLeafNodeAtDocumentOffset(documentOffset);
			if (leafNodeAtDocumentOffset == null && documentOffset == 0 && _lines.Count > 0)
			{
				return _lines[0];
			}
			if (!GetLineInfoFromDocumentOffsetHelper(documentOffset, leafNodeAtDocumentOffset, includeParagraphMarks: false, out var lineIndex, out var _, out var _))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetLineAtIndex(Math.Min(lineIndex, _lines.Count - 1));
		}

		public override IEnumerable<IRichTextLine> GetLines(Rect? overallRect = null)
		{
			if (_lines.Count <= 0)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			if (overallRect.HasValue)
			{
				double paraOffsetY = ContentOverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
				double endY = overallRect.Value.Bottom;
				if (paraOffsetY > endY)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				double paraOffsetX = ContentOverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
				RichTextMargin? margins = Margins;
				double num = (margins.HasValue ? margins.Value.Left.LogicalPixels : 0.0);
				paraOffsetX -= num;
				if (paraOffsetX > overallRect.Value.Right || Height.LogicalPixels + paraOffsetY < overallRect.Value.Top || Width.LogicalPixels + num + paraOffsetX < overallRect.Value.Left)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				endY -= paraOffsetY;
				double value = Math.Max(overallRect.Value.Top - paraOffsetY, 0.0);
				RichTextLine lineContainingOffsetY = _lines.GetLineContainingOffsetY(new Extent(value, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels));
				foreach (RichTextLine line in _lines.GetLines(lineContainingOffsetY))
				{
					double logicalPixels = line.RelativeOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
					if (!(logicalPixels > endY))
					{
						Rect rect = new Rect(paraOffsetX, paraOffsetY + logicalPixels, line._width.LogicalPixels, line._contentHeight.LogicalPixels);
						rect.Intersect(overallRect.Value);
						if (!rect.IsEmpty)
						{
							yield return line;
						}
						continue;
					}
					yield break;
				}
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (RichTextLine line2 in _lines)
			{
				yield return line2;
			}
		}

		public override RichTextHitTestResult? HitTest(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint)
		{
			double logicalPixels = OverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
			double logicalPixels2 = OverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
			double logicalPixels3 = Height.LogicalPixels;
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(layoutPoint.X - logicalPixels2, layoutPoint.Y - logicalPixels);
			if (point.Y < 0.0 || point.Y > logicalPixels3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ListNumberGroup != null && _lines.Count > 0)
			{
				RichTextLine richTextLine = _lines[0];
				if (richTextLine.Count > 0)
				{
					RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = richTextLine[0];
					if (richTextLineContent.Group is ListNumberContentGroup)
					{
						RichTextMargin? richTextMargin = CalculateMarginAndBorderExtents();
						Extent extent = OverallOffsetX + richTextLineContent.RelativeOffsetX;
						Extent extent2 = OverallOffsetY + richTextLineContent.RelativeOffsetY;
						if (richTextMargin.HasValue)
						{
							extent += richTextMargin.Value.Left;
							extent2 += richTextMargin.Value.Top;
						}
						Rect rect = new Rect(extent.LogicalPixels, extent2.LogicalPixels, richTextLineContent.ContentWidth.LogicalPixels, richTextLineContent.Height.LogicalPixels);
						if (rect.Contains(layoutPoint))
						{
							return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.ParagraphListIndicator, this, this, this);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Point relativePoint = new System.Windows.Point(layoutPoint.X - ContentOverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels, layoutPoint.Y - ContentOverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels);
			RichTextLine lineContainingOffsetY = _lines.GetLineContainingOffsetY(new Extent(relativePoint.Y, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels));
			if (lineContainingOffsetY != null && lineContainingOffsetY.Count > 0 && (lineContainingOffsetY.RelativeOffsetY + lineContainingOffsetY.ContentHeight).LogicalPixels >= relativePoint.Y && lineContainingOffsetY[0].RelativeOffsetX.LogicalPixels < relativePoint.X && lineContainingOffsetY.Width.LogicalPixels > relativePoint.X)
			{
				int? documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint = GetDocumentOffsetFromLayoutPoint(relativePoint, includeListNumbers: false, includeParagraphMarks: true);
				if (documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint.HasValue)
				{
					RichTextDocument document = base.Document;
					if (document != null)
					{
						NodeBase nodeAtDocumentOffset = document.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset(documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint.Value);
						if (nodeAtDocumentOffset != null && LayoutManager.NodeMap.TryGetValue(nodeAtDocumentOffset, out var value))
						{
							HyperlinkNode hyperlinkNode = nodeAtDocumentOffset?.GetAncestorNode<HyperlinkNode>();
							if (hyperlinkNode == null)
							{
								return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.Paragraph, this, this, value);
							}
							if (LayoutManager.NodeMap.TryGetValue(hyperlinkNode, out var value2))
							{
								return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.Hyperlink, this, value2, value);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.Paragraph, this, this, this);
		}

		}

		protected override void OnChildrenAddedAndRemoved(IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> addedNodes, IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> removedNodes)
		{
			LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
			if (layoutManager != null)
			{
				List<LayoutNodeBase> list = null;
				List<LayoutNodeBase> list2 = null;
				if (removedNodes != null)
				{
					list2 = new List<LayoutNodeBase>();
					GetAllDescendantLeafNodes(removedNodes, list2);
				}
				if (addedNodes != null)
				{
					list = new List<LayoutNodeBase>();
					CreateAddedSubTree(addedNodes, layoutManager, list);
				}
				if ((list != null && list.Count > 0) || (list2 != null && list2.Count > 0))
				{
					OnLeavesAddedAndRemoved(list, list2);
				}
				MarkAddedChildrenLoaded(addedNodes);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDisposed()
		{
			if (_paragraph != null)
			{
				int indexOfDocNode = _paragraph.ParentCollection?.IndexOf(_paragraph) ?? (-1);
				VerifySiblingFlags(indexOfDocNode, nextSibling: false, calledFromDispose: true);
				VerifySiblingFlags(indexOfDocNode, nextSibling: true, calledFromDispose: true);
				if (!_paragraph.IsSealed)
				{
					PropertyChangeListenerList.ManageListenerHelper(ref _paragraph, null, this, useWeakReference: false);
				}
			}
			if (_layoutInfo != null)
			{
				_layoutInfo.OnBlockDisposed(this);
			}
		}

		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
			switch (property)
			{
			case "ParagraphMarkSettingsResolved":
				if (_paragraphMarkGroup != null && LayoutManager != null)
				{
					LayoutManager.InvalidateLayout();
				}
				break;
			case "SettingsResolved":
				VerifyLayoutInfo();
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.AreMarginsValid, value: false);
				DirtySettings();
				break;
			case "IndicatorSettingsResolved":
			case "ListItemInfoResolved":
				if (_listNumberGroup != null || _paragraph.IsListItemResolved)
				{
					_listNumberGroup = null;
					SetFlag(InternalFlags.AreMarginsValid, value: false);
					DirtySettings();
				}
				break;
			case "StyleId":
				VerifyContextualLayoutInfo();
				break;
			}
		}

		internal override bool ProcessLayout(ref object processStatusInfo, TimeKeeper timeKeeper, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
		{
			ParagraphLayoutHelper paragraphLayoutHelper = processStatusInfo as ParagraphLayoutHelper;
			if (paragraphLayoutHelper == null)
			{
				SetWidth(default(Extent));
				_constraintX = constraintX;
				_constraintY = constraintY;
				paragraphLayoutHelper = (ParagraphLayoutHelper)(processStatusInfo = new ParagraphLayoutHelper(this));
				_lines.Clear();
				if (base.AreDescendantSettingsDirty)
				{
					_groups.Clear();
					SetFlag(InternalFlags.AreGroupsValid, value: false);
				}
				ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
			}
			if (!GetFlag(InternalFlags.AreGroupsValid))
			{
				if (!paragraphLayoutHelper.ProcessGroups(timeKeeper))
				{
					return false;
				}
				_groups.TrimExcess();
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.AreGroupsValid, value: true);
			}
			return paragraphLayoutHelper.LayoutLines(timeKeeper);
		}

		internal override bool ProcessSettingsChanged(ref object processStatusInfo, TimeKeeper timeKeeper, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
		{
			ParagraphLayoutHelper paragraphLayoutHelper = processStatusInfo as ParagraphLayoutHelper;
			if (paragraphLayoutHelper == null)
			{
				if (!base.AreSettingsDirty && !base.AreDescendantSettingsDirty)
				{
					return true;
				}
				paragraphLayoutHelper = new ParagraphLayoutHelper(this);
				_groups.Clear();
				_lines.Clear();
				processStatusInfo = paragraphLayoutHelper;
				paragraphLayoutHelper.ProcessGroups(TimeKeeper.Perpetual);
				_groups.TrimExcess();
			}
			bool num = paragraphLayoutHelper.LayoutLines(TimeKeeper.Perpetual);
			if (num)
			{
				InvalidateMinMaxWidth(paragraphLayoutHelper._previousWidth, paragraphLayoutHelper._previousHeight);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("Paragraph");
			LeafLayoutNode firstVisibleLeafNode = FirstVisibleLeafNode;
			if (firstVisibleLeafNode != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat(": first run='{0}'", firstVisibleLeafNode.ParentLayoutNode);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static void CreateAddedSubTree(IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> addedNodes, LayoutManagerBase lm, List<LayoutNodeBase> addedLeafNodes)
		{
			foreach (LayoutNodeBase addedNode in addedNodes)
			{
				if (!(addedNode is RunLayoutNode run))
				{
					if (!(addedNode is HyperlinkLayoutNode hyperlinkLayoutNode))
					{
						continue;
					}
					NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection nonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection = (NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection)(hyperlinkLayoutNode.ChildNodes = new NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection());
					NodeBase documentNode = hyperlinkLayoutNode.DocumentNode;
					if (documentNode.ChildNodes == null)
					{
						if (addedLeafNodes == null)
						{
							hyperlinkLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
						}
						continue;
					}
					foreach (NodeBase childNode in documentNode.ChildNodes)
					{
						if (LayoutNodeBase.Create(childNode, lm, hyperlinkLayoutNode) is RunLayoutNode runLayoutNode)
						{
							nonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.Add(runLayoutNode);
							CreateAddedSubTreeForRun(lm, addedLeafNodes, runLayoutNode);
							runLayoutNode.ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
							runLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					CreateAddedSubTreeForRun(lm, addedLeafNodes, run);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void CreateAddedSubTreeForRun(LayoutManagerBase lm, List<LayoutNodeBase> addedLeafNodes, RunLayoutNode run)
		{
			NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection nonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection = (NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection)(run.ChildNodes = new NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection());
			NodeBase documentNode = run.DocumentNode;
			if (documentNode.ChildNodes == null)
			{
				if (addedLeafNodes == null)
				{
					run.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (NodeBase childNode in documentNode.ChildNodes)
			{
				LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = LayoutNodeBase.Create(childNode, lm, run);
				if (layoutNodeBase != null)
				{
					nonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.Add(layoutNodeBase);
					addedLeafNodes?.Add(layoutNodeBase);
				}
			}
			if (addedLeafNodes == null)
			{
				run.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
			}
			run.ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
		}

		public int GetDocumentOffsetCountOfLine(IRichTextLine line, bool includeListNumber, bool includeNewLine)
		{
			RichTextLine richTextLine = line as RichTextLine;
			int? documentOffsetOfLine = GetDocumentOffsetOfLine(line, includeListNumber);
			if (!documentOffsetOfLine.HasValue)
			{
				if (_paragraph == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _paragraph.GetDocumentOffset();
			}
			int documentOffsetCount = richTextLine.GetDocumentOffsetCount(includeListNumber, includeNewLine);
			int offset = documentOffsetOfLine.Value + documentOffsetCount;
			return documentOffsetCount + GetHiddenContentOffsetCount(documentOffsetOfLine.Value, offset);
		}

		internal CaretLayoutInfo? GetCaretLayoutFromDocumentOffset(int documentOffset, LayoutNodeBase descendantNode, CharacterSettings settingsOverride, LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext context)
		{
			int visibleDocumentOffsetFromOffset = GetVisibleDocumentOffsetFromOffset(documentOffset, navigateRight: true);
			if (visibleDocumentOffsetFromOffset != documentOffset)
			{
				LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
				if (layoutManager != null)
				{
					NodeBase nodeAtDocumentOffset = layoutManager.Document.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset(visibleDocumentOffsetFromOffset);
					layoutManager.NodeMap.TryGetValue(nodeAtDocumentOffset, out descendantNode);
				}
			}
			LeafLayoutNode leafLayoutNode = descendantNode as LeafLayoutNode;
			if (leafLayoutNode == null)
			{
				if (!(descendantNode is ParagraphChildLayoutNodeBase paragraphChildLayoutNodeBase))
				{
					Utilities.LogDebuggerError("descendent node of ParagraphLayoutNode is not a RunLayoutNode, HyperlinkLayoutNode or LeafLayoutNode in GetCaretLayoutFromDocumentOffset");
					return null;
				}
				leafLayoutNode = paragraphChildLayoutNodeBase.FirstLeafNode;
				if (leafLayoutNode == null)
				{
					Utilities.LogDebuggerError("RunLayoutNode or HyperlinkLayoutNode does not have any child leaf nodes in GetCaretLayoutFromDocumentOffset");
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (!GetLineInfoFromDocumentOffsetHelper(documentOffset, leafLayoutNode, context == LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext.EndOfSelection, out var lineIndex, out var lineContentIndex, out var documentOffsetRemaining))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new CaretLayoutInfo(this, lineIndex, lineContentIndex, documentOffset, documentOffsetRemaining, settingsOverride, context);
		}

				{
					paragraphLayoutHelper.ProcessGroups(TimeKeeper.Perpetual);
					_groups.TrimExcess();
					SetFlag(InternalFlags.AreGroupsValid, value: true);
				}
				_minMaxWidth = paragraphLayoutHelper.CalculateMinMaxWidth();
			}
			return _minMaxWidth;
		}

		public int? GetDocumentOffsetFromLayoutPoint(System.Windows.Point relativePoint, bool includeListNumbers, bool includeParagraphMarks)
		{
			Extent extent = new Extent(Math.Max(relativePoint.X, 0.0), ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			Extent extent2 = new Extent(Math.Max(relativePoint.Y, 0.0), ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			Extent height = Height;
			if (height < extent2)
			{
				extent2 = height;
			}
			int documentOffset = _paragraph.GetDocumentOffset();
			int aggregateOffsetCount = _paragraph.AggregateOffsetCount;
			int prefixOffsetCount = _paragraph.PrefixOffsetCount;
			int postfixOffsetCount = _paragraph.PostfixOffsetCount;
			if (prefixOffsetCount > 0)
			{
				if (includeListNumbers)
				{
					RichTextMargin? richTextMargin = CalculateMarginAndBorderExtents();
					double num = relativePoint.X + OverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
					double num2 = relativePoint.Y + OverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
					if (richTextMargin.HasValue)
					{
						_ = richTextMargin.Value.Left;
						num += richTextMargin.Value.Left.LogicalPixels;
						_ = richTextMargin.Value.Top;
						num2 += richTextMargin.Value.Top.LogicalPixels;
					}
					System.Windows.Point layoutPoint = new System.Windows.Point(num, num2);
					RichTextHitTestResult? richTextHitTestResult = HitTest(layoutPoint);
					if (richTextHitTestResult.HasValue && richTextHitTestResult.Value.Area == RichTextHitTestResultArea.ParagraphListIndicator)
					{
						return documentOffset;
					}
				}
				if (postfixOffsetCount == 0 || extent2 < height)
				{
					RichTextLine richTextLine = ((_lines.Count > 0) ? _lines[0] : null);
					if (richTextLine == null)
					{
						return documentOffset + prefixOffsetCount - 1;
					}
					if (richTextLine.RelativeOffsetY + richTextLine.OverallHeight >= extent2 && richTextLine[0].RelativeOffsetX > extent)
					{
						return documentOffset + prefixOffsetCount - 1;
					}
				}
			}
			if (postfixOffsetCount > 0)
			{
				RichTextLine richTextLine2 = ((_lines.Count > 0) ? _lines[_lines.Count - 1] : null);
				int? num3 = null;
				if (richTextLine2 == null)
				{
					num3 = Math.Max(documentOffset + prefixOffsetCount - 1, 0);
				}
				else if (richTextLine2.RelativeOffsetY < extent2 && richTextLine2[richTextLine2.Count - 1].RelativeOffsetX < extent)
				{
					num3 = documentOffset + _paragraph.AggregateOffsetCount - postfixOffsetCount;
				}
				if (num3.HasValue)
				{
					if (includeParagraphMarks)
					{
						num3++;
					}
					return num3.Value;
				}
			}
			RichTextLine richTextLine3 = _lines.GetLineContainingOffsetY(extent2);
			if (richTextLine3 == null)
			{
				if (_lines.Count == 0)
				{
					return documentOffset;
				}
				richTextLine3 = _lines[_lines.Count - 1];
			}
			if (richTextLine3.Count == 0)
			{
				return documentOffset;
			}
			double offsetX = relativePoint.X;
			bool isAtEnd;
			RichTextLineContentData? contentItem;
			int lineContentIndexAtOffset = richTextLine3.GetLineContentIndexAtOffset(ref offsetX, excludeListNumber: true, out isAtEnd, out contentItem);
			if (lineContentIndexAtOffset < 0)
			{
				return documentOffset + prefixOffsetCount;
			}
			if (lineContentIndexAtOffset >= richTextLine3._contentItems.Count)
			{
				return documentOffset + aggregateOffsetCount - postfixOffsetCount;
			}
			RichTextLineContentData richTextLineContentData = richTextLine3._contentItems.Array[lineContentIndexAtOffset];
			RichTextContentGroupBase richTextContentGroupBase = richTextLineContentData._group;
			int contentItemIndexInGroup = richTextLineContentData._contentItemIndexInGroup;
			LeafLayoutNode firstLeafNode = richTextContentGroupBase._firstLeafNode;
			if (firstLeafNode == null || firstLeafNode.DocumentNode == null)
			{
				return documentOffset + aggregateOffsetCount - postfixOffsetCount;
			}
			int num4 = firstLeafNode.DocumentNode.GetDocumentOffset();
			int offset = num4;
			RichTextContentGroupBase firstGroup = firstLeafNode._firstGroup;
			int indexOfGroup = GetIndexOfGroup(firstGroup);
			if (indexOfGroup < 0)
			{
				Utilities.LogDebuggerError("start group not in groups collection");
				return num4;
			}
			int firstContentIndexInGroup = firstLeafNode._firstContentIndexInGroup;
			bool flag = false;
			int count = _groups.Count;
			int num5 = indexOfGroup;
			int i = firstContentIndexInGroup;
			while (num5 < count)
			{
				RichTextContentGroupBase richTextContentGroupBase2 = _groups.Array[num5];
				for (int count2 = richTextContentGroupBase2._contentItems.Count; i < count2; i++)
				{
					RichTextGroupContentItem richTextGroupContentItem = richTextContentGroupBase2._contentItems.Array[i];
					if (richTextContentGroupBase2 == richTextContentGroupBase && i == contentItemIndexInGroup)
					{
						if (isAtEnd && contentItem.HasValue)
						{
							num4 += richTextGroupContentItem.OverallOffsetCount - 1;
						}
						break;
					}
					num4 += richTextGroupContentItem.OverallOffsetCount;
				}
				if (richTextContentGroupBase2 == richTextContentGroupBase)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				num5++;
				i = 0;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				Utilities.LogDebuggerError("GetDocumentOffsetFromRelativePoint failed. Target content not found", 50);
			}
			if (offsetX > 0.0)
			{
				RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = richTextLine3[lineContentIndexAtOffset];
				_ = richTextLineContent.ContentWidth;
				double logicalPixels = richTextLineContent.ContentWidth.LogicalPixels;
				if (offsetX >= logicalPixels)
				{
					offsetX -= logicalPixels;
					num4 += richTextLineContent.ContentOffsetCount;
					if (offsetX > 0.0 && richTextLineContent.TrailingSpaces > 0)
					{
						double logicalPixels2 = richTextLineContent.Font.WidthOfSpace.LogicalPixels;
						int val = (int)Math.Round(offsetX / logicalPixels2, 0);
						num4 += Math.Min(richTextLineContent.TrailingSpaces, val);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					string textForNavigation = richTextLineContent.TextForNavigation;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(textForNavigation) || (richTextLineContent.ContentType != RichTextLineContentType.Image && richTextLineContent.ContentType != RichTextLineContentType.Object))
					{
						if (textForNavigation == null)
						{
							if (offsetX > richTextLineContent.OverallWidth.LogicalPixels / 2.0)
							{
								num4++;
							}
						}
						else if (richTextLineContent.IsTab)
						{
							if (offsetX > richTextLineContent.OverallWidth.LogicalPixels / 2.0)
							{
								num4++;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							int characterIndexFromOffset = LayoutManager.MetricsProvider.GetCharacterIndexFromOffset(textForNavigation, richTextLineContent.Font, offsetX);
							if (characterIndexFromOffset > 0)
							{
								num4 += characterIndexFromOffset;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return num4 + GetHiddenContentOffsetCount(offset, num4);
		}

		public int? GetDocumentOffsetOfLine(IRichTextLine line, bool includeListNumber)
		{
			if (_paragraph == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int indexOfLine = GetIndexOfLine(line);
			if (indexOfLine < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = _paragraph.GetDocumentOffset();
			if (!includeListNumber)
			{
				num += _paragraph.PrefixOffsetCount;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < indexOfLine; i++)
			{
				num += _lines[i].GetDocumentOffsetCount(includeListNumber: false, includeNewLine: true);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal int GetIndexOfGroup(RichTextContentGroupBase group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int count = _groups.Count;
			if (group._cachedIndexInGroupsList >= 0 && group._cachedIndexInGroupsList < count && group == _groups.Array[group._cachedIndexInGroupsList])
			{
				return group._cachedIndexInGroupsList;
			}
			if (group == _paragraphMarkGroup)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int result = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				RichTextContentGroupBase obj = _groups.Array[i];
				obj._cachedIndexInGroupsList = i;
				if (obj == group)
				{
					result = i;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal LeafLayoutNode GetLeafNodeAtDocumentOffset(int documentOffset)
		{
			int offset = documentOffset - _paragraph.GetDocumentOffset();
			NodeBase nodeAtOffset = _paragraph.GetNodeAtOffset(ref offset);
			if (nodeAtOffset == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!LayoutManager.NodeMap.TryGetValue(nodeAtOffset, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value as LeafLayoutNode;
		}

		public LeafLayoutNode GetRelativeVisibleLeafNode(bool next, LeafLayoutNode leafNode = null)
		{
			if (leafNode == null)
			{
				if (!next)
				{
					return LastVisibleLeafNode;
				}
				return FirstVisibleLeafNode;
			}
			RunLayoutNode runLayoutNode = leafNode.ParentLayoutNode as RunLayoutNode;
			IRunLayoutNodeContainer runLayoutNodeContainer = runLayoutNode.ParentLayoutNode as IRunLayoutNodeContainer;
			while (runLayoutNode != null)
			{
				if (runLayoutNode.IsVisible)
				{
					leafNode = runLayoutNode.GetRelativeVisibleLeafNode(next, leafNode);
					if (leafNode != null)
					{
						return leafNode;
					}
				}
				leafNode = null;
				runLayoutNode = runLayoutNodeContainer.GetRelativeRunNode(next, runLayoutNode);
				if (runLayoutNode != null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!(runLayoutNodeContainer is HyperlinkLayoutNode childNode))
				{
					return null;
				}
				do
				{
					ParagraphChildLayoutNodeBase relativeVisibleChildNode = GetRelativeVisibleChildNode(next, childNode);
					if (relativeVisibleChildNode == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					runLayoutNode = relativeVisibleChildNode as RunLayoutNode;
					if (runLayoutNode != null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					runLayoutNodeContainer = relativeVisibleChildNode as IRunLayoutNodeContainer;
					runLayoutNode = runLayoutNodeContainer.GetRelativeRunNode(next);
					if (runLayoutNode == null)
					{
						relativeVisibleChildNode = GetRelativeVisibleChildNode(next, childNode);
						if (relativeVisibleChildNode == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						runLayoutNode = relativeVisibleChildNode as RunLayoutNode;
					}
				}
				while (runLayoutNode == null);
				runLayoutNodeContainer = runLayoutNode.ParentLayoutNode as IRunLayoutNodeContainer;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal IEnumerable<LeafLayoutNode> GetRelativeVisibleLeafNodes(LeafLayoutNode leaf = null, bool reverse = false)
		{
			while (true)
			{
				leaf = GetRelativeVisibleLeafNode(!reverse, leaf);
				if (leaf == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				yield return leaf;
			}
		}

		public RunLayoutNode GetRelativeRunNode(bool next, RunLayoutNode runNode = null, bool includeHiddenRuns = false)
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = childNodes.Count;
			int i;
			if (runNode != null)
			{
				if (runNode.ParentLayoutNode is HyperlinkLayoutNode hyperlinkLayoutNode)
				{
					RunLayoutNode relativeRunNode = hyperlinkLayoutNode.GetRelativeRunNode(next, runNode, includeHiddenRuns);
					if (relativeRunNode != null)
					{
						return relativeRunNode;
					}
					i = childNodes.IndexOf(hyperlinkLayoutNode);
				}
				else
				{
					i = childNodes.IndexOf(runNode);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				i = ((!next) ? (count - 1) : 0);
			}
			if (i < 0 || i >= count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = (next ? 1 : (-1));
			int num2 = (next ? count : (-1));
			if (runNode != null)
			{
				i += num;
			}
			for (; i != num2; i += num)
			{
				LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = childNodes[i];
				runNode = layoutNodeBase as RunLayoutNode;
				if (runNode == null)
				{
					if (layoutNodeBase is HyperlinkLayoutNode hyperlinkLayoutNode2)
					{
						return hyperlinkLayoutNode2.GetRelativeRunNode(next, null, includeHiddenRuns);
					}
				}
				else if (includeHiddenRuns || runNode.IsVisible)
				{
					return runNode;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Range GetRangeOfContentAtDocumentOffset(int documentOffset, LayoutManagerBase.RelativeContentPosition relativeContentPosition)
		{
			RichTextDocument document = base.Document;
			NodeBase nodeAtDocumentOffset = document.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset(documentOffset);
			RunNode runNode = ((nodeAtDocumentOffset != null) ? (nodeAtDocumentOffset.Parent as RunNode) : null);
			HyperlinkNode hyperlinkNode = ((runNode != null) ? (runNode.Parent as HyperlinkNode) : null);
			if (hyperlinkNode != null)
			{
				DocumentSpan documentSpan = hyperlinkNode.GetDocumentSpan();
				return new Range(document, documentSpan.Start, documentSpan.End);
			}
			LeafLayoutNode leafNodeAtDocumentOffset = GetLeafNodeAtDocumentOffset(documentOffset);
			if (!GetLineInfoFromDocumentOffsetHelper(documentOffset, leafNodeAtDocumentOffset, includeParagraphMarks: false, out var lineIndex, out var lineContentIndex, out var documentOffsetRemaining))
			{
				return new Range(document, documentOffset, Math.Min(documentOffset + 1, base.Root.DocumentNode.AggregateOffsetCount - 1));
			}
			if (!(GetLineAtIndex(lineIndex) is RichTextLine richTextLine))
			{
				return new Range(document, documentOffset, Math.Min(documentOffset + 1, base.Root.DocumentNode.AggregateOffsetCount - 1));
			}
			RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = richTextLine[lineContentIndex];
			int num = documentOffset - documentOffsetRemaining;
			int num2 = num + richTextLineContent.ContentOffsetCount + richTextLineContent.TrailingSpaces;
			int lineContentIndex2 = lineContentIndex;
			num -= GetCountToStartOfThisWord(richTextLine, ref lineContentIndex);
			num2 += GetCountToEndOfThisWord(richTextLine, ref lineContentIndex2);
			return new Range(document, num, num2);
		}

		private int GetVisibleDocumentOffsetFromOffset(int documentOffset, bool navigateRight)
		{
			NodeBase nodeAtDocumentOffset = base.Document.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset(documentOffset);
			if (nodeAtDocumentOffset == null)
			{
				return documentOffset;
			}
			RunNode ancestorNode = nodeAtDocumentOffset.GetAncestorNode<RunNode>();
			if (ancestorNode == null || ancestorNode.SettingsResolved.Hidden != true)
			{
				return documentOffset;
			}
			LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
			RunLayoutNode runLayoutNode = null;
			if (layoutManager != null && layoutManager.NodeMap.TryGetValue(ancestorNode, out var value))
			{
				runLayoutNode = value as RunLayoutNode;
			}
			if (runLayoutNode == null)
			{
				return documentOffset;
			}
			NodeBase nodeBase = GetRelativeRunNode(navigateRight, runLayoutNode)?.DocumentNode;
			if (nodeBase != null)
			{
				documentOffset = nodeBase.GetDocumentOffset();
				if (!navigateRight)
				{
					return documentOffset + nodeBase.AggregateOffsetCount - 1;
				}
				return documentOffset;
			}
			if (navigateRight)
			{
				return _paragraph.GetDocumentOffset() + _paragraph.AggregateOffsetCount - _paragraph.PostfixOffsetCount;
			}
			return _paragraph.GetDocumentOffset();
		}

		internal ParagraphLayoutNode GetSiblingParagraph(bool next, bool crossParents = false, double? preferredXOffset = null)
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = base.ParentLayoutNode.ChildNodes;
			int num = childNodes.IndexOf(this);
			if (next)
			{
				if (num >= childNodes.Count - 1)
				{
					return GetCrossParentSiblingHelper(next, crossParents, preferredXOffset);
				}
				num++;
			}
			else
			{
				if (num < 1)
				{
					return GetCrossParentSiblingHelper(next, crossParents, preferredXOffset);
				}
				num--;
			}
			BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode = childNodes[num] as BlockLayoutNode;
			if (blockLayoutNode is ParagraphLayoutNode result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (crossParents)
			{
				return GetCrossParentSiblingHelper(next, crossParents, preferredXOffset);
			}
			if (blockLayoutNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (next)
			{
				return blockLayoutNode.GetFirstParagraph();
			}
			return blockLayoutNode.GetLastParagraph();
		}

		internal FloatingParagraphGroupInfo GetSiblingParagraphLayoutInfo(bool next)
		{
			return GetSiblingParagraph(next)?._layoutInfo;
		}

		internal void RefreshWidth(bool force = false)
		{
			if (!force && ParentCell != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Extent extent = default(Extent);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _lines.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				RichTextLine richTextLine = _lines[i];
				richTextLine.VerifyLineWidth();
				Extent width = richTextLine._width;
				if (width > extent)
				{
					extent = width;
				}
			}
			if (extent.LogicalPixels == 0.0)
			{
				extent = new Extent(1.0, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			}
			RichTextMargin? richTextMargin = CalculateMarginAndBorderExtents();
			if (richTextMargin.HasValue)
			{
				_ = richTextMargin.Value.Left;
				extent += richTextMargin.Value.Left;
				_ = richTextMargin.Value.Right;
				extent += richTextMargin.Value.Right;
			}
			SetWidth(extent);
		}

		private static Extent AllocateSpacingProportionally(Extent value, Extent setting, Extent otherSetting)
		{
			double logicalPixels = (setting + otherSetting).LogicalPixels;
			if (logicalPixels <= 0.0)
			{
				return value;
			}
			double num = setting.LogicalPixels / logicalPixels;
			return Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(new Extent(value.LogicalPixels * num, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels));
		}

					}

			}
		}

		private int GetCountToEndOfThisWord(RichTextLine line, ref int lineContentIndex)

				}

			}

		}

		private int NavigateToPreferredOffsetInLine(int lineIndex, bool up, double preferredXOffset, bool includeParagraphMarks, bool startOfLine, bool endOfLine)
		{

			int num;

			{
				num = richTextLine.GetDocumentOffsetCount(includeListNumber: true, includeNewLine: true);
			}

			{
				num = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				preferredXOffset -= ContentOverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels;

				if (contentItem.HasValue && remainingXOffset > 0.0)
				{
					string textForNavigation = contentItem.Value.TextForNavigation;
					if (textForNavigation != null)
					{

						if (remainingXOffset >= logicalPixels)
						{
							num += textForNavigation.Length;
							remainingXOffset -= logicalPixels;
							double logicalPixels2 = contentItem.Value.Font.WidthOfSpace.LogicalPixels;
							if (remainingXOffset >= logicalPixels2)
							{
								num += Math.Min(contentItem.Value.TrailingSpaces, (int)Math.Round(remainingXOffset / logicalPixels2));
							}
						}

							if (characterIndexFromOffset >= 0)

		private int NavigateToSiblingParagraph(int documentOffset, bool up, double preferredXOffset, bool includeParagraphMarks, bool startOfLine, bool endOfLine)
		{
			ParagraphLayoutNode siblingParagraph = GetSiblingParagraph(!up, crossParents: true, preferredXOffset);
			if (siblingParagraph != null)
			{
				while (siblingParagraph != null)
				{
					if (siblingParagraph.LineCount == 0)
					{
						return documentOffset;
					}
					int lineIndex = (up ? (siblingParagraph.LineCount - 1) : 0);
					int num = siblingParagraph.NavigateToPreferredOffsetInLine(lineIndex, up, preferredXOffset, includeParagraphMarks, startOfLine, endOfLine);
					if (num == documentOffset)
					{
						siblingParagraph = siblingParagraph.GetSiblingParagraph(!up, crossParents: true, preferredXOffset);
						continue;
					}
					return num;
				}
			}
			else if (includeParagraphMarks && _lines.Count > 0)
			{
				if (up)
				{
					if (!startOfLine)
					{
						return NavigateToPreferredOffsetInLine(0, up, preferredXOffset, includeParagraphMarks, startOfLine: true, endOfLine: false);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!endOfLine)
					{
						return NavigateToPreferredOffsetInLine(_lines.Count - 1, up, preferredXOffset, includeParagraphMarks, startOfLine: false, endOfLine: true);
					}

					if (!includeParagraphMarks)
					{

					}
				}
			}

		}

		private void OnLayoutComplete()
		{
			TableCellLayoutNode parentCell = ParentCell;
			if (parentCell == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = -1;
				Extent constraintX = _constraintX;
				foreach (RichTextLine line in _lines)
				{
					line.UseExplicitWidth = false;
					line.VerifyLineWidth();
					if (line.WidthIncludingParagraphMark > constraintX)
					{
						num2 = num;
						break;
					}
					num++;
				}
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				int lineCount = LineCount;
				for (int i = num2; i < lineCount; i++)
				{
					RichTextLine richTextLine = _lines[i];
					if (i > num2)
					{
						richTextLine.UseExplicitWidth = false;
						richTextLine.VerifyLineWidth();
					}
					bool isLastLineInParagraph = richTextLine.IsLastLineInParagraph;
					int num3 = richTextLine._contentItems.Count - 1;
					if (isLastLineInParagraph)
					{
						num3--;
					}
					if (num3 < 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Extent widthIncludingParagraphMark = richTextLine.WidthIncludingParagraphMark;
					Extent extent = widthIncludingParagraphMark - richTextLine.Width;
					Extent value = widthIncludingParagraphMark - (constraintX + extent);
					if (value.Emus <= 0.0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					RichTextLineContentData richTextLineContentData = richTextLine._contentItems.Array[num3];
					if (!(richTextLineContentData._group is TextContentGroup textContentGroup) || textContentGroup._contentItems.Count == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					RichTextGroupContentItem contentItem = textContentGroup._contentItems.Array[richTextLineContentData._contentItemIndexInGroup];
					Extent extent2 = RichTextGroupContentItem.CalculateTrailingSpacesWidth(textContentGroup.Font, 1.0, contentItem);
					if (!(extent2.Emus > 0.0))
					{
						continue;
					}
					value = Extent.Min(value, extent2);
					if (value.Emus > 0.0)
					{
						int trailingSpaces = contentItem._trailingSpaces;
						Extent extent3 = extent2 / trailingSpaces;
						byte b = (byte)Math.Ceiling(value.Emus / extent3.Emus);
						Extent extent4 = extent3 * (int)b;
						richTextLine._width -= extent4;
						richTextLine.UseExplicitWidth = true;
						TableLayoutNode parentTable = ParentTable;
						TableNode tableNode = ((parentTable != null) ? (parentTable.DocumentNode as TableNode) : null);
						if (tableNode != null)
						{
							TableSettings settingsResolved = tableNode.SettingsResolved;
							parentCell.IsContentWidthClipped = !settingsResolved.PreferredWidth.HasValue || settingsResolved.PreferredWidth.Value.UnitTypeResolved != TableExtentUnitType.Auto;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				RefreshWidth(force: true);
			}
		}

		private static void ResolveSpacingExtents(ParagraphNode paragraph, IRichTextMetricsProvider metricsProvider, out Extent beforeParagraph, out Extent afterParagraph, bool isFirstNodeInParent = false, bool isLastNodeInParent = false, bool isInTable = false)
		{
			beforeParagraph = default(Extent);
			afterParagraph = default(Extent);
			if (paragraph.Document == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ParagraphSettings settingsResolved = paragraph.SettingsResolved;
			if (settingsResolved == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ParagraphSpacingSettings spacing = settingsResolved.Spacing;
			if (spacing == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ParagraphVerticalSpacing? beforeParagraph2 = spacing.BeforeParagraph;
			ParagraphVerticalSpacing? afterParagraph2 = spacing.AfterParagraph;
			if (beforeParagraph2.HasValue || afterParagraph2.HasValue)
			{
				FontSpecification font = FontSpecificationCache.Instance.GetFont(paragraph.Document, metricsProvider, paragraph.RunSettingsResolved);
				if (beforeParagraph2.HasValue)
				{
					beforeParagraph = beforeParagraph2.Value.CalculateExtext(font, isBeforeSpacing: true, isFirstNodeInParent, isLastNodeInParent, isInTable);
				}
				if (afterParagraph2.HasValue)
				{
					afterParagraph = afterParagraph2.Value.CalculateExtext(font, isBeforeSpacing: false, isFirstNodeInParent, isLastNodeInParent, isInTable);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetTopAndBottomMargins(bool checkValidFlag)

			if (metricsProvider == null)

			bool isFirstNodeInParent = false;

			ParagraphNode paragraphNode = null;

			NodeCollection parentCollection = _paragraph.ParentCollection;
			if (parentCollection != null)
			{
				int num = parentCollection.IndexOf(_paragraph);
				isFirstNodeInParent = num == 0;
				isLastNodeInParent = num == parentCollection.Count - 1;
				isInTable = _paragraph.Parent is TableCellNode;
				ParagraphLayoutNode siblingParagraph = GetSiblingParagraph(next: true, crossParents: true);
				ParagraphLayoutNode siblingParagraph2 = GetSiblingParagraph(next: false, crossParents: true);
				paragraphNode = ((siblingParagraph != null) ? (siblingParagraph.DocumentNode as ParagraphNode) : null);
				paragraphNode2 = ((siblingParagraph2 != null) ? (siblingParagraph2.DocumentNode as ParagraphNode) : null);
			}
			ResolveSpacingExtents(_paragraph, metricsProvider, out var beforeParagraph, out var afterParagraph, isFirstNodeInParent, isLastNodeInParent, isInTable);
			afterParagraph = ((paragraphNode == null || !IsContextual || !(_paragraph.StyleId == paragraphNode.StyleId)) ? Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(afterParagraph, 0) : default(Extent));
			if (paragraphNode2 != null && IsContextual && _paragraph.StyleId == paragraphNode2.StyleId)
			{
				beforeParagraph = default(Extent);
			}
			else
			{
				if (paragraphNode2 != null)
				{
					ResolveSpacingExtents(paragraphNode2, metricsProvider, out var _, out var afterParagraph2);
					beforeParagraph -= afterParagraph2;
				}
				beforeParagraph = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(beforeParagraph, 0);
			}
			if (!margins.HasValue || !(margins.Value.Bottom == afterParagraph) || !(margins.Value.Top == beforeParagraph) || !(margins.Value.Left == value.Left) || !(margins.Value.Right == value.Right))
			{
				value.Bottom = afterParagraph;
				value.Top = beforeParagraph;
				base.Margins = value;
			}
		}

		private void VerifyContextualLayoutInfo()
		{
			if (base.ParentLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded)
			{
				ParagraphLayoutNode siblingParagraph = GetSiblingParagraph(next: false);
				ParagraphLayoutNode siblingParagraph2 = GetSiblingParagraph(next: true);
				VerifyContextualLaoutInfo_Impl(siblingParagraph, siblingParagraph2);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyContextualLaoutInfo_Impl(LayoutNodeBase previousBlock, LayoutNodeBase nextBlock)
		{
			if (base.ParentLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded)
			{
				ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphLayoutNode = previousBlock as ParagraphLayoutNode;
				if (paragraphLayoutNode == null && previousBlock != null)
				{
					paragraphLayoutNode = GetSiblingParagraph(next: false);
				}
				ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphLayoutNode2 = nextBlock as ParagraphLayoutNode;
				if (paragraphLayoutNode2 == null && nextBlock != null)
				{
					paragraphLayoutNode2 = GetSiblingParagraph(next: true);
				}
				int indexOfDocNode = _paragraph.ParentCollection?.IndexOf(_paragraph) ?? (-1);
				VerifySiblingFlags(indexOfDocNode, nextSibling: false, calledFromDispose: false, calledFromAdd: true, paragraphLayoutNode);
				VerifySiblingFlags(indexOfDocNode, nextSibling: true, calledFromDispose: false, calledFromAdd: true, paragraphLayoutNode2);
				if (paragraphLayoutNode != null && paragraphLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded && paragraphLayoutNode.GetFlag(InternalFlags.AreGroupsValid))
				{
					paragraphLayoutNode.VerifyTopAndBottomMargins();
				}
				if (paragraphLayoutNode2 != null && paragraphLayoutNode2.IsSubTreeLoaded && paragraphLayoutNode2.GetFlag(InternalFlags.AreGroupsValid))
				{
					paragraphLayoutNode2.VerifyTopAndBottomMargins();
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyLastLine(LayoutHelperBase helper, bool forceHeightInvalidation)
		{
			bool flag = forceHeightInvalidation;
			int count = _groups.Count;
			int count2 = _lines.Count;
			RichTextLine richTextLine = LastLine;
			if (richTextLine == null || (richTextLine.Count > 0 && richTextLine[richTextLine.Count - 1].IsNewLine))
			{
				richTextLine = new RichTextLine();
				_lines.Add(richTextLine);
			}
			if (count2 == 0 && ListNumberGroup != null)
			{
				if (helper == null)
				{
					helper = new ParagraphLayoutHelper(this);
				}
				InitializeFirstLine(richTextLine, helper);
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (!richTextLine.IsLastLineInParagraph)
			{
				richTextLine.IsLastLineInParagraph = true;
				flag2 = true;
			}
			int count3 = richTextLine.Count;
			Extent lineHeight = richTextLine._contentHeight;
			if (count3 == 0 || !richTextLine[count3 - 1].IsParagraphMark)
			{
				TextContentGroup paragraphMarkGroup = ParagraphMarkGroup;
				Extent offsetX;
				if (count3 == 0)
				{
					if (helper == null)
					{
						helper = new ParagraphLayoutHelper(this);
					}
					offsetX = helper._firstLineOffsetX;
				}
				else
				{
					offsetX = richTextLine.Width;
				}
				richTextLine._contentItems.Add(new RichTextLineContentData
				{
					_group = paragraphMarkGroup,
					_contentItemIndexInGroup = 0,
					_offsetX = offsetX
				});
				Extent contentHeight = richTextLine._contentHeight;
				Extent height = paragraphMarkGroup.GetHeight(IsDropCap, alignment: true);
				lineHeight = ((contentHeight.Emus > 0.0) ? contentHeight : height);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				if (helper == null)
				{
					helper = new ParagraphLayoutHelper(this);
				}
				helper.ArrangeContentWithinLine(richTextLine, lineHeight, null, rearrange: true);
				_lines.InvalidateAggregateInfoOnLine(richTextLine);
				_lines.InvalidateAggregateInfoOnAllNodes();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (count == 1 && _groups.Array[0]._contentItems.Count == 0)
			{
				_groups.Array[0]._firstLeafNode = null;
				_groups.Array[0]._firstLine = null;
				_groups.Array[0]._firstLineContentIndex = 0;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				InvalidateAggregatedHeight();
			}
			if (_lines.Count == 1 && richTextLine.Count == 1 && richTextLine._contentItems.Array[0]._group == _paragraphMarkGroup)
			{
				SetWidth(richTextLine.WidthIncludingParagraphMark);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyLayoutInfo()
		{
			TextFrameSettings frameSettings = FrameSettings;
			if (frameSettings == null || ParentCell != null)
			{
				if (_layoutInfo != null)
				{
					FloatingParagraphGroupInfo.UnfloatParagraphNode(this);
				}
			}
			else if (_layoutInfo == null)
			{
				FloatingParagraphGroupInfo.FloatParagraphNode(this, frameSettings);
			}
			else
			{
				FloatingParagraphGroupInfo.VerifyParagraphNodeFloatingGroup(this, frameSettings);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyTopAndBottomMargins()
		{
			if (base.IsSubTreeLoaded)
			{
				RichTextMargin? margins = base.Margins;
				SetTopAndBottomMargins(checkValidFlag: false);
				if (margins != base.Margins)
				{
					InvalidateAggregatedHeight();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RootLayoutNode : LayoutNodeBase
	{
		private class SynchronousUpdateManager<T>
		{
			private readonly Action<T> _callback;

			private readonly T _paramValue;

			private readonly int _synchronusUpdateLimit;

			private int _synchronusUpdateCount;

			internal SynchronousUpdateManager(Action<T> callback, T paramValue, int synchronusUpdateLimit)
			{
				_callback = callback;
				_paramValue = paramValue;
				_synchronusUpdateLimit = synchronusUpdateLimit;
			}

			internal void OnUpdateNotification()
			{
				_synchronusUpdateCount++;
				if (_synchronusUpdateCount == 1)
				{
					Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(ResetUpdateCount), DispatcherPriority.Send);
				}
				if (_synchronusUpdateCount < _synchronusUpdateLimit)
				{
					PerformAction();
				}
				else if (_synchronusUpdateCount == _synchronusUpdateLimit)
				{
					Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(PerformAction), DispatcherPriority.Send);
				}
			}

			internal void PerformAction()
			{
				_callback(_paramValue);
			}

			private void ResetUpdateCount()
			{
				_synchronusUpdateCount = 0;
			}
		}

		private LayoutManagerBase _layoutManager;

		private DocumentBodyNode _bodyNode;

		private Extent _height;

		private Extent _width;

		private Extent _widthConstraint;

		private LayoutNodeCollection _children;

		private AggregatingLayoutNodeTreeList.NodeEx _parentTreeNode;

		private SynchronousUpdateManager<bool> _descendantsRemovedManager;

		private SynchronousUpdateManager<bool> _layoutWidthChangedManager;

		private SynchronousUpdateManager<bool> _layoutHeightChangedManager;

		internal override LayoutNodeCollection ChildNodes
		{
			get
			{
				return _children;
			}
			set
			{
				_children = value;
			}
		}

		internal override NodeBase DocumentNode => _bodyNode;

		internal override Extent Height => _height;

		internal override LayoutManagerBase LayoutManager => _layoutManager;

		internal override LayoutNodeType NodeType => LayoutNodeType.Root;

		internal override AggregatingLayoutNodeTreeList.NodeEx ParentTreeNode
		{
			get
			{
				return _parentTreeNode;
			}
			set
			{
				_parentTreeNode = value;
			}
		}

		internal override Extent Width => _width;

		internal DocumentBodyNode BodyNode => _bodyNode;

		internal Extent WidthConstraint
		{
			get
			{
				return _widthConstraint;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _widthConstraint)
				{
					_widthConstraint = value;
					PerformLayoutAsync();
				}
			}
		}

		internal RootLayoutNode(LayoutManagerBase layout, DocumentBodyNode bodyNode)
			: base(null)
		{
			_layoutManager = layout;
			_descendantsRemovedManager = new SynchronousUpdateManager<bool>(ProcessDescendantsRemoved, paramValue: false, 200);
			_layoutWidthChangedManager = new SynchronousUpdateManager<bool>(NotifyLayoutMangerOnExtentChange, paramValue: true, 1);
			_layoutHeightChangedManager = new SynchronousUpdateManager<bool>(NotifyLayoutMangerOnExtentChange, paramValue: false, 1);
			if (!bodyNode.IsSealed)
			{
				PropertyChangeListenerList.ManageListenerHelper(ref _bodyNode, bodyNode, this, useWeakReference: false);
			}
			else
			{
				_bodyNode = bodyNode;
			}
		}

		internal override void Accept(LayoutNodeVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitRootNode(this);
		}

		internal override TReturn Accept<TReturn>(LayoutNodeVisitor<TReturn> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitRootNode(this);
		}

		internal override TReturn Accept<TArg, TReturn>(LayoutNodeVisitor<TArg, TReturn> visitor, TArg argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitRootNode(this, argument);
		}

		internal override CaretLayoutInfo? GetCaretLayoutFromDocumentOffset(int documentOffset, CharacterSettings settingsOverride, LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext context)
		{
			int aggregateOffsetCount = _bodyNode.AggregateOffsetCount;
			if (documentOffset > aggregateOffsetCount)
			{
				Utilities.LogDebuggerError($"GetCaretLayoutFromDocumentOffset, document offset: {documentOffset} > length: {aggregateOffsetCount}");
				documentOffset = aggregateOffsetCount;
			}
			bool num = documentOffset > 0 && context == LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext.EndOfSelection;
			int offset = documentOffset;
			if (num)
			{
				offset--;
			}
			NodeBase nodeAtOffset = _bodyNode.GetNodeAtOffset(ref offset);
			if (nodeAtOffset != null)
			{
				LayoutNodeBase value = null;
				bool flag = true;
				while (value == null)
				{
					if (_layoutManager.NodeMap.TryGetValue(nodeAtOffset, out value))
					{
						return value.GetCaretLayoutFromDocumentOffset(documentOffset, settingsOverride, context);
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						break;
					}
					flag = false;
					_layoutManager.EnsureStatusIsComplete();
				}
			}
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError($"GetCaretLayoutFromDocumentOffset, document offset: {documentOffset} not found");
			return null;
		}

		internal override ILayoutNodeWithLines GetNodeWithLinesAtPoint(ref System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			point.X -= Extent.LayoutPaddingX.LogicalPixels;
			point.Y -= Extent.LayoutPaddingY.LogicalPixels;
			point.Y = Math.Min(Math.Max(point.Y, 0.0), Height.LogicalPixels - 1.0);
			if (!(ChildNodes is AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.GetLayoutNodeContainingOffsetY(new Extent(point.Y, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels)) is BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode)
			{
				return blockLayoutNode.GetNodeWithLinesAtPoint(ref point);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnChildrenCleared()
		{
			if (!base.IsSubTreeLoaded)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ChildNodes is AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection)
			{
				foreach (LayoutNodeBase item in aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection)
				{
					item.DisposeNodeAndDescendants();
				}
				aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.Clear();
				aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.InvalidateAggregateInfoOnAllNodes();
			}
			InvalidateHeight();
		}

		protected override void OnChildrenAddedAndRemoved(IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> addedNodes, IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> removedNodes)
		{
			if (!base.IsSubTreeLoaded)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (addedNodes != null)
			{
				int num = 0;
				BlockLayoutNode firstNode = null;
				foreach (LayoutNodeBase addedNode in addedNodes)
				{
					addedNode.IsNewlyAdded = true;
					addedNode.LoadSubTree(null, performLayout: false, force: true);
					if (num == 0)
					{
						firstNode = addedNode as BlockLayoutNode;
					}
					num++;
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					LayoutController layoutController = new LayoutController(base.Root, newlyAddedNodesOnly: true, prioritizeViewPorts: false, firstNode);
					LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
					if (layoutManager != null)
					{
						layoutManager.QueueLayoutController(layoutController);
					}
					else
					{
						layoutController.Process(null);
					}
				}
			}
			if (removedNodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LayoutNodeBase removedNode in removedNodes)
			{
				removedNode.DisposeNodeAndDescendants();
			}
		}

		internal override void OnDescendantsRemoved()
		{
			_descendantsRemovedManager.OnUpdateNotification();
		}

		private void ProcessDescendantsRemoved(bool dummy)
		{
			if (ChildNodes is AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection)
			{
				aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.InvalidateAggregateInfoOnAllNodes();
			}
			InvalidateHeight();
		}

		protected override void OnDisposed()
		{
			if (_bodyNode != null && !_bodyNode.IsSealed)
			{
				PropertyChangeListenerList.ManageListenerHelper(ref _bodyNode, null, this, useWeakReference: false);
			}
		}

		internal void FlushPendingOperations()
		{
			_descendantsRemovedManager.PerformAction();
			_layoutHeightChangedManager.PerformAction();
			_layoutWidthChangedManager.PerformAction();
		}

		internal int? GetDocumentOffsetFromLayoutPoint(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint, bool includeListNumbers, bool includeParagraphMarks)
		{
			int num = ((ChildNodes != null) ? ChildNodes.Count : 0);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_layoutManager.HasFloatingBlocks)
			{
				int? documentOffsetFromFloatingLayoutPoint = GetDocumentOffsetFromFloatingLayoutPoint(layoutPoint, includeListNumbers, includeParagraphMarks, LayoutPlane.Foreground);
				if (documentOffsetFromFloatingLayoutPoint.HasValue)
				{
					return documentOffsetFromFloatingLayoutPoint;
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Point point = layoutPoint;
			ILayoutNodeWithLines nodeWithLinesAtPoint = GetNodeWithLinesAtPoint(ref point);
			if (nodeWithLinesAtPoint != null)
			{
				return nodeWithLinesAtPoint.GetDocumentOffsetFromLayoutPoint(point, includeListNumbers, includeParagraphMarks);
			}
			if (_layoutManager.HasFloatingBlocks)
			{
				int? documentOffsetFromFloatingLayoutPoint2 = GetDocumentOffsetFromFloatingLayoutPoint(layoutPoint, includeListNumbers, includeParagraphMarks, LayoutPlane.Background);
				if (documentOffsetFromFloatingLayoutPoint2.HasValue)
				{
					return documentOffsetFromFloatingLayoutPoint2;
				}
			}
			BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode = ChildNodes[0] as BlockLayoutNode;
			if (layoutPoint.Y <= blockLayoutNode.ContentOverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode2 = ChildNodes[num - 1] as BlockLayoutNode;
			Rect? contentRect = blockLayoutNode2.ContentRect;
			if (!contentRect.HasValue || layoutPoint.Y >= contentRect.Value.Bottom)
			{
				int num2 = blockLayoutNode2.DocumentNode.GetDocumentOffset() + blockLayoutNode2.DocumentNode.AggregateOffsetCount;
				if (!includeParagraphMarks)
				{
					num2--;
				}
				return num2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal ParagraphLayoutNode GetParagraphNodeAtDocumentOffset(int documentOffset)
		{
			int aggregateOffsetCount = _bodyNode.AggregateOffsetCount;
			if (documentOffset > aggregateOffsetCount)
			{
				Utilities.LogDebuggerError($"GetCaretLayoutFromDocumentOffset, document offset: {documentOffset} > length: {aggregateOffsetCount}");
				documentOffset = aggregateOffsetCount;
			}
			int offset = documentOffset;
			NodeBase nodeBase = _bodyNode.GetNodeAtOffset(ref offset);
			ParagraphNode paragraphNode = nodeBase as ParagraphNode;
			while (paragraphNode == null && nodeBase != null)
			{
				nodeBase = nodeBase.Parent;
				paragraphNode = nodeBase as ParagraphNode;
			}
			if (paragraphNode != null && _layoutManager.NodeMap.TryGetValue(paragraphNode, out var value))
			{
				return value as ParagraphLayoutNode;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal RichTextHitTestResult[] HitTest(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint, bool includeAllOverlappingHits)
		{
			if (ChildNodes == null || ChildNodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<RichTextHitTestResult> list = new List<RichTextHitTestResult>();
			RichTextHitTestResultArea? richTextHitTestResultArea = null;
			if (layoutPoint.X < Extent.LayoutPaddingX.LogicalPixels)
			{
				richTextHitTestResultArea = RichTextHitTestResultArea.DocumentPaddingAreaLeft;
			}
			else if (layoutPoint.Y < Extent.LayoutPaddingY.LogicalPixels)
			{
				return new RichTextHitTestResult[1]
				{
					new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.DocumentPaddingAreaTop, null, null, null)
				};
			}
			if (_layoutManager.HasFloatingBlocks)
			{
				HitTestFloating(layoutPoint, LayoutPlane.Foreground, list, includeAllOverlappingHits);
				if (list.Count > 0 && !includeAllOverlappingHits)
				{
					return list.ToArray();
				}
			}
			if (ChildNodes is AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection)
			{
				BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode = aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.GetLayoutNodeContainingOffsetY(new Extent(layoutPoint.Y, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels) - Extent.LayoutPaddingY) as BlockLayoutNode;
				if (richTextHitTestResultArea.HasValue && !(blockLayoutNode is TableLayoutNode))
				{
					return new RichTextHitTestResult[1]
					{
						new RichTextHitTestResult(richTextHitTestResultArea.Value, null, null, null)
					};
				}
				if (blockLayoutNode != null)
				{
					RichTextHitTestResult? richTextHitTestResult = blockLayoutNode.HitTest(layoutPoint);
					if (richTextHitTestResult.HasValue)
					{
						list.Add(richTextHitTestResult.Value);
						if (!includeAllOverlappingHits)
						{
							return list.ToArray();
						}
					}
					else if (richTextHitTestResultArea.HasValue)
					{
						return new RichTextHitTestResult[1]
						{
							new RichTextHitTestResult(richTextHitTestResultArea.Value, null, null, null)
						};
					}
				}
			}
			if (_layoutManager.HasFloatingBlocks)
			{
				HitTestFloating(layoutPoint, LayoutPlane.Background, list, includeAllOverlappingHits);
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal void InvalidateHeight()
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Extent extent = childNodes?.Height ?? new Extent(0.0);
			for (int num = childNodes.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (childNodes[num] is BlockLayoutNode { Plane: LayoutPlane.Middle, Margins: var margins } blockLayoutNode)
				{
					if (margins.HasValue)
					{
						extent += blockLayoutNode.Margins.Value.Bottom;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			Extent bottomOfLowestFloatingContent = _layoutManager.BottomOfLowestFloatingContent;
			if (extent < bottomOfLowestFloatingContent)
			{
				extent = bottomOfLowestFloatingContent;
			}
			if (_height != extent)
			{
				_height = extent;
				_layoutHeightChangedManager.OnUpdateNotification();
			}
		}

		internal void SetWidth(Extent newWidth)
		{
			if (_width != newWidth)
			{
				_width = newWidth;
				_layoutWidthChangedManager.OnUpdateNotification();
			}
		}

		private int? GetDocumentOffsetFromFloatingLayoutPoint(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint, bool includeListNumbers, bool includeParagraphMarks, LayoutPlane plane)
		{
			Rect viewport = new Rect(layoutPoint.X, layoutPoint.Y, 1.0, 1.0);
			foreach (FloatingBlockInfoBase item in _layoutManager.GetFloatingBlockInfosInViewPort(viewport, plane))
			{
				int? documentOffsetFromFloatingBlockHelper = GetDocumentOffsetFromFloatingBlockHelper(item.Block, viewport, layoutPoint, includeListNumbers, includeParagraphMarks);
				if (documentOffsetFromFloatingBlockHelper.HasValue)
				{
					return documentOffsetFromFloatingBlockHelper;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private int? GetDocumentOffsetFromFloatingBlockHelper(ILayoutBlock block, Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point layoutPoint, bool includeListNumbers, bool includeParagraphMarks)
		{
			if (block is ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphLayoutNode)
			{
				layoutPoint.X -= paragraphLayoutNode.OverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
				layoutPoint.Y -= paragraphLayoutNode.OverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
				return paragraphLayoutNode.GetDocumentOffsetFromLayoutPoint(layoutPoint, includeListNumbers, includeParagraphMarks);
			}
			Rect? overallRect = block.OverallRect;
			if (!overallRect.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect rect = new Rect(overallRect.Value.Left, overallRect.Value.Top, overallRect.Value.Width - 1.0, overallRect.Value.Height);
			if (!rect.Contains(layoutPoint))
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (ILayoutBlock item in block.GetChildBlocksInViewPort(viewport))
			{
				int? documentOffsetFromFloatingBlockHelper = GetDocumentOffsetFromFloatingBlockHelper(item, viewport, layoutPoint, includeListNumbers, includeParagraphMarks);
				if (documentOffsetFromFloatingBlockHelper.HasValue)
				{
					return documentOffsetFromFloatingBlockHelper;
				}
			}
			if (block is TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode && tableCellLayoutNode.ChildNodes.Count > 0 && tableCellLayoutNode.ChildNodes[0] is ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphLayoutNode2)
			{
				return paragraphLayoutNode2.DocumentNode.GetDocumentOffset() + paragraphLayoutNode2.DocumentNode.PrefixOffsetCount;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void HitTestFloating(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint, LayoutPlane plane, List<RichTextHitTestResult> hitsList, bool includeAllOverlappingHits)
		{
			Rect viewport = new Rect(layoutPoint.X, layoutPoint.Y, 1.0, 1.0);
			foreach (FloatingBlockInfoBase item in _layoutManager.GetFloatingBlockInfosInViewPort(viewport, plane))
			{
				RichTextHitTestResult? richTextHitTestResult = item.Block.HitTest(layoutPoint);
				if (richTextHitTestResult.HasValue)
				{
					hitsList.Add(richTextHitTestResult.Value);
					if (!includeAllOverlappingHits)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void NotifyLayoutMangerOnExtentChange(bool width)
		{
			if (_layoutManager != null)
			{
				if (width)
				{
					_layoutManager.SetLayoutWidth(_width.LogicalPixels);
				}
				else
				{
					_layoutManager.SetLayoutValidatedThroughHeight(_height.LogicalPixels);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RunLayoutNode : ParagraphChildLayoutNodeBase
	{
		private RunNode _run;

		private bool? _isVisible;

		internal override int DescendantLeafCount => ChildNodes?.Count ?? 0;

		internal override NodeBase DocumentNode => _run;

		internal override LeafLayoutNode FirstLeafNode
		{
			get
			{
				LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
				if (childNodes == null || childNodes.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return childNodes[0] as LeafLayoutNode;
			}
		}

		public override LeafLayoutNode FirstVisibleLeafNode
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsVisible)
				{
					return FirstLeafNode;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_isVisible.HasValue)
				{
					_isVisible = !Utilities.GetResolvedValue(SettingsResolved.Hidden, defaultValue: false);
				}
				return _isVisible.Value;
			}
		}

		internal override LeafLayoutNode LastLeafNode
		{
			get
			{
				LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
				int num = childNodes?.Count ?? 0;
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return childNodes[num - 1] as LeafLayoutNode;
			}
		}

		public override LeafLayoutNode LastVisibleLeafNode
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsVisible)
				{
					return LastLeafNode;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal override LayoutNodeType NodeType => LayoutNodeType.Run;

		internal override ParagraphLayoutNode ParentParagraph
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ParentLayoutNode is ParagraphLayoutNode result)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (base.ParentLayoutNode is HyperlinkLayoutNode hyperlinkLayoutNode)
				{
					return hyperlinkLayoutNode.ParentParagraph;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal CharacterSettings SettingsResolved => _run.SettingsResolved;

		internal RunLayoutNode(LayoutNodeBase parent, RunNode run)
			: base(parent)
		{
			if (!run.IsSealed)
			{
				PropertyChangeListenerList.ManageListenerHelper(ref _run, run, this, useWeakReference: false);
			}
			else
			{
				_run = run;
			}
		}

		internal override void Accept(LayoutNodeVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitRunLayoutNode(this);
		}

		internal override TReturn Accept<TReturn>(LayoutNodeVisitor<TReturn> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitRunLayoutNode(this);
		}

		internal override TReturn Accept<TArg, TReturn>(LayoutNodeVisitor<TArg, TReturn> visitor, TArg argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitRunLayoutNode(this, argument);
		}

		internal override void ClearDirtySettingsFlags()
		{
			base.ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
			if (base.ParentLayoutNode is ParagraphChildLayoutNodeBase)
			{
				base.ParentLayoutNode.ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
			}
		}

		public override LeafLayoutNode GetRelativeVisibleLeafNode(bool next, LeafLayoutNode leafNode = null)
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = childNodes.Count;
			int num = (next ? 1 : (-1));
			int num2 = (next ? count : (-1));
			int i = ((leafNode == null) ? ((!next) ? (count - 1) : 0) : (childNodes.IndexOf(leafNode) + num));
			if (i >= 0 && i < count)
			{
				for (; i != num2; i += num)
				{
					leafNode = childNodes[i] as LeafLayoutNode;
					if (leafNode != null)
					{
						return leafNode;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnChildrenCleared()
		{
			ParagraphLayoutNode parentParagraph = ParentParagraph;
			if (parentParagraph == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<LayoutNodeBase> list = new List<LayoutNodeBase>();
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = childNodes.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = childNodes[i];
				if (layoutNodeBase != null)
				{
					list.Add(layoutNodeBase);
				}
			}
			parentParagraph.OnLeavesAddedAndRemoved(null, list);
		}

		protected override void OnChildrenAddedAndRemoved(IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> addedNodes, IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> removedNodes)
		{
			ParentParagraph?.OnLeavesAddedAndRemoved(addedNodes, removedNodes);
		}

		protected override void OnDisposed()
		{
			if (_run != null && !_run.IsSealed)
			{
				PropertyChangeListenerList.ManageListenerHelper(ref _run, null, this, useWeakReference: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
			if (!(property == "SettingsResolved"))
			{
				if (property == "Hidden")
				{
					_isVisible = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DirtySettings();
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("Run: ");
			if (ChildNodes != null)
			{
				foreach (LayoutNodeBase childNode in ChildNodes)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(childNode);
					if (stringBuilder.Length > 50)
					{
						return $"{stringBuilder.ToString().Substring(0, 50)}...";
					}
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class TableCellLayoutNode : BlockLayoutNode
	{
		internal abstract class LayoutHelperBase : TableLayoutNode.BlockContainerLayoutHelper<TableCellLayoutNode, BlockLayoutNode>
		{
			private BlockLayoutNode _currentChild;

			private object _currentChildLayoutContext;

			protected Extent _constraintX;

			protected Extent? _constraintY;

			internal LayoutHelperBase(TableCellLayoutNode node, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
				: base(node)
			{
				_constraintX = constraintX;
				_constraintY = constraintY;
			}

			protected override void Cleanup()
			{
				base.Cleanup();
			}

			protected override void Initialize(LayoutNodeCollection children)
			{
				base.Initialize(children);
			}

			protected override bool ProcessChild(TimeKeeper timeKeeper, BlockLayoutNode child)
			{
				if (child != _currentChild)
				{
					_currentChildLayoutContext = null;
					_currentChild = child;
				}
				return child.ProcessLayout(ref _currentChildLayoutContext, timeKeeper, _constraintX, _constraintY);
			}
		}

		internal class LayoutHelper : LayoutHelperBase
		{
			internal LayoutHelper(TableCellLayoutNode node, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
				: base(node, constraintX, constraintY)
			{
			}

			protected override void Cleanup()
			{
				LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = base.Node.ChildNodes;
				if (childNodes != null)
				{
					foreach (LayoutNodeBase item in childNodes)
					{
						if (item is ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphLayoutNode)
						{
							paragraphLayoutNode.VerifyIsLastEmptyParagraphTrailingTableInCell(refreshHeightIfNecessary: false);
						}
					}
				}
				base.Node.InvalidateAggregatedHeight();
				CalculateOverallWidth();
			}

			private void CalculateOverallWidth()
			{
				LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = base.Node.ChildNodes;
				int num = childNodes?.Count ?? 0;
				Extent extent = default(Extent);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (childNodes[i] is BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode)
					{
						Extent extent2 = blockLayoutNode.RelativeOffsetX + blockLayoutNode.Width;
						if (extent2 > extent)
						{
							extent = extent2;
						}
					}
				}
				base.Node.SetWidth(extent);
			}
		}

		}

		public override Rect? ShadingRect
		{
			get
			{
				if (_tableCell == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				ILayoutBlock parentBlock = ParentBlock;
				Rect? borderRect = parentBlock.BorderRect;
				if (!borderRect.HasValue)
				{
					return null;
				}
				Rect value = borderRect.Value;
				BlockNodeBorders borders = parentBlock.Borders;
				if (borders != null)
				{
					value.X += borders.LeftBorderThickness.LogicalPixels;
					value.Y += borders.TopBorderThickness.LogicalPixels;
					value.Width -= (borders.LeftBorderThickness + borders.RightBorderThickness).LogicalPixels;
					value.Height -= (borders.TopBorderThickness + borders.BottomBorderThickness).LogicalPixels;
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		internal override ParagraphLayoutNode GetFirstParagraph()
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null || childNodes.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return childNodes[0] as ParagraphLayoutNode;
		}

		internal override ILayoutNodeWithLines GetNodeWithLinesAtPoint(ref System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			point.X = Math.Max(point.X - (base.RelativeOffsetX + base.ContentRelativeOffsetX).LogicalPixels, 0.0);
			point.Y = Math.Max(point.Y - (RelativeOffsetY + base.ContentRelativeOffsetY).LogicalPixels, 0.0);
			TableCellMargins tableCellMargins = SettingsResolved?.Margins;
			if (tableCellMargins != null && tableCellMargins.Top.HasValue)
			{
				point.Y = Math.Max(point.Y - Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixel(tableCellMargins.Top.Value.LogicalPixels), 0.0);
			}
			if (!(ChildNodes is AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection { Count: not 0 } aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.GetLayoutNodeContainingOffsetY(new Extent(point.Y, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels)) is BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode)
			{
				return blockLayoutNode.GetNodeWithLinesAtPoint(ref point);
			}
			BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode2 = aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection[0] as BlockLayoutNode;
			if (point.Y <= blockLayoutNode2.RelativeOffsetY.LogicalPixels)
			{
				return blockLayoutNode2.GetNodeWithLinesAtPoint(ref point);
			}
			return (aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection[aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.Count - 1] as BlockLayoutNode).GetNodeWithLinesAtPoint(ref point);
		}

		internal override ParagraphLayoutNode GetLastParagraph()
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null || childNodes.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return childNodes[childNodes.Count - 1] as ParagraphLayoutNode;
		}

		public override RichTextHitTestResult? HitTest(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint)
		{
			Rect? overallRect = base.OverallRect;
			if (overallRect.HasValue && overallRect.Value.Contains(layoutPoint) && HasChildBlocks)
			{
				foreach (ILayoutBlock item in GetChildBlocksInViewPort(overallRect.Value))
				{
					RichTextHitTestResult? result = item.HitTest(layoutPoint);
					if (result.HasValue)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
			}
			return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCell, this, this, this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnAddedToTree(LayoutNodeBase afterNode, LayoutNodeBase beforeNode)

			base.OnAddedToTree(afterNode, beforeNode);
			InitializeBorders();

			InvalidateMinMaxWidth();
		}
