			base.OnPreDisposed();
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
			if (property == "SettingsResolved")
			{
				TableLayoutNode parentTable = ParentTable;
				if (parentTable == null || !parentTable.IsUpdatingDocumentSettings)
				{
					InitializeBorders();
					InvalidateMinMaxWidth();
					InvalidateLayoutGrid(processLayoutAsynchronously: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool ProcessLayout(ref object processStatusInfo, TimeKeeper timeKeeper, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
		{
			LayoutHelper layoutHelper = processStatusInfo as LayoutHelper;
			if (layoutHelper == null)
			{
				_constraintX = constraintX;
				_constraintY = constraintY;
				layoutHelper = (LayoutHelper)(processStatusInfo = new LayoutHelper(this, _constraintX, _constraintY));
				ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
				if (constraintX.Emus <= 0.0 || (constraintY.HasValue && constraintY.Value.Emus <= 0.0))
				{
					SetWidth(default(Extent));
					return true;
				}
			}
			bool num = layoutHelper.ProcessChildren(timeKeeper);
			if (num)
			{
				SetWidth(_constraintX);
				InvalidateAggregatedHeight();
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal override bool ProcessSettingsChanged(ref object processStatusInfo, TimeKeeper timeKeeper, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
		{
			TableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo = processStatusInfo as TableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo;
			if (tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo == null)
			{
				if (!base.AreSettingsDirty && !base.AreDescendantSettingsDirty)
				{
					return true;
				}
				tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo = (TableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo)(processStatusInfo = new TableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo());
			}
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes != null)
			{
				int count = childNodes.Count;
				while (tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo._childIndex < count)
				{
					if (childNodes[tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo._childIndex] is BlockLayoutNode blockLayoutNode && (blockLayoutNode.AreSettingsDirty || blockLayoutNode.AreDescendantSettingsDirty))
					{
						tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo._child = blockLayoutNode;
						if (!blockLayoutNode.ProcessSettingsChanged(ref tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo._childStatusInfo, timeKeeper, constraintX, constraintY))
						{
							return false;
						}
						tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo._childStatusInfo = null;
						tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo._childIndex++;
						blockLayoutNode.ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
						if (timeKeeper.IsTimedOut)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo._childIndex++;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override void ProcessSettingsChangedAborted(object processStatusInfo)
		{
			TableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo = processStatusInfo as TableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo;
			if (tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo._child != null)
			{
				tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo._child.ProcessSettingsChangedAborted(tableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo._childStatusInfo);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			TableRowLayoutNode parentRow = ParentRow;
			if (parentRow != null)
			{
				int num = parentRow.ChildNodes.IndexOf(this);
				int num2 = parentRow.ParentTable.ChildNodes.IndexOf(parentRow);
				return $"Cell index: {num}, in row index: {num2}";
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		internal void ClearLocationFlags()
		{
			_location = (TableCellLocationFlags)0;
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsMinMaxWidthValid, value: false);
		}

		internal static void CreateAddedSubTree(IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> addedNodes, LayoutManagerBase lm)
		{
			List<LayoutNodeBase> list = new List<LayoutNodeBase>();
			foreach (LayoutNodeBase addedNode in addedNodes)
			{
				NodeBase documentNode = addedNode.DocumentNode;
				if (documentNode.ChildNodes == null || documentNode.ChildNodes.Count == 0)
				{
					addedNode.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
					continue;
				}
				if (!(addedNode is ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphLayoutNode))
				{
					if (!(addedNode is TableLayoutNode tableLayoutNode))
					{
						continue;
					}
					AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection = (AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection)(tableLayoutNode.ChildNodes = new AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection());
					foreach (NodeBase childNode in documentNode.ChildNodes)
					{
						LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = LayoutNodeBase.Create(childNode, lm, tableLayoutNode);
						if (layoutNodeBase != null)
						{
							aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.Add(layoutNodeBase);
							list.Add(layoutNodeBase);
						}
					}
					TableLayoutNode.CreateAddedSubTree(list, lm);
					list.Clear();
					tableLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
					continue;
				}
				NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection nonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection = (NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection)(paragraphLayoutNode.ChildNodes = new NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection());
				foreach (NodeBase childNode2 in documentNode.ChildNodes)
				{
					LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase2 = LayoutNodeBase.Create(childNode2, lm, paragraphLayoutNode);
					if (layoutNodeBase2 != null)
					{
						nonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.Add(layoutNodeBase2);
						list.Add(layoutNodeBase2);
					}
				}
				ParagraphLayoutNode.CreateAddedSubTree(list, lm, null);
				list.Clear();
				paragraphLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
			}
		}

		internal MinMaxExtent GetMinMaxWidth()
		{
			if (!GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsMinMaxWidthValid))
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsMinMaxWidthValid, value: true);
				_minMaxWidth = default(MinMaxExtent);
				bool value = false;
				LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
				if (childNodes != null)
				{
					foreach (LayoutNodeBase item in childNodes)
					{
						if (item is ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphLayoutNode)
						{
							MinMaxExtent minMaxWidth = paragraphLayoutNode.GetMinMaxWidth();
							Extent extent = default(Extent);
							RichTextMargin? richTextMargin = paragraphLayoutNode.CalculateMarginAndBorderExtents();
							if (richTextMargin.HasValue)
							{
								extent += richTextMargin.Value.Left + richTextMargin.Value.Right;
							}
							minMaxWidth._minValue += extent;
							minMaxWidth._maxValue += extent;
							_minMaxWidth._minValue = Extent.Max(minMaxWidth._minValue, _minMaxWidth._minValue);
							_minMaxWidth._maxValue = Extent.Max(minMaxWidth._maxValue, _minMaxWidth._maxValue);
							paragraphLayoutNode.VerifyMarkContent();
						}
						else if (item is TableLayoutNode tableLayoutNode)
						{
							value = true;
							tableLayoutNode.VerifyActualColumnWidths();
							Extent width = tableLayoutNode.Width;
							_minMaxWidth._minValue = Extent.Max(width, _minMaxWidth._minValue);
							_minMaxWidth._maxValue = Extent.Max(width, _minMaxWidth._maxValue);
						}
					}
					SetFlag(InternalFlags.HasNestedTable, value);
				}
				Extent widthAdjustment = BorderBlock.GetWidthAdjustment();
				_minMaxWidth._minValue += widthAdjustment;
				_minMaxWidth._maxValue += widthAdjustment;
			}
			return _minMaxWidth;
		}

		internal void InvalidateMinMaxWidth()
		{
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsMinMaxWidthValid, value: false);
			if (base.ParentLayoutNode is TableRowLayoutNode tableRowLayoutNode)
			{
				tableRowLayoutNode.OnInvalidateMinMaxWidth(this);
			}
		}

		internal void SetIsContentHeightClipped(bool isClipped)
		{
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsContentHeightClipped, isClipped);
		}

		internal void SetRelativeOffsetY(Extent value)
		{
			_relativeOffsetY = value;
		}

		private bool GetFlag(InternalFlags flag)
		{
			return (_flags & flag) == flag;
		}

		private bool GetLocationFlag(TableCellLocationFlags flag)
		{
			return (_location & flag) == flag;
		}

		private void InitializeBorders()
		{
			_borders = null;
			TableCellSettings settingsResolved = SettingsResolved;
			if (settingsResolved != null)
			{
				TableCellBorderSettings borders = settingsResolved.Borders;
				if (borders != null)
				{
					_borders = new BlockNodeBorders(borders.Bottom, borders.Start, borders.End, borders.Top, borders.BottomLeftToTopRight, borders.BottomRightToTopLeft);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateLayoutGrid(bool processLayoutAsynchronously = false)
		{
			if (base.ParentLayoutNode is TableRowLayoutNode tableRowLayoutNode)
			{
				tableRowLayoutNode.InvalidatelayoutGrid(processLayoutAsynchronously);
			}
		}

		private void SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_flags &= (InternalFlags)(byte)(~(int)flag);
			}
		}

		private void SetLocationFlag(TableCellLocationFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_location |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_location &= (TableCellLocationFlags)(byte)(~(int)flag);
			}
		}
	}
	internal struct MinMaxExtent : IEquatable<MinMaxExtent>
	{
		internal Extent _minValue;

		internal Extent _maxValue;

		internal MinMaxExtent(Extent minValue, Extent maxValue)
		{
			_minValue = minValue;
			_maxValue = maxValue;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _maxValue.GetHashCode() ^ (_minValue.GetHashCode() << 1);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is MinMaxExtent)
			{
				return this == (MinMaxExtent)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(MinMaxExtent extent1, MinMaxExtent extent2)
		{
			if (extent1._minValue == extent2._minValue)
			{
				return extent1._maxValue == extent2._maxValue;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(MinMaxExtent extent1, MinMaxExtent extent2)
		{
			return !(extent1 == extent2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Min: {_minValue}, Max: {_maxValue}";
		}

		public bool Equals(MinMaxExtent other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	internal class TableCellLayoutBorderBlock : ILayoutBlock
	{
		private TableCellLayoutNode _cellLayoutNode;

		private ILayoutBlock _child;

		private BlockNodeBorders _outerBorders;

		private Extent _relativeOffsetX;

		private Extent _relativeOffsetY;

		private Extent _cellSpacing;

		private Extent _constraintX;

		private int _previousCellChildCount;

		private bool _addMiddleShadingBlock;

		internal bool _bordersRequireBackground;

		private Extent? _previousConstraintX;

		private Extent? _previousConstraintY;

		private Extent _borderAdjustmentX;

		private Extent _borderAdjustmentY;

		private Extent _borderAdjustmentRight;

		private Extent _borderAdjustmentBottom;

		internal TableCellLayoutNode Cell => _cellLayoutNode;

		internal ILayoutBlock CellParentBlock
		{
			get
			{
				if (_child is TableCellLayoutNode)
				{
					return this;
				}
				if (!(_child is TableCellInnerBorder tableCellInnerBorder))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return tableCellInnerBorder.CellParentBlock;
			}
		}

		internal ILayoutBlock Child => _child;

		public Extent ConstraintX => _constraintX;

		public Extent Height => new Extent((_cellLayoutNode.Height + GetHeightAdjustment()).IntegralDevicePixels, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);

		internal Extent RelativeOffsetX => _relativeOffsetX;

		internal Extent RelativeOffsetY => _relativeOffsetY;

		public BlockNodeBorders Borders => _outerBorders;

		Rect? ILayoutBlock.BorderRect
		{
			get
			{
				Rect? overallRect = ((ILayoutBlock)this).OverallRect;
				if (overallRect.HasValue && _outerBorders != null)
				{
					Rect value = overallRect.Value;
					if (_outerBorders.Left != null && _borderAdjustmentX.Emus < 0.0)
					{
						value.X += _borderAdjustmentX.IntegralDevicePixels;
						value.Width -= _borderAdjustmentX.IntegralDevicePixels;
					}
					_ = _outerBorders.Right;
					if (_outerBorders.Top != null && _borderAdjustmentY.Emus < 0.0)
					{
						value.Y += _borderAdjustmentY.IntegralDevicePixels;
						value.Height -= _borderAdjustmentY.IntegralDevicePixels;
					}
					_ = _outerBorders.Bottom;
					return value;
				}
				return overallRect;
			}
		}

		Extent ILayoutBlock.ContentOverallOffsetX => _child.OverallOffsetX + _cellLayoutNode.RelativeOffsetX;

		Extent ILayoutBlock.ContentOverallOffsetY => _child.OverallOffsetY + _cellLayoutNode.RelativeOffsetY;

		Rect? ILayoutBlock.ContentRect
		{
			get
			{
				Extent cellSpacing = _cellSpacing;
				return new Rect((OverallOffsetX + cellSpacing).LogicalPixels, (OverallOffsetY + cellSpacing).LogicalPixels, _child.Width.LogicalPixels, _child.Height.LogicalPixels);
			}
		}

		BlockLayoutNode ILayoutBlock.FirstBlockNode => _cellLayoutNode;

		FloatingBlockInfoBase ILayoutBlock.FloatingBlockInfo => null;

		bool ILayoutBlock.HasChildBlocks => true;

		bool ILayoutBlock.IsContentClipped => false;

		bool ILayoutBlock.IsDropCap => false;

		int ILayoutBlock.LineCount => 0;

		public Extent OverallOffsetX => _relativeOffsetX + _cellLayoutNode.ParentRow.OverallOffsetX;

		public Extent OverallOffsetY => _relativeOffsetY + _cellLayoutNode.ParentRow.OverallOffsetY;

		Rect? ILayoutBlock.OverallRect => new Rect(OverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels, OverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels, Width.LogicalPixels, Height.LogicalPixels);

		ILayoutBlock ILayoutBlock.ParentBlock => _cellLayoutNode.ParentRow;

		LayoutPlane ILayoutBlock.Plane => _cellLayoutNode.Plane;

		BlockRotateTransform ILayoutBlock.RotateTransform => null;

		BlockScaleTransform ILayoutBlock.ScaleTransform => null;

		Shading? ILayoutBlock.Shading
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_bordersRequireBackground)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _cellLayoutNode.ParentTable?.BorderShading;
			}
		}

		Rect? ILayoutBlock.ShadingRect => ((ILayoutBlock)this).OverallRect;

		public Extent Width => new Extent((_cellLayoutNode.Width + GetWidthAdjustment()).IntegralDevicePixels, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);

		internal TableCellLayoutBorderBlock(TableCellLayoutNode cellLayoutNode)
		{
			_cellLayoutNode = cellLayoutNode;
			_child = _cellLayoutNode;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Border block for {_cellLayoutNode}";
		}

		internal Extent GetBottomAdjustment(bool includeCellMargins = true)
		{
			Extent extent = default(Extent);
			for (TableCellInnerBorder tableCellInnerBorder = _child as TableCellInnerBorder; tableCellInnerBorder != null; tableCellInnerBorder = tableCellInnerBorder.Child as TableCellInnerBorder)
			{
				extent += tableCellInnerBorder.GetBottomAdjustment(includeCellMargins);
			}
			if (includeCellMargins && _child == _cellLayoutNode)
			{
				TableCellMargins tableCellMargins = _cellLayoutNode.SettingsResolved?.Margins;
				if (tableCellMargins != null && tableCellMargins.Bottom.HasValue)
				{
					extent += Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(tableCellMargins.Bottom.Value);
				}
			}
			if (_outerBorders != null && _outerBorders.Bottom != null)
			{
				extent += _outerBorders.Bottom.TotalThickness;
			}
			return extent + GetCellSpacingOnBottom() + _borderAdjustmentBottom;
		}

		internal Extent GetCellSpacingOnBottom()
		{
			if (_cellLayoutNode.IsInLastRowInTable)
			{
				return _cellSpacing + _cellSpacing;
			}
			return _cellSpacing;
		}

		internal Extent GetCellSpacingOnLeft()
		{
			if (_cellLayoutNode.Column == 0)
			{
				return _cellSpacing + _cellSpacing;
			}
			return _cellSpacing;
		}

		internal Extent GetCellSpacingOnRight()
		{
			if (_cellLayoutNode.IsLastCellInRow)
			{
				return _cellSpacing + _cellSpacing;
			}
			return _cellSpacing;
		}

		internal Extent GetCellSpacingOnTop()
		{
			if (_cellLayoutNode.Row == 0)
			{
				return _cellSpacing + _cellSpacing;
			}
			return _cellSpacing;
		}

		internal Extent GetHeightAdjustment(bool includeCellMargins = true)
		{
			return GetTopAdjustment(includeCellMargins) + GetBottomAdjustment(includeCellMargins);
		}

		internal Extent GetLeftAdjustment(bool includeCellMargins = true)
		{
			Extent extent = default(Extent);
			for (TableCellInnerBorder tableCellInnerBorder = _child as TableCellInnerBorder; tableCellInnerBorder != null; tableCellInnerBorder = tableCellInnerBorder.Child as TableCellInnerBorder)
			{
				extent += tableCellInnerBorder.GetLeftAdjustment(includeCellMargins);
			}
			if (includeCellMargins && _child == _cellLayoutNode)
			{
				TableCellMargins tableCellMargins = _cellLayoutNode.SettingsResolved?.Margins;
				if (tableCellMargins != null && tableCellMargins.Start.HasValue)
				{
					extent += Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(tableCellMargins.Start.Value);
				}
			}
			if (_outerBorders != null)
			{
				extent += _outerBorders.LeftThickness;
			}
			if (_borderAdjustmentX.Emus > 0.0)
			{
				extent += _borderAdjustmentX;
			}
			return extent + GetCellSpacingOnLeft();
		}

		internal Extent GetRightAdjustment(bool includeCellMargins = true)
		{
			Extent extent = default(Extent);
			for (TableCellInnerBorder tableCellInnerBorder = _child as TableCellInnerBorder; tableCellInnerBorder != null; tableCellInnerBorder = tableCellInnerBorder.Child as TableCellInnerBorder)
			{
				extent += tableCellInnerBorder.GetRightAdjustment(includeCellMargins);
			}
			if (includeCellMargins && _child == _cellLayoutNode)
			{
				TableCellMargins tableCellMargins = _cellLayoutNode.SettingsResolved?.Margins;
				if (tableCellMargins != null && tableCellMargins.End.HasValue)
				{
					extent += Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(tableCellMargins.End.Value);
				}
			}
			if (_outerBorders != null)
			{
				extent += _outerBorders.RightThickness;
			}
			return extent + GetCellSpacingOnRight() + _borderAdjustmentRight;
		}

		internal Extent GetTopAdjustment(bool includeCellMargins = true)
		{
			Extent extent = default(Extent);
			for (TableCellInnerBorder tableCellInnerBorder = _child as TableCellInnerBorder; tableCellInnerBorder != null; tableCellInnerBorder = tableCellInnerBorder.Child as TableCellInnerBorder)
			{
				extent += tableCellInnerBorder.GetTopAdjustment(includeCellMargins);
			}
			if (includeCellMargins && _child == _cellLayoutNode)
			{
				TableCellMargins tableCellMargins = _cellLayoutNode.SettingsResolved?.Margins;
				if (tableCellMargins != null && tableCellMargins.Top.HasValue)
				{
					extent += Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(tableCellMargins.Top.Value);
				}
			}
			if (_outerBorders != null && _outerBorders.Top != null)
			{
				extent += _outerBorders.Top.TotalThickness;
			}
			if (_borderAdjustmentY.Emus > 0.0)
			{
				extent += _borderAdjustmentY;
			}
			return extent + GetCellSpacingOnTop();
		}

		internal Extent GetWidthAdjustment(bool includeCellMargins = true)
		{
			return GetLeftAdjustment(includeCellMargins) + GetRightAdjustment(includeCellMargins);
		}

		internal void InitializeBorders(BlockNodeBorders outerBorders, RichTextMargin outerBorderAdjustment, Tuple<Extent, Extent> cellSpacingBorderAdjustment, BlockNodeBorders innerBorders, BlockNodeBorders innerInnerBorders, bool bordersRequireBackground)
		{
			_bordersRequireBackground = bordersRequireBackground;
			_previousConstraintX = null;
			_previousConstraintY = null;
			_addMiddleShadingBlock = false;
			_outerBorders = outerBorders;
			_cellSpacing = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(Cell.Spacing);
			_borderAdjustmentX = ((outerBorderAdjustment.Left.Emus > 0.0) ? outerBorderAdjustment.Left : default(Extent));
			_borderAdjustmentY = ((outerBorderAdjustment.Top.Emus > 0.0) ? outerBorderAdjustment.Top : default(Extent));
			_borderAdjustmentRight = outerBorderAdjustment.Right;
			_borderAdjustmentBottom = outerBorderAdjustment.Bottom;
			if (_outerBorders != null)
			{
				if (_outerBorders.Left != null)
				{
					_borderAdjustmentX = outerBorderAdjustment.Left;
				}
				if (_outerBorders.Top != null)
				{
					_borderAdjustmentY = outerBorderAdjustment.Top;
				}
			}
			TableCellInnerBorder tableCellInnerBorder = null;
			TableCellInnerBorder tableCellInnerBorder2 = null;
			if (innerBorders != null)
			{
				tableCellInnerBorder = _child as TableCellInnerBorder;
				if (tableCellInnerBorder == null)
				{
					tableCellInnerBorder = (TableCellInnerBorder)(_child = new TableCellInnerBorder(this, _bordersRequireBackground));
				}
				_addMiddleShadingBlock = _cellSpacing.Emus != 0.0 && innerInnerBorders == null && _bordersRequireBackground;
				if (!_addMiddleShadingBlock)
				{
					tableCellInnerBorder.SetBorders(innerBorders, (_borderAdjustmentX.Emus < 0.0) ? _borderAdjustmentX : default(Extent), (_borderAdjustmentY.Emus < 0.0) ? _borderAdjustmentY : default(Extent), cellSpacingBorderAdjustment);
				}
				if (innerInnerBorders != null || _addMiddleShadingBlock)
				{
					tableCellInnerBorder2 = tableCellInnerBorder.Child as TableCellInnerBorder;
					if (tableCellInnerBorder2 == null)
					{
						tableCellInnerBorder2 = new TableCellInnerBorder(tableCellInnerBorder, _bordersRequireBackground);
						tableCellInnerBorder2.SetChild(_cellLayoutNode);
						tableCellInnerBorder.SetChild(tableCellInnerBorder2);
					}
					tableCellInnerBorder2.SetBorders((innerInnerBorders != null) ? innerInnerBorders : innerBorders, (_borderAdjustmentX.Emus < 0.0) ? _borderAdjustmentX : default(Extent), (_borderAdjustmentY.Emus < 0.0) ? _borderAdjustmentY : default(Extent), cellSpacingBorderAdjustment);
				}
				else
				{
					tableCellInnerBorder.SetChild(_cellLayoutNode);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_child = _cellLayoutNode;
			}
		}

		internal void PerformFinalAlignments()
		{
			TableCellVerticalAlignment resolvedValue = Utilities.GetResolvedValue(_cellLayoutNode.SettingsResolved.VerticalAlignment, TableCellVerticalAlignment.Top);
			Extent relativeOffsetY = default(Extent);
			if (resolvedValue == TableCellVerticalAlignment.Center || resolvedValue == TableCellVerticalAlignment.Bottom)
			{
				if (!(_cellLayoutNode.ChildNodes is AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection { Height: var height }))
				{
					Utilities.LogDebuggerError("Every TableCellNode needs a least one child ParagraphNode or TableNode" + Environment.NewLine);
				}
				else
				{
					Extent heightAdjustment = GetHeightAdjustment();
					Extent extent = Height - (heightAdjustment + height);
					if (extent.Emus > 0.0)
					{
						relativeOffsetY = ((resolvedValue != TableCellVerticalAlignment.Center) ? extent : new Extent(extent.Emus / 2.0, ExtentUnitType.Emus));
					}
				}
			}
			_cellLayoutNode.SetRelativeOffsetY(relativeOffsetY);
		}

		internal bool ProcessLayout(ref object processStatusInfo, LayoutNodeBase.TimeKeeper timeKeeper, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
		{
			_constraintX = constraintX;
			TableCellInnerBorder tableCellInnerBorder = Child as TableCellInnerBorder;
			TableCellInnerBorder tableCellInnerBorder2 = ((tableCellInnerBorder != null) ? (tableCellInnerBorder.Child as TableCellInnerBorder) : null);
			Extent cellSpacingOnTop = GetCellSpacingOnTop();
			Extent cellSpacingOnLeft = GetCellSpacingOnLeft();
			Extent extent = default(Extent);
			Extent extent2 = default(Extent);
			constraintX -= extent2 + GetCellSpacingOnRight() + _borderAdjustmentRight;
			if (!_addMiddleShadingBlock)
			{
				constraintX -= cellSpacingOnLeft;
			}
			if (_outerBorders != null)
			{
				extent += _outerBorders.TopThickness;
				extent2 += _outerBorders.LeftThickness;
				constraintX -= _outerBorders.LeftThickness + _outerBorders.RightThickness;
			}
			if (_borderAdjustmentX.Emus > 0.0)
			{
				extent2 += _borderAdjustmentX;
				constraintX -= _borderAdjustmentX;
			}
			if (_borderAdjustmentY.Emus > 0.0)
			{
				extent += _borderAdjustmentY;
			}
			Extent relativeOffsetY = extent;
			Extent relativeOffsetX = extent2;
			if (tableCellInnerBorder != null)
			{
				BlockNodeBorders borders = tableCellInnerBorder.Borders;
				tableCellInnerBorder.ConstraintX = constraintX;
				if (!_addMiddleShadingBlock)
				{
					extent2 += cellSpacingOnLeft;
					extent += cellSpacingOnTop;
				}
				tableCellInnerBorder.SetRelativeOffsetX(extent2);
				tableCellInnerBorder.SetRelativeOffsetY(extent);
				if (borders != null)
				{
					extent2 = borders.LeftThickness;
					extent = borders.TopThickness;
					if (_addMiddleShadingBlock)
					{
						extent2 += cellSpacingOnLeft;
						extent += cellSpacingOnTop;
					}
					relativeOffsetY += extent;
					relativeOffsetX += extent2;
					constraintX -= borders.LeftThickness + borders.RightThickness;
				}
				if (tableCellInnerBorder2 != null)
				{
					BlockNodeBorders borders2 = tableCellInnerBorder2.Borders;
					if (borders == null)
					{
						extent2 = cellSpacingOnLeft;
						extent = cellSpacingOnTop;
						constraintX -= cellSpacingOnLeft;
					}
					else
					{
						extent2 = borders.LeftThickness;
						extent = borders.TopThickness;
					}
					tableCellInnerBorder2.ConstraintX = constraintX;
					tableCellInnerBorder2.SetRelativeOffsetX(extent2);
					tableCellInnerBorder2.SetRelativeOffsetY(extent);
					extent2 = borders2.LeftThickness;
					extent = borders2.TopThickness;
					relativeOffsetY += extent;
					relativeOffsetX += extent2;
					constraintX -= borders2.LeftThickness + borders2.RightThickness;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				relativeOffsetX += cellSpacingOnLeft;
				relativeOffsetY += cellSpacingOnTop;
			}
			TableCellMargins tableCellMargins = _cellLayoutNode.SettingsResolved?.Margins;
			if (tableCellMargins != null)
			{
				if (tableCellMargins.Start.HasValue)
				{
					Extent extent3 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(tableCellMargins.Start.Value);
					constraintX -= extent3;
					relativeOffsetX += extent3;
				}
				if (tableCellMargins.End.HasValue)
				{
					constraintX -= Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(tableCellMargins.End.Value);
				}
				if (tableCellMargins.Top.HasValue)
				{
					relativeOffsetY += Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(tableCellMargins.Top.Value);
				}
			}
			_cellLayoutNode.SetRelativeOffsetX(relativeOffsetX);
			_cellLayoutNode.SetRelativeOffsetY(relativeOffsetY);
			int num = _cellLayoutNode.ChildNodes?.Count ?? 0;
			if (_previousConstraintX.HasValue && _previousConstraintX.Value == constraintX)
			{
				Extent? previousConstraintY = _previousConstraintY;
				Extent? extent4 = constraintY;
				if (previousConstraintY.HasValue == extent4.HasValue && (!previousConstraintY.HasValue || previousConstraintY.GetValueOrDefault() == extent4.GetValueOrDefault()) && _previousCellChildCount == num)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			_previousConstraintX = constraintX;
			_previousConstraintY = constraintY;
			_previousCellChildCount = num;
			return _cellLayoutNode.ProcessLayout(ref processStatusInfo, timeKeeper, constraintX, constraintY);
		}

		RichTextHitTestResult? ILayoutBlock.HitTest(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint)
		{
			double logicalPixels = OverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
			double logicalPixels2 = OverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
			double logicalPixels3 = Width.LogicalPixels;
			double logicalPixels4 = Height.LogicalPixels;
			double num = logicalPixels + logicalPixels3;
			double num2 = logicalPixels2 + logicalPixels4;
			if (_cellLayoutNode.IgnoreCell)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (layoutPoint.Y < logicalPixels2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (layoutPoint.X < logicalPixels)
			{
				if (_cellLayoutNode.IsFirstCellInRow)
				{
					return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableRowPrefixArea, _cellLayoutNode.ParentRow, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode);
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (layoutPoint.X > num)
			{
				if (_cellLayoutNode.IsLastCellInRow)
				{
					TableCellLayoutNode nextSiblingCell = _cellLayoutNode.NextSiblingCell;
					if (nextSiblingCell != null)
					{
						double logicalPixels5 = nextSiblingCell.BorderBlock.OverallOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
						if (layoutPoint.X < logicalPixels5 + 2.5)
						{
							return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCellVerticalResizeBorder, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode);
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (layoutPoint.Y > num2)
			{
				if (_cellLayoutNode.IsBottomCellInColumn)
				{
					TableRowLayoutNode nextSiblingRow = _cellLayoutNode.ParentRow.NextSiblingRow;
					if (nextSiblingRow != null)
					{
						double logicalPixels6 = nextSiblingRow.OverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
						if (layoutPoint.Y < logicalPixels6 + 2.5)
						{
							return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCellHorizontalResizeBorder, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode);
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			double num3 = ((!_cellLayoutNode.IsLastCellInRow) ? 2.5 : 5.0);
			if (layoutPoint.X >= num - num3)
			{
				return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCellVerticalResizeBorder, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode);
			}
			num3 = ((!_cellLayoutNode.IsBottomCellInColumn) ? 2.5 : 5.0);
			if (layoutPoint.Y >= num2 - num3)
			{
				return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCellHorizontalResizeBorder, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode);
			}
			if (_cellLayoutNode.IsTopCellInColumn && layoutPoint.Y <= logicalPixels2 + 5.0)
			{
				return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableColumnPrefixArea, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode);
			}
			if (layoutPoint.X > num || layoutPoint.Y > num2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect? contentRect = _child.ContentRect;
			if (contentRect.HasValue)
			{
				if (contentRect.Value.Contains(layoutPoint))
				{
					return _cellLayoutNode.HitTest(layoutPoint);
				}
				if (layoutPoint.X < contentRect.Value.Left)
				{
					return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCellMarginAreaLeft, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode);
				}
				if (layoutPoint.X > contentRect.Value.Right)
				{
					return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCellMarginAreaRight, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode);
				}
				if (layoutPoint.Y < contentRect.Value.Top)
				{
					return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCellMarginAreaTop, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode);
				}
				if (layoutPoint.Y > contentRect.Value.Bottom)
				{
					return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCellMarginAreaBottom, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode);
				}
			}
			return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCell, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode, _cellLayoutNode);
		}
	}

		Rect? ILayoutBlock.BorderRect
		{
			get
			{
				Rect? overallRect = ((ILayoutBlock)this).OverallRect;
				if (overallRect.HasValue && _borders != null)
				{
					Rect value = overallRect.Value;
					if (_borders.Left != null && _borderOverlapX.Emus < 0.0)
					{
						value.X += _borderOverlapX.IntegralDevicePixels;
						value.Width -= _borderOverlapX.IntegralDevicePixels;
					}
					if (_borders.Top != null && _borderOverlapY.Emus < 0.0)
					{
						value.Y += _borderOverlapY.IntegralDevicePixels;
						value.Height -= _borderOverlapY.IntegralDevicePixels;
					}
					if (_cellSpacingBorderAdjustment != null)
					{
						double integralDevicePixels = _cellSpacingBorderAdjustment.Item1.IntegralDevicePixels;
						double integralDevicePixels2 = _cellSpacingBorderAdjustment.Item2.IntegralDevicePixels;
						value.X -= integralDevicePixels2;
						value.Width += integralDevicePixels2 + integralDevicePixels2;
						value.Y -= integralDevicePixels;
						value.Height += integralDevicePixels + integralDevicePixels;
					}
					return value;
				}
				return overallRect;
			}
		}

		Extent ILayoutBlock.ContentOverallOffsetY => OverallOffsetY + GetTopAdjustment();

		private Extent GetMarginsAndBorderAdjustmentHelper(bool left, bool top, bool right, bool bottom, bool includeBorders = true, bool includeMargins = true)
		{
			Extent result = default(Extent);
			if (_borders == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (includeBorders && _borders != null)
			{
				if (left && _borders.Left != null)
				{
					result += _borders.Left.TotalThickness;
				}
				if (top && _borders.Top != null)
				{
					result += _borders.Top.TotalThickness;
				}
				if (right && _borders.Right != null)
				{
					result += _borders.Right.TotalThickness;
				}
				if (bottom && _borders.Bottom != null)
				{
					result += _borders.Bottom.TotalThickness;
				}
			}
			if (includeMargins && _child is TableCellLayoutNode { SettingsResolved: var settingsResolved })
			{
				TableCellMargins tableCellMargins = settingsResolved?.Margins;
				if (tableCellMargins != null)
				{
					if (left && tableCellMargins.Start.HasValue)
					{
						result += Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(tableCellMargins.Start.Value);
					}
					if (top && tableCellMargins.Top.HasValue)
					{
						result += Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(tableCellMargins.Top.Value);
					}
					if (right && tableCellMargins.End.HasValue)
					{
						result += Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(tableCellMargins.End.Value);
					}
					if (bottom && tableCellMargins.Bottom.HasValue)
					{
						result += Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(tableCellMargins.Bottom.Value);
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

	internal class TableCellSettingsChangeStatusInfo

	internal class TableLayoutNode : BlockLayoutNode
	{
		internal abstract class BlockContainerLayoutHelper<TParent, TChild> where TParent : BlockLayoutNode where TChild : BlockLayoutNode
		{
			private TParent _node;

			private int _currentChildIndex;

			internal TParent Node => _node;

			protected BlockContainerLayoutHelper(TParent node)
			{
				_node = node;
			}

			internal bool ProcessChildren(TimeKeeper timeKeeper)
			{
				LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = _node.ChildNodes;
				if (_currentChildIndex == 0)
				{
					Initialize(childNodes);
				}
				if (childNodes == null)
				{
					Cleanup();
					return true;
				}
				int count = childNodes.Count;
				while (_currentChildIndex < count)
				{
					if (childNodes[_currentChildIndex] is TChild child && !ProcessChild(timeKeeper, child))
					{
						return false;
					}
					_currentChildIndex++;
					if (_currentChildIndex < count && timeKeeper.IsTimedOut)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				Cleanup();
				return true;
			}

			protected virtual void Cleanup()
			{
			}

			protected virtual void Initialize(LayoutNodeCollection children)
			{
			}

			protected abstract bool ProcessChild(TimeKeeper timeKeeper, TChild child);
		}

		internal abstract class LayoutHelperBase : BlockContainerLayoutHelper<TableLayoutNode, TableRowLayoutNode>
		{
			protected Extent _constraintX;

			protected Extent? _constraintY;

			internal LayoutHelperBase(TableLayoutNode node, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
				: base(node)
			{
				_constraintX = constraintX;
				_constraintY = constraintY;
			}

			protected override void Cleanup()
			{
				base.Cleanup();
			}

			protected override void Initialize(LayoutNodeCollection children)
			{
				base.Initialize(children);
				base.Node.VerifyActualColumnWidths();
			}
		}

		internal class LayoutHelper : LayoutHelperBase
		{
			internal LayoutHelper(TableLayoutNode node, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
				: base(node, constraintX, constraintY)
			{
			}

			protected override void Cleanup()
			{
				base.Node.InvalidateAggregatedHeight();
				base.Node.PerformFinalAlignments();
				CalculateOverallWidth();
			}

			protected override bool ProcessChild(TimeKeeper timeKeeper, TableRowLayoutNode child)
			{
				base.Node.MeasureCellsinRow(child);
				return true;
			}

			private void CalculateOverallWidth()
			{
				LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = base.Node.ChildNodes;
				int num = childNodes?.Count ?? 0;
				Extent extent = default(Extent);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (childNodes[i] is TableRowLayoutNode tableRowLayoutNode)
					{
						Extent extent2 = tableRowLayoutNode.RelativeOffsetX + tableRowLayoutNode.Width;
						if (extent2 > extent)
						{
							extent = extent2;
						}
					}
				}
				extent += base.Node.GetMarginWidth();
				extent += base.Node.ExtraWidth;
				base.Node.SetWidth(extent);
			}
		}

		private class ColumnLayoutInfo
		{
			internal TableExtent? _preferredWidth;

			internal MinMaxExtent _minMaxWidth;

			internal Extent _offsetX;

			internal Extent? _maxWidthSpanAllocation;

			internal Extent? _minWidthSpanAllocation;

			internal Extent? _gridWidth;

			internal Extent? _actualWidth;

			internal TableCellLayoutNode _topCellInColumn;

			internal TableCellLayoutNode _bottomCellInColumn;

			internal List<TableCellLayoutNode> _nonSpanningCells = new List<TableCellLayoutNode>();

			internal List<SpannedColumnsInfo> _spanningInfo;

			internal ColumnLayoutInfo()
			{
			}

			internal void AddCellToColumn(TableCellLayoutNode cell)
			{
				if (cell._columnSpan < 2)
				{
					_nonSpanningCells.Add(cell);
				}
				if (_topCellInColumn == null)
				{
					_topCellInColumn = cell;
				}
				_bottomCellInColumn = cell;
			}

			internal ColumnLayoutInfo Clone()
			{
				return new ColumnLayoutInfo
				{
					_actualWidth = _actualWidth,
					_gridWidth = _gridWidth,
					_maxWidthSpanAllocation = _maxWidthSpanAllocation,
					_minMaxWidth = _minMaxWidth,
					_minWidthSpanAllocation = _minWidthSpanAllocation,
					_nonSpanningCells = _nonSpanningCells,
					_offsetX = _offsetX,
					_preferredWidth = _preferredWidth,
					_spanningInfo = _spanningInfo
				};
			}

			internal void RoundToIntegralDevicePixel()
			{
				if (_actualWidth.HasValue)
				{
					_actualWidth = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(_actualWidth.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private class ColumnSpanningCellsSortComparer : IComparer<TableCellLayoutNode>
		{
			internal static readonly ColumnSpanningCellsSortComparer Instance = new ColumnSpanningCellsSortComparer();

			private ColumnSpanningCellsSortComparer()
			{
			}

			public int Compare(TableCellLayoutNode x, TableCellLayoutNode y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (x == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (y == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (x._column != y._column)
				{
					return ((IComparable)x._column).CompareTo((object)y._column);
				}
				return ((IComparable)x._columnSpan).CompareTo((object)y._columnSpan);
			}
		}

		public override RichTextHitTestResult? HitTest(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint)
		{
			Rect? overallRect = base.OverallRect;
			if (!overallRect.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect value = overallRect.Value;
			value.X -= 5.0;
			value.Width += 10.0;
			Rect viewport = value;
			viewport.Width += 15.0;
			if (!viewport.Contains(layoutPoint))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (layoutPoint.X >= value.Right - (11.0 + ExtraWidth.LogicalPixels) && layoutPoint.Y >= value.Bottom - 6.0)
			{
				return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableResizeCorner, this, this, this);
			}
			if (HasChildBlocks)
			{
				foreach (ILayoutBlock item in GetChildBlocksInViewPort(viewport))
				{
					RichTextHitTestResult? result = item.HitTest(layoutPoint);
					if (result.HasValue)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!value.Contains(layoutPoint))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.Table, this, this, this);
		}

		internal override bool ProcessLayout(ref object processStatusInfo, TimeKeeper timeKeeper, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
		{
			LayoutHelper layoutHelper = processStatusInfo as LayoutHelper;
			if (layoutHelper == null)
			{
				SetWidth(default(Extent));
				if (_constraintX != constraintX || _constraintY != constraintY)
				{
					Extent extraWidth = ExtraWidth;
					_constraintX = Extent.Max(constraintX - extraWidth, extraWidth);
					_constraintY = constraintY;
					SetFlag(InternalFlags.AreActualColumnWidthsValid, value: false);
				}
				layoutHelper = (LayoutHelper)(processStatusInfo = new LayoutHelper(this, _constraintX, _constraintY));
			}
			return layoutHelper.ProcessChildren(timeKeeper);
		}

		internal override bool ProcessSettingsChanged(ref object processStatusInfo, TimeKeeper timeKeeper, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
		{
			TableSettingsChangeStatusInfo tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo = processStatusInfo as TableSettingsChangeStatusInfo;
			if (tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo == null)
			{
				if (!base.AreSettingsDirty && !base.AreDescendantSettingsDirty)
				{
					return true;
				}
				tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo = (TableSettingsChangeStatusInfo)(processStatusInfo = new TableSettingsChangeStatusInfo());
			}
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes != null)
			{
				int count = childNodes.Count;
				while (tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._rowIndex < count)
				{
					if (childNodes[tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._rowIndex] is TableRowLayoutNode tableRowLayoutNode && (tableRowLayoutNode.AreSettingsDirty || tableRowLayoutNode.AreDescendantSettingsDirty))
					{
						LayoutNodeCollection childNodes2 = tableRowLayoutNode.ChildNodes;
						if (childNodes2 != null)
						{
							int count2 = childNodes2.Count;
							while (tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._cellindex < count2)
							{
								if (childNodes2[tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._cellindex] is TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode && (tableCellLayoutNode.AreSettingsDirty || tableCellLayoutNode.AreDescendantSettingsDirty))
								{
									tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._cell = tableCellLayoutNode;
									if (!tableCellLayoutNode.ProcessSettingsChanged(ref tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._cellStatusInfo, timeKeeper, constraintX, constraintY))
									{
										return false;
									}
									tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._cellStatusInfo = null;
									tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._cellindex++;
									tableCellLayoutNode.ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
									if (timeKeeper.IsTimedOut)
									{
										return false;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._cellindex++;
								}
							}
						}
						tableRowLayoutNode.ClearDirtySettingsFlags();
					}
					tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._rowIndex++;
					tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._cellindex = 0;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override void ProcessSettingsChangedAborted(object processStatusInfo)
		{
			TableSettingsChangeStatusInfo tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo = processStatusInfo as TableSettingsChangeStatusInfo;
			if (tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._cell != null)
			{
				tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._cell.ProcessSettingsChangedAborted(tableSettingsChangeStatusInfo._cellStatusInfo);
			}
		}

		internal bool CacheRowSpanStarters(TableCellLayoutNode rowSpanStarter)
		{
			if (rowSpanStarter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_rowSpanStartersReturned == null)
			{
				_rowSpanStartersReturned = new HashSet<TableCellLayoutNode>();
			}
			else if (_rowSpanStartersReturned.Contains(rowSpanStarter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			_rowSpanStartersReturned.Add(rowSpanStarter);
			return true;
		}

		internal static void CreateAddedSubTree(IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> addedNodes, LayoutManagerBase lm)
		{
			List<LayoutNodeBase> list = new List<LayoutNodeBase>();
			foreach (LayoutNodeBase addedNode in addedNodes)
			{
				if (!(addedNode is TableRowLayoutNode tableRowLayoutNode))
				{
					continue;
				}
				NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection nonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection = (NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection)(tableRowLayoutNode.ChildNodes = new NonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection());
				NodeBase documentNode = tableRowLayoutNode.DocumentNode;
				if (documentNode.ChildNodes == null || documentNode.ChildNodes.Count == 0)
				{
					tableRowLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
					continue;
				}
				foreach (NodeBase childNode in documentNode.ChildNodes)
				{
					LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = LayoutNodeBase.Create(childNode, lm, tableRowLayoutNode);
					if (layoutNodeBase != null)
					{
						nonAggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.Add(layoutNodeBase);
						list.Add(layoutNodeBase);
					}
				}
				TableRowLayoutNode.CreateAddedSubTree(list, lm);
				list.Clear();
				tableRowLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
			}
		}

		internal Extent GetColumnMinWidth(int columnIndex, int columnSpan)
		{
			ValidateColumnIndex(columnIndex, columnSpan);
			int num = columnIndex + columnSpan - 1;
			Extent value = default(Extent);
			Extent value2 = default(Extent);
			for (int i = columnIndex; i <= num; i++)
			{
				ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo = _columns[i];
				value += columnLayoutInfo._minMaxWidth._minValue;
				if (columnLayoutInfo._spanningInfo == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < columnLayoutInfo._spanningInfo.Count; j++)
				{
					SpannedColumnsInfo spannedColumnsInfo = columnLayoutInfo._spanningInfo[j];
					int index = spannedColumnsInfo._key._index;
					int val = index + spannedColumnsInfo._key._span;
					int num2 = Math.Max(columnIndex, index);
					int num3 = Math.Min(num, val);
					if (num2 <= num3 && spannedColumnsInfo._minMaxWidth._minValue.LogicalPixels > 0.0)
					{
						value2 = Extent.Max(new Extent(spannedColumnsInfo._minMaxWidth._minValue.Emus * (double)(1 + num3 - num2) / (double)spannedColumnsInfo._key._span, ExtentUnitType.Emus), value2);
					}
				}
			}
			return Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(Extent.Max(value, value2));
		}

		internal Extent GetColumnMaxWidth(int columnIndex, int columnSpan)
		{
			ValidateColumnIndex(columnIndex, columnSpan);
			if (columnIndex + columnSpan == _columns.Count)
			{
				return _constraintX + _constraintX;
			}
			Extent? extent = null;
			for (int i = columnIndex; i < columnIndex + columnSpan; i++)
			{
				ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo = _columns[i];
				if (columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth.HasValue)
				{
					extent = (extent.HasValue ? new Extent?(extent.Value + columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth.Value) : new Extent?(columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth.Value));
				}
			}
			Extent? actualWidth = _columns[columnIndex + columnSpan]._actualWidth;
			if (!extent.HasValue || !actualWidth.HasValue)
			{
				return default(Extent);
			}
			Extent columnMinWidth = GetColumnMinWidth(columnIndex + columnSpan, 1);
			Extent extent2 = Extent.Max(actualWidth.Value - columnMinWidth, default(Extent));
			return extent.Value + extent2;
		}

		internal Extent GetColumnWidth(int columnIndex, int columnSpan)
		{

		}

		internal void InvalidateLayoutGrid(bool processLayoutAsynchronously = false)
		{

			SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsLayoutGridValid, value: false);
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsTableNodeGridValid, value: false);

			SetFlag(InternalFlags.AreActualColumnWidthsValid, value: false);

			else

			}
		}

		internal void ResizeColumn(int columnIndex, int columnSpan, Extent widthDelta, bool adjustNextColumn = true)
		{
			if (widthDelta.LogicalPixels == 0.0 || GetFlag(InternalFlags.IsInColumnResize))
			{
				return;
			}
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsInColumnResize, value: true);
			try
			{
				TableSettings settingsResolved = SettingsResolved;
				Utilities.GetResolvedValue(settingsResolved.TableLayout, TableLayout.Autofit);
				TableExtent? tablePreferredWidthSetting = settingsResolved.PreferredWidth;
				GetTablePreferredWidthInTwips(_constraintX, tablePreferredWidthSetting);
				if (tablePreferredWidthSetting.HasValue)
				{
					TableExtentUnitType unitTypeResolved = tablePreferredWidthSetting.Value.UnitTypeResolved;
					if (unitTypeResolved == TableExtentUnitType.Twip || unitTypeResolved == TableExtentUnitType.Percent)
					{
						_ = tablePreferredWidthSetting.Value.GetExtent(_constraintX, default(Extent)).Twips;
					}
					else
					{
						tablePreferredWidthSetting = null;
					}
				}
				ValidateColumnIndex(columnIndex, columnSpan);
				int num = columnIndex + columnSpan - 1;
				ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo = ((columnIndex + columnSpan < _columns.Count) ? _columns[columnIndex + columnSpan] : null);
				if (columnLayoutInfo == null)
				{
					adjustNextColumn = false;
				}
				Extent? extent = (adjustNextColumn ? columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth : ((Extent?)null));
				Extent[] array = new Extent[_columns.Count];
				Extent[] array2 = new Extent[_columns.Count];
				Extent extent2 = default(Extent);
				for (int i = 0; i < _columns.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = default(Extent);
					ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo2 = _columns[i];
					if (!columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.HasValue)
					{
						return;
					}
					array2[i] = columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.Value;
					extent2 += columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.Value;
				}
				Extent extent3 = ((!(widthDelta.Emus > 0.0 && adjustNextColumn)) ? widthDelta : Extent.Min(extent.Value - GetColumnMinWidth(num + 1, 1), widthDelta));
				for (int num2 = num; num2 >= columnIndex; num2--)
				{
					_ = _columns[num2];
					if (widthDelta.Emus < 0.0)
					{
						Extent value = GetColumnMinWidth(num2, 1) - array2[num2];
						array[num2] = Extent.Min(Extent.Max(value, extent3), default(Extent));
					}
					else
					{
						array[num2] = extent3;
					}
					extent3 -= array[num2];
				}
				widthDelta -= extent3;
				if (widthDelta.Emus == 0.0)
				{
					return;
				}
				Extent[] array3 = new Extent[_columns.Count];
				for (int j = 0; j < _columns.Count; j++)
				{
					array3[j] = array2[j] + array[j];
				}
				if (!adjustNextColumn)
				{
					TableCellLayoutNode parentCell = ParentCell;
					if (parentCell != null && widthDelta.Emus > 0.0)
					{
						Extent extent4 = extent2 + widthDelta;
						Extent width = parentCell.Width;
						if (extent4 > width)
						{
							parentCell.ParentTable.ResizeColumn(parentCell._column, parentCell._columnSpan, extent4 - width, adjustNextColumn: false);
						}
					}
					_ = _columns[num];
					List<TableCellLayoutNode> list = new List<TableCellLayoutNode>();
					foreach (LayoutNodeBase childNode in ChildNodes)
					{
						if (childNode.ChildNodes == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (LayoutNodeBase childNode2 in childNode.ChildNodes)
						{
							if (childNode2 is TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode && tableCellLayoutNode._column + tableCellLayoutNode._columnSpan - 1 == num && tableCellLayoutNode.HasNestedTable)
							{
								list.Add(tableCellLayoutNode);
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (TableCellLayoutNode item in list)
					{
						Extent extent5 = default(Extent);
						int num3 = item._column;
						for (int num4 = item._columnSpan; num4 > 0; num4--)
						{
							extent5 += array3[num3];
							num3++;
						}
						extent5 -= item.BorderBlock.Width - item.Width;
						foreach (LayoutNodeBase childNode3 in item.ChildNodes)
						{
							if (!(childNode3 is TableLayoutNode { _columns: not null } tableLayoutNode) || tableLayoutNode._columns.Count <= 0)
							{
								continue;
							}
							Extent widthDelta2 = widthDelta;
							if (widthDelta.LogicalPixels < 0.0)
							{
								widthDelta2 = extent5 - tableLayoutNode.Width;
								if (widthDelta2.LogicalPixels >= 0.0)
								{
									continue;
								}
							}
							tableLayoutNode.ResizeColumn(0, tableLayoutNode._columns.Count, widthDelta2, adjustNextColumn: false);
						}
					}
				}
				Extent extent6 = AggregateAllComunWidths();
				RichTextDocument document = base.Document;
				document.BeginAtomicOperation(Utilities.GetString("Op_ResizeTableColumn_Title"), Utilities.GetString("Op_ResizeTableColumn_Description"));
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingDocumentSettings, value: true);
				try
				{
					int num5 = (adjustNextColumn ? (columnIndex + 1) : columnIndex);
					LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
					int k = 0;
					for (int num6 = childNodes?.Count ?? 0; k < num6; k++)
					{
						if (!(childNodes[k] is TableRowLayoutNode tableRowLayoutNode))
						{
							continue;
						}
						TableRowSettings settingsResolved2 = tableRowLayoutNode.SettingsResolved;
						int value2 = settingsResolved2.LeadingEmptyCellCount.Value;
						int num7 = settingsResolved2.TrailingEmptyCellCount.Value;
						LayoutNodeCollection childNodes2 = tableRowLayoutNode.ChildNodes;
						int num8 = 0;
						int num9 = value2;
						int l = 0;
						for (int num10 = childNodes2?.Count ?? 0; l < num10; l++)
						{
							TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode2 = childNodes2[l] as TableCellLayoutNode;
							if (!(tableCellLayoutNode2.DocumentNode is TableCellNode tableCellNode))
							{
								continue;
							}
							TableCellSettings settingsResolved3 = tableCellLayoutNode2.SettingsResolved;
							int num11 = tableCellNode.SettingsResolved.ColumnSpan.Value;
							Extent extent7 = tableCellLayoutNode2.BorderBlock.ConstraintX;
							while (num11 > 0)
							{
								if (num9 >= columnIndex && num9 <= num)
								{
									extent7 += array[num9];
								}
								else if (num9 == num5)
								{
									extent7 = Extent.Max(extent7 - widthDelta, new Extent(1.0, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels));
								}
								num9++;
								num8++;
								num11--;
							}
							if (extent7.Emus > 0.0)
							{
								settingsResolved3 = tableCellNode.GetUniqueSettings();
								settingsResolved3.PreferredWidth = new TableExtent(extent7);
								tableCellNode.Settings = settingsResolved3;
							}
						}
						int num12 = _columns.Count - (value2 + num8);
						TableRowNode tableRowNode = tableRowLayoutNode.DocumentNode as TableRowNode;
						TableRowSettings tableRowSettings = tableRowNode.Settings;
						if (num12 >= 0 && num12 != num7)
						{
							num7 = num12;
							if (tableRowSettings == null)
							{
								tableRowSettings = new TableRowSettings();
							}
							tableRowSettings.TrailingEmptyCellCount = num7;
						}
						bool flag;
						if (!adjustNextColumn)
						{
							if (value2 >= columnIndex + columnSpan)
							{
								if (tableRowSettings == null)
								{
									tableRowSettings = new TableRowSettings();
								}
								Extent extent8 = default(Extent);
								for (int m = 0; m < array.Length; m++)
								{
									extent8 += array2[m] + array[m];
								}
								tableRowSettings.LeadingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth = new TableExtent(extent8);
							}
							flag = num7 > 0 && columnIndex + columnSpan >= _columns.Count - (num7 + value2);
						}
						else
						{
							flag = num7 > 0 && columnIndex <= _columns.Count - (num7 + value2) && num5 > _columns.Count - (num7 + value2);
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							if (tableRowSettings == null)
							{
								tableRowSettings = new TableRowSettings();
							}
							int num13 = _columns.Count - (num7 + value2);
							Extent extent9 = default(Extent);
							for (int n = num13; n < _columns.Count; n++)
							{
								extent9 += array2[n] + array[n];
							}
							tableRowSettings.TrailingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth = new TableExtent(extent9);
						}
						if (tableRowSettings != null)
						{
							tableRowNode.Settings = tableRowSettings;
						}
					}
					if (!adjustNextColumn && tablePreferredWidthSetting.HasValue)
					{
						Extent extent10 = widthDelta + extent6;
						bool num14 = extent10 > _constraintX;
						TableExtent? preferredWidth = null;
						if (num14)
						{
							preferredWidth = ((!tablePreferredWidthSetting.HasValue || tablePreferredWidthSetting.Value.UnitTypeResolved != TableExtentUnitType.Percent || !(_constraintX.Emus > 0.0)) ? new TableExtent?(new TableExtent(extent10)) : new TableExtent?(new TableExtent(extent10.Emus * 100.0 / _constraintX.Emus, TableExtentUnitType.Percent)));
						}
						TableSettings uniqueSettings = _table.GetUniqueSettings();
						uniqueSettings.PreferredWidth = preferredWidth;
						_table.Settings = uniqueSettings;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingDocumentSettings, value: false);
					document.EndAtomicOperation();
					InvalidateLayoutGrid();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsInColumnResize, value: false);
			}
		}

		internal void ResizeRow(int rowIndex, Extent heightDelta)
		{
			if (heightDelta.LogicalPixels == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			TableRowLayoutNode rowAtIndex = GetRowAtIndex(rowIndex);
			if (rowAtIndex == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Extent height = rowAtIndex.Height;
			TableRowNode tableRowNode = rowAtIndex.DocumentNode as TableRowNode;
			TableRowSettings uniqueSettings = tableRowNode.GetUniqueSettings();
			LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
			bool flag = layoutManager != null && !layoutManager.IsPageLayout && uniqueSettings.Height.HasValue && uniqueSettings.Height.Value.Rule == ExtentRule.Exact;
			RichTextDocument document = base.Document;
			document.BeginAtomicOperation(Utilities.GetString("Op_ResizeTableRow_Title"), Utilities.GetString("Op_ResizeTableRow_Description"));
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingDocumentSettings, value: true);
			try
			{
				uniqueSettings.Height = new TableRowHeight(Extent.Max(height + heightDelta, rowAtIndex.GetMinHeight()), (!flag) ? ExtentRule.AtLeast : ExtentRule.Exact);
				tableRowNode.Settings = uniqueSettings;
			}
			finally
			{
				document.EndAtomicOperation();
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingDocumentSettings, value: false);
				RelayoutTable();
			}
		}

		internal void ResizeTable(Extent widthDelta, Extent heightDelta)
		{
			if ((Math.Abs(widthDelta.LogicalPixels) < Extent.LogicalToDevicePixelFactor && Math.Abs(heightDelta.LogicalPixels) < Extent.LogicalToDevicePixelFactor) || ChildNodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			VerifyActualColumnWidths();
			RichTextDocument document = base.Document;
			document.BeginAtomicOperation(Utilities.GetString("Op_ResizeTable_Title"), Utilities.GetString("Op_ResizeTable_Description"));
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingDocumentSettings, value: true);
			LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
			try
			{
				LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
				int count = childNodes.Count;
				int count2 = _columns.Count;
				if (Math.Abs(heightDelta.LogicalPixels) >= 1.0)
				{
					Extent extent = heightDelta;
					if (extent.Emus > 0.0)
					{
						int num = count;
						for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
						{
							TableRowLayoutNode tableRowLayoutNode = childNodes[i] as TableRowLayoutNode;
							TableRowNode tableRowNode = ((tableRowLayoutNode != null) ? (tableRowLayoutNode.DocumentNode as TableRowNode) : null);
							TableRowSettings tableRowSettings = tableRowNode?.GetUniqueSettings();
							if (tableRowSettings == null)
							{
								num--;
								continue;
							}
							Extent extent2 = new Extent(extent.Emus / (double)num, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
							extent -= extent2;
							num--;
							bool flag = layoutManager != null && !layoutManager.IsPageLayout && tableRowSettings.Height.HasValue && tableRowSettings.Height.Value.Rule == ExtentRule.Exact;
							tableRowSettings.Height = new TableRowHeight(Extent.Max(tableRowLayoutNode.Height + extent2, tableRowLayoutNode.GetMinHeight()), (!flag) ? ExtentRule.AtLeast : ExtentRule.Exact);
							tableRowNode.Settings = tableRowSettings;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						extent = new Extent(extent.Emus * -1.0, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
						List<TableRowLayoutNode> list = new List<TableRowLayoutNode>();
						foreach (LayoutNodeBase childNode in ChildNodes)
						{
							if (childNode is TableRowLayoutNode tableRowLayoutNode2 && tableRowLayoutNode2.Height > tableRowLayoutNode2.GetMinHeight(includeExactHeightSetting: true))
							{
								list.Add(tableRowLayoutNode2);
							}
						}
						int num2 = list.Count;
						while (num2 > 0 && extent.LogicalPixels >= 1.0)
						{
							int num3 = num2;
							for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
							{
								TableRowLayoutNode tableRowLayoutNode3 = list[j];
								Extent height = tableRowLayoutNode3.Height;
								Extent extent3 = new Extent(extent.Emus / (double)num3, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
								Extent extent4 = height - tableRowLayoutNode3.GetMinHeight(includeExactHeightSetting: true);
								bool num4 = extent4 <= extent3;
								if (num4)
								{
									extent3 = extent4;
								}
								extent -= extent3;
								num3--;
								TableRowNode obj = tableRowLayoutNode3.DocumentNode as TableRowNode;
								TableRowSettings uniqueSettings = obj.GetUniqueSettings();
								uniqueSettings.Height = new TableRowHeight(rule: (layoutManager == null || layoutManager.IsPageLayout || !uniqueSettings.Height.HasValue || uniqueSettings.Height.Value.Rule != ExtentRule.Exact) ? ExtentRule.AtLeast : ExtentRule.Exact, extent: Extent.Max(height - extent3, tableRowLayoutNode3.GetMinHeight()));
								obj.Settings = uniqueSettings;
								if (num4)
								{
									list.RemoveAt(j);
									num2--;
									j--;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (!(Math.Abs(widthDelta.LogicalPixels) >= 1.0))
				{
					return;
				}
				TableSettings settingsResolved = SettingsResolved;
				Utilities.GetResolvedValue(settingsResolved.TableLayout, TableLayout.Autofit);
				TableExtent? tablePreferredWidthSetting = settingsResolved.PreferredWidth;
				GetTablePreferredWidthInTwips(_constraintX, tablePreferredWidthSetting);
				if (tablePreferredWidthSetting.HasValue)
				{
					TableExtentUnitType unitTypeResolved = tablePreferredWidthSetting.Value.UnitTypeResolved;
					if (unitTypeResolved == TableExtentUnitType.Twip || unitTypeResolved == TableExtentUnitType.Percent)
					{
						_ = tablePreferredWidthSetting.Value.GetExtent(_constraintX, default(Extent)).Twips;
					}
					else
					{
						tablePreferredWidthSetting = null;
					}
				}
				Extent extent5 = AggregateAllComunWidths();
				Extent extent6 = widthDelta;
				if (extent6.Emus > 0.0)
				{
					int num5 = count2;
					for (int k = 0; k < count2; k++)
					{
						Extent extent7 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(extent6.LogicalPixels / (double)num5);
						extent6 -= extent7;
						num5--;
						ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo = _columns[k];
						columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth += extent7;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					extent6 = new Extent(extent6.Emus * -1.0, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
					List<ColumnLayoutInfo> list2 = new List<ColumnLayoutInfo>();
					for (int l = 0; l < count2; l++)
					{
						ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo2 = _columns[l];
						if (columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.HasValue && columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.Value > columnLayoutInfo2._minMaxWidth._minValue)
						{
							list2.Add(columnLayoutInfo2);
						}
					}
					int num6 = list2.Count;
					while (num6 > 0 && extent6.LogicalPixels >= 1.0)
					{
						int num7 = num6;
						for (int m = 0; m < num6; m++)
						{
							ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo3 = list2[m];
							Extent extent8 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(extent6.LogicalPixels / (double)num7);
							Extent extent9 = columnLayoutInfo3._actualWidth.Value - columnLayoutInfo3._minMaxWidth._minValue;
							bool num8 = extent9 <= extent8;
							if (num8)
							{
								extent8 = extent9;
							}
							extent6 -= extent8;
							num7--;
							columnLayoutInfo3._actualWidth -= extent8;
							if (num8)
							{
								list2.RemoveAt(m);
								num6--;
								m--;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				SetAllCellPreferredWidths();
				if (tablePreferredWidthSetting.HasValue)
				{
					Extent extent10 = widthDelta + extent5;
					bool num9 = extent10 > _constraintX;
					TableExtent? preferredWidth = null;
					if (num9)
					{
						preferredWidth = ((!tablePreferredWidthSetting.HasValue || tablePreferredWidthSetting.Value.UnitTypeResolved != TableExtentUnitType.Percent || !(_constraintX.Emus > 0.0)) ? new TableExtent?(new TableExtent(extent10)) : new TableExtent?(new TableExtent(extent10.Emus * 100.0 / _constraintX.Emus, TableExtentUnitType.Percent)));
					}
					TableSettings uniqueSettings2 = _table.GetUniqueSettings();
					uniqueSettings2.PreferredWidth = preferredWidth;
					_table.Settings = uniqueSettings2;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SetFlag(InternalFlags.IsUpdatingDocumentSettings, value: false);
				document.EndAtomicOperation();
				InvalidateLayoutGrid();
			}
		}

		private Extent AggregateAllComunWidths()
		{
			Extent result = default(Extent);
			foreach (ColumnLayoutInfo column in _columns)
			{
				if (column._actualWidth.HasValue)
				{
					result += column._actualWidth.Value;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Extent CalculateBorderOverlap(BlockNodeBorders borders, TableCellLayoutNode cell, bool top)
		{
			Extent extent = default(Extent);
			if (top)
			{
				if (borders.Top != null && cell.Row > 0)
				{
					return extent - borders.Top.BorderThickness;
				}
			}
			else if (borders.Left != null && !cell.IsFirstCellInRow)
			{
				return extent - borders.Left.BorderThickness;
			}
			return extent;
		}

		private Extent CalculateCellConstraintX(TableCellLayoutNode cell)
		{
			Extent value = default(Extent);
			int i = cell._column;
			for (int num = cell._column + cell._columnSpan; i < num; i++)
			{
				ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo = _columns[i];
				if (columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth.HasValue)
				{
					value += columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth.Value;
				}
			}
			return Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(value);
		}

		private Extent CalculateColumnOffsets(List<ColumnLayoutInfo> columns)
		{
			Extent extent = default(Extent);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = columns.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo = columns[i];
				columnLayoutInfo._offsetX = extent;
				if (columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth.HasValue)
				{
					extent += columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth.Value;
				}
			}
			return extent;
		}

		private static RichTextBorder GetCellEdgeBorder(BlockNodeBorders rowBorders, BlockNodeBorders cellBorders, BorderEdge edge)
		{
			return edge switch
			{
				BorderEdge.Bottom => GetCellEdgeBorderHelper(rowBorders?.Bottom, cellBorders?.Bottom), 
				BorderEdge.Left => GetCellEdgeBorderHelper(rowBorders?.Left, cellBorders?.Left), 
				BorderEdge.Right => GetCellEdgeBorderHelper(rowBorders?.Right, cellBorders?.Right), 
				_ => GetCellEdgeBorderHelper(rowBorders?.Top, cellBorders?.Top), 
			};
		}

		private static RichTextBorder GetCellEdgeBorderHelper(RichTextBorder rowBorder, RichTextBorder cellBorder)
		{
			if (rowBorder == null)
			{
				return cellBorder;
			}
			if (cellBorder == null)
			{
				return rowBorder;
			}
			return cellBorder;
		}

		private bool GetFlag(InternalFlags flag)
		{
			return (_flags & flag) == flag;
		}

		private Extent GetMarginWidth()
		{
			RichTextMargin? richTextMargin = CalculateMarginAndBorderExtents();
			if (richTextMargin.HasValue)
			{
				return richTextMargin.Value.Left + richTextMargin.Value.Right;
			}
			return default(Extent);
		}

		private static double GetTablePreferredWidthInTwips(Extent constraintX, TableExtent? tablePreferredWidthSetting)
		{
			if (tablePreferredWidthSetting.HasValue)
			{
				switch (tablePreferredWidthSetting.Value.UnitTypeResolved)
				{
				case TableExtentUnitType.Twip:
				case TableExtentUnitType.Percent:
					return tablePreferredWidthSetting.Value.GetExtent(constraintX, default(Extent)).Twips;
				}
			}
			return -1.0;
		}

		private void InitializeCellWithSpacingBorder(TableCellLayoutNode cell, BlockNodeBorders rowBorders, BlockNodeBorders cellBorders, BorderEdge edge, DocumentRootNode rootNode, ref BlockNodeBorders outerBorders, ref BlockNodeBorders innerBorders)

		private TableExtentUnitType ProcessEmptyCellAreaSetting(TableExtentUnitType unitTypeToUse, TableExtent? leadingTrailingAreaWidth, bool isLeading, int cellCount)
		{
			if (leadingTrailingAreaWidth.HasValue)
			{
				TableExtentUnitType unitTypeResolved = leadingTrailingAreaWidth.Value.UnitTypeResolved;
				if (unitTypeResolved == TableExtentUnitType.Twip || unitTypeResolved == TableExtentUnitType.Percent)
				{

					{

					}
					unitTypeResolved = unitTypeToUse;
				}
				else
				{
					unitTypeResolved = TableExtentUnitType.Auto;
				}
				if (unitTypeResolved != TableExtentUnitType.Auto)
				{
					List<ColumnLayoutInfo> list = new List<ColumnLayoutInfo>(cellCount);
					int num = (isLeading ? 1 : (-1));
					int num2 = ((!isLeading) ? (_columns.Count - 1) : 0);
					int num3 = num2 + num * cellCount;
					int num4 = 0;
					double num5 = 0.0;
					for (int i = num2; i != num3; i += num)
					{
						ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo = _columns[i];
						if (columnLayoutInfo._preferredWidth.HasValue)
						{
							num5 += columnLayoutInfo._preferredWidth.Value.Value;
						}
						else
						{
							num4++;
						}
						list.Add(columnLayoutInfo);
					}
					double num6 = leadingTrailingAreaWidth.Value.Value - num5;
					if (num6 > 0.0)
					{
						if (num4 > 0)
						{
							int num7 = num4;
							double num8 = num6;
							int j = 0;
							for (int count = list.Count; j < count; j++)
							{
								ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo2 = list[j];

								{
									double num9 = num8 / (double)num7;
									columnLayoutInfo2._preferredWidth = new TableExtent(num9, unitTypeResolved);
									num8 -= num9;
									num7--;
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							int index = ((!isLeading) ? (list.Count - 1) : 0);
							list[index]._preferredWidth = new TableExtent(list[index]._preferredWidth.Value.Value + num6, unitTypeResolved);
						}
					}
				}

		}

		private void ProcessRowSpanningCell(TableCellLayoutNode cell)
		{
			if (cell._rowSpan < 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			int row = cell.Row;
			if (row < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes != null)
			{
				int num = row + cell._rowSpan - 1;

				{

				}
				tableRowLayoutNode._terminatingSpannedCells.Add(cell);
				if (num == childNodes.Count - 1)
				{
					cell.IsInLastRowInTable = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void RelayoutTable()
		{
			_pendingRelayoutTable = null;
			if (_table != null && base.IsSubTreeLoaded)
			{

			}
		}

		private void RelayoutTableAsync()
		{

			}
		}

						if (columnLayoutInfo3._actualWidth.HasValue)
						{
							extent3 += columnLayoutInfo3._actualWidth.Value;
						}
						else
						{
							extent3 += columnLayoutInfo3._minMaxWidth._minValue;
						}
					}
					tableRowSettings.TrailingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth = new TableExtent(extent3);
				}
				if (tableRowSettings != null)
				{
					tableRowNode.Settings = tableRowSettings;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_flags &= (InternalFlags)(byte)(~(int)flag);
			}
		}

		private static bool ShrinkColumnWidthsToFit(List<ColumnLayoutInfo> columns, int columnsWithPreferredWidth, bool allotAcrossAllColumns, ref Extent width, ref Extent delta)
		{
			bool result = false;
			Extent extent;
			if ((allotAcrossAllColumns ? columns.Count : (columns.Count - columnsWithPreferredWidth)) == columns.Count)
			{
				extent = width;
			}
			else
			{
				extent = default(Extent);
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = columns.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo = columns[i];
					if (columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth.HasValue && columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth.Value.Emus != 0.0 && (!columnLayoutInfo._preferredWidth.HasValue || columnLayoutInfo._preferredWidth.Value.UnitType != TableExtentUnitType.Twip))
					{
						extent += columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth.Value;
					}
				}
				if (extent.Emus == 0.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			while (extent.LogicalPixels > 0.0 && delta.LogicalPixels > 0.0)
			{
				double num = Math.Max(delta.Emus / extent.Emus, 0.001);
				Extent extent2 = default(Extent);
				Extent extent3 = default(Extent);
				int j = 0;
				for (int count2 = columns.Count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo2 = columns[j];
					if (columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.HasValue && columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.Value.Emus != 0.0 && (allotAcrossAllColumns || !columnLayoutInfo2._preferredWidth.HasValue || columnLayoutInfo2._preferredWidth.Value.UnitType != TableExtentUnitType.Twip) && !(columnLayoutInfo2._minMaxWidth._minValue >= columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.Value))
					{
						Extent extent4 = new Extent(columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.Value.Emus * num, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
						extent4 = Extent.Min(extent4, columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.Value - columnLayoutInfo2._minMaxWidth._minValue);
						columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth = columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.Value - extent4;
						columnLayoutInfo2.RoundToIntegralDevicePixel();
						extent3 += extent4;
						if (!(columnLayoutInfo2._minMaxWidth._minValue >= columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.Value))
						{
							extent2 += columnLayoutInfo2._actualWidth.Value;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!(extent3.Emus > 0.0))
				{
					break;
				}
				result = true;
				extent = extent2;
				delta -= extent3;
				if (!allotAcrossAllColumns)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void ValidateColumnIndex(int columnIndex, int columnSpan)
		{
			VerifyActualColumnWidths();
			if (columnSpan <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("columnSpan");
			}
			if (columnIndex < 0 || columnIndex + columnSpan > _columns.Count)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("columnIndex");
			}
		}

		private void ValidateRowIndex(int rowIndex)
		{
			if (rowIndex < 0 || ChildNodes == null || rowIndex >= ChildNodes.Count)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("rowIndex");
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyActualColumnWidths()
		{
			VerifyTableNodeGrid();

				{
					aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.InvalidateAggregateInfoOnAllNodes();
				}
				InvalidateAggregatedHeight();
			}
		}

		private void VerifyPreferredWidths()
		{
			VerifyLayoutGrid();
			if (GetFlag(InternalFlags.AreMinMaxColumnWidthsValid))
			{
				return;
			}
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.AreMinMaxColumnWidthsValid, value: true);
			SetFlag(InternalFlags.UsePercentagePreferredWidths, value: false);
			TableExtentUnitType tableExtentUnitType = TableExtentUnitType.Auto;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _columns.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ColumnLayoutInfo columnLayoutInfo = _columns[i];
				columnLayoutInfo._preferredWidth = null;
				columnLayoutInfo._actualWidth = null;
				columnLayoutInfo._minMaxWidth = new MinMaxExtent(new Extent(-1.0, ExtentUnitType.Emus), new Extent(-1.0, ExtentUnitType.Emus));
				if (columnLayoutInfo._spanningInfo != null)
				{
					if (_columnSpanningCells.Count == 0)
					{
						columnLayoutInfo._spanningInfo = null;
					}
					else
					{
						columnLayoutInfo._spanningInfo.Clear();
					}
				}
				int j = 0;
				for (int count2 = columnLayoutInfo._nonSpanningCells.Count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode = columnLayoutInfo._nonSpanningCells[j];
					TableExtent? preferredWidth = tableCellLayoutNode.SettingsResolved.PreferredWidth;
					if (preferredWidth.HasValue)
					{
						TableExtentUnitType unitTypeResolved = preferredWidth.Value.UnitTypeResolved;
						if (unitTypeResolved == TableExtentUnitType.Twip || unitTypeResolved == TableExtentUnitType.Percent)
						{
							if (tableExtentUnitType == TableExtentUnitType.Auto)
							{
								tableExtentUnitType = unitTypeResolved;
							}
							unitTypeResolved = tableExtentUnitType;
						}
						else
						{
							unitTypeResolved = TableExtentUnitType.Auto;
						}
						if (unitTypeResolved != TableExtentUnitType.Auto)
						{
							double value = preferredWidth.Value.Value;
							if (!columnLayoutInfo._preferredWidth.HasValue || columnLayoutInfo._preferredWidth.Value.Value < value)
							{
								columnLayoutInfo._preferredWidth = new TableExtent(value, unitTypeResolved);
							}
						}
					}
					MinMaxExtent minMaxWidth = tableCellLayoutNode.GetMinMaxWidth();
					columnLayoutInfo._minMaxWidth._minValue = Extent.Max(minMaxWidth._minValue, columnLayoutInfo._minMaxWidth._minValue);
					columnLayoutInfo._minMaxWidth._maxValue = Extent.Max(minMaxWidth._maxValue, columnLayoutInfo._minMaxWidth._maxValue);
				}
			}
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			int k = 0;
			for (int num = childNodes?.Count ?? 0; k < num; k++)
			{
				TableRowSettings settingsResolved = (childNodes[k] as TableRowLayoutNode).SettingsResolved;
				int resolvedValue = Utilities.GetResolvedValue(settingsResolved.LeadingEmptyCellCount, 0);
				if (resolvedValue > 0)
				{
					TableExtent? leadingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth = settingsResolved.LeadingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth;
					tableExtentUnitType = ProcessEmptyCellAreaSetting(tableExtentUnitType, leadingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth, isLeading: true, resolvedValue);
				}
				int resolvedValue2 = Utilities.GetResolvedValue(settingsResolved.TrailingEmptyCellCount, 0);
				if (resolvedValue2 > 0)
				{
					TableExtent? trailingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth = settingsResolved.TrailingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth;
					tableExtentUnitType = ProcessEmptyCellAreaSetting(tableExtentUnitType, trailingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth, isLeading: false, resolvedValue2);
				}
			}
			bool flag = true;
			Dictionary<TableSpanningKey, SpannedColumnsInfo> dictionary = null;
			if (_columnSpanningCells.Count > 0)
			{

		internal override ILayoutNodeWithLines GetNodeWithLinesAtPoint(ref System.Windows.Point point)
