						tableRowLayoutNode = tableRowLayoutNode.GetSiblingBlock(next: false) as TableRowLayoutNode;
						if (tableRowLayoutNode == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						point.Y += tableRowLayoutNode.Height.LogicalPixels;
						if (tableRowLayoutNode.GetCellAtColumn(tableCellLayoutNode.Column) != null)
						{
							return tableRowLayoutNode.GetNodeWithLinesAtPoint(ref point);
						}
					}
					return null;
				}
				point.X = Math.Max(point.X - borderBlock.RelativeOffsetX.LogicalPixels, 0.0);
				point.Y = Math.Max(point.Y - borderBlock.RelativeOffsetY.LogicalPixels, 0.0);
				ILayoutNodeWithLines nodeWithLinesAtPoint = tableCellLayoutNode.GetNodeWithLinesAtPoint(ref point);
				if (nodeWithLinesAtPoint == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				return nodeWithLinesAtPoint;
			}
			return this;
		}

		public override RichTextHitTestResult? HitTest(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint)
		{
			Rect? overallRect = base.OverallRect;
			if (!overallRect.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RichTextLine rowMarkLine = RowMarkLine;
			if (rowMarkLine != null && rowMarkLine.Count > 0)
			{
				RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = rowMarkLine[0];
				double num = layoutPoint.X - overallRect.Value.Left;
				double num2 = layoutPoint.Y - overallRect.Value.Top;
				double num3 = rowMarkLine.RelativeOffsetY.LogicalPixels + richTextLineContent.RelativeOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
				double logicalPixels = richTextLineContent.RelativeOffsetX.LogicalPixels;
				if (num2 >= num3 && num2 <= num3 + richTextLineContent.Height.LogicalPixels && num >= logicalPixels && num <= logicalPixels + richTextLineContent.OverallWidth.LogicalPixels)
				{
					return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableRowMark, this, this, this);
				}
			}
			Rect value = overallRect.Value;
			value.X -= 5.0;
			value.Width += 7.5;
			value.Height += 2.5;
			if (!value.Contains(layoutPoint))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (HasChildBlocks)
			{
				foreach (ILayoutBlock item in GetChildBlocksInViewPort(overallRect.Value))
				{
					RichTextHitTestResult? result = item.HitTest(layoutPoint);
					if (result.HasValue)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
			}
			if (_terminatingSpannedCells != null)
			{
				foreach (TableCellLayoutNode terminatingSpannedCell in _terminatingSpannedCells)
				{
					ILayoutBlock borderBlock = terminatingSpannedCell.BorderBlock;
					if (borderBlock != null)
					{
						RichTextHitTestResult? result2 = borderBlock.HitTest(layoutPoint);
						if (result2.HasValue)
						{
							return result2;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return new RichTextHitTestResult(RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableRow, this, this, this);
		}

		protected internal override void OnAddedToTree(LayoutNodeBase afterNode, LayoutNodeBase beforeNode)
		{
			base.OnAddedToTree(afterNode, beforeNode);
			InitializeBordersAndMargins();
		}

		protected override void OnChildrenCleared()
		{
			InvalidatelayoutGrid(processLayoutAsynchronously: true);
		}

		protected override void OnChildrenAddedAndRemoved(IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> addedNodes, IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> removedNodes)
		{
			if (addedNodes != null)
			{
				CreateAddedSubTree(addedNodes, LayoutManager);
			}
			InvalidatelayoutGrid(processLayoutAsynchronously: true);
		}

		protected override void OnDisposed()
		{
			if (_tableRow != null && !_tableRow.IsSealed)
			{
				PropertyChangeListenerList.ManageListenerHelper(ref _tableRow, null, this, useWeakReference: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreDisposed()
		{
			ParentTable?.InvalidateLayoutGrid(processLayoutAsynchronously: true);
			base.OnPreDisposed();
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
			if (property == "SettingsResolved" || property == "TableSettingsResolved")
			{
				TableLayoutNode parentTable = ParentTable;
				if (parentTable == null || !parentTable.IsUpdatingDocumentSettings)
				{
					InitializeBordersAndMargins();
					InvalidatelayoutGrid(processLayoutAsynchronously: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Table row: {Row}";
		}

		internal void ClearRowMarkLine()
		{
			_rowMarkLine = null;
		}

		internal static void CreateAddedSubTree(IEnumerable<LayoutNodeBase> addedNodes, LayoutManagerBase lm)
		{
			List<LayoutNodeBase> list = new List<LayoutNodeBase>();
			foreach (LayoutNodeBase addedNode in addedNodes)
			{
				if (!(addedNode is TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode))
				{
					continue;
				}
				AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection = (AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection)(tableCellLayoutNode.ChildNodes = new AggregatingLayoutNodeCollection());
				NodeBase documentNode = tableCellLayoutNode.DocumentNode;
				if (documentNode.ChildNodes == null || documentNode.ChildNodes.Count == 0)
				{
					tableCellLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
					continue;
				}
				foreach (NodeBase childNode in documentNode.ChildNodes)
				{
					LayoutNodeBase layoutNodeBase = LayoutNodeBase.Create(childNode, lm, tableCellLayoutNode);
					if (layoutNodeBase != null)
					{
						aggregatingLayoutNodeCollection.Add(layoutNodeBase);
						list.Add(layoutNodeBase);
					}
				}
				TableCellLayoutNode.CreateAddedSubTree(list, lm);
				list.Clear();
				tableCellLayoutNode.IsSubTreeLoaded = true;
			}
		}

		internal TableCellLayoutNode GetCellAtColumn(int columnIndex, bool includeCellsThatTerminateOnThisRow = false)
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			int num = childNodes?.Count ?? 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (childNodes[i] is TableCellLayoutNode { IgnoreCell: false } tableCellLayoutNode)
				{
					if (columnIndex >= tableCellLayoutNode.Column && columnIndex < tableCellLayoutNode.Column + tableCellLayoutNode.ColumnSpan)
					{
						return tableCellLayoutNode;
					}
					if (columnIndex < tableCellLayoutNode.Column)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
			}
			if (includeCellsThatTerminateOnThisRow && _terminatingSpannedCells != null)
			{
				num = _terminatingSpannedCells.Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode2 = _terminatingSpannedCells[j];
					if (tableCellLayoutNode2 != null && columnIndex >= tableCellLayoutNode2.Column && columnIndex < tableCellLayoutNode2.Column + tableCellLayoutNode2.ColumnSpan)
					{
						return tableCellLayoutNode2;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public int? GetDocumentOffsetOfLine(IRichTextLine line, bool includeListNumber)
		{
			if (_tableRow == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _tableRow.GetDocumentOffset() + _tableRow.AggregateOffsetCount - _tableRow.PostfixOffsetCount;
		}

		public Extent GetExtraSpacingAtBottom(IRichTextLine line)
		{
			return default(Extent);
		}

		public Extent GetExtraSpacingAtTop(IRichTextLine line)
		{
			return default(Extent);
		}

		internal TableCellLayoutNode GetFirstCell()
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null || childNodes.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return childNodes[0] as TableCellLayoutNode;
		}

		internal TableCellLayoutNode GetLastCell()
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null || childNodes.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return childNodes[childNodes.Count - 1] as TableCellLayoutNode;
		}

		internal Extent GetMinHeight(bool includeExactHeightSetting = false)
		{
			Extent contentHeight = ContentHeight;
			LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
			if (layoutManager != null && layoutManager.IsPageLayout)
			{
				TableRowSettings settingsResolved = SettingsResolved;
				if (settingsResolved != null && settingsResolved.Height.HasValue && settingsResolved.Height.Value.Rule == ExtentRule.Exact)
				{
					return Extent.Min(settingsResolved.Height.Value.Extent, contentHeight);
				}
			}
			return contentHeight;
		}

		internal void InitializeIndent()
		{
			_indent = TableSettingsResolved.TableIndent ?? default(Extent);
		}

		internal void InvalidatelayoutGrid(bool processLayoutAsynchronously = false)
		{
			if (base.ParentLayoutNode is TableLayoutNode tableLayoutNode)
			{
				tableLayoutNode.InvalidateLayoutGrid(processLayoutAsynchronously);
			}
		}

		internal void OnInvalidateMinMaxWidth(TableCellLayoutNode cell)
		{
			if (base.ParentLayoutNode is TableLayoutNode tableLayoutNode)
			{
				tableLayoutNode.OnInvalidateMinMaxWidth(cell);
			}
		}

		internal void PerformFinalAlignments(Extent widthConstraint)
		{
			TableSettings tableSettingsResolved = TableSettingsResolved;
			RichTextLine rowMarkLine = RowMarkLine;
			Extent extent = widthConstraint - (_indent + (rowMarkLine?.WidthIncludingParagraphMark ?? default(Extent)));
			Extent extent2 = default(Extent);
			if (extent.Emus > 0.0 && tableSettingsResolved.Alignment.HasValue && extent.LogicalPixels > 0.0)
			{
				switch (tableSettingsResolved.Alignment.Value)
				{
				case TableAlignment.Center:
					extent2 = new Extent(extent.Emus / 2.0, ExtentUnitType.Emus);
					break;
				case TableAlignment.End:
					extent2 = extent;
					break;
				}
			}
			RichTextMargin? margins = ParentTable.Margins;
			Extent extent3 = extent2 + _indent;
			Extent obj;
			if (margins.HasValue)
			{
				_ = margins.Value.Left;
				obj = margins.Value.Left;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = default(Extent);
			}
			SetRelativeOffsetX(extent3 + obj);
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = ChildNodes;
			int i = 0;
			for (int num = childNodes?.Count ?? 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (childNodes[i] is TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode)
				{
					tableCellLayoutNode.BorderBlock.PerformFinalAlignments();
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeBordersAndMargins()
		{
			TableRowSettings settingsResolved = _tableRow.SettingsResolved;
			_ = _tableRow.TableSettingsResolved;
			_cellSpacing = (settingsResolved.CellSpacing.HasValue ? Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(settingsResolved.CellSpacing.Value) : default(Extent));
		}

		int? ILayoutNodeWithLines.GetDocumentOffsetFromLayoutPoint(System.Windows.Point relativePoint, bool includeListNumbers, bool includeParagraphMarks)
		{
			int postfixOffsetCount = _tableRow.PostfixOffsetCount;
			if (postfixOffsetCount == 0 || relativePoint.X < Width.LogicalPixels)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _tableRow.GetDocumentOffset() + _tableRow.AggregateOffsetCount - postfixOffsetCount;
		}

		int ILayoutNodeWithLines.GetDocumentOffsetCountOfLine(IRichTextLine line, bool includeListNumber, bool includeNewLine)
		{
			return 1;
		}
	}
	internal class TextLayoutNode : ContentLayoutNode
	{
		internal class TextChangeInfo
		{
			internal TextLayoutNode _textNode;

			internal RunLayoutNode _parentRun;

			internal ParagraphLayoutNode _grandParentParagraph;

			internal string _text;

			internal TextChangeInfo(TextLayoutNode textNode)
			{
				_textNode = textNode;
				_text = ((TextNode)_textNode.DocumentNode).Text;
				_parentRun = _textNode.ParentLayoutNode as RunLayoutNode;
				_grandParentParagraph = _parentRun.ParentParagraph;
			}
		}

		private TextNode _textNode;

		internal override object Content => _textNode.Text;

		internal override NodeBase DocumentNode => _textNode;

		internal override LayoutNodeType NodeType => LayoutNodeType.Text;

		internal string Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (_textNode == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _textNode.Text;
			}
		}

		internal TextLayoutNode(LayoutNodeBase parent, TextNode textNode)
			: base(parent)
		{
			if (!(parent is RunLayoutNode))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("TextLayoutNode can only be a child of a RunLayoutNode");
			}
			if (!textNode.IsSealed)
			{
				PropertyChangeListenerList.ManageListenerHelper(ref _textNode, textNode, this, useWeakReference: false);
			}
			else
			{
				_textNode = textNode;
			}
		}

		internal override void Accept(LayoutNodeVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.VisitTextLayoutNode(this);
		}

		internal override TReturn Accept<TReturn>(LayoutNodeVisitor<TReturn> visitor)
		{
			return visitor.VisitTextLayoutNode(this);
		}

		internal override TReturn Accept<TArg, TReturn>(LayoutNodeVisitor<TArg, TReturn> visitor, TArg argument)
		{
			return visitor.VisitTextLayoutNode(this, argument);
		}

		protected override void OnDisposed()
		{
			if (_textNode != null && !_textNode.IsSealed)
			{
				PropertyChangeListenerList.ManageListenerHelper(ref _textNode, null, this, useWeakReference: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
			if (property == "Text")
			{
				OnContentChanged(new TextChangeInfo(this));
			}
		}

		protected override bool ProcessContentChanged(ref object processStatusInfo, object changeInfo, TimeKeeper timeKeeper, Extent constraintX, Extent? constraintY)
		{
			if (!(changeInfo is TextChangeInfo textChangeInfo) || textChangeInfo._parentRun != base.ParentLayoutNode || textChangeInfo._grandParentParagraph != textChangeInfo._parentRun.ParentParagraph)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return textChangeInfo._grandParentParagraph.ProcessTextChange(ref processStatusInfo, textChangeInfo, timeKeeper, constraintX, constraintY);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = Text;
			if (text == null)
			{
				return "<null>";
			}
			if (text.Length > 50)
			{
				return $"{text.Substring(0, 50)}...";
			}
			return text;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class LayoutNodeTreeWalker : LayoutNodeVisitor
	{
		protected override void DefaultVisit(LayoutNodeBase node)
		{
			VisitChildren(node);
		}

		protected virtual void VisitChildren(LayoutNodeBase node)
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = node.ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LayoutNodeBase item in childNodes)
			{
				item.Accept(this);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class MetricsProvider : IRichTextMetricsProvider
	{
		internal class MetricsInfo
		{
			private FontSpecification _fontSpecification;

			private double _baseline;

			private double _height;

			private bool _isFontFixedSize;

			private System.Windows.Size _fixedCharacterSize;

			private System.Windows.Media.FontFamily _fontFamily;

			private bool _fontIsBold;

			private bool _fontIsItalic;

			private string _fontName;

			private Extent _fontSize;

			private double[] _cachedWidths;

			private double _cachedHeight;

			private Dictionary<Tuple<char, char>, float> _characterPairKerningAdjustments;

			private HashSet<Tuple<char, char>> _characterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments;

			private Typeface _typeface;

			[ThreadStatic]
			private static SolidColorBrush s_dummyBrush;

			private const char LOWCHAR = ' ';

			private const char HIGHCHAR = '\u007f';

			private const int CACHE_SIZE = 96;

			private const double MINIMUM_KERNING_ADJUSTMENT = 0.001;

			internal double Baseline
			{
				get
				{
					if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(_baseline))
					{
						return GetFormattedTextHelper("Wo").Baseline;
					}
					return _baseline;
				}
			}

			internal System.Windows.Size FixedCharacterSize => _fixedCharacterSize;

			internal double Height
			{
				get
				{
					if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(_height))
					{
						_height = GetStringSize("Wy").Height;
					}
					return _height;
				}
			}

			internal bool IsFontFixedSize => _isFontFixedSize;

			internal Typeface Typeface
			{
				get
				{
					if (_typeface == null)
					{
						_typeface = new Typeface(FontFamily, Utilities.FontStyleFromIsItalic(_fontIsItalic), Utilities.FontWeightFromIsBold(_fontIsBold), FontStretches.Normal);
					}
					return _typeface;
				}
			}

			private double[] CachedWidths
			{
				get
				{
					if (_cachedWidths == null)
					{
						_cachedWidths = new double[96];
						System.Windows.Size empty = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
						int num = 0;
						string text = null;
						for (int i = 32; i <= 127; i++)
						{
							text = string.Empty;
							text = text.PadRight(30, (char)i);
							empty = MeasureText(text);
							_cachedWidths[num] = empty.Width / 30.0;
							_cachedHeight = empty.Height;
							num++;
						}
					}
					return _cachedWidths;
				}
			}

			private Dictionary<Tuple<char, char>, float> CharacterPairKerningAdjustments => _characterPairKerningAdjustments;

			private HashSet<Tuple<char, char>> CharacterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments => _characterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments;

			private static SolidColorBrush DummyBrush
			{
				get
				{
					if (s_dummyBrush == null)
					{
						s_dummyBrush = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black;
					}
					return s_dummyBrush;
				}
			}

			private System.Windows.Media.FontFamily FontFamily
			{
				get
				{
					if (_fontFamily == null)
					{
						_fontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(_fontName);
					}
					return _fontFamily;
				}
			}

			internal MetricsInfo(FontSpecification fontSpecification)
			{
				_fontSpecification = fontSpecification;
				_baseline = double.PositiveInfinity;
				_height = double.PositiveInfinity;
				_fontIsBold = fontSpecification.Bold;
				_fontIsItalic = fontSpecification.Italic;
				_fontName = fontSpecification.FontName;
				_fontSize = fontSpecification.FontSize;
				_characterPairKerningAdjustments = new Dictionary<Tuple<char, char>, float>(100);
				_characterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments = new HashSet<Tuple<char, char>>();
				UpdateFixedWidthInfo();
			}

			internal double GetCharacterPairKerningAdjustment(char char1, char char2)
			{
				if (IsFontFixedSize)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				Tuple<char, char> tuple = new Tuple<char, char>(char1, char2);
				if (CharacterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments.Count > CharacterPairKerningAdjustments.Count)
				{
					if (CharacterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments.Contains(tuple))
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
					if (CharacterPairKerningAdjustments.Keys.Contains(tuple))
					{
						return Convert.ToDouble(CharacterPairKerningAdjustments[tuple]);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (CharacterPairKerningAdjustments.Keys.Contains(tuple))
					{
						return Convert.ToDouble(CharacterPairKerningAdjustments[tuple]);
					}
					if (CharacterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments.Contains(tuple))
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
				}
				double width = GetStringSize(new string(new char[2] { char1, char2 })).Width;
				double width2 = GetStringSize(new string(char1, 1)).Width;
				double width3 = GetStringSize(new string(char2, 1)).Width;
				double num = width2 + width3 - width;
				if (num > 0.001)
				{
					CharacterPairKerningAdjustments.Add(tuple, (float)num);
					return num;
				}
				CharacterPairsWithNoKerningAdjustments.Add(tuple);
				return 0.0;
			}

			internal System.Windows.Size GetStringSize(string text)
			{
				return GetStringSize(text, useCachedFixedCharacterSizeIfFontIsFixed: true);
			}

			internal System.Windows.Size GetStringSize(string text, bool useCachedFixedCharacterSizeIfFontIsFixed)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
				}
				bool flag = IsFontFixedSize;
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = !ContainsUnicodeCharacters(text);
				}
				if (flag && useCachedFixedCharacterSizeIfFontIsFixed)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size((double)text.Length * FixedCharacterSize.Width, FixedCharacterSize.Height);
				}
				if (!flag && text.Length == 1)
				{
					char c = text[0];
					if (c >= ' ' && c <= '\u007f')
					{
						return new System.Windows.Size(CachedWidths[CacheIndexFromChar(c)], _cachedHeight);
					}
				}
				return MeasureText(text);
			}

			private int CacheIndexFromChar(char c)
			{
				return c - 32;
			}

			private static bool ContainsUnicodeCharacters(string text)
			{
				string text2 = text.Trim();
				for (int i = 0; i < text2.Length; i++)
				{
					if (text[i] > 'ÿ')
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			private FormattedText GetFormattedTextHelper(string text)
			{
				FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(text, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight, Typeface, _fontSize.LogicalPixels, DummyBrush);
				if (_fontIsItalic)
				{
					formattedText.SetFontStyle(FontStyles.Italic);
				}
				if (_fontIsBold)
				{
					formattedText.SetFontWeight(FontWeights.Bold);
				}
				return formattedText;
			}

			private System.Windows.Size MeasureText(string text)
			{
				FormattedText formattedTextHelper = GetFormattedTextHelper(text);
				double extent = formattedTextHelper.Extent;
				return new System.Windows.Size(formattedTextHelper.WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace, Math.Max(extent, formattedTextHelper.Height));
			}

			private void UpdateFixedWidthInfo()
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = MeasureText("W");
				System.Windows.Size size2 = MeasureText(".");
				_isFontFixedSize = size.Width == size2.Width;
				_fixedCharacterSize = (_isFontFixedSize ? size : new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
			}
		}

		internal MetricsProvider()
		{
		}

		internal MetricsInfo GetMetricsInfo(FontSpecification fontSpecification)
		{
			if (fontSpecification.MetricsInfo is MetricsInfo result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return (MetricsInfo)(fontSpecification.MetricsInfo = new MetricsInfo(fontSpecification));
		}

		double IRichTextMetricsProvider.GetBaseline(FontSpecification fontSpec)
		{
			return GetMetricsInfo(fontSpec).Baseline;
		}

		double IRichTextMetricsProvider.GetHeight(FontSpecification fontSpec)
		{
			return GetMetricsInfo(fontSpec).Height;
		}

		double IRichTextMetricsProvider.GetKerningAdjustment(string leading, FontSpecification leadingFont, string trailing, FontSpecification trailingFont)
		{
			if (leadingFont == null || leadingFont != trailingFont || string.IsNullOrEmpty(leading) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(trailing))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double characterPairKerningAdjustment = GetMetricsInfo(leadingFont).GetCharacterPairKerningAdjustment(leading[leading.Length - 1], trailing[0]);
			if (characterPairKerningAdjustment != 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0 - characterPairKerningAdjustment;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		System.Windows.Size IRichTextMetricsProvider.GetOtherContentSize(object content)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size(60.0, 30.0);
		}

		double IRichTextMetricsProvider.GetTextWidth(string text, FontSpecification fontSpec)
		{
			return GetMetricsInfo(fontSpec).GetStringSize(text, useCachedFixedCharacterSizeIfFontIsFixed: true).Width;
		}

		int IRichTextMetricsProvider.GetCharacterIndexFromOffset(string text, FontSpecification fontSpec, double offsetX)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			int length = text.Length;
			MetricsInfo metricsInfo = GetMetricsInfo(fontSpec);
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				num3 = metricsInfo.GetStringSize(text.Substring(i, 1), useCachedFixedCharacterSizeIfFontIsFixed: true).Width;
				if (num + num3 / 2.0 > offsetX)
				{
					return num2;
				}
				num2++;
				num += num3;
				if (!metricsInfo.IsFontFixedSize && i > 0)
				{
					num -= metricsInfo.GetCharacterPairKerningAdjustment(text[i - 1], text[i]);
				}
			}
			return num2;
		}

		double IRichTextMetricsProvider.GetOffsetFromCharacterIndex(string text, FontSpecification fontSpec, int characterIndex)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || characterIndex == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			_ = text.Length;
			MetricsInfo metricsInfo = GetMetricsInfo(fontSpec);
			return metricsInfo.GetStringSize(text.Substring(0, characterIndex)).Width - metricsInfo.GetCharacterPairKerningAdjustment(text[characterIndex - 1], text[characterIndex]);
		}
	}

	internal class TextContentGroup : RichTextContentGroupBase
	{
		internal bool _rightToLeft;

		protected override Extent AlignmentHeight => _font.AlignmentHeight;

		protected override Extent AlignmentHeightInDropCap => _font.AlignmentDropCapHeight;

		protected override Extent Height => _font.Height;

		protected override Extent HeightInDropCap => _font.DropCapHeight;

		internal override bool IsRightToLeft => _rightToLeft;

		internal override bool AreContentsMergeable(RichTextContentGroupBase otherGroup)
		{
			bool flag = otherGroup is TextContentGroup textContentGroup && _font == textContentGroup._font && _characterSettings == textContentGroup._characterSettings;
			if (flag && _sampleCharacter.HasValue && otherGroup._sampleCharacter.HasValue)
			{
				flag = Utilities.WillUseSameResolvedFont(_sampleCharacter.Value, otherGroup._sampleCharacter.Value, _characterSettings);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal override RichTextContentGroupBase CloneSettings()
		{
			TextContentGroup textContentGroup = new TextContentGroup();
			textContentGroup.CopySettings(this);
			textContentGroup._rightToLeft = _rightToLeft;
			return textContentGroup;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _contentItems.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				RichTextGroupContentItem richTextGroupContentItem = _contentItems.Array[i];
				if (richTextGroupContentItem.UnderlyngContent == RichTextGroupContentItem.NewLineContentMarker)
				{
					num++;
					stringBuilder.Append("<break>");
				}
				else
				{
					string underlyngText = richTextGroupContentItem.UnderlyngText;
					if (underlyngText != null)
					{
						num += underlyngText.Length;
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(underlyngText))
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(underlyngText);
					}
					else if (richTextGroupContentItem.UnderlyngContent != null)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(richTextGroupContentItem.UnderlyngContent);
					}
				}
				if (richTextGroupContentItem._trailingSpaces > 0)
				{
					num2 += richTextGroupContentItem._trailingSpaces;
					stringBuilder.Append(new string(' ', richTextGroupContentItem._trailingSpaces));
				}
			}
			string value = $"Text group: count = {_contentItems.Count}, length = {num + num2}, text = ";
			stringBuilder.Insert(0, value);
			if (stringBuilder.Length > 100)
			{
				return $"{stringBuilder.ToString().Substring(0, 100)}...";
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	internal struct RichTextGroupContentItem : IEquatable<RichTextGroupContentItem>
	{
		internal static readonly object NewLineContentMarker = new object();

		internal const string TableMark = "¤";

		internal const char TableMarkChar = '¤';

		internal const string ParagraphMark = "¶";

		internal const char ParagraphMarkChar = '¶';

		internal object _content;

		internal Extent _width;

		internal bool _isInListNumberGroup;

		internal byte _trailingSpaces;

		private readonly byte _offsetCountForNonText;

		internal int ContentOffsetCount
		{
			get
			{
				string underlyngText = UnderlyngText;
				if (_isInListNumberGroup)
				{
					if (underlyngText != null && underlyngText.Length == 1 && underlyngText[0] == '\t')
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				if (underlyngText == null)
				{
					if (_content == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return _offsetCountForNonText;
				}
				return underlyngText.Length;
			}
		}

		public bool IsNewLine => _content == NewLineContentMarker;

		public bool IsNewLineOrParagraphMark
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsNewLine)
				{
					return IsParagraphMark;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsParagraphMark
		{
			get
			{
				string underlyngText = UnderlyngText;
				if (!("¶" == underlyngText))
				{
					return "¤" == underlyngText;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsTab
		{
			get
			{
				string underlyngText = UnderlyngText;
				if (underlyngText != null && underlyngText.Length == 1)
				{
					return underlyngText[0] == '\t';
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal Extent KerningAdjustment
		{
			get
			{
				if (_content is SpecialTextContentBase specialTextContentBase)
				{
					return specialTextContentBase.AdjustmentX;
				}
				return default(Extent);
			}
		}

		internal int OverallOffsetCount => ContentOffsetCount + ((!_isInListNumberGroup) ? _trailingSpaces : 0);

		internal string Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (_content is SpecialTextContentBase specialTextContentBase)
				{
					return specialTextContentBase.Text;
				}
				return _content as string;
			}
		}

		internal string TextForNavigation
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsTab)
				{
					return UnderlyngText;
				}
				return Text;
			}
		}

		internal object UnderlyngContent
		{
			get
			{
				if (_content is SpecialTextContentBase specialTextContentBase)
				{
					return specialTextContentBase.UnderlyngText;
				}
				return _content;
			}
		}

		internal string UnderlyngText
		{
			get
			{
				if (_content is SpecialTextContentBase specialTextContentBase)
				{
					return specialTextContentBase.UnderlyngText;
				}
				return _content as string;
			}
		}

		internal RichTextGroupContentItem(object content, Extent width, byte trailingSpaces, byte offsetCountForNonText = 1)
		{
			_content = content;
			_width = width;
			_trailingSpaces = trailingSpaces;
			_isInListNumberGroup = false;
			_offsetCountForNonText = offsetCountForNonText;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return ((_content != null) ? _content.GetHashCode() : 0) ^ _width.GetHashCode() ^ _trailingSpaces.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is RichTextGroupContentItem)
			{
				return this == (RichTextGroupContentItem)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(RichTextGroupContentItem item1, RichTextGroupContentItem item2)
		{
			if (item1._width == item2._width && object.Equals(item1, item2))
			{
				return item1._trailingSpaces == item2._trailingSpaces;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(RichTextGroupContentItem item1, RichTextGroupContentItem item2)
		{
			return !(item1 == item2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $" RichTextGroupContentItem: {_content}, width:, {_width}, trailing spaces {_trailingSpaces}";
		}

		internal static Extent CalculateOverallWidth(FontSpecification font, double spaceWidthFactor, RichTextGroupContentItem contentItem)
		{
			Extent extent = ((font == null || contentItem._trailingSpaces <= 0) ? contentItem._width : (contentItem._width + new Extent((double)(int)contentItem._trailingSpaces * font.WidthOfSpace.LogicalPixels * spaceWidthFactor, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels)));
			return extent + contentItem.KerningAdjustment;
		}

		internal static Extent CalculateTrailingSpacesWidth(FontSpecification font, double spaceWidthFactor, RichTextGroupContentItem contentItem)
		{
			if (font != null && contentItem._trailingSpaces > 0)
			{
				return new Extent((double)(int)contentItem._trailingSpaces * font.WidthOfSpace.LogicalPixels * spaceWidthFactor, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			}
			return new Extent(0.0);
		}

		internal bool IsContentEqual(object otherContent)
		{
			return UnderlyngText?.Equals(otherContent) ?? (UnderlyngContent == otherContent);
		}

		public bool Equals(RichTextGroupContentItem other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}

	internal class RichTextLine : IRichTextLine
	{
		internal Extent _contentHeight;

		internal Extent _width;

		internal Extent _lineSpacingHeight;

		internal double _justifiedSpaceWidthFactor;

		internal int _firstContentIndexToJustify;

		internal ParagraphLineTreeList.NodeEx _treeNode;

		internal ElasticArray<RichTextLineContentData> _contentItems;

		private RichTextLineInternalFlags _flags;

		public int Count => _contentItems.Count;

		public Extent ContentHeight => _contentHeight;

		public int FirstNonListNumberIndex
		{
			get
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _contentItems.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (!(_contentItems.Array[i]._group is ListNumberContentGroup))
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		public bool HasListNumber
		{
			get
			{
				if (_contentItems.Count > 0)
				{
					return _contentItems.Array[0]._group is ListNumberContentGroup;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool HasBlockContent
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(RichTextLineInternalFlags.HasBlockContent);
			}
			set
			{
				SetFlag(RichTextLineInternalFlags.HasBlockContent, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasContent
		{
			get
			{
				int count = Count;
				if (count > 3)
				{
					return true;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = this[i];
					if (!richTextLineContent.IsInListNumberGroup)
					{
						return !richTextLineContent.IsNewLineOrParagraphMark;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public RichTextLineContent this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				RichTextLineContentData richTextLineContentData = _contentItems.Array[index];
				return new RichTextLineContent(richTextLineContentData._group, GetGroupItem(index), richTextLineContentData._offsetX, richTextLineContentData._offsetY, IsLastLineInParagraph, (index >= _firstContentIndexToJustify) ? _justifiedSpaceWidthFactor : 1.0, index > _firstContentIndexToJustify && _justifiedSpaceWidthFactor > 1.0, IsInDropCap);
			}
		}

		public bool IsInDropCap
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(RichTextLineInternalFlags.IsInDropCap);
			}
			set
			{
				SetFlag(RichTextLineInternalFlags.IsInDropCap, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsLastLineInParagraph
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(RichTextLineInternalFlags.IsLastLine);
			}
			set
			{
				SetFlag(RichTextLineInternalFlags.IsLastLine, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsRightToLeft
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(RichTextLineInternalFlags.IsRightToLeft);
			}
			set
			{
				SetFlag(RichTextLineInternalFlags.IsRightToLeft, value);
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool IsSplitTextLine => false;

		public Extent OverallHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(_lineSpacingHeight > _contentHeight))
				{
					return _contentHeight;
				}
				return _lineSpacingHeight;
			}
		}

		public Extent RelativeOffsetY => ParagraphLineTreeList.GetOffsetY(this);

		internal bool UseExplicitWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return GetFlag(RichTextLineInternalFlags.UseExplicitWidth);
			}
			set
			{
				SetFlag(RichTextLineInternalFlags.UseExplicitWidth, value);
			}
		}

		public Extent Width => _width;

		public Extent WidthIncludingParagraphMark
		{
			get
			{
				if (_contentItems.Count > 0 && IsLastLineInParagraph)
				{
					RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = this[Count - 1];
					if (richTextLineContent.IsParagraphMark)
					{
						return _width + richTextLineContent.Font.WidthOfParagraphMark;
					}
				}
				return _width;
			}
		}

		internal RichTextLine()
		{
			_justifiedSpaceWidthFactor = 1.0;
			_firstContentIndexToJustify = -1;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _contentItems.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = this[i];
				string text = richTextLineContent.Text;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(text);
				}
				else if (richTextLineContent.Content is ImageLayoutNode)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("<image>");
				}
				if (richTextLineContent.TrailingSpaces > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(new string(' ', richTextLineContent.TrailingSpaces));
				}
				if (richTextLineContent.IsNewLine)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal int CalculateContentOffsetFromXOffset(double preferredXOffset, out double remainingXOffset, out RichTextLineContent? contentItem)
		{
			remainingXOffset = 0.0;
			contentItem = null;
			Extent extent = new Extent(preferredXOffset, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			if (extent.Twips <= 0.0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int count = Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = 0;
			if (extent >= Width)
			{
				num = GetDocumentOffsetCount(includeListNumber: false, includeNewLine: false);
				remainingXOffset = preferredXOffset - Width.LogicalPixels;
			}
			else
			{
				remainingXOffset = preferredXOffset;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					RichTextLineContent value = this[i];
					if (value.IsNewLineOrParagraphMark)
					{
						break;
					}
					Extent extent2 = value.RelativeOffsetX + value.OverallWidth;
					if (extent2 >= extent)
					{
						if (value.IsNewLineOrParagraphMark)
						{
							remainingXOffset = 0.0;
						}
						else
						{
							remainingXOffset = Math.Max(preferredXOffset - value.RelativeOffsetX.LogicalPixels, 0.0);
							contentItem = value;
						}
						return num;
					}
					if (!(value.Group is ListNumberContentGroup))
					{
						num += value.ContentOffsetCount + value.TrailingSpaces;
					}
					remainingXOffset = preferredXOffset - extent2.LogicalPixels;
				}
			}
			if (remainingXOffset > 0.0)
			{
				int num2 = count - 1;
				RichTextLineContent value2 = this[num2];
				if (value2.IsNewLineOrParagraphMark && count > 1)
				{
					value2 = this[num2 - 1];
				}
				if (!value2.IsNewLineOrParagraphMark && value2.Font != null && remainingXOffset < value2.Font.WidthOfAverageCharacter.LogicalPixels)
				{
					remainingXOffset = 0.0;
					contentItem = value2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public int GetDocumentOffsetCount(bool includeListNumber, bool includeNewLine, int? stopAtContentIndex = null)

		internal int GetLineContentHashCode()
		{

		public IEnumerable<RichTextLineContent> GetLineContent(double offset, double width)
		{
			if (!(width > 0.0) || !(offset + width > 0.0))
			{
				yield break;
			}
			Extent start = new Extent(Math.Max(offset, 0.0), ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			Extent end = new Extent(width + offset, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			Extent width2 = Width;
			int count = Count;
			if (count > 0 && this[count - 1].IsNewLineOrParagraphMark)
			{
				width2 += this[count - 1].ContentWidth;
			}
			if (!(start < width2))
			{
				yield break;
			}
			bool checkStart = offset > 0.0;
			bool checkEnd = end < width2;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = this[i];
				if ((!checkStart || !(richTextLineContent.EndX < start)) && (!checkEnd || !(richTextLineContent.RelativeOffsetX > end)))
				{
					yield return richTextLineContent;
				}
			}
		}

		internal int GetLineContentIndexAtOffset(ref double offsetX, bool excludeListNumber, out bool isAtEnd, out RichTextLineContentData? contentItem)
		{
			contentItem = null;
			isAtEnd = false;
			int count = Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			Extent extent = new Extent(offsetX, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			if (extent.Twips <= 0.0)
			{
				if (excludeListNumber)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						if (!this[i].IsInListNumberGroup)
						{
							return i;
						}
					}
				}
				return 0;
			}
			if (extent >= Width)
			{
				if (!this[count - 1].IsNewLineOrParagraphMark)
				{
					contentItem = _contentItems.Array[count - 1];
				}
				offsetX = 0.0;
				isAtEnd = true;
				return count - 1;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = this[j];
				if ((!excludeListNumber || !richTextLineContent.IsInListNumberGroup) && richTextLineContent.RelativeOffsetX + richTextLineContent.OverallWidth >= extent)
				{
					if (richTextLineContent.IsNewLineOrParagraphMark)
					{
						offsetX = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						contentItem = _contentItems.Array[j];
						offsetX = Math.Max(offsetX - richTextLineContent.RelativeOffsetX.LogicalPixels, 0.0);
					}
					return j;
				}
			}
			return count;
		}

		internal virtual int GetOffsetCountofItem(int index)

		}

		internal int GetWordBoundaryOffset(bool calledFromPreviousNode, int contentIndex, int offsetIntoContent, bool right, bool includeListNumbers, bool includeParagraphMarks)
		{
			int num = contentIndex;
			int count = _contentItems.Count;
			int num2 = offsetIntoContent;
			int num3;
			int num4;
			if (right)
			{
				if (num >= count)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				num3 = 1;
				num4 = count;
			}
			else
			{
				if (offsetIntoContent == 0 && (!includeParagraphMarks || num != count - 1 || !this[num].IsParagraphMark))
				{
					num--;
				}
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return num2;
				}
				num3 = -1;
				num4 = -1;
			}
			int num5 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			for (int i = num; i != num4; i += num3)
			{
				RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = this[i];
				if (richTextLineContent.IsNewLineOrParagraphMark)
				{
					if (right)
					{
						if (includeParagraphMarks && !flag2 && (i == num || offsetIntoContent > 0 || calledFromPreviousNode))
						{
							num5++;
						}
						break;
					}
					if (!includeParagraphMarks || offsetIntoContent > 0)
					{
						num5--;
					}
					continue;
				}
				bool flag3 = false;
				string text = null;
				if (richTextLineContent.IsInListNumberGroup)
				{
					if (!(!flag && includeListNumbers))
					{
						continue;
					}
					flag = true;
					text = " ";
					flag3 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					text = richTextLineContent.Text;
					if (text != null)
					{
						if (text.Length > 0)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
						if (text.Length == 1)
						{
							switch (Utilities.GetChartype(text[0]))
							{
							case Utilities.CharType.Comma:
							case Utilities.CharType.DoubleQuote:
							case Utilities.CharType.Other:
							case Utilities.CharType.Period:
							case Utilities.CharType.Punctuation:
							case Utilities.CharType.SingleQuote:
							case Utilities.CharType.Tab:
								flag3 = true;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else if (richTextLineContent.ContentOffsetCount > 0)
					{
						text = " ";
						flag3 = true;
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
				if (richTextLineContent.TrailingSpaces > 0 && !right && num5 != 0)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
				if (flag3 && num5 != 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (right)
				{
					if (text != null)
					{
						num5 += text.Length;
					}
					if (richTextLineContent.TrailingSpaces > 0)
					{
						if (i != num4 - 1)
						{
							num5 += richTextLineContent.TrailingSpaces;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						num5 -= num2;
						num2 = 0;
					}
					else if (text != null)
					{
						num5 -= text.Length;
					}
					if (num != contentIndex && richTextLineContent.TrailingSpaces > 0)
					{
						num5 -= richTextLineContent.TrailingSpaces;
					}
				}
				if (flag3 && num5 != 0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (right)
			{
				num5 -= num2;
			}
			return num5;
		}

		internal bool IsLineContentEquivalent(RichTextLine other)
		{
			if (_flags == other._flags && _contentItems.Count == other._contentItems.Count)
			{
				int count = _contentItems.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = this[i];
					RichTextLineContent other2 = other[i];
					if (!richTextLineContent.IsContentEqual(other2))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetFlag(RichTextLineInternalFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_flags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				_flags &= (RichTextLineInternalFlags)(byte)(~(int)flag);
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyLineWidth()
		{
			if (UseExplicitWidth)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = _contentItems.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				RichTextLineContent richTextLineContent = this[count - 1];
				_width = richTextLineContent.RelativeOffsetX;
				if (!richTextLineContent.IsNewLineOrParagraphMark)
				{
					_width += richTextLineContent.OverallWidth;
				}
			}
		}

	internal class SplitTextLine : RichTextLine
	{
		private RichTextGroupContentItem _splitContent;

		internal override bool IsSplitTextLine => true;

		private SplitTextLine()
		{
		}

		internal static RichTextLine Create(RichTextLine sourceLine, string subString, Extent widthOfSubstring, byte trailingSpaces)
		{
			if (sourceLine.IsSplitTextLine)
			{
				return sourceLine;
			}
			int count = sourceLine.Count;
			SplitTextLine splitTextLine = new SplitTextLine();
			splitTextLine.CopySettings(sourceLine);
			splitTextLine._contentItems.AddRange(sourceLine._contentItems.Array);
			splitTextLine._splitContent = new RichTextGroupContentItem(subString, widthOfSubstring, trailingSpaces, 1);
			splitTextLine._width -= sourceLine[count - 1].ContentWidth - widthOfSubstring;
			return splitTextLine;
		}

		internal override RichTextGroupContentItem GetGroupItem(int index)
		{
			if (index == _contentItems.Count - 1)
			{
				return _splitContent;
			}
			return base.GetGroupItem(index);
		}

		internal override int GetOffsetCountofItem(int index)
		{
			if (index == _contentItems.Count - 1)
			{
				if (!(_splitContent._content is string text))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return text.Length;
			}
			return base.GetOffsetCountofItem(index);
		}

		private void CopySettings(RichTextLine sourceLine)
		{
			CopyFlags(sourceLine);
			_contentHeight = sourceLine._contentHeight;
			_firstContentIndexToJustify = sourceLine._firstContentIndexToJustify;
			_justifiedSpaceWidthFactor = sourceLine._justifiedSpaceWidthFactor;
			_lineSpacingHeight = sourceLine._lineSpacingHeight;
			_treeNode = sourceLine._treeNode;
		}
	}

	internal struct RichTextLineContent
	{
		private RichTextContentGroupBase _group;

		private RichTextGroupContentItem _item;

		private Extent _offsetX;

		private Extent _offsetY;

		private double _spaceWidthfactor;

		private bool _isLastLine;

		private bool _isJustified;

		private bool _isInDropCap;

		public Extent AlignmentHeight => _group.GetHeight(_isInDropCap, alignment: true);

		public CharacterSettings CharacterSettings => _group.CharacterSettings;

		public object Content
		{
			get
			{
				object underlyngContent = _item.UnderlyngContent;
				if (underlyngContent != RichTextGroupContentItem.NewLineContentMarker)
				{
					return underlyngContent;
				}
				return Text;
			}
		}

		public RichTextLineContentType ContentType
		{
			get
			{
				if (_item._content == null)
				{
					return RichTextLineContentType.Spacer;
				}
				if (_item._content is TabContent tabContent)
				{
					if (tabContent.Leader != TabStopLeader.None)
					{
						return RichTextLineContentType.TabWithLeader;
					}
					return RichTextLineContentType.Tab;
				}
				if (_item._content is string)
				{
					if (IsParagraphMark)
					{
						return RichTextLineContentType.ParagraphMark;
					}
					return RichTextLineContentType.Text;
				}
				if (_item._content is ImageLayoutNode)
				{
					return RichTextLineContentType.Image;
				}
				if (IsNewLine)
				{
					return RichTextLineContentType.NewLine;
				}
				return RichTextLineContentType.Object;
			}
		}

		public Extent ContentWidth => _item._width;

		public Extent EndX => _offsetX + _item._width;

		public Extent EndY => _offsetY + _group.GetHeight(_isInDropCap, alignment: false);

		public FontSpecification Font => _group.Font;

		public Extent Height => _group.GetHeight(_isInDropCap, alignment: false);

		public bool IsInListNumberGroup => _item._isInListNumberGroup;

		public bool IsJustified => _isJustified;

		public bool IsNewLine => _item.IsNewLine;

		public bool IsNewLineOrParagraphMark => _item.IsNewLineOrParagraphMark;

		public bool IsParagraphMark => _item.IsParagraphMark;

		public bool IsTab => _item.IsTab;

		internal Extent KerningAdjustment => _item.KerningAdjustment;

		public Extent OverallWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (_item._trailingSpaces == 0)
				{
					return _item._width + _item.KerningAdjustment;
				}
				if (_spaceWidthfactor == 1.0)
				{
					return _item._width + TrailingSpaceWidth + _item.KerningAdjustment;
				}
				FontSpecification font = _group.Font;
				if (font == null)
				{
					return _item._width + _item.KerningAdjustment;
				}
				return new Extent((double)(int)_item._trailingSpaces * font.WidthOfSpace.LogicalPixels * _spaceWidthfactor + _item._width.LogicalPixels + _item.KerningAdjustment.LogicalPixels, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			}
		}

		public Extent RelativeOffsetX => _offsetX;

		public Extent RelativeOffsetY => _offsetY;

		public string Text => _item.Text;

		internal string TextForNavigation => _item.TextForNavigation;

		public byte TrailingSpaces => _item._trailingSpaces;

		public Extent TrailingSpaceWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (_item._trailingSpaces == 0)
				{
					return default(Extent);
				}
				FontSpecification font = _group.Font;
				if (font == null)
				{
					return default(Extent);
				}
				return new Extent((double)(int)_item._trailingSpaces * font.WidthOfSpace.LogicalPixels, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			}
		}

		internal object UnderlyingContent => _item.UnderlyngContent;

		internal string UnderlyingText => _item.UnderlyngText;

		internal int ContentOffsetCount => _item.ContentOffsetCount;

		internal RichTextContentGroupBase Group => _group;

		internal int OverallOffsetCount => _item.OverallOffsetCount;

		internal object RawContent => _item._content;

		internal RichTextLineContent(RichTextContentGroupBase group, RichTextGroupContentItem item, Extent offsetX, Extent offsetY, bool isLastLine, double spaceWidthfactor, bool isJustified, bool isinDropCap)
		{
			_group = group;
			_item = item;
			_offsetX = offsetX;
			_offsetY = offsetY;
			_isLastLine = isLastLine;
			_spaceWidthfactor = spaceWidthfactor;
			_isJustified = isJustified;
			_isInDropCap = isinDropCap;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_item._content is ImageLayoutNode)
			{
				return $"<image>, {TrailingSpaces} trailing spaces, offsetX: {_offsetX.LogicalPixels} pixels";
			}
			if (IsTab)
			{
				return $"Tab, Display Text {Text}, offsetX: {_offsetX}";
			}
			return $"Text: '{Text}', {TrailingSpaces} trailing spaces, offsetX: {_offsetX.LogicalPixels} pixels";
		}

		internal bool IsContentEqual(RichTextLineContent other)
		{
			if (TrailingSpaces != other.TrailingSpaces)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object rawContent = RawContent;
			if (rawContent is string)
			{
				return ((string)rawContent).Equals(other.RawContent);
			}
			return rawContent == other.RawContent;
		}
	}

	internal class TabContent : SpecialTextContentBase
	{
		private string _text;

		private TabStopLeader _leader;

		internal override Extent AdjustmentX => default(Extent);

		internal override string Text => _text;

		internal override string UnderlyngText => "\t";

		internal TabStopLeader Leader => _leader;

		internal TabContent()
		{
			_text = "\t";
		}

		internal void InitializeLeader(TabStopLeader leader)
		{
			_leader = leader;
		}

		internal void InitialzeLeaderText(Extent width, FontSpecification font, IRichTextMetricsProvider metricsProvider)
		{
			char c;
			switch (_leader)
			{
			default:
				_text = UnderlyngText;
				return;
			case TabStopLeader.Dot:
			case TabStopLeader.MiddleDot:
				c = '.';
				break;
			case TabStopLeader.Hyphen:
				c = '-';
				break;
			case TabStopLeader.Underscore:
				c = '_';
				break;
			}
			double textWidth = metricsProvider.GetTextWidth(new string(c, 1), font);
			int num = (int)(width.LogicalPixels / textWidth);
			_text = ((num > 0) ? new string(c, num) : UnderlyngText);
		}
	}

	internal class RichTextStringTable
	{
		private class TextReferenceComparer : IEqualityComparer<string>
		{
			public static readonly TextReferenceComparer Instance = new TextReferenceComparer();

			public bool Equals(string x, string y)
			{
				return (object)x == y;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(string obj)
			{
				return obj.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		private struct StringItem
		{
			public readonly int HashCode;

			public readonly string Value;

			public StringItem(int hashCode, string value)
			{
				HashCode = hashCode;
				Value = value;
			}
		}

		private const double LoadFactor = 0.01;

		private const int MaxSharedStringLength = 75;

		private List<StringItem>[] _buckets;

		private int _count;

		private Dictionary<FontSpecification, Dictionary<string, Extent>> _fontMap;

		private FontSpecification _font;

		private Dictionary<string, Extent> _textWidthCache;

		private string _lastText;

		private Extent _lastWidth;

		private IRichTextMetricsProvider _metricsProvider;

		public int Count => _count;

		public RichTextStringTable(IRichTextMetricsProvider metricsProvider)
		{
			_buckets = new List<StringItem>[1103];
			_fontMap = new Dictionary<FontSpecification, Dictionary<string, Extent>>();
			_metricsProvider = metricsProvider;
		}

		private void Add(string value)
		{
			int hashCode = GetHashCode(value);
			int num = hashCode % _buckets.Length;
			List<StringItem> list = _buckets[num];
			if (list == null)
			{
				list = CreateBucket();
				_buckets[num] = list;
			}
			list.Add(new StringItem(hashCode, value));
			_count++;
		}

		private static List<StringItem> CreateBucket()
		{
			return new List<StringItem>(8);
		}

		private static int GetHashCode(string value)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int length = value.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				num ^= (int)((uint)value[i] << i % 16);
			}
			return num & 0x7FFFFFFF;
		}

		public string GetString(string text, FontSpecification font)
		{
			if (text == null || 75 < text.Length)
			{
				if (font != null)
				{
					_lastText = text;
					_lastWidth = new Extent(_metricsProvider.GetTextWidth(text, font), ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
				}
				return text;
			}
			int length = text.Length;
			int hashCode = GetHashCode(text);
			int num = hashCode % _buckets.Length;
			List<StringItem> list = _buckets[num];
			if (list != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = list.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					StringItem stringItem = list[i];
					if (stringItem.HashCode != hashCode)
					{
						continue;
					}
					string value = stringItem.Value;
					if (value.Length != length)
					{
						continue;
					}
					bool flag = true;
					for (int j = 0; j < length; j++)
					{
						if (value[j] != text[j])
						{
							flag = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						if (font != null)
						{
							GetStringWidthHelper(stringItem.Value, font);
						}
						return stringItem.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list = CreateBucket();
				_buckets[num] = list;
			}
			StringItem item = new StringItem(hashCode, text);
			list.Add(item);
			_count++;
			if ((double)_buckets.Length < (double)list.Count / 0.01)
			{
				IncreaseCapacity();
			}
			if (font != null)
			{
				GetStringWidthHelper(item.Value, font);
			}
			return item.Value;
		}

		public Extent GetStringWidth(string text, FontSpecification font)
		{
			if ((object)text != _lastText)
			{
				GetString(text, font);
			}
			return _lastWidth;
		}

		private Extent GetStringWidthHelper(string text, FontSpecification font)
		{
			if (font != _font)
			{
				_font = font;
				if (!_fontMap.TryGetValue(font, out _textWidthCache))
				{
					_textWidthCache = new Dictionary<string, Extent>(TextReferenceComparer.Instance);
					_fontMap.Add(font, _textWidthCache);
				}
			}
			_lastText = text;
			if (!_textWidthCache.TryGetValue(text, out _lastWidth))
			{
				_lastWidth = new Extent(_metricsProvider.GetTextWidth(_lastText, font), ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
				_textWidthCache.Add(text, _lastWidth);
			}
			return _lastWidth;
		}

		private void IncreaseCapacity()
		{
			int num = _buckets.Length;
			List<StringItem>[] array = new List<StringItem>[num * 2];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				List<StringItem> list = _buckets[i];
				if (list == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int j = 0;
				for (int count = list.Count; j < count; j++)
				{
					StringItem item = list[j];
					int num2 = item.HashCode % array.Length;
					List<StringItem> list2 = array[num2];
					if (list2 == null)
					{
						list2 = (array[num2] = CreateBucket());
					}
					list2.Add(item);
				}
			}
			_buckets = array;
		}
	}

		}

		{
			if (base.Root != null)
			{
				base.Root.WidthConstraint = Extent.Max(new Extent(_layoutTargetWidth, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels) - Extent.LayoutPaddingX, new Extent(10.0, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels));
			}
		}

		internal TableCellSettings GetUniqueSettings()

			if (settings == null)
			{

		}

		private bool IsTableArea(TableRowNode row, TableArea area, int rowsInBand = 1, int columnsInBand = 1)
		{
			if (row == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (area)
			{
			case TableArea.TopLeftCell:
				if (IsTableCellArea(row, TableCellArea.LeftMostColumn))
				{
					return row.IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.FirstRow);
				}
				return false;
			case TableArea.TopRightCell:
				if (IsTableCellArea(row, TableCellArea.RightMostColumn))
				{
					return row.IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.FirstRow);
				}
				return false;
			case TableArea.BottomLeftCell:
				if (IsTableCellArea(row, TableCellArea.LeftMostColumn))
				{
					return row.IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.LastRow);
				}
				return false;
			case TableArea.BottomRightCell:
				if (IsTableCellArea(row, TableCellArea.RightMostColumn))
				{
					return row.IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.LastRow);
				}
				return false;
			case TableArea.EvenColumnBanding:
				return IsTableCellArea(row, TableCellArea.EvenColumn, columnsInBand);
			case TableArea.OddColumnBanding:
				return !IsTableCellArea(row, TableCellArea.EvenColumn, columnsInBand);
			case TableArea.EvenRowBanding:
				return row.IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.EvenRow, rowsInBand);
			case TableArea.FirstColumn:
				return IsTableCellArea(row, TableCellArea.FirstColumn);
			case TableArea.FirstRow:
				return row.IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.FirstRow);
			case TableArea.LastColumn:
				return IsTableCellArea(row, TableCellArea.LastColumn);
			case TableArea.LastRow:
				return row.IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.LastRow);
			case TableArea.OddRowBanding:
				return !row.IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.EvenRow, rowsInBand);
			case TableArea.WholeTable:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsTableCellArea(TableRowNode row, TableCellArea area, int columnsInBand = 1)
		{
			if (row != null)
			{
				switch (area)
				{
				case TableCellArea.EvenColumn:
					return row.GetColumnPosition(this) / columnsInBand % 2 == 0;
				case TableCellArea.FirstColumn:
					return row.GetColumnPosition(this) == 0;
				case TableCellArea.LastColumn:
					return (row?.Table).GetColumnCount() == 1 + row.GetColumnPosition(this);
				case TableCellArea.LeftMostColumn:
					return IsTableCellArea(row, TableCellArea.FirstColumn);
				case TableCellArea.RightMostColumn:
					return IsTableCellArea(row, TableCellArea.LastColumn);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea area)
		{
			return Row?.IsTableRowArea(area) ?? false;
		}

		internal void OnDefaultSettingsChanged()
		{
			DirtyStyleInfo();
		}

		private void EnsureSettingsResolved()
		{
			TableRowNode row = Row;
			TableNode tableNode = row?.Table;
			if (tableNode == null || (_settingsResolved != null && _verifiedSettingsResolvedVersion == tableNode._settingsResolvedVersion))
			{
				return;
			}
			row.EnsureSettingsResolved();
			_verifiedSettingsResolvedVersion = tableNode._settingsResolvedVersion;
			TableCellSettings settings = Settings;
			TableStyle styleResolvedHelper = RichTextStyleCollection.GetStyleResolvedHelper<TableStyle>(tableNode, tableNode.StyleId, returnDefaultIfIdNull: true);
			AreaSpecificSettings areaSpecificSettings = styleResolvedHelper?.AreaSpecificSettings;
			PropertyResolverBase propertyResolverBase = Utilities.CreateResolver<TableCellSettings>();
			PropertyResolverBase resolver = null;
			PropertyResolverBase resolver2 = null;
			Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, settings);
			TableCellSettings tableCellSettings = (TableCellSettings)propertyResolverBase.Target;
			if (areaSpecificSettings != null)
			{
				TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags areaUsageFlags = NodeUtils.ResolveTableAreaSettingsUsageFlags(row);
				int rowsInBand = 1;
				int columnsInBand = 1;
				if (styleResolvedHelper != null)
				{
					rowsInBand = styleResolvedHelper.RowsInBand ?? 1;
					columnsInBand = styleResolvedHelper.ColumnsInBand ?? 1;
				}
				propertyResolverBase.SuspendResolve(0);
				TableArea[] array = g_resolveAreas;
				foreach (TableArea area in array)
				{
					TableAreaSettings areaSettings = areaSpecificSettings.GetAreaSettings(area);
					if (areaSettings != null && Utilities.IsTableAreaUsed(area, areaUsageFlags) && IsTableArea(row, area, rowsInBand, columnsInBand))
					{
						Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, areaSettings.CellSettings);
						Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<ParagraphSettings>(ref resolver, areaSettings.ParagraphSettings);
						Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<CharacterSettings>(ref resolver2, areaSettings.CharacterSettings);
					}
				}
				propertyResolverBase.ResumeResolve(0);
				BorderResolutionContext borderResolutionContext = null;
				TableCellBorderSettings tableCellBorderSettings = tableCellSettings.Borders;
				BorderSide[] array2 = g_borderSides;
				foreach (BorderSide borderSide in array2)
				{
					if (tableCellBorderSettings != null && tableCellBorderSettings.GetBorder(borderSide) != null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (borderResolutionContext == null)
					{
						borderResolutionContext = new BorderResolutionContext(settings, row, areaUsageFlags, rowsInBand, columnsInBand, areaSpecificSettings);
					}
					RichTextBorder richTextBorder = ResolveTableAreaCellSettingsBorder(borderSide, borderResolutionContext);
					if (richTextBorder != null)
					{
						if (tableCellBorderSettings == null)
						{
							tableCellBorderSettings = tableCellSettings.BordersAllocated;
						}
						tableCellBorderSettings.SetBorder(borderSide, richTextBorder);
					}
				}
			}
			TableCellSettings obj = propertyResolverBase.Target as TableCellSettings;
			TableBorderSettings borders = row.TableSettingsResolved.Borders;
			if (borders != null)
			{
				Extent? cellSpacing = row.SettingsResolved.CellSpacing;
				bool flag = cellSpacing.HasValue && cellSpacing.Value.LogicalPixels > 0.0;
				TableCellBorderSettings bordersAllocated = tableCellSettings.BordersAllocated;
				if (bordersAllocated.Top == null)
				{
					if (flag || !IsTableArea(row, TableArea.FirstRow))
					{
						bordersAllocated.Top = borders.InsideHorizontal;
					}
					else
					{
						bordersAllocated.Top = borders.Top;
					}
				}
				if (bordersAllocated.Bottom == null)
				{
					if (flag || !IsTableArea(row, TableArea.LastRow))
					{
						bordersAllocated.Bottom = borders.InsideHorizontal;
					}
					else
					{
						bordersAllocated.Bottom = borders.Bottom;
					}
				}
				if (bordersAllocated.Start == null)
				{
					if (flag || !row.IsFirstCellInRow(this))
					{
						bordersAllocated.Start = borders.InsideVertical;
					}
					else
					{
						bordersAllocated.Start = borders.Start;
					}
				}
				if (bordersAllocated.End == null)
				{
					if (flag || !row.IsLastCellInRow(this))
					{
						bordersAllocated.End = borders.InsideVertical;
					}
					else
					{
						bordersAllocated.End = borders.End;
					}
				}
			}
			obj.Margins = Utilities.MergeTwoLazy(obj.Margins, row.TableSettingsResolved.CellMargins);
			_settingsResolved = propertyResolverBase.ResolveRemainingProperties() as TableCellSettings;
			_paragraphSettingsResolved = ((resolver != null) ? ((ParagraphSettings)resolver.Target) : null);
			_runSettingsResolved = ((resolver2 != null) ? ((CharacterSettings)resolver2.Target) : null);
		}

		private TableAreaSettings GetAreaSettingsIfApplicable(TableArea area, BorderResolutionContext context)
		{
			if (!Utilities.IsTableAreaUsed(area, context.AreaUsageFlags))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!IsTableArea(context.Row, area, context.RowsInBand, context.ColumnsInBand))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return context.AreaSpecificSettings.GetAreaSettings(area);
		}

		private RichTextBorder ResolveCellAreaBorder(TableArea cellArea, BorderSide borderSide, BorderResolutionContext context)
		{
			TableAreaSettings areaSettingsIfApplicable = GetAreaSettingsIfApplicable(cellArea, context);
			if (areaSettingsIfApplicable == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (borderSide)
			{
			case BorderSide.Start:
			case BorderSide.Top:
			case BorderSide.End:
			case BorderSide.Bottom:
			case BorderSide.BottomRightToTopLeft:
			case BorderSide.BottomLeftToTopRight:
				return areaSettingsIfApplicable.GetCellBorder(borderSide);
			case BorderSide.InsideHorizontal:
			case BorderSide.InsideVertical:
				return null;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private RichTextBorder ResolveColumnAreaBorder(TableArea columnArea, BorderSide borderSide, BorderResolutionContext context)
		{
			TableAreaSettings areaSettingsIfApplicable = GetAreaSettingsIfApplicable(columnArea, context);
			if (areaSettingsIfApplicable == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (borderSide)
			{
			case BorderSide.Start:
			case BorderSide.End:
			case BorderSide.BottomRightToTopLeft:
			case BorderSide.BottomLeftToTopRight:
				return areaSettingsIfApplicable.GetCellBorder(borderSide);
			case BorderSide.Top:
				if (context.Row.IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.FirstRow))
				{
					return areaSettingsIfApplicable.GetCellBorder(BorderSide.Top);
				}
				return areaSettingsIfApplicable.GetCellBorder(BorderSide.InsideHorizontal);
			case BorderSide.Bottom:
				if (context.Row.IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.LastRow))
				{
					return areaSettingsIfApplicable.GetCellBorder(BorderSide.Bottom);
				}
				return areaSettingsIfApplicable.GetCellBorder(BorderSide.InsideHorizontal);
			case BorderSide.InsideHorizontal:
			case BorderSide.InsideVertical:
				return null;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private RichTextBorder ResolveRowAreaBorder(TableArea rowArea, BorderSide borderSide, BorderResolutionContext context)
		{
			TableAreaSettings areaSettingsIfApplicable = GetAreaSettingsIfApplicable(rowArea, context);
			if (areaSettingsIfApplicable == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (borderSide)
			{
			case BorderSide.Top:
			case BorderSide.Bottom:
			case BorderSide.BottomRightToTopLeft:
			case BorderSide.BottomLeftToTopRight:
				return areaSettingsIfApplicable.GetCellBorder(borderSide);
			case BorderSide.Start:
				if (IsTableCellArea(context.Row, TableCellArea.FirstColumn))
				{
					return areaSettingsIfApplicable.GetCellBorder(BorderSide.Start);
				}
				return areaSettingsIfApplicable.GetCellBorder(BorderSide.InsideVertical);
			case BorderSide.End:
				if (IsTableCellArea(context.Row, TableCellArea.LastColumn))
				{
					return areaSettingsIfApplicable.GetCellBorder(BorderSide.End);
				}
				return areaSettingsIfApplicable.GetCellBorder(BorderSide.InsideVertical);
			case BorderSide.InsideHorizontal:
			case BorderSide.InsideVertical:
				return null;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private RichTextBorder ResolveTableAreaCellSettingsBorder(BorderSide borderSide, BorderResolutionContext context)
		{
			if (context.CellSettings != null && context.CellSettings.ShouldIgnoreTableAreaCellSettings(borderSide))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ResolveCellAreaBorder(TableArea.TopLeftCell, borderSide, context) ?? ResolveCellAreaBorder(TableArea.TopRightCell, borderSide, context) ?? ResolveCellAreaBorder(TableArea.BottomLeftCell, borderSide, context) ?? ResolveCellAreaBorder(TableArea.BottomRightCell, borderSide, context) ?? ResolveRowAreaBorder(TableArea.FirstRow, borderSide, context) ?? ResolveRowAreaBorder(TableArea.LastRow, borderSide, context) ?? ResolveColumnAreaBorder(TableArea.FirstColumn, borderSide, context) ?? ResolveColumnAreaBorder(TableArea.LastColumn, borderSide, context) ?? ResolveColumnAreaBorder(TableArea.EvenColumnBanding, borderSide, context) ?? ResolveColumnAreaBorder(TableArea.OddColumnBanding, borderSide, context) ?? ResolveRowAreaBorder(TableArea.EvenRowBanding, borderSide, context) ?? ResolveRowAreaBorder(TableArea.OddRowBanding, borderSide, context);
		}
	}
	internal enum TableRowArea
	{
		FirstRow,
		LastRow,
		EvenRow
	}
	internal enum TableCellArea
	{
		FirstColumn,
		LastColumn,
		LeftMostColumn,
		RightMostColumn,
		EvenColumn
	}

		private class VerifyLayoutMetricsHelper : NodeTreeWalker
		{
			public override void VisitTableNode(TableNode node)
			{
				base.VisitTableNode(node);
				TableGrid grid = node.Grid;
				int num = 1;
				foreach (NodeBase childNode in node.ChildNodes)
				{
					if (childNode is TableRowNode { SettingsResolved: var settingsResolved } tableRowNode)
					{
						num = Math.Max(settingsResolved.LeadingEmptyCellCount.GetValueOrDefault() + tableRowNode.Cells.Select((TableCellNode c) => c.SettingsResolved.ColumnSpan ?? 1).Sum() + settingsResolved.TrailingEmptyCellCount.GetValueOrDefault(), num);
					}
				}
				if (grid == null || grid.Columns.Count < num)
				{
					TableGrid tableGrid = new TableGrid();
					Extent extent = node.SettingsResolved.PreferredWidth.Value.GetExtent(TableLayoutNode.DefaultTableWidthConstraint, TableLayoutNode.DefaultTableWidthConstraint);
					for (int num2 = 0; num2 < num; num2++)
					{
						tableGrid.Columns.Add(new TableColumn
						{
							Width = new Extent(extent.Emus / (double)num, ExtentUnitType.Emus)
						});
					}
					node.Grid = tableGrid;
				}
			}
		}

		private class DefaultSettingsChangedWalker : NodeTreeWalker
		{
			private bool _isParagraphSettingsDirty;

			private bool _isRunSettingsDirty;

			private bool _isTableSettingsDirty;

			internal DefaultSettingsChangedWalker(bool isParagraphSettingsDirty, bool isRunSettingsDirty, bool isTableSettingsDirty)
			{
				_isParagraphSettingsDirty = isParagraphSettingsDirty;
				_isRunSettingsDirty = isRunSettingsDirty;
				_isTableSettingsDirty = isTableSettingsDirty;
			}

			public override void VisitParagraphNode(ParagraphNode node)
			{
				if (_isParagraphSettingsDirty || _isRunSettingsDirty)
				{
					node.OnDefaultSettingsChanged(_isRunSettingsDirty);
				}
				else if (_isTableSettingsDirty && node.Parent is TableCellNode)
				{
					node.OnDefaultSettingsChanged(isRunSettings: true);
				}
			}

			public override void VisitTableNode(TableNode node)
			{
				if (_isTableSettingsDirty)
				{
					node.OnDefaultSettingsChanged();
				}
				base.VisitTableNode(node);
			}

			public override void VisitCellNode(TableCellNode node)
			{
				if (_isTableSettingsDirty)
				{
					node.OnDefaultSettingsChanged();
				}
				base.VisitCellNode(node);
			}

			public override void VisitRowNode(TableRowNode node)
			{
				if (_isTableSettingsDirty)
				{
					node.OnDefaultSettingsChanged();
				}
				base.VisitRowNode(node);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnChildNodesChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo, bool dontLogChange)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if ("ChildNodes" == property || (sender == base.ChildNodesIfAllocated && extraInfo is NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs))
			{
				flag = UpdateBodyNode();
			}
			base.OnChildNodesChanged(sender, property, extraInfo, dontLogChange || flag);
		}

		internal override void OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			base.OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			if (sender == this && "Settings" == property)
			{
				flag = true;
				flag2 = true;
				flag3 = true;
			}
			else if (extraInfo is PropertyChangeChainContextBase propertyChangeChainContextBase && Settings == propertyChangeChainContextBase.Owner)
			{
				RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase = propertyChangeChainContextBase.Next?.Owner;
				if (richTextObjectBase is RichTextThemeInfo || "ThemeInfo" == property)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (richTextObjectBase is ParagraphSettings || "DefaultParagraphSettings" == property)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else if (richTextObjectBase is CharacterSettings || "DefaultCharacterSettings" == property)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				DirtyThemeInfo();
			}
			if (flag2 || flag3)
			{
				_styleListeners.NotifyAll(this, "Reset", null);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				DirtyDefaultParagraphSettings();
			}
			else if (flag3)
			{
				DirtyDefaultRunSettings();
			}
		}

		private bool SetListInfosHelper(RichTextListCollection value, bool notifyPropChange, bool isLazilyAllocated = false)
		{
			if (Data._lists != value)
			{
				VerifyIsMutable();
				value?.Initialize(this);
				RichTextListCollection lists = Data._lists;
				if (SetField(ref Data._lists, value, notifyPropChange ? new int?(6) : ((int?)null)))
				{
					lists?.Initialize(null);
					if (!isLazilyAllocated)
					{
						_listInfoListeners.NotifyAll(this, "Reset", null);
					}
					RaisePropertyChanged("Lists");
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool SetStylesHelper(RichTextStyleCollection value, bool notifyPropChange, bool isLazilyAllocated = false)
		{
			if (Data._styles != value)
			{
				VerifyIsMutable();
				value?.Initialize(this);
				RichTextStyleCollection styles = Data._styles;
				if (SetField(ref Data._styles, value, notifyPropChange ? new int?(5) : ((int?)null)))
				{
					styles?.Initialize(null);
					if (!isLazilyAllocated)
					{
						_styleListeners.NotifyAll(this, "Reset", null);
					}
					RaisePropertyChanged("Styles");
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void VerifyLayoutMetrics()
		{
			if (Body == null || _body.ChildNodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (NodeBase childNode in _body.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (childNode is TableNode)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (_document == null)
				{
					Accept(new VerifyLayoutMetricsHelper());
				}
				else
				{
					_document.VerifyLayoutMetrics();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void AddStyleListenerHelper(string styleId, NodeBase n, bool listenForDefaultStyleIfIdNull = false)
		{
			bool flag = string.IsNullOrEmpty(styleId);

			{

			if (rootNode != null)

				if (!flag)

					rootNode._styleListeners.AddListener(styleId, n, useWeakReference: false);
				}
				else if (listenForDefaultStyleIfIdNull)
				{
					rootNode._styleListeners.AddDefaultStyleListener(n, useWeakReference: false);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeDocument(RichTextDocument document)
		{
			if (_document != document)
			{
				if (_document != null && document != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Node cannot be associated with multiple RichTextDocument instances.");
				}
				_document = document;
			}
		}

		internal void OnDocumentInitialized()
		{
			RichTextListCollection listsIfAllocated = ListsIfAllocated;
			if (listsIfAllocated == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RichTextList item in listsIfAllocated)
			{
				item.VerifyNumbers();
			}
		}

				}
			}

		private bool UpdateBodyNode()
		{
			DocumentBodyNode documentBodyNode = ((base.ChildNodes != null) ? ((DocumentBodyNode)base.ChildNodes.FirstOrDefault((NodeBase ii) => ii is DocumentBodyNode)) : null);
			if (_body != documentBodyNode)
			{
				_body = documentBodyNode;
				if (_document != null)
				{
					_document.OnDocumentVersionCompatibilityChanged();
				}
				RaisePropertyChanged("Body");
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void EnsureThemeInfoResolved()
		{
			if (Data._themeInfoResolved == null)
			{
				RichTextThemeInfo richTextThemeInfo = new RichTextThemeInfo();
				PropertyResolverBase propertyResolverBase = richTextThemeInfo.PropsInfo.CreateResolver(richTextThemeInfo);
				RichTextThemeInfo richTextThemeInfo2 = ((Settings != null) ? Settings.ThemeInfo : null);
				if (richTextThemeInfo2 != null)
				{
					propertyResolverBase.MergeProperties(richTextThemeInfo2);
				}
				propertyResolverBase.MergeProperties(RichTextThemeInfo.DefaultThemeInfo);
				Data._themeInfoResolved = (RichTextThemeInfo)propertyResolverBase.ResolveRemainingProperties();
				RaisePropertyChanged("ThemeInfoResolved");
			}
		}

		private void OnDefaultSettingsChanged(bool paraSettingsDirty, bool runSettingsDirty, bool tableSettingsDirty)
		{
			Styles._paragraphDefaultStyle.GetDefaultStyle()?.DirtyResolved();
			RichTextDocument.DefaultNormalStyle.DirtyResolved();
			if (runSettingsDirty)
			{
				Styles._runDefaultStyle.GetDefaultStyle()?.DirtyResolved();
			}
			if (tableSettingsDirty)
			{
				Styles._tableDefaultStyle.GetDefaultStyle()?.DirtyResolved();
			}
			DocumentBodyNode body = Body;
			if (body != null)
			{
				new DefaultSettingsChangedWalker(paraSettingsDirty, runSettingsDirty, tableSettingsDirty).VisitBodyNode(body);
			}
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propname)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propname));
			}
		}
	}
