	internal class SchemaValidator
	{
		private static readonly Type[] g_LeafNodeTypes;

		static SchemaValidator()
		{
			g_LeafNodeTypes = new Type[3]
			{
				typeof(TextNode),
				typeof(BreakNode),
				typeof(ImageNode)
			};
		}

		internal static bool CanHaveChildren(Type nodeType)
		{
			return Array.IndexOf(g_LeafNodeTypes, nodeType) < 0;
		}

		internal static bool CanBeChildOfRun(NodeBase node)
		{
			if (!(node is TextNode) && !(node is BreakNode))
			{
				return node is ImageNode;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsValidParagraphDescendant(NodeBase node)
		{
			if (!(node is RunNode))
			{
				return CanBeChildOfRun(node);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool CanBeChildOfBody(NodeBase node)
		{
			if (!(node is ParagraphNode))
			{
				return node is TableNode;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool CanBeChildOfRoot(NodeBase node)
		{
			return node is DocumentBodyNode;
		}

		internal static bool CanBeChildOfParagraph(NodeBase node)
		{
			if (!(node is RunNode))
			{
				return node is HyperlinkNode;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool CanBeChildOfCell(NodeBase node)
		{
			if (!(node is ParagraphNode))
			{
				return node is TableNode;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool AreValidChildNodes(NodeBase parent, IEnumerable<NodeBase> childNodes)
		{
			foreach (NodeBase childNode in childNodes)
			{
				if (!parent.IsValidChildNode(childNode))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void ValidateChildNode(NodeBase parent, NodeBase child)
		{
			if (!parent.IsValidChildNode(child))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"{child.GetType().Name} cannot be child of {parent.GetType().Name}.");
			}
		}
	}

					{
						_imageStatus = RichTextImageStatus.DecodeFailed;
					}
					else
					{
						_imageStatus = RichTextImageStatus.ImageAvailable;
					}

		internal RichTextImageStatus ImageStatus
		{
			get
			{
				if (_loadData != null)
				{
					return _loadData._status;
				}
				ImageNodeData data = Data;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(data._imageUri))
				{
					if (data._image == null)
					{
						return RichTextImageStatus.ImageNotSet;
					}
					return _imageStatus;
				}
				return RichTextImageStatus.DownloadNotStarted;
			}
		}

		{
			return visitor.VisitImageNode(this, argument);
		}

		internal RichTextSize? GetRenderSizeResolved(bool useRenderSizeFromLayoutAsFallback = false)
		{
			RichTextSize? result = null;
			RichTextSize? renderSize = Data._renderSize;
			if (renderSize.HasValue)
			{
				RichTextSize value = renderSize.Value;
				if (value.Width.Emus >= 0.0 && value.Height.Emus >= 0.0)
				{
					return value;
				}
				RichTextSize? richTextSize = ImageResolved?.GetSize();
				if (richTextSize.HasValue && richTextSize.Value.Height.Emus > 0.0 && richTextSize.Value.Width.Emus > 0.0)
				{
					double num = richTextSize.Value.Width.LogicalPixels / richTextSize.Value.Height.LogicalPixels;
					if (value.Width.Emus < 0.0)
					{
						return new RichTextSize(new Extent(value.Height.LogicalPixels * num, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels), value.Height);
					}
					return new RichTextSize(value.Width, new Extent(value.Width.LogicalPixels / num, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels));
				}
			}
			if (useRenderSizeFromLayoutAsFallback && !result.HasValue)
			{
				return ValidatedRenderSize;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public MemoryStream GetImageData()
		{
			if (Image != null)
			{
				return Image.GetData();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool BeginDownload(bool isPriority)
		{
			if (_loadData != null)
			{
				RichTextImageStatus status = _loadData._status;
				if (status == RichTextImageStatus.DownloadComplete || status == RichTextImageStatus.DownloadFailed)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			RichTextDocument document = base.Document;
			if (document == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ImageUri))
			{
				return false;
			}
			_loadData = document.QueueImageDownload(this, isPriority);
			return _loadData != null;
		}

		internal void OnImageDecodeFailed(Exception error)
		{
			if (_loadData != null)
			{
				_loadData._status = RichTextImageStatus.DecodeFailed;
				_loadData._error = error;
			}
			else
			{
				_imageStatus = RichTextImageStatus.DecodeFailed;
				_error = error;
			}
		}

		internal void OnImageDownloadCompleted()
		{
			NotifyListeners(this, "ImageResolved", null);
		}

		private void OnImagePropertyChanged()
		{
			NotifyListeners(this, "ImageResolved", null);
		}

	public abstract class NodeBase : RichTextObjectBase
	{
		internal new static class StorageProps
		{
			internal abstract class Info : RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info
			{
				internal readonly Type _nodeType;

				internal readonly bool _canHaveChildren;

				internal int _styleIdProp;

				internal Type _styleType;

				internal Info(Type nodeType)
				{
					CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(nodeType);
					_nodeType = nodeType;
					_canHaveChildren = SchemaValidator.CanHaveChildren(nodeType);
				}

				internal abstract NodeData CreateNodeData();

				internal override PropertyResolverBase CreateResolver(object target)
				{
					return null;
				}

				protected override void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> map)
				{
					base.Initialize(map);
					StoragePropsInfo.FillMap(new PropInfo[3]
					{
						CreateProp(0, "Id", (NodeBase i) => i.Id, (NodeBase i, string v) => i.SetField(ref i._data._id, v)),
						CreateProp(1, "ChildNodes", (NodeBase i) => i._childNodes, (NodeBase i, NodeCollection v) => i.SetChildNodesHelper(v, notifyPropChange: false), null, CopyMethod.CopyClone),
						CreateProp(2, "CustomAttributes", (NodeBase i) => i.CustomAttributes, (NodeBase i, NodeAttributeCollection v) => i.SetField(ref i._data._customAttributes, v), null, CopyMethod.CopyClone)
					}, map);
				}
			}

			internal const int Id = 0;

			internal const int ChildNodes = 1;

			internal const int CustomAttributes = 2;

			internal const int LAST_PROP = 2;
		}

		internal readonly NodeData _data;

		private NodeBase _parent;

		private NodeCollection _childNodes;

		private object _childNodesToken;

		internal override bool ShouldCreateChangeChainContext => false;

		public RichTextDocument Document => RootNode?.InternalDocument;

		public string Id
		{
			get
			{
				return _data._id;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _data._id, value, 0);
			}
		}

		public NodeCollection ChildNodes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_childNodes == null)
				{
					if (CanHaveChildren && !base.IsSealed)
					{
						SetChildNodesHelper(new NodeCollection(), notifyPropChange: false, isLazilyAllocated: true);
					}
					else
					{
						_childNodes = RichTextSingleton<NodeCollection>.Instance;
					}
				}
				return _childNodes;
			}
			set
			{
				SetChildNodesHelper(value, notifyPropChange: true);
			}
		}

		public NodeAttributeCollection CustomAttributes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_data._customAttributes == null)
				{
					if (!base.IsSealed)
					{
						SetField(ref _data._customAttributes, new NodeAttributeCollection());
					}
					else
					{
						_data._customAttributes = RichTextSingleton<NodeAttributeCollection>.Instance;
					}
				}
				return _data._customAttributes;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _data._customAttributes, value, 2);
			}
		}

		public bool HasChildNodes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_childNodes != null)
				{
					return _childNodes.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool HasCustomAttributes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_data._customAttributes != null)
				{
					return _data._customAttributes.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public NodeBase Parent => _parent;

		public abstract RichTextNodeType Type { get; }

		internal int AggregateOffsetCount => PrefixOffsetCount + PostfixOffsetCount + Utilities.GetOffsetCount(_childNodes);

		internal int AggregateNodeCount => 1 + ((_childNodes != null) ? _childNodes.Info.AggregateNodeCount : 0);

		internal bool CanHaveChildren => ((StorageProps.Info)PropsInfo)._canHaveChildren;

		internal NodeCollection ChildNodesIfAllocated => _childNodes;

		internal object ChildNodesToken
		{
			get
			{
				return _childNodesToken;
			}
			set
			{
				_childNodesToken = value;
			}
		}

		internal NodeBase FirstChild
		{
			get
			{
				if (_childNodes == null || _childNodes.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _childNodes[0];
			}
		}

		internal NodeBase LastChild
		{
			get
			{
				int num = ((_childNodes != null) ? _childNodes.Count : 0);
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _childNodes[num - 1];
			}
		}

		internal int NodeOffsetCount => PrefixOffsetCount + PostfixOffsetCount;

		internal NodeCollection ParentCollection
		{
			get
			{
				if (_parent == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _parent._childNodes;
			}
		}

		internal int PrefixOffsetCount => _data.PrefixOffsetCount;

		internal int PostfixOffsetCount => _data.PostfixOffsetCount;

		internal DocumentRootNode RootNode
		{
			get
			{
				NodeBase nodeBase = this;
				while (nodeBase._parent != null)
				{
					nodeBase = nodeBase._parent;
				}
				return nodeBase as DocumentRootNode;
			}
		}

		public NodeBase()
		{
			_data = ((StorageProps.Info)PropsInfo).CreateNodeData();
		}

		internal NodeBase(NodeData data)
		{
			_data = data;
		}

		public override RichTextObjectBase Clone()
		{
			return Clone(copyId: true, copyChildNodes: true);
		}

		internal override void OnPropertyChanged<T>(int propertyIndex, T oldValue)
		{
			if (1 != propertyIndex)
			{
				NodesChangeManager.OnNodePropertyChanged(this, propertyIndex, oldValue);
			}
			base.OnPropertyChanged(propertyIndex, oldValue);
		}

		internal override void OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (sender == _childNodes)
			{
				OnChildNodesChanged(sender, property, extraInfo, dontLogChange: false);
			}
			else if (this != sender && extraInfo is PropertyChangeChainContextBase context)
			{
				RichTextDocument document = Document;
				if (document != null)
				{
					PropertyChangeChainContextBase context2 = AddSelfToPropertyChangeChainHelper(context);

		public int GetDocumentOffset()
		{
			NodeBase parent = _parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			NodeCollection nodeCollection = parent?._childNodes;
			if (nodeCollection != null)
			{
				int itemOffset = nodeCollection.Info.GetItemOffset(this);
				if (itemOffset >= 0)
				{
					int documentOffset = parent.GetDocumentOffset();
					if (documentOffset >= 0)
					{
						return documentOffset + parent.PrefixOffsetCount + itemOffset;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal int GetAggregateIndex()

		}

		internal DocumentSpan GetDocumentSpan(bool includePrefix, bool includePostfix)
		{

		internal NodeBase GetNodeAtAggregateIndex(int aggregateIndex)
		{
			if (aggregateIndex == 0)
			{
				return this;
			}
			NodeBase nodeBase = null;
			aggregateIndex--;
			int num = ((_childNodes != null) ? _childNodes.Info.AggregateNodeCount : 0);
			if (aggregateIndex < num)
			{
				nodeBase = _childNodes.Info.GetItemContainingAggregateIndex(ref aggregateIndex);
				if (nodeBase != null)
				{
					return nodeBase.GetNodeAtAggregateIndex(aggregateIndex);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal NodeBase GetNodeAtOffset(ref int offset, bool descend = true)
		{
			int prefixOffsetCount = PrefixOffsetCount;
			if (offset < prefixOffsetCount)
			{
				return this;
			}
			NodeBase nodeBase = null;
			offset -= prefixOffsetCount;
			int offsetCount = Utilities.GetOffsetCount(_childNodes);
			if (offset < offsetCount)
			{
				nodeBase = _childNodes.Info.GetItemContainingOffset(ref offset);
				if (nodeBase != null)
				{
					if (descend)
					{
						return nodeBase.GetNodeAtOffset(ref offset);
					}
					return nodeBase;
				}
				offset = -1;
			}
			else
			{
				offset -= offsetCount;
				int postfixOffsetCount = PostfixOffsetCount;
				if (offset < postfixOffsetCount)
				{
					offset += prefixOffsetCount + offsetCount;
					return this;
				}
				offset -= postfixOffsetCount;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal TableCellNode GetCell(int columnIndex, bool includeMergedCells = true)
		{
			foreach (TableCellNode cell in GetCells())
			{
				int columnPosition = GetColumnPosition(cell);
				if (columnIndex == columnPosition || (includeMergedCells && columnIndex > columnPosition && columnIndex < columnPosition + NodeUtils.GetColumnSpan(cell)))
				{
					return cell;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal IEnumerable<TableCellNode> GetCells(int columnIndex, int columnCount, bool includeMergedCells = true)
		{
			DocumentSpan span = new DocumentSpan(columnIndex, columnCount);
			return from cell in GetCells()
				let cellSpan = new DocumentSpan(GetColumnPosition(cell), NodeUtils.GetColumnSpan(cell))
				where span.Contains(cellSpan.Start) || (includeMergedCells && span.OverlapsWith(cellSpan))
				select cell;
		}

		internal bool IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea area, int rowsInBand = 1)
		{
			NodeCollection parentCollection = base.ParentCollection;
			int num = parentCollection?.IndexOf(this) ?? (-1);
			if (num >= 0)

					return num / rowsInBand % 2 == 0;
				case TableRowArea.FirstRow:
					return num == 0;
				case TableRowArea.LastRow:

			return false;
		}

		internal void EnsureSettingsResolved()
		{
			TableNode table = Table;
			if (table == null || (_settingsResolved != null && _verifiedSettingsResolvedVersion == table._settingsResolvedVersion))
			{
				return;
			}
			table.EnsureSettingsResolved();
			_verifiedSettingsResolvedVersion = table._settingsResolvedVersion;
			TableRowSettings settings = Settings;
			TableRowSettingsExceptions tableSettingsExceptions = TableSettingsExceptions;
			AreaSpecificSettings areaSpecificSettings = RichTextStyleCollection.GetStyleResolvedHelper<TableStyle>(table, table.StyleId, returnDefaultIfIdNull: true)?.AreaSpecificSettings;
			PropertyResolverBase propertyResolverBase = Utilities.CreateResolver<TableRowSettings>();
			Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, settings);
			Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, tableSettingsExceptions);
			PropertyResolverBase resolver = null;
			Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<TableSettings>(ref resolver, tableSettingsExceptions);
			if (areaSpecificSettings != null)
			{
				TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags tableAreaSettingsUsageFlags = NodeUtils.ResolveTableAreaSettingsUsageFlags(tableSettingsExceptions, table.SettingsResolved);
				TableAreaSettings tableAreaSettings = (((TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.LastRow & tableAreaSettingsUsageFlags) != 0) ? areaSpecificSettings.LastRow : null);
				if (tableAreaSettings != null && IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.LastRow))
				{
					Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, tableAreaSettings.RowSettings);
					Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<TableSettings>(ref resolver, tableAreaSettings.TableSettings);
				}
				TableAreaSettings tableAreaSettings2 = (((TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.FirstRow & tableAreaSettingsUsageFlags) != 0) ? areaSpecificSettings.FirstRow : null);
				if (tableAreaSettings2 != null && IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.FirstRow))
				{
					Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, tableAreaSettings2.RowSettings);
					Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<TableSettings>(ref resolver, tableAreaSettings2.TableSettings);
				}
				if ((TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.HorizontalBanding & tableAreaSettingsUsageFlags) != 0)
				{
					TableAreaSettings evenRowBanding = areaSpecificSettings.EvenRowBanding;
					TableAreaSettings oddRowBanding = areaSpecificSettings.OddRowBanding;
					if (evenRowBanding != null || oddRowBanding != null)
					{
						TableAreaSettings tableAreaSettings3 = (IsTableRowArea(TableRowArea.EvenRow) ? evenRowBanding : oddRowBanding);
						if (tableAreaSettings3 != null)
						{
							Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, tableAreaSettings3.RowSettings);
							Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<TableSettings>(ref resolver, tableAreaSettings3.TableSettings);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (resolver != null)
			{
				Utilities.MergeHelper(resolver, table.SettingsResolved);
			}
			_tableSettingsResolved = ((resolver != null) ? (resolver.ResolveRemainingProperties() as TableSettings) : table.SettingsResolved);
			Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, _tableSettingsResolved);
			_settingsResolved = propertyResolverBase.ResolveRemainingProperties() as TableRowSettings;
			DocumentRootNode rootNode = base.RootNode;
			if (rootNode != null)
			{
				PropertyResolverBase propertyResolverBase2 = Utilities.CreateResolver<CharacterSettings>();
				_ = rootNode.Settings;
				CharacterSettings characterSettings = ((rootNode.Settings != null) ? rootNode.Settings.DefaultCharacterSettings : null);
				if (characterSettings != null)
				{
					propertyResolverBase2.MergeProperties(characterSettings);
				}
				propertyResolverBase2.MergeProperties(RichTextDocument.DefaultCharacterSettings);
				_rowMarkSettingsResolved = propertyResolverBase2.ResolveRemainingProperties() as CharacterSettings;
			}
		}

			if (_settingsResolved != null)
			{
				AreaSpecificSettings areaSpecificSettings = RichTextStyleCollection.GetStyleResolvedHelper<TableStyle>(this, StyleId, returnDefaultIfIdNull: true)?.AreaSpecificSettings;
				if (areaSpecificSettings != null && (areaSpecificSettings.EvenRowBanding != null || areaSpecificSettings.OddRowBanding != null))
				{
					DirtyStyleInfo();
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnPropertyChanged<T>(int propertyIndex, T oldValue)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(propertyIndex, oldValue);
			switch (propertyIndex)
			{
			case 3:
				DirtyStyleInfo();
				break;
			case 5:
				DirtyStyleInfo(oldValue as string);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal override void OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (extraInfo is PropertyChangeChainContextBase { Owner: var owner } && Settings == owner)
			{
				DirtyStyleInfo();
			}
			base.OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
		}

		public TableRowNode CreateNewRow(int templateRowIndex = -1)
		{
			if (templateRowIndex >= 0)
			{
				TableRowNode[] array = CreateNewRowsInternal(templateRowIndex, 1, null);
				if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return array[0];
			}
			int num = Math.Max(1, GetColumnCount());
			TableRowNode tableRowNode = new TableRowNode();
			TableCellNode[] array2 = new TableCellNode[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = NodeUtils.CreateCellWithParagraph();
			}
			tableRowNode.ChildNodes.InsertRange(0, array2);
			return tableRowNode;
		}

		public TableCellNode GetCell(int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
		{
			return GetRow(rowIndex)?.GetCell(columnIndex);
		}

		public IEnumerable<TableCellNode> GetCellsInColumn(int columnIndex, bool includeMergedCells)
		{
			return GetCellsInColumns(columnIndex, 1, includeMergedCells);
		}

		public IEnumerable<TableCellNode> GetCellsInColumns(int columnIndex, int columnCount, bool includeMergedCells)
		{
			return GetRows().SelectMany((TableRowNode r) => r.GetCells(columnIndex, columnCount, includeMergedCells));
		}

		public IEnumerable<TableCellNode> GetCellsInRow(int rowIndex, bool includeMergedCells)
		{
			return GetCellsInRows(rowIndex, 1, includeMergedCells);
		}

		public IEnumerable<TableCellNode> GetCellsInRows(int rowIndex, int rowCount, bool includeMergedCells)
		{
			IEnumerable<TableRowNode> enumerable = GetRows().Skip(rowIndex).Take(rowCount);
			bool processingFirstRow = true;
			foreach (TableRowNode item in enumerable)
			{
				foreach (TableCellNode cell in item.GetCells())
				{
					if (NodeUtils.IsMergedWithCellAbove(cell))
					{
						if (includeMergedCells && processingFirstRow)
						{
							TableCellNode headCell = GetHeadCell(cell);
							if (headCell != null)
							{
								yield return headCell;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						yield return cell;
					}
				}
				processingFirstRow = false;
			}
		}

		public int GetColumnCount()
		{
			VerifyRowAndCellPositioningInfo();
			return _cachedColumnCount;
		}

		public int GetRowCount()
		{
			return GetRows().Count();
		}

		public TableRowNode GetRow(int rowIndex)
		{
			return GetRows().Skip(rowIndex).FirstOrDefault();
		}

		internal TableRowNode[] CreateNewRowsInternal(int templateRowIndex, int countOfRowsToCreate, Action<int, int, TableCellNode> cellInitializer)
		{
			NodeCollection childNodes = base.ChildNodes;
			TableRowNode tableRowNode = childNodes[templateRowIndex] as TableRowNode;
			TableRowNode tableRowNode2 = ((templateRowIndex < childNodes.Count - 1) ? (childNodes[templateRowIndex + 1] as TableRowNode) : null);
			ReadOnlyNotifyCollection<TableCellNode> cells = tableRowNode.Cells;
			int count = cells.Count;
			TableRowNode[] array = new TableRowNode[countOfRowsToCreate];
			for (int i = 0; i < countOfRowsToCreate; i++)
			{
				TableRowNode tableRowNode3 = (array[i] = new TableRowNode());
				for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
				{
					TableCellNode tableCellNode = cells[j];
					TableCellNode tableCellNode2 = NodeUtils.CreateCellWithParagraph();
					if (tableCellNode.Settings != null)
					{
						tableCellNode2.Settings = tableCellNode.Settings.Clone() as TableCellSettings;
					}
					if (tableCellNode.FirstChild is ParagraphNode paragraphNode)
					{
						ParagraphNode paragraphNode2 = tableCellNode2.FirstChild as ParagraphNode;
						paragraphNode2.StyleId = paragraphNode.StyleId;
						if (paragraphNode.Settings != null)
						{
							paragraphNode2.Settings = paragraphNode.Settings.Clone() as ParagraphSettings;
						}
						if (paragraphNode.MarkSettings != null)
						{
							paragraphNode2.MarkSettings = paragraphNode.MarkSettings.Clone() as CharacterSettings;
						}
					}
					TableCellVerticalMerge? verticalMerge = tableCellNode2.SettingsAllocated.VerticalMerge;
					if (tableRowNode2 == null)
					{
						verticalMerge = null;
					}
					else
					{
						int columnPosition = tableRowNode.GetColumnPosition(tableCellNode);
						verticalMerge = tableRowNode2.GetCell(columnPosition)?.SettingsAllocated.VerticalMerge;
					}
					tableCellNode2.Settings.VerticalMerge = verticalMerge;
					cellInitializer?.Invoke(i, j, tableCellNode2);
					if (tableRowNode.Settings != null)
					{
						tableRowNode3.Settings = tableRowNode.Settings.Clone() as TableRowSettings;
					}
					if (tableRowNode.TableSettingsExceptions != null)
					{
						tableRowNode3.TableSettingsExceptions = tableRowNode.TableSettingsExceptions.Clone() as TableRowSettingsExceptions;
					}
					tableRowNode3.ChildNodes.Add(tableCellNode2);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal void DirtyStyleInfo(string styleIdToUnhook = null)
		{
			if (_settingsResolved != null)
			{
				_settingsResolved = null;
				_settingsResolvedVersion++;
				DocumentRootNode.RemoveStyleListenerHelper(styleIdToUnhook ?? StyleId, this, listenForDefaultStyleIfIdNull: true);
				NotifyListeners(this, "SettingsResolved", null);
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureSettingsResolved()
		{
			if (_settingsResolved == null)
			{
				string styleId = StyleId;
				DocumentRootNode.AddStyleListenerHelper(styleId, this, listenForDefaultStyleIfIdNull: true);
				TableSettings settings = Settings;
				TableStyle styleResolvedHelper = RichTextStyleCollection.GetStyleResolvedHelper<TableStyle>(this, styleId, returnDefaultIfIdNull: true);
				TableStyle tableStyle = ((styleResolvedHelper != null) ? ((TableStyle)styleResolvedHelper.GetResolvedIncludingDefaults(this)) : null);
				TableAreaTableSettings source = null;
				if (tableStyle != null)
				{
					source = tableStyle.GetWholeTableAreaTableSettings();
				}
				PropertyResolver<TableSettings> propertyResolver = Utilities.CreateResolver<TableSettings>();
				Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolver, settings);
				Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolver, source);
				_settingsResolved = propertyResolver.ResolveRemainingProperties() as TableSettings;
			}
		}

		internal IEnumerable<TableRowNode> GetRows()
		{
			return base.ChildNodes.OfType<TableRowNode>();
		}

		internal TableCellNode GetHeadCell(TableCellNode cell)
		{
			if (!NodeUtils.IsMergedWithCellAbove(cell))
			{
				return cell;
			}
			int num = ((cell.Row != null) ? cell.Row.GetColumnPosition(cell) : (-1));
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				while (cell.Row.GetPreviousSibling() is TableRowNode tableRowNode)
				{
					TableCellNode cell2 = tableRowNode.GetCell(num, includeMergedCells: false);
					if (cell2 == null || !NodeUtils.IsMergedWithCellAbove(cell2))
					{
						return cell2;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal TableSettings GetUniqueSettings()
		{
			TableSettings settings = Data._settings;
			if (settings == null)
			{
				return new TableSettings();
			}
			if (settings.HasMultipleOwners)
			{
				return settings.Clone() as TableSettings;
			}
			return settings;
		}

		internal void OnDefaultSettingsChanged()
		{
			DirtyStyleInfo();
		}

		private void VerifyRowAndCellPositioningInfo()
		{
			int cachedColumnCount = GetRows().Max(delegate(TableRowNode ii)
			{
				ii.VerifyCellPositioningInfo();
				return ii._cachedCellPositionCount;
			});
			_cachedColumnCount = cachedColumnCount;
		}
	}
	internal class TableNodeData : BlockNodeData
	{
		internal TableSettings _settings;

		internal TableGrid _grid;

		internal string _styleId;

		internal override NodeBase CreateNode()
		{
			return new TableNode(this);
		}
	}
	public class NumberFormat
	{
		private readonly string _customFormat;

		private readonly NumberFormatType _type;

		private static readonly NumberFormat _bullet = new NumberFormat(NumberFormatType.Bullet);

		private static readonly NumberFormat _cardinalText = new NumberFormat(NumberFormatType.CardinalText);

		private static readonly NumberFormat _decimal = new NumberFormat(NumberFormatType.Decimal);

		private static readonly NumberFormat _decimalEnclosedFullstop = new NumberFormat(NumberFormatType.DecimalEnclosedFullstop);

		private static readonly NumberFormat _decimalEnclosedParen = new NumberFormat(NumberFormatType.DecimalEnclosedParen);

		private static readonly NumberFormat _lowerLetter = new NumberFormat(NumberFormatType.LowerLetter);

		private static readonly NumberFormat _lowerRoman = new NumberFormat(NumberFormatType.LowerRoman);

		private static readonly NumberFormat _ordinal = new NumberFormat(NumberFormatType.Ordinal);

		private static readonly NumberFormat _ordinalText = new NumberFormat(NumberFormatType.OrdinalText);

		private static readonly NumberFormat _upperLetter = new NumberFormat(NumberFormatType.UpperLetter);

		private static readonly NumberFormat _upperRoman = new NumberFormat(NumberFormatType.UpperRoman);

		public static NumberFormat Bullet => _bullet;

		public static NumberFormat CardinalText => _cardinalText;

		public static NumberFormat Decimal => _decimal;

		public static NumberFormat DecimalEnclosedFullstop => _decimalEnclosedFullstop;

		public static NumberFormat DecimalEnclosedParen => _decimalEnclosedParen;

		public static NumberFormat LowerLetter => _lowerLetter;

		public static NumberFormat LowerRoman => _lowerRoman;

		public static NumberFormat Ordinal => _ordinal;

		public static NumberFormat OrdinalText => _ordinalText;

		public static NumberFormat UpperLetter => _upperLetter;

		public static NumberFormat UpperRoman => _upperRoman;

		public string CustomFormat => _customFormat;

		public bool IsCustom => _type == NumberFormatType.Custom;

		public NumberFormatType Type => _type;

		public NumberFormat(string customFormat)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(customFormat, "customFormat");
			_customFormat = customFormat;
			_type = NumberFormatType.Custom;
		}

		private NumberFormat(NumberFormatType value)
		{
			_type = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is NumberFormat numberFormat))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_customFormat == numberFormat._customFormat)
			{
				return _type == numberFormat._type;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (_customFormat != null)
			{
				return _customFormat.GetHashCode();
			}
			return (int)_type;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_customFormat != null)
			{
				return "Custom NumberFormat: " + _customFormat;
			}
			return "NumberFormat: " + _type;
		}

		public static NumberFormat GetNumberFormat(NumberFormatType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				NumberFormatType.Bullet => Bullet, 
				NumberFormatType.Decimal => Decimal, 
				NumberFormatType.DecimalEnclosedFullstop => DecimalEnclosedFullstop, 
				NumberFormatType.DecimalEnclosedParen => DecimalEnclosedParen, 
				NumberFormatType.UpperRoman => UpperRoman, 
				NumberFormatType.LowerRoman => LowerRoman, 
				NumberFormatType.UpperLetter => UpperLetter, 
				NumberFormatType.LowerLetter => LowerLetter, 
				NumberFormatType.Ordinal => Ordinal, 
				NumberFormatType.CardinalText => CardinalText, 
				NumberFormatType.OrdinalText => OrdinalText, 
				NumberFormatType.Custom => throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CustomNumberFormatInvalid"), "type"), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidNumberFormatType"), "type"), 
			};
		}
	}

	public class RichTextBorder : RichTextObjectBase
	{
		internal new static class StorageProps
		{
			internal class Info : RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info
			{
				internal static readonly Info Instance = new Info();

				internal override RichTextObjectBase CreateNew()
				{
					return new RichTextBorder();
				}

				internal override PropertyResolverBase CreateResolver(object target)
				{
					return new PropertyResolver<RichTextBorder>(target as RichTextBorder);
				}

				protected override void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> map)
				{
					_mergePropertiesWhenResolving = false;
					base.Initialize(map);
					StoragePropsInfo.FillMap(new PropInfo[4]
					{
						CreateProp(0, "BorderType", (RichTextBorder i) => i._borderType, (RichTextBorder i, RichTextBorderType v) => i.SetField(ref i._borderType, v), RichTextBorderType.None, CopyMethod.CopyValue, RichTextBorderType.None),
						CreateProp(1, "Color", (RichTextBorder i) => i._color, (RichTextBorder i, ColorInfo v) => i.SetField(ref i._color, v)),
						CreateProp(2, "Size", (RichTextBorder i) => i._size, (RichTextBorder i, Extent? v) => i.SetField(ref i._size, v)),
						CreateProp(3, "Spacing", (RichTextBorder i) => i._spacing, (RichTextBorder i, Extent? v) => i.SetField(ref i._spacing, v))
					}, map);
				}
			}

			internal const int BorderType = 0;

			internal const int Color = 1;

			internal const int Size = 2;

			internal const int Spacing = 3;
		}

		private RichTextBorderType _borderType;

		private ColorInfo _color;

		private Extent? _size;

		private Extent? _spacing;

		private static readonly Extent _DefaultSize = new Extent(0.25, ExtentUnitType.Points);

		internal override RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info PropsInfo => StorageProps.Info.Instance;

		public Extent BorderThickness
		{
			get
			{
				Extent value = default(Extent);
				switch (_borderType)
				{
				case RichTextBorderType.None:
					value = SizeResolved;
					break;
				case RichTextBorderType.Single:
				case RichTextBorderType.Thick:
				case RichTextBorderType.Dotted:
				case RichTextBorderType.Dashed:
				case RichTextBorderType.DotDash:
				case RichTextBorderType.DotDotDash:
				case RichTextBorderType.Wave:
				case RichTextBorderType.DashSmallGap:
				case RichTextBorderType.DashDotStroked:
				case RichTextBorderType.Outset:
				case RichTextBorderType.Inset:
					value = SizeResolved;
					break;
				default:
				{
					Extent[] lineSegmentExtents = LineSegmentExtents;
					Extent[] lineSegmentSpacings = LineSegmentSpacings;
					for (int i = 0; i < lineSegmentExtents.Length; i++)
					{
						value += lineSegmentExtents[i] + lineSegmentSpacings[i];
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				return Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(value, 1);
			}
		}

		public RichTextBorderType BorderType
		{
			get
			{
				return _borderType;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _borderType, value, 0);
			}
		}

		public ColorInfo Color
		{
			get
			{
				return _color;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _color, value, 1);
			}
		}

		public Extent? Size
		{
			get
			{
				return _size;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _size, value, 2);
			}
		}

		public Extent? Spacing
		{
			get
			{
				return _spacing;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _spacing, value, 3);
			}
		}

		internal RichTextBorderType BottomRightComplement => _borderType switch
		{
			RichTextBorderType.ThickThinLargeGap => RichTextBorderType.ThinThickLargeGap, 
			RichTextBorderType.ThickThinMediumGap => RichTextBorderType.ThinThickMediumGap, 
			RichTextBorderType.ThickThinSmallGap => RichTextBorderType.ThinThickSmallGap, 
			RichTextBorderType.ThinThickLargeGap => RichTextBorderType.ThickThinLargeGap, 
			RichTextBorderType.ThinThickMediumGap => RichTextBorderType.ThickThinMediumGap, 
			RichTextBorderType.ThinThickSmallGap => RichTextBorderType.ThickThinSmallGap, 
			_ => _borderType, 
		};

		internal Extent[] LineSegmentExtents
		{
			get
			{
				switch (_borderType)
				{
				default:
					return new Extent[1] { BorderThickness };
				case RichTextBorderType.Single:
				case RichTextBorderType.Thick:
				case RichTextBorderType.Dotted:
				case RichTextBorderType.Dashed:
				case RichTextBorderType.DotDash:
				case RichTextBorderType.DotDotDash:
				case RichTextBorderType.Wave:
				case RichTextBorderType.DashSmallGap:
				case RichTextBorderType.DashDotStroked:
				case RichTextBorderType.Outset:
				case RichTextBorderType.Inset:
					return new Extent[1] { BorderThickness };
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickThinSmallGap:
				{
					Extent extent13 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved.LogicalPixels * 1.5 / 12.0, 1);
					return new Extent[3]
					{
						extent13,
						Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved),
						extent13
					};
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickThinMediumGap:
				{
					Extent extent11 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved.LogicalPixels / 2.0, 1);
					Extent extent12 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved, 1);
					return new Extent[3] { extent11, extent12, extent11 };
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickThinLargeGap:
				{
					Extent extent7 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved.LogicalPixels / 8.0, 1);
					Extent extent8 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(extent7.LogicalPixels * 2.0);
					return new Extent[3] { extent7, extent8, extent7 };
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickSmallGap:
				case RichTextBorderType.ThickThinSmallGap:
				{
					Extent extent14 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved.LogicalPixels / 8.0, 1);
					Extent extent15 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved, 1);
					if (_borderType != RichTextBorderType.ThickThinSmallGap)
					{
						return new Extent[2] { extent15, extent14 };
					}
					return new Extent[2] { extent14, extent15 };
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickMediumGap:
				case RichTextBorderType.ThickThinMediumGap:
				{
					Extent extent9 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved.LogicalPixels / 2.0, 1);
					Extent extent10 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(extent9.LogicalPixels * 2.0);
					if (_borderType != RichTextBorderType.ThickThinMediumGap)
					{
						return new Extent[2] { extent10, extent9 };
					}
					return new Extent[2] { extent9, extent10 };
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickLargeGap:
				case RichTextBorderType.ThickThinLargeGap:
				{
					Extent extent5 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved.LogicalPixels / 8.0, 1);
					Extent extent6 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(extent5.LogicalPixels * 2.0);
					if (_borderType != RichTextBorderType.ThickThinLargeGap)
					{
						return new Extent[2] { extent6, extent5 };
					}
					return new Extent[2] { extent5, extent6 };
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThreeDEmboss:
				case RichTextBorderType.ThreeDEngrave:
				{
					Extent extent3 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved.LogicalPixels / 2.0, 1);
					Extent extent4 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(extent3.LogicalPixels * 2.0);
					return new Extent[3] { extent3, extent4, extent3 };
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.Double:
				case RichTextBorderType.DoubleWave:
				{
					Extent extent2 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved, 1);
					return new Extent[2] { extent2, extent2 };
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.Triple:
				{
					Extent extent = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved, 1);
					return new Extent[3] { extent, extent, extent };
				}
				}
			}
		}

		internal Extent[] LineSegmentSpacings
		{
			get
			{
				switch (_borderType)
				{
				default:
					return new Extent[1];
				case RichTextBorderType.Single:
				case RichTextBorderType.Thick:
				case RichTextBorderType.Dotted:
				case RichTextBorderType.Dashed:
				case RichTextBorderType.DotDash:
				case RichTextBorderType.DotDotDash:
				case RichTextBorderType.Wave:
				case RichTextBorderType.DashSmallGap:
				case RichTextBorderType.DashDotStroked:
				case RichTextBorderType.Outset:
				case RichTextBorderType.Inset:
					return new Extent[1];
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickThinSmallGap:
				{
					Extent extent7 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved.LogicalPixels * 1.5 / 12.0, 1);
					return new Extent[3]
					{
						default(Extent),
						extent7,
						extent7
					};
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickThinMediumGap:
				{
					Extent extent6 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved.LogicalPixels / 2.0, 1);
					return new Extent[3]
					{
						default(Extent),
						extent6,
						extent6
					};
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickThinLargeGap:
				{
					Extent extent5 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved, 1);
					return new Extent[3]
					{
						default(Extent),
						extent5,
						extent5
					};
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickSmallGap:
				case RichTextBorderType.ThickThinSmallGap:
				{
					Extent extent4 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved.LogicalPixels / 8.0, 1);
					return new Extent[2]
					{
						default(Extent),
						extent4
					};
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickMediumGap:
				case RichTextBorderType.ThickThinMediumGap:
				{
					Extent extent3 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved.LogicalPixels / 2.0, 1);
					return new Extent[2]
					{
						default(Extent),
						extent3
					};
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThinThickLargeGap:
				case RichTextBorderType.ThickThinLargeGap:
				{
					Extent extent2 = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved, 1);
					return new Extent[2]
					{
						default(Extent),
						extent2
					};
				}
				case RichTextBorderType.ThreeDEmboss:
				case RichTextBorderType.ThreeDEngrave:
					return new Extent[3];
				case RichTextBorderType.Double:
				case RichTextBorderType.DoubleWave:
					return new Extent[2]
					{
						default(Extent),
						Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved, 1)
					};
				case RichTextBorderType.Triple:
				{
					Extent extent = Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(SizeResolved, 1);
					return new Extent[3]
					{
						default(Extent),
						extent,
						extent
					};
				}
				}
			}
		}

		internal RichTextBorderType[] LineSegmentTypes
		{
			get
			{
				Extent[] lineSegmentExtents = LineSegmentExtents;
				if (lineSegmentExtents.Length == 0)
				{
					return new RichTextBorderType[0];
				}
				RichTextBorderType[] array = new RichTextBorderType[lineSegmentExtents.Length];
				RichTextBorderType richTextBorderType = RichTextBorderType.Single;
				switch (_borderType)
				{
				case RichTextBorderType.None:
					richTextBorderType = RichTextBorderType.None;
					break;
				case RichTextBorderType.DoubleWave:
					richTextBorderType = RichTextBorderType.Wave;
					break;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = richTextBorderType;
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		internal bool RequiresBackground
		{
			get
			{
				switch (_borderType)
				{
				case RichTextBorderType.None:
				case RichTextBorderType.Single:
				case RichTextBorderType.Thick:
				case RichTextBorderType.ThreeDEmboss:
				case RichTextBorderType.ThreeDEngrave:
				case RichTextBorderType.Outset:
				case RichTextBorderType.Inset:
					return false;
				default:
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal Extent TotalThickness
		{
			get
			{
				if (_spacing.HasValue && _spacing.Value.LogicalPixels > 0.0)
				{
					return Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(_spacing.Value, 1) + BorderThickness;
				}
				return BorderThickness;
			}
		}

		private Extent SizeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (_size.HasValue)
				{
					return Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(_size.Value, (_size.Value.LogicalPixels > 0.0) ? 1 : 0);
				}
				return Extent.RoundToIntegralDevicePixelExtent(_DefaultSize);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("Border, type: ");
			stringBuilder.Append(_borderType);
			if (_size.HasValue)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(", pixels: ");
				stringBuilder.Append(_size.Value.LogicalPixels);
			}
			if (_spacing.HasValue)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(", spacing: ");
				stringBuilder.Append(_spacing.Value.LogicalPixels);
			}
			if (_color != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(", color: ");
				stringBuilder.Append(_color);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal RichTextBorder GetBottomRightComplement()
		{
			RichTextBorderType bottomRightComplement = BottomRightComplement;
			if (bottomRightComplement == _borderType)
			{
				return this;
			}
			RichTextBorder obj = Clone() as RichTextBorder;
			obj._borderType = bottomRightComplement;
			return obj;
		}

		internal ColorInfo[] GetLineSegmentColors(DocumentRootNode rootNode)
		{
			Extent[] lineSegmentExtents = LineSegmentExtents;
			if (lineSegmentExtents.Length == 0)
			{
				return new ColorInfo[0];
			}
			ColorInfo[] array = new ColorInfo[lineSegmentExtents.Length];
			if (_color == null)
			{
				return array;
			}
			RichTextBorderType borderType = _borderType;
			if (borderType == RichTextBorderType.ThreeDEmboss || borderType == RichTextBorderType.ThreeDEngrave)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Color resolvedColor = _color.GetResolvedColor(rootNode, AutomaticColorUsageType.Borders);
				ColorInfo colorInfo;
				ColorInfo colorInfo2;
				ColorInfo colorInfo3;
				if (ColorUtilities.IsColorLight(resolvedColor))
				{
					colorInfo = resolvedColor;
					colorInfo2 = new ColorInfo(resolvedColor, -0.3);
					colorInfo3 = new ColorInfo(resolvedColor, -0.7);
				}
				else
				{
					colorInfo3 = resolvedColor;
					colorInfo = new ColorInfo(resolvedColor, 0.75);
					colorInfo2 = new ColorInfo(colorInfo.GetResolvedColor(rootNode, AutomaticColorUsageType.Borders), -0.3);
				}
				if (_borderType == RichTextBorderType.ThreeDEngrave)
				{
					array[0] = colorInfo3;
					array[1] = colorInfo2;
					array[2] = colorInfo;
				}
				else
				{
					array[0] = colorInfo;
					array[1] = colorInfo2;
					array[2] = colorInfo3;
				}
				return array;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = _color;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal static MergedBorderInfo GetMergedBorderInfo(RichTextBorder border, RichTextBorder nextBorder, DocumentRootNode rootNode, bool isBottomOrRightEdge)
		{
			MergedBorderInfo result = default(MergedBorderInfo);
			if (border == null || nextBorder == null)
			{
				if (border != null)
				{
					return GetMergedBorderInfo(border, border, rootNode, isBottomOrRightEdge);
				}
				if (nextBorder != null)
				{
					return GetMergedBorderInfo(nextBorder, nextBorder, rootNode, isBottomOrRightEdge);
				}
				return result;
			}
			RichTextBorder richTextBorder = border;
			if (border.BorderType != nextBorder.BorderType)
			{
				if (border.CalculateBorderWeight() < nextBorder.CalculateBorderWeight())
				{
					ColorInfo color = border.Color;
					border = nextBorder.Clone() as RichTextBorder;
					border._color = color;
					richTextBorder = nextBorder;
				}
				else
				{
					ColorInfo color2 = nextBorder.Color;
					nextBorder = border.Clone() as RichTextBorder;
					nextBorder._color = color2;
				}
			}
			Extent[] lineSegmentExtents = richTextBorder.LineSegmentExtents;
			Extent[] lineSegmentSpacings = richTextBorder.LineSegmentSpacings;
			RichTextBorderType[] lineSegmentTypes = richTextBorder.LineSegmentTypes;
			switch (lineSegmentExtents.Length)
			{
			case 1:
			{
				ColorInfo[] lineSegmentColors3 = border.GetLineSegmentColors(rootNode);
				ColorInfo[] lineSegmentColors4 = nextBorder.GetLineSegmentColors(rootNode);
				result._firstBorder = border.Clone() as RichTextBorder;
				result._firstBorder.Spacing = null;
				result._firstBorder._color = GetColorToUse(rootNode, border.Color, nextBorder.Color);
				result._areColorsEqual = lineSegmentColors3[0] == lineSegmentColors4[0];
				break;
			}
			case 2:
			{
				if (isBottomOrRightEdge)
				{
					Array.Reverse(lineSegmentExtents);
				}
				ColorInfo colorToUse = GetColorToUse(rootNode, border.Color, nextBorder.Color);
				result._firstBorder = new RichTextBorder
				{
					_borderType = lineSegmentTypes[0],
					_size = lineSegmentExtents[0],
					_color = colorToUse,
					_spacing = lineSegmentSpacings[1]
				};
				result._lastBorder = new RichTextBorder
				{
					_borderType = lineSegmentTypes[1],
					_size = lineSegmentExtents[1],
					_color = colorToUse,
					_spacing = lineSegmentSpacings[1]
				};
				break;
			}
			case 3:
			{
				ColorInfo[] lineSegmentColors = border.GetLineSegmentColors(rootNode);
				ColorInfo[] lineSegmentColors2 = nextBorder.GetLineSegmentColors(rootNode);
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 2;
				if (border._borderType == RichTextBorderType.ThreeDEngrave || border._borderType == RichTextBorderType.ThreeDEmboss)
				{
					if (isBottomOrRightEdge)
					{
						num = 2;
						num2 = 0;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					lineSegmentColors[1] = GetColorToUse(rootNode, lineSegmentColors[1], lineSegmentColors2[1]);
				}
				result._firstBorder = new RichTextBorder
				{
					_borderType = lineSegmentTypes[0],
					_size = lineSegmentExtents[0],
					_color = lineSegmentColors[num],
					_spacing = lineSegmentSpacings[1]
				};
				result._middleBorder = new RichTextBorder
				{
					_borderType = lineSegmentTypes[1],
					_size = lineSegmentExtents[1],
					_color = lineSegmentColors[1],
					_spacing = lineSegmentSpacings[2]
				};
				result._lastBorder = new RichTextBorder
				{
					_borderType = lineSegmentTypes[2],
					_size = lineSegmentExtents[2],
					_color = lineSegmentColors2[num2]
				};
				break;
			}
			}
			if (result._firstBorder != null)
			{
				result._firstBorder.Seal();
			}
			if (result._middleBorder != null)
			{
				result._middleBorder.Seal();
			}
			if (result._lastBorder != null)
			{
				result._lastBorder.Seal();
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double CalculateBorderWeight()
		{
			int num;
			switch (_borderType)
			{
			case RichTextBorderType.None:
				return 0.0;
			case RichTextBorderType.Single:
			case RichTextBorderType.Thick:
			case RichTextBorderType.Double:
				num = (int)_borderType;
				break;
			case RichTextBorderType.Dotted:
			case RichTextBorderType.Dashed:
				return 1.0;
			default:
				num = (int)(_borderType + 2);
				break;
			}
			return (double)num * SizeResolved.Points / 8.0;
		}

		private static int CalculateColorTest1Value(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return color.R + color.B + 2 * color.B;
		}

		private static int CalculateColorTest2Value(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return color.B + 2 * color.B;
		}

		private static ColorInfo GetColorToUse(DocumentRootNode rootNode, ColorInfo candidate1, ColorInfo candidate2)
		{
			if (candidate1 == null)
			{
				return candidate2;
			}
			if (candidate2 == null)
			{
				return candidate1;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color resolvedColor = candidate1.GetResolvedColor(rootNode, AutomaticColorUsageType.Borders);
			System.Windows.Media.Color resolvedColor2 = candidate2.GetResolvedColor(rootNode, AutomaticColorUsageType.Borders);
			if (IsBrighter(resolvedColor, resolvedColor2))
			{
				return candidate1;
			}
			return candidate2;
		}

		private static bool IsBrighter(System.Windows.Media.Color color, System.Windows.Media.Color colorToCompare)
		{
			int num = CalculateColorTest1Value(color);
			int num2 = CalculateColorTest1Value(colorToCompare);
			if (num < num2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (num > num2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			num = CalculateColorTest2Value(color);
			num2 = CalculateColorTest2Value(colorToCompare);
			if (num < num2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (num > num2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (color.G < colorToCompare.G)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (color.G > colorToCompare.G)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal struct MergedBorderInfo
	{
		internal RichTextBorder _firstBorder;

		internal RichTextBorder _middleBorder;

		internal RichTextBorder _lastBorder;

		internal bool _areColorsEqual;
	}
	internal struct MergedBorderKey : IEquatable<MergedBorderKey>
	{
		internal RichTextBorder _border1;

		internal RichTextBorder _border2;

		internal bool _isBottomOrRightEdge;

		internal MergedBorderKey(RichTextBorder border1, RichTextBorder border2, bool isBottomOrRightEdge)
		{
			_border1 = border1;
			_border2 = border2;
			_isBottomOrRightEdge = isBottomOrRightEdge;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _border1.BorderType.GetHashCode() ^ (_border2.BorderType.GetHashCode() << 1) ^ (_isBottomOrRightEdge.GetHashCode() << 2);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is MergedBorderKey)
			{
				return this == (MergedBorderKey)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(MergedBorderKey key1, MergedBorderKey key2)
		{
			if (key1._isBottomOrRightEdge != key2._isBottomOrRightEdge)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info.AreObjectsEqual(key1._border1, key2._border1))
			{
				return RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info.AreObjectsEqual(key1._border2, key2._border2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(MergedBorderKey key1, MergedBorderKey key2)
		{
			return !(key1 == key2);
		}

		public bool Equals(MergedBorderKey other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	internal class RichTextDocumentChange
	{
		internal enum RichTextDocumentChangeType
		{
			Settings,
			NodesAdded,
			NodesRemoved,
			NodesReplaced,
			NodesCollectionChanged,
			NodeContentChanged
		}

		private RichTextDocumentChange _nextChange;

		private RichTextDocumentChangeType _changeType;

		private DocumentOffsetChange _offsetChange;

		public RichTextDocumentChange NextChange => _nextChange;

		public RichTextDocumentChangeType ChangeType => _changeType;

		public DocumentOffsetChange OffsetChange => _offsetChange;

		internal RichTextDocumentChange(RichTextDocumentChangeType changeType, DocumentOffsetChange offsetChange = null)
		{
			_changeType = changeType;
			_offsetChange = offsetChange;
		}

		internal static RichTextDocumentChange CreateHelper(RichTextDocument doc, RichTextDocumentChangeType changeType, int startOffset, int oldOffsetCount, int newOffsetCount)
		{
			return new RichTextDocumentChange(changeType, DocumentOffsetChange.CreateHelper(doc, startOffset, oldOffsetCount, newOffsetCount));
		}

		internal void InitializeNextChange(RichTextDocumentChange nextChange)
		{
			if (_nextChange != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			_nextChange = nextChange;
		}
	}
	public class RichTextDocumentVersion
	{
		private int _version;

		private RichTextDocument _document;

		private int _compatibilityVersion;

		private RichTextDocumentChange _futureChanges;

		private DocumentOffsetChange _futureOffsetChanges;

		internal RichTextDocumentChange FutureChanges => _futureChanges;

		internal DocumentOffsetChange FutureOffsetChanges => _futureOffsetChanges;

		public int Version => _version;

		internal RichTextDocumentVersion(RichTextDocument document)
		{
			_document = document;
			_version = document.VersionId;
			_compatibilityVersion = document.CompatibilityVersionId;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<RichTextDocumentChange> GetChangesHelper(RichTextDocumentChange startInclusive, RichTextDocumentChange endExclusive)
		{
			RichTextDocumentChange change = startInclusive;
			while (change != null)
			{
				yield return change;
				change = change.NextChange;
				if (change == endExclusive)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static IEnumerable<DocumentOffsetChange> GetOffsetChangesHelper(DocumentOffsetChange startInclusive, DocumentOffsetChange endExclusive)
		{
			DocumentOffsetChange change = startInclusive;
			while (change != null)
			{
				yield return change;
				change = change.NextChange;
				if (change == endExclusive)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<RichTextDocumentChange> EnumerateChanges(RichTextDocumentVersion from, RichTextDocumentVersion to)
		{
			from.EnsureCompatibleWith(to);
			if (to.IsPredecessor(from))
			{
				return EnumerateChanges(to, from).Reverse();
			}
			return GetChangesHelper(from._futureChanges, to._futureChanges);
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<DocumentOffsetChange> EnumerateOffsetChanges(RichTextDocumentVersion from, RichTextDocumentVersion to)
		{
			from.EnsureCompatibleWith(to);
			if (to.IsPredecessor(from))
			{
				return EnumerateOffsetChanges(to, from).Reverse();
			}
			return GetOffsetChangesHelper(from._futureOffsetChanges, to._futureOffsetChanges);
		}

		internal void EnsureCompatibleWith(RichTextDocumentVersion other)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(other, "RichTextDocumentVersion");
			if (!IsCompatibleWith(other))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_NotPredecessorOrSuccessorSnapshot"), "RichTextDocumentVersion");
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(RichTextDocumentChange futureChanges)
		{
			if (_futureChanges != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			_futureChanges = futureChanges;
		}

		internal void InitializeOffsetChange(DocumentOffsetChange futureChanges)
		{
			if (_futureOffsetChanges != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			_futureOffsetChanges = futureChanges;
		}

		public bool IsCompatibleWith(RichTextDocumentVersion other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_document == other._document)
			{
				return _compatibilityVersion == other._compatibilityVersion;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsPredecessor(RichTextDocumentVersion successor)
		{
			if (IsCompatibleWith(successor))
			{
				return _version < successor._version;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public struct RichTextFont
	{
		private readonly string _name;

		private readonly ThemeFontType _themeType;

		internal bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				if (_name == null)
				{
					return _themeType != ThemeFontType.NotThemed;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public string Name => _name;

		public ThemeFontType ThemeType => _themeType;

		public RichTextFont(string name)
		{
			_name = name;
			_themeType = ThemeFontType.NotThemed;
		}

		public RichTextFont(ThemeFontType themeType)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyEnumValue(themeType, "themeType");
			_name = null;
			_themeType = themeType;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			RichTextFont? richTextFont = obj as RichTextFont?;
			if (!richTextFont.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RichTextFont value = this;
			RichTextFont? richTextFont2 = richTextFont;
			return value == richTextFont2;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (_name != null)
			{
				return _name.GetHashCode();
			}
			return (int)_themeType;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_name != null)
			{
				return _name;
			}
			return _themeType.ToString();
		}

		public static bool operator ==(RichTextFont f1, RichTextFont f2)
		{
			if (f1._name == f2._name)
			{
				return f1._themeType == f2._themeType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(RichTextFont f1, RichTextFont f2)
		{
			return !(f1 == f2);
		}

		public static implicit operator RichTextFont(string name)
		{
			return new RichTextFont(name);
		}

		public static implicit operator RichTextFont(ThemeFontType themeType)
		{
			return new RichTextFont(themeType);
		}

		private static string GetDefaultFontName(DocumentRootNode rootNode, char c, CharacterType characterType)
		{
			DocumentSettings settings = rootNode.Settings;
			if (settings == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CharacterSettings defaultCharacterSettings = settings.DefaultCharacterSettings;
			if (defaultCharacterSettings == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FontSettings fontSettings = defaultCharacterSettings.FontSettings;
			if (fontSettings == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RichTextFont? font = fontSettings.GetFont(characterType);
			if (!font.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return font.Value.GetResolvedFontName(rootNode, c, characterType, useDefaultSettings: false);
		}

		public string GetResolvedFontName(DocumentRootNode rootNode, CharacterSettings characterSettings, char c)
		{
			CharacterType characterType = SerializationUtilities.GetCharacterType(c, characterSettings);
			return GetResolvedFontName(rootNode, c, characterType, useDefaultSettings: true) ?? GetDefaultFontName(rootNode, c, characterType) ?? "Times New Roman";
		}

		private string GetResolvedFontName(DocumentRootNode rootNode, char c, CharacterType characterType, bool useDefaultSettings)
		{
			if (_name != null)
			{
				return _name;
			}
			RichTextThemeFontSet richTextThemeFontSet;
			switch (_themeType)
			{
			default:
				return null;
			case ThemeFontType.Major:
				richTextThemeFontSet = rootNode.ThemeInfoResolved.FontScheme.MajorFonts;
				break;
			case ThemeFontType.Minor:
				richTextThemeFontSet = rootNode.ThemeInfoResolved.FontScheme.MinorFonts;
				break;
			}
			if (richTextThemeFontSet == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RichTextScriptCodeMappings scriptCodeMappings = richTextThemeFontSet.ScriptCodeMappings;
			if (scriptCodeMappings != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				bool flag3 = false;
				string[] scriptCodes = Utilities.GetScriptCodes(c);
				for (int i = 0; i < scriptCodes.Length; i++)
				{
					string fontName = scriptCodeMappings.GetFontName(scriptCodes[i]);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontName))
					{
						return fontName;
					}
					if (!flag && scriptCodes[i] == "Hani")
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (!flag2 && scriptCodes[i] == "Kana")
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					if (!flag3 && scriptCodes[i] == "Hira")
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					string fontName2 = scriptCodeMappings.GetFontName("Hant");
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontName2))
					{
						return fontName2;
					}
					fontName2 = scriptCodeMappings.GetFontName("Hans");
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontName2))
					{
						return fontName2;
					}
				}
				if (flag2 || flag3)
				{
					string fontName3 = scriptCodeMappings.GetFontName("Jpan");
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontName3))
					{
						return fontName3;
					}
				}
			}
			switch (characterType)
			{
			default:
				return richTextThemeFontSet.LatinFontName;
			case CharacterType.EastAsian:
				if (richTextThemeFontSet.EastAsianFontName != null)
				{
					return richTextThemeFontSet.EastAsianFontName;
				}
				if (('\uff00' <= c && c <= '￮') || richTextThemeFontSet.LatinFontName == null)
				{
					return "SimSun";
				}
				return richTextThemeFontSet.LatinFontName;
			case CharacterType.ComplexScript:
				return richTextThemeFontSet.ComplexScriptFontName ?? richTextThemeFontSet.LatinFontName;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RichTextHitTestInfo
	{
		private LayoutManagerBase _layoutManager;

		private RichTextHitTestResultArea _hitTestArea;

		private ILayoutBlock _layoutBlock;

		private TableCellLayoutNode _tableCellLayoutNode;

		private TableCellNode _tableCellNode;

		internal bool HasHits
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyUpdatesApplied();
				if (Hits != null)
				{
					return Hits.Length != 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

				VerifyUpdatesApplied();

		internal HyperlinkNode HyperlinkNode

		internal HyperlinkLayoutNode HyperlinkLayoutNode

				VerifyUpdatesApplied();
				return _hyperlinkLayoutNode;
			}
			private set
			{
				_hyperlinkLayoutNode = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInTable
		{
			get
			{
				if (TableCellLayoutNode == null && TableRowLayoutNode == null)
				{
					return TableLayoutNode != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInTableCell => TableCellLayoutNode != null;

		internal ILayoutBlock LayoutBlock
		{
			get

				VerifyUpdatesApplied();

				VerifyUpdatesApplied();
				return _paragraphLayoutNode;
			}
			private set

				_paragraphLayoutNode = value;
			}
		}

		internal TableCellNode TableCellNode

			get

				VerifyUpdatesApplied();
				return _tableCellNode;

				_tableCellNode = value;
