		internal RichTextHitTestInfo(LayoutManagerBase layoutManager)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(layoutManager, "layoutManager");
			_layoutManager = layoutManager;
			LayoutPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			TextAreaPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			HitTestArea = RichTextHitTestResultArea.Unknown;
			LayoutBlock = null;
		}

		internal RichTextHitTestInfo Clone()
		{
			return new RichTextHitTestInfo(_layoutManager)
			{
				_hitTestArea = _hitTestArea,
				_layoutBlock = _layoutBlock,
				_tableCellLayoutNode = _tableCellLayoutNode,
				_tableCellNode = _tableCellNode,
				_tableRowLayoutNode = _tableRowLayoutNode,
				_tableRowNode = _tableRowNode,
				_tableLayoutNode = _tableLayoutNode,
				_tableNode = _tableNode,
				_paragraphLayoutNode = _paragraphLayoutNode,
				_hits = _hits,
				_updatesApplied = true,
				_layoutPoint = _layoutPoint,
				_textAreaPoint = _textAreaPoint
			};
		}

		internal int GetDocumentOffset()
		{
			int? documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint = _layoutManager.GetDocumentOffsetFromLayoutPoint(LayoutPoint);
			if (documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint.HasValue)
			{
				return documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint.Value;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal void Update(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint, double verticalViewOffset, bool delayUpdatesUntilAccessed = true)
		{
			Update(layoutPoint, new System.Windows.Point(layoutPoint.X, layoutPoint.Y - verticalViewOffset), delayUpdatesUntilAccessed);
		}

		internal void Update(int documentOffset, double verticalViewOffset, bool delayUpdatesUntilAccessed = true)
		{
			documentOffset = Selection.EnsureDocumentOffsetIsValid(documentOffset, _layoutManager.Document);
			CaretLayoutInfo? caretLayoutFromDocumentOffset = _layoutManager.GetCaretLayoutFromDocumentOffset(documentOffset);
			if (caretLayoutFromDocumentOffset.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Point overallTopLeftCaretPoint = caretLayoutFromDocumentOffset.Value.OverallTopLeftCaretPoint;
				System.Windows.Point layoutPoint = new System.Windows.Point(overallTopLeftCaretPoint.X + 1.0, overallTopLeftCaretPoint.Y + caretLayoutFromDocumentOffset.Value.CaretHeight / 2.0);
				Update(layoutPoint, new System.Windows.Point(layoutPoint.X, layoutPoint.Y - verticalViewOffset), delayUpdatesUntilAccessed);
			}
			else
			{
				Update(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), delayUpdatesUntilAccessed);
			}
		}

		internal void Update(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint, System.Windows.Point textAreaPoint, bool delayUpdatesUntilAccessed = true)
		{
			LayoutPoint = layoutPoint;
			TextAreaPoint = textAreaPoint;
			_updatesApplied = false;
			if (!delayUpdatesUntilAccessed)
			{
				VerifyUpdatesApplied();
			}
		}

		private TableCellLayoutNode GetTableCellLayoutNodeFromLayoutBlock(ILayoutBlock layoutBlock)
		{
			if (LayoutBlock is TableCellLayoutNode)
			{
				return LayoutBlock as TableCellLayoutNode;
			}
			if (LayoutBlock is ParagraphLayoutNode)
			{
				return (LayoutBlock as ParagraphLayoutNode).ParentCell;
			}
			if (LayoutBlock is TableLayoutNode)
			{
				return (LayoutBlock as TableLayoutNode).ParentCell;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private TableRowLayoutNode GetTableRowLayoutNodeFromLayoutBlock(ILayoutBlock layoutBlock)
		{
			if (LayoutBlock is TableRowLayoutNode)
			{
				return LayoutBlock as TableRowLayoutNode;
			}
			if (LayoutBlock is ParagraphLayoutNode)
			{
				return (LayoutBlock as ParagraphLayoutNode).ParentRow;
			}
			if (LayoutBlock is TableLayoutNode)
			{
				return (LayoutBlock as TableLayoutNode).ParentRow;
			}
			if (TableRowNode != null && _layoutManager.NodeMap[TableRowNode] is TableRowLayoutNode result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void UpdateTableLayoutNode()
		{
			if (LayoutBlock is TableLayoutNode)
			{
				TableLayoutNode = LayoutBlock as TableLayoutNode;
			}
			else if (TableCellLayoutNode != null)
			{
				TableLayoutNode = TableCellLayoutNode.ParentTable;
			}
			else if (TableRowLayoutNode != null)
			{
				TableLayoutNode = TableRowLayoutNode.ParentTable;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTableLayoutPropsFromParagraphLayoutNodeIfNecessary()
		{
			if (ParagraphLayoutNode != null)
			{
				if (TableCellLayoutNode == null && ParagraphLayoutNode.ParentCell != null)
				{
					TableCellLayoutNode = ParagraphLayoutNode.ParentCell;
				}
				if (TableRowLayoutNode == null && ParagraphLayoutNode.ParentRow != null)
				{
					TableRowLayoutNode = ParagraphLayoutNode.ParentRow;
				}
				if (TableLayoutNode == null && ParagraphLayoutNode.ParentTable != null)
				{
					TableLayoutNode = ParagraphLayoutNode.ParentTable;
				}
				UpdateTableNodePropsFromTableLayoutNodeProps();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTableNodePropsFromTableLayoutNodeProps()
		{
			TableCellNode = ((TableCellLayoutNode == null) ? null : (TableCellLayoutNode.DocumentNode as TableCellNode));
			TableRowNode = ((TableRowLayoutNode != null) ? (TableRowLayoutNode.DocumentNode as TableRowNode) : ((TableCellNode != null) ? TableCellNode.Row : null));
			TableNode = ((TableCellNode != null) ? TableCellNode.Table : ((TableRowNode != null) ? TableRowNode.Table : null));
		}

		private void VerifyUpdatesApplied()
		{
			if (_updatesApplied || _inVerifyUpdatesApplied)
			{
				return;
			}
			_inVerifyUpdatesApplied = true;
			try
			{
				Hits = _layoutManager.HitTest(LayoutPoint, includeAllOverlappingHits: false);
				if (HasHits)
				{
					RichTextHitTestResult richTextHitTestResult = Hits[0];
					LayoutBlock = richTextHitTestResult.Block;
					TableCellLayoutNode = GetTableCellLayoutNodeFromLayoutBlock(LayoutBlock);
					UpdateTableNodePropsFromTableLayoutNodeProps();
					TableRowLayoutNode = GetTableRowLayoutNodeFromLayoutBlock(LayoutBlock);
					UpdateTableLayoutNode();
					ParagraphLayoutNode = LayoutBlock as ParagraphLayoutNode;
					UpdateTableLayoutPropsFromParagraphLayoutNodeIfNecessary();
					UpdateTableNodePropsFromTableLayoutNodeProps();
					HyperlinkLayoutNode = richTextHitTestResult.LayoutNode as HyperlinkLayoutNode;
					if (HyperlinkLayoutNode != null)
					{
						HyperlinkNode = HyperlinkLayoutNode.DocumentNode as HyperlinkNode;
					}
					HitTestArea = richTextHitTestResult.Area;
				}
				else
				{
					LayoutBlock = null;
					TableCellLayoutNode = null;
					TableCellNode = null;
					TableRowLayoutNode = null;
					TableRowNode = null;
					TableLayoutNode = null;
					TableNode = null;
					ParagraphLayoutNode = null;
					HyperlinkLayoutNode = null;
					HyperlinkNode = null;
					HitTestArea = RichTextHitTestResultArea.Unknown;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_inVerifyUpdatesApplied = false;
			}
			_updatesApplied = true;
		}
	}
	public class RichTextImage
	{
		private byte[] _data;

		private RichTextImageFormat _format;

		public RichTextImageFormat Format => _format;

		private RichTextImage()
		{
		}

		public RichTextImage(byte[] imageData, RichTextImageFormat format)
		{
			_data = (byte[])imageData.Clone();
			_format = format;
		}

		public static RichTextImage CreateFrom(Stream stream, RichTextImageFormat format)
		{
			byte[] data = CoreUtilities.ReadData(stream);
			return new RichTextImage
			{
				_data = data,
				_format = format
			};
		}

		public static RichTextImage CreateFrom(string filePath, RichTextImageFormat? format = null)
		{
			RichTextImage richTextImage = null;
			string error = null;
			if (!format.HasValue)
			{
				format = DeduceFormat(filePath, out error);
				if (!format.HasValue)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(error, "filePath");
				}
			}
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(filePath, FileMode.Open);
			try
			{
				richTextImage = CreateFrom(fileStream, format.Value);
				fileStream.Close();
				return richTextImage;
			}
			finally
			{
				fileStream.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public MemoryStream GetData()
		{
			return new MemoryStream(_data, writable: false);
		}

		public void WriteTo(Stream stream)
		{
			stream.Write(_data, 0, _data.Length);
		}

		internal static RichTextImageFormat? DeduceFormat(string filePath, byte[] data, out string error)
		{
			RichTextImageFormat? result = DeduceFormat(filePath, out error);
			if (result.HasValue)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (data != null)
			{
				return ImageDimensionsHelper.GetImageFormat(new MemoryStream(data));
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static RichTextImageFormat? DeduceFormat(string filePath, out string error)
		{
			error = null;
			RichTextImageFormat? imageFormatFromFilePath = SerializationUtilities.GetImageFormatFromFilePath(filePath);
			if (imageFormatFromFilePath.HasValue)
			{
				return imageFormatFromFilePath;
			}
			error = $"Unsupported file format or unable to determine file format based on extension. File: {filePath}";
			return null;
		}

		internal RichTextSize? GetSize()
		{
			if (_data == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Size? dimensions = ImageDimensionsHelper.GetDimensions(new MemoryStream(_data));
			if (!dimensions.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new RichTextSize(new Extent(dimensions.Value.Width, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels), new Extent(dimensions.Value.Height, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels));
		}
	}
	public enum RichTextImageFormat
	{
		Bmp,
		Dib,
		Emf,
		Gif,
		Jpeg,
		Png,
		Tiff,
		Wmf
	}
	public class RichTextList : RichTextObjectBase
	{
		private class LevelNumberCalculator
		{
			private RichTextList _listInfo;

			private IntMap<int?> _numbers = new IntMap<int?>();

			private ListLevelDefinition[] _levelDefinitions;

			private int _maxLevelEncountered = -1;

			private int[] _cachedStartNumbers;

			private string CalculateNumberText(ListLevelDefinition levelDefinition, int number, Func<int, int> getAncestorNumber)
			{
				string text = levelDefinition.LevelText;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					bool flag = levelDefinition.UseLegalNumberFormat ?? false;
					for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++)
					{
						string text2 = "%" + (1 + i);
						int startIndex = 0;
						while ((startIndex = text.IndexOf(text2, startIndex)) >= 0)
						{
							text = text.Remove(startIndex, text2.Length);
							ListLevelDefinition listLevelDefinition = ((i == levelDefinition.Level) ? levelDefinition : (_levelDefinitions[i] ?? Utilities.GetLevelDefinitionSafe(_listInfo, i)));
							if (listLevelDefinition == null)
							{
								return levelDefinition.ConvertToNumberFormat(number);
							}
							int value = ((i == levelDefinition.Level) ? number : getAncestorNumber(i));
							string text3 = (flag ? value.ToString() : listLevelDefinition.ConvertToNumberFormat(value));
							text = text.Insert(startIndex, text3);
							startIndex += text3.Length;
						}
					}
					return text;
				}
				return null;
			}

			private int GetAncestorNumber(int level)
			{
				ListLevelDefinition listLevelDefinition = _levelDefinitions[level];
				return _numbers[level] ?? listLevelDefinition?.Start ?? 1;
			}

			private int GetStartValue(ListLevelDefinition levelDefinition)
			{
				int level = levelDefinition.Level;
				if (level < 0 || level >= _cachedStartNumbers.Length)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return _cachedStartNumbers[level];
			}

			private void RestartNumbersHelper(int levelEncountered)
			{
				if (_maxLevelEncountered < levelEncountered)
				{
					_maxLevelEncountered = levelEncountered;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i <= _maxLevelEncountered; i++)
				{
					ListLevelDefinition listLevelDefinition = _levelDefinitions[i];
					if (listLevelDefinition != null && levelEncountered < i && levelEncountered <= (listLevelDefinition.RestartAtLevel ?? (i - 1)))
					{
						_numbers[i] = null;
					}
				}
			}

			internal void InitListHelper(RichTextList list)
			{
				if (_listInfo == list)
				{
					return;
				}
				_listInfo = list;
				if (_levelDefinitions == null)
				{
					_levelDefinitions = new ListLevelDefinition[9];
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++)
				{
					_levelDefinitions[i] = list.GetLevelDefinition(i);
				}
				if (_cachedStartNumbers == null)
				{
					_cachedStartNumbers = new int[9];
				}
				int j;
				for (j = 0; j < _cachedStartNumbers.Length; j++)
				{
					ListLevelDefinition listLevelDefinition = _levelDefinitions[j];
					int? num = null;
					if (_listInfo._levelOverrides != null)
					{
						ListLevelOverride listLevelOverride = _listInfo._levelOverrides.FirstOrDefault((ListLevelOverride o) => o.Level == j);
						if (listLevelOverride != null && listLevelOverride.StartOverride.HasValue)
						{
							num = listLevelOverride.StartOverride;
							if (!list._havaCalculationsBeenInitializedAtLeastOnce)
							{
								_numbers[j] = null;
							}
						}
					}
					if (!num.HasValue)
					{
						num = listLevelDefinition.Start;
					}
					_cachedStartNumbers[j] = num ?? 1;
				}
				list._havaCalculationsBeenInitializedAtLeastOnce = true;
			}

			internal void AssignNumber(ParagraphNode item, RichTextListItemInfo itemInfo)
			{
				int listLevel = item.ListLevel;
				ListLevelDefinition levelDefinition = itemInfo._levelDefinition;
				int? num = _numbers[listLevel];
				int num2;
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					num2 = 1 + num.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = GetStartValue(levelDefinition);
					int num3 = listLevel - 1;
					while (num3 >= 0 && !_numbers[num3].HasValue)
					{
						_numbers[num3] = GetStartValue(GetCachedLevelDefinition(num3));
						num3--;
					}
				}
				_numbers[listLevel] = num2;
				itemInfo._itemNumber = num2;
				itemInfo._indicator = CalculateNumberText(levelDefinition, num2, GetAncestorNumber);
				RestartNumbersHelper(listLevel);
			}

			internal ListLevelDefinition GetCachedLevelDefinition(int level)
			{
				return _levelDefinitions[level];
			}
		}

		internal new static class StorageProps
		{
			internal class Info : RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info
			{
				internal static readonly Info Instance = new Info();

				internal override RichTextObjectBase CreateNew()
				{
					return new RichTextList();
				}

				internal override PropertyResolverBase CreateResolver(object target)
				{
					return null;
				}

				protected override void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> map)
				{
					base.Initialize(map);
					StoragePropsInfo.FillMap(new PropInfo[4]
					{
						CreateProp(0, "Id", (RichTextList i) => i._id, (RichTextList i, string v) => i.SetField(ref i._id, v)),
						CreateProp(1, "ListStyleId", (RichTextList i) => i._styleId, (RichTextList i, string v) => i.SetField(ref i._styleId, v)),
						CreateProp(2, "Template", (RichTextList i) => i._template, (RichTextList i, ListTemplate v) => i.SetField(ref i._template, v), null, CopyMethod.CopyClone),
						CreateProp(3, "LevelOverrides", (RichTextList i) => i._levelOverrides, (RichTextList i, ListLevelOverrideCollection v) => i.SetField(ref i._levelOverrides, v), null, CopyMethod.CopyClone)
					}, map);
				}
			}

			internal const int Id = 0;

			internal const int ListStyleId = 1;

			internal const int Template = 2;

			internal const int LevelOverrides = 3;
		}

		private RichTextListCollection _owner;

		private string _id;

		private string _styleId;

		private ListTemplate _template;

		private ListLevelOverrideCollection _levelOverrides;

		private DocumentRootNode _rootNode;

		private List<ParagraphNode> _items = new List<ParagraphNode>();

		private bool _calculationsDirty;

		private bool _havaCalculationsBeenInitializedAtLeastOnce;

		private ListTemplate _templateResolved;

		internal override RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info PropsInfo => StorageProps.Info.Instance;

		public string Id
		{
			get
			{
				return _id;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_id != value)
				{
					if (_owner != null)
					{
						_owner.OnItemIdChanging(this, value);
					}
					string id = _id;
					SetField(ref _id, value, 0);
					if (_owner != null)
					{
						_owner.OnItemIdChanged(this, id);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public ListLevelOverrideCollection LevelOverrides
		{
			get
			{
				if (_levelOverrides == null)
				{
					if (!base.IsSealed)
					{
						SetField(ref _levelOverrides, new ListLevelOverrideCollection());
					}
					else
					{
						_levelOverrides = RichTextSingleton<ListLevelOverrideCollection>.Instance;
					}
				}
				return _levelOverrides;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _levelOverrides, value, 3);
			}
		}

		public string ListStyleId
		{
			get
			{
				return _styleId;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _styleId, value, 1);
			}
		}

		public ListTemplate Template
		{
			get
			{
				return _template;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _template, value, 2);
			}
		}

		internal ListTemplate TemplateResolved => _templateResolved;

		internal RichTextListCollection Owner => _owner;

		internal List<ParagraphNode> Paragraphs => _items;

		internal DocumentRootNode Root => _rootNode;

		private bool HasItems => _items.Count > 0;

		internal override void OnPropertyChanged<T>(int propertyIndex, T oldValue)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(propertyIndex, oldValue);
			if (1 == propertyIndex)
			{
				DirtyListStyle(rehookStyle: true, oldValue as string);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (sender is StyleListenersManager)
			{
				DirtyListStyle(rehookStyle: false, null, dirtyNumbers: true);
			}
			else if ("IsInAtomicOperation" == property)
			{
				VerifyNumbers();
			}
			else
			{
				if (sender != this && _owner == sender)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (extraInfo is PropertyChangeChainContextBase context)
				{
					ListInfosChangeManager manager = ListInfosChangeManager.GetManager(_owner);
					if (manager != null)
					{
						PropertyChangeChainContextBase context2 = AddSelfToPropertyChangeChainHelper(context);
						manager._doc.ProcessPropertyChange(context2);
					}
				}
				if (sender != this || !("ListStyleId" == property))
				{
					ResolveTemplate();
					DirtyNumbers();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IndentListHelper(bool indent, out string error, Extent? amount = null)
		{
			error = null;
			if (!indent && !NodeUtils.HasPositiveIndentation(Utilities.GetLevelDefinitionSafe(this, 0)?.ParagraphSettings))
			{
				return false;
			}
			PrepareListTemplateForModifications();
			ListTemplate templateResolved = TemplateResolved;
			if (templateResolved == null)
			{
				error = $"List {Id} doesn't have a valid list style or list template associated with it.";
				return false;
			}
			foreach (ListLevelDefinition levelDefinition in templateResolved.LevelDefinitions)
			{
				NodeUtils.IndentHelper(_rootNode, levelDefinition.ParagraphSettingsAllocated, indent, amount, false);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void InitializeOwner(RichTextListCollection owner)
		{
			if (_owner != owner)
			{
				if (_owner != null && owner != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Same RichTextList instance cannot exist in two or more ListInfoCollections.");
				}
				_owner = owner;
				ReinitializeRootNode();
			}
		}

		internal void MarkCalculationsClean()
		{
			_calculationsDirty = false;
			_havaCalculationsBeenInitializedAtLeastOnce = false;
		}

		internal void PrepareListTemplateForModifications()
		{
			ListTemplate templateResolved = TemplateResolved;
			if (templateResolved != Template)
			{
				Template = (ListTemplate)templateResolved.Clone();
				ListStyleId = null;
			}
		}

		internal void ReinitializeRootNode()
		{
			DocumentRootNode documentRootNode = ((_owner != null) ? _owner.Owner : null);
			if (_rootNode != documentRootNode)
			{
				if (_rootNode != null)
				{
					UnhookFromStyle();
				}
				_rootNode = documentRootNode;
				if (_rootNode == null)
				{
					ClearItems();
				}
				DirtyListStyle();
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyNumbers()
		{
			if (!_calculationsDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			RichTextDocument richTextDocument = ((_rootNode != null) ? _rootNode.Document : null);
			if (richTextDocument != null && !richTextDocument.ListenForAtomicOperationEnd(this))
			{
				ListTemplate templateResolved = TemplateResolved;
				if (templateResolved == null || Owner == null || !templateResolved.CalculateSharedNumbers(Owner))
				{
					_calculationsDirty = false;
					CalculateNumbersHelper();
				}
			}
		}

		private RichTextListItemInfo AssignItemInfo(ParagraphNode paragraph)
		{
			RichTextListItemInfo richTextListItemInfo = paragraph.ListItemInfoResolved;
			if (richTextListItemInfo == null || richTextListItemInfo.Owner != this)
			{
				paragraph.SetResolvedListItemInfo(richTextListItemInfo = new RichTextListItemInfo(paragraph, this));
			}
			return richTextListItemInfo;
		}

		private void CalculateNumbersHelper()
		{
			if (_rootNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LevelNumberCalculator calculator = new LevelNumberCalculator();
			foreach (ParagraphNode item in _items)
			{
				CalculateNumbersHelperHelper(item, this, calculator);
			}
		}

		internal static void CalculateNumbersHelper(IEnumerable<Tuple<ParagraphNode, RichTextList>> paragraphs)
		{
			LevelNumberCalculator calculator = new LevelNumberCalculator();
			foreach (Tuple<ParagraphNode, RichTextList> paragraph in paragraphs)
			{
				CalculateNumbersHelperHelper(paragraph.Item1, paragraph.Item2, calculator);
			}
		}

		private static void CalculateNumbersHelperHelper(ParagraphNode paragraph, RichTextList richTextList, LevelNumberCalculator calculator)
		{
			calculator.InitListHelper(richTextList);
			RichTextListItemInfo richTextListItemInfo = new RichTextListItemInfo(paragraph, richTextList);
			ListLevelDefinition cachedLevelDefinition = calculator.GetCachedLevelDefinition(paragraph.ListLevel);
			ListLevelDefinition listLevelDefinition = richTextList.LevelOverrides[cachedLevelDefinition]?.LevelDefinition;
			if (listLevelDefinition != null)
			{
				PropertyResolver<ListLevelDefinition> propertyResolver = Utilities.CreateResolver<ListLevelDefinition>();
				propertyResolver.MergeProperties(listLevelDefinition);
				propertyResolver.MergeProperties(cachedLevelDefinition);
				richTextListItemInfo._levelDefinition = propertyResolver.Target as ListLevelDefinition;
			}
			else
			{
				richTextListItemInfo._levelDefinition = cachedLevelDefinition;
			}
			calculator.AssignNumber(paragraph, richTextListItemInfo);
			paragraph.SetResolvedListItemInfo(richTextListItemInfo);
			richTextListItemInfo.DirtyIndicatorSettingsResolved();
		}

		private void ClearItems()
		{
			foreach (ParagraphNode item in _items)
			{
				item.SetResolvedListItemInfo(null);
			}
			_items.Clear();
		}

		private void DirtyListStyle(bool rehookStyle = true, string oldId = null, bool dirtyNumbers = false)
		{
			if (rehookStyle)
			{
				UnhookFromStyle(oldId);
				if (_rootNode != null)
				{
					_rootNode._styleListeners.AddListener(ListStyleId, this, useWeakReference: true);
				}
			}
			if (ResolveTemplate() || dirtyNumbers)
			{
				DirtyNumbers();
			}
		}

		internal void DirtyNumbers()
		{
			_calculationsDirty = true;
			VerifyNumbers();
		}

		private int GetInsertLocation(ParagraphNode paragraph)
		{
			int num = _items.BinarySearch(paragraph, NodeUtils.GetAggregateIndexComparer<ParagraphNode>());
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		private ListLevelDefinition GetLevelDefinition(int listLevel)
		{
			ListLevelDefinition listLevelDefinition = Utilities.GetLevelDefinitionSafe(this, listLevel);
			if (listLevelDefinition == null)
			{
				listLevelDefinition = new ListLevelDefinition
				{
					Level = listLevel
				};
			}
			return listLevelDefinition;
		}

		private bool InsertInListHelper(ParagraphNode paragraph, bool needsToReorder)
		{
			int num = _items.IndexOf(paragraph);
			if (needsToReorder)
			{
				_items.RemoveAt(num);
				num = -1;
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = GetInsertLocation(paragraph);
				_items.Insert(num, paragraph);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ProcessParagraph(ParagraphNode paragraph, bool remove = false)
		{
			remove = remove || _rootNode == null || Id != paragraph.ListId;
			if (remove)
			{
				_items.Remove(paragraph);
				paragraph.SetResolvedListItemInfo(null);
			}
			else
			{
				InsertInListHelper(paragraph, needsToReorder: false);
				AssignItemInfo(paragraph);
			}
			DirtyNumbers();
		}

		private bool ResolveTemplate()
		{
			ListTemplate template = Template;
			if (template == null)
			{
				ListStyle styleResolvedHelper = RichTextStyleCollection.GetStyleResolvedHelper<ListStyle>(_rootNode, ListStyleId);
				if (styleResolvedHelper != null)
				{
					template = styleResolvedHelper.Template;
				}
			}
			if (_templateResolved != template)
			{
				ListTemplate templateResolved = _templateResolved;
				_templateResolved = template;
				templateResolved?.RemoveOwningList(this);
				if (_templateResolved != null)
				{
					_templateResolved.AddOwningList(this);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UnhookFromStyle(string unhookIdOverride = null)
		{
			if (_rootNode != null)
			{
				_rootNode._styleListeners.RemoveListener(unhookIdOverride ?? ListStyleId, this);
			}
		}

		internal static void OnListLevelChanged(ParagraphNode paragraph)
		{
			ReprocessParagraph(paragraph);
		}

		internal static void OnSubtreeAttachedOrDetached(NodeBase parent, NodeCollection childNodes, bool attached)
		{
			OnSubtreeAttachedOrDetached_Helper(parent, null, childNodes, attached);
		}

		internal static void OnSubtreeAttachedOrDetached(NodeBase parent, NodeBase tree, bool attached)
		{
			OnSubtreeAttachedOrDetached_Helper(parent, tree, null, attached);
		}

		private static void OnSubtreeAttachedOrDetached_Helper(NodeBase parent, NodeBase subTree, NodeCollection childNodes, bool attached)
		{
			if (parent == null || (attached && subTree != null && (subTree.ParentCollection == null || subTree.ParentCollection.Parent != parent)))
			{
				return;
			}
			DocumentRootNode rootNode = parent.RootNode;
			if (rootNode == null || !rootNode.HasLists)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<ParagraphNode> enumerable = ((subTree != null) ? NodeUtils.GetDescendantParagraphs(subTree) : childNodes?.SelectMany((NodeBase i) => NodeUtils.GetDescendantParagraphs(i)));
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ParagraphNode item in enumerable)
			{
				if (attached)
				{
					if (item.StyleId != null || (item.Settings != null && item.Settings.ListId != null))
					{
						item.DirtyListInfo(true, true);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					item.ListItemInfoResolved?.Owner.ProcessParagraph(item, remove: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void ReprocessParagraph(ParagraphNode paragraph)
		{
			RichTextListItemInfo listItemInfoResolved = paragraph.ListItemInfoResolved;
			if (listItemInfoResolved != null)
			{
				listItemInfoResolved.Owner.ProcessParagraph(paragraph);
				listItemInfoResolved = paragraph.ListItemInfoResolved;
			}
			if (listItemInfoResolved == null)
			{
				RichTextListCollection.GetRichTextListHelper(paragraph, paragraph.ListId)?.ProcessParagraph(paragraph);
			}
		}
	}
	public class RichTextListItemInfo
	{
		internal RichTextList _owner;

		private ParagraphNode _paragraph;

		internal object _indicator;

		internal ListLevelDefinition _levelDefinition;

		private CharacterSettings _indicatorSettingsResolved;

		internal int _itemNumber;

		public RichTextList Owner => _owner;

		public object Indicator => _indicator;

		public CharacterSettings IndicatorSettingsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureIndicatorSettingsResolved();
				return _indicatorSettingsResolved;
			}
		}

		public ListLevelDefinition LevelDefinition => _levelDefinition;

		public int ItemNumber => _itemNumber;

		internal RichTextListItemInfo(ParagraphNode paragraph, RichTextList owner)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(paragraph);
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(owner);
			_paragraph = paragraph;
			_owner = owner;
		}

		internal RichTextListItemInfo Clone(ParagraphNode newOwnerParagraph, bool copyResolvedIndicatorSettings)
		{
			RichTextListItemInfo richTextListItemInfo = (RichTextListItemInfo)MemberwiseClone();
			richTextListItemInfo._paragraph = newOwnerParagraph;
			if (!copyResolvedIndicatorSettings)
			{
				richTextListItemInfo._indicatorSettingsResolved = null;
			}
			return richTextListItemInfo;
		}

		internal void DirtyIndicatorSettingsResolved()
		{
			if (_indicatorSettingsResolved != null)
			{
				_indicatorSettingsResolved = null;
				_paragraph.NotifyListeners(this, "IndicatorSettingsResolved", null);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureIndicatorSettingsResolved()
		{
			if (_indicatorSettingsResolved != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_paragraph.MarkSettings != null || (_levelDefinition != null && _levelDefinition.NumberSettings != null))
			{
				RichTextObjectBase.PropertyResolver<CharacterSettings> propertyResolver = Utilities.CreateResolver<CharacterSettings>();
				if (_levelDefinition != null)
				{
					Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolver, _levelDefinition.NumberSettings);
				}
				Utilities.MergeHelperEx(propertyResolver, _paragraph.MarkSettings, 29);
				Utilities.MergeHelperEx(propertyResolver, _paragraph.RunSettingsResolved, 29);
				_indicatorSettingsResolved = (CharacterSettings)propertyResolver.ResolveRemainingProperties();
			}
			else
			{
				_indicatorSettingsResolved = _paragraph.RunSettingsResolved;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ListTemplate : RichTextObjectBase
	{
		internal new static class StorageProps
		{
			internal class Info : RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info
			{
				internal static readonly Info Instance = new Info();

				internal override RichTextObjectBase CreateNew()
				{
					return new ListTemplate();
				}

				internal override PropertyResolverBase CreateResolver(object target)
				{
					return new PropertyResolver<ListTemplate>(target as ListTemplate);
				}

				protected override void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> map)
				{
					base.Initialize(map);
					StoragePropsInfo.FillMap(new PropInfo[1] { CreateProp(0, "LevelDefinitions", (ListTemplate i) => i._levelDefinitions, (ListTemplate i, ListLevelDefinitionCollection v) => i.SetField(ref i._levelDefinitions, v), null, CopyMethod.CopyClone) }, map);
				}
			}

			internal const int LevelDefinitions = 0;
		}

		internal const int MAX_LEVELS = 9;

		private ListLevelDefinitionCollection _levelDefinitions;

		private object _owningLists;

		internal override RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info PropsInfo => StorageProps.Info.Instance;

		public ListLevelDefinitionCollection LevelDefinitions
		{
			get
			{
				if (_levelDefinitions == null)
				{
					if (!base.IsSealed)
					{
						SetField(ref _levelDefinitions, new ListLevelDefinitionCollection());
					}
					else
					{
						_levelDefinitions = RichTextSingleton<ListLevelDefinitionCollection>.Instance;
					}
				}
				return _levelDefinitions;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _levelDefinitions, value, 0);
			}
		}

		public ListType ListType
		{
			get
			{
				if (_levelDefinitions == null)
				{
					return ListType.HybridMultiLevel;
				}
				int count = _levelDefinitions.Count;
				switch (count)
				{
				case 0:
					return ListType.HybridMultiLevel;
				case 1:
					return ListType.SingleLevel;
				default:
				{
					bool flag = _levelDefinitions[0].GetResolvedNumberFormat() == NumberFormat.Bullet;
					for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
					{
						if (_levelDefinitions[i].GetResolvedNumberFormat() == NumberFormat.Bullet != flag)
						{
							return ListType.HybridMultiLevel;
						}
					}
					return ListType.MultiLevel;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddOwningList(RichTextList list)
		{
			_owningLists = ListenerListEx.Add(_owningLists, list);
		}

		internal bool CalculateSharedNumbers(RichTextListCollection owningCollection)
		{
			if (ListenerListEx.HasPotentiallyMultipleListeners(_owningLists))
			{
				RichTextList[] array = GetOwningLists(owningCollection)?.ToArray();
				if (array != null && array.Length > 1)
				{
					IEnumerable<RichTextList> enumerable = array.Where((RichTextList i) => i.ListStyleId == null);
					RichTextList.CalculateNumbersHelper(from i in enumerable.SelectMany((RichTextList i) => i.Paragraphs.Select((ParagraphNode x) => Tuple.Create(x, i)))
						orderby i.Item1.GetAggregateIndex()
						select i);
					enumerable.ForEach(delegate(RichTextList i)
					{
						i.MarkCalculationsClean();
					});
					foreach (RichTextList listWithStyle in array.Where((RichTextList i) => i.ListStyleId != null))
					{
						RichTextList.CalculateNumbersHelper(from x in listWithStyle.Paragraphs
							select Tuple.Create(x, listWithStyle) into i
							orderby i.Item1.GetAggregateIndex()
							select i);
						listWithStyle.MarkCalculationsClean();
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IEnumerable<RichTextList> GetOwningLists(RichTextListCollection lists)
		{
			return (from <>h__TransparentIdentifier0 in ListenerListEx.GetListeners(_owningLists)?.Select((object i) => new
				{
					i = i,
					l = (i as RichTextList)
				})
				where <>h__TransparentIdentifier0.l != null && <>h__TransparentIdentifier0.l.Owner == lists
				select <>h__TransparentIdentifier0.l);
		}

		internal void RemoveOwningList(RichTextList list)
		{
			_owningLists = ListenerListEx.Remove(_owningLists, list);
		}
	}

	public class ListLevelOverrideCollection : RichTextObjectCollectionBase<ListLevelOverride>
	{
		internal new static class StorageProps
		{
			internal class Info : RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info
			{
				internal static readonly Info Instance = new Info();

				internal override RichTextObjectBase CreateNew()
				{
					return new ListLevelOverrideCollection();
				}

				internal override PropertyResolverBase CreateResolver(object target)
				{
					return new PropertyResolver<ListLevelOverrideCollection>((ListLevelOverrideCollection)target);
				}

				protected override void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> map)
				{
					base.Initialize(map);
					StoragePropsInfo.FillMap(new PropInfo[0], map);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info PropsInfo => StorageProps.Info.Instance;

		internal ListLevelOverride this[ListLevelDefinition levelDefinition]
		{
			get
			{
				if (levelDefinition == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("levelDefinition");
				}
				int count = base.Count;
				int level = levelDefinition.Level;
				if (level >= 0 && level < count)
				{
					ListLevelOverride listLevelOverride = base[level];
					if (listLevelOverride.Level == level)
					{
						return listLevelOverride;
					}
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					ListLevelOverride listLevelOverride2 = base[i];
					if (listLevelOverride2 != null && listLevelOverride2.Level == levelDefinition.Level)
					{
						return listLevelOverride2;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public struct RichTextMargin : IEquatable<RichTextMargin>
	{
		private Extent _left;

		private Extent _top;

		private Extent _right;

		private Extent _bottom;

		public Extent Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				return _bottom;
			}
			set
			{
				_bottom = value;
			}
		}

		public Extent Left
		{
			get
			{
				return _left;
			}
			set
			{
				_left = value;
			}
		}

		public Extent Right
		{
			get
			{
				return _right;
			}
			set
			{
				_right = value;
			}
		}

		public Extent Top
		{
			get
			{
				return _top;
			}
			set
			{
				_top = value;
			}
		}

		public RichTextMargin(Extent allSides)
		{
			_left = (_top = (_right = (_bottom = allSides)));
		}

		public RichTextMargin(Extent topAndBottom, Extent leftAndRight)
		{
			_top = (_bottom = topAndBottom);
			_left = (_right = leftAndRight);
		}

		public RichTextMargin(Extent top, Extent leftAndRight, Extent bottom)
		{
			_top = top;
			_left = (_right = leftAndRight);
			_bottom = bottom;
		}

		public RichTextMargin(Extent top, Extent right, Extent bottom, Extent left)
		{
			_top = top;
			_left = left;
			_right = right;
			_bottom = bottom;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _left.GetHashCode() ^ _top.GetHashCode() ^ _right.GetHashCode() ^ _bottom.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is RichTextMargin)
			{
				return this == (RichTextMargin)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(RichTextMargin thickness1, RichTextMargin thickness2)
		{
			if (thickness1._left == thickness2._left && thickness1._top == thickness2._top && thickness1._right == thickness2._right)
			{
				return thickness1._bottom == thickness2._bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(RichTextMargin thickness1, RichTextMargin thickness2)
		{
			return !(thickness1 == thickness2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Left: {_left}, Top:{_top}, Right:{_right}, Bottom:{_bottom}";
		}

		public bool Equals(RichTextMargin other)
		{
			return other == this;
		}
	}

		public static void ApplyUnsupportedContentHighlight(RichTextDocument document, RunNode runNode)
		{
			if (document != null)
			{
				CharacterSettings unsupportedContentHighlightSettingsResolved = document.UnsupportedContentHighlightSettingsResolved;
				if (runNode.Settings == null)
				{
					runNode.Settings = (CharacterSettings)unsupportedContentHighlightSettingsResolved.Clone();
				}
				else
				{
					runNode.Settings = Utilities.MergeHelper(unsupportedContentHighlightSettingsResolved, runNode.Settings);
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool AreTableLevelSettingsEqual(TableSettings x, TableSettings y)
		{
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				if (x == null)
				{
					return y == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
			IMap<int, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo> props = x.PropsInfo.Props;
			foreach (int item in props)
			{
				if (7 >= item && props[item] is IRichTextPropInfo richTextPropInfo && !richTextPropInfo.AreValuesEqual(x, y))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Size CalculateRenderSize(System.Windows.Size imageSize, RectOffsets? cropping, RichTextImageTransform transform)
		{
			if (!cropping.HasValue && transform == null)
			{
				return imageSize;
			}
			return Utilities.CreateImageLayoutInfo(imageSize, cropping, transform, calculateSizeOnly: true)._imageCropAreaSize;
		}

		public static RunNode CreateRunNodeForUnsupportedContent(RichTextDocument document, NodeBase runOwner, bool haveCreatedRunInUnsupportedContentRegion)
		{
			runOwner.CustomAttributes.Add(new NodeAttribute
			{
				Name = "IG_IsUnsupported"
			});
			UnsupportedContentHandlingMode unsupportedContentHandlingMode = document?.UnsupportedContentHandlingMode ?? UnsupportedContentHandlingMode.IncludeContent;
			RunNode runNode = new RunNode();
			switch (unsupportedContentHandlingMode)
			{
			default:
				runOwner.ChildNodes.Add(runNode);
				runNode.CustomAttributes.Add(new NodeAttribute
				{
					Name = "HighlightAsUnsupported"
				});
				break;
			case UnsupportedContentHandlingMode.IncludeContent:
				runOwner.ChildNodes.Add(runNode);
				break;
			case UnsupportedContentHandlingMode.IncludeMessage:
				if (!haveCreatedRunInUnsupportedContentRegion)
				{
					runOwner.ChildNodes.Add(new RunNode
					{
						Settings = (CharacterSettings)document.UnsupportedContentHighlightSettingsResolved.Clone(),
						ChildNodes = new NodeCollection
						{
							new TextNode
							{
								Text = document.UnsupportedContentMessageResolved
							}
						}
					});
				}
				break;
			case UnsupportedContentHandlingMode.Exclude:
				break;
			}
			return runNode;
		}

		}

		internal static void GetResolvedCellAndRowBorders(TableBorderSettings rowBorderSettings, TableCellBorderSettings cellBorderSettings, TableCellLocationFlags cellLocation, bool hasCellSpacing, out BlockNodeBorders rowBorders, out BlockNodeBorders cellBorders)
		{
			rowBorders = null;
			cellBorders = null;
			RichTextBorder left;
			RichTextBorder right;
			RichTextBorder top;
			RichTextBorder bottom;
			if (rowBorderSettings != null)
			{
				left = (((cellLocation & TableCellLocationFlags.IsFirstCellInRow) != 0) ? rowBorderSettings.Start : null);
				right = (((cellLocation & TableCellLocationFlags.IsLastCellInRow) != 0) ? rowBorderSettings.End : null);
				top = (((cellLocation & TableCellLocationFlags.IsTopCellInColumn) != 0) ? rowBorderSettings.Top : null);
				bottom = (((cellLocation & TableCellLocationFlags.IsBottomCellInColumn) != 0) ? rowBorderSettings.Bottom : null);
				rowBorders = new BlockNodeBorders(bottom, left, right, top);
			}
			if (cellBorderSettings != null)
			{
				left = cellBorderSettings.Start;
				right = cellBorderSettings.End;
				top = cellBorderSettings.Top;
				bottom = cellBorderSettings.Bottom;
			}
			else
			{
				left = (right = (top = (bottom = null)));
			}
			if (left != null || right != null || top != null || bottom != null)
			{
				cellBorders = new BlockNodeBorders(bottom, left, right, top);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void PerformActionBypassingUndoHistory(RichTextDocument document, Action callback)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(document);
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(callback);
			document.BeginAtomicOperation(null, null, updatingTableGridColumns: true);
			try
			{
				callback();
			}
			finally
			{
				document.EndAtomicOperation();
			}
		}

		public static void ResetMatchingProperties<T>(T source, T target) where T : RichTextObjectBase
		{
			if (source == null || target == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IMap<int, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo> props = source.PropsInfo.Props;
			foreach (int item in props)
			{
				if (!(props[item] is IRichTextPropInfo { CopyMethod: not StoragePropsInfo.CopyMethod.None } richTextPropInfo))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (richTextPropInfo.AreValuesEqual(source, target))
				{
					richTextPropInfo.SetValueWithNotifications(target, richTextPropInfo.DefaultValue);
				}
				else
				{
					if (richTextPropInfo.CopyMethod != StoragePropsInfo.CopyMethod.CopyClone)
					{
						continue;
					}
					RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase = source.PropsInfo.GetValue<object>(source, item) as RichTextObjectBase;
					RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase2 = target.PropsInfo.GetValue<object>(target, item) as RichTextObjectBase;
					if (richTextObjectBase != null && richTextObjectBase2 != null)
					{
						ResetMatchingProperties(richTextObjectBase, richTextObjectBase2);
						if (Utilities.HasAllDefaultProperties(richTextObjectBase2))
						{
							richTextPropInfo.SetValueWithNotifications(target, richTextPropInfo.DefaultValue);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ResetOverridingProperties<T>(T source, T target) where T : RichTextObjectBase
		{
			if (source == null || target == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IMap<int, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo> props = source.PropsInfo.Props;
			foreach (int item in props)
			{
				if (!(props[item] is IRichTextPropInfo { CopyMethod: not StoragePropsInfo.CopyMethod.None } richTextPropInfo) || richTextPropInfo.HasDefaultValue(source))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (richTextPropInfo.CopyMethod == StoragePropsInfo.CopyMethod.CopyClone)
				{
					RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase = source.PropsInfo.GetValue<object>(source, item) as RichTextObjectBase;
					RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase2 = target.PropsInfo.GetValue<object>(target, item) as RichTextObjectBase;
					if (richTextObjectBase != null && richTextObjectBase2 != null)
					{
						ResetOverridingProperties(richTextObjectBase, richTextObjectBase2);
						if (Utilities.HasAllDefaultProperties(richTextObjectBase2))
						{
							richTextPropInfo.SetValueWithNotifications(target, richTextPropInfo.DefaultValue);
						}
						continue;
					}
				}
				richTextPropInfo.SetValueWithNotifications(target, richTextPropInfo.DefaultValue);
			}
		}

		public static void ResetCharacterStyleCharacterSettingsResolvedFromBasedOn(CharacterStyle style)
		{
			RichTextStyleCollection owner = style.Owner;
			if (owner != null)
			{
				DocumentRootNode owner2 = owner.Owner;
				ResetMatchingProperties((((owner[style.BasedOn] ?? RichTextSingleton<CharacterStyle>.Instance).GetResolvedHelper(includeDefaults: true, owner2) as CharacterStyle) ?? RichTextSingleton<CharacterStyle>.Instance).CharacterSettings, style.CharacterSettings);
			}
		}

		public static void ResetParagraphStyleCharacterSettingsResolvedFromBasedOn(ParagraphStyle style)
		{
			RichTextStyleCollection owner = style.Owner;
			if (owner != null)
			{
				DocumentRootNode owner2 = owner.Owner;
				ResetMatchingProperties((((owner[style.BasedOn] ?? RichTextSingleton<ParagraphStyle>.Instance).GetResolvedHelper(includeDefaults: true, owner2) as ParagraphStyle) ?? RichTextSingleton<ParagraphStyle>.Instance).CharacterSettings, style.CharacterSettings);
			}
		}

		public static void ResetParagraphStyleParagraphSettingsResolvedFromBasedOn(ParagraphStyle style)
		{
			RichTextStyleCollection owner = style.Owner;
			if (owner != null)
			{
				DocumentRootNode owner2 = owner.Owner;
				ResetMatchingProperties((((owner[style.BasedOn] ?? RichTextSingleton<ParagraphStyle>.Instance).GetResolvedHelper(includeDefaults: true, owner2) as ParagraphStyle) ?? RichTextSingleton<ParagraphStyle>.Instance).ParagraphSettings, style.ParagraphSettings);
			}
		}

		public static void ResetParagraphNodeSettingsResolvedFromStyle(ParagraphNode node)
		{
			ParagraphNode.ResolveParagraphSettingsHelper(node, node.StyleId, null, out var settingsResolved, out var _);
			ResetMatchingProperties(settingsResolved, node.Settings);
		}

		public static void ResetRunNodeSettingsResolvedFromStyle(RunNode node)
		{
			ResetMatchingProperties(RunNode.ResolveRunSettingsHelper(node.Parent, node.GetAncestorNode<ParagraphNode>(), node.StyleId, null), node.Settings);
		}

	public struct RichTextPoint : IEquatable<RichTextPoint>
	{
		private Extent _x;

		private Extent _y;

		public Extent X
		{
			get
			{
				return _x;
			}
			set
			{
				_x = value;
			}
		}

		public Extent Y
		{
			get
			{
				return _y;
			}
			set
			{
				_y = value;
			}
		}

		public RichTextPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
			: this(new Extent(point.X, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels), new Extent(point.Y, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels))
		{
		}

		public RichTextPoint(Extent x, Extent y)
		{
			_x = x;
			_y = y;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _x.GetHashCode() ^ _y.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is RichTextPoint)
			{
				return this == (RichTextPoint)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(RichTextPoint point1, RichTextPoint point2)
		{
			if (point1._x == point2._x)
			{
				return point1._y == point2._y;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(RichTextPoint point1, RichTextPoint point2)
		{
			return !(point1 == point2);
		}

		public static implicit operator RichTextPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return new RichTextPoint(point);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"X: {_x}, Y: {_y}";
		}

		public bool Equals(RichTextPoint other)
		{
			return other == this;
		}
	}
	public class RichTextScriptCodeMappings : RichTextObjectBase, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string>>, IEnumerable
	{
		internal new static class StorageProps
		{
			internal class Info : RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info
			{
				internal static readonly Info Instance = new Info();

				internal override RichTextObjectBase CreateNew()
				{
					return new RichTextScriptCodeMappings();
				}

				internal override PropertyResolverBase CreateResolver(object target)
				{
					return new PropertyResolver<RichTextScriptCodeMappings>(target as RichTextScriptCodeMappings);
				}

				protected override void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> map)
				{
					base.Initialize(map);
					StoragePropsInfo.FillMap(new PropInfo[1] { CreateProp(0, "ScriptCodeToFontNameMap", (RichTextScriptCodeMappings i) => i._scriptCodeToFontNameMap, delegate
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}, CopyMethod.None) }, map);
				}

				private RichTextTypedPropInfo<TValue> CreateProp<TValue>(int prop, string name, Func<RichTextScriptCodeMappings, TValue> getter, Func<RichTextScriptCodeMappings, TValue, bool> setter, CopyMethod copyMethod = CopyMethod.CopyValue)
				{
					return CreateProp(prop, name, getter, setter, default(TValue), copyMethod);
				}
			}

			internal const int ScriptCodeToFontNameMap = 0;
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _scriptCodeToFontNameMap;

		internal override RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info PropsInfo => StorageProps.Info.Instance;

		public RichTextScriptCodeMappings()
		{
			_scriptCodeToFontNameMap = new Dictionary<string, string>();
		}

		public IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<string, string>> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _scriptCodeToFontNameMap.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _scriptCodeToFontNameMap.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public override RichTextObjectBase Clone()
		{
			RichTextScriptCodeMappings richTextScriptCodeMappings = (RichTextScriptCodeMappings)base.Clone();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> item in _scriptCodeToFontNameMap)
			{
				richTextScriptCodeMappings._scriptCodeToFontNameMap.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
			}
			return richTextScriptCodeMappings;
		}

		public void Add(string scriptCode, string fontName)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyNotNull(scriptCode, "scriptCode");
			Utilities.VerifyNotNull(fontName, "fontName");
			if (scriptCode == "Zyyy")
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_CommonScriptCodeInvalid"));
			}
			_scriptCodeToFontNameMap[scriptCode] = fontName;
		}

		public string GetFontName(string scriptCode)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyNotNull(scriptCode, "scriptCode");
			_scriptCodeToFontNameMap.TryGetValue(scriptCode, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public bool Remove(string scriptCode)
		{
			Utilities.VerifyNotNull(scriptCode, "scriptCode");
			return _scriptCodeToFontNameMap.Remove(scriptCode);
		}
	}

		public ThemeColorDefinition GetColorDefinition(ThemeColorType colorType)
		{
			return colorType switch
			{
				ThemeColorType.Light1 => Light1, 
				ThemeColorType.Dark1 => Dark1, 
				ThemeColorType.Light2 => Light2, 
				ThemeColorType.Dark2 => Dark2, 
				ThemeColorType.Accent1 => Accent1, 
				ThemeColorType.Accent2 => Accent2, 
				ThemeColorType.Accent3 => Accent3, 
				ThemeColorType.Accent4 => Accent4, 
				ThemeColorType.Accent5 => Accent5, 
				ThemeColorType.Accent6 => Accent6, 
				ThemeColorType.Hyperlink => Hyperlink, 
				ThemeColorType.FollowedHyperlink => FollowedHyperlink, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public void SetColorDefinition(ThemeColorType colorType, ThemeColorDefinition colorDefinition)
		{
			switch (colorType)
			{
			case ThemeColorType.Light1:
				Light1 = colorDefinition;
				break;
			case ThemeColorType.Dark1:
				Dark1 = colorDefinition;
				break;
			case ThemeColorType.Light2:
				Light2 = colorDefinition;
				break;
			case ThemeColorType.Dark2:
				Dark2 = colorDefinition;
				break;
			case ThemeColorType.Accent1:
				Accent1 = colorDefinition;
				break;
			case ThemeColorType.Accent2:
				Accent2 = colorDefinition;
				break;
			case ThemeColorType.Accent3:
				Accent3 = colorDefinition;
				break;
			case ThemeColorType.Accent4:
				Accent4 = colorDefinition;
				break;
			case ThemeColorType.Accent5:
				Accent5 = colorDefinition;
				break;
			case ThemeColorType.Accent6:
				Accent6 = colorDefinition;
				break;
			case ThemeColorType.Hyperlink:
				Hyperlink = colorDefinition;
				break;
			case ThemeColorType.FollowedHyperlink:
				FollowedHyperlink = colorDefinition;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ThemeColorDefinition
	{
		private readonly System.Windows.Media.Color? _color;

		private readonly SystemColorType? _systemColorType;

		public System.Windows.Media.Color? Color => _color;

		public SystemColorType? SystemColorType => _systemColorType;

		public ThemeColorDefinition(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			_color = color;
			_systemColorType = null;
		}

		public ThemeColorDefinition(SystemColorType systemColorType)
		{
			_color = null;
			_systemColorType = systemColorType;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ThemeColorDefinition themeColorDefinition))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_color == themeColorDefinition._color)
			{
				return _systemColorType == themeColorDefinition._systemColorType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (_color.HasValue)
			{
				return _color.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (_systemColorType.HasValue)
			{
				return _systemColorType.GetHashCode();
			}
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_color.HasValue)
			{
				return _color.ToString();
			}
			if (_systemColorType.HasValue)
			{
				return _systemColorType.ToString();
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		public static implicit operator ThemeColorDefinition(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return new ThemeColorDefinition(color);
		}

		public static implicit operator ThemeColorDefinition(SystemColorType systemColorType)
		{
			return new ThemeColorDefinition(systemColorType);
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color GetResolvedColor()
		{
			if (_color.HasValue)
			{
				return _color.Value;
			}
			if (_systemColorType.HasValue)
			{
				return ColorUtilities.ColorFromSystemColorType(_systemColorType.Value);
			}
			return Colors.Black;
		}
	}

	public class AreaSpecificSettings : RichTextSettingsBase
	{
		internal new static class StorageProps
		{
			internal class Info : RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info
			{
				internal static readonly Info Instance = new Info();

				private static int _AreaCount;

				internal static int AreaCount => _AreaCount;

				internal override RichTextObjectBase CreateNew()
				{
					return new AreaSpecificSettings();
				}

				internal override PropertyResolverBase CreateResolver(object target)
				{
					return new PropertyResolver<AreaSpecificSettings>(target as AreaSpecificSettings);
				}

				protected override void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> map)
				{
					base.Initialize(map);
					List<PropInfo> list = new List<PropInfo>();
					int num = 0;
					foreach (TableArea area in Enum.GetValues(typeof(TableArea)))
					{
						num++;
						list.Add(CreateProp((int)area, area.ToString(), (AreaSpecificSettings i) => i.GetAreaSettings(area), (AreaSpecificSettings i, TableAreaSettings v) => i.SetField(ref i._tableAreaSettings[(uint)area], v), null, CopyMethod.CopyClone));
					}
					_AreaCount = num;
					StoragePropsInfo.FillMap(list.ToArray(), map);
				}
			}
		}

		private TableAreaSettings[] _tableAreaSettings = new TableAreaSettings[StorageProps.Info.AreaCount];

		internal override RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info PropsInfo => StorageProps.Info.Instance;

		internal string ConvertToNumberFormat(int value)
		{
			switch ((_numberFormat != null) ? _numberFormat.Type : NumberFormatType.Bullet)
			{
			case NumberFormatType.DecimalEnclosedFullstop:
				if (value < 21)
				{
					return $"{value}.";
				}
				break;
			case NumberFormatType.DecimalEnclosedParen:
				if (value < 21)
				{
					return $"({value})";
				}
				break;
			case NumberFormatType.Bullet:
				return _levelText;
			case NumberFormatType.LowerLetter:
				return ConvertToLetter(value, upper: false);
			case NumberFormatType.UpperLetter:
				return ConvertToLetter(value, upper: true);
			case NumberFormatType.LowerRoman:
				return ConvertToRoman(value, upper: false);
			case NumberFormatType.UpperRoman:
				return ConvertToRoman(value, upper: true);
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		internal NumberFormat GetResolvedNumberFormat()
		{
			return NumberFormat ?? DefaultNumberFormat;
		}

		private static string ConvertToLetter(int value, bool upper)
		{
			if (value <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int num = value - 1;
			ushort num2 = (ushort)(num % 26);
			ushort c = (ushort)((upper ? 65 : 97) + num2);
			int count = num / 26 % 30 + 1;
			return new string((char)c, count);
		}

		private static string ConvertToRoman(int value, bool upper)
		{
			if (value <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			value = (value - 1) % 32767 + 1;
			string[] array = (upper ? numeralsUpper : numeralsLower);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				int num = values[i];
				string value2 = array[i];
				while (value >= num)
				{
					value -= num;
					stringBuilder.Append(value2);
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

						CreateProp(0, "RotationAngle", (RichTextImageTransform i) => i._rotationAngle, (RichTextImageTransform i, float v) => i.SetField(ref i._rotationAngle, v), 0f, CopyMethod.CopyValue, 0f),
						CreateProp(2, "FlipHorizontally", (RichTextImageTransform i) => i._flipHorizontally, (RichTextImageTransform i, bool v) => i.SetField(ref i._flipHorizontally, v), resolutionDefault: false, CopyMethod.CopyValue, defaultValue: false),
						CreateProp(3, "FlipVertically", (RichTextImageTransform i) => i._flipVertically, (RichTextImageTransform i, bool v) => i.SetField(ref i._flipVertically, v), resolutionDefault: false, CopyMethod.CopyValue, defaultValue: false)

	[TypeConverter(typeof(TableExtentConverter))]
	public struct TableExtent : IEquatable<TableExtent>
	{
		private double _value;

		private TableExtentUnitType _unitType;

		internal static readonly Extent AutoCellWidth = new Extent(100.0, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);

		internal static readonly Extent AutoCellMarginWidth = new Extent(2.0, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);

		public TableExtentUnitType UnitType => _unitType;

		public double Value => _value;

		internal TableExtentUnitType UnitTypeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (_value != 0.0 || _unitType == TableExtentUnitType.None)
				{
					return _unitType;
				}
				return TableExtentUnitType.Auto;
			}
		}

		public TableExtent(Extent extent)
			: this(extent.Twips, TableExtentUnitType.Twip)
		{
		}

		public TableExtent(int twips)
			: this(twips, TableExtentUnitType.Twip)
		{
		}

		public TableExtent(double value, TableExtentUnitType unitType)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(value, "value");
			_value = value;
			_unitType = unitType;
			switch (unitType)
			{
			case TableExtentUnitType.Auto:
			case TableExtentUnitType.Twip:
			case TableExtentUnitType.None:
			case TableExtentUnitType.Percent:
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("unitType");
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _value.GetHashCode() ^ _unitType.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is TableExtent)
			{
				return this == (TableExtent)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(TableExtent width1, TableExtent width2)
		{
			if (width1._unitType != width2._unitType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TableExtentUnitType unitType = width1._unitType;
			if (unitType == TableExtentUnitType.Auto || unitType == TableExtentUnitType.None)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return width1._value == width2._value;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(TableExtent width1, TableExtent width2)
		{
			return !(width1 == width2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			TableExtentUnitType unitType = _unitType;
			if (unitType == TableExtentUnitType.Auto || unitType == TableExtentUnitType.None)
			{
				return _unitType.ToString();
			}
			return $"{_value} {_unitType}";
		}

		public Extent? GetExtent()
		{
			if (_unitType != TableExtentUnitType.Twip)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new Extent(_value);
		}

		internal Extent GetExtent(Extent totalAvailable, Extent autoValue)
		{
			return _unitType switch
			{
				TableExtentUnitType.Twip => new Extent(_value), 
				TableExtentUnitType.Percent => new Extent(totalAvailable.Emus * _value / 100.0, ExtentUnitType.Emus), 
				_ => autoValue, 
			};
		}

		internal string Serialize(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			if (_unitType == TableExtentUnitType.None)
			{
				return "none";
			}
			if (_unitType == TableExtentUnitType.Auto && _value == 0.0)
			{
				return "auto";
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(_value.ToString(formatProvider));
			switch (_unitType)
			{
			case TableExtentUnitType.Percent:
				stringBuilder.Append("%");
				break;
			case TableExtentUnitType.Auto:
				stringBuilder.Append("auto");
				break;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string value, IFormatProvider formatProvider, out TableExtent result)
		{
			result = new TableExtent(0.0, TableExtentUnitType.None);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
			if (value == "none")
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (value == "auto")
			{
				result = new TableExtent(0.0, TableExtentUnitType.Auto);
				return true;
			}
			NumberStyles style = NumberStyles.AllowLeadingWhite | NumberStyles.AllowTrailingWhite | NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint | NumberStyles.AllowThousands;
			double result2;
			if (value[value.Length - 1] == '%')
			{
				if (double.TryParse(value.Substring(0, value.Length - 1), style, formatProvider, out result2))
				{
					result = new TableExtent(result2, TableExtentUnitType.Percent);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (value.Contains("auto"))
			{
				string[] array = value.Split(new string[1] { "auto" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				if (array.Length != 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (double.TryParse(array[0], style, formatProvider, out result2))
				{
					result = new TableExtent(result2, TableExtentUnitType.Auto);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(value, style, formatProvider, out result2))
			{
				result = new TableExtent(result2, TableExtentUnitType.Twip);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

	public struct VersionedDocumentOffset : IEquatable<VersionedDocumentOffset>, IComparable<VersionedDocumentOffset>
	{
		private RichTextDocumentVersion _version;

		private int _offset;

		public int Offset => _offset;

		public RichTextDocumentVersion Version => _version;

		public VersionedDocumentOffset(RichTextDocument document, int offset)
			: this(document.CurrentVersion, offset)
		{
		}

		public VersionedDocumentOffset(RichTextDocumentVersion version, int offset)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(version, "version");
			_version = version;
			_offset = offset;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			VersionedDocumentOffset? versionedDocumentOffset = obj as VersionedDocumentOffset?;
			if (!versionedDocumentOffset.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == versionedDocumentOffset.Value;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (_version.GetHashCode() << 16) ^ _offset;
		}

		public VersionedDocumentOffset Add(int value)
		{
			return new VersionedDocumentOffset(_version, _offset + value);
		}

		public int Difference(VersionedDocumentOffset other)
		{
			return Difference(this, other);
		}

		public VersionedDocumentOffset Subtract(int value)
		{
			return Add(-value);
		}

		public VersionedDocumentOffset TranslateTo(RichTextDocumentVersion target, OffsetTrackingMode mode)
		{
			if (_version == null)
			{
				return new VersionedDocumentOffset(target, _offset);
			}
			_version.EnsureCompatibleWith(target);
			bool flag = target.IsPredecessor(_version);
			int num = _offset;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (DocumentOffsetChange item in RichTextDocumentVersion.EnumerateOffsetChanges(_version, target))
			{
				DocumentSpan oldSpan = item.OldSpan;
				DocumentSpan newSpan = item.NewSpan;
				if (oldSpan == newSpan)
				{
					if (num < oldSpan.Start || num > oldSpan.End)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (mode == OffsetTrackingMode.Negative)
					{
						if (num == oldSpan.Start)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					else if (num == oldSpan.End)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				int num3 = num;
				int num4 = 0;
				if (flag)
				{
					int offset;
					if (newSpan.Length > 0)
					{
						offset = newSpan.Offset;
						if (newSpan.Contains(num) || newSpan.End == num)
						{
							num = offset;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						offset = oldSpan.Offset;
						num4 = num2;
					}
					if (num < offset + num4)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (num == offset + num4)
					{
						if (mode == OffsetTrackingMode.Positive)
						{
							num = offset + num4 + oldSpan.Length;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num -= item.LengthDelta;
						num = Math.Min(num, item.OldLength - 1);
						num = Math.Max(num, 0);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int offset2;
					if (oldSpan.Length > 0)
					{
						offset2 = oldSpan.Offset;
						num4 = num2;
						if (oldSpan.Contains(num - num4) || oldSpan.End == num - num4)
						{
							num = offset2 + num4;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						offset2 = newSpan.Offset;
					}
					if (num < offset2 + num4)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (num == offset2 + num4)
					{
						if (mode == OffsetTrackingMode.Positive)
						{
							num = offset2 + num4 + newSpan.Length;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num += item.LengthDelta;
						num = Math.Min(num, item.NewLength);
						num = Math.Max(num, 0);
					}
				}
				num2 += num - num3;
			}
			return new VersionedDocumentOffset(target, num);
		}

		private static int Difference(VersionedDocumentOffset x, VersionedDocumentOffset y)
		{
			x.VerifyVersionsMatch(y);
			return x._offset - y._offset;
		}

		private void VerifyVersionsMatch(VersionedDocumentOffset other)
		{
			if (_version != other._version)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Versions do not match.");
			}
		}

		public static implicit operator int(VersionedDocumentOffset item)
		{
			return item._offset;
		}

		public static VersionedDocumentOffset operator +(VersionedDocumentOffset offset, int value)
		{
			return offset.Add(value);
		}

		public static VersionedDocumentOffset operator -(VersionedDocumentOffset offset, int value)
		{
			return offset.Add(-value);
		}

		public static int operator -(VersionedDocumentOffset x, VersionedDocumentOffset y)
		{
			return Difference(x, y);
		}

		public static bool operator >(VersionedDocumentOffset x, VersionedDocumentOffset y)
		{
			return ((IComparable<VersionedDocumentOffset>)x).CompareTo(y) > 0;
		}

		public static bool operator <(VersionedDocumentOffset x, VersionedDocumentOffset y)
		{
			return ((IComparable<VersionedDocumentOffset>)x).CompareTo(y) < 0;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(VersionedDocumentOffset x, VersionedDocumentOffset y)
		{
			if (x._offset == y._offset)
			{
				return x._version == y._version;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(VersionedDocumentOffset x, VersionedDocumentOffset y)
		{
			return !(x == y);
		}

		public bool Equals(VersionedDocumentOffset other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}

		int IComparable<VersionedDocumentOffset>.CompareTo(VersionedDocumentOffset other)
		{
			VerifyVersionsMatch(other);
			return _offset.CompareTo(other._offset);
		}
	}

		public VersionedDocumentSpan TranslateTo(RichTextDocumentVersion target, SpanTrackingMode mode)
		{
			OffsetTrackingMode mode2;
			OffsetTrackingMode mode3;
			switch (mode)
			{
			case SpanTrackingMode.EdgePositive:
				mode2 = OffsetTrackingMode.Positive;
				mode3 = OffsetTrackingMode.Positive;
				break;
			case SpanTrackingMode.EdgeNegative:
				mode2 = OffsetTrackingMode.Negative;
				mode3 = OffsetTrackingMode.Negative;
				break;
			case SpanTrackingMode.EdgeExclusive:
				mode2 = OffsetTrackingMode.Positive;
				mode3 = OffsetTrackingMode.Negative;
				break;
			case SpanTrackingMode.EdgeInclusive:
				mode2 = OffsetTrackingMode.Negative;
				mode3 = OffsetTrackingMode.Positive;
				break;
			default:
				CoreUtilities.ValidateEnum("mode", typeof(SpanTrackingMode), mode);
				return Empty;
			}
			VersionedDocumentOffset versionedDocumentOffset = Start.TranslateTo(target, mode2);
			VersionedDocumentOffset versionedDocumentOffset2 = End.TranslateTo(target, mode3);
			return new VersionedDocumentSpan(target, versionedDocumentOffset.Offset, Math.Max(versionedDocumentOffset2.Offset - versionedDocumentOffset.Offset, 0));
		}

		private void VerifyVersionsMatch(VersionedDocumentSpan other)
		{
			if (_version != other._version)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Versions do not match.");
			}
		}

		{
			return this == other;
		}

	public class RichTextClipboardOperationCancelEventArgs : ClipboardOperationCancelEventArgs
	{
		public DocumentRootNode RootNode { get; private set; }

		public Selection Selection { get; private set; }

		public SerializationProviderBase SerializationProviderUsedToLoadData { get; private set; }

		internal bool BreakParagraphAfterContent { get; private set; }

		internal IDataObject DataObjectUsedToDeserialize { get; private set; }

		public RichTextClipboardOperationCancelEventArgs(Selection selection, ClipboardOperation clipboardOperation, IDataObject dataObject, Exception exception = null)
			: base(clipboardOperation, dataObject, exception)
		{
			Selection = selection;
			if (base.ClipboardOperation == ClipboardOperation.Paste)
			{
				RefreshRootNode();
			}
			else
			{
				RootNode = Selection.Document.RootNode;
			}
		}

		public void RefreshRootNode()
		{
			if (base.ClipboardOperation != ClipboardOperation.Paste)
			{
				return;
			}
			BreakParagraphAfterContent = false;
			base.Exception = null;
			RootNode = null;
			SerializationProviderUsedToLoadData = null;
			DataObjectUsedToDeserialize = base.DataObject;
			if (DataObjectUsedToDeserialize == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string clipboardFormats = Selection.SelectionOwner.ClipboardFormats;
			Dictionary<string, List<SerializationProviderBase>> serializationProvidersByFormat = Selection.GetSerializationProvidersByFormat();
			if (clipboardFormats == null || serializationProvidersByFormat == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<Exception> list = new List<Exception>();
			LoadFromClipboardResult loadFromClipboardResult = null;
			bool hasMultipleSelections = Selection.Ranges.Count > 1;
			string[] array = clipboardFormats.Split(',');
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				if (!DataObjectUsedToDeserialize.GetDataPresent(text) || !serializationProvidersByFormat.TryGetValue(text, out var value))
				{
					continue;
				}
				object obj = DataObjectUsedToDeserialize.GetData(text);
				_ = Selection.SelectionOwner.AcceptsReturn;
				if (!Selection.SelectionOwner.AcceptsReturn)
				{
					switch (text)
					{
					case "UnicodeText":
					case "System.String":
					case "Text":
						if (obj is string)
						{
							char[] anyOf = new char[2] { '\r', '\n' };
							int num = obj.ToString().IndexOfAny(anyOf);
							if (-1 != num)
							{
								obj = obj.ToString().Substring(0, num);
							}
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				LoadFromClipboardContext loadFromClipboardContext = new LoadFromClipboardContext(obj, text, hasMultipleSelections);
				loadFromClipboardContext.AssociatedDocument = Selection.Document;
				foreach (SerializationProviderBase item2 in value)
				{
					try
					{
						loadFromClipboardResult = item2.LoadFromClipboard(loadFromClipboardContext);
						if (loadFromClipboardResult != null)
						{
							SerializationProviderUsedToLoadData = item2;
							break;
						}
					}
					catch (Exception item)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				if (SerializationProviderUsedToLoadData != null)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (loadFromClipboardResult == null)
			{
				RootNode = null;
				BreakParagraphAfterContent = false;
			}
			else
			{
				RootNode = loadFromClipboardResult.RootNode;
				BreakParagraphAfterContent = loadFromClipboardResult.BreakParagraphAfterContent;
			}
			base.Exception = Utilities.GetExceptionFromMultiple(list);
		}
	}

		internal static Extent[] CalcColumnExtents(Extent totalExtent, int columnCount, Extent? fixedColumnWidth = null)
		{
			double twips = totalExtent.Twips;
			double num = Math.Floor(twips / (double)columnCount);
			double num2 = twips - num * (double)columnCount;
			Extent[] array = new Extent[columnCount];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				double num3 = num;
				if (num2 >= 1.0)
				{
					num3 += 1.0;
					num2 -= 1.0;
				}
				Extent extent = new Extent(num3);
				if (fixedColumnWidth.HasValue && fixedColumnWidth.Value <= extent)
				{
					extent = fixedColumnWidth.Value;
				}
				array[i] = extent;
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal static Extent CalculateIndentation(DocumentRootNode rootNode, ParagraphSettings settings, bool indent, Extent currentIndentation, Extent? amountParam)
		{
			if (amountParam.HasValue)
			{
				return amountParam.Value;
			}
			Extent extent = (rootNode?.Settings)?.DefaultTabStop ?? RichTextDocument.DefaultTabStopExtent;
			if (settings.HasTabStops)
			{
				TabStopCollection tabStops = settings.TabStops;
				int count = tabStops.Count;
				Extent? extent2 = null;
				int num = ((!indent) ? (count - 1) : 0);
				int num2 = (indent ? count : (-1));
				int num3 = (indent ? 1 : (-1));
				for (int i = num; i != num2; i += num3)
				{
					TabStop tabStop = tabStops[i];
					TabStopAlignment alignment = tabStop.Alignment;
					if (alignment == TabStopAlignment.Bar || alignment == TabStopAlignment.Clear)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (indent)
					{
						if (tabStop.Position > currentIndentation)
						{
							extent2 = tabStop.Position;
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (tabStop.Position < currentIndentation)
					{
						extent2 = tabStop.Position;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (extent2.HasValue)
				{
					return Extent.Min(extent, indent ? (extent2.Value - currentIndentation) : (currentIndentation - extent2.Value));
				}
			}
			return extent;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<NodeBase> CreateNodesFromText(string text)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if ('\r' == c || '\n' == c)
				{
					if (num < i)
					{
						yield return CreateTextNode(text, num, i - num);
					}
					if ('\r' == c && 1 + i < text.Length && '\n' == text[1 + i])
					{
						i++;
					}
					yield return new BreakNode();
					num = 1 + i;
				}
			}
			if (num < text.Length)
			{
				yield return CreateTextNode(text, num, text.Length - num);
			}
		}

		internal static RunNode CreateRunNode(string text, CharacterSettings settings = null, RunNode fallbackSettingsRun = null)
		{
			RunNode runNode = new RunNode();
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = fallbackSettingsRun?.Settings;
			if (characterSettings != null)
			{
				settings = Utilities.MergeHelper(settings, characterSettings);
			}
			runNode.Settings = settings;

				runNode.StyleId = fallbackSettingsRun.StyleId;
			}
			runNode.ChildNodes.AddRange(CreateNodesFromText(text));
			return runNode;
		}
