		internal static TableNode CreateTable(int columns, int rows, TableExtentBehavior extentBehavior = TableExtentBehavior.FixedWidthColumns, Extent? pageExtent = null, Extent? fixedColumnWidth = null, ParagraphNode insertionPointParagraph = null)
		{
			if (columns <= 0 || rows <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (fixedColumnWidth.HasValue && fixedColumnWidth.Value.Emus == 0.0)
			{
				fixedColumnWidth = null;
			}
			DocumentRootNode root = insertionPointParagraph?.RootNode;
			ParagraphNode newParagraph = ((insertionPointParagraph != null) ? insertionPointParagraph.Clone(copyId: false, copyChildNodes: false, copyListItemInfo: true, root) : new ParagraphNode());
			CharacterSettings charSettings = null;
			ParagraphIndentationSettings paragraphIndentationSettings = null;
			if (insertionPointParagraph != null)
			{
				charSettings = insertionPointParagraph.RunSettingsResolved;
				paragraphIndentationSettings = insertionPointParagraph.SettingsResolved.Indentation;
			}
			TableNode tableNode = new TableNode();
			if (!pageExtent.HasValue)
			{
				pageExtent = ((extentBehavior != TableExtentBehavior.FixedWidthColumns || !fixedColumnWidth.HasValue || !(fixedColumnWidth.Value.LogicalPixels > 0.0)) ? new Extent?(new Extent(6.5, ExtentUnitType.Inches)) : new Extent?(new Extent(fixedColumnWidth.Value.LogicalPixels * (double)columns, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels)));
			}
			Extent[] array = null;
			TableExtent[] array2 = null;
			TableExtent? preferredWidth = null;
			switch (extentBehavior)
			{
			case TableExtentBehavior.FixedWidthColumns:
			{
				array = CalcColumnExtents(pageExtent.Value, columns, fixedColumnWidth);
				array2 = array.Select((Extent i) => new TableExtent(fixedColumnWidth ?? i)).ToArray();
				Extent extent = default(Extent);
				Extent[] array3 = array;
				foreach (Extent extent2 in array3)
				{
					extent += extent2;
				}
				preferredWidth = new TableExtent(extent.Twips, TableExtentUnitType.Twip);
				break;
			}
			case TableExtentBehavior.FitColumnsToContent:
			{
				Extent colExtent2 = new Extent(222.0);
				array = (from i in Enumerable.Range(0, columns)
					select colExtent2).ToArray();
				preferredWidth = new TableExtent(0.0, TableExtentUnitType.Auto);
				array2 = CreateArray(preferredWidth.Value, columns);
				break;
			}
			case TableExtentBehavior.FitTableToWindow:
			{
				Extent colExtent = new Extent(222.0);
				array = (from i in Enumerable.Range(0, columns)
					select colExtent).ToArray();
				preferredWidth = new TableExtent(100.0, TableExtentUnitType.Percent);
				array2 = CreateArray(new TableExtent(100.0 / (double)columns, TableExtentUnitType.Percent), columns);
				break;
			}
			}
			TableSettings uniqueSettings = tableNode.GetUniqueSettings();
			if (paragraphIndentationSettings != null)
			{
				if (paragraphIndentationSettings.Start.HasValue)
				{
					FontSpecification font = FontSpecificationCache.Instance.GetFont(insertionPointParagraph.Document, new MetricsProvider(), charSettings);
					uniqueSettings.TableIndent = paragraphIndentationSettings.Start.Value.CalculateExtent(font);
				}
				paragraphIndentationSettings = new ParagraphIndentationSettings
				{
					Start = new Indentation(new Extent(0.0)),
					FirstLine = new FirstLineIndentation(new Indentation(new Extent(0.0)), isHanging: false)
				};
				if (newParagraph.Settings == null)
				{
					newParagraph.Settings = new ParagraphSettings
					{
						Indentation = paragraphIndentationSettings
					};
				}
				else
				{
					newParagraph.Settings.Indentation = paragraphIndentationSettings;
				}
			}
			uniqueSettings.PreferredWidth = preferredWidth;
			uniqueSettings.AreaUsageFlags = TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.FirstColumn | TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.FirstRow | TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.HorizontalBanding;
			tableNode.Settings = uniqueSettings;
			TableColumnsCollection tableColumnsCollection = new TableColumnsCollection();
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < columns; num2++)
			{
				tableColumnsCollection.Add(new TableColumn
				{
					Width = array[num2]
				});
			}
			tableNode.Grid = new TableGrid
			{
				Columns = tableColumnsCollection
			};
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < rows; num3++)
			{
				TableRowNode tableRowNode = new TableRowNode();
				for (int num4 = 0; num4 < columns; num4++)
				{
					TableCellNode tableCellNode = CreateCellWithParagraph(delegate
					{
						ParagraphNode result = newParagraph;
						newParagraph = newParagraph.Clone(copyId: false, copyChildNodes: false, copyListItemInfo: true, root);
						return result;
					});
					if (array2 != null)
					{
						TableCellSettings uniqueSettings2 = tableCellNode.GetUniqueSettings();
						uniqueSettings2.PreferredWidth = array2[num4];
						tableCellNode.Settings = uniqueSettings2;
					}
					tableRowNode.ChildNodes.Add(tableCellNode);
				}
				tableNode.ChildNodes.Add(tableRowNode);
			}
			return tableNode;
		}

					{

					}
					if (num2 > 0 && (richTextList != nodeAtDocumentOffset.ListItemInfoResolved.Owner || num != nodeAtDocumentOffset.ListItemInfoResolved.LevelDefinition.Level))
					{
						return false;

					{
						richTextList = nodeAtDocumentOffset.ListItemInfoResolved.Owner;
						num = nodeAtDocumentOffset.ListItemInfoResolved.LevelDefinition.Level;
					}
					num2++;
				}
				matchingList = richTextList;
				matchingLevel = num;
			}
			return num2 > 0;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<RichTextStyleBase> FilterStylesUsedByContent(NodeBase contentTree, IEnumerable<RichTextStyleBase> styles)

				{

					{
						string value = info.GetValue<string>(allNode, info._styleIdProp);
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && dictionary.ContainsKey(value) && dictionary.TryGetValue(value, out var value2) && info._styleType.IsInstanceOfType(value2))
						{
							set.Add(value2);
						}
					}
				}

			}

		}

		private static string CalcSeperationText(NodeBase prev, NodeBase next, TextConsumer tc)
		{
			ParagraphNode paragraphNode = prev as ParagraphNode;
			ParagraphNode paragraphNode2 = next as ParagraphNode;
			if (paragraphNode != null && paragraphNode2 != null && Utilities.AreIdsEqual(paragraphNode.ListId, paragraphNode2.ListId) && paragraphNode.IsListItemResolved && paragraphNode2.IsListItemResolved)
			{
				return tc._formatOptions.ListItemSeparationText;
			}
			return tc._formatOptions.ParagraphSeparationText;
		}

		internal static void GetBlockOwnerText(NodeBase owner, TextConsumer tc)
		{
			NodeBase nodeBase = null;
			foreach (NodeBase item in tc.GetChildNodesOfInterest(owner))
			{
				if (nodeBase != null)
				{
					tc.Append(CalcSeperationText(nodeBase, item, tc), nodeBase);
				}
				DocumentSpan? nodePortionOfInterest = tc.GetNodePortionOfInterest(item);
				if (item is ParagraphNode paragraphNode)
				{
					if (paragraphNode.IsListItemResolved && (!nodePortionOfInterest.HasValue || nodePortionOfInterest.Value.Contains(GetNodePrefixSpan(paragraphNode))))
					{
						RichTextListItemInfo listItemInfoResolved = paragraphNode.ListItemInfoResolved;
						tc.Append(Utilities.GetPlainTextListIndicator(listItemInfoResolved, listItemInfoResolved.Owner.Root), paragraphNode);
						tc.Append(" ", paragraphNode);
					}
					GetRunOwnerText(paragraphNode, tc);
				}
				else if (item is TableNode table)
				{
					GetTableText(table, tc);
				}
				nodeBase = item;
			}
		}

		internal static NodeBase GetChildNodeAtOffsetForInsert(NodeBase parent, ref int offset)
		{
			int num = offset;
			NodeBase nodeBase = parent.GetNodeAtOffset(ref offset, descend: false);
			if (nodeBase != parent)
			{
				if (nodeBase == null && num == parent.AggregateOffsetCount)
				{
					NodeBase lastChild = parent.LastChild;
					if (lastChild != null)
					{
						offset = lastChild.AggregateOffsetCount;
						nodeBase = lastChild;
					}
				}
				if (!(nodeBase is TextNode))
				{
					NodeBase previousSibling;
					if (offset == 0 && (previousSibling = nodeBase.GetPreviousSibling()) is TextNode)
					{
						nodeBase = previousSibling;
						offset = nodeBase.AggregateOffsetCount;
					}
					else if (offset == nodeBase.AggregateOffsetCount && (previousSibling = nodeBase.GetNextSibling()) is TextNode)
					{
						nodeBase = previousSibling;
						offset = 0;
					}
				}
				return nodeBase;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static NodeBase GetMatchingInsertTextNodeHelper(ref RunNode run, ref int offset, InsertTextOptions insertTextOptions, bool disallowPrependOrAppendToFieldContent = true)
		{
			if (disallowPrependOrAppendToFieldContent && insertTextOptions != null && !insertTextOptions._mergeWithExistingSettings)
			{
				disallowPrependOrAppendToFieldContent = false;
			}
			if (IsRunNodeSuitable(run, insertTextOptions) && (!disallowPrependOrAppendToFieldContent || !IsAtHyperlinkBoundary(run, offset)))
			{
				return GetChildNodeAtOffsetForInsert(run, ref offset);
			}
			if (offset == 0)
			{
				RunNode siblingRun = GetSiblingRun(run, next: false);
				if (siblingRun != null && IsRunNodeSuitable(siblingRun, insertTextOptions) && (!disallowPrependOrAppendToFieldContent || !SpansIntoHyperlink(run, siblingRun)))
				{
					NodeBase lastChild = siblingRun.LastChild;
					if (lastChild != null)
					{
						run = siblingRun;
						offset = lastChild.AggregateOffsetCount;
						return lastChild;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (offset == run.AggregateOffsetCount)
			{
				RunNode siblingRun2 = GetSiblingRun(run, next: true);
				if (siblingRun2 != null && IsRunNodeSuitable(siblingRun2, insertTextOptions) && (!disallowPrependOrAppendToFieldContent || !SpansIntoHyperlink(run, siblingRun2)))
				{
					NodeBase firstChild = siblingRun2.FirstChild;
					if (firstChild != null)
					{
						run = siblingRun2;
						offset = 0;
						return firstChild;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static Extent GetNextFontSize(Extent currentSize, bool grow, Extent? extentDelta)
		{
			float[] array = g_fontSizeIncreaseMatrics;
			double val;
			if (extentDelta.HasValue)
			{
				val = currentSize.Points + extentDelta.Value.Points * (double)(grow ? 1 : (-1));
				val = Math.Max(array[1], Math.Min(array[array.Length - 1], val));
			}
			else
			{
				double points = currentSize.Points;
				val = points;
				for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i += 2)
				{
					float num = array[i];
					if (grow ? (points < (double)num) : (points <= (double)num))
					{
						float num2 = array[i - 1];
						float num3 = ((i > 2) ? array[i - 2] : 1f);
						float num4 = array[i];
						val = points + (double)(grow ? num2 : (0f - num2));
						val = Math.Max(num3, Math.Min(num4, val));
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return new Extent(val, ExtentUnitType.Points);
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<NodeBase> GetNodesIntersectingSpan(RichTextDocument doc, DocumentSpan documentSpan, bool skipDescendantsOfFullyContainedNodes, out NodeSpanCache nodeSpanCache, NodeBase subtree = null, Func<NodeBase, bool> traverseDescendants = null)
		{
			NodeSpanCache spanCache = new NodeSpanCache(doc);
			Func<NodeBase, bool> traverseDescendants2 = traverseDescendants;
			if (skipDescendantsOfFullyContainedNodes)
			{
				traverseDescendants2 = (NodeBase n) => !documentSpan.Contains(spanCache.GetCachedSpan(n)) && (traverseDescendants == null || traverseDescendants(n));
			}
			List<NodeBase> list = GetNodesIntersectingSpan(doc, documentSpan, null, traverseDescendants2).ToList();
			spanCache.CacheSpans(list);
			nodeSpanCache = spanCache;
			return list;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<NodeBase> GetNodesIntersectingSpan(RichTextDocument doc, DocumentSpan documentSpan, NodeBase subtree = null, Func<NodeBase, bool> traverseDescendants = null, bool fullyContainedNodesOnly = false)
		{
			DocumentRootNode rootNode = doc.RootNode;
			if (rootNode != null)
			{
				DocumentSpan? documentSpan2;
				if (subtree != null)
				{
					DocumentSpan nodeSpan = doc.GetNodeSpan(subtree);
					documentSpan2 = documentSpan.Intersection(nodeSpan);
				}
				else
				{
					documentSpan2 = new DocumentSpan(0, doc.RootNode.AggregateOffsetCount).Overlap(documentSpan);
				}
				if (documentSpan2.HasValue)
				{
					DocumentSpan span = documentSpan2.Value;
					NodeBase tree = subtree ?? rootNode;
					NodeBase nodeAtDocumentOffset = doc.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset(span.Start);
					NodeBase stopAtPathLeafNode = ((span.Length == 0) ? nodeAtDocumentOffset : doc.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset(span.Start + Math.Max(0, span.Length - 1)));
					Func<NodeBase, bool> filter = (fullyContainedNodesOnly ? ((Func<NodeBase, bool>)((NodeBase n) => span.Contains(doc.GetNodeSpan(n)))) : ((Func<NodeBase, bool>)((NodeBase n) => span.OverlapsWith(doc.GetNodeSpan(n)))));
					return new NodeEnumerable(tree, traverseDescendants, nodeAtDocumentOffset, stopAtPathLeafNode, filter);
				}
			}
			return new CoreUtilities.EmptyEnumerable<NodeBase>();
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<TNode> GetNodesIntersectingSpan<TNode>(RichTextDocument doc, DocumentSpan span, bool fullyContainedNodesOnly = false) where TNode : NodeBase
		{
			return Filter<TNode>(GetNodesIntersectingSpan(doc, span, null, null, fullyContainedNodesOnly));
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<TNode> GetChildNodesIntersectingSpan<TNode>(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase parent, DocumentSpan documentSpan, bool fullyContainedNodesOnly = false) where TNode : NodeBase
		{
			return from n in GetNodesIntersectingSpan(doc, documentSpan, parent, (NodeBase n) => n.Parent != parent, fullyContainedNodesOnly).OfType<TNode>()
				where n.Parent == parent
				select n;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<NodeBase> GetParagraphsAndRunsIntersectingSpan(RichTextDocument doc, DocumentSpan span, out NodeSpanCache nodeSpanCache, NodeBase subtree = null)
		{
			return from ii in GetNodesIntersectingSpan(doc, span, skipDescendantsOfFullyContainedNodes: false, out nodeSpanCache, null, (NodeBase n) => !(n is RunNode))
				where ii is RunNode || ii is ParagraphNode
				select ii;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<ParagraphNode> GetParagraphsIntersectingSpan(RichTextDocument doc, DocumentSpan span)
		{

		}

		internal static List<NodeBase> GetPathToRoot(NodeBase root, NodeBase n, bool includeRoot)
		{
			if (n != null)
			{
				List<NodeBase> list = new List<NodeBase>();
				while (n != null)
				{
					if ((root == null) ? (n.Parent == null) : (n == root))
					{
						if (includeRoot || root == null)
						{
							list.Add(n);
						}
						list.Reverse();
						return list;
					}
					list.Add(n);
					n = n.Parent;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<RunNode> GetRunNodesIntersectingSpan(RichTextDocument doc, DocumentSpan span, out NodeSpanCache nodeSpanCache, NodeBase subtree = null)

		}

		internal static DocumentSpan GetRelativeSpan(NodeBase n, DocumentSpan documentSpan)
		{
			return new DocumentSpan(documentSpan.Start - n.GetDocumentOffset(), documentSpan.Length, allowNegativeOffset: true);
		}

		internal static string GetRunOwnerText(NodeBase owner, PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions)
		{
			StringBuilderTextConsumer stringBuilderTextConsumer = new StringBuilderTextConsumer();
			GetRunOwnerText(owner, stringBuilderTextConsumer);
			return stringBuilderTextConsumer._sb.ToString();
		}

		internal static void GetRunOwnerText(NodeBase owner, TextConsumer tc)
		{
			foreach (NodeBase item in tc.GetChildNodesOfInterest(owner))
			{
				if (item is RunNode run)
				{
					GetRunText(run, tc);
				}
				else
				{
					GetRunOwnerText(item, tc);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static string GetRunStyleId(HyperlinkNode hyperlink)
		{
			return GetChildNodes<RunNode>(hyperlink).FirstOrDefault()?.StyleId;
		}

		internal static void GetRunText(RunNode run, TextConsumer tc)
		{
			foreach (NodeBase item in tc.GetChildNodesOfInterest(run))
			{
				DocumentSpan? nodePortionOfInterest = tc.GetNodePortionOfInterest(item);
				string text = GetTextFromTextualNode(item, tc._formatOptions, nodePortionOfInterest);
				if (text == null && item is ImageNode)
				{
					text = tc._formatOptions.ImagePlaceholderText;
				}
				tc.Append(text, item, nodePortionOfInterest.HasValue ? nodePortionOfInterest.Value.Start : 0);
			}
		}

		internal static RunNode GetSiblingRun(RunNode run, bool next, bool crossHyperlinks = true)
		{
			RunNode runNode = run.GetSibling(next) as RunNode;
			if (runNode != null)
			{
				return runNode;
			}
			if (crossHyperlinks)
			{
				ParagraphNode ancestorNode = run.GetAncestorNode<ParagraphNode>();
				if (ancestorNode != null)
				{
					int relativeOffsetOfDescendant = GetRelativeOffsetOfDescendant(ancestorNode, run);
					if (relativeOffsetOfDescendant >= 0)
					{
						relativeOffsetOfDescendant = ((!next) ? (relativeOffsetOfDescendant - 1) : (relativeOffsetOfDescendant + run.AggregateOffsetCount));
						runNode = ancestorNode.GetNodeAtOffset(ref relativeOffsetOfDescendant)?.GetAncestorNode<RunNode>();
						if (runNode == run)
						{
							runNode = null;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return runNode;
		}

		internal static string GetSubstringSafe(string text, DocumentSpan span)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DocumentSpan? documentSpan = new DocumentSpan(0, text.Length).Intersection(span);
			if (documentSpan.HasValue)
			{
				span = documentSpan.Value;
				return text.Substring(span.Start, span.Length);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal static void GetTableText(TableNode table, TextConsumer tc)
		{
			PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions = tc._formatOptions;
			TableRowNode tableRowNode = null;
			foreach (TableRowNode item in tc.GetChildNodesOfInterest(table).OfType<TableRowNode>())
			{
				if (tableRowNode != null)
				{
					tc.Append(formatOptions.TableRowSeparationText, tableRowNode);
				}
				TableCellNode tableCellNode = null;
				foreach (TableCellNode item2 in tc.GetChildNodesOfInterest(item).OfType<TableCellNode>())
				{
					if (tableCellNode != null)
					{
						tc.Append(formatOptions.TableCellSeparationText, tableCellNode);
					}
					GetBlockOwnerText(item2, tc);
					tableCellNode = item2;
				}
				tableRowNode = item;
			}
		}

		internal static string GetTextFromTextualNode(NodeBase n, PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions, DocumentSpan? nodeSpan = null)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (n is TextNode textNode)
			{
				text = textNode.Text;
				if (nodeSpan.HasValue)
				{
					text = GetSubstringSafe(text, nodeSpan.Value);
				}
			}
			else if (n is BreakNode && (!nodeSpan.HasValue || (nodeSpan.Value.Offset == 0 && nodeSpan.Value.Length >= 1)))
			{
				text = formatOptions.NewLineText;
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal static bool HasPositiveIndentation(ParagraphSettings settings)
		{
			ParagraphIndentationSettings paragraphIndentationSettings = settings?.Indentation;
			if (paragraphIndentationSettings != null)
			{
				Indentation? start = paragraphIndentationSettings.Start;
				if (start.HasValue)
				{
					Extent? extent = start.Value.Extent;
					if (extent.HasValue && extent.Value.Emus > 0.0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool HaveSameAncestor<TAncestor>(NodeBase x, NodeBase y) where TAncestor : NodeBase
		{
			TAncestor ancestorNode = x.GetAncestorNode<TAncestor>();
			if (ancestorNode != null)
			{
				return ancestorNode == y.GetAncestorNode<TAncestor>();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IndentHelper(DocumentRootNode rootNode, ParagraphSettings settings, bool indent, Extent? amountParam = null, bool? firstLineOnly = null, DocumentSpan? selection = null, ParagraphNode paragraphNode = null)
		{
			ParagraphIndentationSettings paragraphIndentationSettings = ((settings.Indentation != null) ? ((ParagraphIndentationSettings)settings.Indentation.Clone()) : new ParagraphIndentationSettings());
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (!firstLineOnly.HasValue && selection.HasValue && paragraphNode != null)
			{
				if (!paragraphNode.GetDocumentSpan().Contains(selection.Value))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				flag2 = selection.Value.Length == 0 && IsDocumentOffsetAtNodeStart(rootNode.Document, paragraphNode, selection.Value.Start);
			}
			FirstLineIndentation? firstLine = paragraphIndentationSettings.FirstLine;
			Indentation? start = paragraphIndentationSettings.Start;
			if ((firstLineOnly.HasValue && !firstLineOnly.Value) || flag)
			{
				Extent amount = CalculateIndentation(rootNode, settings, indent, paragraphIndentationSettings.Start.HasValue ? paragraphIndentationSettings.Start.Value.CalculateExtent(null) : Utilities.ZeroExtent, amountParam);
				paragraphIndentationSettings.Start = (indent ? Utilities.Add(paragraphIndentationSettings.Start, amount, allowNegative: false) : Utilities.Subtract(paragraphIndentationSettings.Start, amount, allowNegative: false));
			}
			else
			{
				Extent extent = Utilities.ResolveExtent(paragraphIndentationSettings.Start);
				Extent extent2 = Utilities.ResolveExtent(paragraphIndentationSettings.FirstLine);
				Extent extent3 = ((paragraphIndentationSettings.FirstLine.HasValue && paragraphIndentationSettings.FirstLine.Value.IsHanging) ? (extent - extent2) : (extent + extent2));
				Extent extent4 = CalculateIndentation(rootNode, settings, indent, extent3, amountParam);
				if (firstLineOnly.HasValue && firstLineOnly.Value)
				{
					extent3 = (indent ? Utilities.Add(extent3, extent4) : Utilities.Subtract(extent3, extent4));
				}
				else if (indent)
				{
					if (flag2 && extent3 < Utilities.ZeroExtent)
					{
						extent3 = Utilities.ZeroExtent;
					}
					else if (flag2 && extent3 < extent + extent4)
					{
						extent3 = extent4 + Utilities.Min(extent, extent3);
					}
					else
					{
						paragraphIndentationSettings.Start = Utilities.Add(paragraphIndentationSettings.Start, extent4, allowNegative: false);
						if (!flag2 && extent3 > extent && (!selection.HasValue || paragraphNode == null || !selection.Value.Contains(paragraphNode.GetChildNodesDocumentSpan())))
						{
							extent3 = Utilities.Max(extent, extent - extent4);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (flag2 && extent3 > extent)
				{
					extent3 = Utilities.Max(extent, extent3 - extent4);
				}
				else
				{
					if (Utilities.ZeroExtent == extent)
					{
						extent3 = extent;
					}
					paragraphIndentationSettings.Start = Utilities.Subtract(paragraphIndentationSettings.Start, extent4, allowNegative: false);
				}
				extent3 = Utilities.Max(extent3, Utilities.ZeroExtent);
				bool flag3 = extent3 < extent;
				extent3 = (flag3 ? (extent - extent3) : (extent3 - extent));
				paragraphIndentationSettings.FirstLine = new FirstLineIndentation(new Indentation(extent3), flag3);
			}
			bool flag4 = false;
			Extent zeroExtent = Utilities.ZeroExtent;
			if (Utilities.Add(start, zeroExtent) != Utilities.Add(paragraphIndentationSettings.Start, zeroExtent))
			{
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (!flag4)
			{
				FirstLineIndentation firstLineIndentation = firstLine ?? new FirstLineIndentation(new Indentation(zeroExtent), isHanging: false);
				FirstLineIndentation firstLineIndentation2 = paragraphIndentationSettings.FirstLine ?? new FirstLineIndentation(new Indentation(zeroExtent), isHanging: false);
				if (firstLineIndentation.IsHanging != firstLineIndentation2.IsHanging || Utilities.Add(firstLineIndentation.Indentation, zeroExtent) != Utilities.Add(firstLineIndentation2.Indentation, zeroExtent))
				{
					flag4 = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				settings.Indentation = paragraphIndentationSettings;
			}
			return flag4;
		}

		internal static bool InsertTextHelper(TextNode textNode, int offset, string text)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				if (RequiresMultipleRunContentNodes(text))
				{
					return SplitAndInsert(textNode, offset, CreateNodesFromText(text));
				}
				return textNode.InsertText(offset, text);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsAncestor(NodeBase ancestorToTest, NodeBase n)
		{
			while (n != null)
			{
				if (ancestorToTest == n)
				{
					return true;
				}
				n = n.Parent;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsAtHyperlinkBoundary(RunNode run, int relativeOffset)
		{
			HyperlinkNode ancestorNode = run.GetAncestorNode<HyperlinkNode>();
			if (ancestorNode != null)
			{
				int num = MapOffset(run, relativeOffset, ancestorNode);
				if (num == 0 || num == ancestorNode.AggregateOffsetCount)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsDocumentOffsetAtNodeStart(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n, int documentOffset)
		{
			int relativeOffset = GetRelativeOffset(doc, n, documentOffset);
			if (relativeOffset >= 0)
			{
				return relativeOffset <= n.PrefixOffsetCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsDocumentOffsetAtNodeEnd(RichTextDocument doc, NodeBase n, int documentOffset)
		{
			int relativeOffset = GetRelativeOffset(doc, n, documentOffset);
			int aggregateOffsetCount = n.AggregateOffsetCount;
			if (relativeOffset >= 0 && relativeOffset < aggregateOffsetCount)
			{
				return relativeOffset >= aggregateOffsetCount - n.PostfixOffsetCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsMergedWithCellAbove(TableCellNode cell)
		{
			TableCellSettings settings = cell.Settings;
			if (settings != null && settings.VerticalMerge.HasValue)
			{
				return TableCellVerticalMerge.Continue == settings.VerticalMerge.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsOffsetInPostfix(NodeBase node, int relativeOffset)
		{
			return GetNodePostfixSpan(node).Contains(relativeOffset);
		}

		internal static bool IsOffsetInPrefix(NodeBase node, int relativeOffset)
		{
			return GetNodePrefixSpan(node).Contains(relativeOffset);
		}

		internal static bool IsOffsetInPrefixOrPostfix(NodeBase node, int relativeOffset)
		{
			if (!GetNodePrefixSpan(node).Contains(relativeOffset))
			{
				return GetNodePostfixSpan(node).Contains(relativeOffset);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsRootOrBodyNode(NodeBase n)
		{
			if (!(n is DocumentRootNode))
			{
				return n is DocumentBodyNode;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsRunNodeSuitable(RunNode run, InsertTextOptions insertTextOptions)
		{
			if (insertTextOptions == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			CharacterSettings settingsResolved = run.SettingsResolved;
			if (settingsResolved != null)
			{
				if (insertTextOptions._mergeWithExistingSettings)
				{
					bool flag = insertTextOptions._styleId == null || insertTextOptions._styleId == run.StyleId;
					if (flag && insertTextOptions._settings != null)
					{
						flag = Utilities.AreRTOsEqual(Utilities.MergeHelper(insertTextOptions._settings, settingsResolved), settingsResolved);
					}
					return flag;
				}
				if (insertTextOptions._styleId == run.StyleId && Utilities.AreRTOsEqual(run.Settings, insertTextOptions._settings, considerNullAsEmptyRTO: true))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsStyleUsedByContent(NodeBase contentTree, RichTextStyleBase style)
		{
			if (style != null)
			{
				string id = style.Id;
				foreach (NodeBase allNode in GetAllNodes(contentTree))
				{
					NodeBase.StorageProps.Info info = allNode.PropsInfo as NodeBase.StorageProps.Info;
					if (info._styleIdProp >= 0 && info.GetValue<string>(allNode, info._styleIdProp) == id && info._styleType.IsInstanceOfType(style))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static int MapOffset(NodeBase fromNode, int fromRelativeOffset, NodeBase toNode)
		{
			int documentOffset = fromNode.GetDocumentOffset();
			int documentOffset2 = toNode.GetDocumentOffset();
			if (documentOffset >= 0 && documentOffset2 >= 0)
			{
				return documentOffset + fromRelativeOffset - documentOffset2;
			}
			return int.MinValue;
		}

		internal static bool MoveParagraphContent(ParagraphNode target, int targetRelativeOffset, ParagraphNode source)
		{
			List<NodeBase> list = source.ChildNodes.ToList();
			source.ChildNodes.Clear();
			int offset = targetRelativeOffset;
			NodeBase nodeAtOffset = target.GetNodeAtOffset(ref offset, descend: false);
			if (nodeAtOffset != null && nodeAtOffset != target)
			{
				if (SplitAndInsert(nodeAtOffset, offset, list))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			target.ChildNodes.InsertRange(list, targetRelativeOffset <= target.PrefixOffsetCount);
			return true;
		}

		internal static TLastChildNode RemoveAllButLastChildNodeOfType<TLastChildNode>(NodeBase parent) where TLastChildNode : NodeBase
		{
			NodeCollection childNodesIfAllocated = parent.ChildNodesIfAllocated;
			if (childNodesIfAllocated != null)
			{
				TLastChildNode val = childNodesIfAllocated.LastOrDefault((NodeBase ii) => ii is TLastChildNode) as TLastChildNode;
				for (int num = childNodesIfAllocated.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (val != childNodesIfAllocated[num])
					{
						childNodesIfAllocated.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				return val;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool RemoveLayer(NodeBase node)
		{
			NodeBase parent = node.Parent;
			NodeCollection parentCollection = node.ParentCollection;
			if (parent != null && parentCollection != null)
			{
				NodeCollection childNodesIfAllocated = node.ChildNodesIfAllocated;
				if (childNodesIfAllocated == null || SchemaValidator.AreValidChildNodes(parent, childNodesIfAllocated))
				{
					NodeBase[] array = childNodesIfAllocated?.ToArray();
					int num = parentCollection.IndexOf(node);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						parentCollection.RemoveAt(num);
						if (array != null)
						{
							childNodesIfAllocated.Clear();
							parentCollection.InsertRange(num, array);
						}
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void RemoveNodeHelper(NodeBase n)
		{
			_ = (n.Parent?.ChildNodes)?.Remove(n) ?? false;
		}

		internal static bool RequiresMultipleRunContentNodes(string text)
		{
			if (text != null)
			{
				return text.IndexOfAny(SPECIAL_CHARS) >= 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static InsertTextOptions ResolveInsertTextOptionsHelper(InsertTextOptions options, RunNode fallbackSettingsRun, bool useFallbackRunStyleId = true)
		{
			InsertTextOptions insertTextOptions = options;
			if ((insertTextOptions == null || insertTextOptions._mergeWithExistingSettings) && fallbackSettingsRun != null)
			{
				if (insertTextOptions == null)
				{
					insertTextOptions = new InsertTextOptions();
				}
				insertTextOptions._settings = Utilities.MergeThreeLazy(null, insertTextOptions._settings, fallbackSettingsRun.Settings);
				insertTextOptions._cloneSettings = false;
				if (useFallbackRunStyleId)
				{
					string styleId = fallbackSettingsRun.StyleId;
					if (styleId != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(insertTextOptions._styleId))
					{
						insertTextOptions._styleId = styleId;
					}
				}
			}
			return insertTextOptions;
		}

		}

		internal static StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo SetPathValue(RichTextObjectBase richTextObject, string path, object value, out string error)
		{
			error = null;
			string[] array = path.Split('.');
			RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase = richTextObject;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				string text = array[i];
				StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo propInfoFromName = richTextObjectBase.PropsInfo.GetPropInfoFromName(text);
				if (propInfoFromName == null)
				{
					error = $"Invalid property path {path}. {text} is not a valid property of {richTextObjectBase.GetType().FullName}.";
					break;
				}
				IFieldValueAccessor fieldValueAccessor = (IFieldValueAccessor)propInfoFromName;
				if (i == array.Length - 1)
				{
					if (value != null && !propInfoFromName._type.IsAssignableFrom(value.GetType()))
					{
						error = string.Format("{0} is not a valid value type for the property identified by {1} path.", (value == null) ? "{null}" : value, path);
						break;
					}
					fieldValueAccessor.SetValue(richTextObjectBase, value);
					return propInfoFromName;
				}
				RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info propsInfo = RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info.GetPropsInfo(propInfoFromName._type);
				if (propsInfo == null)
				{
					bool isValueType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(propInfoFromName._type).IsValueType;
					error = string.Format("{0} type returned by the {1} property in the {2} property path is {3} type and therefore you cannot set a property into it.", propInfoFromName._type, propInfoFromName._name, path, isValueType ? "a structure" : "an immutable");
					break;
				}
				RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase2 = (RichTextObjectBase)fieldValueAccessor.GetValue(richTextObjectBase);
				if (richTextObjectBase2 == null)
				{
					fieldValueAccessor.SetValue(richTextObjectBase, richTextObjectBase2 = propsInfo.CreateNew());
				}
				richTextObjectBase = richTextObjectBase2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static void SetRunOwnerText(NodeBase owner, string text)
		{
			RemoveAllButLastChildNodeOfType<RunNode>(owner);
			RunNode runNode = GetLastNodeOfType<RunNode>(owner);
			bool flag = false;
			if (runNode == null)
			{
				flag = true;
				runNode = new RunNode();
			}
			runNode.SetText(text);
			if (flag)
			{
				owner.ChildNodes.Add(runNode);
			}
		}

		internal static bool SpansHyperlink(NodeBase x, NodeBase y)
		{
			return x.GetAncestorNode<HyperlinkNode>() != y.GetAncestorNode<HyperlinkNode>();
		}

		internal static bool SpansIntoHyperlink(NodeBase from, NodeBase to)
		{
			HyperlinkNode hyperlinkNode = to?.GetAncestorNode<HyperlinkNode>();
			if (hyperlinkNode != null)
			{
				HyperlinkNode hyperlinkNode2 = from?.GetAncestorNode<HyperlinkNode>();
				if (hyperlinkNode != hyperlinkNode2)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool Split(RunNode run, DocumentSpan relativeMiddleRunSpan, out RunNode middle, out RunNode right)
		{
			middle = (right = null);
			int start = relativeMiddleRunSpan.Start;
			int end = relativeMiddleRunSpan.End;
			int aggregateOffsetCount = run.AggregateOffsetCount;
			if (start >= 0 && end <= aggregateOffsetCount && (start > 0 || end < aggregateOffsetCount))
			{
				if (end == aggregateOffsetCount)
				{
					return Split(run, start, out middle);
				}
				if (start == 0)
				{
					return Split(run, end, out middle);
				}
				if (Split(run, start, out middle) && Split(middle, end - start, out right))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool Split(RunNode run, int relativeOffset, out RunNode right)
		{
			return SplitGeneric(run, relativeOffset, out right);
		}

		internal static bool Split(RunNode run, NodeBase childNode, out RunNode right)
		{
			int childNodeRelativeOffset = run.GetChildNodeRelativeOffset(childNode);
			return SplitGeneric(run, childNodeRelativeOffset, out right);
		}

		internal static bool Split(TextNode textNode, int relativeOffset, out TextNode right)
		{
			string text = textNode.Text;
			if (text != null && relativeOffset > 0 && relativeOffset < text.Length)
			{
				string text2 = text.Substring(relativeOffset);
				right = new TextNode
				{
					Text = text2
				};
				textNode.DeleteText(relativeOffset);
				return true;
			}
			right = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool Split(ParagraphNode paragraph, int relativeOffset, out ParagraphNode right)
		{
			return SplitGeneric(paragraph, relativeOffset, out right);
		}

		internal static bool SplitAndInsert<TNode>(TNode node, int relativeOffset, TNode siblingToInsert) where TNode : NodeBase
		{
			return SplitAndInsert(node, relativeOffset, new TNode[1] { siblingToInsert });
		}

		internal static bool SplitAndInsert<TNode>(TNode node, int relativeOffset, IEnumerable<TNode> siblingsToInsert) where TNode : NodeBase
		{
			TNode splitNodeRight;
			return SplitAndInsert(node, relativeOffset, siblingsToInsert, out splitNodeRight);
		}

		internal static bool SplitAndInsert<TNode>(TNode node, int relativeOffset, IEnumerable<TNode> siblingsToInsert, out TNode splitNodeRight) where TNode : NodeBase
		{
			NodeCollection parentCollection = node.ParentCollection;
			int num = parentCollection?.IndexOf(node) ?? (-1);
			splitNodeRight = null;
			if (num >= 0 && relativeOffset >= 0 && relativeOffset <= node.AggregateOffsetCount)
			{
				if (relativeOffset != 0)
				{
					if (relativeOffset != node.AggregateOffsetCount)
					{
						if (SplitGeneric(node, relativeOffset, out var right))
						{
							if (right != null)
							{
								parentCollection.InsertAfter(node, right);
								splitNodeRight = right;
							}
						}
						else if (!node.CanHaveChildren || (relativeOffset > node.PrefixOffsetCount && relativeOffset < node.AggregateOffsetCount - node.PostfixOffsetCount))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					num++;
				}
				foreach (TNode item in siblingsToInsert)
				{
					parentCollection.Insert(num++, item);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool SplitAndInsertChildNode(NodeBase parent, NodeBase childNodeToInsert, int parentInsertOffset)
		{
			int offset = parentInsertOffset;
			NodeBase nodeAtOffset = parent.GetNodeAtOffset(ref offset, descend: false);
			if (nodeAtOffset != null)
			{
				if (nodeAtOffset != parent)
				{
					return SplitAndInsert(nodeAtOffset, offset, childNodeToInsert);
				}
				bool atBeginning = parentInsertOffset <= parent.PrefixOffsetCount;
				parent.ChildNodes.Insert(childNodeToInsert, atBeginning);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool SplitAt(ParagraphNode node, int relativeOffset, bool dontSplitAtNodeBoundary = true)
		{
			ParagraphNode left;
			ParagraphNode right;
			return SplitAt(node, relativeOffset, dontSplitAtNodeBoundary, out left, out right);
		}

		internal static bool SplitAt(ParagraphNode node, int relativeOffset, bool dontSplitAtNodeBoundary, out ParagraphNode left, out ParagraphNode right)
		{
			if (node.ParentCollection != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				ParagraphNode right2 = null;
				if (relativeOffset <= node.PrefixOffsetCount || relativeOffset >= node.AggregateOffsetCount - node.PostfixOffsetCount)
				{
					if (!dontSplitAtNodeBoundary)
					{
						right2 = (ParagraphNode)node.Clone(copyId: false, copyChildNodes: false);
						flag = relativeOffset <= node.PrefixOffsetCount;
					}
				}
				else if (SplitGeneric(node, relativeOffset, out right2))
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (right2 != null)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						left = right2;
						right = node;
					}
					else
					{
						left = node;
						right = right2;
					}
					if (node.ParentCollection != null)
					{
						return node.ParentCollection.InsertBeforeAfter(node, right2, flag);
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			left = (right = null);
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool SplitAtGeneric<TNode>(TNode node, int relativeOffset) where TNode : NodeBase
		{
			if (node.ParentCollection != null && SplitGeneric(node, relativeOffset, out var right))
			{
				return node.ParentCollection.InsertAfter(node, right);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool SplitGeneric<TNode>(TNode node, int relativeOffset, out TNode right) where TNode : NodeBase
		{
			if (node is TextNode)
			{
				if (Split(node as TextNode, relativeOffset, out var right2))
				{
					right = right2 as TNode;
					return true;
				}
				right = null;
				return false;
			}
			int offset = relativeOffset;
			NodeBase nodeBase = node.GetNodeAtOffset(ref offset, descend: false);
			if (nodeBase != null && nodeBase != node)
			{
				NodeBase nodeBase2 = null;
				if (offset != 0 && SplitGeneric(nodeBase, offset, out var right3))
				{
					nodeBase2 = right3;
					nodeBase = node.ChildNodes.GetNextSibling(nodeBase);
				}
				NodeCollection right4;
				if (nodeBase != null)
				{
					node.ChildNodes.Split(nodeBase, out right4);
				}
				else
				{
					right4 = new NodeCollection();
				}
				if (nodeBase2 != null)
				{
					right4.Insert(0, nodeBase2);
				}
				right = (TNode)node.Clone(copyId: false, copyChildNodes: false);
				NodeCollection childNodes = right4;
				right.ChildNodes = childNodes;
				return true;
			}
			right = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal static RunNode SplitHelper(RunNode run, DocumentSpan relativeSpan)
		{
			NodeCollection parentCollection = run.ParentCollection;
			int num = parentCollection?.IndexOf(run) ?? (-1);
			if (num >= 0 && Split(run, relativeSpan, out var middle, out var right))
			{
				if (middle != null)
				{
					parentCollection.Insert(++num, middle);
				}
				if (right != null)
				{
					parentCollection.Insert(++num, right);
				}
				if (relativeSpan.Start == 0)
				{
					return run;
				}
				return middle ?? right;
			}
			return run;
		}

		internal static bool SplitParagraphContentAt(RichTextDocument doc, int documentOffset)
		{
			NodeBase nodeAtDocumentOffset = doc.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset(documentOffset);
			nodeAtDocumentOffset = ((nodeAtDocumentOffset != null) ? GetAncestorThatIsParagraphChild(nodeAtDocumentOffset) : null);
			if (nodeAtDocumentOffset != null)
			{
				int relativeOffset = GetRelativeOffset(doc, nodeAtDocumentOffset, documentOffset);
				if (relativeOffset > 0)

				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void SplitParagraphContentAtBoundaries(RichTextDocument doc, DocumentSpan span)

			SplitParagraphContentAt(doc, span.Start);
		}

	internal abstract class TextConsumer

		protected NodeBase _lastAppendNode;

		}

		internal void InitializeSpan(RichTextDocument document, DocumentSpan span)
		{

				_documentSpanOfInterest = span;
			}
			_documentSpanOfInterest_Doc = document;
			if (_documentSpanOfInterest.HasValue)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(_documentSpanOfInterest_Doc);
			}
		}

		internal IEnumerable<NodeBase> GetChildNodesOfInterest(NodeBase parent)
		{
			NodeCollection childNodes = parent.ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes != null && _documentSpanOfInterest.HasValue)
			{
				return NodeUtils.GetChildNodesIntersectingSpan<NodeBase>(_documentSpanOfInterest_Doc, parent, _documentSpanOfInterest.Value);
			}
			return childNodes;
		}

		internal DocumentSpan? GetNodePortionOfInterest(NodeBase n)
		{

			{
				return null;
			}
			return NodeUtils.GetRelativePortion(n, _documentSpanOfInterest.Value) ?? new DocumentSpan?(new DocumentSpan(0, 0));
		}

		internal virtual void Append(string s, NodeBase associatedNode, int associatedNodeOffset = -1)
		{
			AppendOverride(s);
			_totalTextLength += s.Length;
			_lastAppendNode = associatedNode;
		}

		protected abstract void AppendOverride(string s);
	}

	internal class FindTextConsumer : StringBuilderTextConsumer
	{
		private Regex _rx;

		private Action<DocumentSpan, string> _matchCallback;

		private int _sbStartingDocumentOffset = -1;

		private bool _done;

		private bool _allowOverlappingMatches;

		internal FindTextConsumer(Regex regex, Action<DocumentSpan, string> matchCallback, bool allowOverlappingMatches)
			: base(null, CreateFormatOptions())
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(regex);
			_rx = regex;
			_matchCallback = matchCallback;
			_allowOverlappingMatches = allowOverlappingMatches;
		}

		private static PlainTextFormatOptions CreateFormatOptions()
		{
			return new PlainTextFormatOptions
			{
				NewLineText = "\n"
			};
		}

		private bool BreakEncountered(NodeBase nextNode, out bool dontProcessNextNodeText)
		{
			dontProcessNextNodeText = false;
			NodeBase lastAppendNode = _lastAppendNode;
			if (lastAppendNode != nextNode)
			{
				if (nextNode is BlockNode || nextNode is ImageNode)
				{
					dontProcessNextNodeText = true;
					return true;
				}
				if (lastAppendNode != null && lastAppendNode.GetNextSibling() != nextNode)
				{
					DocumentSpan documentSpan = lastAppendNode.GetDocumentSpan();
					DocumentSpan documentSpan2 = nextNode.GetDocumentSpan();
					if (documentSpan.End != documentSpan2.Start)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ProcessPendingText()
		{
			if (_sb.Length <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = _sb.ToString();
			_sb.Clear();
			int sbStartingDocumentOffset = _sbStartingDocumentOffset;
			if (_allowOverlappingMatches)
			{
				int num = 0;
				int length = text.Length;
				while (num < length && !_done)
				{
					Match match = _rx.Match(text, num);
					if (match.Success)
					{
						ProcessMatch(new DocumentSpan(sbStartingDocumentOffset + match.Index, match.Length), match.Value);
						num = 1 + match.Index;
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
				return;
			}
			MatchCollection matchCollection = _rx.Matches(text);
			int num2 = matchCollection?.Count ?? 0;
			if (num2 <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				if (_done)
				{
					break;
				}
				Match match2 = matchCollection[i];
				ProcessMatch(new DocumentSpan(sbStartingDocumentOffset + match2.Index, match2.Length), match2.Value);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessMatch(DocumentSpan span, string foundText)
		{
			_matchCallback(span, foundText);
		}

		internal void Stop()
		{
			_done = true;
		}

		internal override void Append(string s, NodeBase associatedNode, int associatedNodeOffset)
		{
			if (_done)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (BreakEncountered(associatedNode, out var dontProcessNextNodeText))
			{
				ProcessPendingText();
				_sbStartingDocumentOffset = -1;
			}
			if (dontProcessNextNodeText)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_sbStartingDocumentOffset < 0 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(s))
			{
				_sbStartingDocumentOffset = associatedNode.GetDocumentOffset();
				if (_sbStartingDocumentOffset >= 0 && associatedNodeOffset >= 0)
				{
					_sbStartingDocumentOffset += associatedNodeOffset;
				}
			}
			base.Append(s, associatedNode, associatedNodeOffset);
		}
	}

	internal class NodeEnumerable : IEnumerable<NodeBase>, IEnumerable
	{
		internal class Enumerator : IEnumerator<NodeBase>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private readonly NodeBase _tree;

			private readonly Func<NodeBase, bool> _traverseDescendants;

			private readonly Func<NodeBase, bool> _filter;

			private Stack<IEnumerator<NodeBase>> _ancestors;

			private IEnumerator<NodeBase> _currentEnumerator;

			private NodeBase _current;

			private NodeBase[] _startAtPath;

			private NodeBase[] _stopAtPath;

			public NodeBase Current => _current;

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			internal Enumerator(NodeEnumerable enumerable)
			{
				_tree = enumerable._tree;
				_traverseDescendants = enumerable._traverseDescendants;
				_filter = enumerable._filter;
				InitializeStartPath(enumerable._startAtPathLeafNode);
				InitializeStopPath(enumerable._stopAtPathLeafNode);
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				Reset();
			}

			private void InitializeStartPath(NodeBase pathLeaf)
			{
				List<NodeBase> pathToRoot = NodeUtils.GetPathToRoot(_tree, pathLeaf, includeRoot: false);
				_startAtPath = (CoreUtilities.HasItems(pathToRoot) ? pathToRoot.ToArray() : null);
			}

			private void InitializeStopPath(NodeBase pathLeaf)
			{
				List<NodeBase> pathToRoot = NodeUtils.GetPathToRoot(_tree, pathLeaf, includeRoot: false);
				_stopAtPath = (CoreUtilities.HasItems(pathToRoot) ? pathToRoot.ToArray() : null);
			}

			private NodeBase GetNodeFromListHelper(NodeBase[] list, bool nullOutIfFound)
			{
				int num = _ancestors.Count - 1;
				NodeBase nodeBase = ((num >= 0 && num < list.Length) ? list[num] : null);
				if (nodeBase != null && nullOutIfFound)
				{
					list[num] = null;
				}
				return nodeBase;
			}

			private void PushChildNodesEnumerator()
			{
				if (_stopAtPath != null && _current == GetNodeFromListHelper(_stopAtPath, nullOutIfFound: false))
				{
					int num = 0;
					while (_ancestors.Count > 0 && _ancestors.Peek() != null)
					{
						_ancestors.Pop();
						num++;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
					{
						_ancestors.Push(null);
					}
					_currentEnumerator = null;
				}
				if (!_current.HasChildNodes)
				{
					return;
				}
				_ancestors.Push(_currentEnumerator);
				NodeBase nodeBase = ((_startAtPath != null) ? GetNodeFromListHelper(_startAtPath, nullOutIfFound: true) : null);
				if (_traverseDescendants == null || _traverseDescendants(_current))
				{
					_currentEnumerator = ((nodeBase != null) ? _current.ChildNodes.GetEnumeratorStartingAt(nodeBase) : _current.ChildNodes.GetEnumerator());
					return;
				}
				_currentEnumerator = _ancestors.Pop();
				if (nodeBase != null)
				{
					_startAtPath = null;
				}
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				while (true)
				{
					if (_currentEnumerator != null && _currentEnumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						_current = _currentEnumerator.Current;
						PushChildNodesEnumerator();
						if (_filter == null || _filter(_current))
						{
							return true;
						}
						continue;
					}
					if (_ancestors == null)
					{
						_ancestors = new Stack<IEnumerator<NodeBase>>();
						_current = _tree;
						PushChildNodesEnumerator();
						return true;
					}
					if (_ancestors.Count == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					_currentEnumerator = _ancestors.Pop();
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_ancestors = null;
				_currentEnumerator = null;
				_current = null;
			}
		}

		private readonly NodeBase _tree;

		private readonly Func<NodeBase, bool> _traverseDescendants;

		private readonly NodeBase _startAtPathLeafNode;

		private readonly NodeBase _stopAtPathLeafNode;

		private readonly Func<NodeBase, bool> _filter;

		internal NodeEnumerable(NodeBase tree, Func<NodeBase, bool> traverseDescendants = null, NodeBase startAtPathLeafNode = null, NodeBase stopAtPathLeafNode = null, Func<NodeBase, bool> filter = null)
		{
			_tree = tree;
			_traverseDescendants = traverseDescendants;
			_startAtPathLeafNode = startAtPathLeafNode;
			_stopAtPathLeafNode = stopAtPathLeafNode;
			_filter = filter;
		}

		public IEnumerator<NodeBase> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new Enumerator(this);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

	internal class ApplySettingsHelper
	{
		internal readonly RichTextObjectBase _source;

		private ApplySettingsHelper[] _subObjProps;

		private StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo _parentProp;

		private bool _isClearingValue;

		internal ApplySettingsHelper(RichTextObjectBase source, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo nonDefaultPropOverride = null, bool cloneSourceObject = true)
		{
			_source = (cloneSourceObject ? source.Clone() : source);
			_propsInfo = _source.PropsInfo;
			List<IRichTextPropInfo> list = (from i in GetNonDefaultProps(_propsInfo._nonSettingsPropIds, nonDefaultPropOverride)
				select (IRichTextPropInfo)i).ToList();
			List<ApplySettingsHelper> list2 = new List<ApplySettingsHelper>();
			foreach (StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo nonDefaultProp in GetNonDefaultProps(_propsInfo._SettingsPropIds, nonDefaultPropOverride))
			{
				RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase = (RichTextObjectBase)nonDefaultProp.GetValue(_source, _propsInfo._defaultStorage);
				if (richTextObjectBase == null || nonDefaultPropOverride == nonDefaultProp)
				{
					if (nonDefaultPropOverride == nonDefaultProp)
					{
						list.Add((IRichTextPropInfo)nonDefaultPropOverride);
					}
					continue;
				}
				ApplySettingsHelper applySettingsHelper = new ApplySettingsHelper(richTextObjectBase, nonDefaultPropOverride, cloneSourceObject: false)
				{
					_parentProp = nonDefaultProp
				};
				if (CoreUtilities.HasItems(applySettingsHelper._nonDefaultProps) || CoreUtilities.HasItems(applySettingsHelper._subObjProps))
				{
					list2.Add(applySettingsHelper);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				_nonDefaultProps = list.ToArray();
			}
			if (list2.Count > 0)
			{
				_subObjProps = list2.ToArray();
			}
		}

		internal static ApplySettingsHelper CreateHelper<TRichTextObject, TValue>(string propertyPath, TValue leafValue, out string error) where TRichTextObject : RichTextObjectBase, new()
		{
			TRichTextObject val = new TRichTextObject();
			StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo nonDefaultPropOverride = NodeUtils.SetPathValue(val, propertyPath, leafValue, out error);
			if (error == null)
			{
				ApplySettingsHelper applySettingsHelper = new ApplySettingsHelper(val, nonDefaultPropOverride);
				if (leafValue == null)

					SetIsClearingValueRecursive(applySettingsHelper);
				}

			}
			return null;
		}

		private static void SetIsClearingValueRecursive(ApplySettingsHelper i)
		{

			Utilities.PerformOnAll(i._subObjProps, SetIsClearingValueRecursive);
		}

		private IEnumerable<StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo> GetNonDefaultProps(int[] props, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo nonDefaultPropOverride)
		{
			return from i in props
				let p = _propsInfo.Props[i]
				where !p.IsDefaultValue(_source, _propsInfo._defaultStorage) || p == nonDefaultPropOverride
				select p;
		}

		internal TSettings ApplyToSettingsHelper<TSettings>(TSettings settings, bool cloneIfMultipleOwners = true) where TSettings : RichTextObjectBase
		{
			if (settings == null)
			{
				return (TSettings)_source;
			}
			if (settings.HasMultipleOwners || settings.IsSealed)
			{
				settings = (TSettings)settings.Clone();
				ApplyTo(settings);
				return settings;
			}
			ApplyTo(settings);
			return settings;
		}

		internal void ApplyTo(RichTextObjectBase dest)
		{
			IRichTextPropInfo[] nonDefaultProps = _nonDefaultProps;
			if (nonDefaultProps != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < nonDefaultProps.Length; i++)
				{
					nonDefaultProps[i].CopyValueWithNotifications(_source, dest);
				}
			}
			ApplySettingsHelper[] subObjProps = _subObjProps;
			if (subObjProps == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			while (num < subObjProps.Length)
			{
				ApplySettingsHelper applySettingsHelper = subObjProps[num];
				StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo parentProp = applySettingsHelper._parentProp;
				RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase = (RichTextObjectBase)((IFieldValueAccessor)parentProp).GetValue(dest);
				object value = null;
				bool flag = false;
				if (richTextObjectBase == null)
				{
					if (!_isClearingValue)
					{
						value = applySettingsHelper._source;
						flag = true;
					}
					goto IL_00ae;
				}
				int num2;
				if (!richTextObjectBase.HasMultipleOwners)
				{
					num2 = (richTextObjectBase.IsSealed ? 1 : 0);
					if (num2 == 0)
					{
						goto IL_009c;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = 1;
				}
				richTextObjectBase = richTextObjectBase.Clone();
				goto IL_009c;
				IL_00ae:
				if (flag)
				{
					((IRichTextPropInfo)parentProp).SetValueWithNotifications(dest, value);
				}
				num++;
				continue;
				IL_009c:
				applySettingsHelper.ApplyTo(richTextObjectBase);
				if (num2 != 0)
				{
					value = richTextObjectBase;
					flag = true;
				}
				goto IL_00ae;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class GetCommonSettingsHelper
	{
		internal readonly RichTextObjectBase _dest;

		private RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info _propsInfo;

		private const bool _ignoreDefaultValues = false;

		private ulong _nonConflictingProps;

		private ulong _unsetProps;

		private StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo[] _nonSubObjProps;

		private StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo[] _subObjProps;

		private GetCommonSettingsHelper[] _subObjHelpers;

		private ulong _subObjHelpers_doneFlags;

		internal GetCommonSettingsHelper(RichTextObjectBase dest)
		{
			_dest = dest;
			_propsInfo = dest.PropsInfo;
			_nonSubObjProps = _propsInfo._nonSettingsPropIds.Select((int i) => _propsInfo.Props[i]).ToArray();
			_subObjProps = _propsInfo._SettingsPropIds.Select((int i) => _propsInfo.Props[i]).ToArray();
			_subObjHelpers = new GetCommonSettingsHelper[_subObjProps.Length];
			for (int num = 0; num < _nonSubObjProps.Length; num++)
			{
				_unsetProps |= (ulong)(1L << num);
			}
			_nonConflictingProps = _unsetProps;
		}

		internal void Process(RichTextObjectBase item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RichTextStorageProps<RichTextObjectBase>.DefaultStorage defaultStorage = _propsInfo._defaultStorage;
			if (_nonConflictingProps != 0L)
			{
				StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo[] nonSubObjProps = _nonSubObjProps;
				for (int i = 0; i < nonSubObjProps.Length; i++)
				{
					ulong num = (ulong)(1L << i);
					if ((_nonConflictingProps & num) != 0L)
					{
						StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo propInfo = nonSubObjProps[i];
						if ((_unsetProps & num) != 0L)
						{
							propInfo.CopyValue(item, defaultStorage, _dest, defaultStorage);
							_unsetProps &= ~num;
						}
						else if (!((IRichTextPropInfo)propInfo).AreValuesEqual(_dest, item))
						{
							((IFieldValueAccessor)propInfo).SetValue(_dest, propInfo._defaultValue);
							_nonConflictingProps &= ~num;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo[] subObjProps = _subObjProps;
			if (subObjProps == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < subObjProps.Length; j++)
			{
				IFieldValueAccessor fieldValueAccessor = (IFieldValueAccessor)subObjProps[j];
				RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase = (RichTextObjectBase)fieldValueAccessor.GetValue(item);
				ulong num2 = (ulong)(1L << j);
				if (richTextObjectBase == null)
				{
					_subObjHelpers_doneFlags |= num2;
					fieldValueAccessor.SetValue(_dest, null);
				}
				else
				{
					if ((_subObjHelpers_doneFlags & num2) != 0L)
					{
						continue;
					}
					GetCommonSettingsHelper getCommonSettingsHelper = _subObjHelpers[j];
					if (getCommonSettingsHelper == null)
					{
						RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase2 = (RichTextObjectBase)fieldValueAccessor.GetValue(_dest);
						if (richTextObjectBase2 == null)
						{
							fieldValueAccessor.SetValue(_dest, richTextObjectBase2 = richTextObjectBase.PropsInfo.CreateNew());
						}
						getCommonSettingsHelper = (_subObjHelpers[j] = new GetCommonSettingsHelper(richTextObjectBase2));
					}
					getCommonSettingsHelper.Process(richTextObjectBase);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SetPathValueHelper<TValue>
	{
		private int[] _props;

		private RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info[] _propOwners;

		internal string _error;

		private TValue _value;

		internal static SetPathValueHelper<TValue> CreateHelper(RichTextObjectBase richTextObject, string path, TValue value, out string error)
		{
			SetPathValueHelper<TValue> setPathValueHelper = new SetPathValueHelper<TValue>();
			setPathValueHelper._value = value;
			setPathValueHelper.Initialize(richTextObject, path);
			error = setPathValueHelper._error;
			if (error != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return setPathValueHelper;
		}

		private void Initialize(RichTextObjectBase richTextObject, string path)
		{
			string[] array = path.Split('.');
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				_error = $"Invalid property path {path}.";
				return;
			}
			_props = new int[array.Length];
			_propOwners = new RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info[array.Length];
			Type type = richTextObject.GetType();
			RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info info = richTextObject.PropsInfo;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				string text = array[i];
				StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo propInfoFromName = info.GetPropInfoFromName(text);
				if (propInfoFromName == null)
				{
					_error = $"Invalid property path {path}. {text} is not a valid property of {type.FullName}.";
					break;
				}
				RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info propsInfo = RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info.GetPropsInfo(propInfoFromName._type);
				if (propsInfo == null && i < array.Length - 1)
				{
					bool isValueType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(propInfoFromName._type).IsValueType;
					_error = string.Format("{0} type returned by the {1} property in the {2} property path is {3} type and therefore you cannot set a property into it.", propInfoFromName._type, propInfoFromName._name, path, isValueType ? "a structure" : "an immutable");
					break;
				}
				_propOwners[i] = info;
				_props[i] = propInfoFromName._key;
				if (i == array.Length - 1 && !propInfoFromName._type.IsInstanceOfType(_value))
				{
					_error = string.Format("{0} is not a valid value type for the property identified by {1} path.", (_value == null) ? "{null}" : _value.GetType().Name, path);
					break;
				}
				type = propInfoFromName._type;
				info = propsInfo;
			}
		}

		internal void SetValue(RichTextObjectBase target, bool withPropertyNotifications = true)
		{
			RichTextObjectBase item = target;
			int[] props = _props;
			RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info[] propOwners = _propOwners;
			for (int i = 0; i < props.Length; i++)
			{
				int property = props[i];
				RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info info = propOwners[i];
				if (i == props.Length - 1)
				{
					info.SetValue(item, property, _value, withPropertyNotifications);
					continue;
				}
				RichTextObjectBase value = info.GetValue<RichTextObjectBase>(item, property);
				if (value == null)
				{
					info.SetValue(item, property, value, withPropertyNotifications);
				}
				item = value;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class NodeTreeWalker : NodeVisitor
	{
		protected override void DefaultVisit(NodeBase node)
		{
			VisitChildren(node);
		}

		protected virtual void VisitChildren(NodeBase node)
		{
			NodeCollection childNodesIfAllocated = node.ChildNodesIfAllocated;
			if (childNodesIfAllocated == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (NodeBase item in childNodesIfAllocated)
			{
				item.Accept(this);
			}
		}
	}

		internal override void OnPropertyChanged<T>(int propertyIndex, T oldValue)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(propertyIndex, oldValue);
			switch (propertyIndex)
			{
			case 5:
				DirtyMarkSettings();
				break;
			case 3:
				DirtyListInfo();
				DirtyStyleInfo();
				break;
			case 4:
				DirtyListInfo();
				DirtyStyleInfo(oldValue as string);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal override void OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (sender is StyleListenersManager)
			{
				DirtyListInfo();
				DirtyStyleInfo();
				return;
			}
			if (sender is ListInfoListenersManager)
			{
				DirtyListInfo(null, true);
				return;
			}
			if (extraInfo is PropertyChangeChainContextBase { Owner: var owner })
			{
				if (Settings == owner)
				{
					if (property == "ListId" || property == "ListLevel")
					{
						DirtyListInfo();
					}
					DirtyStyleInfo();
				}
				else if (MarkSettings == owner)
				{
					DirtyMarkSettings();
				}
			}
			base.OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
		}

		internal ParagraphNode Clone(bool copyId, bool copyChildNodes, bool copyListItemInfo, DocumentRootNode destinationRootNode)
		{

			if (copyListItemInfo)

				if (listItemInfoResolved != null)
				{
					RichTextListItemInfo richTextListItemInfo = listItemInfoResolved.Clone(this, copyResolvedIndicatorSettings: false);
					if (destinationRootNode != null && richTextListItemInfo._owner != null)
					{
						RichTextList richTextList = destinationRootNode.Lists[richTextListItemInfo._owner.Id];
						if (richTextList != null)

					}
					paragraphNode.SetResolvedListItemInfo(richTextListItemInfo);
					ParagraphNodeData.ParagraphListInfoHolder listInfoHolder = Data._listInfoHolder;
					ParagraphNodeData.ParagraphListInfoHolder listInfoHolder2 = paragraphNode.Data._listInfoHolder;
					if (listInfoHolder != null && listInfoHolder2 != null)
					{
						listInfoHolder2._listId = listInfoHolder._listId;
						listInfoHolder2._listLevel = listInfoHolder._listLevel;
					}
				}
			}
			return paragraphNode;
		}

		internal void DirtyListInfo(bool? rehook = null, bool? reprocessParagraph = null)
		{
			string listId = ListId;
			ParagraphNodeData data = Data;
			ParagraphNodeData.ParagraphListInfoHolder paragraphListInfoHolder = data._listInfoHolder ?? new ParagraphNodeData.ParagraphListInfoHolder();
			paragraphListInfoHolder.ResolveListId(this);
			string listId2 = paragraphListInfoHolder._listId;
			if (listId2 != null)
			{
				data._listInfoHolder = paragraphListInfoHolder;
			}
			if (listId != listId2)
			{
				rehook = true;
				reprocessParagraph = true;
			}
			else if (listId2 != null)
			{
				RichTextListItemInfo listItemInfoResolved = ListItemInfoResolved;
				if (listItemInfoResolved != null && ((listItemInfoResolved._levelDefinition != null) ? listItemInfoResolved._levelDefinition.Level : (-1)) != ListLevel)
				{
					reprocessParagraph = true;
				}
			}
			if (true == rehook)
			{
				DocumentRootNode.RemoveListInfoListenerHelper(listId, this);
				DocumentRootNode.AddListInfoListenerHelper(listId2, this);
			}
			if (true == reprocessParagraph)
			{
				RichTextList.ReprocessParagraph(this);
			}
			if (listId2 == null && data._listInfoHolder != null && data._listInfoHolder._listItemInfoResolved == null)
			{
				data._listInfoHolder = null;
			}
		}

		internal static void ResolveParagraphSettingsHelper(ParagraphNode node, string styleId, ParagraphSettings thisSettings, out ParagraphSettings settingsResolved, out CharacterSettings runSettingsResolved)
		{
			ParagraphStyle paragraphStyle = RichTextStyleCollection.GetStyleResolvedHelper<ParagraphStyle>(node, styleId, returnDefaultIfIdNull: true);
			if (paragraphStyle == null)
			{
				paragraphStyle = RichTextDocument.DefaultNormalStyle;
			}
			ParagraphStyle paragraphStyle2 = (ParagraphStyle)paragraphStyle.GetResolvedIncludingDefaults(node);
			TableCellNode tableCellNode = node.Parent as TableCellNode;
			ParagraphSettings paragraphSettings = tableCellNode?.ParagraphSettingsResolved;
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = tableCellNode?.RunSettingsResolved;
			RichTextListItemInfo listItemInfoResolved = node.ListItemInfoResolved;
			if (thisSettings == null && paragraphSettings == null && characterSettings == null && listItemInfoResolved == null)
			{
				settingsResolved = paragraphStyle2.ParagraphSettings;
				runSettingsResolved = paragraphStyle2.CharacterSettings;
				return;
			}
			PropertyResolverBase resolver = null;
			if (paragraphSettings == null && characterSettings == null && listItemInfoResolved == null)
			{
				resolver = Utilities.CreateResolver<ParagraphSettings>();
				Utilities.MergeHelper(resolver, thisSettings);
				Utilities.MergeHelper(resolver, paragraphStyle2.ParagraphSettings);
				settingsResolved = resolver.ResolveRemainingProperties() as ParagraphSettings;
				runSettingsResolved = paragraphStyle2.CharacterSettings;
				return;
			}
			PropertyResolverBase resolver2 = null;
			Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<ParagraphSettings>(ref resolver, thisSettings);
			if (listItemInfoResolved != null && listItemInfoResolved.LevelDefinition != null)
			{
				Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<ParagraphSettings>(ref resolver, listItemInfoResolved.LevelDefinition.ParagraphSettings);
			}
			if (paragraphSettings != null)
			{
				Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<ParagraphSettings>(ref resolver, ((ParagraphStyle)paragraphStyle.Resolved).ParagraphSettings);
				Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<ParagraphSettings>(ref resolver, paragraphSettings);
			}
			if (resolver != null)
			{
				Utilities.MergeHelper(resolver, paragraphStyle2.ParagraphSettings);
			}
			if (characterSettings != null)
			{
				Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<CharacterSettings>(ref resolver2, ((ParagraphStyle)paragraphStyle.Resolved).CharacterSettings);
				Utilities.MergeHelperLazy<CharacterSettings>(ref resolver2, characterSettings);
			}
			if (resolver2 != null)
			{
				Utilities.MergeHelper(resolver2, paragraphStyle2.CharacterSettings);
			}
			settingsResolved = ((resolver != null) ? (resolver.ResolveRemainingProperties() as ParagraphSettings) : paragraphStyle2.ParagraphSettings);
			runSettingsResolved = ((resolver2 != null) ? (resolver2.ResolveRemainingProperties() as CharacterSettings) : paragraphStyle2.CharacterSettings);
		}

		internal void SetResolvedListItemInfo(RichTextListItemInfo info)
		{
			if (ListItemInfoResolved != info)
			{
				bool isListItemResolved = IsListItemResolved;
				Data.ListItemInfoResolved = info;
				if (isListItemResolved != IsListItemResolved)
				{
					OnAggregateOffsetCountChanged();
					NotifyListeners(this, "IsListItemResolved", null);
				}
				DirtyStyleInfo();
				NotifyListeners(this, "ListItemInfoResolved", null);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureParagraphMarkSettingsResolved()
		{
			EnsureSettingsResolved();
			if (_paragraphMarkSettingsResolved == null)
			{
				CharacterSettings markSettings = MarkSettings;
				if (markSettings != null)
				{
					PropertyResolver<CharacterSettings> propertyResolver = Utilities.CreateResolver<CharacterSettings>();
					propertyResolver.SuspendResolve(29);
					Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolver, markSettings);
					Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolver, RunSettingsResolved);
					propertyResolver.ResumeResolve(29);
					_paragraphMarkSettingsResolved = (CharacterSettings)propertyResolver.ResolveRemainingProperties();
				}
				else
				{
					_paragraphMarkSettingsResolved = RunSettingsResolved;
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsureSettingsResolved()
		{
			if (_settingsResolved == null)
			{
				string styleId = StyleId;
				DocumentRootNode.AddStyleListenerHelper(styleId, this, listenForDefaultStyleIfIdNull: true);
				ResolveParagraphSettingsHelper(this, styleId, Settings, out _settingsResolved, out _runSettingsResolved);
				_paragraphMarkSettingsResolved = null;
			}
		}
	}

		internal void DirtyStyleInfo(string styleIdToUnhook = null)
		{
			if (_settingsResolved != null)
			{
				_settingsResolved = null;
				DocumentRootNode.RemoveStyleListenerHelper(styleIdToUnhook ?? StyleId, this, listenForDefaultStyleIfIdNull: true);
				ParagraphNode parentParagraph = ParentParagraph;
				if (parentParagraph == null || _verifiedSettingsResolvedVersion == parentParagraph._settingsResolvedVersion)
				{
					NotifyListeners(this, "SettingsResolved", null);
				}
			}

		internal static CharacterSettings ResolveRunSettingsHelper(NodeBase parent, ParagraphNode paragraph, string runStyleId, CharacterSettings runSettings)
		{
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = null;
			PropertyResolverBase propertyResolverBase = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (runStyleId == "Hyperlink")
			{
				flag = true;
				if (parent is HyperlinkNode { IsFollowed: not false })
				{
					runStyleId = "FollowedHyperlink";
				}
			}
			CharacterStyle characterStyle = null;
			if (paragraph != null)
			{
				characterStyle = RichTextStyleCollection.GetStyleResolvedHelper<CharacterStyle>(paragraph, runStyleId, returnDefaultIfIdNull: true);
				if (runSettings == null)
				{
					if (characterStyle == null)
					{
						characterSettings = paragraph.RunSettingsResolved;
					}
					else if (paragraph != null && paragraph.RunSettingsResolved == ((ParagraphStyle)RichTextDocument.DefaultNormalStyle.GetResolvedIncludingDefaults(paragraph)).CharacterSettings)
					{
						characterSettings = ((CharacterStyle)characterStyle.GetResolvedIncludingDefaults(paragraph)).CharacterSettings;
					}
					if (characterStyle != null && characterSettings != null)
					{
						CharacterSettings source = characterSettings;
						characterSettings = new CharacterSettings();
						propertyResolverBase = characterSettings.PropsInfo.CreateResolver(characterSettings);
						Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, characterStyle.CharacterSettings);
						Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, source);
					}
				}
			}
			if (characterSettings == null)
			{
				characterSettings = new CharacterSettings();
				propertyResolverBase = characterSettings.PropsInfo.CreateResolver(characterSettings);
				if (flag && runSettings != null && runSettings.FontSettings != null)
				{
					if (characterSettings.FontSettings == null)
					{
						characterSettings.FontSettings = new FontSettings();
					}
					Utilities.MergeHelper(characterSettings.FontSettings.PropsInfo.CreateResolver(characterSettings.FontSettings), runSettings.FontSettings);
				}
				if (flag && characterStyle != null)
				{
					Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, characterStyle.CharacterSettings);
				}
				Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, runSettings);
				if (characterStyle != null && !flag)
				{
					Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, characterStyle.CharacterSettings);
				}
				if (paragraph != null)
				{
					Utilities.MergeHelper(propertyResolverBase, paragraph.RunSettingsResolved);
				}
				propertyResolverBase.MergeProperties(RichTextDocument.DefaultCharacterSettings);
				characterSettings = propertyResolverBase.ResolveRemainingProperties() as CharacterSettings;
			}
			return characterSettings;
		}

		private void EnsureSettingsResolved()
		{
			ParagraphNode parentParagraph = ParentParagraph;
			if (_settingsResolved == null || (parentParagraph != null && _verifiedSettingsResolvedVersion != parentParagraph._settingsResolvedVersion))
			{
				string styleId = StyleId;
				DocumentRootNode.AddStyleListenerHelper(styleId, this, listenForDefaultStyleIfIdNull: true);
				_settingsResolved = ResolveRunSettingsHelper(base.Parent, parentParagraph, styleId, Settings);
				if (parentParagraph != null)
				{
					_verifiedSettingsResolvedVersion = parentParagraph._settingsResolvedVersion;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		internal bool DeleteText(int start)
		{
			string text = Text;
			if (text != null)
			{
				return DeleteText(start, text.Length - start);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool DeleteText(int start, int length)
		{
			if (length > 0)
			{
				string text = Text;
				int num = start + length - 1;
				if (text == null || start < 0 || num >= text.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string text2 = text.Substring(0, start);
				string text3 = ((1 + num < text.Length) ? text.Substring(1 + num) : string.Empty);
				Text = text2 + text3;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool InsertText(int location, string textToInsert)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(textToInsert))
			{
				string text = Text ?? string.Empty;
				if (location < 0 || location > text.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Text = text.Insert(location, textToInsert);
			}
			return true;
		}
