	public class Range : IRange, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private VersionedDocumentOffset _start;

		private VersionedDocumentOffset _end;

		internal VersionedDocumentOffset EndVersioned => _end;

		internal VersionedDocumentOffset StartVersioned => _start;

		private Selection Selection { get; set; }

		public CharacterSettings CharacterSettings => null;

		public string CharacterStyleId
		{
			get
			{
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("CharacterStyleId");
			}
		}

		public RichTextDocument Document { get; private set; }

		public DocumentSpan DocumentSpan => new DocumentSpan(Start, Length);

		public int End
		{
			get
			{
				return _end.Offset;
			}
			set
			{
				VersionedDocumentOffset versionedDocumentOffset = new VersionedDocumentOffset(Document.CurrentVersion, value);
				_ = _end.Offset;
				EnsureEndVersionIsCurrent(raisePropertyChangeNotification: false);
				if (!(_end != versionedDocumentOffset))
				{
					return;
				}
				bool num = versionedDocumentOffset.Offset != _end.Offset;
				_end = versionedDocumentOffset;
				if (num)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("End");
					RaisePropertyChanged("Range");
				}
				EnsureStartVersionIsCurrent(raisePropertyChangeNotification: false);
				if (_end < _start)
				{
					bool num2 = _end.Offset != _start.Offset;
					_start = _end;
					if (num2)
					{
						RaisePropertyChanged("Start");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public int Length => End - Start;

		public IEnumerable<ParagraphNode> Paragraphs => null;

		public ParagraphSettings ParagraphSettings => null;

		public string ParagraphStyleId
		{
			get
			{
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("ParagraphStyleId");
			}
		}

		public int Start
		{
			get
			{
				return _start.Offset;
			}
			set
			{
				VersionedDocumentOffset versionedDocumentOffset = new VersionedDocumentOffset(Document.CurrentVersion, value);
				_ = _start.Offset;
				EnsureStartVersionIsCurrent(raisePropertyChangeNotification: false);
				if (!(_start != versionedDocumentOffset))
				{
					return;
				}
				bool num = versionedDocumentOffset.Offset != _start.Offset;
				_start = versionedDocumentOffset;
				if (num)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("Start");
					RaisePropertyChanged("Range");
				}
				EnsureEndVersionIsCurrent(raisePropertyChangeNotification: false);
				if (_start > _end)
				{
					bool num2 = _end.Offset != _start.Offset;
					_end = _start;
					if (num2)
					{
						RaisePropertyChanged("End");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return Document.GetTextInSpan(DocumentSpan);
			}
			set
			{
				if (Selection != null)
				{
					Selection.SetSelectedText(value, preserveSelection: false);
				}
				else
				{
					Document.SetTextInSpan(DocumentSpan, value);
				}
				RaisePropertyChanged("Text");
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public Range(RichTextDocument document, int start, int end)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(document, "document");
			Document = document;
			SetRangePrivate(start, end, raisePropertyChangedNotifications: false);
		}

		internal Range(Selection selection, RichTextDocument document, int start, int end)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(document, "document");
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(selection, "selection");
			Document = document;
			Selection = selection;
			SetRangePrivate(start, end, raisePropertyChangedNotifications: false);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"[{_start.Offset},{_end.Offset},{Length},{_end.Version.Version}]";
		}

		public void CheckSpelling()
		{
		}

		internal void CombineWithRange(Range otherRange)
		{
			if (Intersects(otherRange))
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				int start = Start;
				int end = End;
				if (otherRange.End > End)
				{
					end = otherRange.End;
					flag = true;
				}
				if (otherRange.Start < Start)
				{
					start = otherRange.Start;
					flag2 = true;
				}
				if (flag2 || flag)
				{
					SetRangePrivate(start, end);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool Contains(Range otherRange)
		{
			if (otherRange.Start >= Start)
			{
				return otherRange.End <= End;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool Contains(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			if (span.Start >= Start)
			{
				return span.End <= End;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool Contains(int start, int end)
		{
			if (start >= Start)
			{
				return end <= End;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool Contains(int offset)
		{
			if (offset >= Start)
			{
				return offset < End;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void EnsureEndVersionIsCurrent(bool raisePropertyChangeNotification)
		{
			RichTextDocumentVersion currentVersion = Document.CurrentVersion;
			if (_end.Version != currentVersion)
			{
				int offset = _end.Offset;
				_end = _end.TranslateTo(currentVersion, OffsetTrackingMode.Positive);
				if (_end.Offset != offset && raisePropertyChangeNotification)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("End");
				}
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureStartVersionIsCurrent(bool raisePropertyChangeNotification)
		{
			RichTextDocumentVersion currentVersion = Document.CurrentVersion;
			if (_start.Version != currentVersion)
			{
				int offset = _start.Offset;
				_start = _start.TranslateTo(currentVersion, OffsetTrackingMode.Positive);
				if (_start.Offset != offset && raisePropertyChangeNotification)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("Start");
				}
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureStartAndEndVersionsAreCurrent(bool raisePropertyChangeNotification)
		{
			EnsureStartVersionIsCurrent(raisePropertyChangeNotification);
			EnsureEndVersionIsCurrent(raisePropertyChangeNotification);
		}

		internal bool Intersects(Range otherRange)
		{
			if (otherRange.Start < Start || otherRange.Start > End)
			{
				if (otherRange.End >= Start)
				{
					return otherRange.End <= End;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool Intersects(DocumentSpan span)
		{
			if (span.Start < Start || span.Start > End)
			{
				if (span.End >= Start)
				{
					return span.End <= End;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool Intersects(int start, int end)
		{
			if (start < Start || start > End)
			{
				if (end >= Start)
				{
					return end <= End;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		private void SetRangePrivate(int start, int end, bool raisePropertyChangedNotifications = true)
		{
			if (end < start)
			{
				int num = start;
				start = end;
				end = num;
			}

			}

		internal class PropertyResolver<TItem> : PropertyResolverBase where TItem : RichTextObjectBase
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static WeakDictionary<TItem, TItem> _ResolvedCache;

			private TItem _target;

			private StorageProps.Info _propsInfo;

			private IPropertyStorage<RichTextObjectBase, int> _storage;

			private bool _resolveAllProperties;

			internal override RichTextObjectBase Target => _target;

			internal bool IsResolutionComplete => _propsToResolve == 0;

			internal PropertyResolver(TItem target)
				: this(target, target.PropsInfo._resolverPropertyKeyBits)
			{
			}

			internal PropertyResolver(TItem target, ulong propsToResolve)
			{
				if (target.GetType() != typeof(TItem))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Target must be of specified class, not a sub-class");
				}
				_target = target;
				_propsToResolve = propsToResolve;
				_propsInfo = target.PropsInfo;
				_storage = _propsInfo._defaultStorage;
				_resolveAllProperties = propsToResolve == _propsInfo._resolverPropertyKeyBits;
			}

			internal override void MergeProperties(RichTextObjectBase source)
			{
				if (_propsToResolve == 0L)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool flag = source is TItem;
				IMap<int, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo> props = _propsInfo.Props;
				StorageProps.Info info = (flag ? _propsInfo : source.PropsInfo);
				IMap<int, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo> map = (flag ? props : info.Props);
				int i = 0;
				for (int propertyCount = _propsInfo._propertyCount; i < propertyCount; i++)
				{
					ulong num = (ulong)(1L << i);
					if ((num & _propsToResolve) != 0L)
					{
						if (!flag && (info._propertyCount <= i || !Utilities.HasSameOwnerHelper(map[i], props[i])))
						{
							break;
						}
						MergeHelper(source, props[i], num);
					}
				}
			}

			internal override RichTextObjectBase ResolveRemainingProperties()
			{
				if (_propsToResolve != 0L)
				{
					IMap<int, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo> props = _propsInfo.Props;
					int i = 0;
					for (int propertyCount = _propsInfo._propertyCount; i < propertyCount; i++)
					{
						ulong num = (ulong)(1L << i);
						if ((num & _propsToResolve) != 0L)
						{
							ResolveHelper(props[i], num);
						}
					}
					if (!_isSubObjectResolver && _descendantList != null)
					{
						for (int num2 = _descendantList.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
						{
							PropertyResolverBase propertyResolverBase = _descendantList[num2];
							RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase = propertyResolverBase.ResolveRemainingProperties();
							if (propertyResolverBase._parentProp is IFieldValueAccessor fieldValueAccessor)
							{
								fieldValueAccessor.SetValue(propertyResolverBase._parentObj, richTextObjectBase.Clone());
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (_resolveAllProperties)
				{
					TItem uniqueInstance = GetUniqueInstance(_target);
					if (_isSubObjectResolver && uniqueInstance != _target && _parentObj != null && !_parentObj.IsSealed && _parentProp is IFieldValueAccessor fieldValueAccessor2)
					{
						fieldValueAccessor2.SetValue(_parentObj, uniqueInstance);
					}
					return uniqueInstance;
				}
				return _target;
			}

			internal override void ResumeResolve(int propertyKey)
			{
				_propsToResolve |= (ulong)(1L << propertyKey);
			}

			internal override void SuspendResolve(int propertyKey)
			{
				_propsToResolve &= (ulong)(~(1L << propertyKey));
			}

			private void MergeHelper(RichTextObjectBase source, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo propInfo, ulong propBit)
			{
				StoragePropsInfo.CopyMethod copyMethod = propInfo._copyMethod;
				if (copyMethod != StoragePropsInfo.CopyMethod.CopyValue)
				{
					if (copyMethod != StoragePropsInfo.CopyMethod.CopyClone)
					{
						_propsToResolve &= ~propBit;
						return;
					}
					if (!(propInfo.GetValue(source, _storage) is RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase))
					{
						return;
					}
					if (richTextObjectBase is IListInternal)
					{
						if (((IListInternal)richTextObjectBase).Count == 0)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (richTextObjectBase is IList && ((IList)richTextObjectBase).Count == 0)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (richTextObjectBase.PropsInfo._mergePropertiesWhenResolving)
					{
						RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase2 = propInfo.GetValue(_target, _storage) as RichTextObjectBase;
						PropertyResolverBase value = null;
						if (richTextObjectBase2 == null)
						{
							richTextObjectBase2 = richTextObjectBase.Clone();
							_storage.SetValue(_target, propInfo._key, richTextObjectBase2);
						}
						else if (_descendantMap != null)
						{
							_descendantMap.TryGetValue(richTextObjectBase2, out value);
						}
						if (value == null)
						{
							value = richTextObjectBase2.PropsInfo.CreateResolver(richTextObjectBase2);
							if (value == null)
							{
								_propsToResolve &= ~propBit;
								return;
							}
							if (_descendantMap == null)
							{
								_descendantMap = new Dictionary<RichTextObjectBase, PropertyResolverBase>();
								_descendantList = new List<PropertyResolverBase>();
							}
							_descendantMap.Add(richTextObjectBase2, value);
							_descendantList.Add(value);
							value._descendantMap = _descendantMap;
							value._descendantList = _descendantList;
							value._isSubObjectResolver = true;
							value._parentObj = _target;
							value._parentProp = propInfo;
						}
						value.MergeProperties(richTextObjectBase);
						if (value._propsToResolve == 0L)
						{
							_propsToResolve &= ~propBit;
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				if (!propInfo.IsDefaultValue(_target, _storage))
				{
					_propsToResolve &= ~propBit;
				}
				else
				{
					propInfo.CopyValue(source, _storage, _target, _storage);
				}
			}

			private void ResolveHelper(StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo propInfo, ulong propBit)
			{
				switch (propInfo._copyMethod)
				{
				case StoragePropsInfo.CopyMethod.CopyValue:
					if (propInfo.IsDefaultValue(_target, _storage))
					{
						_propsToResolve &= ~propBit;
						if (propInfo is IRichTextPropInfo richTextPropInfo)
						{
							richTextPropInfo.SetResolvedDefault(_target);
						}
					}
					break;
				case StoragePropsInfo.CopyMethod.CopyClone:
					_propsToResolve &= ~propBit;
					break;
				default:
					_propsToResolve &= ~propBit;
					break;
				}
			}

			internal static TItem GetUniqueInstance(TItem item)
			{
				TItem value = null;
				if (_ResolvedCache == null)
				{
					_ResolvedCache = new WeakDictionary<TItem, TItem>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: true, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: true, RichTextObjectEqualityComparer<TItem>.Instance);
				}
				else
				{
					_ResolvedCache.TryGetValue(item, out value);
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					return value;
				}
				item.Seal();
				_ResolvedCache[item] = item;
				return item;
			}
		}

		{
			if (IsSealed)

				return;
			}
			StorageProps.Info propsInfo = PropsInfo;
			RichTextStorageProps<RichTextObjectBase>.DefaultStorage defaultStorage = propsInfo._defaultStorage;

				if (value != null)

				}
			}
			num = 0;
			IListInternal listInternal = this as IListInternal;
			IList list = null;
			if (listInternal != null)
			{
				num = listInternal.Count;
			}
			else
			{
				list = this as IList;
				if (list != null)
				{

				}

			{

				PropertyChangeChainContext<T> propertyChangeChainContext = new PropertyChangeChainContext<T>(oldValue, this, propInfo);
				OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(this, propInfo._name, propertyChangeChainContext);
				if (propertyChangeChainContext.CompletionCallback != null)
				{
					propertyChangeChainContext.CompletionCallback(propertyChangeChainContext);
				}
			}

			}
		}

				}

			}
		}

		internal virtual bool SetField<T>(ref T member, T newValue, int? propertyIndex = null)
		{

				return false;
			}
			T oldValue = member;
			VerifyIsMutable();
			PropertyChangeListenerList.ManageListenerHelperObj(ref member, newValue, this, useWeakReference: false);
			if (propertyIndex.HasValue)
			{
				OnPropertyChanged(propertyIndex.Value, oldValue);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool SetFlag(ulong flag, ref ulong flagsMember, out bool oldValue, bool value)
		{
			oldValue = false;
			oldValue = GetFlag(flag, flagsMember);
			if (value == oldValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			VerifyIsMutable();
			if (value)
			{
				flagsMember |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				flagsMember &= ~flag;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool SetFlag(ulong flag, ref ulong flagsMember, ref ulong nonNullFlagsMember, out bool? oldValue, bool? value)
		{
			oldValue = null;
			oldValue = GetFlag(flag, flagsMember, nonNullFlagsMember);
			if (value == oldValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			VerifyIsMutable();
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				nonNullFlagsMember |= flag;
				if (value.Value)
				{
					flagsMember |= flag;
				}
				else
				{
					flagsMember &= ~flag;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				nonNullFlagsMember &= ~flag;
				flagsMember &= ~flag;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void VerifyIsMutable()
		{
			if (IsSealed)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Object is sealed and can not be modified");
			}
		}

		void ITypedSupportPropertyChangeNotifications<object, string>.RemoveListener(ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string> listener)
		{
			RemoveListener(listener);
		}

		void ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string>.OnPropertyValueChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			NotifyListeners(sender, property, extraInfo);
		}

		{
			private Type _type;

			private string _propertyName;

			internal TypeStringKey(Type type, string propertyName)
			{
				_type = type;
				_propertyName = propertyName;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is TypeStringKey)
				{
					return this == (TypeStringKey)obj;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return _type.GetHashCode() ^ _propertyName.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return $"Property: '{_propertyName}', of type: {_type.Name}";
			}

			public static bool operator ==(TypeStringKey key1, TypeStringKey key2)
			{
				if (key1._type == key2._type)
				{
					return key1._propertyName == key2._propertyName;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public static bool operator !=(TypeStringKey key1, TypeStringKey key2)
			{
				return !(key1 == key2);
			}

			public bool Equals(TypeStringKey other)
			{
				return this == other;
			}
		}

		internal struct TypeTypeKey : IEquatable<TypeTypeKey>

				}

		private PropertyChangeChainContext(PropertyChangeChainContext<T> childContext, RichTextObjectBase owner, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo propertyInfo, int? index)
		{
			_child = childContext;

		internal override PropertyChangeChainContextBase CreateOwnerContextChain(RichTextObjectBase owner)
		{
			object owner2 = _owner;
			Type childType = owner2.GetType();
			TypeTypeKey key = new TypeTypeKey(owner.GetType(), childType);
			if (_CompatiblePropMap == null)
			{
				_CompatiblePropMap = new Dictionary<TypeTypeKey, List<StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo>>();
			}
			if (!_CompatiblePropMap.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info ownerProps = owner.PropsInfo;
				value = (from propIndex in ownerProps.GetMatchingProps((StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo i) => i._type.IsAssignableFrom(childType))
					select ownerProps.Props[propIndex]).ToList();
				_CompatiblePropMap.Add(key, value);
			}
			StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo propInfo = null;
			int count = value.Count;
			for (int num = 0; num < count; num++)
			{
				StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo propInfo2 = value[num];
				if (propInfo2.GetValue(owner, owner.PropsInfo._defaultStorage) == owner2)
				{
					propInfo = propInfo2;
					break;
				}
			}
			int? num2 = null;
			if (propInfo == null)
			{
				if (owner is IListInternal listInternal)
				{
					num2 = listInternal.IndexOf(owner2);
				}
				else if (owner is IList list)
				{
					num2 = list.IndexOf(owner2);
				}
				if (!num2.HasValue || num2 < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return new PropertyChangeChainContext<T>(this, owner, propInfo, num2);
		}

		internal override UndoUnit CreateUndoUnit(RichTextDocument document)
		{
			if (_owner is NodeBase)
			{
				return new NodeSubObjectChangedUndoUnit<T>(document, this);
			}
			if (_owner is RichTextStyleBase)
			{

			}
			if (_owner is RichTextList)
			{
				return new ListSubObjectChangedUndoUnit<T>(document, this);
			}
			return null;
		}

		}

		internal class RichTextTypedPropInfo<TValue> : TypedPropInfo<TItem, TValue>, IRichTextPropInfo
		{
			internal readonly Type _ownerType;

			internal readonly Func<TItem, TValue> _getter;

			internal readonly Func<TItem, TValue, bool> _setter;

			internal readonly TValue _resolutionDefault;

			private IEqualityComparer<TValue> _resolvedEqualityComparer;

			CopyMethod IRichTextPropInfo.CopyMethod => _copyMethod;

			object IRichTextPropInfo.DefaultValue => _defaultValue;

			Type IRichTextPropInfo.OwnerType => _ownerType;

			internal RichTextTypedPropInfo(Type ownerType, int key, string name, Func<TItem, IPropertyStorage<TItem, int>> storageRetriever, Func<TItem, TValue> getter, Func<TItem, TValue, bool> setter, TValue resolutionDefault = default(TValue), IValueConverter converter = null, CopyMethod copyMethod = CopyMethod.CopyValue, TValue defaultValue = default(TValue), Func<TItem, TValue> defaultValueFactoryFunc = null, IEqualityComparer<TValue> equalityComparer = null)
				: base(key, name, storageRetriever, (object)null, isReadOnly: false, converter, copyMethod, defaultValue, (Func<TItem, TValue>)null, (IEqualityComparer<TValue>)null, updateDataItemAsynchronously: false, cacheDataItemConvertedValue: false)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(ownerType);
				_ownerType = ownerType;
				_getter = getter;
				_setter = setter;
				_resolutionDefault = resolutionDefault;
				_resolvedEqualityComparer = ResolveEqualityComparer(equalityComparer);
			}

			public override TValue GetValue(object dataItem)
			{
				return _getter((TItem)dataItem);
			}

			private IEqualityComparer<TValue> ResolveEqualityComparer(IEqualityComparer<TValue> defaultEqualityComparer)
			{
				IEqualityComparer<TValue> equalityComparer = defaultEqualityComparer;
				if (equalityComparer == null)
				{
					equalityComparer = ((!typeof(RichTextObjectBase).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(TValue))) ? EqualityComparer<TValue>.Default : ((IEqualityComparer<TValue>)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(RichTextObjectEqualityComparer<>).MakeGenericType(typeof(TValue)))));
				}
				return equalityComparer;
			}

			public void SetResolvedDefault(RichTextObjectBase target)
			{
				_setter((TItem)target, _resolutionDefault);
			}

			int IRichTextPropInfo.GetValueHashCode(RichTextObjectBase item)
			{
				return _resolvedEqualityComparer.GetHashCode(_getter((TItem)item));
			}

			bool IRichTextPropInfo.AreValuesEqual(RichTextObjectBase x, RichTextObjectBase y)
			{
				return _resolvedEqualityComparer.Equals(_getter((TItem)x), _getter((TItem)y));
			}

			bool IRichTextPropInfo.HasDefaultValue(RichTextObjectBase item)
			{
				return _resolvedEqualityComparer.Equals(_getter((TItem)item), _defaultValue);
			}

			void IRichTextPropInfo.SetValueWithNotifications(RichTextObjectBase dest, object value)
			{
				SetValueWithNotifications((TItem)dest, (TValue)value);
			}

			public void SetValueWithNotifications(TItem dest, TValue value)
			{
				TValue oldValue = _getter(dest);
				if (_setter(dest, value))
				{
					dest.OnPropertyChanged(_key, oldValue);
				}
			}

			void IRichTextPropInfo.CopyValueWithNotifications(RichTextObjectBase source, RichTextObjectBase dest)
			{
				SetValueWithNotifications((TItem)dest, _getter((TItem)source));
			}
		}

		internal class DefaultStorage : IPropertyStorage<TItem, int>
		{
			private readonly PropInfo[] _props;

			internal DefaultStorage(RichTextStorageProps<TItem> props)
			{
				IMap<int, PropInfo> props2 = props.Props;
				_props = new PropInfo[(props2.Count() > 0) ? (1 + props2.Max()) : 0];
				foreach (int item in props2)
				{
					_props[item] = props2[item];
				}
			}

			public T GetValue<T>(TItem item, int prop)
			{
				if (_props[prop] is RichTextTypedPropInfo<T> richTextTypedPropInfo)
				{
					return richTextTypedPropInfo._getter(item);
				}
				return (T)((IFieldValueAccessor)_props[prop]).GetValue(item);
			}

			public void SetValue<T>(TItem item, int prop, T newVal)
			{
				if (_props[prop] is RichTextTypedPropInfo<T> richTextTypedPropInfo)
				{
					richTextTypedPropInfo._setter(item, newVal);
				}
				else
				{
					((IFieldValueAccessor)_props[prop]).SetValue(item, newVal);
				}
			}

			public void SetValueWithNotifications<T>(TItem item, int prop, T newVal)
			{
				if (_props[prop] is RichTextTypedPropInfo<T> richTextTypedPropInfo)
				{
					richTextTypedPropInfo.SetValueWithNotifications(item, newVal);
				}
				else
				{
					((IRichTextPropInfo)_props[prop]).SetValueWithNotifications(item, newVal);
				}
			}

			public bool HasValue(TItem item, int prop)
			{
				return !_props[prop].IsDefaultValue(item, this);
			}
		}

		internal Func<TItem, IPropertyStorage<TItem, int>> _storageRetriever;

		internal DefaultStorage _defaultStorage;

		internal readonly ulong _resolverPropertyKeyBits;

		internal readonly int _propertyCount;

		protected RichTextStorageProps()
		{
			_defaultStorage = new DefaultStorage(this);
			_propertyCount = 0;
			foreach (int prop in base.Props)
			{
				_propertyCount++;
				PropInfo propInfo = base.Props[prop];
				if (propInfo._copyMethod != CopyMethod.None && prop <= 63)
				{
					_resolverPropertyKeyBits |= (ulong)(1L << prop);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool CopyContentsOverride(PropInfo propInfo, object sourceVal, object destVal, MergeMethod mergeMethod)
		{
			bool flag = base.CopyContentsOverride(propInfo, sourceVal, destVal, mergeMethod);
			if (!flag && sourceVal is ICollection && destVal is ICollection)
			{
				flag = propInfo.CopyCollectionOfPropertyType((ICollection)sourceVal, (ICollection)destVal);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected override void Initialize(IMap<int, PropInfo> props)
		{
			_storageRetriever = (TItem i) => _defaultStorage;
		}
	}

		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(document, "document");
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(layoutManager, "layoutManager");
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(selectionOwner, "selectionOwner");
			Document = document;
			LayoutManager = layoutManager;
			SelectionOwner = selectionOwner;
			_ranges = new ObservableCollectionExtended<Range>();
			_rangesReadOnly = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<Range>(_ranges);
			_ranges.CollectionChanged += _ranges_CollectionChanged;

			_selectedRows = new List<TableRowNode>(10);
			_clipboardRootNodes = new Dictionary<int, DocumentRootNode>();

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			string arg = ((_range == null) ? "<unset>" : _range.ToString());
			stringBuilder.Append($"Primary Range - {arg}");
			if (_ranges != null && HasMultipleSelectionRanges)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append($", Additional Ranges ({(_ranges.Count - 1).ToString()}) - ");
				for (int i = 0; i < _ranges.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append($"Range #{i.ToString()}-{_ranges[i].ToString()}, ");
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void ApplyFont(RichTextFont font)
		{
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = (ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges ? PendingCharacterSettings : new CharacterSettings());
			characterSettings.FontSettings = new FontSettings();
			characterSettings.FontSettings.Ascii = font;
			characterSettings.FontSettings.EastAsia = font;
			characterSettings.FontSettings.HighAnsi = font;
			characterSettings.FontSettings.ComplexScript = font;
			if (!ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges)
			{
				ApplyCharacterSettingsHelper(characterSettings);
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged("CharacterSettings");
		}

		public void ApplyFontSize(double fontSizeInPoints)
		{
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = (ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges ? PendingCharacterSettings : new CharacterSettings());
			characterSettings.FontSettings = new FontSettings();
			characterSettings.FontSize = new Extent(fontSizeInPoints, ExtentUnitType.Points);
			if (!ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges)
			{
				ApplyCharacterSettingsHelper(characterSettings);
			}

		public bool CanPaste()
		{
			string clipboardFormats = SelectionOwner.ClipboardFormats;
			Dictionary<string, List<SerializationProviderBase>> serializationProvidersByFormat = GetSerializationProvidersByFormat();
			if (clipboardFormats == null || serializationProvidersByFormat == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IDataObject dataObject = ClipboardManager.GetDataObject();
			if (dataObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string[] array = clipboardFormats.Split(',');
			foreach (string format in array)
			{
				if (dataObject.GetDataPresent(format))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Copy()
		{
			CopyHelper(ClipboardOperation.Copy);
		}

		private bool CopyHelper(ClipboardOperation clipboardOperation)
		{
			if (Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string clipboardFormats = SelectionOwner.ClipboardFormats;
			Dictionary<string, List<SerializationProviderBase>> serializationProvidersByFormat = GetSerializationProvidersByFormat();
			if (clipboardFormats == null || serializationProvidersByFormat == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CustomDataObject customDataObject = new CustomDataObject();
			customDataObject.SuspendSynchronizations();
			List<Exception> list = new List<Exception>();
			bool flag = false;
			int num = _nextClipboardOperationId++;
			string[] array = clipboardFormats.Split(',');
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				if (!serializationProvidersByFormat.TryGetValue(text, out var value))
				{
					continue;
				}
				SaveToClipboardContext saveToClipboardContext = new SaveToClipboardContext(this, text, num);
				foreach (SerializationProviderBase item3 in value)
				{
					try
					{
						if (item3.SaveToClipboard(saveToClipboardContext) && saveToClipboardContext.Data != null)
						{
							flag = true;
							customDataObject.SetData(text, saveToClipboardContext.Data);
							break;
						}
					}
					catch (Exception item)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			_clipboardRootNodes.Remove(num);
			customDataObject.ResumeSynchronizations();
			RichTextClipboardOperationCancelEventArgs e = new RichTextClipboardOperationCancelEventArgs(this, clipboardOperation, customDataObject, Utilities.GetExceptionFromMultiple(list));
			SelectionOwner.OnClipboardOperationExecuting(e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			list = new List<Exception>();
			try
			{
				ClipboardManager.SetDataObject(e.DataObject);
			}
			catch (Exception item2)
			{
				list.Add(item2);
			}
			RichTextClipboardOperationEventArgs args = new RichTextClipboardOperationEventArgs(clipboardOperation, e.DataObject, (!flag && list.Count != 0) ? ClipboardOperationStatus.Error : ClipboardOperationStatus.Successful, Utilities.GetExceptionFromMultiple(list));
			SelectionOwner.OnClipboardOperationExecuted(args);
			SelectionOwner.RefreshCommandsCanExecute();
			return true;
		}

		public void Cut()

				DeleteCurrentCharacter();
				Collapse(SelectionCollapseDirection.Start);
			}
		}

		public void Paste()
		{
			IDataObject dataObject = ClipboardManager.GetDataObject();
			if (dataObject == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RichTextClipboardOperationCancelEventArgs e = new RichTextClipboardOperationCancelEventArgs(this, ClipboardOperation.Paste, dataObject);
			SelectionOwner.OnClipboardOperationExecuting(e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			StartUndoLoggingIfNecessary();
			List<Exception> list = new List<Exception>();
			if (e.RootNode != null)
			{
				foreach (Range range in Ranges)
				{
					Document.ReplaceContents(range.DocumentSpan, e.RootNode, out var error, breakParagraphBeforeContent: false, e.BreakParagraphAfterContent);
					if (error != null)
					{
						list.Add(new InvalidOperationException(error));
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			ClipboardOperationStatus status = ((e.RootNode == null) ? ((e.Exception == null && list.Count == 0) ? ClipboardOperationStatus.NoFormatsSupported : ClipboardOperationStatus.Error) : ClipboardOperationStatus.Successful);
			RichTextClipboardOperationEventArgs args = new RichTextClipboardOperationEventArgs(ClipboardOperation.Paste, e.DataObjectUsedToDeserialize, e.SerializationProviderUsedToLoadData, status, Utilities.GetExceptionFromMultiple(list));
			SelectionOwner.OnClipboardOperationExecuted(args);
			Collapse(SelectionCollapseDirection.Start);
		}

		internal void AddCellsToSelectionFromRectangularArea(int startingRowIndex, int rowCount, int startingColumnIndex, int columnCount, TableNode tableNode, bool processBackwards, bool replaceEntireSelection = false, bool addNestedTableCells = true)
		{
			int count = tableNode.Rows.Count;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 1;
			if (processBackwards)
			{
				num = Math.Min(count - 1, startingRowIndex + (rowCount - 1));
				num2 = Math.Max(0, startingRowIndex);
				num3 = -1;
			}
			else
			{
				num = Math.Max(0, startingRowIndex);
				num2 = Math.Min(count - 1, startingRowIndex + (rowCount - 1));
				num3 = 1;
			}
			List<TableCellNode> list = new List<TableCellNode>(50);
			for (int i = num; processBackwards ? (i >= num2) : (i <= num2); i += num3)
			{
				list.AddRange(tableNode.Rows[i].GetCells(startingColumnIndex, columnCount, includeMergedCells: false));
			}
			if (addNestedTableCells)
			{
				TableCellNode[] array = list.ToArray();
				foreach (TableCellNode nodeToProcess in array)
				{
					ProcessNodeForNestedTableCells(list, nodeToProcess);
				}
			}
			AddCellsToSelectionHelper(list, processBackwards: false, replaceEntireSelection);
		}

		private void ProcessNodeForNestedTableCells(List<TableCellNode> cellsList, NodeBase nodeToProcess)
		{
			foreach (NodeBase childNode in nodeToProcess.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (childNode is TableCellNode)
				{
					cellsList.Add(childNode as TableCellNode);
				}
				if (childNode.HasChildNodes)
				{
					ProcessNodeForNestedTableCells(cellsList, childNode);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddCellsToSelectionHelper(IEnumerable<TableCellNode> cells, bool processBackwards, bool replaceEntireSelection = false)
		{
			if (processBackwards)
			{
				cells = cells.Reverse();
			}
			if (replaceEntireSelection)
			{
				ClearSelectedCellsList();
			}
			foreach (TableCellNode cell in cells)
			{
				AddSelectedCell(cell);
				if (_selectionStartReferenceRowCol == null && LayoutManager.NodeMap[cell] is TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode)
				{
					_selectionStartReferenceRowCol = new Tuple<int, int>(tableCellLayoutNode.Row, tableCellLayoutNode.Column);
				}
			}
			UpdateSelectionWithSpans(cells.Select((TableCellNode tableCellNode) => tableCellNode.GetDocumentSpan()), replaceEntireSelection, clearSelectedCellsAndRows: false);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<TableCellNode> AddColumnCellsToSelectionHelper(TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode, TableNode tableNode, bool processBackwards = false, bool replaceEntireSelection = false)
		{
			if (tableCellLayoutNode != null && tableNode != null)
			{
				List<TableCellNode> list = new List<TableCellNode>(10);
				int column = tableCellLayoutNode.Column;
				int num = tableCellLayoutNode.Column + tableCellLayoutNode.ColumnSpan;
				for (int i = column; i < num; i++)
				{
					foreach (TableCellNode item in tableNode.GetCellsInColumn(i, includeMergedCells: true))
					{
						if (tableCellLayoutNode.LayoutManager.NodeMap.TryGetValue(item, out var value) && !((TableCellLayoutNode)value).IgnoreCell)
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
				AddCellsToSelectionHelper(list, processBackwards, replaceEntireSelection);
				return list;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal IEnumerable<TableCellNode> AddRowCellsToSelectionHelper(TableRowLayoutNode tableRowLayoutNode, TableNode tableNode, bool processBackwards = false, bool replaceEntireSelection = false)
		{
			if (tableRowLayoutNode != null && tableNode != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<TableCellNode> cellsInRow = tableNode.GetCellsInRow(tableRowLayoutNode.Row, includeMergedCells: true);
				AddCellsToSelectionHelper(cellsInRow, processBackwards, replaceEntireSelection);
				return cellsInRow;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void BeginNotificationQuietPeriod()
		{
			_startChangeReceivedWhileQuiet = false;
			_endChangeReceivedWhileQuiet = false;
			_lengthChangeReceivedWhileQuiet = false;
			_rangeChangeReceivedWhileQuiet = false;
			_isChangeNotificationQuiet = true;
		}

		{

					RaisePropertyChanged("End");

				}
			}
		}

		internal void Collapse(bool clearSelectedCellsAndRows = true)
		{
			ClearSelectedListIndicators();
			if (IsSelectionInverted)
			{
				Collapse(SelectionCollapseDirection.End);
			}
			else
			{
				Collapse(SelectionCollapseDirection.Start);
			}
			ClearMultipleSelections(raisePropertyChanged: false);
			if (clearSelectedCellsAndRows)
			{
				ClearSelectedCellsAndRows();
			}
		}

		internal bool ContainsOffset(int documentOffset)
		{
			foreach (Range range in Ranges)
			{
				if (range.Contains(documentOffset))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void EndMultiSelection()
		{
			if (!_isMultiSelectInProgress)
			{
				DisplayDebugInfo("EndMultiSelection abort");
				return;
			}
			DisplayDebugInfo("EndMultiSelection begin");
			_isMultiSelectInProgress = false;
			if (Length < 1)
			{
				if (HasMultipleSelectionRanges)
				{
					Range range = _ranges[_ranges.Count - 2];
					SetRange(range.Start, range.End);
				}
				SelectionAnchorOffset = _selectionAnchorOffsetAtStartOfMultiSelect;
			}
			NormalizeRanges();
			if (_isChangeNotificationQuiet)
			{
				_lengthChangeReceivedWhileQuiet = true;
			}
			else
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("Length");
			}
			DisplayDebugInfo("EndMultiSelection end");
		}

		internal void EndNotificationQuietPeriod(bool raisePendingNotifications = true)
		{
			_isChangeNotificationQuiet = false;
			if (raisePendingNotifications)
			{
				if (_startChangeReceivedWhileQuiet)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("Start");
				}
				if (_endChangeReceivedWhileQuiet)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("End");
				}
				if (_lengthChangeReceivedWhileQuiet)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("Length");
				}
				if (_rangeChangeReceivedWhileQuiet)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("Range");
				}
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureAllRangesAreCurrent(bool raisePropertyChangeNotification)
		{
			Range.EnsureStartAndEndVersionsAreCurrent(raisePropertyChangeNotification);
			foreach (Range range in Ranges)
			{
				range.EnsureStartAndEndVersionsAreCurrent(raisePropertyChangeNotification);
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureStartVersionIsCurrent(bool raisePropertyChangeNotification)
		{
			Range.EnsureStartVersionIsCurrent(raisePropertyChangeNotification);
		}

		internal void EstablishSelectionForNavigatedOffset(int newDocumentOffset, bool selectingBackwards, SelectionDirection? selectionDirection)
		{
			double verticalViewOffset = SelectionOwner.VerticalViewOffset;
			int num = ((selectionDirection == SelectionDirection.Left) ? newDocumentOffset : AdjustDocumentOffsetForParagraphMarkIfNecessaryForNavigation(newDocumentOffset, bypassIfSelectionIsZeroLength: false));
			bool flag = num != newDocumentOffset;
			RichTextHitTestInfo richTextHitTestInfo = new RichTextHitTestInfo(LayoutManager);
			richTextHitTestInfo.Update(SelectionStartReferenceOffset, verticalViewOffset);
			RichTextHitTestInfo richTextHitTestInfo2 = new RichTextHitTestInfo(LayoutManager);
			richTextHitTestInfo2.Update(newDocumentOffset, verticalViewOffset);
			RichTextHitTestInfo richTextHitTestInfo3 = new RichTextHitTestInfo(LayoutManager);
			richTextHitTestInfo3.Update(num, verticalViewOffset, delayUpdatesUntilAccessed: false);
			if (!selectionDirection.HasValue || selectionDirection.Value == SelectionDirection.Left || selectionDirection.Value == SelectionDirection.Right)
			{
				richTextHitTestInfo2 = richTextHitTestInfo3;
			}
			SelectionActivityType selectionActivityType = ((richTextHitTestInfo.HitTestArea != RichTextHitTestResultArea.Paragraph || richTextHitTestInfo.TableCellNode == null) ? SelectionActivityType.Select : SelectionActivityType.SelectInsideTableCell);
			int? num2 = ProcessIntraTableSelection(selectionActivityType, richTextHitTestInfo, richTextHitTestInfo2, selectionDirection, flag);
			if (!num2.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			Start = num2.Value;
			SelectionAnchorOffset = num2.Value;
			bool num3 = flag && richTextHitTestInfo3.TableNode == null;
			int? num4 = null;
			if (!num3 && richTextHitTestInfo2.TableNode != null && selectionActivityType != SelectionActivityType.SelectInsideTableCell)
			{
				num4 = richTextHitTestInfo2.TableRowNode.GetDocumentOffset();
				if (!selectingBackwards)
				{
					num4 += richTextHitTestInfo2.TableRowNode.AggregateOffsetCount;
				}
			}
			if (!num4.HasValue)
			{
				num4 = newDocumentOffset;
			}
			SetSelectionEndUsingSelectionAnchor(num4.Value);
		}

		internal void ExtendSelectionToIncludeEntireLineIfNecessary(bool right)
		{
			RichTextDocument document = Document;
			if (End >= document.AggregateOffsetCount)
			{
				return;
			}
			ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphAtDocumentOffset = LayoutManager.GetParagraphAtDocumentOffset(Start);
			if (paragraphAtDocumentOffset == null)

			{

			ParagraphNode paragraphNode = paragraphAtDocumentOffset.DocumentNode as ParagraphNode;
			ParagraphNode paragraphNode2 = paragraphAtDocumentOffset2.DocumentNode as ParagraphNode;
			if (paragraphNode == null || paragraphNode2 == null || GetIsParagraphInTable(paragraphAtDocumentOffset2))

				flag = Length == num - 1;

				}

			{

			}
		}

		internal DocumentRootNode GetClipboardRootNode(int? clipboardOperationId)
		{
			if (!clipboardOperationId.HasValue)
			{
				return ClipboardRootNodeCreator.Create(Document.RootNode, Ranges);
			}
			if (!_clipboardRootNodes.TryGetValue(clipboardOperationId.Value, out var value))
			{
				value = ClipboardRootNodeCreator.Create(Document.RootNode, Ranges);
				_clipboardRootNodes.Add(clipboardOperationId.Value, value);
			}

		}

		internal int GetColumnIndexFromHitTestInfo(RichTextHitTestInfo hitTestInfo, bool selectingBackwards)
		{
			TableLayoutNode tableLayoutNode = hitTestInfo.TableLayoutNode;
			return hitTestInfo.TableCellLayoutNode?.Column ?? GetColumnIndexFromLayoutXOffset(tableLayoutNode, hitTestInfo.LayoutPoint.X);
		}

		internal int GetColumnIndexFromLayoutXOffset(TableLayoutNode tableLayoutNode, double xOffset)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < tableLayoutNode.ColumnCount; i++)
			{
				double logicalPixels = tableLayoutNode.GetColumnOffset(i).LogicalPixels;
				if (xOffset < logicalPixels)
				{
					return Math.Max(0, i - 1);
				}
				if (DoublesAreClose(xOffset, logicalPixels))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return tableLayoutNode.ColumnCount - 1;
		}

		internal int GetRowIndexFromLayoutYOffset(TableLayoutNode tableLayoutNode, double yOffset)
		{
			foreach (LayoutNodeBase childNode in tableLayoutNode.ChildNodes)
			{
				TableRowLayoutNode tableRowLayoutNode = childNode as TableRowLayoutNode;
				double logicalPixels = tableRowLayoutNode.OverallOffsetY.LogicalPixels;
				if (yOffset < logicalPixels)
				{
					return Math.Max(0, tableRowLayoutNode.Row - 1);
				}
			}
			return tableLayoutNode.GetLastRow().Row;
		}

		internal List<Range> GetSortedRanges()
		{
			List<Range> list = _ranges.ToList();
			if (list.Count < 2)
			{
				return list;
			}
			list.Sort(new RangeComparer());
			return list;
		}

				if (line != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			line = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal int? ProcessIntraTableSelection(SelectionActivityType selectionActivityType, RichTextHitTestInfo selectionStartHitTestInfo, RichTextHitTestInfo selectionEndHitTestInfo, SelectionDirection? selectionDirection, bool? isSelectionEndAdjusted)
		{
			int documentOffset = selectionStartHitTestInfo.GetDocumentOffset();
			int documentOffset2 = selectionEndHitTestInfo.GetDocumentOffset();
			bool flag = documentOffset2 < documentOffset;
			int num = documentOffset;
			if (selectionActivityType == SelectionActivityType.SelectTableColumn || selectionActivityType == SelectionActivityType.SelectTableRow || selectionActivityType == SelectionActivityType.SelectTableCell || selectionActivityType == SelectionActivityType.SelectInsideTableCell)
			{
				num = SelectionStartReferenceOffset;
				bool flag2 = selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableNode != null && selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableNode == selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableNode;
				switch (selectionActivityType)
				{
				case SelectionActivityType.SelectTableColumn:
					if (flag2)
					{
						NormalizedStartEnd normalizedStartEnd6 = new NormalizedStartEnd(selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableCellLayoutNode.Column, GetColumnIndexFromHitTestInfo(selectionEndHitTestInfo, flag));
						AddCellsToSelectionHelper(selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableNode.GetCellsInColumns(normalizedStartEnd6.Start, normalizedStartEnd6.Count, includeMergedCells: true), flag, replaceEntireSelection: true);
						return null;
					}
					num = selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableRowNode.GetDocumentOffset();
					if (flag)
					{
						NodeBase documentNode = selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableLayoutNode.GetLastRow().DocumentNode;
						num = documentNode.GetDocumentOffset() + documentNode.AggregateOffsetCount - 1;
					}
					ClearSelectedCellsAndRows();
					break;
				case SelectionActivityType.SelectTableRow:
					if (flag2)
					{
						NormalizedStartEnd normalizedStartEnd3 = new NormalizedStartEnd(selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableRowLayoutNode.Row, selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableRowLayoutNode.Row);
						TableLayoutNode tableLayoutNode = selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableLayoutNode;
						TableNode tableNode = selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableNode;
						List<TableCellNode> list = new List<TableCellNode>(10);
						for (int i = normalizedStartEnd3.Start; i <= normalizedStartEnd3.End; i++)
						{
							list.AddRange(tableNode.GetCellsInRow(tableLayoutNode.GetRowAtIndex(i).Row, includeMergedCells: true));
						}
						AddCellsToSelectionHelper(list, processBackwards: false, replaceEntireSelection: true);
						return null;
					}
					num = selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableRowNode.GetDocumentOffset();
					if (flag)
					{
						num += selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableRowNode.AggregateOffsetCount - 1;
					}
					ClearSelectedCellsAndRows();
					break;
				case SelectionActivityType.SelectTableCell:
					if (flag2)
					{
						NormalizedStartEnd normalizedStartEnd4 = new NormalizedStartEnd(selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableCellLayoutNode.Column, GetColumnIndexFromHitTestInfo(selectionEndHitTestInfo, flag));
						NormalizedStartEnd normalizedStartEnd5 = new NormalizedStartEnd(selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableCellLayoutNode.Row, GetRowIndexFromLayoutYOffset(selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableLayoutNode, selectionEndHitTestInfo.LayoutPoint.Y));
						AddCellsToSelectionFromRectangularArea(normalizedStartEnd5.Start, normalizedStartEnd5.Count, normalizedStartEnd4.Start, normalizedStartEnd4.Count, selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableNode, flag, replaceEntireSelection: true);
						return null;
					}
					num = selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableRowNode.GetDocumentOffset();
					if (flag)
					{
						num += selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableRowNode.AggregateOffsetCount;
					}
					ClearSelectedCellsAndRows();
					break;
				case SelectionActivityType.SelectInsideTableCell:
					if (flag2)
					{
						TableCellNode tableCellNode = selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableCellNode;
						TableCellNode tableCellNode2 = selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableCellNode;
						if (tableCellNode == null || tableCellNode2 == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						if (selectionEndHitTestInfo.HitTestArea == RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCellHorizontalResizeBorder || selectionEndHitTestInfo.HitTestArea == RichTextHitTestResultArea.TableCellVerticalResizeBorder)
						{
							return null;
						}
						bool flag3 = tableCellNode2 == tableCellNode;
						DocumentSpan documentSpan = tableCellNode.GetDocumentSpan();
						DocumentSpan documentSpan2 = tableCellNode2.GetDocumentSpan();
						if (!flag3 && selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableCellNode != null && selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableCellNode != null)
						{
							flag3 = documentSpan.End == documentSpan2.Start && documentSpan2.Start == selectionEndHitTestInfo.GetDocumentOffset();
						}
						bool flag4 = false;
						if (flag3 && isSelectionEndAdjusted.HasValue && isSelectionEndAdjusted.Value)
						{
							flag4 = documentOffset == documentSpan.Start && (documentOffset2 == documentSpan.End || documentOffset2 == documentSpan.End - 1);
						}
						else if (flag3)
						{
							flag4 = documentOffset == documentSpan.Start && documentOffset2 == documentSpan.End;
						}
						if (!flag3 || flag4)
						{
							NormalizedStartEnd normalizedStartEnd = default(NormalizedStartEnd);
							NormalizedStartEnd normalizedStartEnd2 = default(NormalizedStartEnd);
							RowColRange? selectedCellsRowColRange = GetSelectedCellsRowColRange();
							if (Cells.Count() > 0 && selectionDirection.HasValue && selectedCellsRowColRange.HasValue)
							{
								switch (selectionDirection.Value)
								{
								case SelectionDirection.Left:
								{
									bool num3 = selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinCol < selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableCellLayoutNode.Column;
									int minCol = selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinCol;
									normalizedStartEnd = ((!num3) ? new NormalizedStartEnd(selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinCol, Math.Max(0, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxCol - 1)) : new NormalizedStartEnd(Math.Max(0, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinCol - 1), selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxCol));
									int start = ((minCol < 1) ? Math.Max(0, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinRow - 1) : selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinRow);
									normalizedStartEnd2 = new NormalizedStartEnd(start, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxRow);
									break;
								}
								case SelectionDirection.Right:
								{
									bool num2 = selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinCol < selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableCellLayoutNode.Column;
									int maxCol = selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxCol;
									normalizedStartEnd = ((!num2) ? new NormalizedStartEnd(selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinCol, Math.Min(selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableLayoutNode.ColumnCount - 1, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxCol + 1)) : new NormalizedStartEnd(selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinCol + 1, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxCol));
									int end = ((maxCol >= selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableLayoutNode.ColumnCount - 1) ? Math.Min(selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableNode.GetRowCount() - 1, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxRow + 1) : selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxRow);
									normalizedStartEnd2 = new NormalizedStartEnd(selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinRow, end);
									break;
								}
								case SelectionDirection.Up:
									normalizedStartEnd2 = ((selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinRow >= selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableCellLayoutNode.Row) ? new NormalizedStartEnd(selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinRow, Math.Max(0, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxRow - 1)) : new NormalizedStartEnd(Math.Max(0, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinRow - 1), selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxRow));
									normalizedStartEnd = new NormalizedStartEnd(selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinCol, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxCol);
									break;
								case SelectionDirection.Down:
									normalizedStartEnd2 = ((selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinRow >= selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableCellLayoutNode.Row) ? new NormalizedStartEnd(selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinRow, Math.Min(selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableNode.GetRowCount() - 1, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxRow + 1)) : new NormalizedStartEnd(selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinRow + 1, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxRow));
									normalizedStartEnd = new NormalizedStartEnd(selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MinCol, selectedCellsRowColRange.Value.MaxCol);
									break;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								normalizedStartEnd = new NormalizedStartEnd(selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableCellLayoutNode.Column, GetColumnIndexFromHitTestInfo(selectionEndHitTestInfo, flag));
								normalizedStartEnd2 = new NormalizedStartEnd(selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableCellLayoutNode.Row, GetRowIndexFromLayoutYOffset(selectionEndHitTestInfo.TableLayoutNode, selectionEndHitTestInfo.LayoutPoint.Y));
							}
							AddCellsToSelectionFromRectangularArea(normalizedStartEnd2.Start, normalizedStartEnd2.Count, normalizedStartEnd.Start, normalizedStartEnd.Count, selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableNode, flag, replaceEntireSelection: true);
							RowColRange? selectedCellsRowColRange2 = GetSelectedCellsRowColRange();
							if (selectedCellsRowColRange2.HasValue)
							{
								IsSelectionInverted = selectedCellsRowColRange2.Value.MinRow < _selectionStartReferenceRowCol.Item1 || selectedCellsRowColRange2.Value.MinCol < _selectionStartReferenceRowCol.Item2;
							}
							return null;
						}
						num = SelectionStartReferenceOffset;
						ClearSelectedCellsAndRows();
					}
					else
					{
						num = selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableRowNode.GetDocumentOffset();
						if (flag)
						{
							num += selectionStartHitTestInfo.TableRowNode.AggregateOffsetCount;
						}
						ClearSelectedCellsAndRows();
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			_selectionStartReferenceRowCol = null;
			return num;
		}

		internal void RestoreSelectionRangesFromUndoRanges(Range[] undoRanges)
		{
			if (undoRanges == null || undoRanges.Length < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (undoRanges.Length == 1 && undoRanges[0].Length == 1)
			{
				int start = undoRanges[0].Start;
				LayoutManager.EnsureStatusIsComplete();
				if (SelectListIndicatorAtOffset(start))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			Range range = undoRanges[undoRanges.Length - 1];
			SelectionAnchorOffset = range.Start;
			SetRange(range.Start, range.End);
			_ranges.Clear();
			int num = undoRanges.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num - 1; i++)
			{
				Range range2 = undoRanges[i];
				_ranges.Add(new Range(this, Document, range2.Start, range2.End));
			}
			_ranges.Add(Range);
		}

		internal bool SelectListIndicatorAtOffset(int documentOffset)
		{
			if (!GetIsOffsetAtListIndicator(documentOffset))
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
			RichTextDocument document = Document;
			int num = documentOffset;
			ParagraphNode paragraphNode = layoutManager.GetParagraphAtDocumentOffset(documentOffset).DocumentNode as ParagraphNode;
			IsListIndicatorSelectionPending = true;
			SetRange(num, num + 1);
			foreach (ParagraphNode item in document.GetParagraphsInListAtOffset(documentOffset, paragraphNode.ListLevel))
			{
				num = item.GetDocumentOffset();
				SelectedListIndicators.Add(new Range(this, document, num, num + 1));
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged("ListIndicatorSelections");
			IsListIndicatorSelectionPending = false;
			return true;
		}

		internal bool SelectListIndicatorAtPoint(System.Windows.Point layoutPoint)
		{
			int? documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint = LayoutManager.GetDocumentOffsetFromLayoutPoint(Utilities.AdjustPointForYCusp(layoutPoint), includeListNumbers: true);
			_ = Document;
			if (documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint.HasValue && documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint.HasValue)
			{
				return SelectListIndicatorAtOffset(documentOffsetFromLayoutPoint.Value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		internal void StartMultiSelection(int newStart)
		{
			DisplayDebugInfo("StartMultiSelection begin");
			_isMultiSelectInProgress = true;

			DisplayDebugInfo("StartMultiSelection end");
		}

		internal void SetSelectionEndUsingSelectionAnchor(int selectionEnd)
		{
			int num = Start;
			if (Length == 0)
			{
				SelectionAnchorOffset = num;
			}
			else
			{
				num = (SelectionAnchorOffset.HasValue ? SelectionAnchorOffset.Value : num);
			}
			SelectionChangedUsingAnchor = true;
			IsSelectionInverted = selectionEnd < num;
			Range rangeToCombine = new Range(this, Document, num, selectionEnd);
			rangeToCombine = CombineWithAnyIntersectingMultiSelectRanges(rangeToCombine);
			SetRange(rangeToCombine.Start, rangeToCombine.End);
		}

		private int AdjustDocumentOffsetForParagraphMarkIfNecessaryForNavigation(int documentOffset, bool bypassIfSelectionIsZeroLength = true)
		{
			if (bypassIfSelectionIsZeroLength && Length < 1)
			{
				return documentOffset;
			}
			int num = 0;
			DocumentSpan intersectSpan = new DocumentSpan(Math.Max(0, documentOffset - 1), 0);
			foreach (ParagraphNode paragraph in Document.GetParagraphs(intersectSpan))
			{
				int num2 = paragraph.GetDocumentOffset() + paragraph.AggregateOffsetCount;
				if (documentOffset == num2)
				{
					num = 1;
					break;
				}
			}
			return documentOffset - num;
		}

		private void ApplyRemoveBoldItalicFormattingHelper(bool add, bool bold)
		{
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = (ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges ? PendingCharacterSettings : new CharacterSettings());
			if (bold)
			{
				characterSettings.Bold = add;
			}
			else
			{
				characterSettings.Italics = add;
			}
			if (!ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges)
			{
				ApplyCharacterSettingsHelper(characterSettings);
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged("CharacterSettings");
		}

		private void ApplyRemoveSingleDoubleStrikethroughFormattingHelper(bool add, bool single)
		{
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = (ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges ? PendingCharacterSettings : new CharacterSettings());
			if (single)
			{
				characterSettings.StrikeThrough = add;
				if (add)
				{
					characterSettings.DoubleStrikeThrough = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				characterSettings.DoubleStrikeThrough = add;
				if (add)
				{
					characterSettings.StrikeThrough = false;
				}
			}
			if (!ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges)
			{
				ApplyCharacterSettingsHelper(characterSettings);
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged("CharacterSettings");
		}

		private bool ApplyRemoveSmallCapsAllCapsHelper(bool add, bool smallCaps)
		{
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = (ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges ? PendingCharacterSettings : new CharacterSettings());
			if (smallCaps)
			{
				characterSettings.SmallCaps = add;
			}
			else
			{
				characterSettings.AllCaps = add;
			}
			if (!ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges)
			{
				return ApplyCharacterSettingsHelper(characterSettings);
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged("CharacterSettings");
			return false;
		}

		private void ApplyRemoveSuperscriptSubscriptHelper(bool add, bool superscript)
		{
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = (ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges ? PendingCharacterSettings : new CharacterSettings());
			if (superscript)
			{
				characterSettings.VerticalAlignment = (add ? RunVerticalAlignment.Superscript : RunVerticalAlignment.Baseline);
			}
			else
			{
				characterSettings.VerticalAlignment = (add ? RunVerticalAlignment.Subscript : RunVerticalAlignment.Baseline);
			}
			if (!ShouldDeferCharacterSettingChanges)
			{
				ApplyCharacterSettingsHelper(characterSettings);
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged("CharacterSettings");
		}

		private bool ApplyCharacterSettingsHelper(CharacterSettings characterSettings)
		{
			StartUndoLoggingIfNecessary();
			RichTextDocument document = Document;
			string error = null;
			bool flag = true;
			if (Length == 0)
			{
				Range rangeOfContentAtDocumentOffset = LayoutManager.GetRangeOfContentAtDocumentOffset(Start, LayoutManagerBase.RelativeContentPosition.Current);
				DocumentSpan span = new DocumentSpan(rangeOfContentAtDocumentOffset.Start, rangeOfContentAtDocumentOffset.Length);
				document.ApplyCharacterSettings(span, characterSettings, out error);
				flag = string.IsNullOrEmpty(error);
			}
			else
			{
				document.UndoManager.StartTransaction(null, null);
				foreach (DocumentSpan documentSpan in GetDocumentSpans())
				{
					document.ApplyCharacterSettings(documentSpan, characterSettings, out error);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				flag = string.IsNullOrEmpty(error);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
				{
					document.UndoManager.CurrentTransaction.Commit();
				}
				else
				{
					document.UndoManager.CurrentTransaction.Rollback();
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void ApplyParagraphSettingsHelper(ParagraphSettings paragraphSettings)
		{
			StartUndoLoggingIfNecessary();
			string error = null;
			RichTextDocument document = Document;
			document.UndoManager.StartTransaction(null, null);
			foreach (DocumentSpan documentSpan in GetDocumentSpans())
			{
				document.ApplyParagraphSettings(documentSpan, paragraphSettings, out error);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
			{
				document.UndoManager.CurrentTransaction.Commit();
			}
			else
			{
				document.UndoManager.CurrentTransaction.Rollback();
			}
		}

		private bool BeginModificationOperation()
		{
			ISelectionOwner selectionOwner = SelectionOwner;
			if (selectionOwner.IsReadOnlyResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (selectionOwner.IsUndoEnabled)
			{
				Document.StartUndoLogging();
			}
			selectionOwner.OnSelectionModifyingSelectedContent();
			return true;
		}

		private void ClearPendingCharacterSettingsIfNecessary()
		{
			if (Length < 1)
			{
				_pendingCharacterSettings = null;
			}
		}

		private Range CombineWithAnyIntersectingMultiSelectRanges(Range rangeToCombine, bool removeIntersectingMultiSelectRange = true)
		{
			if (GetIsRangeACellRange(rangeToCombine))
			{
				return rangeToCombine;
			}
			ObservableCollectionExtended<Range> ranges = _ranges;
			for (int num = ranges.Count - 2; num > -1; num--)
			{
				Range range = ranges[num];
				if (!GetIsRangeACellRange(range) && (range.Intersects(rangeToCombine) || range.Contains(rangeToCombine) || rangeToCombine.Intersects(range) || rangeToCombine.Contains(range)))
				{
					rangeToCombine.CombineWithRange(range);
					if (removeIntersectingMultiSelectRange)
					{
						ranges.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
			}
			return rangeToCombine;
		}

		private void CompleteModificationOperation()
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			SelectionOwner.OnSelectionModifiedSelectedContent(empty, preserveSelection: true);
		}

		private void DeleteCharacterHelper(bool previous)
		{
			ClearPendingCharacterSettingsIfNecessary();

				return;

			else if (!previous || (int)StartVersioned >= 1)

				ReplaceTextHelper("", new DocumentSpan(offset, 1));
			}
		}

		}

		private static bool DoublesAreClose(double value1, double value2)
		{
			if (value1 == value2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			double num = (Math.Abs(value1) + Math.Abs(value2) + 10.0) * 2.220446049250313E-16;
			double num2 = value1 - value2;
			if (0.0 - num < num2)
			{
				return num > num2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static int EnsureDocumentOffsetIsValid(int documentOffset, RichTextDocument document, bool allowOffsetThatFollowsFinalParagraphMark = false)
		{
			int num = documentOffset;
			int aggregateOffsetCount = document.RootNode.AggregateOffsetCount;
			if (num >= aggregateOffsetCount)
			{
				if (document.GetNodeAtDocumentOffset(aggregateOffsetCount - 1) is ParagraphNode)
				{
					if (!(num == aggregateOffsetCount && allowOffsetThatFollowsFinalParagraphMark))
					{
						num = aggregateOffsetCount - 1;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num = aggregateOffsetCount;
				}
			}
			return Math.Max(0, num);
		}

		internal static DocumentSpan EnsureDocumentSpanIsValid(DocumentSpan documentSpan, RichTextDocument document)
		{
			int num = EnsureDocumentOffsetIsValid(documentSpan.Start, document);
			int num2 = EnsureDocumentOffsetIsValid(documentSpan.End, document);
			return new DocumentSpan(num, num2 - num);
		}

		private IEnumerable<DocumentSpan> GetDocumentSpans(bool includeMultiSelectRanges = true, bool includeListIndicatorRanges = true)
		{
			yield return DocumentSpan;
			if (includeMultiSelectRanges)
			{
				int count = Ranges.Count - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					Range range = Ranges[i];
					yield return new DocumentSpan(range.Start, range.Length);
				}
			}
			if (includeListIndicatorRanges)
			{
				int count2 = SelectedListIndicators.Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
				{
					Range range2 = SelectedListIndicators[j];
					yield return new DocumentSpan(range2.Start, range2.Length);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool GetIsOffsetAtBeginningOfLine(int documentOffset)
		{
			ParagraphLayoutNode paragraphAtDocumentOffset = LayoutManager.GetParagraphAtDocumentOffset(documentOffset);
			if (paragraphAtDocumentOffset != null)
			{
				IRichTextLine lineAtDocumentOffset = paragraphAtDocumentOffset.GetLineAtDocumentOffset(documentOffset);
				if (lineAtDocumentOffset != null)
				{
					int indexOfLine = paragraphAtDocumentOffset.GetIndexOfLine(lineAtDocumentOffset);
					int num = paragraphAtDocumentOffset.DocumentNode.GetDocumentOffset();
					for (int i = 0; i < indexOfLine; i++)
					{
						IRichTextLine lineAtIndex = paragraphAtDocumentOffset.GetLineAtIndex(i);
						if (lineAtIndex != null)
						{
							num += paragraphAtDocumentOffset.GetDocumentOffsetCountOfLine(lineAtIndex, includeListNumber: true, includeNewLine: true);
						}
					}
					return documentOffset == num;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool GetIsOffsetAtBeginningOfList(int documentOffset)
		{
			IEnumerable<ParagraphNode> paragraphsInListAtOffset = Document.GetParagraphsInListAtOffset(documentOffset);
			if (paragraphsInListAtOffset != null)
			{
				ParagraphNode paragraphNode = paragraphsInListAtOffset.First();
				if (documentOffset != paragraphNode.GetDocumentOffset())
				{
					return documentOffset == paragraphNode.GetDocumentOffset() + paragraphNode.PrefixOffsetCount;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GetStartEndOffsetsOfLineContainingOffset(int documentOffset, bool includeListNumbers, bool includeParagraphMark, out int lineStartOffset, out int lineEndOffset)
		{

					lineStartOffset = documentOffsetOfLine.Value;
					lineEndOffset = lineStartOffset + layoutNodeWithLines.GetDocumentOffsetCountOfLine(line, includeListNumbers, includeParagraphMark);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private RowColRange? GetSelectedCellsRowColRange()
		{
			if (Cells.Count() < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			int num2 = int.MaxValue;
			int num3 = int.MinValue;
			int num4 = int.MinValue;
			foreach (TableCellNode cell in Cells)
			{
				TableCellLayoutNode tableCellLayoutNode = LayoutManager.NodeMap[cell] as TableCellLayoutNode;
				num = Math.Min(num, tableCellLayoutNode.Row);
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, tableCellLayoutNode.Row);
				num2 = Math.Min(num2, tableCellLayoutNode.Column);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, tableCellLayoutNode.Column);
			}
			return new RowColRange(num, num3, num2, num4);
		}

		internal Dictionary<string, List<SerializationProviderBase>> GetSerializationProvidersByFormat()
		{
			List<SerializationProviderBase> clipboardSerializationProviders = SelectionOwner.ClipboardSerializationProviders;
			if (clipboardSerializationProviders == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Dictionary<string, List<SerializationProviderBase>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, List<SerializationProviderBase>>();
			foreach (SerializationProviderBase item in clipboardSerializationProviders)
			{
				if (item.SupportedClipboardFormats == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string[] array = item.SupportedClipboardFormats.Split(',');
				foreach (string key in array)
				{
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
					{
						value = new List<SerializationProviderBase>();
						dictionary.Add(key, value);
					}
					value.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private bool MergeRangeIfOverlapping(Range rangeToMerge)
		{
			if (_ranges.Count < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			for (int num = _ranges.Count - 2; num > -1; num--)
			{
				Range range = _ranges[num];
				if (!rangeToMerge.Equals(range) && rangeToMerge.Intersects(range))
				{
					DisplayDebugInfo("CombineOverlappingRanges before remove");
					_ranges.RemoveAt(num);
					DisplayDebugInfo("CombineOverlappingRanges after remove");
					rangeToMerge.CombineWithRange(range);
					DisplayDebugInfo("CombineOverlappingRanges after combining");
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

			if (!select && Length > 0)

			RichTextHitTestInfo richTextHitTestInfo = new RichTextHitTestInfo(LayoutManager);
			richTextHitTestInfo.Update(num2, SelectionOwner.VerticalViewOffset);
			double num3 = 0.0;

			if (!up && richTextHitTestInfo.TableCellLayoutNode == null && Length > 0 && isOffsetAtBeginningOfLine)
			{
				num3 = 2147483647.0;
			}
			else

				if (num != num2)

					System.Windows.Point? point = LayoutPointFromDocumentOffset(num, LayoutManagerBase.CaretContext.EndOfSelection);
