		private void NormalizeRanges()
		{
			if (_ranges.Count < 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			ObservableCollectionExtended<Range> ranges = _ranges;
			for (int num = ranges.Count - 2; num > -1; num--)
			{
				if (ranges[num].Length == 0)
				{
					ranges.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			bool flag = true;
			while (flag)
			{
				flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < _ranges.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					Range range = _ranges[i];
					if (!GetIsRangeACellRange(range))
					{
						if (GetIsRangeContainedWithinAnotherRange(range))
						{
							_ranges.RemoveAt(i);
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						if (MergeRangeIfOverlapping(range))
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnRangePropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.PropertyName)
			{
			case "Start":
				if (_isChangeNotificationQuiet)
				{
					_startChangeReceivedWhileQuiet = true;
					_lengthChangeReceivedWhileQuiet = true;
				}
				else
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("Start");
					RaisePropertyChanged("Length");
				}
				break;
			case "End":
				if (_isChangeNotificationQuiet)
				{
					_endChangeReceivedWhileQuiet = true;
					_lengthChangeReceivedWhileQuiet = true;
				}
				else
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("End");
					RaisePropertyChanged("Length");
				}
				break;
			case "Length":
				if (Range.Length == 0 && !_isMultiSelectInProgress)
				{
					ClearMultipleSelections(raisePropertyChanged: false);
				}
				break;
			case "Range":
				if (_isChangeNotificationQuiet)
				{
					_rangeChangeReceivedWhileQuiet = true;
					break;
				}
				RaisePropertyChanged("Range");
				ClearSelectedListIndicators();
				break;
			}
			DisplayDebugInfo($"OnProperty '{e.PropertyName}' Changed");
		}

		private void _ranges_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			if (!SelectionChangedUsingAnchor)
			{
				SelectionAnchorOffset = null;
			}
			_shouldDeferCharacterSettingsChanges = null;
			if (propertyName != "CharacterSettings")
			{
				_pendingCharacterSettings = null;
			}
		}

		internal void ReplaceTextHelper(string text, DocumentSpan span)
		{
			StartUndoLoggingIfNecessary();
			int aggregateOffsetCount = Document.RootNode.AggregateOffsetCount;
			_ = span.Length;
			if (span.End <= aggregateOffsetCount || aggregateOffsetCount - span.Start > 0)
			{
				SelectionOwner.OnSelectionReplacingText(span);
				string error = string.Empty;
				Document.ReplaceContents(span, text, out error);
				SelectionOwner.OnSelectionReplacedText(error);
			}
		}

		internal void SetSelectedText(string newText, bool preserveSelection)
		{
			SetSelectedTextHelper(newText, Document, Range, SelectionOwner, preserveSelection);
		}

		internal static void SetSelectedTextHelper(string newText, RichTextDocument document, Range range, ISelectionOwner selectionOwner, bool preserveSelection)
		{
			SetSelectedTextHelper(newText, document, new Range[1] { range }, selectionOwner, preserveSelection);
		}

		internal static void SetSelectedTextHelper(string newText, RichTextDocument document, Range[] ranges, ISelectionOwner selectionOwner, bool preserveSelection)
		{
			if (!selectionOwner.IsReadOnlyResolved)
			{
				if (selectionOwner.IsUndoEnabled)
				{
					document.StartUndoLogging();
				}
				selectionOwner.OnSelectionModifyingSelectedContent();
				string error = string.Empty;
				foreach (Range range in ranges)
				{
					range.EnsureStartAndEndVersionsAreCurrent(raisePropertyChangeNotification: false);
					DocumentSpan span = EnsureDocumentSpanIsValid(new DocumentSpan(range.Start, range.Length), document);
					document.ReplaceContents(span, newText, out error);
				}
				selectionOwner.OnSelectionModifiedSelectedContent(error, preserveSelection);
			}
		}

		internal void StartUndoLoggingIfNecessary()
		{
			ISelectionOwner selectionOwner = SelectionOwner;
			if (!selectionOwner.IsReadOnlyResolved && selectionOwner.IsUndoEnabled)
			{
				Document.StartUndoLogging();
			}
		}

		private void ToggleAllCapsSmallCapsFormattingHelper(bool smallCaps)
		{
			CharacterSettings commonCharacterSettings = Document.GetCommonCharacterSettings(GetSpanOfFirstCharacterInSelection());
			bool flag = ResolveNullableBool(commonCharacterSettings.SmallCaps);
			bool flag2 = ResolveNullableBool(commonCharacterSettings.AllCaps);
			bool flag3 = flag;
			bool flag4 = flag2;
			if (smallCaps)
			{
				if (!flag && PendingCharacterSettings.SmallCaps.HasValue)
				{
					flag = PendingCharacterSettings.SmallCaps.Value;
				}
				flag3 = !flag;
				if (flag3)
				{
					flag4 = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!flag2 && PendingCharacterSettings.AllCaps.HasValue)
				{
					flag2 = PendingCharacterSettings.AllCaps.Value;
				}
				flag4 = !flag2;
				if (flag4)
				{
					flag3 = false;
				}
			}
			RichTextDocument document = Document;
			document.UndoManager.StartTransaction(null, null);
			bool flag5 = ApplyRemoveSmallCapsAllCapsHelper(flag3, smallCaps: true);
			if (flag5)
			{
				flag5 = ApplyRemoveSmallCapsAllCapsHelper(flag4, smallCaps: false);
			}
			if (flag5)
			{
				document.UndoManager.CurrentTransaction.Commit();
			}
			else
			{
				document.UndoManager.CurrentTransaction.Rollback();
			}
		}

		private void ToggleBoldItalicFormattingHelper(bool bold)
		{
			CharacterSettings commonCharacterSettings = Document.GetCommonCharacterSettings(GetSpanOfFirstCharacterInSelection());
			bool flag = (bold ? ResolveNullableBool(commonCharacterSettings.Bold) : ResolveNullableBool(commonCharacterSettings.Italics));
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (bold)
				{
					if (PendingCharacterSettings.Bold.HasValue)
					{
						flag = PendingCharacterSettings.Bold.Value;
					}
				}
				else if (PendingCharacterSettings.Italics.HasValue)
				{
					flag = PendingCharacterSettings.Italics.Value;
				}
			}
			bool add = !flag;
			ApplyRemoveBoldItalicFormattingHelper(add, bold);
		}

		private void ToggleBulletNumberFormattingHelper(bool bullet)
		{
			if (!BeginModificationOperation())
			{
				return;
			}
			RichTextDocument document = Document;
			DocumentSpan documentSpan = DocumentSpan;
			string commonParagraphListStyle = document.GetCommonParagraphListStyle(documentSpan);
			string error = null;
			if (bullet)
			{
				switch (commonParagraphListStyle)
				{
				case "Bullet":
				case "BulletCircle":
				case "BulletArrow":
				case "Bullet_Check":
				case "BulletSquare":
				case "BulletDiamond":
				case "BulletDiamondArrow":
					document.ClearParagraphListStyle(documentSpan, out error);
					if (IsListIndicatorSelected)
					{
						ClearSelectedListIndicators();
					}
					break;
				default:
					document.ApplyParagraphListStyle(documentSpan, "Bullet", out error);
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (commonParagraphListStyle)
				{
				case "Decimal":
				case "DecimalConcatenated":
				case "DecimalParenthesis":
				case "DecimalParenthesisHybrid":
				case "LowerLetter":
				case "LowerLetterParenthesis":
				case "LowerRoman":
				case "UpperLetter":
				case "UpperRoman":
					document.ClearParagraphListStyle(documentSpan, out error);
					if (IsListIndicatorSelected)
					{
						ClearSelectedListIndicators();
					}
					break;
				default:
					document.ApplyParagraphListStyle(documentSpan, "Decimal", out error);
					break;
				}
			}
			CompleteModificationOperation();
		}

		private void ToggleSuperscriptSubscriptFormattingHelper(bool superscript)
		{
			CharacterSettings commonCharacterSettings = Document.GetCommonCharacterSettings(GetSpanOfFirstCharacterInSelection());
			RunVerticalAlignment runVerticalAlignment = (commonCharacterSettings.VerticalAlignment.HasValue ? commonCharacterSettings.VerticalAlignment.Value : RunVerticalAlignment.Baseline);
			if (runVerticalAlignment == RunVerticalAlignment.Baseline && PendingCharacterSettings.VerticalAlignment.HasValue)
			{
				runVerticalAlignment = PendingCharacterSettings.VerticalAlignment.Value;
			}
			RunVerticalAlignment runVerticalAlignment2 = runVerticalAlignment;
			if (superscript)
			{
				switch (runVerticalAlignment)
				{
				case RunVerticalAlignment.Baseline:
					runVerticalAlignment2 = RunVerticalAlignment.Superscript;
					break;
				case RunVerticalAlignment.Superscript:
					runVerticalAlignment2 = RunVerticalAlignment.Baseline;
					break;
				case RunVerticalAlignment.Subscript:
					runVerticalAlignment2 = RunVerticalAlignment.Superscript;
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (runVerticalAlignment)
				{
				case RunVerticalAlignment.Baseline:
					runVerticalAlignment2 = RunVerticalAlignment.Subscript;
					break;
				case RunVerticalAlignment.Superscript:
					runVerticalAlignment2 = RunVerticalAlignment.Subscript;
					break;
				case RunVerticalAlignment.Subscript:
					runVerticalAlignment2 = RunVerticalAlignment.Baseline;
					break;
				}
			}
			ApplyRemoveSuperscriptSubscriptHelper(runVerticalAlignment2 != RunVerticalAlignment.Baseline, superscript);
		}

		private void ToggleSingleDoubleStrikethroughFormattingHelper(bool single)
		{
			CharacterSettings commonCharacterSettings = Document.GetCommonCharacterSettings(GetSpanOfFirstCharacterInSelection());
			bool flag = (single ? ResolveNullableBool(commonCharacterSettings.StrikeThrough) : ResolveNullableBool(commonCharacterSettings.DoubleStrikeThrough));
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (single)
				{
					if (PendingCharacterSettings.StrikeThrough.HasValue)
					{
						flag = PendingCharacterSettings.StrikeThrough.Value;
					}
				}
				else if (PendingCharacterSettings.DoubleStrikeThrough.HasValue)
				{
					flag = PendingCharacterSettings.DoubleStrikeThrough.Value;
				}
			}
			bool add = !flag;
			ApplyRemoveSingleDoubleStrikethroughFormattingHelper(add, single);
		}

		private void UpdateSelectionWithSpans(IEnumerable<DocumentSpan> spans, bool replaceEntireSelection = false, bool clearSelectedCellsAndRows = true)
		{
			if (spans == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginNotificationQuietPeriod();
			try
			{
				ObservableCollectionExtended<Range> ranges = _ranges;
				if (replaceEntireSelection)
				{
					Collapse(clearSelectedCellsAndRows);
					ranges.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					int count = ranges.Count;
					if (count > 0)
					{
						Range value = ranges[count - 1].Clone();
						ranges[count - 1] = value;
					}
				}
				DocumentSpan[] array = spans.ToArray();
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					RichTextDocument document = Document;
					DocumentSpan documentSpan;
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length - 1; i++)
					{
						documentSpan = array[i];
						ranges.Add(new Range(this, document, documentSpan.Start, documentSpan.End));
					}
					ranges.Add(Range);
					documentSpan = array[array.Length - 1];
					Start = documentSpan.Start;
					SelectionAnchorOffset = documentSpan.Start;
					SetSelectionEndUsingSelectionAnchor(documentSpan.End);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndNotificationQuietPeriod();
			}
		}

		public void Collapse(SelectionCollapseDirection collapseDirection)
		{
			Range.Collapse(collapseDirection);
		}

		private bool ResolveNullableBool(bool? nullableBool)
		{
			if (nullableBool.HasValue && nullableBool.Value)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void SetRange(int start, int end)
		{
			Range range = new Range(this, Document, start, end);
			Range.SetRange(range.Start, range.End);
		}
	}

	internal struct NormalizedStartEnd
	{
		internal int Start;

		internal int End;

		internal int Count;

		internal NormalizedStartEnd(int start, int end)
		{
			Start = start;
			End = end;
			if (end < start)
			{
				Start = end;
				End = start;
			}
			Count = End - Start + 1;
		}
	}

					}, map);

		private InternalFlags OtherFontFlags => _flags & InternalFlags.OtherFontFlags;

		internal static bool AreFontSettingsEquivalent(CharacterType characterType, CharacterSettings settings1, CharacterSettings settings2)
		{
			if (settings1.OtherFontFlags == settings2.OtherFontFlags && settings1.GetFontFlags(characterType) == settings2.GetFontFlags(characterType))
			{
				Extent? fontSize = settings1._fontSize;
				Extent? fontSize2 = settings2._fontSize;
				if (fontSize.HasValue == fontSize2.HasValue && (!fontSize.HasValue || fontSize.GetValueOrDefault() == fontSize2.GetValueOrDefault()) && settings1._fontKerning == settings2._fontKerning)
				{
					RunVerticalAlignment? verticalAlignment = settings1._verticalAlignment;
					RunVerticalAlignment? verticalAlignment2 = settings2._verticalAlignment;
					if (verticalAlignment.GetValueOrDefault() == verticalAlignment2.GetValueOrDefault() && verticalAlignment.HasValue == verticalAlignment2.HasValue && settings1.GetFont(characterType, useFallback: false) == settings2.GetFont(characterType, useFallback: false))
					{
						RichTextFont? font = settings1.GetFont(characterType, useFallback: true);
						RichTextFont? font2 = settings2.GetFont(characterType, useFallback: true);
						if (font.HasValue != font2.HasValue)
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (!font.HasValue)
						{
							return true;
						}
						return font.GetValueOrDefault() == font2.GetValueOrDefault();
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal int GetFontEquivalentHashCode(CharacterType characterType)
		{
			InternalFlags fontFlags = GetFontFlags(characterType);
			InternalFlags otherFontFlags = OtherFontFlags;
			int num = fontFlags.GetHashCode() ^ otherFontFlags.GetHashCode() ^ _fontKerning.GetHashCode() ^ _fontSize.GetHashCode() ^ _verticalAlignment.GetHashCode();
			RichTextFont? richTextFont = GetFont(characterType, useFallback: false) ?? GetFont(characterType, useFallback: true);
			if (richTextFont.HasValue)
			{
				num ^= richTextFont.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num ^ GetFontSize(characterType).GetHashCode();
		}

		private InternalFlags GetFontFlags(CharacterType characterType)
		{
			return (InternalFlags)((uint)_flags & (uint)((characterType == CharacterType.ComplexScript) ? 12 : 129));
		}

		private Extent? GetFontSize(CharacterType characterType)
		{
			if (characterType != CharacterType.ComplexScript || !_complexScriptFontSize.HasValue)
			{
				return _fontSize;
			}
			return _complexScriptFontSize;
		}

		private RichTextFont? GetFont(CharacterType characterType, bool useFallback)
		{
			if (_fontSettings == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (useFallback)
			{
				return _fontSettings.Ascii;
			}
			return _fontSettings.GetFont(characterType);
		}

		private bool? GetFlag(InternalFlags flag)
		{
			return RichTextObjectBase.GetFlag((ulong)flag, (ulong)_flags, (ulong)_nonNullFlags);
		}

		private bool SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool? value, int? notificationPropIndex = null)
		{
			ulong flagsMember = (ulong)_flags;
			ulong nonNullFlagsMember = (ulong)_nonNullFlags;
			bool? oldValue;
			bool num = SetFlag((ulong)flag, ref flagsMember, ref nonNullFlagsMember, out oldValue, value);
			if (num)
			{
				_flags = (InternalFlags)flagsMember;
				_nonNullFlags = (InternalFlags)nonNullFlagsMember;
				if (notificationPropIndex.HasValue)
				{
					OnPropertyChanged(notificationPropIndex.Value, oldValue);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

						CreateProp(4, "Hint", (FontSettings i) => (i._extendedInfo != null) ? i.ExInfo._hint : ((FontUsageHint?)null), (FontSettings i, FontUsageHint? v) => i.SetField(ref i.ExInfo._hint, v))
					}, map);
				}

				private RichTextTypedPropInfo<TValue> CreateProp<TValue>(int prop, string name, Func<FontSettings, TValue> getter, Func<FontSettings, TValue, bool> setter, CopyMethod copyMethod = CopyMethod.CopyValue)
				{

		private class ExtendedInfo : IEquatable<ExtendedInfo>
		{
			internal RichTextFont? _complexScript;

			internal RichTextFont? _eastAsia;

			internal RichTextFont? _highAnsi;

			internal FontUsageHint? _hint;

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				int num = _hint.GetHashCode();
				if (_complexScript.HasValue)
				{
					num ^= _complexScript.GetHashCode();
				}
				if (_eastAsia.HasValue)
				{
					num ^= _eastAsia.GetHashCode();
				}
				if (_highAnsi.HasValue)
				{
					num ^= _highAnsi.GetHashCode();
				}
				return num;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is ExtendedInfo extendedInfo))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (_complexScript == extendedInfo._complexScript)
				{
					RichTextFont? eastAsia = _eastAsia;
					RichTextFont? eastAsia2 = extendedInfo._eastAsia;
					if (eastAsia.HasValue == eastAsia2.HasValue && (!eastAsia.HasValue || eastAsia.GetValueOrDefault() == eastAsia2.GetValueOrDefault()) && _highAnsi == extendedInfo._highAnsi)
					{
						return _hint == extendedInfo._hint;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public bool Equals(ExtendedInfo other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
		}

		private RichTextFont? _ascii;

		private ExtendedInfo _extendedInfo;

		internal override RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info PropsInfo => StorageProps.Info.Instance;

		public RichTextFont? Ascii
		{
			get
			{
				return _ascii;
			}
			set
			{
				ValidateFont(value);
				SetField(ref _ascii, value, 0);
			}
		}

		public RichTextFont? ComplexScript
		{
			get
			{
				if (_extendedInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _extendedInfo._complexScript;
			}
			set
			{
				ValidateFont(value);
				SetField(ref ExInfo._complexScript, value, 1);
			}
		}

		public RichTextFont? EastAsia
		{
			get
			{
				if (_extendedInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _extendedInfo._eastAsia;
			}
			set
			{
				ValidateFont(value);
				SetField(ref ExInfo._eastAsia, value, 2);
			}
		}

		public RichTextFont? HighAnsi
		{
			get
			{
				if (_extendedInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _extendedInfo._highAnsi;
			}
			set
			{
				ValidateFont(value);
				SetField(ref ExInfo._highAnsi, value, 3);
			}
		}

		public FontUsageHint? Hint
		{
			get
			{
				if (_extendedInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _extendedInfo._hint;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref ExInfo._hint, value, 4);
			}
		}

		private ExtendedInfo ExInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (_extendedInfo == null)
				{
					_extendedInfo = new ExtendedInfo();
				}
				return _extendedInfo;
			}
		}

		internal RichTextFont? GetFont(CharacterType characterType)
		{
			return characterType switch
			{
				CharacterType.HighAnsi => HighAnsi, 
				CharacterType.EastAsian => EastAsia, 
				CharacterType.ComplexScript => ComplexScript, 
				_ => Ascii, 
			};
		}

		private static void ValidateFont(RichTextFont? value)
		{
			if (value.HasValue && !value.Value.IsValid)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_NoNameFont"), "value");
			}
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(IndentationConverter))]
	public struct Indentation : IEquatable<Indentation>
	{
		private readonly Extent? _extent;

		private readonly int? _characterPercent;

		public Extent? Extent => _extent;

		public int? CharacterPercent => _characterPercent;

		public Indentation(Extent extent)
		{
			_extent = extent;
			_characterPercent = null;
		}

		public Indentation(int characterPercent)
		{
			_extent = null;
			_characterPercent = characterPercent;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _characterPercent.GetHashCode() ^ _extent.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is Indentation)
			{
				return this == (Indentation)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(Indentation indent1, Indentation indent2)
		{
			if (indent1._extent == indent2._extent)
			{
				return indent1._characterPercent == indent2._characterPercent;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(Indentation indent1, Indentation indent2)
		{
			return !(indent1 == indent2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_extent.HasValue)
			{
				return _extent.ToString();
			}
			if (_characterPercent.HasValue)
			{
				return $"{_characterPercent.Value} % of a character";
			}
			return "??";
		}

		internal Extent CalculateExtent(FontSpecification font)
		{
			if (_extent.HasValue)
			{
				return _extent.Value;
			}
			if (_characterPercent.HasValue && font != null)
			{
				return new Extent(font.WidthOfSpace.LogicalPixels * (double)_characterPercent.Value / 100.0, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			}
			return default(Extent);
		}

		internal string Serialize(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			if (_extent.HasValue)
			{
				return _extent.Value.Serialize(formatProvider);
			}
			if (_characterPercent.HasValue)
			{
				return $"{_characterPercent.Value}%";
			}
			return "";
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string value, IFormatProvider formatProvider, out Indentation result)
		{
			result = new Indentation(0);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
			if (value[value.Length - 1] == '%')
			{
				if (int.TryParse(value.Substring(0, value.Length - 1), NumberStyles.AllowTrailingWhite | NumberStyles.AllowLeadingSign | NumberStyles.AllowThousands, formatProvider, out var result2))
				{
					result = new Indentation(result2);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (Infragistics.Documents.RichText.Extent.TryParse(value, formatProvider, out var result3))
			{
				result = new Indentation(result3);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(Indentation other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	internal class IndentationConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string value2 && Indentation.TryParse(value2, culture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is Indentation && destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return ((Indentation)value).Serialize(culture);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(FirstLineIndentationConverter))]
	public struct FirstLineIndentation : IEquatable<FirstLineIndentation>
	{
		private readonly Indentation _indentation;

		private readonly bool _isHanging;

		public Indentation Indentation => _indentation;

		public bool IsHanging => _isHanging;

		public FirstLineIndentation(Indentation indentation, bool isHanging)
		{
			_indentation = indentation;
			_isHanging = isHanging;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			FirstLineIndentation? firstLineIndentation = obj as FirstLineIndentation?;
			if (!firstLineIndentation.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_indentation == firstLineIndentation.Value._indentation)
			{
				return _isHanging == firstLineIndentation.Value._isHanging;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _indentation.GetHashCode() ^ (_isHanging ? 268435455 : 0);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _indentation.ToString();
		}

		public static bool operator ==(FirstLineIndentation indent1, FirstLineIndentation indent2)
		{
			if (indent1._indentation == indent2._indentation)
			{
				return indent1._isHanging == indent2._isHanging;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(FirstLineIndentation indent1, FirstLineIndentation indent2)
		{
			return !(indent1 == indent2);
		}

		internal string Serialize(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(_indentation.Serialize(formatProvider));
			if (_isHanging)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" hanging");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string value, IFormatProvider formatProvider, out FirstLineIndentation result)
		{
			result = new FirstLineIndentation(new Indentation(0), isHanging: false);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
			bool isHanging = false;
			if (value.Contains("hanging"))
			{
				isHanging = true;
				string[] array = value.Split(new string[1] { "hanging" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				if (array.Length == 1)
				{
					value = array[0];
				}
				else
				{
					if (array.Length != 2)
					{
						return false;
					}
					array[0] = array[0].Trim();
					array[1] = array[1].Trim();
					if (array[0].Length > 0)
					{
						if (array[1].Length > 0)
						{
							return false;
						}
						value = array[0];
					}
					else
					{
						if (array[1].Length <= 0)
						{
							return false;
						}
						value = array[1];
					}
				}
			}
			if (Indentation.TryParse(value, formatProvider, out var result2))
			{
				result = new FirstLineIndentation(result2, isHanging);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(FirstLineIndentation other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	internal class FirstLineIndentationConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string value2 && FirstLineIndentation.TryParse(value2, culture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is FirstLineIndentation && destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return ((FirstLineIndentation)value).Serialize(culture);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

		private bool? GetFlag(InternalFlags flag)
		{
			return RichTextObjectBase.GetFlag((ulong)flag, (ulong)_flags, (ulong)_nonNullFlags);
		}

		private bool SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool? value, int? notificationPropIndex = null)
		{
			ulong flagsMember = (ulong)_flags;
			ulong nonNullFlagsMember = (ulong)_nonNullFlags;
			bool? oldValue;
			bool num = SetFlag((ulong)flag, ref flagsMember, ref nonNullFlagsMember, out oldValue, value);
			if (num)
			{
				_flags = (InternalFlags)flagsMember;
				_nonNullFlags = (InternalFlags)nonNullFlagsMember;
				if (notificationPropIndex.HasValue)
				{
					OnPropertyChanged(notificationPropIndex.Value, oldValue);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(LineSpacingConverter))]
	public struct LineSpacing : IEquatable<LineSpacing>
	{
		private readonly Extent? _extent;

		private readonly ExtentRule _rule;

		private readonly float? _lineFactor;

		internal const string SingleLiteral = "single";

		internal const string DoubleLiteral = "double";

		public Extent? Extent => _extent;

		public float? LineFactor => _lineFactor;

		public ExtentRule Rule => _rule;

		public LineSpacing(Extent extent, ExtentRule rule)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(extent.Twips, "extent");
			if (rule != ExtentRule.AtLeast && rule != ExtentRule.Exact)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidLineSpacing"));
			}
			_extent = extent;
			_rule = rule;
			_lineFactor = null;
		}

		public LineSpacing(float lineFactor)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(lineFactor, "lineFactor");
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotInfinity(lineFactor);
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNan(lineFactor);
			_extent = null;
			_lineFactor = lineFactor;
			_rule = ExtentRule.Auto;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _lineFactor.GetHashCode() ^ _extent.GetHashCode() ^ _rule.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is LineSpacing)
			{
				return this == (LineSpacing)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(LineSpacing spacing1, LineSpacing spacing2)
		{
			Extent? extent = spacing1._extent;
			Extent? extent2 = spacing2._extent;
			if (extent.HasValue == extent2.HasValue && (!extent.HasValue || extent.GetValueOrDefault() == extent2.GetValueOrDefault()) && spacing1._lineFactor == spacing2._lineFactor)
			{
				return spacing1._rule == spacing2._rule;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(LineSpacing spacing1, LineSpacing spacing2)
		{
			return !(spacing1 == spacing2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_extent.HasValue)
			{
				return $"{_rule} {_extent.Value}";
			}
			if (_lineFactor.HasValue)
			{
				return $"{_lineFactor.Value} times the height of a line.";
			}
			return _rule.ToString();
		}

		internal Extent CalculateLineHeight(FontSpecification font)
		{
			switch (_rule)
			{
			case ExtentRule.AtLeast:
				if (_extent.HasValue && _extent.Value > font.Height)
				{
					return _extent.Value;
				}
				break;
			case ExtentRule.Exact:
				if (_extent.HasValue)
				{
					return _extent.Value;
				}
				break;
			case ExtentRule.Auto:
				if (_lineFactor.HasValue)
				{
					return new Extent(font.Height.LogicalPixels * (double)_lineFactor.Value, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
				}
				break;
			}
			return font.Height;
		}

		internal string Serialize(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			if (_lineFactor.HasValue)
			{
				if (_lineFactor == 1f)
				{
					return "single";
				}
				if (_lineFactor == 2f)
				{
					return "double";
				}
				return $"{_lineFactor.Value.ToString(formatProvider)}x";
			}
			if (_rule == ExtentRule.Auto)
			{
				return "auto";
			}
			string text = _extent.Value.Serialize(formatProvider);
			if (_rule == ExtentRule.AtLeast)
			{
				return $"atleast {text}";
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string value, IFormatProvider formatProvider, out LineSpacing result)
		{
			result = new LineSpacing(1f);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
			switch (value)
			{
			case "auto":
				result = new LineSpacing(new Extent(0.0), ExtentRule.Auto);
				return true;
			case "single":
				result = new LineSpacing(1f);
				return true;
			case "double":
				result = new LineSpacing(2f);
				return true;
			default:
			{
				if (value[value.Length - 1] == 'x' && float.TryParse(value.Substring(0, value.Length - 1), NumberStyles.AllowTrailingWhite | NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint | NumberStyles.AllowThousands, formatProvider, out var result2))
				{
					result = new LineSpacing(result2);
					return true;
				}
				ExtentRule rule = ExtentRule.Exact;
				if (value.Length > 7 && value.Substring(0, 7) == "atleast")
				{
					rule = ExtentRule.AtLeast;
					value = value.Substring(7);
				}
				if (Infragistics.Documents.RichText.Extent.TryParse(value, formatProvider, out var result3) && !(result3.Emus < 0.0))
				{
					result = new LineSpacing(result3, rule);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			}
		}

		public bool Equals(LineSpacing other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	internal class LineSpacingConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string value2 && LineSpacing.TryParse(value2, culture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is LineSpacing && destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return ((LineSpacing)value).Serialize(culture);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ParagraphVerticalSpacingConverter))]
	public struct ParagraphVerticalSpacing : IEquatable<ParagraphVerticalSpacing>
	{
		private Extent? _extent;

		private int? _linePercent;

		public static readonly ParagraphVerticalSpacing Auto = new ParagraphVerticalSpacing(isAuto: true);

		public Extent? Extent => _extent;

		public int? LinePercent => _linePercent;

		public bool IsAuto
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_linePercent.HasValue)
				{
					return !_extent.HasValue;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private ParagraphVerticalSpacing(bool isAuto)
		{
			_extent = null;
			_linePercent = null;
		}

		public ParagraphVerticalSpacing(Extent extent)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(extent.Twips, "extent");
			_extent = extent;
			_linePercent = null;
		}

		public ParagraphVerticalSpacing(int linePercent)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(linePercent, "linePercent");
			_extent = null;
			_linePercent = linePercent;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _linePercent.GetHashCode() ^ _extent.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ParagraphVerticalSpacing)
			{
				return this == (ParagraphVerticalSpacing)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(ParagraphVerticalSpacing spacing1, ParagraphVerticalSpacing spacing2)
		{
			if (spacing1._extent == spacing2._extent)
			{
				return spacing1._linePercent == spacing2._linePercent;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ParagraphVerticalSpacing spacing1, ParagraphVerticalSpacing spacing2)
		{
			return !(spacing1 == spacing2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_extent.HasValue)
			{
				return _extent.ToString();
			}
			if (_linePercent.HasValue)
			{
				return $"{_linePercent.Value} % of a line";
			}
			return "Auto";
		}

		internal Extent CalculateExtext(FontSpecification font, bool isBeforeSpacing, bool isFirstNodeInParent, bool isLastNodeInParent, bool isInTable)
		{
			if (_extent.HasValue)
			{
				return _extent.Value;
			}
			if (_linePercent.HasValue)
			{
				return new Extent(font.Height.LogicalPixels * (double)_linePercent.Value / 100.0, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
			}
			if (isBeforeSpacing)
			{
				if (isFirstNodeInParent)
				{
					return default(Extent);
				}
			}
			else if (isLastNodeInParent && isInTable)
			{
				return default(Extent);
			}
			return new Extent(font.Height.LogicalPixels, ExtentUnitType.LogicalPixels);
		}

		internal string Serialize(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			if (IsAuto)
			{
				return "auto";
			}
			if (_linePercent.HasValue)
			{
				return $"{_linePercent.Value.ToString(formatProvider)}%";
			}
			return _extent.Value.Serialize(formatProvider);
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string value, IFormatProvider formatProvider, out ParagraphVerticalSpacing result)
		{
			result = Auto;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
			if (value == "auto")
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (value[value.Length - 1] == '%')
			{
				if (int.TryParse(value.Substring(0, value.Length - 1), NumberStyles.AllowTrailingWhite | NumberStyles.AllowThousands, formatProvider, out var result2))
				{
					result = new ParagraphVerticalSpacing(result2);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (Infragistics.Documents.RichText.Extent.TryParse(value, formatProvider, out var result3) && !(result3.Emus < 0.0))
			{
				result = new ParagraphVerticalSpacing(result3);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(ParagraphVerticalSpacing other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	internal class ParagraphVerticalSpacingConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}

			{
				return _bottomLeftToTopRight;
			}
			set
			{
				SetField(ref _bottomLeftToTopRight, value, 7);
			}
		}

		internal RichTextBorder GetBorder(BorderSide borderSide)
		{
			return borderSide switch
			{
				BorderSide.Start => base.Start, 
				BorderSide.Top => base.Top, 
				BorderSide.End => base.End, 
				BorderSide.Bottom => base.Bottom, 
				BorderSide.BottomRightToTopLeft => BottomRightToTopLeft, 
				BorderSide.BottomLeftToTopRight => BottomLeftToTopRight, 
				BorderSide.InsideHorizontal => base.InsideHorizontal, 
				BorderSide.InsideVertical => base.InsideVertical, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal void SetBorder(BorderSide borderSide, RichTextBorder value)
		{
			switch (borderSide)
			{
			case BorderSide.Start:
				base.Start = value;
				break;
			case BorderSide.Top:
				base.Top = value;
				break;
			case BorderSide.End:
				base.End = value;
				break;
			case BorderSide.Bottom:
				base.Bottom = value;
				break;
			case BorderSide.BottomRightToTopLeft:
				BottomRightToTopLeft = value;
				break;
			case BorderSide.BottomLeftToTopRight:
				BottomLeftToTopRight = value;
				break;
			case BorderSide.InsideHorizontal:
				base.InsideHorizontal = value;
				break;
			case BorderSide.InsideVertical:
				base.InsideVertical = value;
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(TableRowHeightConverter))]
	public struct TableRowHeight : IEquatable<TableRowHeight>
	{
		internal class TableRowHeightConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}

			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (value is string value2 && TryParse(value2, culture, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (value is TableRowHeight && destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return ((TableRowHeight)value).Serialize(culture);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		private static readonly TableRowHeight _auto = new TableRowHeight(default(Extent), ExtentRule.Auto);

		private readonly Extent _extent;

		private readonly ExtentRule _rule;

		public static TableRowHeight Auto => _auto;

		public Extent Extent => _extent;

		public ExtentRule Rule => _rule;

		public TableRowHeight(Extent extent, ExtentRule rule)
		{
			switch (rule)
			{
			case ExtentRule.Exact:
				if (extent.Twips < 1.0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidHeight_2"));
				}
				break;
			case ExtentRule.AtLeast:
				if (extent.Twips < 0.0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidHeight_3"));
				}
				break;
			case ExtentRule.Auto:
				if (extent.Twips != 0.0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidHeight_4"));
				}
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidHeight_5"));
			}
			_extent = extent;
			_rule = rule;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _extent.GetHashCode() ^ _rule.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is TableRowHeight)
			{
				return this == (TableRowHeight)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(TableRowHeight height1, TableRowHeight height2)
		{
			if (height1._extent == height2._extent)
			{
				return height1._rule == height2._rule;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(TableRowHeight height1, TableRowHeight height2)
		{
			return !(height1 == height2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_rule == ExtentRule.Auto)
			{
				return "Auto";
			}
			return $"{_rule} {_extent}";
		}

		internal string Serialize(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			if (_rule == ExtentRule.Auto)
			{
				return "auto";
			}
			string text = _extent.Serialize(formatProvider);
			if (_rule == ExtentRule.AtLeast)
			{
				return $"atleast {text}";
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string value, IFormatProvider formatProvider, out TableRowHeight result)
		{
			result = new TableRowHeight(new Extent(0.0), ExtentRule.Auto);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
			if (value == "auto")
			{
				return true;
			}
			ExtentRule rule = ExtentRule.Exact;
			if (value.Length > 7 && value.Substring(0, 7) == "atleast")
			{
				rule = ExtentRule.AtLeast;
				value = value.Substring(7);
			}
			if (Extent.TryParse(value, formatProvider, out var result2) && !(result2.Emus < 0.0))
			{
				result = new TableRowHeight(result2, rule);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(TableRowHeight other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}

	{

		private TabStopLeader _leader;

		public TabStopAlignment Alignment
		{
			get

			set

				_alignment = value;
			}
		}

		public TabStopLeader Leader
		{
			get
			{
				return _leader;
			}
			set
			{
				_leader = value;
			}
		}

		public Extent Position
		{
			get
			{
				return _position;
			}
			set
			{
				_position = value;
			}
		}

		public TabStop(Extent position, TabStopAlignment alignment = TabStopAlignment.Start, TabStopLeader leader = TabStopLeader.None)
		{
			_position = position;
			_alignment = alignment;
			_leader = leader;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _position.GetHashCode() ^ _alignment.GetHashCode() ^ (_leader.GetHashCode() << 1);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is TabStop)
			{
				return this == (TabStop)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static implicit operator Extent(TabStop stop)
		{
			return stop._position;
		}

		public static bool operator >(TabStop stop, TabStop other)
		{
			return ((IComparable<TabStop>)stop).CompareTo(other) > 0;
		}

		public static bool operator <(TabStop stop, TabStop other)
		{
			return ((IComparable<TabStop>)stop).CompareTo(other) < 0;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(TabStop stop1, TabStop stop2)
		{
			if (stop1._position == stop2._position && stop1._alignment == stop2._alignment)
			{
				return stop1.Leader == stop2.Leader;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(TabStop stop1, TabStop stop2)
		{
			return !(stop1 == stop2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{_alignment} tab at position {_position}";
		}

		public bool Equals(TabStop other)
		{
			return other == this;
		}

		int IComparable<TabStop>.CompareTo(TabStop other)
		{
			int num = ((IComparable<Extent>)_position).CompareTo(other._position);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return _alignment.CompareTo(other._alignment);
		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(TextFrameHeightConverter))]
	public struct TextFrameHeight : IEquatable<TextFrameHeight>
	{
		private static readonly TextFrameHeight _auto = new TextFrameHeight(null, ExtentRule.Auto);

		private readonly Extent? _extent;

		private readonly ExtentRule _rule;

		public static TextFrameHeight Auto => _auto;

		public Extent? Extent => _extent;

		public ExtentRule Rule => _rule;

		public TextFrameHeight(Extent? extent, ExtentRule rule)
		{
			if (extent.HasValue)
			{
				CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(extent.Value.Twips, "extent");
			}
			if (rule == ExtentRule.AtLeast || rule == ExtentRule.Exact)
			{
				if (!extent.HasValue)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidRule_1"));
				}
			}
			else if (extent.HasValue)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_InvalidRule_2"));
			}
			_extent = extent;
			_rule = rule;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _extent.GetHashCode() ^ _rule.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is TextFrameHeight)
			{
				return this == (TextFrameHeight)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(TextFrameHeight height1, TextFrameHeight height2)
		{
			if (height1._extent == height2._extent)
			{
				return height1._rule == height2._rule;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(TextFrameHeight height1, TextFrameHeight height2)
		{
			return !(height1 == height2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_extent.HasValue)
			{
				return $"{_rule} {_extent.Value}";
			}
			return _rule.ToString();
		}

		internal string Serialize(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			if (_rule == ExtentRule.Auto)
			{
				return "auto";
			}
			string text = _extent.Value.Serialize(formatProvider);
			if (_rule == ExtentRule.AtLeast)
			{
				return $"atleast {text}";
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string value, IFormatProvider formatProvider, out TextFrameHeight result)
		{
			result = new TextFrameHeight(null, ExtentRule.Auto);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
			if (value == "auto")
			{
				return true;
			}
			ExtentRule rule = ExtentRule.Exact;
			if (value.Length > 7 && value.Substring(0, 7) == "atleast")
			{
				rule = ExtentRule.AtLeast;
				value = value.Substring(7);
			}
			if (Infragistics.Documents.RichText.Extent.TryParse(value, formatProvider, out var result2))
			{
				result = new TextFrameHeight(result2, rule);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(TextFrameHeight other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	internal class TextFrameHeightConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string value2 && TextFrameHeight.TryParse(value2, culture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is TextFrameHeight && destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return ((TextFrameHeight)value).Serialize(culture);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ShadingConverter))]
	public struct Shading : IEquatable<Shading>
	{
		private ColorInfo _background;

		private ShadingPattern _pattern;

		private ColorInfo _patternColor;

		private const char Delimiter = ':';

		public ColorInfo Background => _background;

		public ShadingPattern Pattern => _pattern;

		public ColorInfo PatternColor => _patternColor;

		public Shading(ColorInfo background)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(background, "background");
			_background = background;
			_pattern = ShadingPattern.Clear;
			_patternColor = null;
		}

		public Shading(ColorInfo background, ShadingPattern pattern, ColorInfo patternColor)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(background, "background");
			CoreUtilities.ValidateEnum(typeof(ShadingPattern), pattern);
			_background = background;
			_pattern = pattern;
			_patternColor = patternColor;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (_background == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int hashCode = _background.GetHashCode();
			hashCode ^= _pattern.GetHashCode();
			if (_patternColor != null)
			{
				hashCode ^= _patternColor.GetHashCode();
			}
			return hashCode;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is Shading)
			{
				return this == (Shading)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(Shading shading1, Shading shading2)
		{
			if (shading1._background == shading2._background && shading1._pattern == shading2._pattern)
			{
				return shading1._patternColor == shading2._patternColor;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(Shading thickness1, Shading thickness2)
		{
			return !(thickness1 == thickness2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_background == null)
			{
				return base.ToString();
			}
			if (_patternColor == null)
			{
				return $"{_background} background";
			}
			return $"{_background} background with a pattern of {_pattern}: {_patternColor}";
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color GetResolvedBackgroundColor(RichTextDocument document)
		{
			if (_background == null)
			{
				return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			return _background.GetResolvedColor(document, AutomaticColorUsageType.Background);
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color GetResolvedBackgroundColor(DocumentRootNode documentRootNode)
		{
			if (_background == null)
			{
				return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			return _background.GetResolvedColor(documentRootNode, AutomaticColorUsageType.Background);
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color? GetResolvedPatternColor(RichTextDocument document)
		{
			if (_patternColor == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _patternColor.GetResolvedColor(document, AutomaticColorUsageType.Foreground);
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color? GetResolvedPatternColor(DocumentRootNode documentRootNode)
		{
			if (_patternColor == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _patternColor.GetResolvedColor(documentRootNode, AutomaticColorUsageType.Foreground);
		}

		internal string Serialize(CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (_pattern == ShadingPattern.Clear && PatternColor == null && _background != null)
			{
				return _background.Serialize(culture);
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(_pattern.ToString());
			if (_background != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(':');
				stringBuilder.Append(_background.Serialize(culture));
			}
			if (_patternColor != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(':');
				stringBuilder.Append(_patternColor.Serialize(culture));
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string stringValue, CultureInfo culture, out Shading result)
		{
			result = default(Shading);
			if (stringValue == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string[] array = stringValue.Trim().Split(':');
			if (array.Length == 0 || array.Length > 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ColorInfo result2 = null;
			ColorInfo result3;
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				if (ColorInfo.TryParse(array[0], culture, out result3))
				{
					result = new Shading(result3);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (!Enum.TryParse<ShadingPattern>(array[0], out var result4))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ColorInfo.TryParse(array[1], culture, out result3))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (array.Length > 2 && !ColorInfo.TryParse(array[2], culture, out result2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			result = new Shading(result3, result4, result2);
			return true;
		}

		public bool Equals(Shading other)
		{
			return other == this;
		}
	}
	internal class ShadingConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)

				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string stringValue && Shading.TryParse(stringValue, culture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is Shading && destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return ((Shading)value).Serialize(culture);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

	{

		}

		public const string CommonScriptCode = "Zyyy";

		private static string[][] _scriptCodesLookup;

		private static byte[] _scriptCodesIndexesByChar = GetScriptCodesIndexesByChar();

		internal static readonly string[] g_nccActionNames = GetNCCActionEnumNamesHelper<NotifyCollectionChangedAction>();

		internal static readonly Extent ZeroExtent = default(Extent);

		internal static System.Windows.Media.Color WindowTextColor => System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowTextColor;

		internal static Indentation Add(Indentation? x, Extent amount, bool allowNegative = true)
		{
			return new Indentation(Add(x.HasValue ? x.Value.Extent : ((Extent?)null), amount, allowNegative));
		}

		internal static Extent Add(Extent? x, Extent? y, bool allowNegative = true)
		{
			Extent result = ((!x.HasValue || !y.HasValue) ? (x ?? y ?? ZeroExtent) : (x.Value + y.Value));
			if (!allowNegative && result.Twips < 0.0)
			{
				result = ZeroExtent;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static void AddListener(ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications notifier, IPropertyChangeListener listener, bool useWeakReference)
		{
			notifier.AddListener(listener, useWeakReference);
		}

		internal static void AddListenerHelper(object notifier, Action<object, object, string, object> handler, object owner)
		{
			PropertyChangeListener<object> listener = new PropertyChangeListener<object>(owner, handler);
			((ISupportPropertyChangeNotifications)notifier).AddListener(listener, useWeakReference: false);
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Point AdjustPointForYCusp(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y + 1.0);
		}

		public static bool AnyNonGeneric(this IEnumerable enumerable)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = enumerable.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					_ = enumerator.Current;
					return true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool AreCollectionEqual<TItem>(IList<TItem> x, IList<TItem> y, Func<TItem, TItem, bool> areEqual)
		{
			int count = x.Count;
			if (count != y.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!areEqual(x[i], y[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool AreEquivalent(Transform t1, Transform t2)
		{
			if (t1 == null && t2 == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (t1 == null || t2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Matrix.Equals(t1.Value, t2.Value);
		}

		internal static bool AreIdsEqual(string xId, string yId)
		{
			return StringComparer.InvariantCulture.Equals(xId, yId);
		}

		internal static bool AreRTOsEqual(RichTextObjectBase x, RichTextObjectBase y, bool considerNullAsEmptyRTO = false)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				if (!considerNullAsEmptyRTO)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x == null)
				{
					x = y.PropsInfo.CreateNew();
				}
				else
				{
					y = x.PropsInfo.CreateNew();
				}
			}
			return x.PropsInfo.AreObjectsEqualOverride(x, y);
		}

		internal static ImageLayoutInfo CreateImageLayoutInfo(System.Windows.Size imageSize, RectOffsets? cropping, RichTextImageTransform transform, bool calculateSizeOnly)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			ImageLayoutInfo result = default(ImageLayoutInfo);
			result._imageSize = imageSize;
			result._imageTransform = null;
			result._imageCropAreaTransform = null;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			double num6 = 0.0;
			if (cropping.HasValue)
			{
				if (cropping.Value.Top != 0.0)
				{
					num3 = imageSize.Height * cropping.Value.Top / 100.0;
				}
				if (cropping.Value.Bottom != 0.0)
				{
					num4 = imageSize.Height * cropping.Value.Bottom / 100.0;
				}
				if (cropping.Value.Left != 0.0)
				{
					num5 = imageSize.Width * cropping.Value.Left / 100.0;
				}
				if (cropping.Value.Right != 0.0)
				{
					num6 = imageSize.Width * cropping.Value.Right / 100.0;
				}
				if (num3 != 0.0 || num5 != 0.0)
				{
					result._imageTransform = new TranslateTransform();
					result._imageTransform.X = 0.0 - num5;
					result._imageTransform.Y = 0.0 - num3;
				}
				num = num5 + num6;
				num2 = num3 + num4;
			}
			double num7 = Math.Max(imageSize.Width - num, 2.0);
			double num8 = Math.Max(imageSize.Height - num2, 2.0);
			result._imageCropAreaSize = new System.Windows.Size(num7, num8);
			TransformCollection transformCollection = new TransformCollection();
			if (transform == null)
			{
				result._imageOuterAreaSize = result._imageCropAreaSize;
				result._stretchSizeResolved = result._imageCropAreaSize;
			}
			else
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = (result._stretchSizeResolved = transform.StretchSize.ToSize() ?? result._imageCropAreaSize);
				double num9 = GetFlipScaleMultiplier(transform.FlipHorizontally) * size.Width / num7;
				double num10 = GetFlipScaleMultiplier(transform.FlipVertically) * size.Height / num8;
				if (num9 != 1.0 || num10 != 1.0)
				{
					transformCollection.Add(new ScaleTransform
					{
						ScaleX = num9,
						ScaleY = num10,
						CenterX = num7 / 2.0,
						CenterY = num8 / 2.0
					});
				}
				if (!calculateSizeOnly && transform.RotationAngle != 0f)
				{
					transformCollection.Add(new RotateTransform
					{
						Angle = transform.RotationAngle,
						CenterX = size.Width / 2.0,
						CenterY = size.Height / 2.0
					});
				}
				if (transformCollection.Count == 0)
				{
					result._imageOuterAreaSize = result._imageCropAreaSize;
				}
				else
				{
					result._imageCropAreaTransform = new TransformGroup
					{
						Children = transformCollection
					};
					Rect rect = result._imageCropAreaTransform.TransformBounds(new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), result._imageCropAreaSize));
					result._imageOuterAreaSize = new System.Windows.Size(rect.Width, rect.Height);
					if (rect.X != 0.0 || rect.Y != 0.0)
					{
						transformCollection.Add(new TranslateTransform
						{
							X = 0.0 - rect.Left,
							Y = 0.0 - rect.Top
						});
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static List<DocumentSpan> CompactAndSortSpans(IEnumerable<DocumentSpan> spans)
		{
			IOrderedEnumerable<DocumentSpan> orderedEnumerable = spans.OrderBy((DocumentSpan i) => i.Start);
			List<DocumentSpan> list = new List<DocumentSpan>();
			DocumentSpan? documentSpan = null;
			foreach (DocumentSpan item in orderedEnumerable)
			{
				if (documentSpan.HasValue)
				{
					DocumentSpan? documentSpan2 = Union(documentSpan.Value, item);
					if (documentSpan2.HasValue)
					{
						documentSpan = documentSpan2;
						continue;
					}
					list.Add(documentSpan.Value);
				}
				documentSpan = item;
			}
			if (documentSpan.HasValue)
			{
				list.Add(documentSpan.Value);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal static ListStyle CreateListStyle(string id, string name, int sortPriority, ListLevelDefinition[] initialLevels, ListLevelDefinition[] repeatLevels, bool concatenateLevelText = false, bool indentFirstLevel = true)
		{
			ListStyle listStyle = new ListStyle();
			listStyle.Id = id;
			listStyle.Name = name;
			listStyle.SortPriority = sortPriority;
			Extent extent = RichTextDocument.DefaultTabStopExtent;
			Extent extent2 = new Extent(extent.Twips / 2.0);
			Extent extent3 = new Extent(extent.Twips / 4.0);
			Extent extent4 = new Extent(0.0);
			if (!indentFirstLevel)
			{
				extent = extent2;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = null;
			if (concatenateLevelText)
			{
				stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			}
			ListLevelDefinitionCollection listLevelDefinitionCollection = new ListLevelDefinitionCollection();
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++)
			{
				ListLevelDefinition listLevelDefinition;
				if (initialLevels != null && initialLevels.Length > i)
				{
					listLevelDefinition = initialLevels[i];
				}
				else
				{
					listLevelDefinition = repeatLevels[num];
					num = ((num != repeatLevels.Length - 1) ? (num + 1) : 0);
				}
				ListLevelDefinition listLevelDefinition2 = listLevelDefinition.Clone() as ListLevelDefinition;
				listLevelDefinition2.Level = i;
				listLevelDefinition2.Start = 1;
				if (listLevelDefinition2.NumberFormat != NumberFormat.Bullet)
				{
					string text = string.Format(listLevelDefinition2.LevelText, i + 1);
					if (concatenateLevelText)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(text);
						listLevelDefinition2.LevelText = stringBuilder.ToString();
					}
					else
					{
						listLevelDefinition2.LevelText = text;
					}
				}
				extent4 += extent;
				ParagraphIndentationSettings paragraphIndentationSettings = new ParagraphIndentationSettings();
				paragraphIndentationSettings.Start = new Indentation(extent4);
				Extent extent5 = ((i != 0 && listLevelDefinition2.NumberAlignment == NumberAlignment.End) ? extent3 : extent2);
				paragraphIndentationSettings.FirstLine = new FirstLineIndentation(new Indentation(extent5), isHanging: true);
				listLevelDefinition2.ParagraphSettings = new ParagraphSettings
				{
					Indentation = paragraphIndentationSettings
				};
				listLevelDefinitionCollection.Add(listLevelDefinition2);
			}
			listStyle.Template = new ListTemplate
			{
				LevelDefinitions = listLevelDefinitionCollection
			};
			return listStyle;
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		public static void DebugVerifyExpectedCommonBaseType<T>(object x, object y, string message)
		{
			if (x != null && y != null)
			{
				HashSet<Type> hashSet = new HashSet<Type>();
				Type type = x.GetType();
				while (type != null)
				{
					hashSet.Add(type);
					type = type.BaseType;
				}
				Type type2 = y.GetType();
				while (type2 != null && !hashSet.Contains(type2))
				{
					type2 = type2.BaseType;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static int GetCollectionHashCode<TItem>(IList<TItem> items, Func<TItem, int> getHashCode)
		{
			int count = items.Count;
			int num = count.GetHashCode();
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				num ^= getHashCode(items[i]);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static CharType GetChartype(char chr)
		{
			switch (chr)
			{
			case ',':
				return CharType.Comma;
			case '\n':
			case '\r':
				return CharType.NewLine;
			case '.':
				return CharType.Period;
			case ' ':
				return CharType.Space;
			case '\t':
				return CharType.Tab;
			case '\'':
				return CharType.SingleQuote;
			case '"':
				return CharType.DoubleQuote;
			case '0':
			case '1':
			case '2':
			case '3':
			case '4':
			case '5':
			case '6':
			case '7':
			case '8':
			case '9':
				return CharType.Digit;
			default:
				if (char.IsLetter(chr))
				{
					return CharType.Letter;
				}
				if (char.IsPunctuation(chr))
				{
					return CharType.Punctuation;
				}
				return CharType.Other;
			}
		}

		private static string[] GetNCCActionEnumNamesHelper<TEnum>() where TEnum : struct
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TEnum);
			if (!typeFromHandle.IsEnum)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			Array values = Enum.GetValues(typeFromHandle);
			Dictionary<int, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				object value = values.GetValue(i);
				int key = (int)CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(int), null, null);
				dictionary[key] = Enum.GetName(typeFromHandle, value);
			}
			string[] array = new string[1 + dictionary.Keys.Max()];
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				if (dictionary.TryGetValue(j, out var value2))
				{
					array[j] = value2;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal static TEnum[] GetEnumValuesHelper<TEnum>() where TEnum : struct
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TEnum);
			if (!typeFromHandle.IsEnum)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return (TEnum[])Enum.GetValues(typeFromHandle);
		}

		public static Exception GetExceptionFromMultiple(List<Exception> exceptions)
		{
			return exceptions.Count switch
			{
				0 => null, 
				1 => exceptions[0], 
				_ => new AggregateException(exceptions), 
			};
		}

		}

		internal static ListLevelDefinition GetLevelDefinitionSafe(RichTextList listInfo, int level)
		{

				ListTemplate templateResolved = listInfo.TemplateResolved;
				if (templateResolved != null)
				{
					ListLevelDefinitionCollection levelDefinitions = templateResolved.LevelDefinitions;
					if (levelDefinitions != null && level >= 0 && level < levelDefinitions.Count)
					{

					}
					return null;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

				{
					return i;
				}
			}

		}

		public static string GetPlainTextListIndicator(RichTextListItemInfo listItemInfo, DocumentRootNode rootNode)
		{
			if (!(listItemInfo.Indicator is string text))
			{
				return "*";
			}
			if (text.Length != 1)
			{
				return text;
			}
			ListLevelDefinition levelDefinition = listItemInfo.LevelDefinition;
			if (levelDefinition == null || levelDefinition.NumberFormat != NumberFormat.Bullet)
			{
				return text;
			}
			if (text == "•")
			{
				return "*";
			}
			string text2 = null;
			CharacterSettings numberSettings = levelDefinition.NumberSettings;
			if (numberSettings != null && numberSettings.FontSettings != null)
			{
				CharacterSettings indicatorSettingsResolved = listItemInfo.IndicatorSettingsResolved;
				text2 = numberSettings.FontSettings.GetFont(SerializationUtilities.GetCharacterType("*"[0], indicatorSettingsResolved)).GetValueOrDefault().GetResolvedFontName(rootNode, indicatorSettingsResolved, "*"[0]);
			}
			if (!(text2 == "Symbol"))
			{
				if (text2 == "Wingdings")
				{
					if (text[0] == '\uf0d8')
					{
						return ">";
					}
					return "*";
				}
				return text;
			}
			return "*";
		}

		public static string GetPlainTextListIndicatorAndSuffix(RichTextListItemInfo listItemInfo, DocumentRootNode rootNode)
		{
			return string.Concat(str1: listItemInfo.LevelDefinition.NumberSuffix switch
			{
				NumberSuffix.Nothing => string.Empty, 
				NumberSuffix.Space => " ", 
				_ => "\t", 
			}, str0: GetPlainTextListIndicator(listItemInfo, rootNode));
		}

		internal static TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags GetRequiredAreaFlags(TableArea area)
		{
			switch (area)
			{
			case TableArea.TopLeftCell:
				return TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.FirstColumn | TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.FirstRow;
			case TableArea.TopRightCell:
				return TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.FirstRow | TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.LastColumn;
			case TableArea.BottomLeftCell:
				return TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.FirstColumn | TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.LastRow;
			case TableArea.BottomRightCell:
				return TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.LastColumn | TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.LastRow;
			case TableArea.EvenColumnBanding:
			case TableArea.OddColumnBanding:
				return TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.VerticalBanding;
			case TableArea.EvenRowBanding:
			case TableArea.OddRowBanding:
				return TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.HorizontalBanding;
			case TableArea.FirstColumn:
				return TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.FirstColumn;
			case TableArea.FirstRow:
				return TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.FirstRow;
			case TableArea.LastColumn:
				return TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.LastColumn;
			case TableArea.LastRow:
				return TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags.LastRow;
			case TableArea.WholeTable:
				return (TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags)0;
			default:
				return (TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags)0;
			}
		}

		internal static TChild GetRelativeVisibleParaChildNode<TParent, TChild>(TParent parent, bool next, TChild child = null, bool includeHiddenRuns = false) where TParent : LayoutNodeBase, IRunLayoutNodeContainer where TChild : ParagraphChildLayoutNodeBase
		{
			LayoutNodeCollection childNodes = parent.ChildNodes;
			if (childNodes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = childNodes.Count;
			int i = ((child == null) ? ((!next) ? (count - 1) : 0) : childNodes.IndexOf(child));
			if (i < 0 || i >= count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = (next ? 1 : (-1));
			int num2 = (next ? count : (-1));
			if (child != null)
			{
				i += num;
			}
			for (; i != num2; i += num)
			{
				child = childNodes[i] as TChild;
				if (includeHiddenRuns || child.IsVisible)
				{
					return child;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static RichTextStyleCollection GetStyleCollection(NodeBase n)
		{
			if (n != null)
			{
				DocumentRootNode rootNode = n.RootNode;

		}

		public static bool HasAllDefaultProperties<T>(T value) where T : RichTextObjectBase
		{
			IMap<int, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo> props = value.PropsInfo.Props;
			foreach (int item in props)
			{
				if (props[item] is IRichTextPropInfo richTextPropInfo && !richTextPropInfo.HasDefaultValue(value))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (value is IListInternal { Count: not 0 })
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value is IEnumerable enumerable && enumerable.AnyNonGeneric())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool HasCommonScriptCode(char a, char b)
		{
			byte b2 = _scriptCodesIndexesByChar[(uint)a];
			byte b3 = _scriptCodesIndexesByChar[(uint)b];
			if (b2 == b3)
			{
				return true;
			}
			string[] a2 = _scriptCodesLookup[b2];
			string[] b4 = _scriptCodesLookup[b3];
			if (a2.Length < b4.Length)
			{
				Swap(ref a2, ref b4);
			}
			foreach (string text in a2)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < b4.Length; j++)
				{
					if (b4[j] == text)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool HasItems<T>(T[] items)
		{
			if (items != null)
			{
				return items.Length != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool HasSameItems<T>(IList<T> x, IList<T> y, bool orderIsSignificant)
		{
			int num = x?.Count ?? 0;
			int num2 = y?.Count ?? 0;
			if (num != num2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				if (orderIsSignificant || 1 == num)
				{
					return CoreUtilities.AreEqual(x, y);
				}
				return ((x as HashSet<T>) ?? new HashSet<T>(x)).SetEquals(y);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool HasSameOwnerHelper(StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo rtoPropX, StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo rtoPropY)
		{
			IRichTextPropInfo richTextPropInfo = rtoPropX as IRichTextPropInfo;
			IRichTextPropInfo richTextPropInfo2 = rtoPropY as IRichTextPropInfo;
			if (richTextPropInfo != null && richTextPropInfo2 != null)
			{
				return richTextPropInfo.OwnerType == richTextPropInfo2.OwnerType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static int Compare(Indentation? x, Extent y)
		{
			return ((x.HasValue ? x.Value.Extent : ((Extent?)null)) ?? ZeroExtent).Twips.CompareTo(y.Twips);
		}

		internal static int Compare(FirstLineIndentation? x, Extent y)
		{
			return Compare(x.HasValue ? new Indentation?(x.Value.Indentation) : ((Indentation?)null), y);
		}

		internal static bool IsWordBreakingComma(char chr)
		{
			switch (chr)
			{
			case 1373:
			case 1548:
			case 6146:
			case 6152:
			case 12289:
			case 65040:
			case 65041:
			case 65104:
			case 65105:
			case 65292:
			case 65380:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsWordBreakingSemicolon(char chr)
		{
			if (chr == '﹔' || chr == '；')
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsSymbolFont(string name)
		{
			return SerializationUtilities.GetExtendedFontInfo(name, getDefaultFontInfo: true).CharSets.Contains(2);
		}

		internal static bool IsTableAreaUsed(TableArea area, TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags areaUsageFlags)
		{
			TableAreaSettingsUsageFlags requiredAreaFlags = GetRequiredAreaFlags(area);
			return requiredAreaFlags == (requiredAreaFlags & areaUsageFlags);
		}

		internal static bool IsWordCharacter(char chr)
		{
			CharType chartype = GetChartype(chr);
			if (chartype == CharType.Digit || chartype == CharType.Letter)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsWordBreakingChar(char chr)
		{
			if (IsWordBreakingComma(chr) || IsWordBreakingSemicolon(chr))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

			{
				Debugger.Log(level, category, message);
			}
		}
