		internal static void MergeHelper(RichTextObjectBase.PropertyResolverBase resolver, RichTextObjectBase source)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				resolver.MergeProperties(source);
			}
		}

		internal static void MergeHelperEx(RichTextObjectBase.PropertyResolverBase resolver, RichTextObjectBase source, params int[] propsToExclude)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				if (propsToExclude != null && propsToExclude.Length != 0)
				{
					resolver.SuspendResolve(propsToExclude);
					resolver.MergeProperties(source);
					resolver.ResumeResolve(propsToExclude);
				}
				else
				{
					resolver.MergeProperties(source);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void MergeHelperLazy<TItem>(ref RichTextObjectBase.PropertyResolverBase resolver, RichTextObjectBase source) where TItem : RichTextObjectBase, new()
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				if (resolver == null)
				{
					resolver = CreateResolver<TItem>();
				}
				resolver.MergeProperties(source);
			}
		}

		internal static T MergeHelper<T>(T highPriority, T lowPriority) where T : RichTextObjectBase, new()
		{
			T val = new T();
			RichTextObjectBase.PropertyResolverBase propertyResolverBase = val.PropsInfo.CreateResolver(val);
			if (highPriority != null)
			{
				propertyResolverBase.MergeProperties(highPriority);
			}
			if (lowPriority != null)
			{
				propertyResolverBase.MergeProperties(lowPriority);
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal static T MergeTwoLazy<T>(T dest, T source) where T : RichTextObjectBase, new()
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				if (dest == null)
				{
					dest = new T();
				}
				dest.PropsInfo.CreateResolver(dest).MergeProperties(source);
			}
			return dest;
		}

		internal static T MergeThreeLazy<T>(T dest, T source1, T source2) where T : RichTextObjectBase, new()
		{
			if (source1 != null || source2 != null)
			{
				if (dest == null)
				{
					dest = new T();
				}
				RichTextObjectBase.PropertyResolverBase resolver = dest.PropsInfo.CreateResolver(dest);
				MergeHelper(resolver, source1);
				MergeHelper(resolver, source2);
			}
			return dest;
		}

		internal static TItem MergeOldSettingsIntoNew<TItem>(TItem oldSettings, TItem newSettings) where TItem : RichTextObjectBase
		{
			newSettings.PropsInfo.CreateResolver(newSettings).MergeProperties(oldSettings);
			return newSettings;
		}

		internal static List<DocumentSpan> MergeSpans(List<DocumentSpan> list)
		{
			if (list == null || list.Count <= 1)
			{
				return list;
			}
			List<DocumentSpan> list2 = new List<DocumentSpan>();
			DocumentSpan item = list[0];
			int i = 1;
			for (int count = list.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				DocumentSpan documentSpan = list[i];
				if (item.End == documentSpan.Start)
				{
					item = new DocumentSpan(item.Start, item.Length + documentSpan.Length);
					continue;
				}
				list2.Add(item);
				item = documentSpan;
			}
			list2.Add(item);
			return list2;
		}

		public static float MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(float value)
		{
			return (float)MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value, 0);
		}

		public static double MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(double value)
		{
			return MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(value, 0);
		}

		public static double MidpointRoundingAwayFromZero(double value, int digits)
		{
			if (digits < 0 || digits > 15)
			{
				double num = Math.Pow(10.0, digits);
				int num2 = Math.Sign(value);
				return Truncate(value * num + 0.5 * (double)num2) / num;
			}
			return Math.Round(value, digits, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
		}

		internal static Extent Min(Extent x, Extent y)
		{
			if (!(x <= y))
			{
				return y;
			}
			return x;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<T> NonNullItems<T>(IEnumerable<T> items) where T : class
		{
			return items.Where((T i) => i != null);
		}

		internal static void OnError(string formattedErrorText, params object[] formatValues)
		{
			if (formatValues != null && formatValues.Length != 0)
			{
				string.Format(formattedErrorText, formatValues);
			}
		}

		internal static void PerformOnAll<T>(IEnumerable<T> items, Action<T> action)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (T item in items)
			{
				action(item);
			}
		}

		internal static void PerformOnAll<T, TArg>(IEnumerable<T> items, Action<T, TArg> action, TArg arg)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (T item in items)
			{
				action(item, arg);
			}
		}

		internal static void PerformOnAll<T, TArg1, TArg2>(IEnumerable<T> items, Action<T, TArg1, TArg2> action, TArg1 arg1, TArg2 arg2)
		{
			if (items == null)

		{

		internal static void SetPropertyValueIf<TItem, TValue>(IEnumerable<TItem> items, int property, TValue value, TValue ifValue) where TItem : RichTextObjectBase
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (TItem item in items)
			{
				RichTextObjectBase.StorageProps.Info propsInfo = item.PropsInfo;
				if (EqualityComparer<TValue>.Default.Equals(propsInfo.GetValue<TValue>(item, property), ifValue))

					propsInfo.SetValue(item, property, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public static byte[] StreamToArray(Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream.CanSeek)
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[stream.Length];
				stream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				return array;
			}
			byte[] array2 = new byte[16384];
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			int count;
			while ((count = stream.Read(array2, 0, array2.Length)) > 0)
			{
				memoryStream.Write(array2, 0, count);
			}
			return memoryStream.ToArray();
		}

		{
			Extent? y2 = (y.HasValue ? new Extent?(new Extent(0.0 - y.Value.Twips)) : ((Extent?)null));

		}

		internal static int TryParseInt(string s)
		{

		}

		internal static DocumentSpan? Union(DocumentSpan x, DocumentSpan y)
		{
			if (x.IntersectsWith(y))
			{
				int num = Math.Min(x.Start, y.Start);
				int num2 = Math.Max(x.End, y.End);
				return new DocumentSpan(num, num2 - num);
			}
			return null;
		}

	internal static class AutomaticForegroundColorUtilities
	{
		private static double? CalculateYiqYValue(DocumentRootNode documentRootNode, Shading shading)
		{
			double? patternColorWeight = GetPatternColorWeight(shading.Pattern);
			if (!patternColorWeight.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double a = ColorUtilities.CalculateYiqYValue(shading.Background.GetResolvedColor(documentRootNode, AutomaticColorUsageType.Background));
			double b = ColorUtilities.CalculateYiqYValue((shading.PatternColor ?? ((ColorInfo)Colors.White)).GetResolvedColor(documentRootNode, AutomaticColorUsageType.Foreground));
			return WeightedAverage(a, b, patternColorWeight.Value);
		}

		public static Shading GetBackgroundShading(DocumentRootNode rootNode, ILayoutBlock block)
		{
			while (block != null)
			{
				if (block.Shading.HasValue)
				{
					return block.Shading.GetValueOrDefault();
				}
				block = block.ParentBlock;
			}
			if (rootNode != null)
			{
				DocumentSettings settings = rootNode.Settings;
				if (settings != null && settings.Background != null)
				{
					return new Shading(settings.Background);
				}
			}
			return new Shading(System.Windows.SystemColors.WindowColor);
		}

		public static Shading? GetBackgroundShading(Shading? blockShading, Shading? characterShading)
		{
			return characterShading ?? blockShading;
		}

		private static double? GetPatternColorWeight(ShadingPattern pattern)
		{
			return pattern switch
			{
				ShadingPattern.Clear => 0.0, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct5 => 0.05, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct10 => 0.1, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct12 => 0.12, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct15 => 0.15, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct20 => 0.2, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct25 => 0.25, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct30 => 0.3, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct35 => 0.35, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct37 => 0.37, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct40 => 0.4, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct45 => 0.45, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct50 => 0.5, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct55 => 0.55, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct60 => 0.6, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct62 => 0.62, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct65 => 0.65, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct70 => 0.7, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct75 => 0.75, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct80 => 0.8, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct85 => 0.85, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct87 => 0.87, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct90 => 0.9, 
				ShadingPattern.Pct95 => 0.95, 
				ShadingPattern.Solid => 1.0, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public static bool ShouldUseLightColor(DocumentRootNode documentRootNode, Shading shading)
		{
			double? num = CalculateYiqYValue(documentRootNode, shading);
			if (!num.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return num.GetValueOrDefault() < 0.23828;
		}

		private static double WeightedAverage(double a, double b, double weightOfB)
		{
			return a * (1.0 - weightOfB) + b * weightOfB;
		}
	}
	internal struct ElasticArray<T>
	{
		private static readonly T[] _EmptyArray = new T[0];

		private const double DefaultGrowthFactor = 1.5;

		private const double DefaultShrinkFactor = 1.8;

		private T[] _array;

		private int _count;

		internal T[] Array
		{
			get
			{
				if (_array == null)
				{
					_array = _EmptyArray;
				}
				return _array;
			}
		}

		internal int Capacity
		{
			get
			{
				return Array.Length;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == Array.Length)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value < _count)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Capacity");
				}
				if (value == 0)
				{
					_array = _EmptyArray;
					return;
				}
				T[] array = new T[value];
				if (_count > 0)
				{
					System.Array.Copy(_array, 0, array, 0, _count);
				}
				_array = array;
			}
		}

		internal int Count => _count;

		internal void Add(T item)
		{
			EnsureCapacityOnAdd(_count + 1);
			_array[_count++] = item;
		}

		internal void AddRange(IEnumerable<T> enumerable)
		{
			InsertRange(Count, enumerable);
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			_count = 0;
			VerifyCapacityAfterRemove();
		}

		internal void ClearNoRelease()
		{
			_count = 0;
		}

		internal int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _count; i++)
			{
				if (object.Equals(item, _array[i]))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index > _count)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
			}
			if (_count == Array.Length)
			{
				EnsureCapacityOnAdd(_count + 1);
			}
			if (index < _count)
			{
				System.Array.Copy(_array, index, _array, index + 1, _count - index);
			}
			_array[index] = item;
			_count++;
		}

		internal void InsertRange(int index, IEnumerable<T> enumerable)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index > _count)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
			}
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(enumerable, "collection");
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
			}
			if (!(enumerable is ICollection<T> { Count: var count } collection))
			{
				foreach (T item in enumerable)
				{
					Insert(index++, item);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (count != 0)
			{
				EnsureCapacityOnAdd(_count + count);
				if (index < _count)
				{
					System.Array.Copy(_array, index, _array, index + count, _count - index);
				}
				if (_array == collection)
				{
					System.Array.Copy(_array, 0, _array, index, index);
					System.Array.Copy(_array, index + count, _array, index * 2, _count - index);
				}
				else
				{
					T[] array = new T[count];
					collection.CopyTo(array, 0);
					array.CopyTo(_array, index);
				}
				_count += count;
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= _count)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
			}
			_count--;
			if (index < _count)
			{
				System.Array.Copy(_array, index + 1, _array, index, _count - index);
			}
			_array[_count] = default(T);
			VerifyCapacityAfterRemove();
		}

		internal void RemoveRange(int index, int count)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= _count)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
			}
			if (count < 0 || index + count > _count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("count");
			}
			if (count != 0)
			{
				_count -= count;
				if (index < _count)
				{
					System.Array.Copy(_array, index + count, _array, index, _count - index);
				}
				System.Array.Clear(_array, _count, count);
				VerifyCapacityAfterRemove();
			}
		}

		internal void ReplaceArray(T[] newArray)
		{
			_array = newArray;
			_count = _array.Length;
		}

		internal void TrimExcess()
		{
			Capacity = _count;
		}

		private void EnsureCapacityOnAdd(int count)
		{
			if (count != 0)
			{
				if (_array == null)
				{
					_array = new T[count];
				}
				if (count > _array.Length)
				{
					T[] array = new T[Math.Min(Math.Max(Math.Max(count, 4), (int)(1.5 * (double)count)), int.MaxValue)];
					System.Array.Copy(_array, 0, array, 0, _count);
					_array = array;
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyCapacityAfterRemove()
		{
			if (_array != null && !((double)_array.Length < (double)_count * 1.8))
			{
				if (_count == 0)
				{
					_array = _EmptyArray;
					return;
				}
				T[] array = new T[Math.Min(Math.Max(Math.Max(_count, 4), (int)(1.5 * (double)_count)), int.MaxValue)];
				System.Array.Copy(_array, 0, array, 0, _count);
				_array = array;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class ListenerListEx
	{
		private class Set : WeakSet<object>
		{
			internal int _isTraversingList;
		}

		private class List : WeakList<object>
		{
			internal int _isTraversingList;
		}

		public static object Add(object currentListener, object listener)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(listener);
			object itemHelper = GetItemHelper(currentListener);
			if (itemHelper == null)
			{
				return new WeakReference(listener);
			}
			Set set = currentListener as Set;
			if (set == null)
			{
				List list = currentListener as List;
				if (list == null)
				{
					if (itemHelper == listener)
					{
						return currentListener;
					}
					list = new List();
					list.Add(itemHelper);
				}
				if (list.Count < 20)
				{
					if (!list.Contains(listener))
					{
						list.Add(listener);
					}
					return list;
				}
				set = new Set();
				set.UnionWith(list);
			}
			set.Add(listener);
			return set;
		}

		internal static object GetItemHelper(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is WeakReference weakReference)
			{
				return CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(weakReference);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<object> GetListeners(object listeners)
		{
			if (listeners == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (listeners is Set result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (listeners is List result2)
			{
				return result2;
			}
			if (listeners != null)
			{
				ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string> typedPropertyChangeListener = (ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string>)GetItemHelper(listeners);
				if (typedPropertyChangeListener != null)
				{
					return new object[1] { typedPropertyChangeListener };
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool HasPotentiallyMultipleListeners(object listeners)
		{
			return listeners is List || listeners is Set;
		}

		internal static void RaisePropertyChanged(object listeners, object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			if (listeners == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (listeners is Set set)
			{
				set._isTraversingList++;
				try
				{
					foreach (ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string> item in set)
					{
						item?.OnPropertyValueChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
					}
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					set._isTraversingList--;
				}
			}
			if (listeners is List list)
			{
				list._isTraversingList++;
				try
				{
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = list.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						((ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string>)list[i])?.OnPropertyValueChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
					}
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					list._isTraversingList--;
				}
			}
			if (listeners != null)
			{
				((ITypedPropertyChangeListener<object, string>)GetItemHelper(listeners))?.OnPropertyValueChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
			}
		}

		public static object Remove(object currentListener, object listener)
		{
			Set set = currentListener as Set;
			if (set == null)
			{
				List list = currentListener as List;
				if (list == null)
				{
					if (GetItemHelper(currentListener) == listener)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return currentListener;
				}
				if (list._isTraversingList > 0)
				{
					List list2 = new List();
					list2.AddRange(list);
					list = list2;
				}
				list.Remove(listener);
				return list;
			}
			if (set._isTraversingList > 0)
			{
				Set set2 = new Set();
				set2.UnionWith(set);
				set = set2;
			}
			set.Remove(listener);
			return set;
		}
	}

	public class Replacement
	{
		private FindMatch _match;

		private string _replacementText;

		private NodeBase _replacementContent;

		public FindMatch Match => _match;

		public string ReplacementText => _replacementText;

		public NodeBase ReplacementContent => _replacementContent;

		internal Replacement(FindMatch match, string replacementText)
			: this(match, null, replacementText)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(replacementText);
		}

		internal Replacement(FindMatch match, NodeBase replacementContent)
			: this(match, replacementContent, null)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(replacementContent);
		}

		private Replacement(FindMatch match, NodeBase replacementContent, string replacementText)
		{
			if (!((replacementContent != null) ^ (replacementText != null)))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Either replacement content or replacement text should be specified but not both.");
			}
			_match = match;
			_replacementContent = replacementContent;
			_replacementText = replacementText;
		}

		internal static Replacement CreateHelper(FindMatch match, NodeBase replacementContent, string replacementText)
		{

			ParagraphSettings paragraphSettings = documentSettings?.DefaultParagraphSettings;
			if (paragraphSettings != null)
			{
				resolver.MergeProperties(new ParagraphStyle
				{
					ParagraphSettings = paragraphSettings
				});
			}
			ParagraphStyle paragraphStyle = resolver.Target as ParagraphStyle;
			PropertyResolver<CharacterSettings> propertyResolver = Utilities.CreateResolver<CharacterSettings>();
			if (paragraphStyle.CharacterSettings != null)
			{
				propertyResolver.MergeProperties(paragraphStyle.CharacterSettings);
			}
			CharacterSettings characterSettings = documentSettings?.DefaultCharacterSettings;
			if (characterSettings != null)

			resolver.MergeProperties(new ParagraphStyle
			{

			});
			ParagraphStyle defaultNormalStyle = RichTextDocument.DefaultNormalStyle;
			if (defaultNormalStyle != this)
			{
				resolver.MergeProperties(defaultNormalStyle.Resolved);
			}
			ParagraphStyle paragraphStyle2 = new ParagraphStyle();
			paragraphStyle2.CharacterSettings = RichTextDocument.DefaultCharacterSettings;
			paragraphStyle2.ParagraphSettings = RichTextDocument.DefaultParagraphSettings;
			resolver.MergeProperties(paragraphStyle2);

		internal RichTextStyleBase Resolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (_resolved == null)
				{
					_resolved = GetResolvedHelper(includeDefaults: false, null);
				}
				return _resolved;
			}
		}

		internal override void OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(object sender, string property, object extraInfo)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (sender is RichTextStyleBase richTextStyleBase)
			{
				if (this == richTextStyleBase)
				{
					if (property == "Resolved")
					{
						base.OnSubObjectPropertyChanged(sender, property, extraInfo);
						return;
					}
					if (property == "IsDefault")
					{
						RichTextStyleCollection.DirtyDefaultStyleHelper(this);
					}
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (_owner == sender)
			{
				switch (property)
				{
				case "Add":
				case "Remove":
				case "Reset":
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (IsDefault && _owner != null)
				{
					DocumentRootNode owner = _owner.Owner;
					if (owner != null)
					{
						flag2 = true;
						if (this is ParagraphStyle && _owner._paragraphDefaultStyle.GetDefaultStyle() == this)
						{
							owner.DirtyDefaultParagraphSettings();
						}
						else if (this is CharacterStyle && _owner._runDefaultStyle.GetDefaultStyle() == this)
						{
							owner.DirtyDefaultRunSettings();
						}
						else if (this is TableStyle && _owner._tableDefaultStyle.GetDefaultStyle() == this)
						{
							owner.DirtyDefaultTableSettings();
						}
						else
						{
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					DirtyResolved();
				}
			}
			if (extraInfo is PropertyChangeChainContextBase context && (sender == this || (_owner != sender && !(sender is StyleListenersManager))))
			{
				StylesChangeManager manager = StylesChangeManager.GetManager(_owner);
				if (manager != null)
				{
					PropertyChangeChainContextBase context2 = AddSelfToPropertyChangeChainHelper(context);
					manager._doc.ProcessPropertyChange(context2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal RichTextStyleBase GetResolvedIncludingDefaults(NodeBase context)
		{
			if (_resolvedIncludingDefaults == null)
			{
				_resolvedIncludingDefaults = GetResolvedHelper(includeDefaults: true, context);
			}
			return _resolvedIncludingDefaults;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static RichTextStyleBase GetResolvedStyle(RichTextStyleBase originalStyle, NodeBase context = null)
		{
			return originalStyle.GetResolvedIncludingDefaults(context);
		}

		internal void DirtyResolved()
		{
			bool num = _resolved != null;
			bool flag = _resolvedIncludingDefaults != null;
			_resolved = null;
			_resolvedIncludingDefaults = null;
			if (num)
			{
				NotifyListeners(this, "Resolved", null);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				NotifyListeners(this, "ResolvedIncludingDefaults", null);
			}
		}

		private bool GetFlag(InternalFlags flag)
		{
			return RichTextObjectBase.GetFlag((ulong)flag, (ulong)_flags);
		}

		private bool SetFlag(InternalFlags flag, bool value, int? notificationPropIndex = null)
		{
			ulong flagsMember = (ulong)_flags;
			bool oldValue;
			bool num = SetFlag((ulong)flag, ref flagsMember, out oldValue, value);
			if (num)
			{
				_flags = (InternalFlags)flagsMember;
				if (notificationPropIndex.HasValue)
				{
					OnPropertyChanged(notificationPropIndex.Value, oldValue);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private RichTextStyleBase GetResolvedHelper(bool includeDefaults, NodeBase context)
		{
			DocumentRootNode documentRootNode = ((_owner != null) ? _owner.Owner : null);
			if (documentRootNode == null && context != null)
			{
				documentRootNode = context.RootNode;
			}
			return GetResolvedHelper(includeDefaults, documentRootNode);
		}

		internal RichTextStyleBase GetResolvedHelper(bool includeDefaults, DocumentRootNode rootNode)
		{
			RichTextStyleBase richTextStyleBase = (RichTextStyleBase)PropsInfo.CreateNew();
			PropertyResolverBase propertyResolverBase = PropsInfo.CreateResolver(richTextStyleBase);
			propertyResolverBase.MergeProperties(this);
			RichTextStyleBase richTextStyleBase2 = (_owner ?? rootNode?.StylesIfAllocated)?[_basedOn];
			if (richTextStyleBase2 != null)
			{
				if (richTextStyleBase2.PropsInfo == PropsInfo)
				{
					propertyResolverBase.MergeProperties(richTextStyleBase2.Resolved);
				}
				else
				{
					Utilities.OnError("{0} style's BasedOn id of {1} refers to a style of a different type.", _id, _basedOn);
				}
			}
			if (includeDefaults)
			{
				ResolveToDefaultNormalStyleOverride(propertyResolverBase, rootNode);
				((RichTextStyleBase)propertyResolverBase.Target).DisplayMode = DisplayMode;
				((RichTextStyleBase)propertyResolverBase.Target).IsCustom = IsCustom;
				((RichTextStyleBase)propertyResolverBase.Target).IsDefault = IsDefault;
				((RichTextStyleBase)propertyResolverBase.Target).IsLocked = IsLocked;
				((RichTextStyleBase)propertyResolverBase.Target).IsPrimary = IsPrimary;
				((RichTextStyleBase)propertyResolverBase.Target).SortPriority = SortPriority;
				((RichTextStyleBase)propertyResolverBase.Target).UnhideWhenUsed = UnhideWhenUsed;
				richTextStyleBase = (RichTextStyleBase)propertyResolverBase.ResolveRemainingProperties();
			}
			else
			{
				richTextStyleBase.DisplayMode = DisplayMode;
				richTextStyleBase.IsCustom = IsCustom;
				richTextStyleBase.IsDefault = IsDefault;
				richTextStyleBase.IsLocked = IsLocked;
				richTextStyleBase.IsPrimary = IsPrimary;
				richTextStyleBase.SortPriority = SortPriority;
				richTextStyleBase.UnhideWhenUsed = UnhideWhenUsed;
				richTextStyleBase.Seal();
			}
			return richTextStyleBase;
		}

		internal void InitializeOwner(RichTextStyleCollection owner)
		{
			if (_owner != owner)
			{
				if (_owner != null && owner != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Same RichTextStyleBase instance cannot exist in two or more RichTextStyleCollections.");
				}
				RichTextStyleCollection.RemoveStyleListenerHelper(owner, _basedOn, this);
				_owner = owner;
				RichTextStyleCollection.AddStyleListenerHelper(_owner, _basedOn, this);
				DirtyResolved();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void ResolveToDefaultNormalStyleOverride(PropertyResolverBase resolver, DocumentRootNode root)
		{
		}
	}

			: base(document, context)
		{
			_nodeAggregateIndex = ((NodeBase)context.Owner)?.GetAggregateIndex() ?? (-1);
			CoreUtilities.ValidateIsNotNegative(_nodeAggregateIndex);
		}

	}

	{
		private string _styleId;

		internal StyleSubObjectChangedUndoUnit(RichTextDocument document, PropertyChangeChainContext<T> context)
			: base(document, context)
		{
			_styleId = ((RichTextStyleBase)context.Owner)?.Id;
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotEmpty(_styleId);
		}

		protected override RichTextObjectBase GetTargetRoot()
		{
			DocumentRootNode rootNode = _document.RootNode;
			if (rootNode == null || rootNode.StylesIfAllocated == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return rootNode.StylesIfAllocated[_styleId];
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SubObjectChangedUndoUnitBase<T> : UndoUnit
	{
		private class PropertyIndexPath : IEquatable<PropertyIndexPath>
		{
			internal readonly int[] _ancestorPropIndices;

			internal PropertyIndexPath(int[] ancestorPropIndices)
			{
				_ancestorPropIndices = ancestorPropIndices;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is PropertyIndexPath)
				{
					return this == (PropertyIndexPath)obj;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (_ancestorPropIndices != null)
				{
					int num2 = _ancestorPropIndices.Length;
					for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
					{
						num ^= _ancestorPropIndices[i].GetHashCode();
					}
				}
				return num;
			}

			public static bool operator ==(PropertyIndexPath path1, PropertyIndexPath path2)
			{
				if ((object)path1 == null)
				{
					return (object)path2 == null;
				}
				if ((object)path2 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = ((path1._ancestorPropIndices != null) ? path1._ancestorPropIndices.Length : 0);
				int num2 = ((path2._ancestorPropIndices != null) ? path2._ancestorPropIndices.Length : 0);
				if (num != num2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (path1._ancestorPropIndices[i] != path2._ancestorPropIndices[i])
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public static bool operator !=(PropertyIndexPath path1, PropertyIndexPath path2)
			{
				return !(path1 == path2);
			}

			public bool Equals(PropertyIndexPath other)
			{
				return this == other;
			}
		}

		private static readonly Dictionary<PropertyIndexPath, PropertyIndexPath> _GlobalPathMap = new Dictionary<PropertyIndexPath, PropertyIndexPath>();

		private const int COLLECTION_INDEX_BASE = 1000;

		protected RichTextDocument _document;

		private PropertyIndexPath _path;

		private T _oldValue;

		private StoragePropsInfo.PropInfo _targetProp;

		public override object Target => _document;

		internal SubObjectChangedUndoUnitBase(RichTextDocument document, PropertyChangeChainContext<T> context)
		{
			_document = document;
			_oldValue = context.OldValue;
			if (_oldValue is RichTextObjectBase { IsSealed: false } richTextObjectBase)
			{
				RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase2 = richTextObjectBase.Clone();
				richTextObjectBase2.Seal();
				_oldValue = (T)(object)richTextObjectBase2;
			}
			_targetProp = context.LeafChildContext.OwnerProp;
			bool flag = false;
			int chainLength = context.ChainLength;
			int[] array = ((chainLength > 1) ? new int[chainLength - 1] : null);
			if (array != null)
			{
				int num = 0;
				while (context != context.LeafChildContext)
				{
					if (context.OwnerIndex.HasValue)
					{
						flag = flag || context.OwnerIndex.Value > 3;
						array[num++] = context.OwnerIndex.Value + 1000;
					}
					else
					{
						array[num++] = context.OwnerProp._key;
					}
					context = context.ChildContext;
				}
			}
			if (array == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (typeof(PropertyIndexPath))
			{
				PropertyIndexPath propertyIndexPath = new PropertyIndexPath(array);
				if (flag)
				{
					_path = propertyIndexPath;
				}
				else if (!_GlobalPathMap.TryGetValue(propertyIndexPath, out _path))
				{
					_GlobalPathMap.Add(propertyIndexPath, propertyIndexPath);
					_path = propertyIndexPath;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool Execute(UndoExecuteContext executeInfo)
		{
			RichTextObjectBase richTextObjectBase = GetTargetRoot();
			if (richTextObjectBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_path != null)
			{
				int num = _path._ancestorPropIndices.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					int num2 = _path._ancestorPropIndices[i];
					if (num2 >= 1000)
					{
						num2 -= 1000;
						if (richTextObjectBase is IListInternal listInternal)
						{
							richTextObjectBase = listInternal[num2] as RichTextObjectBase;
						}
						else if (richTextObjectBase is IList list)
						{
							richTextObjectBase = list[num2] as RichTextObjectBase;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						richTextObjectBase = richTextObjectBase.PropsInfo._defaultStorage.GetValue<RichTextObjectBase>(richTextObjectBase, num2);
					}
					if (richTextObjectBase == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			richTextObjectBase.ApplyUndo(_targetProp._key, _oldValue);
			return false;
		}

		public override string GetDescription(UndoHistoryItemType itemType, bool detailed)
		{
			return $"{_targetProp._name} changed";
		}

		protected override UndoMergeAction Merge(UndoMergeContext mergeInfo)
		{
			return UndoMergeAction.NotMerged;
		}

		protected abstract RichTextObjectBase GetTargetRoot();
	}
	internal struct UndoCollectionChangeInfo<T>
	{
		private UndoCollectionChangeAction _action;

		private int _index;

		private T _oldValue;

		private T[] _oldValues;

		internal UndoCollectionChangeAction Action => _action;

		internal int Index => _index;

		internal T OldValue => _oldValue;

		internal T[] OldValues => _oldValues;

		internal UndoCollectionChangeInfo(UndoCollectionChangeAction action, T[] oldValues)
		{
			_index = -1;
			_oldValue = oldValues[0];
			_oldValues = oldValues;
			_action = action;
		}

		internal UndoCollectionChangeInfo(UndoCollectionChangeAction action, int index, T oldValue)
		{
			_index = index;
			_oldValue = oldValue;
			_oldValues = null;
			_action = action;
		}
	}
	internal enum UndoCollectionChangeAction : byte
	{
		Reset,
		Insert,
		Remove,
		Replace
	}

	internal static class ClipboardRootNodeCreator
	{
		private abstract class DocumentSpanProxyBase
		{
			public abstract bool Contains(DocumentSpan span);

			public abstract DocumentSpan? Intersection(DocumentSpan span);

			public abstract bool OverlapsWith(DocumentSpan span);
		}

		private class DocumentSpanProxy : DocumentSpanProxyBase
		{
			private readonly DocumentSpan _span;

			public DocumentSpanProxy(DocumentSpan span)
			{
				_span = span;
			}

			public override bool Contains(DocumentSpan span)
			{
				return _span.Contains(span);
			}

			public override DocumentSpan? Intersection(DocumentSpan span)
			{
				return _span.Intersection(span);
			}

			public override bool OverlapsWith(DocumentSpan span)
			{
				return _span.OverlapsWith(span);
			}
		}

		private class DocumentSpanProxyTableCellSpans : DocumentSpanProxyBase
		{
			private readonly DocumentSpan[] _spans;

			public DocumentSpanProxyTableCellSpans(DocumentSpan[] spans)
			{
				_spans = spans;
			}

			public override bool Contains(DocumentSpan span)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _spans.Length; i++)
				{
					if (_spans[i].Contains(span))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override DocumentSpan? Intersection(DocumentSpan span)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _spans.Length; i++)
				{
					DocumentSpan? result = _spans[i].Intersection(span);
					if (result.HasValue)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override bool OverlapsWith(DocumentSpan span)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _spans.Length; i++)
				{
					if (_spans[i].OverlapsWith(span))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class GatherClipboardRootNodesVisitor : NodeTreeWalker
		{
			private struct ParentNodeInfo
			{
				public readonly List<NodeBase> NewChildren;

				public readonly NodeBase OriginalParentNode;

				public ParentNodeInfo(NodeBase originalParentNode, List<NodeBase> newChildren = null)
				{
					OriginalParentNode = originalParentNode;
					NewChildren = newChildren ?? new List<NodeBase>();
				}
			}

			private readonly Stack<ParentNodeInfo> _currentNodesStack;

			private readonly bool _hasMultipleUserSelections;

			private readonly MockNodeCreator _mockNodeCreator;

			private readonly DocumentRootNode _mockRootNode;

			private readonly DocumentSpanProxyBase _span;

			private readonly List<NodeBase> _topLevelBodyNodes;

			private readonly HashSet<string> _usedListIds;

			private readonly HashSet<string> _usedStyleIds;

			public GatherClipboardRootNodesVisitor(DocumentSpanProxyBase span, bool hasMultipleUserSelections, DocumentRootNode mockRootNode, List<NodeBase> topLevelBodyNodes, HashSet<string> usedListIds, HashSet<string> usedStyleIds)
			{
				_currentNodesStack = new Stack<ParentNodeInfo>();
				_hasMultipleUserSelections = hasMultipleUserSelections;
				_mockNodeCreator = new MockNodeCreator(mockRootNode, span);
				_mockRootNode = mockRootNode;
				_span = span;
				_topLevelBodyNodes = topLevelBodyNodes;
				_usedListIds = usedListIds;
				_usedStyleIds = usedStyleIds;
				_currentNodesStack.Push(new ParentNodeInfo(null, _topLevelBodyNodes));
			}

			protected override void DefaultVisit(NodeBase node)
			{
				DefaultVisitHelper(node);
			}

			public override void VisitBodyNode(DocumentBodyNode node)
			{
				VisitChildren(node);
			}

			public override void VisitCellNode(TableCellNode node)
			{
				DefaultVisitHelper(node, null, null, shouldPromoteChildrenIfParentPartiallySelected: true);
			}

			public override void VisitHyperlinkNode(HyperlinkNode node)
			{
				DefaultVisitHelper(node, null, null, shouldPromoteChildrenIfParentPartiallySelected: true);
			}

			public override void VisitParagraphNode(ParagraphNode node)
			{
				ParagraphNode paragraphNode = DefaultVisitHelper(node, (ParagraphNode p) => p.Clone(copyId: true, copyChildNodes: true, copyListItemInfo: true, _mockRootNode));
				if (paragraphNode == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (paragraphNode.Settings != null && paragraphNode.Settings.ListId != null)
				{
					_usedListIds.Add(paragraphNode.Settings.ListId);
				}
				if (paragraphNode.StyleId != null)
				{
					_usedStyleIds.Add(paragraphNode.StyleId);
				}
				if (!_span.Contains(node.GetParagraphMarkSpan()) && !_hasMultipleUserSelections)
				{
					paragraphNode.CustomAttributes.Add(new NodeAttribute
					{
						Name = "IG_ParagraphMarkUnselected"
					});
				}
				if (node.IsListItemResolved)
				{
					DocumentSpan span = new DocumentSpan(node.GetDocumentSpan(includePrefix: false, includePostfix: false).Start, 1);
					if (_span.Contains(span))
					{
						paragraphNode.CustomAttributes.Add(new NodeAttribute
						{
							Name = "IG_PrecedingListIndicatorText",
							Value = Utilities.GetPlainTextListIndicatorAndSuffix(node.ListItemInfoResolved, node.RootNode)
						});
					}
				}
			}

			public override void VisitRootNode(DocumentRootNode node)
			{
				VisitChildren(node);
			}

			public override void VisitRowNode(TableRowNode node)
			{
				DefaultVisitHelper(node, null, (List<NodeBase> children) => children.Count != 0 && children[0] is TableCellNode);
			}

			public override void VisitRunNode(RunNode node)
			{
				RunNode runNode = DefaultVisitHelper(node);
				if (runNode != null)
				{
					if (runNode.StyleId != null)
					{
						_usedStyleIds.Add(runNode.StyleId);
					}
					if (node.SettingsResolved.AreAllCharactersCapitalized())
					{
						runNode.CustomAttributes.Add(new NodeAttribute
						{
							Name = "IG_HadCapitalizedText"
						});
					}
					if (node.Parent is HyperlinkNode && !(_currentNodesStack.Peek().OriginalParentNode is HyperlinkNode) && (runNode.StyleId == "Hyperlink" || runNode.StyleId == "FollowedHyperlink"))
					{
						runNode.StyleId = null;
					}
				}
			}

			public override void VisitTableNode(TableNode node)
			{
				TableNode tableNode = DefaultVisitHelper(node, null, (List<NodeBase> children) => children.Count != 0 && children[0] is TableRowNode);
				if (tableNode != null && tableNode.StyleId != null)
				{
					_usedStyleIds.Add(tableNode.StyleId);
				}
			}

			private T DefaultVisitHelper<T>(T node, Func<T, T> cloneNode = null, Func<List<NodeBase>, bool> shouldCreateParent = null, bool shouldPromoteChildrenIfParentPartiallySelected = false) where T : NodeBase
			{
				if (!_span.OverlapsWith(node.GetDocumentSpan()))
				{
					return null;
				}
				T val;
				if (IsNodeTreeFullySelected(node))
				{
					val = ((cloneNode == null) ? ((T)node.Clone()) : cloneNode(node));
					ProcessClonedNode(val);
				}
				else
				{
					if (shouldPromoteChildrenIfParentPartiallySelected)
					{
						VisitChildren(node);
						return null;
					}
					_currentNodesStack.Push(new ParentNodeInfo(node));
					VisitChildren(node);
					List<NodeBase> newChildren = _currentNodesStack.Pop().NewChildren;
					if (shouldCreateParent != null && !shouldCreateParent(newChildren))
					{
						_currentNodesStack.Peek().NewChildren.AddRange(newChildren);
						return null;
					}
					val = (T)node.Accept(_mockNodeCreator);
					val.ChildNodes.AddRange(newChildren);
				}
				_currentNodesStack.Peek().NewChildren.Add(val);
				return val;
			}

			private bool IsNodeTreeFullySelected(NodeBase treeRoot)
			{
				if (treeRoot is TableCellNode && _hasMultipleUserSelections)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return _span.Contains(treeRoot.GetDocumentSpan());
			}

			private void ProcessClonedNode(NodeBase node)
			{
				ParagraphNode paragraphNode = node as ParagraphNode;
				RunNode runNode = node as RunNode;
				TableNode tableNode = node as TableNode;
				if (paragraphNode != null)
				{
					if (paragraphNode.Settings != null && paragraphNode.Settings.ListId != null)
					{
						_usedListIds.Add(paragraphNode.Settings.ListId);
					}
					if (paragraphNode.StyleId != null)
					{
						_usedStyleIds.Add(paragraphNode.StyleId);
					}
				}
				else if (runNode != null)
				{
					if (runNode.StyleId != null)
					{
						_usedStyleIds.Add(runNode.StyleId);
					}
				}
				else if (tableNode != null && tableNode.StyleId != null)
				{
					_usedStyleIds.Add(tableNode.StyleId);
				}
				if (node.HasChildNodes)
				{
					node.ChildNodes.ForEach(ProcessClonedNode);
				}
			}
		}

		private class MockNodeCreator : NodeVisitor<NodeBase>
		{
			private readonly DocumentRootNode _mockRootNode;

			private readonly DocumentSpanProxyBase _span;

			public MockNodeCreator(DocumentRootNode mockRootNode, DocumentSpanProxyBase span)
			{
				_mockRootNode = mockRootNode;
				_span = span;
			}

			protected override NodeBase DefaultVisit(NodeBase node)
			{
				return node.Clone(copyId: true, copyChildNodes: false);
			}

			public override NodeBase VisitBodyNode(DocumentBodyNode node)
			{
				return new DocumentBodyNode();
			}

			public override NodeBase VisitParagraphNode(ParagraphNode node)
			{
				if (_span.Contains(node.GetParagraphMarkSpan()))
				{
					return node.Clone(copyId: true, copyChildNodes: false, copyListItemInfo: true, _mockRootNode);
				}
				return new ParagraphNode();
			}

			public override NodeBase VisitRootNode(DocumentRootNode node)
			{
				return new DocumentRootNode();
			}

			public override NodeBase VisitRowNode(TableRowNode node)
			{
				return node.Clone(copyId: true, copyChildNodes: false);
			}

			public override NodeBase VisitRunNode(RunNode node)
			{
				return node.Clone(copyId: true, copyChildNodes: false);
			}

			public override NodeBase VisitTableNode(TableNode node)
			{
				return node.Clone(copyId: true, copyChildNodes: false);
			}

			public override NodeBase VisitTextNode(TextNode node)
			{
				DocumentSpan? documentSpan = _span.Intersection(node.GetDocumentSpan());
				if (!documentSpan.HasValue)
				{
					return node;
				}
				DocumentSpan documentSpan2 = documentSpan.Value.OffsetBy(-node.GetDocumentOffset());
				return new TextNode
				{
					Text = node.Text.Substring(documentSpan2.Start, documentSpan2.Length)
				};
			}
		}

		private class SelectedTableCellDetector : NodeTreeWalker
		{
			private int _currentRowIndex;

			private int _currentColumnIndex;

			private bool _hasSelectionsOtherThanFullCells;

			private readonly List<TableCellLocationInfo> _selectedCells;

			private readonly DocumentSpan _span;

			public bool HasSelectionsOtherThanFullCells => _hasSelectionsOtherThanFullCells;

			public SelectedTableCellDetector(DocumentSpan span, List<TableCellLocationInfo> selectedCells)
			{
				_selectedCells = selectedCells;
				_span = span;
			}

			protected override void DefaultVisit(NodeBase node)
			{
				if (!_hasSelectionsOtherThanFullCells && _span.OverlapsWith(node.GetDocumentSpan()))
				{
					_hasSelectionsOtherThanFullCells = true;
				}
			}

			public override void VisitBodyNode(DocumentBodyNode node)
			{
				VisitChildren(node);
			}

			public override void VisitCellNode(TableCellNode node)
			{
				try
				{
					if (!_hasSelectionsOtherThanFullCells && _span.OverlapsWith(node.GetDocumentSpan()))
					{
						if (!_span.Contains(node.GetDocumentSpan()))
						{
							_hasSelectionsOtherThanFullCells = true;
						}
						else
						{
							_selectedCells.Add(new TableCellLocationInfo(node, _currentColumnIndex, _currentRowIndex));
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					_currentColumnIndex++;
				}
			}

			protected override void VisitChildren(NodeBase node)
			{
				NodeCollection childNodesIfAllocated = node.ChildNodesIfAllocated;
				if (childNodesIfAllocated == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (NodeBase item in childNodesIfAllocated)
				{
					item.Accept(this);
					if (HasSelectionsOtherThanFullCells)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			public override void VisitRootNode(DocumentRootNode node)
			{
				VisitChildren(node);
			}

			public override void VisitRowNode(TableRowNode node)
			{
				int currentColumnIndex = _currentColumnIndex;
				_currentColumnIndex = ((node.Settings != null) ? (node.Settings.LeadingEmptyCellCount ?? 0) : 0);
				VisitChildren(node);
				_currentColumnIndex = currentColumnIndex;
				_currentRowIndex++;
			}

			public override void VisitTableNode(TableNode node)
			{
				int currentRowIndex = _currentRowIndex;
				_currentRowIndex = 0;
				VisitChildren(node);
				_currentRowIndex = currentRowIndex;
			}
		}

		private struct TableCellLocationInfo
		{
			public readonly TableCellNode Cell;

			public readonly int ColumnIndex;

			public readonly int RowIndex;

			public TableCellLocationInfo(TableCellNode cell, int columnIndex, int rowIndex)
			{
				Cell = cell;
				ColumnIndex = columnIndex;
				RowIndex = rowIndex;
			}
		}

		public static DocumentRootNode Create(DocumentRootNode rootNode, ReadOnlyCollection<Range> saveRanges)
		{
			if (saveRanges == null)
			{
				return rootNode;
			}
			if (saveRanges.Count == 1 && saveRanges[0].DocumentSpan.Contains(rootNode.GetDocumentSpan()))
			{
				return rootNode;
			}
			List<NodeBase> list = new List<NodeBase>();
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			HashSet<string> hashSet2 = new HashSet<string>();
			DocumentSpan[] array = saveRanges.Select((Range r) => r.DocumentSpan).ToArray();
			bool flag = false;
			DocumentRootNode documentRootNode = (DocumentRootNode)rootNode.Clone(copyId: true, copyChildNodes: false);
			if (saveRanges.Count != 1 && AreAllSpansOfRectangularCellArea(rootNode, array))
			{
				GatherClipboardRootNodesVisitor visitor = new GatherClipboardRootNodesVisitor(new DocumentSpanProxyTableCellSpans(array), flag, documentRootNode, list, hashSet, hashSet2);
				rootNode.Accept(visitor);
			}
			else
			{
				flag = saveRanges.Count != 1;
				DocumentSpan[] array2 = array;
				for (int num = 0; num < array2.Length; num++)
				{
					GatherClipboardRootNodesVisitor visitor2 = new GatherClipboardRootNodesVisitor(new DocumentSpanProxy(array2[num]), flag, documentRootNode, list, hashSet, hashSet2);
					rootNode.Accept(visitor2);
				}
			}
			NodeBase nodeBase = rootNode.Body.Clone(copyId: true, copyChildNodes: false);
			documentRootNode.CustomAttributes.Add(new NodeAttribute
			{
				Name = "IsClipboardRootNodeClone"
			});
			nodeBase.ChildNodes.AddRange(list);
			documentRootNode.ChildNodes.Add(nodeBase);
			if (flag)
			{
				documentRootNode.CustomAttributes.Add(new NodeAttribute
				{
					Name = "IG_HasMultipleSelections"
				});
			}
			SerializationUtilities.TransitiveClosureOfUsedStyles(rootNode.Styles, hashSet2);
			foreach (RichTextStyleBase style in rootNode.Styles)
			{
				if (!hashSet2.Contains(style.Id))
				{
					documentRootNode.Styles.Remove(style.Id);
				}
				else if (style is ParagraphStyle { ParagraphSettings: not null } paragraphStyle && paragraphStyle.ParagraphSettings.ListId != null)
				{
					hashSet.Add(paragraphStyle.ParagraphSettings.ListId);
				}
			}
			foreach (RichTextList list2 in rootNode.Lists)
			{
				if (!hashSet.Contains(list2.Id))
				{
					documentRootNode.Lists.Remove(list2.Id);
				}
			}
			return documentRootNode;
		}

		private static bool AreAllSpansOfRectangularCellArea(DocumentRootNode rootNode, IEnumerable<DocumentSpan> spans)
		{
			List<TableCellLocationInfo> selectedCells = new List<TableCellLocationInfo>();
			foreach (DocumentSpan span in spans)
			{
				SelectedTableCellDetector selectedTableCellDetector = new SelectedTableCellDetector(span, selectedCells);
				rootNode.Accept(selectedTableCellDetector);
				if (selectedTableCellDetector.HasSelectionsOtherThanFullCells)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return AreCellsFromRectangularArea(selectedCells);
		}

		private static bool AreCellsFromRectangularArea(List<TableCellLocationInfo> selectedCells)
		{
			if (selectedCells.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TableNode table = selectedCells[0].Cell.Parent.Parent as TableNode;
			if (table == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!selectedCells.All((TableCellLocationInfo t) => t.Cell.Parent.Parent == table))
			{
				return false;
			}
			selectedCells = (from t in selectedCells
				orderby t.RowIndex, t.ColumnIndex
				select t).ToList();
			int columnIndex = selectedCells[0].ColumnIndex;
			int num = columnIndex;
			int? num2 = null;
			int num3 = selectedCells[0].RowIndex;
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < selectedCells.Count; num4++)
			{
				TableCellLocationInfo tableCellLocationInfo = selectedCells[num4];
				if (tableCellLocationInfo.RowIndex != num3)
				{
					if (tableCellLocationInfo.RowIndex != num3 + 1)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!num2.HasValue)
					{
						num2 = num;
					}
					else if (num2.Value != num)
					{
						return false;
					}
					num3++;
					num = columnIndex;
				}
				if (tableCellLocationInfo.ColumnIndex != num++)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (num2.HasValue && num2.Value != num)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static DocumentSpan GetParagraphMarkSpan(this ParagraphNode node)
		{
			return new DocumentSpan(node.GetDocumentSpan().End - 1, 1);
		}
	}
	public class CustomBinaryDocumentAdapter : RichTextDocumentAdapterBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LoadOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("LoadOptions", typeof(LoadOptionsBase), typeof(CustomBinaryDocumentAdapter), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SaveOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("SaveOptions", typeof(SaveOptionsBase), typeof(CustomBinaryDocumentAdapter), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(null, OnSaveOptionsChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SerializationProviderProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("SerializationProvider", typeof(SerializationProviderBase), typeof(CustomBinaryDocumentAdapter), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(null, OnSerializationProviderChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("Value", typeof(byte[]), typeof(CustomBinaryDocumentAdapter), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(null, OnValueChanged, DependencyPropertyUtilities.MetadataOptionFlags.BindsTwoWayByDefault));

		public LoadOptionsBase LoadOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return (LoadOptionsBase)GetValue(LoadOptionsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LoadOptionsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public SaveOptionsBase SaveOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return (SaveOptionsBase)GetValue(SaveOptionsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SaveOptionsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public SerializationProviderBase SerializationProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return (SerializationProviderBase)GetValue(SerializationProviderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SerializationProviderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public byte[] Value
		{
			get
			{
				return (byte[])GetValue(ValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override void RefreshDocumentCore()
		{
			RichTextDocument document = base.Document;
			SerializationProviderBase serializationProvider = SerializationProvider;
			if (document == null || serializationProvider == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			byte[] value = Value;
			if (value == null)
			{
				document.RootNode = SerializationUtilities.CreateEmptyRootNode();
				return;
			}
			using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(value);
			document.Load(serializationProvider, stream, LoadOptions);
		}

		protected override void RefreshValueCore()
		{
			RichTextDocument document = base.Document;
			SerializationProviderBase serializationProvider = SerializationProvider;
			if (document == null || serializationProvider == null)
			{
				UpdateValue(null);
				return;
			}
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			document.Save(serializationProvider, memoryStream, SaveOptions);
			memoryStream.Flush();
			UpdateValue(memoryStream.ToArray());
		}

		private void HookSaveOptionsPropertyChanged(SaveOptionsBase saveOptions)
		{
			if (saveOptions != null)
			{
				saveOptions.PropertyChanged += OnSaveOptionsPropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnSaveOptionsPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnSaveOptionsChanged();
		}

		private void UnhookSaveOptionsPropertyChanged(SaveOptionsBase saveOptions)
		{
			if (saveOptions != null)
			{
				saveOptions.PropertyChanged -= OnSaveOptionsPropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateValue(byte[] newValue)
		{
			DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(this, ValueProperty, newValue);
		}

		private static void OnSaveOptionsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CustomBinaryDocumentAdapter obj = (CustomBinaryDocumentAdapter)d;
			obj.OnSaveOptionsChanged();
			obj.UnhookSaveOptionsPropertyChanged((SaveOptionsBase)e.OldValue);
			obj.HookSaveOptionsPropertyChanged((SaveOptionsBase)e.NewValue);
		}

		private static void OnSerializationProviderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((CustomBinaryDocumentAdapter)d).OnSaveOptionsChanged();
		}

		private static void OnValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((CustomBinaryDocumentAdapter)d).OnValueChanged();
		}
	}

	public class ImageSerializationProvider : SerializationProviderBase
	{
		[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 2)]
		private struct BITMAPFILEHEADER
		{
			public const int Size = 14;

			public const short BM = 19778;

			public short bfType;

			public int bfSize;

			public short bfReserved1;

			public short bfReserved2;

			public int bfOffBits;

			public byte[] ToByteArray()
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[14];
				Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(bfType), 0, array, 0, 2);
				Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(bfSize), 0, array, 2, 4);
				Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(bfReserved1), 0, array, 6, 2);
				Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(bfReserved2), 0, array, 8, 2);
				Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(bfOffBits), 0, array, 10, 4);
				return array;
			}
		}

		private struct BITMAPINFOHEADER
		{
			public int biSize;

			public int biWidth;

			public int biHeight;

			public short biPlanes;

			public short biBitCount;

			public int biCompression;

			public int biSizeImage;

			public int biXPelsPerMeter;

			public int biYPelsPerMeter;

			public int biClrUsed;

			public int biClrImportant;

			public static BITMAPINFOHEADER FromByteArray(byte[] dibContent, int startIndex)
			{
				BITMAPINFOHEADER result = default(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
				result.biSize = BitConverter.ToInt32(dibContent, startIndex);
				startIndex += 4;
				result.biWidth = BitConverter.ToInt32(dibContent, startIndex);
				startIndex += 4;
				result.biHeight = BitConverter.ToInt32(dibContent, startIndex);
				startIndex += 4;
				result.biPlanes = BitConverter.ToInt16(dibContent, startIndex);
				startIndex += 2;
				result.biBitCount = BitConverter.ToInt16(dibContent, startIndex);
				startIndex += 2;
				result.biCompression = BitConverter.ToInt32(dibContent, startIndex);
				startIndex += 4;
				result.biSizeImage = BitConverter.ToInt32(dibContent, startIndex);
				startIndex += 4;
				result.biXPelsPerMeter = BitConverter.ToInt32(dibContent, startIndex);
				startIndex += 4;
				result.biYPelsPerMeter = BitConverter.ToInt32(dibContent, startIndex);
				startIndex += 4;
				result.biClrUsed = BitConverter.ToInt32(dibContent, startIndex);
				startIndex += 4;
				result.biClrImportant = BitConverter.ToInt32(dibContent, startIndex);
				startIndex += 4;
				return result;
			}
		}

		private static readonly ImageSerializationProvider _instance = new ImageSerializationProvider();

		public static ImageSerializationProvider Instance => _instance;

		public ImageSerializationProvider()
		{
			base.SupportedClipboardFormats = string.Join(",", "DeviceIndependentBitmap");
		}

		protected internal override void LoadDocument(LoadDocumentContext context)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_LoadingNotSupported", "ImageSerializationProvider"));
		}

		protected internal override void SaveDocument(SaveDocumentContext context)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException(Utilities.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_SavingNotSupported", "ImageSerializationProvider"));
		}

		protected internal override LoadFromClipboardResult LoadFromClipboard(LoadFromClipboardContext context)
		{
			string format = context.Format;
			if (format == "DeviceIndependentBitmap")
			{
				try
				{
					byte[] array = ImageFromClipboardDib(context.Data as Stream);
					if (array == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					RichTextImage image = new RichTextImage(array, RichTextImageFormat.Bmp);
					return new LoadFromClipboardResult(new DocumentRootNode
					{
						ChildNodes = new NodeCollection
						{
							new DocumentBodyNode
							{
								ChildNodes = new NodeCollection
								{
									new ParagraphNode
									{
										ChildNodes = new NodeCollection
										{
											new RunNode
											{
												ChildNodes = new NodeCollection
												{
													new ImageNode
													{
														Image = image
													}
												}
											}
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					});
				}
				catch (Exception innerException)
				{
					throw new FileFormatException("There was an error loading the image.", innerException);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override bool SaveToClipboard(SaveToClipboardContext context)
		{
			string format = context.Format;
			_ = format == "DeviceIndependentBitmap";
			return false;
		}

		private static byte[] ImageFromClipboardDib(Stream original)
		{
			if (original == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				original.Position = 0L;
				byte[] array = new byte[original.Length];
				original.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				original.Position = 0L;
				BITMAPINFOHEADER bITMAPINFOHEADER = BITMAPINFOHEADER.FromByteArray(array, 0);
				int biSize = bITMAPINFOHEADER.biSize;
				int bfSize = 14 + bITMAPINFOHEADER.biSize + bITMAPINFOHEADER.biSizeImage;
				BITMAPFILEHEADER bITMAPFILEHEADER = new BITMAPFILEHEADER
				{
					bfType = 19778,
					bfSize = bfSize,
					bfReserved1 = 0,
					bfReserved2 = 0,
					bfOffBits = 14 + biSize + bITMAPINFOHEADER.biClrUsed * 4
				};
				byte[] array2 = bITMAPFILEHEADER.ToByteArray();
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				memoryStream.Write(array2, 0, array2.Length);
				memoryStream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
				return memoryStream.ToArray();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class LoadDocumentContext

		public LoadDocumentContext(RichTextDocument document, Stream stream, LoadOptionsBase options = null)
		{
			Document = document;
			Options = options;
			Stream = stream;
		}

		public T GetOptions<T>(T defaultOptions) where T : LoadOptionsBase
		{
			if (Options == null)
			{
				return defaultOptions;
			}
			return (Options as T) ?? throw new ArgumentException($"The options must be an instance of type {typeof(T).Name}.", "options");
		}
	}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("Value", typeof(string), typeof(PlainTextDocumentAdapter), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(null, OnValueChanged, DependencyPropertyUtilities.MetadataOptionFlags.BindsTwoWayByDefault));

		{

		{
			RichTextDocument document = base.Document;
