	public class PlainTextSerializationProvider : SerializationProviderBase
	{
		private class SaveVisitor : NodeTreeWalker
		{
			private class SaveContext
			{
				public int TableCellsInRowWritten { get; private set; }

				public int TableRowsWritten { get; private set; }

				public void OnTableCellNodeSaved(TableCellNode node)
				{
					TableCellsInRowWritten++;
				}

				public void OnTableNodeSaved(TableNode node)
				{
					TableRowsWritten = 0;
				}

				public void OnTableRowNodeSaved(TableRowNode node)
				{
					TableCellsInRowWritten = 0;
					TableRowsWritten++;
				}
			}

			private RunNode _currentRunNode;

			private readonly PlainTextFormatOptions _formatOptions;

			private readonly bool _isRootNodeTemporaryClipboardClone;

			private readonly bool _isSavingToClipboard;

			private readonly DocumentRootNode _rootNode;

			private readonly Stack<SaveContext> _saveContextsPerTableNesting;

			private readonly StreamWriteHelper _writeHelper;

			private SaveContext CurrentSaveContext => _saveContextsPerTableNesting.Peek();

			public SaveVisitor(DocumentRootNode rootNode, StreamWriteHelper writeHelper, PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions, bool isSavingToClipboard = false)
			{
				_saveContextsPerTableNesting = new Stack<SaveContext>();
				_saveContextsPerTableNesting.Push(new SaveContext());
				_formatOptions = formatOptions;
				_isRootNodeTemporaryClipboardClone = rootNode.HasCustomAttribute("IsClipboardRootNodeClone");
				_isSavingToClipboard = isSavingToClipboard;
				_rootNode = rootNode;
				_writeHelper = writeHelper;
			}

			public override void VisitBreakNode(BreakNode node)
			{
				_writeHelper.Write(_formatOptions.NewLineText);
			}

			public override void VisitCellNode(TableCellNode node)
			{
				SaveContext currentSaveContext = CurrentSaveContext;
				if (currentSaveContext.TableCellsInRowWritten != 0)
				{
					_writeHelper.Write(_formatOptions.TableCellSeparationText);
				}
				_saveContextsPerTableNesting.Push(new SaveContext());
				base.VisitCellNode(node);
				_saveContextsPerTableNesting.Pop();
				currentSaveContext.OnTableCellNodeSaved(node);
			}

			public override void VisitImageNode(ImageNode node)
			{
				_writeHelper.Write(_formatOptions.ImagePlaceholderText);
			}

			public override void VisitParagraphNode(ParagraphNode node)
			{
				if (_isSavingToClipboard && _isRootNodeTemporaryClipboardClone)
				{
					string customAttribute = node.GetCustomAttribute("IG_PrecedingListIndicatorText");
					if (customAttribute != null)
					{
						_writeHelper.Write(customAttribute);
					}
				}
				else if (node.IsListItemResolved)
				{
					_writeHelper.Write(Utilities.GetPlainTextListIndicatorAndSuffix(node.ListItemInfoResolved, _rootNode));
				}
				base.VisitParagraphNode(node);
				if (SerializationUtilities.IsParagraphMarkSelected(node))
				{
					_writeHelper.Write(GetParagraphSeparationText(node, SerializationUtilities.HasMultipleSelections(_rootNode)));
				}
			}

			public override void VisitRowNode(TableRowNode node)
			{
				SaveContext currentSaveContext = CurrentSaveContext;
				if (currentSaveContext.TableRowsWritten != 0)
				{
					_writeHelper.Write(_formatOptions.TableRowSeparationText);
				}
				base.VisitRowNode(node);
				currentSaveContext.OnTableRowNodeSaved(node);
			}

			public override void VisitRunNode(RunNode node)
			{
				RunNode currentRunNode = _currentRunNode;
				_currentRunNode = node;
				base.VisitRunNode(node);
				_currentRunNode = currentRunNode;
			}

			public override void VisitTableNode(TableNode node)
			{
				SaveContext currentSaveContext = CurrentSaveContext;
				base.VisitTableNode(node);
				if (node.GetNextSibling() != null)
				{
					_writeHelper.Write(_formatOptions.ParagraphSeparationText);
				}
				currentSaveContext.OnTableNodeSaved(node);
			}

			public override void VisitTextNode(TextNode node)
			{
				string text = node.Text;
				if (text != null)
				{
					if (_currentRunNode != null && (_currentRunNode.SettingsResolved.AreAllCharactersCapitalized() || _currentRunNode.HasCustomAttribute("IG_HadCapitalizedText")))
					{
						text = text.ToUpper();
					}
					_writeHelper.Write(text);
				}
			}

			private string GetParagraphSeparationText(ParagraphNode node, bool forceSeparationAfterLastParagraph = false)
			{
				NodeBase nextSibling = node.GetNextSibling();
				if (node != null && node.IsListItemResolved && nextSibling is ParagraphNode { IsListItemResolved: not false } paragraphNode && paragraphNode.ListId == node.ListId)
				{
					return _formatOptions.ListItemSeparationText;
				}
				if (!forceSeparationAfterLastParagraph && nextSibling == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return _formatOptions.ParagraphSeparationText;
			}
		}

		private class StreamReadHelper
		{
			private const int ByteBufferSize = 1024;

			private const int CharBufferSize = 1024;

			private readonly byte[] _byteBuffer;

			private readonly char[] _charBuffer;

			private int _charBufferCount;

			private int _charBufferPosition;

			private readonly Decoder _decoder;

			private readonly StringBuilder _lineBuilder;

			private string _resolvedNewLineText;

			private string _resolvedParagraphSeparationText;

			private readonly Stream _stream;

			private readonly TextReader _textReader;

			private bool StreamHasMoreData => _stream.Position < _stream.Length;

			public StreamReadHelper(Stream stream, Encoding encoding, PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions)
			{
				_stream = stream;
				_byteBuffer = new byte[1024];
				int num = _stream.Read(_byteBuffer, 0, _byteBuffer.Length);
				int firstByteIndex = 0;
				if (encoding == null)
				{
					encoding = DetectEncoding(num, ref firstByteIndex);
				}
				_decoder = encoding.GetDecoder();
				_charBuffer = new char[encoding.GetMaxCharCount(1024)];
				_lineBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				InitializeFormatOptions(formatOptions);
				CacheNextBufferHelper(firstByteIndex, num - firstByteIndex);
			}

			public StreamReadHelper(TextReader textReader, PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions)
			{
				_textReader = textReader;
				_charBuffer = new char[1024];
				_lineBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				InitializeFormatOptions(formatOptions);
				CacheNextBuffer();
			}

			public string ReadLine(out bool? isParagraphBreak)
			{
				isParagraphBreak = null;
				if (_charBufferCount == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				_lineBuilder.Clear();
				while (true)
				{
					int originalPosition = _charBufferPosition;
					int lineEndIndex = _charBufferCount;
					while (_charBufferPosition < _charBufferCount)
					{
						TryMatchLineEnding(ref originalPosition, ref lineEndIndex, ref isParagraphBreak);
						if (isParagraphBreak.HasValue)
						{
							break;
						}
						_charBufferPosition++;
					}
					_lineBuilder.Append(_charBuffer, originalPosition, lineEndIndex - originalPosition);
					if (isParagraphBreak.HasValue)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!CacheNextBuffer())
					{
						if (_lineBuilder.Length != 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						return null;
					}
				}
				return _lineBuilder.ToString();
			}

			private bool CacheNextBuffer()
			{
				if (_stream != null)
				{
					if (!StreamHasMoreData)
					{
						_charBufferCount = 0;
						_charBufferPosition = 0;
						return false;
					}
					int count = _stream.Read(_byteBuffer, 0, _byteBuffer.Length);
					CacheNextBufferHelper(0, count);
					return true;
				}
				_charBufferCount = _textReader.Read(_charBuffer, 0, _charBuffer.Length);
				_charBufferPosition = 0;
				return _charBufferCount != 0;
			}

			private void CacheNextBufferHelper(int startIndex, int count)
			{
				_charBufferCount = _decoder.GetChars(_byteBuffer, startIndex, count, _charBuffer, 0, !StreamHasMoreData);
				_charBufferPosition = 0;
			}

			private Encoding DetectEncoding(int byteCount, ref int firstByteIndex)
			{
				Encoding result = SerializationUtilities.DefaultEncoding;
				if ((long)byteCount >= 2L)
				{
					if (byte.MaxValue == _byteBuffer[0] && 254 == _byteBuffer[1])
					{
						firstByteIndex = 2;
						result = Encoding.Unicode;
					}
					else if (254 == _byteBuffer[0] && byte.MaxValue == _byteBuffer[1])
					{
						firstByteIndex = 2;
						result = Encoding.BigEndianUnicode;
					}
					else if ((long)byteCount >= 3L && 239 == _byteBuffer[0] && 187 == _byteBuffer[1] && 191 == _byteBuffer[2])
					{
						firstByteIndex = 3;
						result = Encoding.UTF8;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}

			private static char GetResolvedChar(string s, ref int sIndex)
			{
				char c = s[sIndex];
				switch (c)
				{
				case '\r':
					if (sIndex + 1 < s.Length && s[sIndex + 1] == '\n')
					{
						sIndex++;
					}
					return '\n';
				case '\n':
					if (sIndex + 1 < s.Length && s[sIndex + 1] == '\r')
					{
						sIndex++;
					}
					return '\n';
				default:
					return c;
				}
			}

			private static char GetResolvedChar(char[] s, ref int sIndex)
			{
				char c = s[sIndex];
				switch (c)
				{
				case '\r':
					if (sIndex + 1 < s.Length && s[sIndex + 1] == '\n')
					{
						sIndex++;
					}
					return '\n';
				case '\n':
					if (sIndex + 1 < s.Length && s[sIndex + 1] == '\r')
					{
						sIndex++;
					}
					return '\n';
				default:
					return c;
				}
			}

			private void InitializeFormatOptions(PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions)
			{
				if (formatOptions == null)
				{
					formatOptions = PlainTextFormatOptions.Default;
				}
				_resolvedNewLineText = ResolveFormatString(formatOptions.NewLineText);
				_resolvedParagraphSeparationText = ResolveFormatString(formatOptions.ParagraphSeparationText);
			}

			private static bool? MatchFormatString(char[] charBuffer, ref int charBufferIndex, string resolvedFormatString, ref int formatStringIndex)
			{
				if (resolvedFormatString == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = charBufferIndex;
				while (charBufferIndex < charBuffer.Length)
				{
					char resolvedChar = GetResolvedChar(charBuffer, ref charBufferIndex);
					char c = resolvedFormatString[formatStringIndex];
					if (resolvedChar != c)
					{
						formatStringIndex = 0;
						charBufferIndex = num;
						return false;
					}
					charBufferIndex++;
					formatStringIndex++;
					if (formatStringIndex == resolvedFormatString.Length)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			private static string ResolveFormatString(string formatString)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formatString))
				{
					return null;
				}
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				for (int i = 0; i < formatString.Length; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(GetResolvedChar(formatString, ref i));
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}

			private void TryMatchLineEnding(ref int originalPosition, ref int lineEndIndex, ref bool? isParagraphBreak)
			{
				int charBufferIndex = _charBufferPosition;
				int formatStringIndex = 0;
				bool? flag = null;
				int charBufferIndex2 = _charBufferPosition;
				int formatStringIndex2 = 0;
				bool? flag2 = null;
				while (true)
				{
					if (!flag.HasValue)
					{
						flag = MatchFormatString(_charBuffer, ref charBufferIndex, _resolvedParagraphSeparationText, ref formatStringIndex);
					}
					if (flag == true)
					{
						flag2 = false;
					}
					else if (!flag2.HasValue)
					{
						flag2 = MatchFormatString(_charBuffer, ref charBufferIndex2, _resolvedNewLineText, ref formatStringIndex2);
					}
					if (flag.HasValue && flag2.HasValue)
					{
						break;
					}
					_lineBuilder.Append(_charBuffer, originalPosition, _charBufferCount - originalPosition);
					if (!CacheNextBuffer())
					{
						return;
					}
					originalPosition = _charBufferPosition;
					_charBufferPosition = -1;
					lineEndIndex = _charBufferCount;
				}
				if (flag == true)
				{
					isParagraphBreak = true;
					lineEndIndex = _charBufferPosition;
					_charBufferPosition = charBufferIndex;
				}
				else if (flag2 == true)
				{
					isParagraphBreak = false;
					lineEndIndex = _charBufferPosition;
					_charBufferPosition = charBufferIndex2;
				}
			}
		}

		private class StreamWriteHelper : IDisposable
		{
			private const int CharBufferSize = 1024;

			private readonly byte[] _byteBuffer;

			private readonly char[] _charBuffer;

			private int _charBufferCount;

			private readonly System.Text.Encoder _encoder;

			private readonly Stream _stream;

			private readonly TextWriter _textWriter;

			public StreamWriteHelper(Stream stream, Encoding encoding, bool writeByteOrderMarks)
			{
				_stream = stream;
				_encoder = encoding.GetEncoder();
				_charBuffer = new char[1024];
				_byteBuffer = new byte[encoding.GetMaxByteCount(1024)];
				if (writeByteOrderMarks)
				{
					if (encoding == Encoding.Unicode)
					{
						_stream.Write(new byte[2] { 255, 254 }, 0, 2);
					}
					else if (encoding == Encoding.BigEndianUnicode)
					{
						_stream.Write(new byte[2] { 254, 255 }, 0, 2);
					}
					else if (encoding == Encoding.UTF8)
					{
						_stream.Write(new byte[3] { 239, 187, 191 }, 0, 3);
					}
				}
			}

			public StreamWriteHelper(TextWriter textWriter)
			{
				_textWriter = textWriter;
				_charBuffer = new char[1024];
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
				CommitToStream(flush: true);
			}

			private void CommitToStream(bool flush)
			{
				if (_charBufferCount != 0)
				{
					if (_stream == null)
					{
						_textWriter.Write(_charBuffer, 0, _charBufferCount);
					}
					else
					{
						int bytes = _encoder.GetBytes(_charBuffer, 0, _charBufferCount, _byteBuffer, 0, flush);
						_stream.Write(_byteBuffer, 0, bytes);
					}
					_charBufferCount = 0;
				}
			}

			public void Write(string value)
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num;
				for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i += num)
				{
					if (_charBufferCount == _charBuffer.Length)
					{
						CommitToStream(flush: false);
					}
					num = Math.Min(_charBuffer.Length - _charBufferCount, value.Length - i);
					value.CopyTo(i, _charBuffer, _charBufferCount, num);
					_charBufferCount += num;
				}
			}
		}

		private static readonly PlainTextSerializationProvider _instance = new PlainTextSerializationProvider();

		public static PlainTextSerializationProvider Instance => _instance;

		public PlainTextFormatOptions ClipboardFormatOptions { get; set; }

		public PlainTextFormatOptions FormatOptions { get; set; }

		private PlainTextFormatOptions ClipboardFormatOptionsResolved => ClipboardFormatOptions ?? PlainTextFormatOptions.ClipboardDefault;

		private PlainTextFormatOptions FormatOptionsResolved => FormatOptions ?? PlainTextFormatOptions.Default;

		public PlainTextSerializationProvider()
		{
			base.SupportedClipboardFormats = string.Join(",", "System.String", "UnicodeText", "Text");
		}

		protected internal override void LoadDocument(LoadDocumentContext context)
		{
			PlainTextLoadOptions options = context.GetOptions(PlainTextLoadOptions.DefaultInstance);
			DocumentRootNode rootNode = CreateNodeFromPlainTextStream(context.Stream, options.Encoding, options.FormatOptions ?? FormatOptionsResolved);
			context.Document.RootNode = rootNode;
		}

		protected internal override void SaveDocument(SaveDocumentContext context)
		{
			PlainTextSaveOptions options = context.GetOptions(PlainTextSaveOptions.DefaultInstance);
			PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions = options.FormatOptions ?? FormatOptionsResolved;
			Encoding encoding = options.Encoding ?? Encoding.UTF8;
			using StreamWriteHelper writeHelper = new StreamWriteHelper(context.Stream, encoding, writeByteOrderMarks: true);
			SaveVisitor visitor = new SaveVisitor(context.DocumentRootNode, writeHelper, formatOptions);
			context.DocumentRootNode.Accept(visitor);
		}

		protected internal override LoadFromClipboardResult LoadFromClipboard(LoadFromClipboardContext context)
		{
			switch (context.Format)
			{
			case "System.String":
			case "UnicodeText":
			case "Text":
				return LoadFromPlainTextFormat(context);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool SaveToClipboard(SaveToClipboardContext context)
		{
			switch (context.Format)
			{
			case "UnicodeText":
				return SaveToPlainTextFormat(context, Encoding.Unicode);
			case "System.String":
			case "Text":
				return SaveToPlainTextFormat(context, SerializationUtilities.DefaultEncoding);
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static RunNode CreateBlankParagraphAndRunNode(DocumentBodyNode bodyNode)
		{
			ParagraphNode paragraphNode = new ParagraphNode();
			bodyNode.ChildNodes.Add(paragraphNode);
			RunNode runNode = new RunNode();
			paragraphNode.ChildNodes.Add(runNode);
			return runNode;
		}

		internal static DocumentRootNode CreateNodeFromPlainTextStream(Stream stream, Encoding encoding, PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions)
		{
			bool breakParagraphAfterContent;
			return CreateNodeFromStreamReadHelper(new StreamReadHelper(stream, encoding, formatOptions), out breakParagraphAfterContent);
		}

		private static DocumentRootNode CreateNodeFromStreamReadHelper(StreamReadHelper streamReadHelper, out bool breakParagraphAfterContent)
		{
			breakParagraphAfterContent = false;
			try
			{
				DocumentRootNode documentRootNode = new DocumentRootNode();
				documentRootNode.CustomAttributes.Add(new NodeAttribute
				{
					Name = "IG_LoadedFromPlainText"
				});
				DocumentBodyNode documentBodyNode = new DocumentBodyNode();
				documentRootNode.ChildNodes.Add(documentBodyNode);
				RunNode runNode = CreateBlankParagraphAndRunNode(documentBodyNode);
				string text;
				bool? isParagraphBreak;
				while ((text = streamReadHelper.ReadLine(out isParagraphBreak)) != null)
				{
					runNode.ChildNodes.Add(new TextNode
					{
						Text = text
					});
					if (isParagraphBreak.HasValue)
					{
						if (isParagraphBreak == true)
						{
							runNode = CreateBlankParagraphAndRunNode(documentBodyNode);
						}
						else
						{
							runNode.ChildNodes.Add(new BreakNode());
						}
					}
				}
				if (runNode.ChildNodes.Count == 0 && documentBodyNode.ChildNodes.Count > 1)
				{
					documentBodyNode.ChildNodes.RemoveAt(documentBodyNode.ChildNodes.Count - 1);
					breakParagraphAfterContent = true;
				}
				return documentRootNode;
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new FileFormatException("There was an error loading the plain text document.", innerException);
			}
		}

		internal static DocumentRootNode CreateNodeFromTextReader(TextReader textReader, PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions)
		{
			bool breakParagraphAfterContent;
			return CreateNodeFromTextReader(textReader, formatOptions, out breakParagraphAfterContent);
		}

		internal static DocumentRootNode CreateNodeFromTextReader(TextReader textReader, PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions, out bool breakParagraphAfterContent)
		{
			return CreateNodeFromStreamReadHelper(new StreamReadHelper(textReader, formatOptions), out breakParagraphAfterContent);
		}

		private LoadFromClipboardResult LoadFromPlainTextFormat(LoadFromClipboardContext context)
		{
			if (!(context.Data is string s))
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				using StringReader textReader = new StringReader(s);
				bool breakParagraphAfterContent;
				return new LoadFromClipboardResult(CreateNodeFromTextReader(textReader, ClipboardFormatOptionsResolved, out breakParagraphAfterContent), breakParagraphAfterContent);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Utilities.LogDebuggerError("Failed to Paste from Clipboard with following exception: " + ex.ToString());
				throw;
			}
		}

		internal static DocumentRootNode LoadFromString(string value, PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions)
		{
			using StringReader textReader = new StringReader(value);
			bool breakParagraphAfterContent;
			return CreateNodeFromTextReader(textReader, formatOptions, out breakParagraphAfterContent);
		}

		private bool SaveToPlainTextFormat(SaveToClipboardContext context, Encoding encoding)
		{
			try
			{
				PlainTextFormatOptions clipboardFormatOptionsResolved = ClipboardFormatOptionsResolved;
				using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
				{
					using (StreamWriteHelper writeHelper = new StreamWriteHelper(memoryStream, encoding, writeByteOrderMarks: false))
					{
						DocumentRootNode selectedContentRootNode = context.SelectedContentRootNode;
						SaveVisitor visitor = new SaveVisitor(selectedContentRootNode, writeHelper, clipboardFormatOptionsResolved, isSavingToClipboard: true);
						selectedContentRootNode.Accept(visitor);
					}
					byte[] array = memoryStream.ToArray();
					context.Data = encoding.GetString(array, 0, array.Length);
				}
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Utilities.LogDebuggerError("Failed to Copy to Clipboard with following exception: " + ex.ToString());
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static string SaveToString(DocumentRootNode rootNode, PlainTextFormatOptions formatOptions)
		{
			using StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
			using (StreamWriteHelper writeHelper = new StreamWriteHelper(stringWriter))
			{
				if (formatOptions == null)
				{
					formatOptions = PlainTextFormatOptions.Default;
				}
				SaveVisitor visitor = new SaveVisitor(rootNode, writeHelper, formatOptions);
				rootNode.Accept(visitor);
			}
			stringWriter.Flush();
			return stringWriter.GetStringBuilder().ToString();
		}
	}
	public abstract class RichTextDocumentAdapterBase : FrameworkElement
	{
		private readonly DeferredOperation _deferredRefreshDocumentOrValueOperation;

		private readonly DeferredOperation _deferredRefreshValueOperation;

		private bool _documentHasUnsavedChanges;

		private bool _documentPropertyIsDirty;

		private bool _hasDocumentBeenSetOnce;

		private bool _isContentChangedHooked;

		private bool _isRefreshingDocument;

		private bool _isRefreshingValue;

		private DispatcherTimer _timerFromFirstEdit;

		private DispatcherTimer _timerFromLastEdit;

		private bool _valuePropertyIsDirty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DelayAfterFirstEditProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("DelayAfterFirstEdit", typeof(TimeSpan?), typeof(RichTextDocumentAdapterBase), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(null, OnDelayAfterFirstEditChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DelayAfterLastEditProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("DelayAfterLastEdit", typeof(TimeSpan?), typeof(RichTextDocumentAdapterBase), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(null, OnDelayAfterLastEditChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DocumentProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("Document", typeof(RichTextDocument), typeof(RichTextDocumentAdapterBase), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(null, OnDocumentChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RefreshTriggerProperty = DependencyPropertyUtilities.Register("RefreshTrigger", typeof(RichTextRefreshTrigger), typeof(RichTextDocumentAdapterBase), DependencyPropertyUtilities.CreateMetadata(RichTextRefreshTrigger.LostFocus, OnRefreshTriggerChanged));

		public TimeSpan? DelayAfterFirstEdit
		{
			get
			{
				return (TimeSpan?)GetValue(DelayAfterFirstEditProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DelayAfterFirstEditProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public TimeSpan? DelayAfterLastEdit
		{
			get
			{
				return (TimeSpan?)GetValue(DelayAfterLastEditProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DelayAfterLastEditProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public RichTextDocument Document
		{
			get
			{
				return (RichTextDocument)GetValue(DocumentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DocumentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public RichTextRefreshTrigger RefreshTrigger
		{
			get
			{
				return (RichTextRefreshTrigger)GetValue(RefreshTriggerProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RefreshTriggerProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFirstEditTimerRunning
		{
			get
			{
				if (_timerFromFirstEdit != null)
				{
					return _timerFromFirstEdit.IsEnabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<DocumentLoadErrorEventArgs> DocumentLoadError;

		protected RichTextDocumentAdapterBase()
		{
			_deferredRefreshDocumentOrValueOperation = new DeferredOperation(RefreshDocumentOrValue);
			_deferredRefreshValueOperation = new DeferredOperation(RefreshValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDocumentLoadError(DocumentLoadErrorEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.DocumentLoadError != null)
			{
				this.DocumentLoadError(this, args);
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseDocumentLoadError(Exception exception)
		{
			DocumentLoadErrorEventArgs e = new DocumentLoadErrorEventArgs(exception);
			OnDocumentLoadError(e);
			if (e.RethrowException)
			{
				throw exception;
			}
		}

		public void RefreshDocument()
		{
			if (!_valuePropertyIsDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isRefreshingDocument = _isRefreshingDocument;
			RichTextDocument document = Document;
			Exception ex = null;
			try
			{
				document?.SuspendImageDownloads();
				_isRefreshingDocument = true;
				try
				{
					RefreshDocumentCore();
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					ex = ex2;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_isRefreshingDocument = isRefreshingDocument;
				document?.ResumeImageDownloads();
			}
			OnDocumentOrValueRefreshed();
			if (ex != null)
			{
				RaiseDocumentLoadError(ex);
			}
		}

		public void RefreshValue()
		{
			if (_documentHasUnsavedChanges)
			{
				bool isRefreshingValue = _isRefreshingValue;
				try
				{
					_isRefreshingValue = true;
					RefreshValueCore();
				}
				finally
				{
					_isRefreshingValue = isRefreshingValue;
				}
				OnDocumentOrValueRefreshed();
			}
		}

		protected abstract void RefreshDocumentCore();

		protected abstract void RefreshValueCore();

		protected void OnSaveOptionsChanged()
		{
			_documentHasUnsavedChanges = true;
			_deferredRefreshValueOperation.StartAsyncOperation();
		}

		protected void OnValueChanged()
		{
			if (!_isRefreshingValue)
			{
				_valuePropertyIsDirty = true;
				_deferredRefreshValueOperation.CancelPendingOperation();
				OnDocumentOrValueChanged();
			}
		}

		[Conditional("LOG_DOCUMENT_VALUE_ACTIVITY")]
		internal static void LogActivity(string message)
		{
			Utilities.LogDebuggerError(message + Environment.NewLine);
		}

		internal void OnEditorLostFocus()
		{
			if (RefreshTrigger == RichTextRefreshTrigger.LostFocus)
			{
				RefreshValue();
			}
		}

		private void AttachToDocument(RichTextDocument document)
		{
			document.RegisterDocumentAdapter(this);
			HookContentChanged(document);
			_documentHasUnsavedChanges = true;
			_documentPropertyIsDirty = true;
		}

		private void CancelPendingOperations()
		{
			if (_deferredRefreshValueOperation.IsOperationPending)
			{
				_deferredRefreshValueOperation.CancelPendingOperation();
			}
			if (_deferredRefreshDocumentOrValueOperation.IsOperationPending)
			{
				_deferredRefreshDocumentOrValueOperation.CancelPendingOperation();
			}
		}

		private void DetachFromDocument(RichTextDocument document)
		{
			document.UnregisterDocumentAdapter(this);
			UnhookContentChanged(document);
			_documentHasUnsavedChanges = true;
			_documentPropertyIsDirty = true;
		}

		private void HookContentChanged(RichTextDocument document)
		{
			if (!_isContentChangedHooked)
			{
				document.ContentChanged += OnDocumentContentChanged;
				_isContentChangedHooked = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnDelayTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			StopTimers();
			RefreshValue();
		}

		private void OnDocumentContentChanged(object sender, DocumentContentChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_isRefreshingDocument)
			{
				return;
			}
			_documentHasUnsavedChanges = true;
			switch (RefreshTrigger)
			{
			case RichTextRefreshTrigger.Delayed:
				ResetLastEditTimer();
				if (!IsFirstEditTimerRunning)
				{
					ResetFirstEditTimer();
				}
				break;
			case RichTextRefreshTrigger.ContentChanged:
				RefreshValue();
				break;
			case RichTextRefreshTrigger.Explicit:
			case RichTextRefreshTrigger.LostFocus:
				break;
			}
		}

		private void OnDocumentOrValueChanged()
		{
			_deferredRefreshDocumentOrValueOperation.StartAsyncOperation();
		}

		private void OnDocumentOrValueRefreshed()
		{
			ResetDirtyFlags();
			CancelPendingOperations();
			StopTimers();
		}

		private void RefreshDocumentOrValue()
		{
			if (_valuePropertyIsDirty)
			{
				if (!_hasDocumentBeenSetOnce && Document == null && GetBindingExpression(DocumentProperty) != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				RefreshDocument();
			}
			else if (_documentPropertyIsDirty)
			{
				RefreshValue();
			}
			ResetDirtyFlags();
		}

		private void ResetDirtyFlags()
		{
			_documentHasUnsavedChanges = false;
			_documentPropertyIsDirty = false;
			_valuePropertyIsDirty = false;
			if (!_hasDocumentBeenSetOnce)
			{
				_hasDocumentBeenSetOnce = Document != null;
			}
		}

		private void ResetFirstEditTimer()
		{
			if (_timerFromFirstEdit != null && DelayAfterFirstEdit.HasValue)
			{
				_timerFromFirstEdit.Stop();
				_timerFromFirstEdit.Start();
			}
		}

		private void ResetLastEditTimer()
		{
			if (_timerFromLastEdit != null && DelayAfterLastEdit.HasValue)
			{
				_timerFromLastEdit.Stop();
				_timerFromLastEdit.Start();
			}
		}

		private void StopTimers()
		{
			if (_timerFromFirstEdit != null)
			{
				_timerFromFirstEdit.Stop();
			}
			if (_timerFromLastEdit != null)
			{
				_timerFromLastEdit.Stop();
			}
		}

		private void UnhookContentChanged(RichTextDocument document)
		{
			if (_isContentChangedHooked)
			{
				document.ContentChanged -= OnDocumentContentChanged;
				_isContentChangedHooked = false;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFirstEditTimer(TimeSpan? delayAfterFirstEdit)
		{
			if (!delayAfterFirstEdit.HasValue)
			{
				if (_timerFromFirstEdit != null)
				{
					_timerFromFirstEdit.Tick -= OnDelayTimerTick;
					_timerFromFirstEdit.Stop();
					_timerFromFirstEdit = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (_timerFromFirstEdit == null)
				{
					_timerFromFirstEdit = new DispatcherTimer();
					_timerFromFirstEdit.Tick += OnDelayTimerTick;
				}
				_timerFromFirstEdit.Interval = delayAfterFirstEdit.Value;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLastEditTimer(TimeSpan? delayAfterLastEdit)
		{
			if (!delayAfterLastEdit.HasValue)
			{
				if (_timerFromLastEdit != null)
				{
					_timerFromLastEdit.Tick -= OnDelayTimerTick;
					_timerFromLastEdit.Stop();
					_timerFromLastEdit = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (_timerFromLastEdit == null)
				{
					_timerFromLastEdit = new DispatcherTimer();
					_timerFromLastEdit.Tick += OnDelayTimerTick;
				}
				_timerFromLastEdit.Interval = delayAfterLastEdit.Value;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTigger(RichTextRefreshTrigger trigger)
		{
			switch (trigger)
			{
			default:
				StopTimers();
				break;
			case RichTextRefreshTrigger.Delayed:
				if (_documentHasUnsavedChanges)
				{
					ResetFirstEditTimer();
					ResetLastEditTimer();
				}
				break;
			case RichTextRefreshTrigger.ContentChanged:
				StopTimers();
				RefreshValue();
				break;
			case RichTextRefreshTrigger.LostFocus:
				StopTimers();
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void OnDelayAfterFirstEditChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RichTextDocumentAdapterBase)d).UpdateFirstEditTimer((TimeSpan?)e.NewValue);
		}

		private static void OnDelayAfterLastEditChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RichTextDocumentAdapterBase)d).UpdateLastEditTimer((TimeSpan?)e.NewValue);
		}

		private static void OnDocumentChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RichTextDocumentAdapterBase richTextDocumentAdapterBase = (RichTextDocumentAdapterBase)d;
			RichTextDocument richTextDocument = (RichTextDocument)e.OldValue;
			if (richTextDocument != null)
			{
				richTextDocumentAdapterBase.DetachFromDocument(richTextDocument);
			}
			RichTextDocument richTextDocument2 = (RichTextDocument)e.NewValue;
			if (richTextDocument2 != null)
			{
				richTextDocumentAdapterBase.AttachToDocument(richTextDocument2);
			}
			richTextDocumentAdapterBase.OnDocumentOrValueChanged();
		}

		private static void OnRefreshTriggerChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RichTextDocumentAdapterBase)d).UpdateTigger((RichTextRefreshTrigger)e.NewValue);
		}
	}
	public class DocumentLoadErrorEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private bool _rethrowException = true;

		private Exception _exception;

		public string Description
		{
			get
			{
				if (_exception.InnerException == null)
				{
					return _exception.Message;
				}
				return $"{_exception.Message}\r\n{_exception.InnerException.Message}";
			}
		}

		public Exception Exception => _exception;

		public bool RethrowException
		{
			get
			{
				return _rethrowException;
			}
			set
			{
				_rethrowException = value;
			}
		}

		public DocumentLoadErrorEventArgs(Exception exception)
		{
			_exception = exception;
		}
	}

		public SaveDocumentContext(DocumentRootNode documentRootNode, Stream stream, SaveOptionsBase options = null)
		{
			DocumentRootNode = documentRootNode;
			Options = options;
			Stream = stream;
		}

		public T GetOptions<T>(T defaultOptions) where T : SaveOptionsBase
		{
			if (Options == null)
			{
				return defaultOptions;
			}
			return (Options as T) ?? throw new ArgumentException($"The options must be an instance of type {typeof(T).Name}.", "options");
		}
	}

				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}

		public static System.Windows.Size? GetDimensions(MemoryStream imageData)
		{
			using BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(imageData);
			return GetDimensions(binaryReader);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Size? GetDimensions(BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			return GetHelper(binaryReader, ImageFormatDecoders)?.Item2(binaryReader);
		}

		private static T GetHelper<T>(BinaryReader binaryReader, Dictionary<byte[], T> map)
		{
			try
			{
				int num = map.Keys.Max((byte[] x) => x.Length);
				byte[] array = new byte[num];
				int i;
				for (i = 0; i < num && i < binaryReader.BaseStream.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = binaryReader.ReadByte();
					foreach (KeyValuePair<byte[], T> item in map.Where((KeyValuePair<byte[], T> p) => p.Key.Length == i + 1))
					{
						if (item.Key.Length - 1 <= i && array.StartsWith(item.Key))
						{
							return item.Value;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		public static RichTextImageFormat? GetImageFormat(Stream imageData)
		{
			using BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(imageData);
			return GetImageFormat(binaryReader);
		}

		public static RichTextImageFormat? GetImageFormat(BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			return GetHelper(binaryReader, ImageFormatDecoders)?.Item1;
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size? GetBitmapDimensions(BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(16);
			int num = binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			int num2 = binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size? GetEmfDimensions(BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(4);
			int num = binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			int num2 = binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			int num3 = binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			int num4 = binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(4);
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(4);
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(4);
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(4);
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(4);
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(4);
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(4);
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(4);
			binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: true);
			return new System.Windows.Size(num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size? GetGifDimensions(BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			short num = binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian: true);
			int num2 = binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian: true);
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size? GetJfifDimensions(BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			while (binaryReader.ReadByte() == byte.MaxValue)
			{
				byte num = binaryReader.ReadByte();
				short num2 = binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian: false);
				if (num == 192)
				{
					binaryReader.ReadByte();
					int num3 = binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian: false);
					return new System.Windows.Size(binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian: false), num3);
				}
				binaryReader.ReadBytes(num2 - 2);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size? GetPngDimensions(BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(8);
			int num = binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: false);
			int num2 = binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian: false);
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size? GetTiffDimensions(BinaryReader binaryReader, bool isLittleEndian)
		{
			uint? num = null;
			uint? num2 = null;
			while (true)
			{
				int num3 = binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian);
				if (num3 == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				binaryReader.BaseStream.Position = num3;
				short num4 = binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian);
				for (int i = 0; i < num4; i++)
				{
					short num5 = binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian);
					short type = binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian);
					int valueCount = binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian);
					int valueOffset = binaryReader.ReadInt32(isLittleEndian);
					switch (num5)
					{
					case 256:
						num2 = GetTiffValue(binaryReader, isLittleEndian, type, valueCount, valueOffset);
						break;
					case 257:
						num = GetTiffValue(binaryReader, isLittleEndian, type, valueCount, valueOffset);
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num.HasValue && num2.HasValue)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size(num2.Value, num.Value);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static uint GetTiffValue(BinaryReader binaryReader, bool isLittleEndian, short type, int valueCount, int valueOffset)
		{
			if (valueCount == 1)
			{
				if (type == 3 && !isLittleEndian)
				{
					return (uint)valueOffset >> 16;
				}
				return (uint)valueOffset;
			}
			long position = binaryReader.BaseStream.Position;
			try
			{
				binaryReader.BaseStream.Position = valueOffset;
				return type switch
				{
					3 => binaryReader.ReadUInt16(isLittleEndian), 
					4 => binaryReader.ReadUInt32(isLittleEndian), 
					_ => 0u, 
				};
			}
			finally
			{
				binaryReader.BaseStream.Position = position;
			}
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size? GetWmfDimensions(BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(2);
			short num = binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian: true);
			short num2 = binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian: true);
			short num3 = binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian: true);
			short num4 = binaryReader.ReadInt16(isLittleEndian: true);
			return new System.Windows.Size(num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Size? GetWmfNonPlaceableDimensions(BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			return null;
		}

		private static short ReadInt16(this BinaryReader binaryReader, bool isLittleEndian)
		{
			if (isLittleEndian == BitConverter.IsLittleEndian)
			{
				return binaryReader.ReadInt16();
			}
			return binaryReader.ReadInt16Reverse();
		}

		private static short ReadInt16Reverse(this BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[2];
			for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
			{
				array[1 - i] = binaryReader.ReadByte();
			}
			return BitConverter.ToInt16(array, 0);
		}

		private static int ReadInt32(this BinaryReader binaryReader, bool isLittleEndian)
		{
			if (isLittleEndian == BitConverter.IsLittleEndian)
			{
				return binaryReader.ReadInt32();
			}
			return binaryReader.ReadInt32Reverse();
		}

		private static int ReadInt32Reverse(this BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[4];
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				array[3 - i] = binaryReader.ReadByte();
			}
			return BitConverter.ToInt32(array, 0);
		}

		private static ushort ReadUInt16(this BinaryReader binaryReader, bool isLittleEndian)
		{
			if (isLittleEndian == BitConverter.IsLittleEndian)
			{
				return binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
			}
			return binaryReader.ReadUInt16Reverse();
		}

		private static ushort ReadUInt16Reverse(this BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[2];
			for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
			{
				array[1 - i] = binaryReader.ReadByte();
			}
			return BitConverter.ToUInt16(array, 0);
		}

		private static uint ReadUInt32(this BinaryReader binaryReader, bool isLittleEndian)
		{
			if (isLittleEndian == BitConverter.IsLittleEndian)
			{
				return binaryReader.ReadUInt32();
			}
			return binaryReader.ReadUInt32Reverse();
		}

		private static uint ReadUInt32Reverse(this BinaryReader binaryReader)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[4];
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				array[3 - i] = binaryReader.ReadByte();
			}
			return BitConverter.ToUInt32(array, 0);
		}

		private static bool StartsWith(this byte[] source, byte[] comparison)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < comparison.Length; i++)
			{
				if (source[i] != comparison[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class ListTemplateWrapper
	{
		public int AbstractNumId;

		public readonly ListTemplate ListTemplate;

		public string NumStyleLink;

		public string StyleLink;

		public ListTemplateWrapper(ListTemplate listTemplate)
		{
			ListTemplate = listTemplate;
		}
	}
	internal class ListWrapper
	{
		public readonly RichTextList List;

		public ListTemplateWrapper ListTemplateWrapper;

		public int NumId;

		private ListWrapper(RichTextList list, DocumentRootNode rootNode, ListTemplate listStyleListTemplate, Dictionary<ListTemplate, ListTemplateWrapper> sharedTemplateWrappers)
		{
			List = list;
			if (rootNode != null)
			{
				ListTemplateWrapper = GetListTemplateResolved(rootNode, listStyleListTemplate, sharedTemplateWrappers);
			}
		}

		public static ListWrapper CreateForLoading(RichTextList list)
		{
			return new ListWrapper(list, null, null, null);
		}

		public static ListWrapper CreateForSaving(RichTextList list, DocumentRootNode rootNode, ListTemplate listStyleListTemplate = null, Dictionary<ListTemplate, ListTemplateWrapper> sharedTemplateWrappers = null)
		{
			return new ListWrapper(list, rootNode, listStyleListTemplate, sharedTemplateWrappers);
		}

		private ListTemplateWrapper GetListTemplateResolved(DocumentRootNode rootNode, ListTemplate listStyleListTemplate, Dictionary<ListTemplate, ListTemplateWrapper> sharedTemplateWrappers)
		{
			if (List.Template != null)
			{
				if (sharedTemplateWrappers != null && sharedTemplateWrappers.TryGetValue(List.Template, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return new ListTemplateWrapper(List.Template);
			}
			if (List.ListStyleId == null)
			{
				return new ListTemplateWrapper(new ListTemplate());
			}
			if (!(rootNode.Styles[List.ListStyleId] is ListStyle listStyle))
			{
				return new ListTemplateWrapper(new ListTemplate());
			}
			if (listStyleListTemplate != null)
			{
				return new ListTemplateWrapper(listStyleListTemplate)
				{
					StyleLink = List.ListStyleId
				};
			}
			if (listStyle.Template == null)
			{
				return new ListTemplateWrapper(new ListTemplate());
			}
			return new ListTemplateWrapper(new ListTemplate())
			{
				NumStyleLink = List.ListStyleId
			};
		}
	}
	internal static class SerializationUtilities
	{
		private class PopulateFontInfoMappingsHelper
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<string, ExtendedFontInfo> _fontInfoMappings;

			public PopulateFontInfoMappingsHelper(Dictionary<string, ExtendedFontInfo> fontInfoMappings)
			{
				_fontInfoMappings = fontInfoMappings;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			public int EnumFontFamExProc(ref NativeWindowMethods.ENUMLOGFONT lpelf, ref NativeWindowMethods.NEWTEXTMETRIC lpntm, uint FontType, IntPtr lParam)
			{
				string lfFaceName = lpelf.elfLogFont.lfFaceName;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(lfFaceName))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily fontPitchAndFamily = (NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily)(lpelf.elfLogFont.lfPitchAndFamily & 0x70);
				NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily fontPitchAndFamily2 = (NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily)(lpelf.elfLogFont.lfPitchAndFamily & -113);
				FontFamilyInternal fontFamilyInternal = fontPitchAndFamily switch
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.DEFAULT_PITCH => FontFamilyInternal.DontCare, 
					NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.FF_ROMAN => FontFamilyInternal.Roman, 
					NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.FF_SWISS => FontFamilyInternal.Swiss, 
					NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.FF_MODERN => FontFamilyInternal.Modern, 
					NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.FF_SCRIPT => FontFamilyInternal.Script, 
					NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.FF_DECORATIVE => FontFamilyInternal.Decorative, 
					_ => FontFamilyInternal.DontCare, 
				};
				RtfFontPitch fontPitch = fontPitchAndFamily2 switch
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.DEFAULT_PITCH => RtfFontPitch.Default, 
					NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.FIXED_PITCH => RtfFontPitch.Fixed, 
					NativeWindowMethods.FontPitchAndFamily.VARIABLE_PITCH => RtfFontPitch.Variable, 
					_ => RtfFontPitch.Default, 
				};
				byte lfCharSet = lpelf.elfLogFont.lfCharSet;
				if (_fontInfoMappings.TryGetValue(lfFaceName, out var value))
				{
					value.AddCharSet(lfCharSet);
				}
				else
				{
					_fontInfoMappings[lfFaceName] = new ExtendedFontInfo(fontFamilyInternal, fontPitch, lfCharSet);
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		public static int BinarySearchCharacterRanges<C>(char c, IList<C> list, Func<C, CharacterRange> rangeGetter)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = list.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num) / 2;
				CharacterRange characterRange = rangeGetter(list[num3]);
				if (characterRange.Contains(c))
				{
					return num3;
				}
				if (characterRange.End < c)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
				}
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		public static DocumentRootNode CreateEmptyRootNode()
		{
			return new DocumentRootNode
			{
				ChildNodes = new NodeCollection
				{
					new DocumentBodyNode
					{
						ChildNodes = new NodeCollection
						{
							new ParagraphNode()
						}
					}
				}
			};
		}

		public static CharacterType GetCharacterType(char c, CharacterSettings characterSettings)
		{
			if (ShouldForceComplexScript(characterSettings))
			{
				return CharacterType.ComplexScript;
			}
			return GetCharacterType(c);
		}

		public static CharacterType GetCharacterType(char c)
		{
			if (c < '\u0080')
			{
				return CharacterType.Ascii;
			}
			if (IsLetterlikeSymbol(c))
			{
				return CharacterType.HighAnsi;
			}
			switch (c)
			{
			case 338:
			case 339:
			case 352:
			case 353:
			case 376:
			case 381:
			case 382:
			case 402:
			case 710:
			case 732:
			case 8211:
			case 8212:
			case 8216:
			case 8217:
			case 8218:
			case 8220:
			case 8221:
			case 8222:
			case 8224:
			case 8226:
			case 8230:
			case 8240:
			case 8249:
			case 8250:
			case 8364:
				return CharacterType.HighAnsi;
			default:
				if ('\u0080' <= c && c <= 'ÿ')
				{
					return CharacterType.HighAnsi;
				}
				if ('Ѐ' <= c && c <= 'ӿ')
				{
					return CharacterType.HighAnsi;
				}
				if ('\uf020' <= c && c <= '\uf0ff')
				{
					return CharacterType.HighAnsi;
				}
				if (BinarySearchCharacterRanges(c, _eastAsianCharacterRanges, (CharacterRange r) => r) >= 0)
				{
					return CharacterType.EastAsian;
				}
				return CharacterType.ComplexScript;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsLetterlikeSymbol(char c)
		{
			if (!_letterlikeCharRange.HasValue)
			{
				_letterlikeCharRange = new CharacterRange('℀', '⅏');
			}
			return _letterlikeCharRange.Value.Contains(c);
		}

		public static RichTextFont? GetDefaultFont(FontSettings settings)
		{
			if (settings == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (settings.Hint)
			{
			case FontUsageHint.ComplexScript:
				if (settings.ComplexScript.HasValue)
				{
					return settings.ComplexScript;
				}
				break;
			case FontUsageHint.EastAsia:
				if (settings.EastAsia.HasValue)
				{
					return settings.EastAsia;
				}
				break;
			}
			return settings.Ascii ?? settings.HighAnsi ?? settings.EastAsia ?? settings.ComplexScript;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<T> GetEnumValues<T>() where T : struct
		{
			return from f in typeof(T).GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public)
				where f.IsLiteral
				select (T)f.GetValue(null);
		}

		public static ExtendedFontInfo GetExtendedFontInfo(string fontName, bool getDefaultFontInfo = false)
		{
			if (fontName != null)
			{
				if (_fontInfoMappings.TryGetValue(fontName, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				string safeFontName = GetSafeFontName(fontName);
				if (_fontInfoMappings.TryGetValue(safeFontName, out value))
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
			if (getDefaultFontInfo)
			{
				return _defaultExtendedFontInfo;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, ExtendedFontInfo> PopulateFontInfoMappings()
		{
			Dictionary<string, ExtendedFontInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, ExtendedFontInfo>();
			PrePopulateFontInfoMappings(dictionary);
			try
			{
				PopulateFontInfoMappingsUnsafe(dictionary);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static void PopulateFontInfoMappingsUnsafe(Dictionary<string, ExtendedFontInfo> fontInfoMappings)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			IntPtr intPtr2 = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				intPtr = NativeWindowMethods.GetDC(IntPtr.Zero);
				NativeWindowMethods.LOGFONT structure = new NativeWindowMethods.LOGFONT
				{
					lfCharSet = 1
				};
				intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf((object)structure));
				Marshal.StructureToPtr((object)structure, intPtr2, fDeleteOld: true);
				PopulateFontInfoMappingsHelper populateFontInfoMappingsHelper = new PopulateFontInfoMappingsHelper(fontInfoMappings);
				NativeWindowMethods.EnumFontFamiliesEx(intPtr, intPtr2, populateFontInfoMappingsHelper.EnumFontFamExProc, IntPtr.Zero, 0u);
			}
			finally
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.ReleaseDC(IntPtr.Zero, intPtr);
				if (intPtr2 != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr2);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void GetListInformation(DocumentRootNode rootNode, out IEnumerable<ListWrapper> listWrappers, out IEnumerable<ListTemplateWrapper> listTemplateWrappers)
		{
			IEnumerable<RichTextStyleBase> styles = rootNode.Styles;
			IEnumerable<RichTextStyleBase> source = styles ?? Enumerable.Empty<RichTextStyleBase>();
			Dictionary<ListTemplate, ListTemplateWrapper> sharedTemplateWrappers = (from t in (from list in rootNode.Lists
					let template = list.Template
					where template != null
					select template).Distinct()
				select new ListTemplateWrapper(t)).ToDictionary((ListTemplateWrapper w) => w.ListTemplate);
			IEnumerable<ListWrapper> enumerable = rootNode.Lists.Select((RichTextList l) => ListWrapper.CreateForSaving(l, rootNode, null, sharedTemplateWrappers));
			Dictionary<string, ListWrapper> listsFromDocumentById = enumerable.ToDictionary((ListWrapper w) => w.List.Id);
			IEnumerable<ListWrapper> first = from listStyle in source.OfType<ListStyle>()
				where listStyle.Template != null
				select ListWrapper.CreateForSaving(new RichTextList
				{
					ListStyleId = listStyle.Id,
					Id = GetUniqueIdForListWrapper("$ListStyle_Num$." + listStyle.Id, listsFromDocumentById)
				}, rootNode, listStyle.Template);
			listWrappers = first.Concat(enumerable).ToList();
			listTemplateWrappers = listWrappers.Select((ListWrapper l) => l.ListTemplateWrapper).Distinct().ToList();
		}

		public static TableCellBorderResolutionFlags GetIgnoreTableAreaCellSettingsBorderResolutionFlag(BorderSide borderSide)
		{
			switch (borderSide)
			{
			case BorderSide.Start:
				return TableCellBorderResolutionFlags.IgnoreTableAreaCellSettingsForStart;
			case BorderSide.Top:
				return TableCellBorderResolutionFlags.IgnoreTableAreaCellSettingsForTop;
			case BorderSide.End:
				return TableCellBorderResolutionFlags.IgnoreTableAreaCellSettingsForEnd;
			case BorderSide.Bottom:
				return TableCellBorderResolutionFlags.IgnoreTableAreaCellSettingsForBottom;
			case BorderSide.BottomRightToTopLeft:
			case BorderSide.BottomLeftToTopRight:
				return TableCellBorderResolutionFlags.None;
			case BorderSide.InsideHorizontal:
			case BorderSide.InsideVertical:
				return TableCellBorderResolutionFlags.None;
			default:
				return TableCellBorderResolutionFlags.None;
			}
		}

		public static RichTextImageFormat? GetImageFormatFromFilePath(string filepath)
		{
			string extension = Path.GetExtension(filepath);
			if (extension != null)
			{
				switch (extension.ToLowerInvariant())
				{
				case ".jpeg":
				case ".jpg":
				case ".jpe":
				case ".jfif":
					return RichTextImageFormat.Jpeg;
				case ".png":
					return RichTextImageFormat.Png;
				case ".gif":
					return RichTextImageFormat.Gif;
				case ".tif":
				case ".tiff":
					return RichTextImageFormat.Tiff;
				case ".emf":
					return RichTextImageFormat.Emf;
				case ".wmf":
					return RichTextImageFormat.Wmf;
				case ".dib":
					return RichTextImageFormat.Dib;
				case ".bmp":
					return RichTextImageFormat.Bmp;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static RichTextImage GetImageToSerialize(this ImageNode node, bool canSerialiazeBothUriAndImage = true, bool preferUri = true)
		{
			string imageUri = node.ImageUri;
			RichTextImage image = node.Image;
			RichTextImage imageResolved = node.ImageResolved;
			if (image == null)
			{
				if (imageResolved == null || canSerialiazeBothUriAndImage)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (imageUri != null)
				{
					if (preferUri)
					{
						return null;
					}
					RichTextImageFormat? imageFormatFromFilePath = GetImageFormatFromFilePath(imageUri);
					if (imageFormatFromFilePath.HasValue && imageFormatFromFilePath.Value != imageResolved.Format)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				return imageResolved;
			}
			if (imageResolved.Format != image.Format)
			{
				return image;
			}
			return imageResolved;
		}

		public static string GetImageUriToSerialize(this ImageNode node, bool canSerialiazeBothUriAndImage = true, bool preferUri = true)
		{
			string imageUri = node.ImageUri;
			if (imageUri == null || canSerialiazeBothUriAndImage)
			{
				return imageUri;
			}
			if (preferUri)
			{
				return imageUri;
			}
			if (node.GetImageToSerialize(canSerialiazeBothUriAndImage, preferUri) == null)
			{
				return imageUri;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string GetSafeFontName(string fontName)
		{
			if (IsFontNameSafe(fontName))
			{
				return fontName;
			}
			try
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<XmlLanguage, string> familyName in new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(fontName).FamilyNames)
				{
					if (IsFontNameSafe(familyName.Value))
					{
						return familyName.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return fontName;
		}

		public static void GetTintAndShadeValues(double? tintMerged, out byte? tint, out byte? shade)
		{
			tint = null;
			shade = null;
			if (tintMerged.HasValue)
			{
				double value = tintMerged.Value;
				if (value <= 0.0)
				{
					shade = (byte)((-1.0 - value) * -255.0);
				}
				else
				{
					tint = (byte)((1.0 - value) * 255.0);
				}
			}
		}

		private static string GetUniqueIdForListWrapper(string baseId, Dictionary<string, ListWrapper> listWrappers)
		{
			string result = baseId;
			int num = 1;
			while (listWrappers.ContainsKey(baseId))
			{
				result = baseId + "_" + num++;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool HasMultipleSelections(DocumentRootNode rootNode)
		{
			return rootNode.HasCustomAttribute("IG_HasMultipleSelections");
		}

		private static bool IsFontNameSafe(string fontName)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < fontName.Length; i++)
			{
				if ((fontName[i] & 0xFF80) != 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsParagraphMarkSelected(ParagraphNode node)
		{
			return !node.HasCustomAttribute("IG_ParagraphMarkUnselected");
		}

		public static double? MergeTintAndShadeValues(byte? tint, byte? shade)
		{
			if (tint.HasValue)
			{
				int? num = tint;
				int num2 = 255;
				if (num.GetValueOrDefault() == num2 && num.HasValue && shade.HasValue)
				{
					return -1.0 - (double)(int)shade.GetValueOrDefault() / -255.0;
				}
				return 1.0 - (double)(int)tint.GetValueOrDefault() / 255.0;
			}
			return -1.0 - (double?)(int?)shade / -255.0;
		}

		public static bool ShouldForceComplexScript(CharacterSettings characterSettings)
		{
			if (characterSettings != null && (characterSettings.UseComplexScriptFormatting == true || characterSettings.RightToLeft == true))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool ShouldIgnoreTableAreaCellSettings(BorderSide borderSide, TableCellBorderResolutionFlags tableCellResolutionFlags)
		{
			TableCellBorderResolutionFlags ignoreTableAreaCellSettingsBorderResolutionFlag = GetIgnoreTableAreaCellSettingsBorderResolutionFlag(borderSide);
			if (ignoreTableAreaCellSettingsBorderResolutionFlag == TableCellBorderResolutionFlags.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (tableCellResolutionFlags & ignoreTableAreaCellSettingsBorderResolutionFlag) == ignoreTableAreaCellSettingsBorderResolutionFlag;
		}

		public static void TransitiveClosureOfUsedStyles(RichTextStyleCollection styles, HashSet<string> usedStyleIdsFromNodes)
		{
			bool flag;
			do
			{
				flag = false;
				foreach (RichTextStyleBase style in styles)
				{
					if (usedStyleIdsFromNodes.Contains(style.Id))
					{
						if (style.BasedOn != null)
						{
							flag |= usedStyleIdsFromNodes.Add(style.BasedOn);
						}
						if (style.LinkedStyle != null)
						{
							flag |= usedStyleIdsFromNodes.Add(style.LinkedStyle);
						}
						if (style is ParagraphStyle { NextParagraphStyleId: not null } paragraphStyle)
						{
							flag |= usedStyleIdsFromNodes.Add(paragraphStyle.NextParagraphStyleId);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			while (flag);
		}

			}
		}

		}

		public static TableAreaSettings GetAreaSettingsAllocated(this TableStyle tableStyle, TableArea area)
		{
			AreaSpecificSettings areaSpecificSettingsAllocated = tableStyle.GetAreaSpecificSettingsAllocated();

		}

		public static string GetCustomAttribute(this NodeBase node, string attributeName)
		{
			if (!node.HasCustomAttributes)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (NodeAttribute customAttribute in node.CustomAttributes)
			{
				if (customAttribute.Name == attributeName)
				{
					return customAttribute.Value;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool HasCustomAttribute(this NodeBase node, string attributeName)
		{
			if (node.HasCustomAttributes)
			{
				return node.CustomAttributes.Any((NodeAttribute n) => n.Name == attributeName);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void TryAddChildNode(this NodeBase parentNode, NodeBase childNode)
		{
			if (childNode != null)
			{
				parentNode.ChildNodes.Add(childNode);
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum BorderSide : byte
	{
		Start,
		Top,
		End,
		Bottom,
		BottomRightToTopLeft,
		BottomLeftToTopRight,
		InsideHorizontal,
		InsideVertical
	}
	internal struct CharacterRange
	{
		public readonly char Start;

		public readonly char End;

		public CharacterRange(char start, char end)
		{
			Start = start;
			End = end;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			CharacterRange? characterRange = obj as CharacterRange?;
			if (!characterRange.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (characterRange.Value.Start == Start)
			{
				return characterRange.Value.End == End;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)(((uint)Start << 16) | End);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return (int)Start + " - " + (int)End;
		}

		public bool Contains(char c)
		{
			if (Start <= c)
			{
				return c <= End;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal enum CharacterType : byte
	{
		Ascii,
		HighAnsi,
		EastAsian,
		ComplexScript
	}
	internal class ExtendedFontInfo
	{
		public readonly List<int> CharSets;

		public readonly FontFamilyInternal FontFamilyInternal;

		public readonly RtfFontPitch FontPitch;

		public ExtendedFontInfo(FontFamilyInternal fontFamilyInternal, RtfFontPitch fontPitch, int charSet)
		{
			CharSets = new List<int> { charSet };
			FontFamilyInternal = fontFamilyInternal;
			FontPitch = fontPitch;
		}

		public ExtendedFontInfo(FontFamilyInternal fontFamilyInternal, RtfFontPitch fontPitch, params int[] charSets)
		{
			CharSets = new List<int>(charSets);
			FontFamilyInternal = fontFamilyInternal;
			FontPitch = fontPitch;
		}

		public void AddCharSet(int charSet)
		{
			if (!CharSets.Contains(charSet))
			{
				CharSets.Add(charSet);
			}
		}
	}

	}
	internal static class RichTextSingleton<T> where T : RichTextObjectBase, new()
	{
		internal static readonly T Instance;

		static RichTextSingleton()
		{
			T val = new T();
			val.Seal();
			Instance = val;
		}
	}

	}
	internal class TableRowSerializationContext
	{
		private readonly Extent _cellSpacing;

		private int _currentColumnIndex;

		private readonly TableGrid _grid;

		public readonly TableExtent? LeadingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth;

		public readonly Extent LeadingEmptyAreaWidth;

		public readonly int LeadingEmptyCellCount;

		public Extent NextCellLeftEdge;

		public readonly Extent TableLeftOffset;

		public readonly TableExtent? TrailingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth;

		public readonly Extent TrailingEmptyAreaWidth;

		public readonly int TrailingEmptyCellCount;

		public TableRowSerializationContext(TableNode table, TableRowNode currentRow, Extent? tableLeftOffset)
		{
			_grid = table.Grid;
			_cellSpacing = currentRow.TableSettingsResolved.CellSpacing ?? new Extent(0.0);
			TableColumnsCollection columns = _grid.Columns;
			TableRowSettings tableRowSettings = currentRow.Settings ?? new TableRowSettings();
			LeadingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth = tableRowSettings.LeadingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth;
			LeadingEmptyCellCount = Math.Min(tableRowSettings.LeadingEmptyCellCount ?? 0, columns.Count);
			TrailingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth = tableRowSettings.TrailingEmptyAreaPreferredWidth;
			TrailingEmptyCellCount = Math.Min(tableRowSettings.TrailingEmptyCellCount ?? 0, columns.Count);
			LeadingEmptyAreaWidth = new Extent(0.0);
			for (int i = 0; i < LeadingEmptyCellCount; i++)
			{
				LeadingEmptyAreaWidth += columns[i].Width;
			}
			TrailingEmptyAreaWidth = new Extent(0.0);
			for (int j = 0; j < TrailingEmptyCellCount; j++)
			{
				TrailingEmptyAreaWidth += columns[columns.Count - j - 1].Width;
			}
			TableLeftOffset = tableLeftOffset ?? CalculateTableLeftOffset(currentRow);
			NextCellLeftEdge = TableLeftOffset + LeadingEmptyAreaWidth;
			_currentColumnIndex = LeadingEmptyCellCount;
		}

		public void OnCellSerialized(TableCellNode cell, out int columnSpan)
		{
			columnSpan = cell.SettingsResolved.ColumnSpan ?? 1;
			for (int i = 0; i < columnSpan; i++)
			{
				if (_grid.Columns.Count <= _currentColumnIndex)
				{
					break;
				}
				NextCellLeftEdge += _grid.Columns[_currentColumnIndex++].Width;
				NextCellLeftEdge += 2.0 * _cellSpacing;
			}
			NodeBase parent = cell.Parent;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				if (cell == parent.ChildNodes[0])
				{
					NextCellLeftEdge += _cellSpacing;
				}
				if (cell == parent.ChildNodes[parent.ChildNodes.Count - 1])
				{
					NextCellLeftEdge += _cellSpacing;
				}
			}
		}

		private Extent CalculateTableLeftOffset(TableRowNode row)
		{
			Extent extent = row.TableSettingsResolved.TableIndent ?? new Extent(0.0);
			TableCellMargins tableCellMargins = null;
			TableBorderSettingsBase tableBorderSettingsBase = null;
			TableCellNode tableCellNode = row.ChildNodes.OfType<TableCellNode>().FirstOrDefault();
			if (tableCellNode != null)
			{
				tableBorderSettingsBase = tableCellNode.SettingsResolved.Borders;
				tableCellMargins = tableCellNode.SettingsResolved.Margins;
			}
			else
			{
				tableBorderSettingsBase = row.TableSettingsResolved.Borders;
				tableCellMargins = row.TableSettingsResolved.CellMargins;
			}
			if (tableCellMargins == null)
			{
				tableCellMargins = new TableCellMargins();
			}
			if (tableBorderSettingsBase == null)
			{
				tableBorderSettingsBase = new TableCellBorderSettings();
			}
			Extent extent2 = (tableCellMargins.Start ?? new Extent(0.0)) - extent + 2.0 * _cellSpacing;
			RichTextBorder richTextBorder = tableBorderSettingsBase.Start ?? new RichTextBorder();
			return -(extent2 + richTextBorder.BorderThickness);
		}
	}
}
